bullocks-oriole.name: Bullocks Oriole
bullocks-oriole.description: The Bullocks oriole is a bright orange and black songbird of western North America that weaves hanging basket nests.
bullocks-oriole.funFact: Les orioles de Bullock tissent des nids en panier pendus élaborés qui pendent des branches d'arbres.

barn-swallow.name: Barn Swallow
barn-swallow.description: The barn swallow is the most widespread swallow species in the world with a distinctive deeply forked tail.
barn-swallow.funFact: Les hirondelles rustiques migrent jusqu'à 9 600 km entre leurs zones de reproduction et d'hivernage.

tree-swallow.name: Tree Swallow
tree-swallow.description: The tree swallow is a small, iridescent blue-green swallow with white underparts.
tree-swallow.funFact: Les hirondelles bicolores sont l'un des rares passereaux d'Amérique du Nord capables de digérer les baies, leur permettant de migrer plus tôt au printemps.

cliff-swallow.name: Cliff Swallow
cliff-swallow.description: The cliff swallow is a small swallow with a pale rump and squared-off tail that builds enclosed mud nests in colonies.
cliff-swallow.funFact: Les hirondelles à front blanc construisent des nids de boue en forme de calebasse en colonies pouvant compter des centaines d'individus.

purple-martin.name: Purple Martin
purple-martin.description: The purple martin is the largest North American swallow with iridescent purple-blue plumage in males.
purple-martin.funFact: Les hirondelles pourpres sont presque entièrement dépendantes des nichoirs fournis par les humains dans l'est des États-Unis.

bank-swallow.name: Bank Swallow
bank-swallow.description: The bank swallow is the smallest swallow in North America, nesting in burrows excavated in sandy banks near water.
bank-swallow.funFact: Les hirondelles de rivage sont la plus petite espèce d'hirondelle d'Amérique du Nord et nichent dans des terriers creusés dans les berges sableuses.

violet-green-swallow.name: Violet-green Swallow
violet-green-swallow.description: The violet-green swallow is a small, colorful swallow with iridescent green and violet upperparts.
violet-green-swallow.funFact: Les hirondelles à face violette ont des taches blanches sur leur visage qui s'enroulent jusqu'à l'arrière de leur tête.

chimney-swift.name: Chimney Swift
chimney-swift.description: The chimney swift is a cigar-shaped, dark gray bird that spends most of its life on the wing.
chimney-swift.funFact: Les martinets ramoneurs peuvent passer presque toute leur vie en l'air, dormant même en volant.

common-nighthawk.name: Common Nighthawk
common-nighthawk.description: The common nighthawk is a nocturnal bird that feeds on flying insects caught during acrobatic aerial displays.
common-nighthawk.funFact: Les engoulevents d'Amérique ont de minuscules plumes autour de leur bouche qui forment un large entonnoir pour attraper les insectes en vol.

eastern-whip-poor-will.name: Eastern Whip-poor-will
eastern-whip-poor-will.description: The eastern whip-poor-will is a nocturnal bird named for its distinctive three-part call.
eastern-whip-poor-will.funFact: Les engoulevents boisés peuvent chanter jusqu'à 400 fois par heure, répétant leur cri qui ressemble à leur nom toute la nuit.

greater-roadrunner.name: Greater Roadrunner
greater-roadrunner.description: The greater roadrunner is a large, ground-dwelling cuckoo of the American deserts known for its X-shaped tail.
greater-roadrunner.funFact: Les géocoucous peuvent courir à des vitesses allant jusqu'à 32 km/h et peuvent vivre sans boire d'eau.

yellow-billed-cuckoo.name: Yellow-billed Cuckoo
yellow-billed-cuckoo.description: The yellow-billed cuckoo is a slim, long-tailed bird with a curved yellow bill that feeds on caterpillars.
yellow-billed-cuckoo.funFact: Les coucous à bec jaune sont parfois appelés coucous de la pluie parce qu'ils crient plus fréquemment avant les orages.

hoopoe.name: Eurasian Hoopoe
hoopoe.description: The Eurasian hoopoe is a distinctive bird with cinnamon plumage, black and white wing bars, and a spectacular erectile crest.
hoopoe.funFact: L'huppe fasciée a une crête spectaculaire en forme d'éventail qu'elle relève lorsqu'elle est excitée ou alarmée.

tawny-frogmouth.name: Tawny Frogmouth
tawny-frogmouth.description: The tawny frogmouth is a nocturnal bird of Australia with cryptic plumage that perfectly camouflages it against tree bark.
tawny-frogmouth.funFact: Les podarges fauves sont souvent confondus avec des hiboux mais sont en réalité plus étroitement liés aux engoulevents.

common-potoo.name: Common Potoo
common-potoo.description: The common potoo is a nocturnal bird of Central and South American forests with an enormous mouth and cryptic plumage.
common-potoo.funFact: Les ibijaux à gorge blanche sont perchés droites sur les branches pendant la journée, ressemblant exactement à une souche d'arbre cassée.

american-goldfinch.name: American Goldfinch
american-goldfinch.description: The American goldfinch is a small, bright yellow songbird with black wings and cap, one of the latest-nesting birds in North America.
american-goldfinch.funFact: Les chardonnerets jaunes sont l'un des derniers oiseaux à nichent, ne se reproduisant souvent qu'à la fin juillet.

pine-grosbeak.name: Pine Grosbeak
pine-grosbeak.description: The pine grosbeak is a large, plump finch with rosy-pink plumage in males. Found in boreal forests across North America.
pine-grosbeak.funFact: Les pinsons du pin sont l'un des oiseaux boréaux les plus apprivoisés, permettant souvent une approche rapprochée.

evening-grosbeak.name: Evening Grosbeak
evening-grosbeak.description: The evening grosbeak is a large, stocky finch with a massive conical bill and bright yellow body in males.
evening-grosbeak.funFact: Les pinsons du soir sont des migrants irruptifs, apparaissant en grand nombre loin au sud de leur aire normale certaines années.

cassins-finch.name: Cassins Finch
cassins-finch.description: The Cassins finch is a medium-sized finch with rosy-red crown and pinkish wash on the breast, found in mountain forests.
cassins-finch.funFact: Le pinson de Cassin est l'espèce d'oiseau nord-américain décrite le plus récemment, non reconnue avant 1861.

red-crossbill.name: Red Crossbill
red-crossbill.description: The red crossbill is a finch with a uniquely crossed bill adapted for extracting seeds from conifer cones.
red-crossbill.funFact: Le bec-croisé des sapins a des mandibules croisées de façon unique spécialement adaptées pour extraire les graines des cônes de conifères.

pine-siskin.name: Pine Siskin
pine-siskin.description: The pine siskin is a small, streaky brown finch with yellow edging on its wings and tail, an irruptive species.
pine-siskin.funFact: Les linottes des pins peuvent porter des bactéries salmonella sans tomber malades, ce qui peut être transmis aux oiseaux de jardin aux mangeoires.

common-redpoll.name: Common Redpoll
common-redpoll.description: The common redpoll is a tiny, streaky finch with a distinctive red cap and pink breast, breeding in Arctic tundra.
common-redpoll.funFact: Les linottes cannay peuvent survivre à des températures de -51 °C en mangeant des graines et en gonflant leurs plumes.

hoary-redpoll.name: Hoary Redpoll
hoary-redpoll.description: The hoary redpoll is a tiny Arctic finch, paler and frostier-looking than the common redpoll.
hoary-redpoll.funFact: La linotte des neiges est l'un des passereaux les plus résistants, vivant plus au nord que presque tout autre passériforme.

house-finch.name: House Finch
house-finch.description: The house finch is a small songbird common in urban and suburban areas with red or orange plumage in males.
house-finch.funFact: Les mâles des pinsons des maisons obtiennent leur couleur rouge des pigments de leur régime alimentaire de baies et de fruits.

purple-finch.name: Purple Finch
purple-finch.description: The purple finch is a medium-sized finch with rosy-red plumage in males and streaked brown in females.
purple-finch.funFact: Roger Tory Peterson a décrit les mâles des pinsons pourpres comme trempés dans du jus de framboise.

eastern-wood-pewee.name: Eastern Wood-Pewee
eastern-wood-pewee.description: The eastern wood-pewee is a small flycatcher with olive-gray plumage and a distinctive, plaintive whistle.
eastern-wood-pewee.funFact: Le cri de l'ylobe du bois est si distinctif que l'espèce a été nommée d'après son chant.

great-crested-flycatcher.name: Great Crested Flycatcher
great-crested-flycatcher.description: The great crested flycatcher is a large, yellow-bellied flycatcher with a distinctive crest. It always includes snakeskin in its nest.
great-crested-flycatcher.funFact: Les moucherolles à huppe incorporent toujours de la peau de serpent dans le matériel de leur nid.

eastern-kingbird.name: Eastern Kingbird
eastern-kingbird.description: The eastern kingbird is a bold flycatcher with dark gray upperparts and a distinctive white tip on its tail.
eastern-kingbird.funFact: Les tyrantraques de l'Est sont nommés pour leur comportement territorial agressif, attaquant des oiseaux beaucoup plus grands qu'eux.

eastern-phoebe.name: Eastern Phoebe
eastern-phoebe.description: The eastern phoebe is a small, brownish-gray flycatcher that bobs its tail frequently and often nests on human structures.
eastern-phoebe.funFact: La moucherolle de l'Est a été le premier oiseau jamais bagué en Amérique du Nord, par Audubon en 1840.

willow-flycatcher.name: Willow Flycatcher
willow-flycatcher.description: The willow flycatcher is a small, inconspicuous flycatcher best known for its distinctive fitz-bew song.
willow-flycatcher.funFact: Les moucherolles des saules sont virtuellement identiques à plusieurs autres moucherolles du genre Empidonax et sont mieux identifiés par leur cri distinctif FITZ-bew.

scissor-tailed-flycatcher.name: Scissor-tailed Flycatcher
scissor-tailed-flycatcher.description: The scissor-tailed flycatcher is a distinctive flycatcher with extremely long, forked tail feathers. It is the state bird of Oklahoma.
scissor-tailed-flycatcher.funFact: Les longues plumes de la queue de la moucherolle à forked tail peuvent être deux fois plus longues que son corps.

vermilion-flycatcher.name: Vermilion Flycatcher
vermilion-flycatcher.description: The vermilion flycatcher is a small, vividly colored flycatcher with males displaying brilliant red plumage and a black mask.
vermilion-flycatcher.funFact: La moucherolle vermillon est l'une des moucherolles les plus brillamment colorées de l'hémisphère occidental.

common-merganser.name: Common Merganser
common-merganser.description: The common merganser is a large diving duck with a reddish-brown crested head in females and a dark green head in males. It feeds primarily on fish.
common-merganser.funFact: Les harles huppés ont des becs dentés qui les aident à saisir les poissons glissants en plongeant sous l'eau.

hooded-merganser.name: Hooded Merganser
hooded-merganser.description: The hooded merganser is a small, striking diving duck. Males have a bold black and white fan-shaped crest with a rusty flank patch.
hooded-merganser.funFact: Les harles huppés ont la huppe la plus grande par rapport à la taille du corps de tout canard, qu'ils relèvent et abaissent à volonté.

bufflehead.name: Bufflehead
bufflehead.description: The bufflehead is a small, compact diving duck. Males have a striking iridescent green and purple head with large white patches.
bufflehead.funFact: Les.harles bigenés sont les plus petits canards plongeurs d'Amérique du Nord et nichent souvent dans d'anciens trous de pics.

common-goldeneye.name: Common Goldeneye
common-goldeneye.description: The common goldeneye is a medium-sized diving duck with a distinctive round head. Males have a dark green-black head with a white circular patch near the bill.
common-goldeneye.funFact: Les fuligules à tête blanche couvrent leurs œufs avec des plumes détachées de leur propre ventre.

ring-necked-duck.name: Ring-necked Duck
ring-necked-duck.description: The ring-necked duck is a medium-sized diving duck with a distinctive peaked head shape. Males have a black back, gray flanks, and a white breast with a subtle neck ring.
ring-necked-duck.funFact: Malgré son nom, le collier du fuligule à collier est rarement visible sur le terrain.

gadwall.name: Gadwall
gadwall.description: The gadwall is a dabbling duck with subtle but elegant plumage. Males are mostly gray with black rear ends, while females are mottled brown.
gadwall.funFact: Le canard chipeau est souvent appelé canard ordinaire, mais les mâles ont un motif élégant de fine vermiculation visible de près.

blue-winged-teal.name: Blue-winged Teal
blue-winged-teal.description: The blue-winged teal is a small dabbling duck. Males have a slate-blue head with a white crescent in front of the eye. It is one of the earliest migrating ducks.
blue-winged-teal.funFact: Les sarcelles à ailes bleues sont parmi les premiers migrants printaniers et les derniers migrants automnaux d'Amérique du Nord.

crested-caracara.name: Crested Caracara
crested-caracara.description: The crested caracara is a distinctive raptor with a black cap, white neck, and orange face. Despite being in the falcon family, it scavenges and forages on the ground.
crested-caracara.funFact: Les caracaras huppés sont membres de la famille des faucons mais se comportent davantage comme des vautours, charognant souvent.

palm-nut-vulture.name: Palm-nut Vulture
palm-nut-vulture.description: The palm-nut vulture is a unique raptor of West African palm forests that feeds mainly on the fruit of the oil palm.
palm-nut-vulture.funFact: Le vautour palmiste est la seule espèce de vautour qui se nourrit principalement de matière végétale, en particulier de fruits de palmier.

black-vulture.name: Black Vulture
black-vulture.description: The black vulture is a common New World vulture with black plumage and a bare, dark head. It soars in groups looking for carcasses.
black-vulture.funFact: Les vautours ont une excellente vue et utilisent également leur odorat pour localiser la charogne.

roseate-spoonbill.name: Roseate Spoonbill
roseate-spoonbill.description: The roseate spoonbill is a large, pink wading bird with a distinctive spatulate bill. It feeds by sweeping its bill through shallow water.
roseate-spoonbill.funFact: Les spatules roses balayent leurs becs en forme de spatule de droite et de gauche dans les eaux peu profondes pour attraper de petits poissons et des crustacés.

wood-stork.name: Wood Stork
wood-stork.description: The wood stork is a large, white wading bird with a dark, featherless head and a long, curved bill. It is the only stork species breeding in the United States.
wood-stork.funFact: Les maguari sont la seule espèce de cigogne qui se reproduit en Amérique du Nord et utilisent la chasse tactile pour attraper des proies.

white-ibis.name: White Ibis
white-ibis.description: The white ibis is a medium-sized wading bird with white plumage, black wing tips, and a distinctive long, curved pink bill.
white-ibis.funFact: Les ibis blancs sonnent la boue avec leurs becs longs et courbés et peuvent détecter des proies uniquement par le toucher.

limpkin.name: Limpkin
limpkin.description: The limpkin is a large, brown wading bird with white spotting. It is specialized in feeding on apple snails and has a distinctive wailing call.
limpkin.funFact: Les courlitous sont des mangeurs spécialisés de pomures de mer, avec des becs spécialement adaptés pour extraire les escargots de leurs coquilles.

rusty-blackbird.name: Rusty Blackbird
rusty-blackbird.description: The rusty blackbird is a medium-sized blackbird that breeds in boreal wetlands and winters in the southeastern United States. Males are glossy black with rust-colored edges on feathers in fall.
rusty-blackbird.funFact: Le carouge roux a diminué de plus de 90 % au cours des 50 dernières années, ce qui en fait l'un des oiseaux en déclin le plus rapide d'Amérique du Nord.

blue-tang.name: Blue Tang
blue-tang.description: The blue tang is a striking royal blue fish with a bright yellow tail and black markings. Found throughout the Indo-Pacific, it feeds primarily on algae and plays an important role in keeping coral reefs healthy.
blue-tang.funFact: Les chirurgiens bleus peuvent se rendre presque invisibles la nuit en changeant de couleur.

mandarinfish.name: Mandarinfish
mandarinfish.description: The mandarinfish is a small, incredibly colorful reef fish with vivid blue, orange, and green patterns. It produces a toxic mucus coating that deters predators and gives it a distinctive smell.
mandarinfish.funFact: Les poissons mandarins sont l'un des deux seuls vertébrés connus pour produire un pigment bleu.

sixbar-wrasse.name: Sixbar Wrasse
sixbar-wrasse.description: The sixbar wrasse is a slender reef fish with distinctive dark vertical bars across its body. Found throughout the Indo-Pacific, it feeds on small crustaceans and fish.
sixbar-wrasse.funFact: Les labres à six bandes peuvent changer de sexe de femelle à mâle pendant leur durée de vie.

yellowtail-coris.name: Yellowtail Coris
yellowtail-coris.description: The yellowtail coris is a colorful wrasse found in coral reefs across the Indo-Pacific. Adults have a green body with yellow tail and red spots, while juveniles are orange.
yellowtail-coris.funFact: Les jeunes labres jaune-queue ressemblent complètement différent des adultes avec des taches orange et blanches.

bicolor-angelfish.name: Bicolor Angelfish
bicolor-angelfish.description: The bicolor angelfish features a striking split coloration of dark blue-black on the front half and bright yellow on the rear half. Found in Caribbean reefs, it feeds on algae.
bicolor-angelfish.funFact: Les demoiselles bicolores peuvent émettre des sons de claquement forts pour la communication.

flame-angelfish.name: Flame Angelfish
flame-angelfish.description: The flame angelfish is a brilliant orange-red fish with black vertical bars native to the Pacific. It is one of the most popular marine aquarium fish.
flame-angelfish.funFact: Les demoiselles flamme peuvent devenir agressives lorsqu'elles sont maintenus dans de petits aquariums.

queen-angelfish.name: Queen Angelfish
queen-angelfish.description: The queen angelfish is a large, stunningly colorful reef fish with blue, yellow, and green hues. Found throughout the tropical western Atlantic, it feeds primarily on sponges.
queen-angelfish.funFact: Les demoiselles reine doivent leur nom à un anneau bleu foncé sur leur front ressemblant à une couronne.

french-angelfish.name: French Angelfish
french-angelfish.description: The French angelfish is a striking black fish with bright yellow-edged scales found in Caribbean reefs. Young individuals are bright yellow but darken as adults.
french-angelfish.funFact: Les demoiselles françaises sont souvent vues en paires monogames et voyagent ensemble pour la vie.

regal-tang.name: Regal Tang
regal-tang.description: The regal tang, also known as the palette surgeonfish, is a bright blue fish with a yellow tail and black markings. Found across the Indo-Pacific.
regal-tang.funFact: Les chirurgiens ont une épine rétractable près de leur queue qui peut infliger des blessures douloureuses.

sohal-surgeonfish.name: Sohal Surgeonfish
sohal-surgeonfish.description: The sohal surgeonfish is a large, gray-blue reef fish with horizontal stripes and sharp scalpel-like spines on its tail. Native to the Red Sea and Persian Gulf.
sohal-surgeonfish.funFact: Les chirurgiens du sont extrêmement territoriaux et attaqueront les plongeurs qui pénètrent dans leur espace.

moorish-idol.name: Moorish Idol
moorish-idol.description: The Moorish idol is one of the most recognizable reef fish with its dramatic black, white, and yellow coloration and a long flowing dorsal fin filament.
moorish-idol.funFact: Les zanclidae sont notoirement difficiles à garder en captivité et survivent rarement longtemps dans les aquariums.

royal-gramma.name: Royal Gramma
royal-gramma.description: The royal gramma, or fairy basslet, has a stunning two-tone coloration with bright purple on the front half and yellow on the rear half. Found in Caribbean caves.
royal-gramma.funFact: Les grammes royaux se suspendent souvent la tête en bas sous des rebords rocheux.

longnose-butterflyfish.name: Longnose Butterflyfish
longnose-butterflyfish.description: The longnose butterflyfish is a slender reef fish with a distinctive elongated snout and yellow body with a dark eye band.
longnose-butterflyfish.funFact: Le poisson-papillon à long nez utilise son museau allongé pour atteindre les crevasses coralliennes à la recherche de nourriture.

copperband-butterflyfish.name: Copperband Butterflyfish
copperband-butterflyfish.description: The copperband butterflyfish has a striking pattern of vertical orange bands with black edges on a silver-white body.
copperband-butterflyfish.funFact: Les poissons-papillons à bandes de cuivre ont une fausse tache près de leur queue pour tromper les prédateurs.

foureye-butterflyfish.name: Foureye Butterflyfish
foureye-butterflyfish.description: The foureye butterflyfish gets its name from the prominent black eye spot on each side near its tail, confusing predators.
foureye-butterflyfish.funFact: Les poissons-papillons à quatre yeux ont de grandes taches qui font penser aux prédateurs que leur queue est leur tête.

bluegill.name: Bluegill
bluegill.description: The bluegill is a freshwater sunfish native to eastern North America. It has an olive-green body with a distinctive dark spot on the ear flap.
bluegill.funFact: Les oreochromis mâles construisent des nids circulaires dans les eaux peu profondes et gardent férocement les œufs.

largemouth-bass.name: Largemouth Bass
largemouth-bass.description: The largemouth bass is the largest of the black basses and the most popular freshwater game fish in North America.
largemouth-bass.funFact: Les black bass à grande bouche peuvent ouvrir la bouche assez large pour avaler des proies presque la moitié de leur taille.

smallmouth-bass.name: Smallmouth Bass
smallmouth-bass.description: The smallmouth bass is a freshwater fish prized by anglers for its aggressive fighting style.
smallmouth-bass.funFact: Les black bass à petite bouche sont connus pour leur capacité de combat et sont appelés « brownies » ou « bronzebacks ».

rainbow-trout.name: Rainbow Trout
rainbow-trout.description: The rainbow trout is a coldwater fish with an olive-green body and a distinctive pinkish-red stripe along its side.
rainbow-trout.funFact: Les truite arc-en-ciel peuvent changer l'intensité de leur couleur en fonction de leur environnement et de leur humeur.

brook-trout.name: Brook Trout
brook-trout.description: The brook trout, also called speckled trout, has a dark green body with light spots and red spots with blue halos.
brook-trout.funFact: Les truites de ruisseau sont la seule truite native de la majeure partie de l'est de l'Amérique du Nord.

atlantic-salmon.name: Atlantic Salmon
atlantic-salmon.description: The Atlantic salmon is an anadromous fish born in freshwater, migrates to the ocean, and returns to freshwater to spawn.
atlantic-salmon.funFact: Les saumons atlantiques peuvent sauter des cascades et des barrages pendant leur migration de frai vers l'amont.

chinook-salmon.name: Chinook Salmon
chinook-salmon.description: The Chinook salmon, also called king salmon, is the largest Pacific salmon with a greenish back and dark spots.
chinook-salmon.funFact: Les saumons chinook sont les plus grands de toutes les espèces de saumons du Pacifique.

coho-salmon.name: Coho Salmon
coho-salmon.description: The coho salmon, also known as silver salmon, has a silver body with black spots and is found throughout the North Pacific.
coho-salmon.funFact: Les saumons coho deviennent rouge vif avec des mâchoires crochutées pendant la saison de frai.

pacific-bluefin-tuna.name: Pacific Bluefin Tuna
pacific-bluefin-tuna.description: The Pacific bluefin tuna is a large, fast, pelagic fish found throughout the Pacific Ocean, highly prized in sushi markets.
pacific-bluefin-tuna.funFact: Les thons rouges du Pacifique peuvent traverser tout l'océan Pacifique en moins de 60 jours.

yellowfin-tuna.name: Yellowfin Tuna
yellowfin-tuna.description: The yellowfin tuna is a large, streamlined ocean fish with bright yellow dorsal and anal fins found in tropical oceans worldwide.
yellowfin-tuna.funFact: Les thons jaunes peuvent nager à des vitesses allant jusqu'à 64 km/h en rafales courtes.

atlantic-cod.name: Atlantic Cod
atlantic-cod.description: The Atlantic cod is a large, cold-water fish with a distinctive chin barbel and three dorsal fins, once one of the most important food fish in the world.
atlantic-cod.funFact: Les morues de l'Atlantique peuvent détecter leurs proies par électroréception même dans l'eau trouble.

atlantic-grouper.name: Atlantic Grouper
atlantic-grouper.description: The Atlantic grouper is a large, robust reef fish with a wide mouth and thick lips found in warm Atlantic waters.
atlantic-grouper.funFact: Les mérous peuvent inhaler des proies entières en ouvrant soudainement leur large bouche.

goliath-grouper.name: Goliath Grouper
goliath-grouper.description: The goliath grouper is the largest bony fish in the Western Atlantic, reaching weights of up to 800 pounds.
goliath-grouper.funFact: Les mérous géants sont si grands qu'ils peuvent peser autant qu'une petite voiture.

red-snapper.name: Red Snapper
red-snapper.description: The red snapper is a bright red reef fish found in the Gulf of Mexico and western Atlantic.
red-snapper.funFact: Les vivaneaux rouges peuvent vivre plus de 50 ans, ce qui en fait l'une des espèces de vivaneaux les plus longévives.

mahi-mahi.name: Mahi-Mahi
mahi-mahi.description: The mahi-mahi is a brightly colored pelagic fish with a golden-green body and blue fins found in tropical oceans.
mahi-mahi.funFact: Les coryphènes sont aussi appelés dorades ou dauphins, à ne pas confondre avec les dauphins.

wahoo.name: Wahoo
wahoo.description: The wahoo is a large, fast pelagic fish related to mackerels with a sleek, torpedo-shaped body and vertical blue bars.
wahoo.funFact: Les auas sont parmi les poissons les plus rapides de l'océan, capables d'atteindre des vitesses allant jusqu'à 80 km/h.

sailfish.name: Sailfish
sailfish.description: The sailfish is a large billfish with a spectacular high dorsal fin resembling a sail, found in tropical oceans worldwide.
sailfish.funFact: Les voiliers sont considérés comme les poissons les plus rapides de l'océan, atteignant des vitesses allant jusqu'à 110 km/h.

blue-marlin.name: Blue Marlin
blue-marlin.description: The blue marlin is one of the largest ocean fish with a distinctive blue upper body and silver-white belly found in tropical Atlantic waters.
blue-marlin.funFact: Les marlins bleus peuvent peser plus de 450 kg et sont parmi les plus grands poissons osseux du monde.

nassau-grouper.name: Nassau Grouper
nassau-grouper.description: The Nassau grouper is a large reef fish capable of rapid color changes, now critically endangered from overfishing.
nassau-grouper.funFact: Les mérous de Nassau peuvent changer de couleur en quelques secondes pour s'adapter à leur environnement.

striped-bass.name: Striped Bass
striped-bass.description: The striped bass is a silver fish with distinctive horizontal dark stripes found along the Atlantic coast.
striped-bass.funFact: Les bar rayés sont anadromes et peuvent parcourir des centaines de kilomètres pour frayer.

red-drum.name: Red Drum
red-drum.description: The red drum, also called redfish, is a copper-bronze fish with a distinctive black spot near the tail.
red-drum.funFact: Les tambours rouges sont aussi appelés tambours de canal et sont le poisson officiel de l'État de la Caroline du Nord.

black-drum.name: Black Drum
black-drum.description: The black drum is a large, dark fish with barbels on its chin that can grow to over 100 pounds.
black-drum.funFact: Les tambours noirs peuvent produire des sons de tambour forts en utilisant des muscles de leur vessie natatoire.

channel-catfish.name: Channel Catfish
channel-catfish.description: The channel catfish is the most fished catfish species in North America with a forked tail and whisker-like barbels.
channel-catfish.funFact: Les silures en canal ont des bourgeons du goût couvrant tout leur corps et peuvent goûter la nourriture de loin.

blue-catfish.name: Blue Catfish
blue-catfish.description: The blue catfish is the largest species of North American catfish reaching weights of over 100 pounds.
blue-catfish.funFact: Les silures bleus peuvent dépasser 45 kg et sont les plus grands poissons d'eau douce d'Amérique du Nord.

walking-catfish.name: Walking Catfish
walking-catfish.description: The walking catfish is a freshwater catfish native to Southeast Asia that can breathe air and move across land.
walking-catfish.funFact: Les silures marcheurs peuvent survivre hors de l'eau pendant des heures et utilisent leurs nageoires pectorales pour marcher sur la terre.

wels-catfish.name: Wels Catfish
wels-catfish.description: The wels catfish is the largest freshwater fish in Europe reaching lengths of over 16 feet with a wide, flat head.
wels-catfish.funFact: Il a été rapporté que les silures glane peuvent croître à plus de 5 mètres de long dans de rares cas.

eurasian-pike.name: Eurasian Pike
eurasian-pike.description: The Eurasian pike is a large, ambush predator found throughout Europe, Asia, and northern North America.
eurasian-pike.funFact: Les brochets peuvent accélérer de 0 à 32 km/h en moins d'un dixième de seconde.

muskellunge.name: Muskellunge
muskellunge.description: The muskellunge, or muskie, is the largest freshwater fish in the pike family found in clear lakes and rivers of North America.
muskellunge.funFact: Les maskinongés sont aussi appelés masques et sont le plus grand membre de la famille des brochets.

walleye.name: Walleye
walleye.description: The walleye is a freshwater fish named for its distinctive, glassy eyes that reflect light found in cool, clear lakes.
walleye.funFact: Les dorés ont une couche réfléchissante appelée tapis tapetum lucidum qui fait briller leurs yeux la nuit.

common-carp.name: Common Carp
common-carp.description: The common carp is a large, golden-brown freshwater fish found throughout the world, originally from Eurasia.
common-carp.funFact: Les carpes communes sont considérées comme l'une des espèces de poissons envahissantes les plus influentes au monde.

grass-carp.name: Grass Carp
grass-carp.description: The grass carp is a large freshwater fish native to eastern Asia that feeds almost exclusively on aquatic plants.
grass-carp.funFact: Les carpes herbivores peuvent manger jusqu'à 40 % de leur poids corporel en végétation chaque jour.

koi-carp.name: Koi
koi-carp.description: Koi are ornamental varieties of common carp bred for their vibrant colors and patterns from Japan.
koi-carp.funFact: Le plus cher koi jamais vendu était un poisson japonais nommé S Legend qui a été vendu 1,8 million de dollars.

tench.name: Tench
tench.description: The tench is a freshwater fish with a thick, slimy body and olive-green to bronze coloration found throughout Europe and Asia.
tench.funFact: Les tanches sécrètent un mucus qui peut cicatriser les blessures chez d'autres poissons.

three-spined-stickleback.name: Three-spined Stickleback
three-spined-stickleback.description: The three-spined stickleback is a small, spiny fish found throughout the Northern Hemisphere, males build intricate nests.
three-spined-stickleback.funFact: Les mâles des épinoches construisent des nids élaborés à partir de plantes aquatiques et ventilent les œufs pour fournir de l'oxygène.

florida-gar.name: Florida Gar
florida-gar.description: The Florida gar is a long, slender predatory fish with an elongated snout and armored scales found in Florida and Georgia.
florida-gar.funFact: Les lépisostées de Floride ont un museau allongé rempli de dents en forme d'aiguille et peuvent respirer l'air.

alligator-gar.name: Alligator Gar
alligator-gar.description: The alligator gar is the largest freshwater fish in North America, reaching over 8 feet long with a long, alligator-like snout.
alligator-gar.funFact: Les œufs de lépisostée alligator sont toxiques pour les humains mais consommés par les Amérindiens après traitement.

bowfin.name: Bowfin
bowfin.description: The bowfin is a primitive freshwater fish with an elongated body and a distinctive long dorsal fin found in eastern North America.
bowfin.funFact: Les amia sont le seul membre survivant d'un ancien ordre de poissons.

chinese-sturgeon.name: Chinese Sturgeon
chinese-sturgeon.description: The Chinese sturgeon is a critically endangered species found only in the Yangtze River that can grow to over 16 feet.
chinese-sturgeon.funFact: Les esturgeons de Chine existent depuis plus de 140 millions d'années et sont appelés fossiles vivants.

atlantic-sturgeon.name: Atlantic Sturgeon
atlantic-sturgeon.description: The Atlantic sturgeon is a large, primitive fish with a prehistoric appearance featuring bony plates instead of scales.
atlantic-sturgeon.funFact: Les esturgeons de l'Atlantique peuvent vivre plus de 100 ans et ont été chassés pour leur caviar.

arctic-char.name: Arctic Char
arctic-char.description: The Arctic char is a cold-water fish related to salmon and trout found in Arctic and subarctic waters.
arctic-char.funFact: Les ombles arctiques sont les poissons d'eau douce les plus septentrionaux du monde.

lake-trout.name: Lake Trout
lake-trout.description: The lake trout is a large, cold-water salmonid found in deep lakes of northern North America with a forked tail.
lake-trout.funFact: Les touladis peuvent vivre plus de 40 ans et croître à plus de 27 kg.

cutthroat-trout.name: Cutthroat Trout
cutthroat-trout.description: The cutthroat trout is a cold-water fish native to western North America, named for red-orange slash marks under its lower jaw.
cutthroat-trout.funFact: Les truites à gorge coupée tirent leur nom de la marque rouge distinctive sous leur mâchoire.

golden-trout.name: Golden Trout
golden-trout.description: The golden trout is a subspecies of rainbow trout found in high-altitude mountain streams of California with golden-yellow body.
golden-trout.funFact: Les truites dorées sont le poisson officiel de l'État de Californie et ne se trouvent que dans quelques ruisseaux isolés.

tiger-shark.name: Tiger Shark
tiger-shark.description: The tiger shark is a large predator with distinctive dark vertical stripes found in tropical and subtropical oceans worldwide.
tiger-shark.funFact: Les requins-tigres sont connus comme les poubelles de la mer parce qu'ils mangent presque tout.

oceanic-whitetip-shark.name: Oceanic Whitetip Shark
oceanic-whitetip-shark.description: The oceanic whitetip shark is a large, slow-moving pelagic shark with distinctive white-tipped fins, critically endangered.
oceanic-whitetip-shark.funFact: Les requins océaniques à pointes blanches étaient responsables de plus de victimes humaines que toute autre espèce pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

blacktip-shark.name: Blacktip Shark
blacktip-shark.description: The blacktip shark is a medium-sized shark with distinctive black tips on all its fins found in warm coastal waters.
blacktip-shark.funFact: Les requins à pointes noires sont connus pour leur comportement de bondissement dramatique, tournant hors de l'eau.

scalloped-hammerhead.name: Scalloped Hammerhead
scalloped-hammerhead.description: The scalloped hammerhead is one of the most common hammerhead species with a distinctive scalloped leading edge on its head.
scalloped-hammerhead.funFact: Les requins-marteaux à lion forment des écoles massives de centaines pendant leur migration annuelle.

thresher-shark.name: Thresher Shark
thresher-shark.description: The thresher shark is a distinctive shark with an extremely long upper tail that can be as long as its body found in open ocean.
thresher-shark.funFact: Les requins renards utilisent leur queue extrêmement longue pour étourdir des bancs de poissons.

basking-shark.name: Basking Shark
basking-shark.description: The basking shark is the second largest fish in the world, filter-feeding on plankton with an enormous mouth over 3 feet wide.
basking-shark.funFact: Les requins pèlerins sont le deuxième plus grand poisson du monde, après les requins-baleines.

nurse-shark.name: Nurse Shark
nurse-shark.description: The nurse shark is a sluggish, bottom-dwelling shark with barbels near its nostrils that help detect prey hidden in sand.
nurse-shark.funFact: Les requins nounous peuvent pomper l'eau sur leurs branchies tout en reposant sur le fond océanique.

zebra-shark.name: Zebra Shark
zebra-shark.description: The zebra shark is a distinctive shark with dark spots on a tan body found on tropical coral reefs of the Indo-Pacific.
zebra-shark.funFact: Les requins zèbres passent d'un motif rayé en tant que juvéniles à un motif tacheté en tant qu'adultes.

epaulette-shark.name: Epaulette Shark
epaulette-shark.description: The epaulette shark is a small reef shark that can walk on its fins across the reef flat found in the Indo-Pacific.
epaulette-shark.funFact: Les requins épaulettes peuvent marcher sur leurs nageoires à travers le platier corallien à marée basse.

angel-shark.name: Angel Shark
angel-shark.description: The angel shark is a flattened shark that lies buried in sand on the ocean floor, critically endangered due to habitat loss.
angel-shark.funFact: Les requins anges peuvent s'enterrer complètement dans le sable pour ambushier les proies qui passent.

southern-stingray.name: Southern Stingray
southern-stingray.description: The southern stingray is a large, diamond-shaped ray found in shallow tropical waters of the western Atlantic.
southern-stingray.funFact: Les raies aigles peuvent infliger un dard venimeux qui peut causer une douleur intense.

cownose-ray.name: Cownose Ray
cownose-ray.description: The cownose ray is a distinctive ray with a unique head shape resembling a cow's nose, forming large schools during migration.
cownose-ray.funFact: Les raies vaches migrent en écoles massives de milliers le long de la côte atlantique.

eagle-ray.name: Spotted Eagle Ray
eagle-ray.description: The spotted eagle ray is a large ray with distinctive white spots on a dark body found in tropical and subtropical oceans.
eagle-ray.funFact: Les aigles de mer tachetés peuvent sauter de plusieurs pieds hors de l'eau.

anglerfish.name: Atlantic Anglerfish
anglerfish.description: The Atlantic anglerfish is a deep-sea fish with a distinctive bioluminescent lure that attracts prey found on the deep ocean floor.
anglerfish.funFact: Utilise un leurre bioluminescent pour attirer ses proies

viperfish.name: Viperfish
viperfish.description: The viperfish is a deep-sea predator with extremely long, needle-like teeth and a bioluminescent photophore along its body.
viperfish.funFact: Les viperfish ont des dents extrêmement longues en forme d'aiguille si longues qu'elles ne tiennent pas dans leur bouche.

gulper-eel.name: Gulper Eel
gulper-eel.description: The gulper eel is a deep-sea fish with an enormous, loosely hinged mouth and a long, whip-like tail found in deep ocean waters.
gulper-eel.funFact: Les anguilles guloir ont des bouches énormes qui peuvent s'ouvrir assez large pour avaler des proies plus grandes qu'elles.

lungfish.name: Lungfish
lungfish.description: The lungfish is a freshwater fish with both gills and primitive lungs, one of the closest living relatives to tetrapods found in Africa, South America, and Australia.
lungfish.funFact: Les dipneustes peuvent respirer l'air et survivre hors de l'eau pendant des mois en s'enfouissant dans la boue.

coelacanth.name: Coelacanth
coelacanth.description: The coelacanth is a living fossil, a lobe-finned fish once thought extinct that was rediscovered off the coast of South Africa in 1938.
coelacanth.funFact: Les cœlacanthes étaient considérés comme éteints depuis 66 millions d'années jusqu'à leur redécouverte en 1938.

red-bellied-piranha.name: Red-bellied Piranha
red-bellied-piranha.description: The red-bellied piranha is a freshwater fish native to South America known for its sharp teeth and powerful jaws found in rivers and lakes.
red-bellied-piranha.funFact: Les piranhas à ventre rouge peuvent dépouiller une carcasse jusqu'à l'os en quelques minutes avec leurs dents tranchantes.

arapaima.name: Arapaima
arapaima.description: The arapaima is one of the largest freshwater fish in the world, reaching lengths of over 10 feet, found in the Amazon basin.
arapaima.funFact: Les arapaimas sont parmi les plus grands poissons d'eau douce du monde et peuvent respirer l'air.

arowana.name: Arowana
arowana.description: The arowana is a freshwater fish with large, metallic scales and an upward-pointing mouth found in tropical rivers of South America, Asia, and Australia.
arowana.funFact: Les arowanas peuvent sauter à 1,80 mètre hors de l'eau pour attraper des proies sur des branches en surplomb.

knifefish.name: Black Ghost Knifefish
knifefish.description: The black ghost knifefish is a freshwater fish with an elongated, laterally compressed body and a distinctive anal fin used for propulsion.
knifefish.funFact: Les poissons-couteaux fantômes noirs utilisent des champs électriques faibles pour naviguer et trouver des proies dans l'eau sombre et trouble.

betta.name: Betta
betta.description: The betta, or Siamese fighting fish, is a small freshwater fish with flowing fins and vibrant colors native to Southeast Asia.
betta.funFact: Les mâles des combattants construisent des nids de bulles à la surface de l'eau pour leurs œufs.

discus.name: Discus
discus.description: The discus is a freshwater fish with a distinctive disc-shaped body found in the Amazon basin, popular in aquariums for its vibrant colors.
discus.funFact: Les discus produisent une sécrétion de mucus que leurs petits consomment pendant les premières semaines.

oscarr.name: Oscar
oscarr.description: The oscar is a large cichlid native to South America with a dark body and orange-red markings, popular in aquariums for its personality.
oscarr.funFact: Les oscars sont des poissons très intelligents qui peuvent reconnaître leurs propriétaires.

angelfish-freshwater.name: Freshwater Angelfish
angelfish-freshwater.description: The freshwater angelfish is a popular aquarium fish with a distinctive triangular body shape and long, flowing fins native to the Amazon basin.
angelfish-freshwater.funFact: Les poissons-anges d'eau douce sont en réalité des cichlidés, pas apparentés aux poissons-anges marins.

convict-cichlid.name: Convict Cichlid
convict-cichlid.description: The convict cichlid is a small freshwater fish with distinctive black vertical stripes on a light body found in Central America.
convict-cichlid.funFact: Les cichlidés zébrés sont des parents dévoués qui défendent agressivement leurs petits.

peacock-cichlid.name: Peacock Cichlid
peacock-cichlid.description: The peacock cichlid is a colorful freshwater fish found in Lake Malawi with males displaying vibrant blues, reds, and golds.
peacock-cichlid.funFact: Les mâles des cichlidés paons affichent des couleurs bleu, rouge et or éclatantes pendant la reproduction.

lionfish.name: Lionfish
lionfish.description: The lionfish is a venomous marine fish with distinctive red, white, and brown stripes and fan-like pectoral fins found in tropical reefs.
lionfish.funFact: Les épines venimeuses des poissons-lions peuvent causer une douleur intense et leur venin est thermostable.

stonefish.name: Stonefish
stonefish.description: The stonefish is the most venomous fish in the world, masters of camouflage resembling rocks on the ocean floor found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.
stonefish.funFact: Les poissons-pierre sont les poissons les plus venimeux au monde, leur piqûre peut être fatale pour les humains.

leafy-seadragon.name: Leafy Seadragon
leafy-seadragon.description: The leafy seadragon is a marine fish related to seahorses with leaf-like appendages providing perfect camouflage in kelp forests.
leafy-seadragon.funFact: Les dragons des mers feuillus n'ont pas d'estomac ni de dents et doivent manger presque constamment.

weedy-seadragon.name: Weedy Seadragon
weedy-seadragon.description: The weedy seadragon is a marine fish related to seahorses with small leaf-like appendages found in kelp forests of southern Australia.
weedy-seadragon.funFact: Les dragons des mers portent leurs œufs sur la queue du mâle jusqu'à ce qu'ils éclosent.

boxfish.name: Yellow Boxfish
boxfish.description: The yellow boxfish is a small, cube-shaped reef fish with bright yellow coloration and black spots found in the Indo-Pacific.
boxfish.funFact: Les poissons-coffres peuvent libérer une toxine lorsqu'ils sont stressés, ce qui peut tuer d'autres poissons dans un aquarium.

cowfish.name: Longhorn Cowfish
cowfish.description: The longhorn cowfish is a distinctive reef fish with horn-like spines on its head and a boxy, armored body found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.
cowfish.funFact: Les bœufs à cornes ont deux épines en forme de corne qui dépassent de leur tête.

trunkfish.name: Spotted Trunkfish
trunkfish.description: The spotted trunkfish is a small, box-shaped reef fish with white spots on a dark body found in Caribbean coral reefs.
trunkfish.funFact: Les poissons-caisses peuvent projeter une substance toxique de leur peau en cas de menace.

filefish.name: Scrawled Filefish
filefish.description: The scrawled filefish is a marine fish with a distinctive elongated body and blue spots found in tropical Atlantic waters.
filefish.funFact: Les poissons-peigne peuvent changer de couleur et de motif pour s'adapter à leur environnement.

triggerfish.name: Queen Triggerfish
triggerfish.description: The queen triggerfish is a large, colorful reef fish with distinctive blue lines on its face and a trigger spine on its dorsal fin.
triggerfish.funFact: Les poissons-guitares ont une épine sur leur nageoire dorsale qui peut être verrouillée en position dressée.

leatherjacket.name: Slender Leatherjacket
leatherjacket.description: The slender leatherjacket is a small marine fish with a compressed body and rough skin found in coastal waters worldwide.
leatherjacket.funFact: Les cuirassiers ont une peau rugueuse similaire à du papier de verre, utilisée par les premiers colons comme papier de verre.

parrotfish.name: Stoplight Parrotfish
parrotfish.description: The stoplight parrotfish is a colorful reef fish with a beak-like mouth used to scrape algae from coral found in Caribbean reefs.
parrotfish.funFact: Les poissons-perroquets excrètent du corail digéré sous forme de sable blanc fin, créant des plages tropicales.

wrasse.name: Cleaner Wrasse
wrasse.description: The cleaner wrasse is a small reef fish with a distinctive blue stripe that sets up cleaning stations to remove parasites from larger fish.
wrasse.funFact: Les labres nettoyeurs établissent des stations de nettoyage où les plus grands poissons font la queue pour se faire enlever les parasites.

tuskfish.name: Ornate Tuskfish
tuskfish.description: The ornate tuskfish is a colorful reef fish with distinctive blue and orange markings found in the Indo-Pacific.
tuskfish.funFact: Les poissons à défenses utilisent des rocs comme enclumes pour briser les coquillages.

grouper-marbled.name: Marbled Grouper
grouper-marbled.description: The marbled grouper is a large reef fish with a marbled pattern found in tropical Indo-Pacific coral reefs.
grouper-marbled.funFact: Les mérous marbrés forment des agrégats de frai massifs de milliers d'individus.

wrasse-humphead.name: Humphead Wrasse
wrasse-humphead.description: The humphead wrasse is the largest living wrasse species with a distinctive hump on its forehead found in Indo-Pacific coral reefs.
wrasse-humphead.funFact: Les labres à bosse peuvent vivre plus de 30 ans et sont les plus grands labridés vivants.

coral-grouper.name: Coral Grouper
coral-grouper.description: The coral grouper is a large reef fish with a reddish body and blue spots found in tropical Indo-Pacific coral reefs.
coral-grouper.funFact: Les mérous coraux chassent de façon coopérative avec les murènes, utilisant des secouements de tête pour signaler à la murène de déloger les proies.

cardinalfish.name: Banggai Cardinalfish
cardinalfish.description: The Banggai cardinalfish is a small, striking reef fish with black and white stripes and long fins found only in the Banggai Islands of Indonesia.
cardinalfish.funFact: Les mâles des cardinaux de Banggai incubent les œufs dans leur bouche jusqu'à l'éclosion.

damselfish.name: Garibaldi Damselfish
damselfish.description: The garibaldi is a bright orange damselfish found in kelp forests of the eastern Pacific, the official marine fish of California.
damselfish.funFact: Les mâles des garibalis construisent et entretiennent des nids d'algues élaborés pour attirer les femelles.

sergeant-major.name: Sergeant Major
sergeant-major.description: The sergeant major is a small reef fish with five black vertical bars on a light body found in tropical Atlantic waters.
sergeant-major.funFact: Les mâles des sergents-majors deviennent violet foncé lorsqu'ils gardent leurs œufs.

goby.name: Neon Goby
goby.description: The neon goby is a tiny reef fish with a bright blue stripe that sets up cleaning stations to remove parasites from larger fish.
goby.funFact: Les gobies néon établissent des stations de nettoyage et enlèvent les parasites des poissons plus grands.

blenny.name: Midas Blenny
blenny.description: The Midas blenny is a small, golden-yellow reef fish that mimics cleaner wrasses for protection found in Indo-Pacific coral reefs.
blenny.funFact: Les blennies dorés rejoignent souvent des bancs de labres nettoyeurs pour éviter la prédation.

scorpionfish.name: Tasseled Scorpionfish
scorpionfish.description: The tasseled scorpionfish is a venomous reef fish with elaborate skin flaps providing excellent camouflage found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.
scorpionfish.funFact: Les rascasses sont des maîtres du camouflage, ressemblant à des rochers couverts d'algues sur le récif.

flathead.name: Bartail Flathead
flathead.description: The bartail flathead is a bottom-dwelling marine fish with a flattened head and body found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.
flathead.funFact: Les platystacus sont des prédateurs en embuscade qui s'enterrent dans le sable pour surprendre les proies.

grunt.name: Blue-striped Grunt
grunt.description: The blue-striped grunt is a small reef fish with distinctive blue horizontal stripes found in Caribbean coral reefs.
grunt.funFact: Les girelles tirent leur nom du son qu'elles produisent en frottant leurs dents.

tang.name: Clown Tang
tang.description: The clown tang is a bright blue surgeonfish with white and black markings found in coral reefs of the Indo-Pacific.
tang.funFact: Les chirurgiens clown sont extrêmement territoriaux et peuvent être agressifs envers d'autres poissons.

squirrelfish.name: Squirrelfish
squirrelfish.description: The squirrelfish is a small, red reef fish with large eyes found in tropical coral reefs worldwide, active at night.
squirrelfish.funFact: Les holocentrides ont de grands yeux adaptés à la chasse nocturne.

sweep.name: Sweep
sweep.description: The sweep is a small, silvery fish with a distinctive deep body found in temperate rocky reefs of the Indo-Pacific.
sweep.funFact: Les simulidés tirent leur nom de leur mouvement de nage distinctif.

leatherjacket-freshwater.name: New Zealand Magpie
leatherjacket-freshwater.description: The New Zealand magpie is a small freshwater fish with a compressed body and rough skin found in rivers and lakes of New Zealand.
leatherjacket-freshwater.funFact: Les labres d'eau douce de Nouvelle-Zélande ne se trouvent qu'en Nouvelle-Zélande.

john-dory.name: John Dory
john-dory.description: The John Dory is a marine fish with a distinctive oval body and dark lateral spot found in temperate coastal waters of the Indo-Pacific.
john-dory.funFact: Les zéidés ont une tache sombre distinctive sur chaque flanc qui ressemble à une empreinte digitale.

boarfish.name: Longsnout Boarfish
boarfish.description: The longsnout boarfish is a distinctive reef fish with a long, tubular snout and black and white stripes found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.
boarfish.funFact: Les caproïdes utilisent leur museau allongé pour extraire de petits invertébrés des crevasses coralliennes.

bigeye.name: Bigeye
bigeye.description: The bigeye is a small reef fish with disproportionately large eyes found in tropical coral reefs worldwide, active at night.
bigeye.funFact: Les grand-œil ont des yeux extrêmement grands adaptés à l'alimentation nocturne.

soldierfish.name: Blackbar Soldierfish
soldierfish.description: The blackbar soldierfish is a small, red reef fish with a distinctive black bar behind its gill cover found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.
soldierfish.funFact: Les holocentrides sont nocturnes et se cachent dans les crevasses des récifs pendant la journée.

green-anole.name: Green Anole
green-anole.description: The green anole is a small arboreal lizard native to the southeastern United States. Often called the American chameleon, it can shift its skin color between green and brown. Males display a pinkish-red dewlap under their throat during courtship or territorial displays.

saltwater-crocodile.name: Saltwater Crocodile
saltwater-crocodile.description: The saltwater crocodile is the largest living reptile and has the strongest bite force ever measured. Found in coastal regions from eastern India to Australia, it is an opportunistic apex predator. Adults can survive in both saltwater and freshwater environments.

reticulated-python.name: Reticulated Python
reticulated-python.description: The reticulated python is a non-venomous constrictor and the longest snake in the world. Native to Southeast Asia, it is found in rainforests, rivers, and even near human settlements. It kills prey by constriction and can swallow animals much larger than its head.
reticulated-python.funFact: Le plus long serpent du monde

panther-chameleon.name: Panther Chameleon
panther-chameleon.description: The panther chameleon is a vibrant species native to Madagascar's tropical rainforests. Males display vivid colors ranging from blue, green, and yellow to red. They use their long, sticky tongues to catch insects with remarkable accuracy.
panther-chameleon.funFact: Les caméléons changent de couleur principalement pour la communication et la thermorégulation, pas pour le camouflage.

american-alligator.name: American Alligator
american-alligator.description: The American alligator is a large crocodilian native to the southeastern United States. Once endangered, it has made a remarkable recovery through conservation efforts. It inhabits freshwater environments and is an opportunistic predator of fish, birds, and mammals.
american-alligator.funFact: A failli disparaître, maintenant en voie de rétablissement

leopard-gecko.name: Leopard Gecko
leopard-gecko.description: The leopard gecko is a small, nocturnal lizard native to the rocky deserts and grasslands of South Asia. Unlike many geckos, it has movable eyelids and can blink. It is one of the most popular pet reptiles due to its docile temperament.
leopard-gecko.funFact: Peut détacher sa queue en cas de danger

eastern-diamondback-rattlesnake.name: Eastern Diamondback Rattlesnake
eastern-diamondback-rattlesnake.description: The eastern diamondback rattlesnake is the largest venomous snake in North America. Found in the coastal scrublands and pine flatwoods of the southeastern United States, it uses its diamond-shaped dorsal pattern as camouflage. Its rattle serves as an auditory warning to potential threats.
eastern-diamondback-rattlesnake.funFact: Le rattle du serpent à sonnette à dos en diamant peut vibrer jusqu'à 50 fois par seconde comme signal d'avertissement.

gila-monster.name: Gila Monster
gila-monster.description: The Gila monster is one of only a few venomous lizards in the world, native to the deserts of the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico. It has a stout body with bead-like scales in black and pink, orange, or yellow patterns. It spends most of its life underground.
gila-monster.funFact: Le venin du monstre de Gila contient un composé utilisé dans un médicament pour traiter le diabète de type 2.

leatherback-sea-turtle.name: Leatherback Sea Turtle
leatherback-sea-turtle.description: The leatherback sea turtle is the largest living turtle and the fourth heaviest reptile. Unlike other sea turtles, it has a flexible, leathery carapace instead of a hard shell. It dives to depths exceeding 3,000 feet and feeds almost exclusively on jellyfish.
leatherback-sea-turtle.funFact: Les tortues luths sont les plus grandes tortues du monde et existent depuis plus de 100 millions d'années.

boomslang.name: Boomslang
boomslang.description: The boomslang is a highly venomous rear-fanged snake native to sub-Saharan Africa. Males are typically bright green while females are brown. It is arboreal, spending most of its time in trees, and feeds on birds, chameleons, and small mammals.
boomslang.funFact: Le venin du boomslang empêche la coagulation du sang, faisant saigner les victimes par chaque orifice.

indian-cobra.name: Indian Cobra
indian-cobra.description: The Indian cobra is one of the 'big four' venomous snakes responsible for the most snakebite deaths in India. It is iconic for its hood, which it displays when threatened. It is found across the Indian subcontinent in a variety of habitats.
indian-cobra.funFact: Le plus célèbre des cobras à capuchon

rhinoceros-iguana.name: Rhinoceros Iguana
rhinoceros-iguana.description: The rhinoceros iguana is a large, heavy-bodied lizard endemic to the Caribbean island of Hispaniola. It is named for the bony, horn-like outgrowths on its snout. It inhabits dry, rocky areas and feeds on leaves, flowers, and fruit.
rhinoceros-iguana.funFact: Les iguanes rhinocéros tirent leur nom des écailles en forme de corne sur leur museau, qui ressemblent à des cornes de rhinocéros.

emerald-tree-boa.name: Emerald Tree Boa
emerald-tree-boa.description: The emerald tree boa is a bright green, non-venomous constrictor native to the rainforests of South America. It spends almost its entire life coiled on branches, waiting to ambush birds and small mammals. Its white markings along the spine help break up its silhouette.
emerald-tree-boa.funFact: Les boas émeraude ont des fossettes thermosensibles le long de leurs lèvres pour détecter les proies à sang chaud dans l'obscurité.

mexican-beaded-lizard.name: Mexican Beaded Lizard
mexican-beaded-lizard.description: The Mexican beaded lizard is a large, venomous lizard found in the dry forests and thorn scrub of Mexico and Guatemala. It has black skin with yellow or pinkish banding and bead-like scales. It is nocturnal and spends most of its time in burrows.
mexican-beaded-lizard.funFact: Le lézard perlé du Mexique est l'un des rares lézards venimeux et peut infliger une morsure douloureuse, bien que rarement mortelle.

desert-tortoise.name: Desert Tortoise
desert-tortoise.description: The desert tortoise is a species of tortoise native to the Mojave and Sonoran Deserts. It spends up to 95% of its life underground in burrows that can be over 30 feet long. It is well adapted to extreme heat and arid conditions.
desert-tortoise.funFact: Les tortues du désert peuvent stocker plus d'un litre d'eau dans leur vessie et la réabsorber pendant les sécheresses.

black-mamba.name: Black Mamba
black-mamba.description: The black mamba is the fastest snake in the world and one of the most venomous. Found in eastern and southern Africa, it can reach speeds of 12 mph and strike with incredible accuracy. Its venom is neurotoxic and can be fatal without antivenom.
black-mamba.funFact: Le serpent le plus rapide au monde

tokay-gecko.name: Tokay Gecko
tokay-gecko.description: The tokay gecko is a large gecko native to Southeast Asia, known for its loud, distinctive call. Males are territorial and aggressive, often found on walls and ceilings of buildings. It is widely used in traditional medicine in some Asian cultures.
tokay-gecko.funFact: Les geckos tokay peuvent produire l'un des cris les plus forts de tous les geckos, entendu jusqu'à un kilomètre.

king-snake.name: Eastern King Snake
king-snake.description: The eastern king snake is a powerful, non-venomous constrictor found across the eastern United States. It has a distinctive chain-link pattern of white or yellow bands on a dark background. It is immune to the venom of many pit vipers.
king-snake.funFact: Les couleuvres royales sont appelées « rois » parce qu'elles mangent régulièrement d'autres serpents, y compris des serpents à sonnette venimeux.

blue-tongued-skink.name: Blue-Tongued Skink
blue-tongued-skink.description: The blue-tongued skink is a group of lizards native to Australia, Tasmania, and New Guinea. They are known for their distinctive blue tongues, which they display as a defense mechanism. They are omnivorous, eating insects, snails, and vegetation.
blue-tongued-skink.funFact: Les scinques à langue bleue clignotent de leurs langues bleu vif pour effrayer les prédateurs et les faire reculer.

american-crocodile.name: American Crocodile
american-crocodile.description: The American crocodile is found in the coastal regions of the Americas, from southern Florida to northern South America. It is less aggressive than the saltwater crocodile and prefers brackish and saltwater habitats. It is lighter in color than most crocodiles.
american-crocodile.funFact: Les crocodiles d'Amérique sont plus tolérants à l'eau salée que les alligators, c'est pourquoi on les trouve dans les habitats côtiers.

asian-water-monitor.name: Asian Water Monitor
asian-water-monitor.description: The Asian water monitor is a large lizard native to Southeast Asia, commonly found near water. It is an opportunistic carnivore feeding on fish, frogs, birds, and carrion. It is one of the most common monitor lizards in the world.
asian-water-monitor.funFact: Les varans d'eau sont d'excellents nageurs et peuvent retenir leur souffle jusqu'à 30 minutes.

eastern-hognose-snake.name: Eastern Hognose Snake
eastern-hognose-snake.description: The eastern hognose snake is a non-venomous colubrid found across eastern North America. It has an upturned snout used for burrowing. When threatened, it may flatten its neck like a cobra or play dead with theatrical drama.
eastern-hognose-snake.funFact: Les couleuvres à museau relevé sont connues pour jouer mort en cas de menace, se roulant sur le dos avec la bouche ouverte.

sailfin-lizard.name: Sailfin Lizard
sailfin-lizard.description: The sailfin lizard is a semi-aquatic agamid lizard found in the Philippines and Indonesia. Males have large dorsal crests that resemble sails. They are often found near water and can run bipedally across water surfaces when startled.
sailfin-lizard.funFact: Les lézards voiliers peuvent courir sur la surface de l'eau sur de courtes distances en utilisant leurs orteils plats et frangés.

texas-rat-snake.name: Texas Rat Snake
texas-rat-snake.description: The Texas rat snake is a large, non-venomous colubrid native to Texas and the south-central United States. It is a powerful constrictor that feeds primarily on rodents. It is highly adaptable and found in a wide range of habitats.
texas-rat-snake.funFact: Les couleuvres ratelles du Texas sont d'excellents grimpeurs et ont été trouvées dans des arbres à plus de 12 mètres de haut.

gopher-tortoise.name: Gopher Tortoise
gopher-tortoise.description: The gopher tortoise is a keystone species of the southeastern United States, known for digging extensive burrows. These burrows provide critical shelter for over 350 other species, including the eastern indigo snake. It is a slow-moving herbivore.
gopher-tortoise.funFact: Les terriers de tortues gaufres peuvent dépasser 12 mètres de long et fournir un abri à plus de 350 autres espèces.

bush-viper.name: Bush Viper
bush-viper.description: The bush viper is a venomous, arboreal viper found in the tropical rainforests of equatorial Africa. It has distinctive leaf-shaped, keeled scales in various colors. It is nocturnal and uses its prehensile tail to hang from branches while hunting.
bush-viper.funFact: Les vipères buissonnières ont des écailles carénées en forme de feuille qui leur donnent une apparence hérissée, unique parmi les serpents.

pancake-tortoise.name: Pancake Tortoise
pancake-tortoise.description: The pancake tortoise is a critically endangered species with a uniquely flat, flexible shell. Found in the rocky outcrops of East Africa, it wedges itself into crevices when threatened. It is one of the fastest tortoise species relative to its size.
pancake-tortoise.funFact: Les tortues plate ont des carapaces plates et flexibles qui leur permettent de se coincer dans des crevasses rocheuses pour échapper aux prédateurs.

cottonmouth.name: Cottonmouth
cottonmouth.description: The cottonmouth, or water moccasin, is a venomous pit viper found in the wetlands of the southeastern United States. It is the only venomous water snake in North America. It is often found swimming with its head above water.
cottonmouth.funFact: Les crovilles tirent leur nom du revêtement blanc en forme de coton de leur bouche, qu'elles affichent comme avertissement.

green-basilisk.name: Green Basilisk
green-basilisk.description: The green basilisk is a striking lizard found in the tropical rainforests of Central America. Males have impressive crests on their heads, backs, and tails. It is famous for its ability to run bipedally across water surfaces for short distances.
green-basilisk.funFact: Le basilic vert est aussi appelé le lézard Jésus-Christ parce qu'il peut courir sur la surface de l'eau.

cuban-crocodile.name: Cuban Crocodile
cuban-crocodile.description: The Cuban crocodile is a critically endangered species found only in the Zapata Swamp and Isle of Youth in Cuba. It is highly aggressive and more terrestrial than other crocodiles. It can gallop on land and is known for its distinctive horned ridges.
cuban-crocodile.funFact: Les crocodiles de Cuba sont les plus terrestres des crocodiliens du Nouveau Monde et peuvent galoper comme un cheval.

bearded-dragon.name: Central Bearded Dragon
bearded-dragon.description: The central bearded dragon is a popular pet lizard native to the arid regions of central Australia. It displays a darkened beard when threatened or during social interactions. It basks on rocks and branches, absorbing heat to regulate its body temperature.
bearded-dragon.funFact: Gonfle son cou en forme de barbe

yellow-bellied-slider.name: Yellow-Bellied Slider
yellow-bellied-slider.description: The yellow-bellied slider is a semi-aquatic turtle native to the southeastern United States. It has a dark shell with yellow stripes and a distinctive yellow patch on its plastron. It is one of the most common turtle species in pet trade.
yellow-bellied-slider.funFact: Les tortues à plastron jaune peuvent se chauffer sur des troncs pendant des heures, utilisant le soleil pour réguler leur température corporelle et digérer la nourriture.

western-diamondback-rattlesnake.name: Western Diamondback Rattlesnake
western-diamondback-rattlesnake.description: The western diamondback rattlesnake is one of the most dangerous snakes in North America. Found across the southwestern United States and Mexico, it is responsible for the majority of snakebite fatalities in the region. Its rattle serves as a warning when threatened.
western-diamondback-rattlesnake.funFact: Les serpents à sonnette à dos en diamant de l'Ouest ajoutent un nouveau segment à leur sonnette chaque fois qu'ils changent de peau.

caiman-lizard.name: Caiman Lizard
caiman-lizard.description: The caiman lizard is a semi-aquatic lizard found in the swamps and rivers of South America. It has a flattened tail for swimming and powerful jaws for crushing snail shells. Its skin resembles that of a caiman, hence its name.
caiman-lizard.funFact: Les lézards caïmans ont des mâchoires puissantes et des écailles épaisses et cuirassées qui ressemblent à celles des caïmans.

nile-crocodile.name: Nile Crocodile
nile-crocodile.description: The Nile crocodile is one of the largest crocodilian species and is considered the most dangerous to humans. Found throughout sub-Saharan Africa, it is an apex predator of rivers and lakes. It can go months without eating and has the most powerful bite of any living animal.
nile-crocodile.funFact: La morsure la plus puissante du règne animal

carpet-python.name: Carpet Python
carpet-python.description: The carpet python is a large, non-venomous snake found across Australia and New Guinea. It has a variable pattern of dark bands on a lighter background. It is arboreal and commonly found in trees and on the roofs of houses.
carpet-python.funFact: Les pythons à carreaux sont des chasseurs nocturnes qui utilisent des fossettes thermosensibles pour détecter les proies à sang chaud dans l'obscurité totale.

brown-basilisk.name: Brown Basilisk
brown-basilisk.description: The brown basilisk is a large lizard found in the tropical rainforests of Central America. It has a distinctive crest on its head and can run bipedally across water. It is semi-arboreal and often found near streams and rivers.
brown-basilisk.funFact: Les basilics bruns peuvent courir sur l'eau en utilisant leurs longs orteils et leurs écailles frangées, leur valant le surnom de « lézard Jésus-Christ ».

dumerils-boa.name: Dumeril's Boa
dumerils-boa.description: Dumeril's boa is a heavy-bodied, non-venomous snake endemic to Madagascar. It has a tan and brown pattern that provides excellent camouflage on the forest floor. It is a ground-dwelling ambush predator feeding on mammals and birds.
dumerils-boa.funFact: Le boa de Duméril peut réduire son taux métabolique pour survivre de longues périodes sans nourriture, ne mangeant que tous les quelques mois.

sulcata-tortoise.name: African Spurred Tortoise
sulcata-tortoise.description: The African spurred tortoise is the third-largest tortoise species in the world, native to the Sahel region of Africa. It is named for the large, pointed spurs on its legs. It digs deep burrows to escape desert temperatures.
sulcata-tortoise.funFact: La troisième plus grande tortue terrestre

common-caiman.name: Common Caiman
common-caiman.description: The common caiman is a medium-sized crocodilian found throughout Central and South America. It is one of the most widespread crocodilian species. It feeds primarily on fish and invertebrates and is often found in large groups basking on riverbanks.
common-caiman.funFact: Les caïmans communs ont une crête osseuse entre leurs yeux qui agit comme une paire de lunettes de soleil intégrée en plein soleil.

western-hognose-snake.name: Western Hognose Snake
western-hognose-snake.description: The western hognose snake is a small, non-venomous snake with an upturned snout used for burrowing. Found in the sandy prairies of central North America, it is known for its dramatic threat display. It feeds primarily on toads and small rodents.
western-hognose-snake.funFact: Les couleuvres à museau relevé de l'Ouest aplatissent leur tête et sifflent fort en cas de menace, mais leur bluff ne dégénère rarement en morsure.

forest-cobra.name: Forest Cobra
forest-cobra.description: The forest cobra is the largest cobra species, found in the tropical forests and savannas of central and western Africa. It is highly venomous and can spit venom accurately. It is a strong swimmer and often found near bodies of water.
forest-cobra.funFact: Le cobra de la forêt est la vraie plus grande espèce de cobra et un excellent nageur, souvent trouvé près de l'eau.

veiled-chameleon.name: Veiled Chameleon
veiled-chameleon.description: The veiled chameleon is one of the most popular pet chameleon species, native to Yemen and Saudi Arabia. Males have a distinctive tall casque on their heads. It is an arboreal species that feeds on insects by projecting its long, sticky tongue.
veiled-chameleon.funFact: Les mâles des caméléons à voile ont un haut casque sur leur tête qui peut aider à canaliser les gouttes de rosée dans leur bouche.

common-snapping-turtle.name: Common Snapping Turtle
common-snapping-turtle.description: The common snapping turtle is a large, freshwater turtle found across eastern North America. It has a powerful beak-like jaw and a long, prehistoric-looking tail. Unlike most turtles, it cannot fully retract into its shell, making it more aggressive on land.
common-snapping-turtle.funFact: Les tortues snapping peuvent étendre leur cou presque de la longueur de leur carapace pour frapper des proies ou des menaces.

rough-scaled-sand-boa.name: Rough-Scaled Sand Boa
rough-scaled-sand-boa.description: The rough-scaled sand boa is a small, non-venomous constrictor found in the arid deserts of South Asia. It has a stout body adapted for burrowing and spends most of its time beneath the sand. It feeds primarily on rodents and small lizards.
rough-scaled-sand-boa.funFact: Les boas des sables passent la majeure partie de leur vie enterrés sous terre, avec seulement leurs yeux et leur museau visibles au-dessus du sable.

philippine-crocodile.name: Philippine Crocodile
philippine-crocodile.description: The Philippine crocodile is a critically endangered species endemic to the Philippines. It is the most endangered crocodilian in the world, with a wild population estimated at fewer than 100 individuals. It inhabits freshwater rivers, lakes, and marshes.
philippine-crocodile.funFact: Le crocodile des Philippines est le crocodilien le plus menacé au monde, avec moins de 100 individus restant dans la nature.

rainbow-boa.name: Rainbow Boa
rainbow-boa.description: The rainbow boa is a non-venomous constrictor found in the rainforests of South America. Its name comes from the iridescent sheen of its scales, which refract light to create a rainbow effect. It is a terrestrial species found on the forest floor.
rainbow-boa.funFact: Les boas arc-en-ciel ont des écailles iridescentes qui réfractent la lumière, créant un scintillement arc-en-ciel saisissant au soleil.

giant-plated-lizard.name: Giant Plated Lizard
giant-plated-lizard.description: The giant plated lizard is a large, robust lizard found in the rocky outcrops of southern and eastern Africa. It has heavy, plate-like scales and a powerful tail. It is semi-arboreal and feeds on insects, small vertebrates, and fruit.
giant-plated-lizard.funFact: Les lézards géants à plaques se coincent dans les crevasses rocheuses et gonflent leur corps, les rendant presque impossibles à extraire.

alligator-snapping-turtle.name: Alligator Snapping Turtle
alligator-snapping-turtle.description: The alligator snapping turtle is the largest freshwater turtle in North America. It has a massive head, a hooked beak, and a shell with three prominent ridges. It is an ambush predator that lies motionless on the river bottom with its mouth open.
alligator-snapping-turtle.funFact: Les tortues alligator ont un appendice en forme de ver sur leur langue qui attire directement les poissons dans leur bouche.

black-spiny-tailed-iguana.name: Black Spiny-Tailed Iguana
black-spiny-tailed-iguana.description: The black spiny-tailed iguana is the fastest lizard in the world, reaching speeds of 21 mph. Native to Central America, it is found on rocky cliffs, walls, and in urban areas. It is an omnivorous species that feeds on plants and small animals.
black-spiny-tailed-iguana.funFact: L'iguane à queue épineuse noire est le lézard le plus rapide du monde, capable de courir à 34 km/h.

burmese-python.name: Burmese Python
burmese-python.description: The Burmese python is one of the five largest snakes in the world, native to Southeast Asia. It is a popular pet species but has become a significant invasive species in the Florida Everglades. It is a powerful constrictor that feeds on mammals and birds.
burmese-python.funFact: Les pythons de Birmanie sont l'une des plus grandes espèces de serpents et sont devenus une espèce envahissante destructrice dans les Everglades de Floride.

ornate-box-turtle.name: Ornate Box Turtle
ornate-box-turtle.description: The ornate box turtle is a small, terrestrial turtle native to the prairies of central North America. It has a domed shell with intricate yellow and orange patterns. It can fully close its hinged plastron to protect itself from predators.
ornate-box-turtle.funFact: Les tortues boîtes ornées peuvent complètement fermer leur plastron articulé, s'enfermant à l'intérieur de leur carapace pour se protéger.

common-house-gecko.name: Common House Gecko
common-house-gecko.description: The common house gecko is a small, nocturnal lizard found throughout the tropical and subtropical regions of the world. It is commonly seen on walls and ceilings of buildings, hunting insects. Its toe pads allow it to climb smooth vertical surfaces.
common-house-gecko.funFact: Les geckos communs sont l'une des espèces de lézards les plus répandues sur Terre, présentes sur tous les continents sauf l'Antarctique.

sidewinder-rattlesnake.name: Sidewinder Rattlesnake
sidewinder-rattlesnake.description: The sidewinder rattlesnake is a venomous pit viper adapted to desert life in the southwestern United States. It uses a distinctive sidewinding locomotion that leaves J-shaped tracks in the sand. It buries itself in sand to ambush prey and escape heat.
sidewinder-rattlesnake.funFact: Les serpents à sonnette du désert se déplacent à l'aide d'une locomotion en S qui minimise le contact avec le sable chaud du désert.

chinese-water-dragon.name: Chinese Water Dragon
chinese-water-dragon.description: The Chinese water dragon is an arboreal agamid lizard found near streams in the forests of southeastern China. Males display vibrant green with white and orange markings. It is an excellent swimmer and can hold its breath for up to an hour.
chinese-water-dragon.funFact: Les dragons d'eau de Chine peuvent tomber de hauteurs de 12 mètres et atterrir en toute sécurité sur les branches ci-dessous.

west-african-dwarf-crocodile.name: West African Dwarf Crocodile
west-african-dwarf-crocodile.description: The West African dwarf crocodile is the smallest living crocodile species, found in the swamps and rivers of western and central Africa. It is nocturnal and highly terrestrial, digging burrows for shelter. It feeds primarily on fish, crustaceans, and insects.
west-african-dwarf-crocodile.funFact: Les nains de l'Afrique de l'Ouest sont les plus terrestres de tous les crocodiliens et creusent des terriers profonds pour se reposer pendant la journée.

cape-cobra.name: Cape Cobra
cape-cobra.description: The Cape cobra is one of the most dangerous cobras in Africa, found in the shrublands and fynbos of southern Africa. It is highly venomous with potent neurotoxin. It is a diurnal species and an excellent climber.
cape-cobra.funFact: Les cobras du Cap sont très venimeux et sont responsables des décès par morsure de serpent les plus fréquents en Afrique australe.

crested-iguana.name: Crested Iguana
crested-iguana.description: The crested iguana is a critically endangered species endemic to the dry forests of western Madagascar. It has a distinctive high dorsal crest and is one of the rarest iguanas in the world. It is primarily herbivorous, feeding on leaves and fruit.
crested-iguana.funFact: Les iguanes huppés peuvent changer de couleur du vert au noir en fonction de la température et du contexte social.

argentine-tegu.name: Argentine Black and White Tegu
argentine-tegu.description: The Argentine black and white tegu is a large, omnivorous lizard native to South America. It has distinctive black and white banding and a robust body. It feeds on a wide variety of foods including insects, small animals, fruit, and eggs.
