lacewing.description: Green lacewings are delicate, golden-green insects with lace-like wings. Their larvae are voracious predators of aphids and other soft-bodied pests, making them valuable biological control agents.

dobsonfly.name: Eastern Dobsonfly
dobsonfly.description: The eastern dobsonfly is a large, impressive insect with enormous wings and males have extremely long mandibles. The aquatic larvae are important food for trout and indicators of stream health.

mayfly.name: Mayfly
mayfly.description: Mayflies are aquatic insects with extremely short adult lifespans dedicated solely to reproduction. Their larvae are important indicators of water quality and food for fish.

earwig.name: Common European Earwig
earwig.description: The common European earwig is a nocturnal insect with distinctive pincer-like cerci on its abdomen. Despite myths, earwigs do not burrow into human ears, and mothers provide notable parental care.

silverfish.name: Common Silverfish
silverfish.description: Silverfish are small, wingless, silver-colored insects that damage paper, textiles, and food. They are nocturnal and thrive in warm, humid environments like bathrooms and basements.

firebrat.name: Firebrat
firebrat.description: Firebrats are close relatives of silverfish that prefer much warmer environments. They are found near heat sources like furnaces and water heaters and feed on starchy materials.

jumping-bristletail.name: Jumping Bristletail
jumping-bristletail.description: Jumping bristletails are small, wingless insects that can jump by curling their abdomen. They are found in moist environments and feed on algae, lichens, and decaying plant matter.

snakefly.name: Snakefly
snakefly.description: Snakeflies are predatory insects with an elongated prothorax that gives them a snake-like appearance. Both adults and larvae are beneficial predators of pest insects on trees.

cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.name: Bombus Bob
cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.description: This cuckoo bumblebee species is a social parasite that takes over nests of other bumblebee species. The female enters a host nest, kills or displaces the queen, and uses the existing workers.

musk-bee.name: Musk Bee
musk-bee.description: The musk bee is a solitary ground-nesting bee known for its distinctive musky scent. It emerges in late summer and is an important pollinator of goldenrod and other fall wildflowers.

alkali-bee.name: Alkali Bee
alkali-bee.description: The alkali bee is a solitary ground-nesting bee that prefers alkaline soils near salt flats. It is an excellent pollinator of alfalfa and has been managed commercially for this purpose.

carpenter-ant.name: Black Carpenter Ant
carpenter-ant.description: Black carpenter ants are large ants that excavate nests in moist, decaying wood. Unlike termites, they do not consume wood but can cause structural damage by hollowing out timbers.

pharaoh-ant.name: Pharaoh Ant
pharaoh-ant.description: Pharaoh ants are tiny, pale-colored invasive ants that are particularly problematic in hospitals and food facilities. They form huge colonies with multiple queens and bud frequently.

odorous-house-ant.name: Odorous House Ant
odorous-house-ant.description: Odorous house ants are common household ants that emit a distinctive coconut-like odor when crushed. They form large colonies and frequently nest inside walls and under floors.

blue-ringed-octopus.name: Blue-Ringed Octopus
blue-ringed-octopus.description: The blue-ringed octopus is a small but deadly cephalopod native to coral reefs. Despite its diminutive size, its bright blue rings serve as a warning of its highly potent venom.
blue-ringed-octopus.funFact: El pulpo más venenoso del mundo

mimic-octopus.name: Mimic Octopus
mimic-octopus.description: The mimic octopus is a master of disguise, capable of altering its shape, color, and behavior to resemble other marine animals. It was only discovered in 1998 off the coast of Indonesia.
mimic-octopus.funFact: Un pulpo que imita a otros animales

colossal-squid.name: Colossal Squid
colossal-squid.description: The colossal squid is one of the largest invertebrates on Earth, inhabiting the frigid deep waters of the Antarctic. Its massive eyes are adapted to detect light in the perpetual darkness of the deep sea.
colossal-squid.funFact: El calamar más grande del mundo

humboldt-squid.name: Humboldt Squid
humboldt-squid.description: The Humboldt squid is a large, aggressive cephalopod named after the Humboldt Current. It hunts in packs and is known for its rapid growth rate and voracious appetite.

giant-squid.name: Giant Squid
giant-squid.description: The giant squid is one of the most mysterious creatures of the deep ocean. With eyes the size of dinner plates and tentacles reaching over 40 feet, it is a legendary predator of the abyss.

firefly-squid.name: Firefly Squid
firefly-squid.description: The firefly squid is a small cephalopod famous for its bioluminescence. Each spring millions gather in Toyama Bay, Japan, creating a spectacular natural light show.

caribbean-reef-octopus.name: Caribbean Reef Octopus
caribbean-reef-octopus.description: The Caribbean reef octopus is a nocturnal predator that hunts crustaceans and small fish among coral formations. Its chromatophores allow rapid color changes for communication and camouflage.

flamboyant-cuttlefish.name: Flamboyant Cuttlefish
flamboyant-cuttlefish.description: The flamboyant cuttlefish is a small, vibrantly colored cephalopod that walks along the seafloor on its tentacles. It displays pulsating patterns of yellow, maroon, and white as a warning to predators.

common-cuttlefish.name: Common Cuttlefish
common-cuttlefish.description: The common cuttlefish is a highly intelligent cephalopod with W-shaped pupils and an internal cuttlebone used for buoyancy. It is renowned for its extraordinary ability to change color and texture.

chambered-nautilus.name: Chambered Nautilus
chambered-nautilus.description: The chambered nautilus is a cephalopod often called a living fossil, having existed since before the dinosaurs. Its beautiful spiral shell is divided into chambers used for buoyancy control.

argonaut.name: Argonaut
argonaut.description: The argonaut, or paper nautilus, is a pelagic octopus where only females produce a delicate calcareous shell. Males are much smaller and lack shells entirely.

vampire-squid.name: Vampire Squid
vampire-squid.description: The vampire squid inhabits the deep ocean's oxygen minimum zones. Despite its name, it feeds on marine snow rather than prey, and can turn itself inside out as a defense mechanism.

strawberry-squid.name: Strawberry Squid
strawberry-squid.description: The strawberry squid is a deep-sea cephalopod covered in light-producing photophores. Its red coloring is invisible in the deep ocean, providing effective camouflage against predators.

cockatoo-squid.name: Cockatoo Squid
cockatoo-squid.description: The cockatoo squid is a small, translucent deep-sea cephalopod that inflates its body like a balloon when threatened. Its distinctive appearance resembles a cockatoo with its arms raised.

pajama-squid.name: Pajama Squid
pajama-squid.description: The pajama squid is a small, nocturnal cephalopod with distinctive black and white stripes. It buries itself in sand during the day and emerges at night to hunt small crustaceans.

bobtail-squid.name: Bobtail Squid
bobtail-squid.description: Bobtail squids are small, round cephalopods that partner with bioluminescent bacteria. The bacteria produce light that matches the moonlight from above, eliminating the squid's shadow.

pygmy-squid.name: Pygmy Squid
pygmy-squid.description: The pygmy squid is one of the smallest cephalopods, reaching barely an inch long. It uses a special adhesive gland to attach itself to seagrass blades, waiting to ambush passing prey.
pygmy-squid.funFact: El calamar más pequeño del mundo

american-lobster.name: American Lobster
american-lobster.description: The American lobster is a large marine crustacean prized as a delicacy. It uses its powerful claws for defense and crushing prey, and can regenerate lost limbs during molting.

european-lobster.name: European Lobster
european-lobster.description: The European lobster is a large, deep-blue crustacean found along rocky coastlines. It is a solitary nocturnal hunter that preys on fish, crabs, and mollusks.

spiny-lobster.name: Spiny Lobster
spiny-lobster.description: Spiny lobsters are colorful crustaceans found in tropical marine environments. Unlike true lobsters, they lack large front claws and instead rely on their spiny antennae and a unique alarm call.

slipper-lobster.name: Slipper Lobster
slipper-lobster.description: Slipper lobsters are robust crustaceans recognized by their flattened, slipper-shaped antennae. They are bottom-dwellers that hunt mollusks and other invertebrates at night.

mantis-shrimp.name: Mantis Shrimp
mantis-shrimp.description: The mantis shrimp is a strikingly colored crustacean with the fastest punch in the animal kingdom. It possesses the most complex eyes known, with 16 types of color receptors compared to humans' three.

peacock-mantis-shrimp.name: Peacock Mantis Shrimp
peacock-mantis-shrimp.description: The peacock mantis shrimp is one of the most colorful and formidable predators in the reef. Its club-like appendages strike with incredible speed and force, capable of shattering glass aquariums.

spearer-mantis-shrimp.name: Spearer Mantis Shrimp
spearer-mantis-shrimp.description: Spearer mantis shrimp are ambush predators that wait at the entrance of their mud burrows. They strike passing prey with barbed, spear-like appendages that can impale fish in milliseconds.

blue-crab.name: Blue Crab
blue-crab.description: The blue crab is a commercially important species found along the Atlantic coast of North America. It is an aggressive swimmer and opportunistic feeder that plays a key role in estuarine ecosystems.

king-crab.name: Red King Crab
king-crab.description: The red king crab is one of the largest crabs in the world, prized commercially in Alaska and Russia. Its massive, spiny legs can span over five feet and it can walk up to 100 miles during its annual migration.

japanese-spider-crab.name: Japanese Spider Crab
japanese-spider-crab.description: The Japanese spider crab holds the record for the largest leg span of any living arthropod. Despite its enormous size, it is a gentle giant that scavenges on the ocean floor.
japanese-spider-crab.funFact: El cangrejo araña más grande del mundo

hermit-crab.name: Hermit Crab
hermit-crab.description: Hermit crabs are decapod crustaceans that use abandoned snail shells to protect their soft abdomens. They are social animals often found in groups, and play dead when threatened.

coconut-crab.name: Coconut Crab
coconut-crab.description: The coconut crab is the largest terrestrial arthropod, capable of cracking coconuts with its powerful claws. Despite its name, it lives primarily on land but must return to the sea to reproduce.

snow-crab.name: Snow Crab
snow-crab.description: The snow crab is a cold-water species that lives on sandy and muddy bottoms. It is an important commercial species in both the Atlantic and Pacific, known for its sweet, tender meat.

fiddler-crab.name: Fiddler Crab
fiddler-crab.description: Fiddler crabs are small semiterrestrial crabs recognized by the male's single oversized claw used in elaborate mating dances. They are important ecosystem engineers in mangrove and marsh habitats.

mud-crab.name: Mud Crab
mud-crab.description: The mud crab is a robust species found in mangrove ecosystems across the Indo-Pacific. It is one of the most commercially important crabs in aquaculture, prized for its sweet, firm meat.

atlantic-ghost-crab.name: Atlantic Ghost Crab
atlantic-ghost-crab.description: Ghost crabs are pale, fast-moving crustaceans that burrow in sandy beaches. They are mostly nocturnal and use their large stalked eyes and acute hearing to detect predators and prey.

tropical-hermit-crab.name: Tropical Hermit Crab
tropical-hermit-crab.description: Tropical hermit crabs are colorful land-dwelling crustaceans that inhabit beaches and coastal forests. They are highly social and often form shell exchange chains to ensure all members have appropriate shelter.

coconut-hermit-crab.name: Coconut Hermit Crab
coconut-hermit-crab.description: The coconut hermit crab is a large land-dwelling species that inhabits tropical island beaches. It is known for its habit of using coconut shells as mobile homes and feeding on fallen coconuts.

zebra-fiddler-crab.name: Zebra Fiddler Crab
zebra-fiddler-crab.description: The zebra fiddler crab is named for the distinctive stripes on its carapace. Males perform elaborate claw-waving displays to attract females and defend territory on tropical mudflats.

great-spider-crab.name: Great Spider Crab
great-spider-crab.description: The great spider crab is a camouflaged crustacean that attaches organisms to its shell for disguise. It migrates in large numbers to shallow waters for mating each autumn.

swimming-crab.name: Portunus Swimming Crab
swimming-crab.description: Swimming crabs are agile crustaceans with modified rear legs that function as paddles. They are aggressive predators that can pursue prey through the water column with remarkable speed.

common-shore-shrimp.name: Common Shore Shrimp
common-shore-shrimp.description: Common shore shrimp are small crustaceans inhabiting the turbulent intertidal zone. They use specialized appendages to cling to rocks and forage among algae and barnacles for food.

antarctic-krill.name: Antarctic Krill
antarctic-krill.description: Antarctic krill are small crustaceans that form the foundation of the Antarctic marine food web. Swarms can contain billions of individuals and are a critical food source for whales, seals, and penguins.

pacific-krill.name: Pacific Krill
pacific-krill.description: Pacific krill are tiny shrimp-like crustaceans that swarm in massive numbers in the North Pacific. They are essential to the marine food web, feeding on phytoplankton and being consumed by larger marine life.

atlantic-krill.name: Atlantic Krill
atlantic-krill.description: Atlantic krill are small pelagic crustaceans found throughout the North Atlantic. They are a keystone species, supporting populations of cod, herring, whales, and numerous seabirds.

giant-amphipod.name: Giant Amphipod
giant-amphipod.description: Giant amphipods are deep-sea crustaceans found in ocean trenches up to 10,000 meters deep. Their enormous size compared to shallow-water relatives is an example of deep-sea gigantism.

giant-isopod.name: Giant Isopod
giant-isopod.description: Giant isopods are deep-sea crustaceans that can grow up to 14 inches long. They are scavengers that feed on whale falls and other organic material that sinks to the ocean floor.

lions-mane-jellyfish.name: Lion's Mane Jellyfish
lions-mane-jellyfish.description: The lion's mane jellyfish is the largest known jellyfish species. Its mass of long, trailing tentacles resembles a lion's mane and can extend far beyond its bell diameter.

portuguese-man-of-war.name: Portuguese Man-of-War
portuguese-man-of-war.description: The Portuguese man-of-war is a siphonophore, not a true jellyfish. Its iconic blue float sails on the surface while trailing long, venomous tentacles that can deliver an extremely painful sting.

pacific-sea-nettle.name: Pacific Sea Nettle
pacific-sea-nettle.description: The Pacific sea nettle is a large, visually striking jellyfish with a rusty-orange bell and long, coiling tentacles. It feeds on zooplankton, fish eggs, and other jellyfish.

upside-down-jellyfish.name: Upside-Down Jellyfish
upside-down-jellyfish.description: The upside-down jellyfish, or Cassiopea, lies bell-down on the substrate to maximize photosynthesis by its symbiotic algae. It pulses gently to circulate water and capture food particles.

immortal-jellyfish.name: Immortal Jellyfish
immortal-jellyfish.description: The immortal jellyfish, Turritopsis dohrnii, is biologically immortal. When stressed or aging, it reverts to its polyp form and begins its life cycle anew, making it the only known creature capable of true rejuvenation.

sea-wasp.name: Sea Wasp
sea-wasp.description: The sea wasp, or Chironex fleckeri, is the largest and most dangerous box jellyfish. Its nearly invisible body and incredibly potent venom make it one of the deadliest creatures in the ocean.

compass-jellyfish.name: Compass Jellyfish
compass-jellyfish.description: The compass jellyfish is easily identified by the brown radiating lines on its translucent bell that resemble compass markings. It feeds on small fish and other jellyfish.

fried-egg-jellyfish.name: Fried Egg Jellyfish
fried-egg-jellyfish.description: The fried egg jellyfish, or Cotylorhiza tuberculata, is a visually striking species with a bell that looks remarkably like a fried egg. Despite its large size, its sting is relatively mild.

blood-belly-comb-jelly.name: Blood Belly Comb Jelly
blood-belly-comb-jelly.description: The blood belly comb jelly is a deep-water ctenophore found in the Mediterranean. When threatened, it produces vivid red bioluminescence, creating a spectacular display in the dark waters.

atolla-jellyfish.name: Atolla Jellyfish
atolla-jellyfish.description: The Atolla jellyfish inhabits the deep ocean and is famous for its burglar alarm display. When attacked, it produces a rotating wheel of blue bioluminescence to attract larger predators that may attack its attacker.

spotted-jelly.name: Spotted Jelly
spotted-jelly.description: The spotted jelly is a rhizostome jellyfish with a translucent bell covered in brown spots. It feeds on plankton and small organisms using oral arms lined with tiny mouth openings.

mauve-stinger.name: Mauve Stinger
mauve-stinger.description: The mauve stinger is a deep-water jellyfish with a distinctive reddish-purple bell covered in nematocyst clusters. It forms massive blooms in open ocean waters.

staghorn-coral.name: Staghorn Coral
staghorn-coral.description: Staghorn coral is a critically endangered branching coral species. Once dominant in Caribbean reefs, its populations have declined by over 80% due to disease, bleaching, and predation.

brain-coral.name: Brain Coral
brain-coral.description: Brain coral is named for its spherical shape and the winding grooves on its surface that resemble a human brain. It is a slow-growing but extremely long-lived reef-building species.

elkhorn-coral.name: Elkhorn Coral
elkhorn-coral.description: Elkhorn coral is a critically endangered species that once formed vast reefs throughout the Caribbean. Its large, branching colonies provide essential habitat for hundreds of reef species.

pillar-coral.name: Pillar Coral
pillar-coral.description: Pillar coral is one of the rarest reef-building corals, distinguished by its tall, cylindrical columns that rise from the reef. It is listed as critically endangered with populations plummeting.

fire-coral.name: Fire Coral
fire-coral.description: Fire coral is a colony-forming hydrozoan that looks like true coral but delivers a painful sting on contact. Its smooth, branching colonies are typically brown, yellow, or reddish in color.

blue-coral.name: Blue Coral
blue-coral.description: Blue coral is a unique reef-building species with a distinctive blue skeleton. It is one of the few corals that can survive in turbid, low-light environments where other corals cannot.

mushroom-coral.name: Mushroom Coral
mushroom-coral.description: Mushroom corals are solitary, free-living scleractinian corals shaped like mushrooms. Unlike colonial species, each is a single polyp that can detach and roll across the substrate.

black-coral.name: Black Coral
black-coral.description: Black corals are deep-water colonial organisms with a black or dark brown skeleton. They are among the longest-lived organisms on Earth, with some colonies surviving for millennia.

sea-pen.name: Sea Pen
sea-pen.description: Sea pens are colonial cnidarians that resemble old-fashioned quill pens. They anchor in soft sediment and can produce bioluminescent waves of light that travel along their colonies.

sea-whip.name: Sea Whip
sea-whip.description: Sea whips are octocoral colonies that grow in long, whip-like branches. They are filter feeders that extend polyps into the current to capture plankton and organic particles.

sunflower-sea-star.name: Sunflower Sea Star
sunflower-sea-star.description: The sunflower sea star is one of the largest and fastest sea stars, but populations have crashed by over 90% due to sea star wasting disease. It is now listed as critically endangered.

crown-of-thorns-starfish.name: Crown-of-Thorns Starfish
crown-of-thorns-starfish.description: The crown-of-thorns starfish is a large, multi-armed sea star covered in venomous spines. It is a significant coral predator whose population outbreaks can devastate reef ecosystems.
crown-of-thorns-starfish.funFact: Una estrella de mar corona de espinas

blue-sea-star.name: Blue Sea Star
blue-sea-star.description: The blue sea star is a strikingly colored echinoderm that lives on sandy substrates. It feeds on small invertebrates buried in the sand and can regenerate lost arms.

leather-star.name: Leather Star
leather-star.description: The leather star is a smooth-skinned sea star found on rocky reefs. It has a distinctive reddish-brown color and a unique garlic-like odor when handled.
leather-star.funFact: Una estrella de mar de cuero

common-brittle-star.name: Common Brittle Star
common-brittle-star.description: Brittle stars are echinoderms with a distinct central disc and five long, slender arms. They are more agile than sea stars, moving by writhing their arms across the seabed.

giant-basket-star.name: Giant Basket Star
giant-basket-star.description: The giant basket star is a spectacular echinoderm with a complex network of branching arms. At night, it unfurls its arms into the current to capture plankton and small crustaceans.

feather-star.name: Feather Star
feather-star.description: Feather stars are mobile crinoids that cling to coral or swim through the water column. Their feathery arms filter plankton from passing currents, and they can detach to relocate when conditions change.

crinoid-feather-star.name: Crinoid Feather Star
crinoid-feather-star.description: Crinoid feather stars are ancient echinoderms related to sea lilies. They perch on coral heads and wave their feathery arms to capture passing plankton from ocean currents.

disk-brittle-star.name: Disk-Brittle Star
disk-brittle-star.description: The disk-brittle star is a small, agile echinoderm found in rock crevices and under stones. It is an opportunistic feeder that can regenerate lost body parts rapidly.

purple-sea-urchin.name: Purple Sea Urchin
purple-sea-urchin.description: The purple sea urchin is a spiny echinoderm that inhabits rocky shores. It uses its five-toothed jaw, Aristotle's lantern, to scrape algae and even excavate burrows in solid rock.

long-spined-sea-urchin.name: Long-Spined Sea Urchin
long-spined-sea-urchin.description: Long-spined sea urchins are tropical echinoderms with extremely long, sharp spines that provide excellent defense. They play a critical role in controlling algal growth on coral reefs.
long-spined-sea-urchin.funFact: Un erizo de mar de espinas largas

pencil-urchin.name: Pencil Urchin
pencil-urchin.description: Pencil urchins are named for their thick, cylindrical spines that look like colored pencils. They inhabit tropical reefs where they graze on algae using their complex jaw apparatus.

green-sea-urchin.name: Green Sea Urchin
green-sea-urchin.description: The green sea urchin is a cold-water species found on rocky substrates. It is an important herbivore in kelp forest ecosystems, controlling algal growth and providing food for sea otters.

flower-urchin.name: Flower Urchin
flower-urchin.description: The flower urchin is one of the most dangerous sea urchins, covered in venomous flower-shaped pedicellariae. Despite its beautiful appearance, contact causes intense pain and potential tissue damage.

sand-dollar.name: Sand Dollar
sand-dollar.description: Sand dollars are flat, burrowing sea urchins found on sandy ocean floors. Their flattened bodies and fine spines allow them to bury themselves just beneath the sediment surface.

carpenter-sea-urchin.name: Carpenter Sea Urchin
carpenter-sea-urchin.description: The carpenter sea urchin is named for its ability to excavate burrows in solid coral rock. Its powerful Aristotle's lantern allows it to bore into reef substrates for shelter.

fire-urchin.name: Fire Urchin
fire-urchin.description: The fire urchin is a striking red echinoderm with venomous spines that deliver an intensely painful sting. Despite its danger, it provides a symbiotic home for certain shrimp and crabs.
fire-urchin.funFact: Un erizo de mar de fuego

slate-pencil-urchin.name: Slate Pencil Urchin
slate-pencil-urchin.description: Slate pencil urchins are named for their thick, blunt spines that resemble slate pencils. These colorful echinoderms inhabit tropical reefs where they graze on algae.
slate-pencil-urchin.funFact: Un erizo de mar de lápiz pizarra

tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.name: Tiger Tail Sea Cucumber
tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.description: The tiger tail sea cucumber is a large, conspicuous species with distinctive dark stripes. It is an important bioturbator, processing sediment and recycling nutrients in tropical marine ecosystems.
tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.funFact: Un pepino de mar de cola de tigre

lolly-sea-cucumber.name: Lolly Sea Cucumber
lolly-sea-cucumber.description: The lolly sea cucumber is a small, cylindrical species that processes sand and sediment on tropical reefs. It plays a vital role in reef health by recycling organic matter.

pacific-sea-cucumber.name: Pacific Sea Cucumber
pacific-sea-cucumber.description: The Pacific sea cucumber is an ecologically important detritivore that processes vast quantities of sediment. It is commercially harvested and considered a culinary delicacy in many Asian cultures.
pacific-sea-cucumber.funFact: Un pepino de mar del Pacífico

black-sea-cucumber.name: Black Sea Cucumber
black-sea-cucumber.description: The black sea cucumber is a large, commercially valuable species found on tropical reefs. It ejects its internal organs as a defense mechanism and later regenerates them completely.

teatfish-sea-cucumber.name: Teatfish Sea Cucumber
teatfish-sea-cucumber.description: The teatfish is a large, highly valued sea cucumber that has been overexploited for the Asian beche-de-mer trade. Its distinctive nipple-like projections give it its common name.

red-sea-cucumber.name: Red Sea Cucumber
red-sea-cucumber.description: The red sea cucumber is a common species in Pacific kelp forests. It grazes on detritus and algae on rocky substrates, playing an important role in nutrient cycling.

christmas-tree-worm.name: Christmas Tree Worm
christmas-tree-worm.description: Christmas tree worms are tubeworms that burrow into living coral colonies. Their colorful, spiral-shaped radioles filter plankton from the water and can retract instantly when disturbed.

giant-tubeworm.name: Giant Tube Worm
giant-tubeworm.description: Giant tube worms are extraordinary deep-sea organisms that thrive at hydrothermal vents. They rely on chemosynthetic bacteria housed in a special organ called the trophosome for all nutrition.

feather-duster-worm.name: Feather Duster Worm
feather-duster-worm.description: Feather duster worms are sedentary polychaetes that construct tubes on reef surfaces. Their spectacular crown of feathery tentacles filters plankton and can retract rapidly when threatened.

bearded-fireworm.name: Bearded Fireworm
bearded-fireworm.description: The bearded fireworm is a predatory polychaete with venomous bristles called chaetae. Contact with these white, hair-like structures causes severe pain, inflammation, and numbness.

blue-glaucus.name: Blue Glaucus
blue-glaucus.description: The blue glaucus, or blue dragon, is a tiny, vibrant blue sea slug that floats upside-down on the ocean surface. It stores stinging cells from its prey for its own defense.

spanish-dancer.name: Spanish Dancer
spanish-dancer.description: The Spanish dancer is one of the largest and most colorful nudibranchs. When swimming, it unfurls its brilliant red and white mantle in a mesmerizing undulating display.

leaf-sheep.name: Leaf Sheep
leaf-sheep.description: The leaf sheep, or Costasiella kuroshimae, is a tiny sea slug that can photosynthesize like a plant. It steals chloroplasts from the algae it eats and stores them in its body to produce energy.
leaf-sheep.funFact: Una babosa marina oveja de hoja

sea-butterfly.name: Sea Butterfly
sea-butterfly.description: Sea butterflies are tiny marine snails that swim through the open ocean by flapping their wing-like shell extensions. They are an important food source for fish, whales, and seabirds.

sea-angel.name: Sea Angel
sea-angel.description: Sea angels are gelatinous, transparent marine gastropods that lack shells. They swim through cold ocean waters by flapping wing-like appendages and prey on sea butterflies.

sea-hare.name: California Sea Hare
sea-hare.description: The California sea hare is a large marine gastropod named for its ear-like rhinophores. It feeds on kelp and seaweed and can release a cloud of purple ink as a defense mechanism.

giant-clam.name: Giant Clam
giant-clam.description: The giant clam is the largest living bivalve mollusk, reaching over four feet in length. Its colorful mantle harbors symbiotic algae that provide much of its nutrition through photosynthesis.

geoduck.name: Geoduck
geoduck.description: The geoduck is the largest burrowing clam in the world, with a siphon that can extend three feet. Native to the Pacific Northwest, it is a prized delicacy in Asian cuisine.

atlantic-surf-clam.name: Atlantic Surf Clam
atlantic-surf-clam.description: The Atlantic surf clam is a large bivalve found on sandy substrates. It uses its powerful foot to burrow and can explosively eject itself from the sand when threatened by predators.

bay-scallop.name: Bay Scallop
bay-scallop.description: Bay scallops are small, fan-shaped bivalves that live in shallow coastal waters. Unlike most clams, they can swim by rapidly clapping their valves, ejecting water for propulsion.

blue-mussel.name: Blue Mussel
blue-mussel.description: Blue mussels are filter-feeding bivalves that attach to rocks with strong byssal threads. They form dense beds that provide habitat for numerous other species and are commercially cultivated.

thorny-oyster.name: Thorny Oyster
thorny-oyster.description: The thorny oyster is a large, spiny bivalve that cements itself to reef substrates. Its long, sharp spines protect it from predators and can cause painful wounds if touched.

lion-paw-scallop.name: Lion Paw Scallop
lion-paw-scallop.description: The lion paw scallop is a large, colorful bivalve with a distinctive ridged shell. It can swim by clapping its valves and is found in kelp forests along the Pacific coast.
lion-paw-scallop.funFact: Una vieira de pata de león

nautilus-pompilius.name: Nautilus Pompilius
nautilus-pompilius.description: Nautilus pompilius is a cephalopod with a beautiful, spiraled shell that has inspired artists and mathematicians for centuries. It is a living fossil, virtually unchanged for 500 million years.

paper-nautilus.name: Paper Nautilus
paper-nautilus.description: The paper nautilus is an argonaut octopus in which only females produce a fragile, calcareous shell. Males are much smaller and shell-less, using a specialized arm to transfer sperm.

atlantic-horseshoe-crab.name: Atlantic Horseshoe Crab
atlantic-horseshoe-crab.description: The Atlantic horseshoe crab is a marine arthropod often called a living fossil. Despite its name, it is more closely related to spiders and scorpions than to true crabs.

japanese-horseshoe-crab.name: Japanese Horseshoe Crab
japanese-horseshoe-crab.description: The Japanese horseshoe crab is an endangered species whose unique blue blood is vital to modern medicine. The substance in its blood detects bacterial endotoxins in pharmaceuticals and medical devices.

indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.name: Indo-Pacific Horseshoe Crab
indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.description: The Indo-Pacific horseshoe crab is an endangered marine arthropod found in Southeast Asian coastal waters. Like its Atlantic relative, it has blue blood containing valuable immune cells.

sea-squirt-tunicate.name: Sea Squirt
sea-squirt-tunicate.description: Sea squirts are tunicates, marine invertebrates that are surprisingly closely related to vertebrates. As larvae they have a notochord, which they lose as adults when they attach to surfaces and become filter feeders.

marine-flatworm.name: Marine Flatworm
marine-flatworm.description: Marine flatworms are colorful, soft-bodied invertebrates that glide across reef surfaces. Despite their simple appearance, they are active predators that can deliver venomous bites.

sea-pen-glow.name: Deep-Sea Pennatula
sea-pen-glow.description: The deep-sea pennatula is a species of sea pen that inhabits deep muddy bottoms. When disturbed, it produces stunning bioluminescent waves that ripple along its colony.

dodo.name: Dodo
dodo.description: The dodo was a large, flightless bird native to the island of Mauritius in the Indian Ocean. It was related to pigeons and doves but evolved to be completely flightless with no natural predators.

woolly-mammoth.name: Woolly Mammoth
woolly-mammoth.description: The woolly mammoth was a species of elephant covered in thick fur that lived during the Pleistocene epoch. They roamed the cold tundra regions of North America, Europe, and Asia.

passenger-pigeon.name: Passenger Pigeon
passenger-pigeon.description: The passenger pigeon was once the most abundant bird in North America, with flocks containing billions of individuals. Systematic hunting and habitat destruction led to its extinction in 1914.
passenger-pigeon.funFact: El pájaro que oscureció los cielos

tasmanian-tiger.name: Tasmanian Tiger
tasmanian-tiger.description: The Tasmanian tiger, or thylacine, was a carnivorous marsupial native to Tasmania, Australia, and New Guinea. The last known individual died in captivity in 1936.

quagga.name: Quagga
quagga.description: The quagga was a subspecies of plains zebra that lived in South Africa. It was distinguished by its limited striping pattern, with stripes only on the head and front body.

pig.name: Pig
pig.description: The domestic pig is a stout-bodied farm animal raised worldwide for meat and known for its intelligence and social nature.
pig.funFact: Pigs are highly intelligent and can learn tricks like dogs

sheep.name: Sheep
sheep.description: Sheep are woolly ruminants raised for wool, meat and milk, known for flocking behavior.
sheep.funFact: Sheep can recognize up to 50 faces for years

goat.name: Goat
goat.description: Goats are hardy farm animals known for climbing and curiosity, raised for milk, meat and fiber.
goat.funFact: Goats have rectangular pupils for wide vision

horse.name: Horse
horse.description: The horse is a large domesticated hoofed mammal used for riding, work and sport.
horse.funFact: Horses can sleep both standing and lying down

donkey.name: Donkey
donkey.description: Donkeys are sturdy equids used as working animals, known for endurance and strong memory.
donkey.funFact: Donkeys have incredible memory and remember places for 25 years

chicken.name: Chicken
chicken.description: Chickens are domesticated fowl raised for eggs and meat, the most numerous bird on Earth.

duck.name: Duck
duck.description: Ducks are waterfowl raised on farms and found wild on ponds and rivers.
duck.funFact: Duck feathers are waterproof due to oil coating

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.description: Turkeys are large North American game birds domesticated for meat.
turkey.funFact: Turkeys can change head color with mood

alpaca.name: Alpaca
alpaca.description: Alpacas are South American camelids raised for soft fleece, similar to llamas but smaller.
alpaca.funFact: Alpaca fleece is 3x warmer than sheep wool

llama.name: Llama
llama.description: Llamas are domesticated camelids from the Andes used as pack animals and for wool.
llama.funFact: Llamas hum to communicate with each other

unicorn.name: Unicorn
unicorn.description: The unicorn is a legendary horse-like creature with a single spiraled horn, symbol of purity and magic.
unicorn.funFact: Unicorn horns were said to purify poisoned water

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.description: Dragons are legendary giant reptiles with wings and fire breath, guardians of treasure in folklore.
dragon.funFact: Dragons were said to hoard gold and breathe fire

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.description: The phoenix is a mythical fire bird that cyclically regenerates by rising from its ashes.
phoenix.funFact: The phoenix rises from its own ashes every 500 years

griffin.name: Griffin
griffin.description: The griffin has the body of a lion and head and wings of an eagle, a majestic guardian beast.
griffin.funFact: Griffins were said to guard gold mines

pegasus.name: Pegasus
pegasus.description: Pegasus is a winged horse of Greek mythology, born from Medusa and symbol of inspiration.
pegasus.funFact: Pegasus was born from Medusa's blood

mermaid.name: Mermaid
mermaid.description: Mermaids are half-human, half-fish beings who lure sailors with enchanting songs.
mermaid.funFact: Mermaid tears were believed to be pearls

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.description: The Kraken is a colossal sea monster resembling a giant squid, feared by sailors.
kraken.funFact: The Kraken was said to drag entire ships underwater

fairy.name: Fairy
fairy.description: Fairies are tiny winged folk who live in forests and use magic to protect nature.
fairy.funFact: Fairies were said to be 6 inches tall

t-rex.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
t-rex.description: Tyrannosaurus rex was a massive predatory dinosaur of the Late Cretaceous with tiny arms and powerful jaws.
t-rex.funFact: T-Rex had the strongest bite of any terrestrial animal

triceratops.name: Triceratops
triceratops.description: Triceratops was a horned dinosaur with three facial horns and a large frill for defense.
triceratops.funFact: Triceratops had three horns and a bony frill

stegosaurus.name: Stegosaurus
stegosaurus.description: Stegosaurus had distinctive kite-shaped plates along its back and spiked tail.
stegosaurus.funFact: Stegosaurus had a brain the size of a dog's

velociraptor.name: Velociraptor
velociraptor.description: Velociraptor was a feathered predatory dinosaur that hunted in packs.
velociraptor.funFact: Velociraptor was actually turkey-sized, not 2m tall

brachiosaurus.name: Brachiosaurus
brachiosaurus.description: Brachiosaurus was a giant long-necked sauropod that could reach high treetops.
brachiosaurus.funFact: Brachiosaurus was as tall as a 4-story building

pterodactyl.name: Pterodactyl
pterodactyl.description: Pterodactylus was a flying reptile with a wingspan up to 1m that soared over coasts.
pterodactyl.funFact: Pterodactyls were not dinosaurs but flying reptiles

ankylosaurus.name: Ankylosaurus
ankylosaurus.description: Ankylosaurus was an armored dinosaur covered in bony plates with a massive tail club.
ankylosaurus.funFact: Ankylosaurus had a club tail that could break T-Rex bones

brontosaurus.name: Brontosaurus
brontosaurus.description: Brontosaurus was a massive sauropod long thought to be Apatosaurus but now recognized again.

saber-toothed-tiger.name: Saber-Toothed Tiger
saber-toothed-tiger.description: Smilodon, the saber-toothed cat, had enormous curved canines for slashing prey.

hydra.name: Hydra
hydra.description: The Hydra is a multi-headed serpent of Greek myth slain by Heracles.
hydra.funFact: Cutting one head makes two more grow

cerberus.name: Cerberus
cerberus.description: Cerberus is the three-headed dog that guards the entrance to the Greek underworld.
cerberus.funFact: Cerberus guarded the gates of the Underworld

minotaur.name: Minotaur
minotaur.description: The Minotaur is half-man, half-bull imprisoned in the Cretan labyrinth.
minotaur.funFact: The Minotaur lived in a labyrinth on Crete

basilisk.name: Basilisk
basilisk.description: The basilisk is a legendary serpent king whose glance is lethal.
basilisk.funFact: Basilisk gaze could turn victims to stone

leviathan.name: Leviathan
leviathan.description: Leviathan is a colossal sea serpent of Hebrew mythology embodying chaos of the ocean.
leviathan.funFact: Leviathan could create whirlpools that sank ships

thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
thunderbird.description: The Thunderbird is a giant legendary bird of Native American lore that creates thunder.
thunderbird.funFact: Thunderbird wings were said to create thunder

kitsune.name: Kitsune
kitsune.description: Kitsune are nine-tailed fox spirits in Japanese folklore, shape-shifters of great magic.
kitsune.funFact: Kitsune gains a tail every 100 years, up to nine

nessie.name: Loch Ness Monster
nessie.description: Nessie is the legendary long-necked creature said to inhabit Scotland's Loch Ness.
nessie.funFact: First sighting of Nessie was in 565 AD

lop-rabbit.name: Lop Rabbit
lop-rabbit.description: Lop rabbits are domestic bunnies with long floppy ears, beloved as gentle pets.
lop-rabbit.funFact: Lop rabbits' ears flop due to a genetic mutation

persian-cat.name: Persian Cat
persian-cat.description: Persian cats are fluffy long-haired cats with flat faces, known for calm temperament.
persian-cat.funFact: Persian cats are one of the oldest cat breeds

corgi.name: Corgi
corgi.description: Corgis are short-legged Welsh herding dogs famous for cute looks and loyalty.
corgi.funFact: Corgis were herding dogs despite short legs

baby-otter.name: Baby Otter
baby-otter.description: Baby otters are incredibly cute pups that hold hands while sleeping to not drift apart.
baby-otter.funFact: Baby otters cannot swim at birth and must be taught

pika-cute.name: Pika
pika-cute.description: Pikas are tiny mountain hamster-like mammals that make hay piles for winter.
pika-cute.funFact: Pikas say 'meh' and collect tiny haystacks

fennec-cute.name: Fennec Fox
fennec-cute.description: Fennec foxes are desert foxes with enormous ears, often called the cutest fox.
fennec-cute.funFact: Fennec fox kits have oversized ears like their parents

quokka-cute.name: Quokka
quokka-cute.description: Quokkas are small marsupials from Australia famous for selfies and smiles.
quokka-cute.funFact: Quokkas always look like they are smiling

axolotl-cute.name: Axolotl
axolotl-cute.description: Axolotls are cute neotenic salamanders that keep external gills and smile.
axolotl-cute.funFact: Axolotls can regenerate their hearts and brains

hedgehog-cute.name: Hedgehog
hedgehog-cute.description: Hedgehogs are small spiny mammals that curl up when scared, adored for cuteness.
hedgehog-cute.funFact: Hedgehogs have 5000 spines and curl into a ball

sugar-glider-cute.name: Sugar Glider
sugar-glider-cute.description: Sugar gliders are tiny marsupials with a membrane that lets them glide, big-eyed and cute.
sugar-glider-cute.funFact: Sugar gliders can glide 50 meters between trees

centaur.name: Centaur
centaur.description: The centaur is half-human, half-horse, known for wisdom and archery in Greek mythology.
centaur.funFact: Centaurs were expert archers and healers

satyr.name: Satyr
satyr.description: Satyrs are half-goat, half-human forest spirits who love music and revelry.
satyr.funFact: Satyrs played flutes that enchanted travelers

wyvern.name: Wyvern
wyvern.description: The wyvern is a winged dragon with two legs and a barbed tail, often guarding castles.
wyvern.funFact: Wyverns have two legs unlike four-legged dragons

djinn.name: Djinn
djinn.description: Djinn are magical smoke-formed beings from Arabian lore who inhabit deserts and grant wishes.
djinn.funFact: Djinn were said to grant three wishes

golem.name: Golem
golem.description: The golem is a clay giant brought to life by Hebrew magic to protect its creator.
golem.funFact: Golems are animated by a word on their forehead

banshee.name: Banshee
banshee.description: The banshee is a wailing female spirit from Irish folklore whose cry warns of death.
banshee.funFact: Hearing a banshee wail foretold death

leprechaun.name: Leprechaun
leprechaun.description: Leprechauns are tiny shoemaking fairies from Irish myth who hide pots of gold.
leprechaun.funFact: Leprechauns hide gold at the end of rainbows

nymph.name: Nymph
nymph.description: Nymphs are nature spirits inhabiting rivers, trees and mountains in Greek lore.
nymph.funFact: Nymphs could live inside trees or rivers

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.description: The werewolf is a human cursed to become a wolf under the full moon.

yeti.name: Yeti
yeti.description: The Yeti, or Abominable Snowman, is a giant ape-like cryptid of the Himalayas.
yeti.funFact: Yeti footprints can be 45 cm long

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.description: Goblins are small, clever, green-skinned tricksters living in caves and mines.
goblin.funFact: Goblins were master miners and craftsmen

troll.name: Troll
troll.description: Trolls are giant, slow-witted brutes who live under bridges and mountains.
troll.funFact: Trolls turn to stone in sunlight

roc.name: Roc
roc.description: The Roc is a gigantic bird of Arabian myth so large it can carry elephants.
roc.funFact: Roc eggs were said to be 15 meters around

sphinx.name: Sphinx
sphinx.description: The Sphinx has a lion's body, human head and eagle wings, guardian of riddles.
sphinx.funFact: The Sphinx asked riddles to travelers

chimera.name: Chimera
chimera.description: The Chimera is a fire-breathing hybrid of lion, goat and serpent from Greek myth.
chimera.funFact: Chimera had a lion head, goat body and snake tail

siren.name: Siren
siren.description: Sirens are enchanting half-bird, half-women whose songs doom sailors.
siren.funFact: Sirens lured sailors to shipwreck with songs

harpy.name: Harpy
harpy.description: The Harpy is half-woman, half-bird, a swift wind spirit that steals offerings.
harpy.funFact: Harpies were winds spirits that snatched souls

garuda.name: Garuda
garuda.description: Garuda is a giant eagle-like deity, mount of Vishnu and enemy of serpents.
garuda.funFact: Garuda is the king of birds in Hindu myth

qilin.name: Qilin
qilin.description: The Qilin is a gentle Chinese unicorn-deer with dragon scales that brings good fortune.
qilin.funFact: Qilin appears only during peaceful reigns

fenrir.name: Fenrir
fenrir.description: Fenrir is the monstrous wolf of Norse myth destined to devour Odin at Ragnarok.
fenrir.funFact: Fenrir was chained by the gods with magic ribbon

jormungandr.name: Jörmungandr
jormungandr.description: Jörmungandr is the World Serpent of Norse myth, so huge it bites its own tail around Earth.

cyclops.name: Cyclops
cyclops.description: The Cyclops is a one-eyed giant blacksmith of Greek myth who forged divine weapons.

medusa.name: Medusa
medusa.description: Medusa is a Gorgon with snakes for hair whose gaze petrifies victims.
medusa.funFact: Medusa's gaze turned people to stone

anubis.name: Anubis
anubis.description: Anubis is the jackal-headed Egyptian god who guides souls to the afterlife.
anubis.funFact: Anubis weighed hearts against a feather

allosaurus.name: Allosaurus
allosaurus.description: Allosaurus was the top predator of Jurassic North America before T. rex.
allosaurus.funFact: Allosaurus had 32 teeth shaped like steak knives

spinosaurus.name: Spinosaurus
spinosaurus.description: Spinosaurus was a semi-aquatic fish-eating dinosaur larger than T. rex with a distinctive sail.
spinosaurus.funFact: Spinosaurus had a sail 1.8m tall on its back

diplodocus.name: Diplodocus
diplodocus.description: Diplodocus was an extremely long-necked sauropod with a whip-like tail.
diplodocus.funFact: Diplodocus had a tail with 80 vertebrae

parasaurolophus.name: Parasaurolophus
parasaurolophus.description: Parasaurolophus was a crested hadrosaur that could make loud calls through its hollow crest.
parasaurolophus.funFact: Its crest acted like a trumpet

iguanodon.name: Iguanodon
iguanodon.description: Iguanodon was one of the first dinosaurs discovered, with distinctive thumb spikes.
iguanodon.funFact: Iguanodon had thumb spikes for defense

archaeopteryx.name: Archaeopteryx
archaeopteryx.description: Archaeopteryx was a feathered dinosaur-bird that could glide between trees 150 million years ago.
archaeopteryx.funFact: Archaeopteryx is the earliest known bird

mosasaurus.name: Mosasaurus
mosasaurus.description: Mosasaurus was a giant marine reptile that ruled Late Cretaceous seas.
mosasaurus.funFact: Mosasaurus had double-hinged jaws like a snake

plesiosaurus.name: Plesiosaurus
plesiosaurus.description: Plesiosaurus was a long-necked marine reptile that swam with four powerful flippers.
plesiosaurus.funFact: Plesiosaurus had four flippers and a long neck

dimetrodon.name: Dimetrodon
dimetrodon.description: Dimetrodon was a sail-backed synapsid predator that lived 40 million years before T. rex.

woolly-rhino.name: Woolly Rhino
woolly-rhino.description: The woolly rhinoceros was a shaggy-coated rhino that roamed Ice Age Eurasia alongside mammoths.

irish-elk.name: Irish Elk
irish-elk.description: Irish Elk was the largest deer ever, with enormous antlers that spanned over 3 meters.

dire-wolf.name: Dire Wolf
dire-wolf.description: Dire Wolf was a large Ice Age wolf that hunted in packs across North America.
dire-wolf.funFact: Dire wolves were 30% heavier than gray wolves

painted-frog.name: ウキガエル
painted-frog.description: ウキガエルは地中海地方に生息する中型のカエルです。
painted-frog.funFact: 塗り絵ガエルは海水に耐え、沿岸部でも見られることがあります。

african-elephant.name: アフリカゾウ
african-elephant.description: アフリカゾウは现存する最大的陆上動物です。
african-elephant.funFact: 陸上で最も大きな動物です。

lion.name: ライオン
lion.description: ライオンは社会的なグループで生活する唯一の猫科です。
lion.funFact: 社会的に生活する唯一の猫科です。

tiger.name: トラ
tiger.description: トラは最大の野生猫科です。
tiger.funFact: 現存する最大の猫科です。

giraffe.name: キリン
giraffe.description: キリンは现存する最高的陸上動物です。
giraffe.funFact: 現存する最も背の高い陸上動物です。

cheetah.name: チーター
cheetah.description: チーターは陆上最速の動物です。
cheetah.funFact: 陸上で最も速い動物です。

penguin.name: ペンギン
penguin.description: ペンギンは飛べない海鳥です。

dolphin.name: イルカ
dolphin.description: イルカは賢い海の哺乳類です。

octopus.name: タコ
octopus.description: タコは非常に賢い軟体動物です。

butterfly.name: チョウ
butterfly.description: チョウは色彩豊かな昆虫です。

asian-elephant.name: アジアゾウ
asian-elephant.description: The Asian elephant is smaller than its African cousin, with smaller ears and a more domed head.
asian-elephant.funFact: アフリカゾウより小さく、耳も小さいです。

white-rhinoceros.name: ウシサイ
white-rhinoceros.description: The white rhinoceros is the largest of the five rhino species, known for its wide mouth adapted for grazing.
white-rhinoceros.funFact: 鼻の上に2本の角があります。

black-rhinoceros.name: キタサイ
black-rhinoceros.description: The black rhinoceros is a browser with a hooked upper lip, known for its aggressive temperament.
black-rhinoceros.funFact: 非常に攻撃的で、脅されると突進してきます。

hippopotamus.name: カバ
hippopotamus.description: The hippopotamus is a large semi-aquatic mammal that spends most of its day in water to keep cool.
hippopotamus.funFact: 水中で5分間息を止めることができます。

okapi.name: オカピ
okapi.description: The okapi is a shy, forest-dwelling relative of the giraffe with distinctive striped legs.
okapi.funFact: キリンに最も近い生き物です。

cape-buffalo.name: ケープバッファロー
cape-buffalo.description: The Cape buffalo is a large bovid known for its unpredictable nature and massive curved horns.
cape-buffalo.funFact: アフリカ五大陸上動物の一つです。

american-bison.name: アメリカバイソン
american-bison.description: The American bison is the largest land mammal in North America, once roaming the Great Plains in massive herds.
american-bison.funFact: かつて北米に3000万〜6000万頭いました。

water-buffalo.name: スイギュウ
water-buffalo.description: The water buffalo is a large bovid widely used in agriculture throughout Asia.
water-buffalo.funFact: アジアの稲作に欠かせない存在です。

yak.name: ヤク
yak.description: The yak is a long-haired bovid adapted to high altitudes in the Himalayas.
yak.funFact: 標高6000メートル以上でも生きることができます。

domestic-cattle.name: ウシ
domestic-cattle.description: Domestic cattle are large ungulates raised for meat, milk, and leather.
domestic-cattle.funFact: 世界に10億頭以上の牛がいます。

gaur.name: ガウル
gaur.description: The gaur is the largest wild cattle species, native to South and Southeast Asia.
gaur.funFact: 世界最大の野生ウシです。

saiga-antelope.name: サイガ
saiga-antelope.description: The saiga antelope is known for its unusual, oversized nose that filters dust and warms cold air.
saiga-antelope.funFact: 特徴的な丸みを帯びた鼻を持っています。

addax.name: アダックス
addax.description: The addax is a critically endangered antelope adapted to life in the Sahara Desert.
addax.funFact: 水を飲まずに生きることができます。

oryx.name: オリックス
oryx.description: The oryx is a large antelope with long, straight horns, adapted to arid environments.
oryx.funFact: 何ヶ月も水なしで生きることができます。

leopard.name: ヒョウ
leopard.description: The leopard is a powerful, agile big cat known for its rosette-patterned coat.
leopard.funFact: 体重2倍の獲物を木に持ち上げることができます。

snow-leopard.name: ユキヒョウ
snow-leopard.description: The snow leopard is a solitary big cat adapted to life in cold, mountainous regions of Central Asia.
snow-leopard.funFact: 他の大猫と異なり、吼えることができません。

jaguar.name: ジャガー
jaguar.description: The jaguar is a stocky, muscular cat with a powerful bite, capable of piercing turtle shells.
jaguar.funFact: すべての大猫の中で最も強い噛みつき力を持っています。

cougar.name: ピューマ
cougar.description: The cougar is a large cat native to the Americas, known by many names including puma and mountain lion.
cougar.funFact: ピューマやマウンテンライオンとも呼ばれています。

clouded-leopard.name: ネービングヒョウ
clouded-leopard.description: The clouded leopard is a medium-sized cat with distinctive cloud-shaped markings and exceptionally long canines.
clouded-leopard.funFact: 体のサイズに対して最も長い犬歯を持っています。

serval.name: セルバル
serval.description: The serval is a medium-sized cat with long legs and large ears, found in African grasslands.
serval.funFact: 3メートル以上ジャンプすることができます。

caracal.name: カラカル
caracal.description: The caracal is a medium-sized cat known for its distinctive black-tufted ears.
caracal.funFact: 鳥を捕らえるために3メートルまでジャンプします。

pallas-s-cat.name: マヌルネコ
pallas-s-cat.description: Pallas's cat is a small wild cat with a flattened face and dense fur, adapted to cold steppes.
pallas-s-cat.funFact: すべての猫種の中で最も厚い毛皮を持っています。

sand-cat.name: スナネコ
sand-cat.description: The sand cat is a small wild cat adapted to life in deserts, with furry paws for walking on hot sand.
sand-cat.funFact: 水なしで生きることができます。

fishing-cat.name: マネコ
fishing-cat.description: The fishing cat is a medium-sized cat that hunts fish and is an excellent swimmer.
fishing-cat.funFact: 水が好きで、泳ぐのが得意です。

brown-bear.name: ヒグマ
brown-bear.description: The brown bear is one of the largest bear species, found across North America, Europe, and Asia.
brown-bear.funFact: 馬と同じ速さで走ることができます。

grizzly-bear.name: グリズリー
grizzly-bear.description: The grizzly bear is a North American subspecies of brown bear, known for its distinctive shoulder hump.
grizzly-bear.funFact: 32キロ先の食べ物の匂いを嗅ぎつけることができます。

polar-bear.name: ホッキョクグマ
polar-bear.description: The polar bear is a large bear native to the Arctic, adapted to life on sea ice.
polar-bear.funFact: 優れた泳ぎの名手で、何日でも泳ぐことができます。

american-black-bear.name: アメリカヒグマ
american-black-bear.description: The American black bear is the most common bear in North America, known for its climbing ability.
american-black-bear.funFact: 優れた木登りの名手です。

asian-black-bear.name: ツキノワグマ
asian-black-bear.description: The Asian black bear is a medium-sized bear with a distinctive white V-shaped chest marking.
asian-black-bear.funFact: 胸の白いV字の模様からムーンベアとも呼ばれています。

spectacled-bear.name: メガネクマ
spectacled-bear.description: The spectacled bear is the only bear native to South America, named for its distinctive facial markings.
spectacled-bear.funFact: 南米に生息する唯一のクマです。

sun-bear.name: ヒマラヤツキノワグマ
sun-bear.description: The sun bear is the smallest bear species, with a distinctive golden chest patch.

sloth-bear.name: ナマケグマ
sloth-bear.description: The sloth bear has shaggy fur and specialized lips for eating termites and ants.
sloth-bear.funFact: 唇を使って昆虫を吸い上げます。

giant-panda.name: ジャイアントパンダ
giant-panda.description: The giant panda is a bear native to China, famous for its black and white coloring and bamboo diet.

andean-bear.name: アンデスクマ
andean-bear.description: The Andean bear is the only bear species in South America, found in the Andes mountains.
andean-bear.funFact: メガネクマとも呼ばれます。

gray-wolf.name: オオカミ
gray-wolf.description: The gray wolf is the largest wild member of the canine family, living in packs.

arctic-wolf.name: ホッキョクオオカミ
arctic-wolf.description: The Arctic wolf is a subspecies of gray wolf adapted to life in the high Arctic.
arctic-wolf.funFact: マイナス70度の気温でも生きることができます。

red-fox.name: アカギツネ
red-fox.description: The red fox is the largest true fox, found across the entire Northern Hemisphere.
red-fox.funFact: 世界で最も広く分布する肉食動物です。

fennec-fox.name: フェネック
fennec-fox.description: The fennec fox is the smallest fox, with enormous ears that help regulate body temperature.
fennec-fox.funFact: 体温を下げるための大きな耳を持っています。

arctic-fox.name: ホッキョクギツネ
arctic-fox.description: The Arctic fox has a white coat in winter and brown in summer for camouflage.
arctic-fox.funFact: 季節によって毛色が変わります。

african-wild-dog.name: リカオン
african-wild-dog.description: The African wild dog is a highly social canid with distinctive patched coat.
african-wild-dog.funFact: すべての捕食者の中で最も高い狩りの成功率を持っています。

coyote.name: コヨーテ
coyote.description: The coyote is a highly adaptable canid found throughout North America.
coyote.funFact: 都市部でも適応して生きています。

jackal.name: ジャッカル
jackal.description: Jackals are medium-sized canids known for their cunning and adaptability.
jackal.funFact: ライオンの後をついてスカベンジングしているのがよく見られます。

dingo.name: ディンゴ
dingo.description: The dingo is a wild dog found in Australia, believed to have arrived with humans 4000 years ago.
dingo.funFact: オーストラリア最大の陸上捕食者です。

maned-wolf.name: オオカミギツネ
maned-wolf.description: The maned wolf has long legs adapted for seeing over tall grasses.
maned-wolf.funFact: 南米で最も背の高い野生犬です。

western-gorilla.name: セイブウエスタンゴリラ
western-gorilla.description: The western gorilla is one of two species of gorilla, found in the forests of central Africa.
western-gorilla.funFact: ヒトに最も近い親族（DNAの98%を共有）です。

eastern-gorilla.name: ヒガシゴリラ
eastern-gorilla.description: The eastern gorilla is the largest living primate, found in the forests of eastern Africa.
eastern-gorilla.funFact: 現存する最大のサルです。

chimpanzee.name: チンパンジー
chimpanzee.description: The chimpanzee is our closest living relative, sharing about 98% of our DNA.
chimpanzee.funFact: 野生で道具を使います。

bonobo.name: ボノボ
bonobo.description: The bonobo is a great ape known for its peaceful, matriarchal society.
bonobo.funFact: チンパンジーよりもヒトに近い親戚です。

orangutan.name: オランウータン
orangutan.description: Orangutans are highly intelligent great apes that spend most of their time in trees.
orangutan.funFact: 最大の樹上性動物です。

siamang.name: シアマンガibbon
siamang.description: The siamang is the largest gibbon, known for its loud vocalizations.
siamang.funFact: 叫び声を増幅する喉の嚢があります。

gibbon.name: テナガザル
gibbon.description: Gibbons are small apes known for their brachiation, swinging through trees.
gibbon.funFact: 木々を高速で渡り歩くことができます。

mandrill.name: マンドリル
mandrill.description: The mandrill is the largest and most colorful of all monkeys.
mandrill.funFact: 最もカラフルなサルです。

proboscis-monkey.name: テングザル
proboscis-monkey.description: The proboscis monkey is known for its unusually large nose, found in Borneo's mangroves.
proboscis-monkey.funFact: 大きく肉質の鼻を持っています。

spider-monkey.name: クモザル
spider-monkey.description: Spider monkeys have long limbs and a prehensile tail for life in the canopy.
spider-monkey.funFact: 第5の腕のように使える握り尾を持っています。

capuchin-monkey.name: オマキザル
capuchin-monkey.description: Capuchin monkeys are highly intelligent and known for their tool use.
capuchin-monkey.funFact: クルミを割るために道具を使います。

lemur.name: キツネザル
lemur.description: Lemurs are a diverse group of primates found only on the island of Madagascar.
lemur.funFact: マダガスカルにのみ生息しています。

indri.name: インドリ
indri.description: The indri is the largest living lemur, known for its haunting calls.
indri.funFact: 現存する最大のレムールです。

tarsier.name: ターザイ
tarsier.description: The tarsier is a tiny primate with enormous eyes adapted for night vision.
tarsier.funFact: すべての哺乳類の中で体のサイズに対して最も大きな目を持っています。

aye-aye.name: アイアイ
aye-aye.description: The aye-aye is a nocturnal lemur with a specialized finger for extracting insects.
aye-aye.funFact: 木をたたいて昆虫を探します。

blue-whale.name: シロナガスクジラ
blue-whale.description: The blue whale is the largest animal ever to have lived, with a heart the size of a small car.
blue-whale.funFact: 地球上でかつて最も大きな動物です。

humpback-whale.name: ザトウクジラ
humpback-whale.description: The humpback whale is known for its spectacular breaching and complex vocalizations.
humpback-whale.funFact: 複雑な鳴き声で知られています。

sperm-whale.name: マッコウクジラ
sperm-whale.description: The sperm whale is the largest toothed whale, famous for diving to great depths.
sperm-whale.funFact: すべての動物の中で最大の脳を持っています。

killer-whale.name: シャチ
killer-whale.description: The killer whale or orca is the largest member of the dolphin family.
killer-whale.funFact: 実はイルカの一種です。

bottlenose-dolphin.name: バンドウイルカ
bottlenose-dolphin.description: The bottlenose dolphin is one of the most well-known and intelligent marine mammals.
bottlenose-dolphin.funFact: 狩りに道具（スポンジ）を使います。

narwhal.name: イッカク
narwhal.description: The narwhal is an Arctic whale known for its long, spiral tusk.
narwhal.funFact: 長いらせん状の牙（変形した歯）を持っています。

beluga-whale.name: ジコース
beluga-whale.description: The beluga whale is a small, white Arctic whale known for its expressive face.
beluga-whale.funFact: 表情を変えることができます。

manatee.name: マナティー
manatee.description: Manatees are gentle, herbivorous marine mammals that inhabit shallow coastal waters.

dugong.name: ジュゴン
dugong.description: The dugong is a large marine mammal related to manatees, found in warm coastal waters.
dugong.funFact: 完全に草食性の唯一の海洋哺乳類です。

walrus.name: セイウチ
walrus.description: The walrus is a large pinniped with distinctive long tusks used for hauling out on ice.
walrus.funFact: 心拍数を落として寒い水を生き延びることができます。

elephant-seal.name: ゾウアザラシ
elephant-seal.description: Elephant seals are the largest seals, named for their trunk-like nose.
elephant-seal.funFact: 2時間息を止めることができます。

leopard-seal.name: ヒョウアザラシ
leopard-seal.description: The leopard seal is a powerful predator found in Antarctic waters.
leopard-seal.funFact: 南極海の頂点捕食者です。

harp-seal.name: ワモンアザラシ
harp-seal.description: The harp seal is named for the harp-shaped marking on its back.
harp-seal.funFact: 子供は白い毛皮を持って生まれます。

sea-otter.name: ラッコ
sea-otter.description: The sea otter is a marine mammal that uses tools to feed on shellfish.
sea-otter.funFact: 岩を使って貝類を割ります。

capybara.name: カピバラ
capybara.description: The capybara is the largest living rodent, a semi-aquatic mammal found in South America.
capybara.funFact: 世界最大のげっ歯類です。

beaver.name: ビーバー
beaver.description: Beavers are large rodents known for building dams and lodges.
beaver.funFact: ダムを築いて entire 生態系を作り出します。

porcupine.name: ヤマアラシ
porcupine.description: Porcupines are rodents covered in sharp quills used for defense.

squirrel.name: リス
squirrel.description: Squirrels are small rodents known for their bushy tails and tree-dwelling habits.
squirrel.funFact: 雪の下に埋めたナッツを見つけることができます。

chinchilla.name: チンチラ
chinchilla.description: Chinchillas are small rodents with incredibly soft fur, native to the Andes.
chinchilla.funFact: 1.8メートル以上ジャンプすることができます。

guinea-pig.name: モルモット
guinea-pig.description: Guinea pigs are small, friendly rodents originally from South America.
guinea-pig.funFact: ビタミンCを合成することができません。

hamster.name: ハムスター
hamster.description: Hamsters are small, nocturnal rodents known for their cheek pouches and burrowing behavior.
hamster.funFact: 頬の袋に食べ物を保存することができます。

mouse.name: ネズミ
mouse.description: Mice are small rodents found worldwide, important in scientific research.
mouse.funFact: 6mmの隙間でも抜けることができます。

rat.name: ドブネズミ
rat.description: Rats are intelligent rodents that have adapted to live alongside humans.
rat.funFact: 非常に賢く、社交的です。

red-kangaroo.name: アカカンガルー
red-kangaroo.description: The red kangaroo is the largest living marsupial, found throughout Australia.
red-kangaroo.funFact: 一跳びで9メートルジャンプします。

grey-kangaroo.name: ハイイロカンガルー
grey-kangaroo.description: The grey kangaroo is the second-largest marsupial, common in eastern Australia.
grey-kangaroo.funFact: 時速65キロメートルで移動できます。

wallaby.name: ワラビー
wallaby.description: Wallabies are small to medium-sized marsupials related to kangaroos.
wallaby.funFact: カンガルーの小さな親戚です。

tree-kangaroo.name: クウロウツリカンガルー
tree-kangaroo.description: Tree kangaroos are adapted to life in the canopy, unlike their ground-dwelling relatives.
tree-kangaroo.funFact: カンガルーにもかかわらず、木の上に住んでいます。

koala.name: コアラ
koala.description: The koala is an arboreal marsupial that feeds almost exclusively on eucalyptus leaves.

wombat.name: ウォンバット
wombat.description: Wombats are sturdy, burrowing marsupials with tough rear ends for defense.

tasmanian-devil.name: タスマニアディーゴ
tasmanian-devil.description: The Tasmanian devil is a carnivorous marsupial with a fearsome reputation.
tasmanian-devil.funFact: 体のサイズに対して最も強い噛みつき力を持っています。

otter.name: カワウソ
otter.description: Otters are playful, semi-aquatic mammals known for their dense fur and tool use.
otter.funFact: すべての哺乳類の中で最も密度の高い毛皮を持っています。

wolverine.name: ジュズカケモノ
wolverine.description: The wolverine is a powerful, stocky mustelid known for its strength and ferocity.
wolverine.funFact: オオカミやクマと戦うことができます。

badger.name: アナグマ
badger.description: Badgers are sturdy, burrowing mammals with distinctive black and white faces.
badger.funFact: 広大な地下トンネルシステムを掘ります。

honey-badger.name: ミツアナグマ
honey-badger.description: The honey badger is known for its fearlessness and thick skin that resists bee stings.
honey-badger.funFact: 最も恐れを知らない動物として知られています。

raccoon.name: アライグマ
raccoon.description: Raccoons are clever, adaptable mammals known for their masked faces and dexterous front paws.

red-panda.name: レッドパンダ
red-panda.description: The red panda is a small arboreal mammal with reddish-brown fur and a ringed tail.
red-panda.funFact: ジャイアントパンダとはあまり近い関係ではありません。

hedgehog.name: ハリネズミ
hedgehog.description: Hedgehogs are small, spiny mammals found across Europe, Asia, and Africa.
hedgehog.funFact: 約5000本のトゲがあります。

shrew.name: トガリネズミ
shrew.description: Shrews are tiny, insect-eating mammals with extremely high metabolic rates.
shrew.funFact: 非常に高い代謝を持っています。

clownfish.name: クマノミ
clownfish.description: Clownfish are vibrant orange fish with white bands that live symbiotically among sea anemone tentacles. They gain protection from predators while providing the anemone with food scraps and increased water circulation.
clownfish.funFact: クラゲの刺胞に対して免疫があります。

seahorse.name: タツノオトシゴ
seahorse.description: The seahorse is a small marine fish with a horse-like head, prehensile tail, and upright swimming posture found in shallow coastal waters worldwide.
seahorse.funFact: オスのタツノオトシゴは妊娠して出産する唯一のオスの動物です。

tiger-shark.name: シロザメ
tiger-shark.description: The tiger shark is a large predator with distinctive dark vertical stripes found in tropical and subtropical oceans worldwide.
tiger-shark.funFact: ほぼ何でも食べるため、海のゴミ箱と呼ばれています。

bull-shark.name: ウシザメ
bull-shark.description: The bull shark is a large, stocky shark found in warm, shallow coastal waters and occasionally in freshwater rivers.
bull-shark.funFact: 淡水の川でも生きられる数少ないサメの一種です。

hammerhead-shark.name: シュモクザメ
hammerhead-shark.description: The hammerhead shark is a distinctive shark with a wide, flattened head that gives it a hammer-like appearance found in warm waters.
hammerhead-shark.funFact: 広く離れた目により、360度の視界を持っています。

whale-shark.name: ジンベエザメ
whale-shark.description: The whale shark is the largest fish in the world, reaching over 40 feet, a gentle filter feeder found in tropical oceans.
whale-shark.funFact: 500列にわたって3000本以上の小さな歯がありますが、食べ物には使いません。

great-white-shark.name: ホホジロザメ
great-white-shark.description: The great white shark is the world's largest known predatory fish, an apex predator found in coastal and offshore waters worldwide.
great-white-shark.funFact: 100リットルの水中に1滴の血液でも感知できます。

manta-ray.name: マンタ
manta-ray.description: The manta ray is one of the largest rays in the world with a wingspan that can exceed 20 feet, a gentle filter feeder.
manta-ray.funFact: マンタは魚の中で最大の脳体積比を持ち、鏡に映った自分を認識できると言われています。

anglerfish.name: アンコウ
anglerfish.description: The Atlantic anglerfish is a deep-sea fish with a distinctive bioluminescent lure that attracts prey found on the deep ocean floor.
anglerfish.funFact: オスのアンコウはメスに永久に融合し、血液を共有します。

pufferfish.name: フグ
pufferfish.description: The pufferfish is a marine fish capable of inflating its body to several times its normal size as a defense mechanism, found in tropical and subtropical waters.
pufferfish.funFact: シアン化物より1200倍 Deadlyなテトロドトキシンを含んでいます。

piranha.name: ピラニア
piranha.description: The piranha is a freshwater fish native to South American rivers known for its sharp teeth and powerful jaws found in tropical and subtropical waters.
piranha.funFact: 人を噛むこともあります。

electric-eel.name: デンキウナギ
electric-eel.description: The electric eel is a freshwater fish capable of generating powerful electric shocks used for hunting and self-defense found in South American rivers.
electric-eel.funFact: 860ボルトの電撃を発生させ、馬を気絶させる力があります。

green-anole.name: アノールトカゲ
green-anole.description: The green anole is a small arboreal lizard native to the southeastern United States. Often called the American chameleon, it can shift its skin color between green and brown. Males display a pinkish-red dewlap under their throat during courtship or territorial displays.
green-anole.funFact: 気分や温度、社会的シグナルに応じて緑から茶色に色を変えます。

komodo-dragon.name: コモドオオトカゲ
komodo-dragon.description: The Komodo dragon is the largest living lizard in the world, found on a few Indonesian islands. It is an apex predator capable of taking down deer, pigs, and even water buffalo. Young Komodo dragons spend their first years in trees to avoid predation by adults.
komodo-dragon.funFact: 獲物の血液凝固を阻害する毒腺があります。

king-cobra.name: キングコブラ
king-cobra.description: The king cobra is the world's longest venomous snake, capable of reaching lengths over 13 feet. Found in the tropical forests of South and Southeast Asia, it primarily feeds on other snakes. Its venom is potent enough to kill an elephant.
king-cobra.funFact: 卵の巣を作る唯一のヘビで、孵化まで激しく守ります。

green-sea-turtle.name: アオウミガメ
green-sea-turtle.description: Green sea turtles are among the largest sea turtles in the world and the only herbivorous marine turtle species. They migrate long distances between feeding grounds and nesting beaches, returning to the same beach where they were born.
green-sea-turtle.funFact: 海藻中心の食事から体脂肪が緑色になることから名前がついています。

saltwater-crocodile.name: イリエワニ
saltwater-crocodile.description: The saltwater crocodile is the largest living reptile and has the strongest bite force ever measured. Found in coastal regions from eastern India to Australia, it is an opportunistic apex predator. Adults can survive in both saltwater and freshwater environments.
saltwater-crocodile.funFact: 3700psi以上と推定される、現存する動物の中で最も強い噛みつき力を持っています。

reticulated-python.name: レティキュレッドパイソン
reticulated-python.description: The reticulated python is a non-venomous constrictor and the longest snake in the world. Native to Southeast Asia, it is found in rainforests, rivers, and even near human settlements. It kills prey by constriction and can swallow animals much larger than its head.
reticulated-python.funFact: 世界最長のヘビで、7メートル以上になる个体もいます。

panther-chameleon.name: パンサカメレオン
panther-chameleon.description: The panther chameleon is a vibrant species native to Madagascar's tropical rainforests. Males display vivid colors ranging from blue, green, and yellow to red. They use their long, sticky tongues to catch insects with remarkable accuracy.
panther-chameleon.funFact: 色の変化は主にコミュニケーションと温度調節のためで、camouflage ではありません。

american-alligator.name: アメリカアリゲーター
american-alligator.description: The American alligator is a large crocodilian native to the southeastern United States. Once endangered, it has made a remarkable recovery through conservation efforts. It inhabits freshwater environments and is an opportunistic predator of fish, birds, and mammals.
american-alligator.funFact: 口を開けて体温を調節することができます。

leopard-gecko.name: ヒョウモントカゲモドキ
leopard-gecko.description: The leopard gecko is a small, nocturnal lizard native to the rocky deserts and grasslands of South Asia. Unlike many geckos, it has movable eyelids and can blink. It is one of the most popular pet reptiles due to its docile temperament.
leopard-gecko.funFact: 尻尾に脂肪を蓄え、捕らえられた場合に切り離し、後で再生させることができます。

green-iguana.name: アオイグアナ
green-iguana.description: The green iguana is a large, arboreal herbivorous lizard native to Central and South America. It is excellent at swimming and can hold its breath for up to 30 minutes. Juveniles are bright green while adults may turn orange or dull grey.
green-iguana.funFact: 15メートルの高さから落ちても、尻尾で落下を遅らせて生き残れます。

gharial.name: ガビアル
gharial.description: The gharial is a critically endangered crocodilian with a distinctive long, thin snout adapted for catching fish. Once found across the Indian subcontinent, it is now restricted to a few rivers in India and Nepal. It is one of the largest crocodilian species.
gharial.funFact: 魚を捕らえるのに最適な、最も長く細い吻を持つワニです。

boa-constrictor.name: ボアコンストリクター
boa-constrictor.description: The boa constrictor is a large, non-venomous constrictor found throughout Central and South America. It is a highly adaptable species found in rainforests, savannas, and even near human habitations. It kills prey by constriction and is a popular species in captivity.
boa-constrictor.funFact: 卵を産むのではなく、直接子を産み、60頭以上になることもあります。

black-mamba.name: ブラックマンバ
black-mamba.description: The black mamba is the fastest snake in the world and one of the most venomous. Found in eastern and southern Africa, it can reach speeds of 12 mph and strike with incredible accuracy. Its venom is neurotoxic and can be fatal without antivenom.
black-mamba.funFact: 名前に反し、黒くない。名前は暗い青黒い口の内側に由来します。

bearded-dragon.name: フクロトカゲ
bearded-dragon.description: The central bearded dragon is a popular pet lizard native to the arid regions of central Australia. It displays a darkened beard when threatened or during social interactions. It basks on rocks and branches, absorbing heat to regulate its body temperature.
bearded-dragon.funFact: 脅されるとトゲのある喉の鱗を膨らませ、口を開いて大きく見えようとします。

nile-crocodile.name: ナイルワニ
nile-crocodile.description: The Nile crocodile is one of the largest crocodilian species and is considered the most dangerous to humans. Found throughout sub-Saharan Africa, it is an apex predator of rivers and lakes. It can go months without eating and has the most powerful bite of any living animal.
nile-crocodile.funFact: ヒトに最も危険なワニとして知られ、年間約1000件の攻撃が報告されています。

ball-python.name: ボールパイソン
ball-python.description: The ball python is a non-venomous constrictor native to the grasslands of western and central Africa. It is the most popular pet snake in the world due to its docile temperament and manageable size. It has hundreds of color morphs bred in captivity.
ball-python.funFact: 驚くと頭を中央に隠した小さなボールになります。

red-eared-slider.name: ミシシッピカミソリ
red-eared-slider.description: The red-eared slider is a semi-aquatic turtle native to the Mississippi Valley region of the United States. It is the most popular pet turtle in the world and has become a significant invasive species on every continent except Antarctica. It has a distinctive red stripe behind each eye.
red-eared-slider.funFact: 世界で最も広く分布するガメで、外来種トップ100に入っています。

emperor-penguin.name: エンペラーペンギン
emperor-penguin.description: The emperor penguin is the tallest and heaviest of all living penguins. It breeds during the Antarctic winter, with males incubating the egg for about 65 days.
emperor-penguin.funFact: 550メートル以上まで潜り、20分以上息を止めることができます。

king-penguin.name: キングペンギン
king-penguin.description: The king penguin is the second-largest penguin species, found on sub-Antarctic islands with striking orange and silver markings.
king-penguin.funFact: 親は孵化中に2週間食べないこともあります。

rockhopper-penguin.name: イワトビペンギン
rockhopper-penguin.description: The rockhopper penguin is a small penguin known for its distinctive yellow and black crest feathers. It navigates steep, rocky terrain by hopping.
rockhopper-penguin.funFact: 歩く代わりに両足で岩から岩へ跳ねます。

gentoo-penguin.name: ジェンツーペンギン
gentoo-penguin.description: The gentoo penguin is recognizable by the white stripe across its head and its bright orange-red bill. It is the fastest underwater swimming bird.
gentoo-penguin.funFact: 時速35キロメートルで泳ぐ、最も速い水中泳ぎの鳥です。

african-penguin.name: アフリカペンギン
african-penguin.description: The African penguin, also known as the jackass penguin for its donkey-like bray, is the only penguin species that breeds in Africa. It is endangered.
african-penguin.funFact: ロバのように鳴くため、ジャックアスペンギンとも呼ばれます。

bald-eagle.name: オオワシ
bald-eagle.description: The bald eagle is a bird of prey found in North America and a national symbol of the United States. It is a large raptor with a distinctive white head and tail contrasting with a dark brown body.
bald-eagle.funFact: 獲物を探すために180度頭を回転させることができます。

golden-eagle.name: イヌワシ
golden-eagle.description: The golden eagle is one of the largest and most powerful raptors in North America and Eurasia. Named for the golden-brown plumage on its head and neck, it hunts primarily rabbits and hares.
golden-eagle.funFact: 獲物に急降下する時に時速320キロメートル以上に達します。

peregrine-falcon.name: ハヤブサ
peregrine-falcon.description: The peregrine falcon is a widespread bird of prey known for its incredible speed during its hunting dive. It feeds primarily on medium-sized birds caught in flight.
peregrine-falcon.funFact: 狩りの急降下で時速380キロメートル以上に達する、最も速い動物です。

barn-owl.name: メンガタコウモリ
barn-owl.description: The barn owl is a nocturnal raptor found on every continent except Antarctica. Known for its heart-shaped face and ghostly white plumage, it is an exceptionally efficient hunter of rodents.
barn-owl.funFact: 完全な暗闇でも驚くべき聴力だけで獲物を見つけることができます。

great-horned-owl.name: オオメンガタコウモリ
great-horned-owl.description: The great horned owl is a powerful nocturnal predator with distinctive ear tufts and deep hooting calls. It is highly adaptable and preys on a wide range of animals.
great-horned-owl.funFact: 約300psiの握力を持ち、大型犬の噛みつき力に匹敵します。

snowy-owl.name: シロフクロウ
snowy-owl.description: The snowy owl is a large, white owl of the Arctic tundra. Unlike most owl species, it hunts during the day, feeding primarily on lemmings. Males become whiter as they age.
snowy-owl.funFact: 他のフクロウと異なり、昼間に狩りをする昼行性です。

mallard.name: マガモ
mallard.description: The mallard is the most common and widespread duck in the Northern Hemisphere. Males have a distinctive iridescent green head, while females are mottled brown.
mallard.funFact: モスクビガモ以外のすべての家ガチョは野生のマガモの子孫です。

canada-goose.name: カナダガン
canada-goose.description: The Canada goose is a large waterfowl native to North America, recognized by its black head and neck with white chinstrap. Highly adaptable, it is known for its V-formation flight.
canada-goose.funFact: 一生の伴侶とし、20年以上一緒にいます。

mute-swan.name: コブハクチョウ
mute-swan.description: The mute swan is one of the largest flying birds, with pure white plumage and an orange bill with a black knob. It is known for its graceful S-shaped neck posture.
mute-swan.funFact: 巣の激しい防御者で、侵入者に突進します。

flamingo.name: フラミンゴ
flamingo.description: The greater flamingo is the largest and most widespread flamingo species. Its pink plumage, long legs, and curved bill are unmistakable.
flamingo.funFact: エビや藻に含まれるカロテノイド色素からピンク色になります。

ostrich.name: ダチョウ
