ostrich.description: The common ostrich is the largest living bird, native to Africa. Unable to fly, it has powerful legs and can run at sustained speeds of 30 mph.
ostrich.funFact: すべての陸上動物の中で最も大きな目を持ち、直径約5センチです。

emu.name: エミュー
emu.description: The emu is the second-largest living bird, native to Australia. It is flightless with vestigial wings. The male emu performs all parental duties.
emu.funFact: オスのエミューは卵を孵し、最大18ヶ月 alone で子育てします。

scarlet-macaw.name: アイインコ
scarlet-macaw.description: The scarlet macaw is a large, colorful parrot with brilliant red, yellow, and blue plumage. Found in Central and South American rainforests.
scarlet-macaw.funFact: 飼育下で75年以上生き、一生の伴侶とします。

monarch-butterfly.name: タテチョウ
monarch-butterfly.description: The monarch butterfly is one of the most recognizable butterflies in North America, known for its striking orange and black wing pattern. It is famous for its incredible long-distance migration across thousands of miles.
monarch-butterfly.funFact: 毎年秋、カナダからメキシコまで最大5000キロメートル移動します。

ladybug.name: テントウムシ
ladybug.description: Ladybugs are small, round beetles valued by gardeners for their appetite for aphids and other plant pests. Their bright red coloration with black spots warns predators of their bitter taste.
ladybug.funFact: 一生で最大5000匹のアブラムシを食べることができます。

sloth.name: ナマケモノ
sloth.description: Sloths are slow-moving tree-dwelling mammals known for their lazy lifestyle.

axolotl.name: アクシオロトル
axolotl.description: The Axolotl is a neotenic salamander that retains its larval features throughout life, including external gills. Found only in Lake Xochimilco in Mexico, it is critically endangered in the wild but widely bred in captivity.
axolotl.funFact: 一生を通じて手足、脊髄、心臓、脳の一部を再生することができます。

incredible-frog.name: インクレディブルガエル
incredible-frog.description: The Incredible Frog is a small tree frog found in the rainforests of Central America. They have specialized finger and toe pads that allow them to control their descent when jumping between trees.
incredible-frog.funFact: 高い枝からジャンプする際に、指とつま先を広げて落下を遅らせることができます。

meerkat.name: ミーアキャット
meerkat.description: Meerkats are social mongooses that live in the Kalahari Desert.
meerkat.funFact: 最大30頭のグループで生活します。

mongoose.name: マングース
mongoose.description: Mongooses are small carnivores known for their ability to fight snakes.
mongoose.funFact: ある種のヘビの毒に対して免疫があります。

praying-mantis.name: カマキリ
praying-mantis.description: The Chinese praying mantis is a large, elongated predatory insect with triangular head and powerful raptorial front legs. It is a sit-and-wait ambush predator of other insects.
praying-mantis.funFact: 獲物を探すために180度頭を回転させることができます。

dragonfly.name: トンボ
dragonfly.description: Dragonflies are ancient aerial predators with enormous compound eyes and two pairs of independently controlled wings. They are among the most efficient hunters in the insect world.
dragonfly.funFact: 6方向すべてに飛ぶことができ、ヘリコプターのようにホバリングできます。

firefly.name: ホタル
firefly.description: Fireflies are beetles famous for their bioluminescent abdomens used to attract mates. Both adults and larvae produce light through a chemical reaction involving luciferin and luciferase.
firefly.funFact: 幼虫も光り、一部は捕食者を防ぐために光を出します。

black-widow-spider.name: クロゴケグモ
black-widow-spider.description: The southern black widow is one of North America's most venomous spiders. Females are recognized by the red hourglass marking on their abdomen and sometimes eat the male after mating.
black-widow-spider.funFact: 毒はガラガラヘビの15倍強いですが、注入される量は少ないです。

tarantula.name: タランチュラ
tarantula.description: The Mexican red-kneed tarantula is a large, docile spider popular in the pet trade. It has urticating hairs on its abdomen that it can flick at threats, causing skin irritation.
tarantula.funFact: 牙から消化液を出し、水として排泄します。

giant-pacific-octopus.name: ミズダコ
giant-pacific-octopus.description: The giant Pacific octopus is the largest known octopus species, renowned for its intelligence and ability to solve puzzles. It has three hearts, blue blood, and eight dexterous arms lined with suckers.
giant-pacific-octopus.funFact: ミリ秒単位で色と模様を変化させて周囲に溶け込みます。

common-octopus.name: マダコ
common-octopus.description: The common octopus is a highly intelligent marine invertebrate with excellent eyesight and problem-solving abilities. It uses ink clouds and camouflage as primary defense mechanisms.
common-octopus.funFact: 口のビックより大きい隙間ならどこでも通り抜けられます。

moon-jellyfish.name: ミズクラゲ
moon-jellyfish.description: Moon jellyfish are one of the most common and widely distributed jellyfish species. Their translucent bells pulse gently through coastal waters, feeding on plankton and small organisms.
moon-jellyfish.funFact: 有性生殖と無性生殖の両方で繁殖し、個体数を爆発的に増やすことができます。

box-jellyfish.name: ハブクラゲ
box-jellyfish.description: Box jellyfish are among the most venomous creatures on Earth. Their nearly transparent, cube-shaped bells and up to 60 tentacles make them difficult to spot in tropical waters.
box-jellyfish.funFact: 画像を形成できる2つの目を含む24個の目を持っています。

common-starfish.name: イトマキヒトデ
common-starfish.description: The common starfish is one of the most recognizable sea stars, with five arms and a tough, spiny surface. It feeds on mussels and oysters by everting its stomach through its mouth.
common-starfish.funFact: 胃を口から外に押し出して獲物を外部消化することができます。

blue-poison-dart-frog.name: アオヤドクガエル
blue-poison-dart-frog.description: The Blue Poison Dart Frog is a small, brilliantly colored amphibian found in the rainforests of Suriname. Their vivid blue coloration warns predators of their potent skin toxins.
blue-poison-dart-frog.funFact: 野生で食べるアリやダニから毒素を得ています。

golden-poison-dart-frog.name: キンイロヤドクガエル
golden-poison-dart-frog.description: The Golden Poison Dart Frog is the most toxic vertebrate on Earth. Found only in Colombia, its bright yellow skin contains batrachotoxin, a potent neurotoxin used by indigenous people to poison blowgun darts.
golden-poison-dart-frog.funFact: 一匹のキンイロヤドクガエルには10人の大人を殺せるほどの毒が含まれています。

red-eyed-tree-frog.name: アカマタメガエル
red-eyed-tree-frog.description: The Red-Eyed Tree Frog is one of the most iconic rainforest amphibians. With vibrant green bodies, blue and yellow striped sides, and stunning red eyes, they are a symbol of tropical biodiversity.
red-eyed-tree-frog.funFact: 鮮やかな赤い目で捕食者を驚かせ、逃げる時間を稼ぎます。

green-basilisk.name: イグアナ
green-basilisk.description: The green basilisk is a striking lizard found in the tropical rainforests of Central America. Males have impressive crests on their heads, backs, and tails. It is famous for its ability to run bipedally across water surfaces for short distances.
green-basilisk.funFact: 水面を走ることができ、イエスキリストザルとも呼ばれています。

thorny-devil.name: サボテントカゲ
thorny-devil.description: The thorny devil is a small, spiny lizard native to the arid deserts of central Australia. Its entire body is covered in conical spines that provide defense against predators. Its skin has microscopic channels that collect water and transport it to its mouth.
thorny-devil.funFact: 皮膚のマイクロチャネルが体のどこからでも口まで水を運びます。

common-snapping-turtle.name: ガメ
common-snapping-turtle.description: The common snapping turtle is a large, freshwater turtle found across eastern North America. It has a powerful beak-like jaw and a long, prehistoric-looking tail. Unlike most turtles, it cannot fully retract into its shell, making it more aggressive on land.
common-snapping-turtle.funFact: 殻の長さに匹敵するほど首を伸ばして獲物や脅威を攻撃できます。

alligator-snapping-turtle.name: アリゲーターガメ
alligator-snapping-turtle.description: The alligator snapping turtle is the largest freshwater turtle in North America. It has a massive head, a hooked beak, and a shell with three prominent ridges. It is an ambush predator that lies motionless on the river bottom with its mouth open.
alligator-snapping-turtle.funFact: 舌の上のワームのような突起で魚をおびき寄せて食べます。

hawaiian-monk-seal.name: Hawaiian Monk Seal
hawaiian-monk-seal.description: The Hawaiian monk seal is an endangered species endemic to the Hawaiian Islands.
hawaiian-monk-seal.funFact: 世界で最も希少なアザラシの1つ

steller-sea-lion.name: Steller Sea Lion
steller-sea-lion.description: Steller sea lions are the largest of the eared seals, named after Georg Steller.
steller-sea-lion.funFact: 耳付きアザラシの中で最大種

crested-porcupine.name: Crested Porcupine
crested-porcupine.description: The crested porcupine is a large rodent with long, sharp quills.
crested-porcupine.funFact: 棘は最大35cmまで成長する

naked-mole-rat.name: Naked Mole Rat
naked-mole-rat.description: The naked mole rat is a burrowing rodent with unusual adaptations for underground life.
naked-mole-rat.funFact: 同サイズのげっ歯類よりも数十年長生きできる

prairie-dog.name: Prairie Dog
prairie-dog.description: Prairie dogs are social rodents that live in underground burrow systems.
prairie-dog.funFact: 複雑なコミュニケーションシステムを持つ

indian-flying-fox.name: Indian Flying Fox
indian-flying-fox.description: The Indian flying fox is one of the largest bats in the world, a fruit-eating megabat.
indian-flying-fox.funFact: 翼開長が最大1.5メートルに達する

little-brown-bat.name: Little Brown Bat
little-brown-bat.description: The little brown bat is a small insectivorous bat found across North America.
little-brown-bat.funFact: 1時間に1000匹の蚊を食べることができる

mexican-free-tailed-bat.name: Mexican Free-tailed Bat
mexican-free-tailed-bat.description: The Mexican free-tailed bat is known for its incredible speed and massive colonies.
mexican-free-tailed-bat.funFact: 水平飛行で最速の動物

fruit-bat.name: Fruit Bat
fruit-bat.description: Fruit bats or megabats feed on fruit and nectar, using keen senses of smell and sight.
fruit-bat.funFact: エコーロケーションの代わりに嗅覚を使う

horseshoe-bat.name: Horseshoe Bat
horseshoe-bat.description: Horseshoe bats are named for their distinctive nose leaf used in echolocation.
horseshoe-bat.funFact: 独特の蹄形の鼻葉を持つ

vampire-bat.name: Vampire Bat
vampire-bat.description: Vampire bats are the only mammals that feed exclusively on blood.
vampire-bat.funFact: 完全に血液のみを餌にする唯一の哺乳類

megabat.name: Megabat
megabat.description: Megabats are large fruit-eating bats with excellent vision and sense of smell.
megabat.funFact: 翼開長が1.7メートルに達することがある

quokka.name: Quokka
quokka.description: Quokkas are small marsupials famous for their 'smiling' expression.
quokka.funFact: 地球上で最も幸せな動物として知られる

quoll.name: Quoll
quoll.description: Quolls are carnivorous marsupials with distinctive spotted coats.
quoll.funFact: オーストラリアとニューギニア固有の動物

numbat.name: Numbat
numbat.description: The numbat is a small, termite-eating marsupial with distinctive striped rear.
numbat.funFact: 1日に最大20000匹のシロアリを食べる

bandicoot.name: Bandicoot
bandicoot.description: Bandicoots are small, omnivorous marsupials found throughout Australia.

sugar-glider.name: Sugar Glider
sugar-glider.description: The sugar glider is a small, nocturnal marsupial with membrane for gliding.
sugar-glider.funFact: 最大50メートル滑空することができる

possum.name: Possum
possum.description: Possums are small to medium-sized marsupials found in Australia and surrounding regions.
possum.funFact: オーストラリアの郊外で一般的

fisher.name: Fisher
fisher.description: The fisher is a medium-sized mustelid known for hunting porcupines.
fisher.funFact: ヤマアラシを杀死できる数少ない動物の1つ

pine-marten.name: Pine Marten
pine-marten.description: The pine marten is a small, agile mustelid found in European forests.
pine-marten.funFact: 後ろ足を回転させて木を降りることができる

stoat.name: Stoat
stoat.description: The stoat or short-tailed weasel is a small predator with seasonal coat changes.
stoat.funFact: 季節に合わせて毛色が変化する

weasel.name: Weasel
weasel.description: Weasels are small, slender carnivores with long bodies and short legs.
weasel.funFact: 2cmほどの穴をすり抜けることができる

european-polecat.name: European Polecat
european-polecat.description: The European polecat is a medium-sized mustelid, ancestor of the domestic ferret.

mink.name: Mink
mink.description: Minks are semi-aquatic mustelids prized for their luxurious fur.
mink.funFact: 優れた泳ぎ手と潜水者

coati.name: Coati
coati.description: Coatis are social, ring-tailed relatives of raccoons found in the Americas.
coati.funFact: 20個体以上の群体で生活する

kinkajou.name: Kinkajou
kinkajou.description: The kinkajou is a nocturnal, tree-dwelling mammal with a prehensile tail.
kinkajou.funFact: 足を180度回転させることができる

tenrec.name: Tenrec
tenrec.description: Tenrecs are small, insect-eating mammals endemic to Madagascar.
tenrec.funFact: マダガスカルにのみ生息する

star-nosed-mole.name: Star-nosed Mole
star-nosed-mole.description: The star-nosed mole has a distinctive star-shaped nose used to detect prey underground.
star-nosed-mole.funFact: 230ミリ秒以内に食物を認識して食べることができる

golden-mole.name: Golden Mole
golden-mole.description: Golden moos are small, burrowing insectivores with shimmering golden fur.
golden-mole.funFact: 虹色の光沢がある毛皮を持つ

solenodon.name: Solenodon
solenodon.description: The solenodon is a rare, venomous mammal found only in the Caribbean.

elephant-shrew.name: Elephant Shrew
elephant-shrew.description: Elephant shrews are small, insect-eating mammals with distinctive long noses.

chinese-pangolin.name: Chinese Pangolin
chinese-pangolin.description: The Chinese pangolin is a critically endangered, scaly anteater.
chinese-pangolin.funFact: 世界で最も密売されている哺乳類

sunda-pangolin.name: Sunda Pangolin
sunda-pangolin.description: The Sunda pangolin is a scaly anteater found in Southeast Asia.
sunda-pangolin.funFact: 脅威を受けると球体に丸まる

indian-pangolin.name: Indian Pangolin
indian-pangolin.description: The Indian pangolin is a scaly anteater found in the Indian subcontinent.
indian-pangolin.funFact: 歯がないが強い腹筋を使う

white-bellied-pangolin.name: White-bellied Pangolin
white-bellied-pangolin.description: The white-bellied pangolin is a tree-dwelling pangolin with a prehensile tail.

giant-pangolin.name: Giant Pangolin
giant-pangolin.description: The giant pangolin is the largest living pangolin, found in Central Africa.
giant-pangolin.funFact: 全てのパンゴリンの中で最大

giant-armadillo.name: Giant Armadillo
giant-armadillo.description: The giant armadillo is the largest living armadillo, found in South America.
giant-armadillo.funFact: 一振りでシロアリの塚を破壊できる

nine-banded-armadillo.name: Nine-banded Armadillo
nine-banded-armadillo.description: The nine-banded armadillo is the only armadillo found in the United States.
nine-banded-armadillo.funFact: 常に同一の四つ子を出産する

pink-fairy-armadillo.name: Pink Fairy Armadillo
pink-fairy-armadillo.description: The pink fairy armadillo is the smallest armadillo, found in central Argentina.

southern-three-banded-armadillo.name: Southern Three-banded Armadillo
southern-three-banded-armadillo.description: The southern three-banded armadillo can roll into a perfect ball for protection.
southern-three-banded-armadillo.funFact: 完全な球体に丸まることができる

giant-anteater.name: Giant Anteater
giant-anteater.description: The giant anteater is the largest of the anteaters, with a long, sticky tongue.
giant-anteater.funFact: 1日に35000匹のアリを食べることができる

two-toed-sloth.name: Two-toed Sloth
two-toed-sloth.description: Two-toed sloths are nocturnal, tree-dwelling mammals with two claws on each foot.
two-toed-sloth.funFact: 動きが遅すぎて毛皮に藻が生える

southern-tamandua.name: Southern Tamandua
southern-tamandua.description: The southern tamandua is a medium-sized anteater with a prehensile tail.

aardvark.name: Aardvark
aardvark.description: The aardvark is a nocturnal, burrowing mammal that feeds on ants and termites.

bat-eared-fox.name: Bat-eared Fox
bat-eared-fox.description: The bat-eared fox has enormous ears used to detect insects beneath the soil.
bat-eared-fox.funFact: 大きな耳を使って地下の昆虫を見つける

fossa.name: Fossa
fossa.description: The fossa is a cat-like predator found only in Madagascar.
fossa.funFact: 最も近い親戚はマングース

aardwolf.name: Aardwolf
aardwolf.description: The aardwolf is a small, insectivorous member of the hyena family.
aardwolf.funFact: シロアリのみを食べる

spotted-hyena.name: Spotted Hyena
spotted-hyena.description: The spotted hyena is a powerful predator and scavenger with an impressive bite.
spotted-hyena.funFact: 最も強い噛む力の1つを持つ

striped-hyena.name: Striped Hyena
striped-hyena.description: The striped hyena is a smaller hyena species with distinctive stripes.
striped-hyena.funFact: 背骨に沿って縞模様の毛並みを持つ

martens.name: Martens
martens.description: Martens are small, agile mustelids found in forests worldwide.

sable.name: Sable
sable.description: The sable is a species of marten known for its highly valued fur.

hog-badger.name: Hog Badger
hog-badger.description: The hog badger is a stout badger found in Southeast Asia.
hog-badger.funFact: 掘るのに強い爪を持つ

raccoon-dog.name: Raccoon Dog
raccoon-dog.description: The raccoon dog is a canid native to East Asia that resembles a raccoon.
raccoon-dog.funFact: 実際はラッコでもイヌでもない

crabeater-seal.name: Crabeater Seal
crabeater-seal.description: The crabeater seal is the most numerous seal species, found around Antarctica.
crabeater-seal.funFact: 世界で最も豊富なアザラシ種

weddell-seal.name: Weddell Seal
weddell-seal.description: The Weddell seal is the southernmost breeding mammal on Earth.

ross-seal.name: Ross Seal
ross-seal.description: The Ross seal is a small, rarely seen seal found in Antarctic pack ice.
ross-seal.funFact: 過酷な生息地のためめったに見られない

arctic-ground-squirrel.name: Arctic Ground Squirrel
arctic-ground-squirrel.description: The Arctic ground squirrel is the only Arctic mammal that hibernates.
arctic-ground-squirrel.funFact: 血液を氷点下まで過冷却できる

nutria.name: Nutria
nutria.description: Nutria are large, semi-aquatic rodents native to South America.

african-crested-porcupine.name: African Crested Porcupine
african-crested-porcupine.description: The African crested porcupine is the largest porcupine found in Africa.
african-crested-porcupine.funFact: アフリカ最大のヤマアラシ

springhare.name: Springhare
springhare.description: The springhare is a rodent that moves by hopping, similar to a kangaroo.
springhare.funFact: 最大2メートル跳ねることができる

cane-rat.name: Cane Rat
cane-rat.description: The cane rat is a large rodent found in West and Central Africa.
cane-rat.funFact: アフリカで重要なブッシュミート種

paca.name: Paca
paca.description: The paca is a large rodent found in tropical forests of Central and South America.
paca.funFact: 体側に特徴的な白い斑点を持つ

agouti.name: Agouti
agouti.description: The agouti is a rodent that plays an important role in forest ecosystems.
agouti.funFact: ブラジルナッツの種子散布を助ける

mara.name: Mara
mara.description: The mara is a large, long-legged rodent found in Argentina.
mara.funFact: 時速45kmで走ることができる

rock-hyrax.name: Rock Hyrax
rock-hyrax.description: The rock hyrax is a small, herbivorous mammal found in Africa and the Middle East.
rock-hyrax.funFact: ゾウの最も近い現存親戚

cape-hyrax.name: Cape Hyrax
cape-hyrax.description: The Cape hyrax is a small, social mammal found in southern Africa.
cape-hyrax.funFact: 特徴的な芳香腺を持つ

hyrax.name: Hyrax
hyrax.description: Hyraxes are small, rock-dwelling mammals related to elephants.
hyrax.funFact: サイズに関係なくゾウと関連する

golden-moles.name: Golden Moles
golden-moles.description: Golden moos are small, burrowing insectivores with shimmering golden fur.
golden-moles.funFact: 虹色の光沢がある毛皮を持つ

elephant-shrews.name: Elephant Shrews
elephant-shrews.description: Elephant shrews are small, insect-eating mammals with distinctive long noses.

fennec-foxes.name: Fennec Foxes
fennec-foxes.description: The fennec fox is the smallest fox, with enormous ears that help regulate body temperature.
fennec-foxes.funFact: 放熱用の大型の耳を持つ

blanford-s-fox.name: Blanford's Fox
blanford-s-fox.description: Blanford's fox is a small fox found in the Middle East and Central Asia.
blanford-s-fox.funFact: 最大3メートル垂直に跳ねることができる

r-ppell-s-fox.name: Rüppell's Fox
r-ppell-s-fox.description: Rüppell's fox is a small fox found in North Africa and the Middle East.
r-ppell-s-fox.funFact: ドイツの博物学者エドゥアルト・リュペルにちまって命名

corsac-fox.name: Corsac Fox
corsac-fox.description: The Corsac fox is a small fox found in the steppes of Central Asia.

ussuri-brown-bear.name: Ussuri Brown Bear
ussuri-brown-bear.description: The Ussuri brown bear is one of the largest bear subspecies in the world.
ussuri-brown-bear.funFact: ヨーロッパとアジアで最大のヒグマ

kodiak-bear.name: Kodiak Bear
kodiak-bear.description: The Kodiak bear is a subspecies of brown bear found on Kodiak Island, Alaska.
kodiak-bear.funFact: 最大のヒグマ亜種の1つ

gobi-bear.name: Gobi Bear
gobi-bear.description: The Gobi bear is the rarest bear subspecies, found only in the Gobi Desert.
gobi-bear.funFact: 世界で最も希少なヒグマ

syrian-brown-bear.name: Syrian Brown Bear
syrian-brown-bear.description: The Syrian brown bear is a relatively small brown bear subspecies found in the Middle East.
syrian-brown-bear.funFact: ヒグマ亜種の中で最小

atlantic-walrus.name: Atlantic Walrus
atlantic-walrus.description: The Atlantic walrus is a large pinniped with distinctive long tusks.
atlantic-walrus.funFact: 牙は最大1メートルまで成長する

pacific-walrus.name: Pacific Walrus
pacific-walrus.description: The Pacific walrus is a large pinniped with tusks used for hauling out on ice.
pacific-walrus.funFact: 牙を使って氷上に引き上げる

northern-fur-seal.name: Northern Fur Seal
northern-fur-seal.description: The northern fur seal is a eared seal known for its dense, luxurious fur.
northern-fur-seal.funFact: 厚い二重構造の毛皮を持つ

guadalupe-fur-seal.name: Guadalupe Fur Seal
guadalupe-fur-seal.description: The Guadalupe fur seal is a rare eared seal found off the coast of Mexico.
guadalupe-fur-seal.funFact: かつて絶滅の危機に瀕した

new-zealand-sea-lion.name: New Zealand Sea Lion
new-zealand-sea-lion.description: The New Zealand sea lion is one of the rarest sea lions in the world.
new-zealand-sea-lion.funFact: 最も希少なアザラシの1つ

galapagos-sea-lion.name: Galapagos Sea Lion
galapagos-sea-lion.description: The Galapagos sea lion is endemic to the Galapagos Islands.
galapagos-sea-lion.funFact: ガラパゴス諸島にのみ生息

south-american-sea-lion.name: South American Sea Lion
south-american-sea-lion.description: The South American sea lion is found along the coasts of South America.
south-american-sea-lion.funFact: オスは厚いタテガミを持つ

australian-sea-lion.name: Australian Sea Lion
australian-sea-lion.description: The Australian sea lion is an endangered species endemic to Australia.
australian-sea-lion.funFact: オーストラリアにのみ生息

antarctic-fur-seal.name: Antarctic Fur Seal
antarctic-fur-seal.description: The Antarctic fur seal has incredibly dense fur for insulation.
antarctic-fur-seal.funFact: 1平方センチメートルあたり最大30万本の毛を持つ密毛

subantarctic-fur-seal.name: Subantarctic Fur Seal
subantarctic-fur-seal.description: The subantarctic fur seal lives on remote islands in the Southern Ocean.
subantarctic-fur-seal.funFact: 過酷な亜南極島に生息

pangolin.name: Pangolin
pangolin.description: Pangolins are scaly anteaters, the only mammals with scales.
pangolin.funFact: 世界で最も密売されている哺乳類

black-footed-ferret.name: Black-footed Ferret
black-footed-ferret.description: The black-footed ferret is one of the most endangered mammals in North America.
black-footed-ferret.funFact: かつて絶滅したと考えられていた

steppe-polecat.name: Steppe Polecat
steppe-polecat.description: The steppe polecat is a small mustelid found in the steppes of Central Asia.
steppe-polecat.funFact: マスクされたテンとも呼ばれる

yellow-throated-marten.name: Yellow-throated Marten
yellow-throated-marten.description: The yellow-throated marten is an agile predator found in Asian forests.
yellow-throated-marten.funFact: 自分より大きい動物を捕食できる

marbled-polecat.name: Marbled Polecat
marbled-polecat.description: The marbled polecat is a small, colorful mustelid found in Central Asia.
marbled-polecat.funFact: 特徴的な大理石模様の毛皮を持つ

least-weasel.name: Least Weasel
least-weasel.description: The least weasel is the smallest carnivore, yet a fierce hunter.

long-tailed-weasel.name: Long-tailed Weasel
long-tailed-weasel.description: The long-tailed weasel is a slender predator found across the Americas.
long-tailed-weasel.funFact: 先が黒い長い尻尾を持つ

greater-sheathbill.name: Greater Sheathbill
greater-sheathbill.description: The greater sheathbill is the only land bird found in Antarctica.

yellow-eyed-panda.name: Yellow-eyed Panda
yellow-eyed-panda.description: The yellow-eyed panda is a rare subspecies of giant panda with yellowish fur.
yellow-eyed-panda.funFact: ゴールデンパンダとも呼ばれる

tibetan-fox.name: Tibetan Fox
tibetan-fox.description: The Tibetan fox is a small fox with a uniquely flat, square face.
tibetan-fox.funFact: 特徴的な四角い顔を持つ

pale-fox.name: Pale Fox
pale-fox.description: The pale fox is a small, desert-dwelling fox found in the Sahel region of Africa.
pale-fox.funFact: 地下の巣穴で生活する

crab-eating-fox.name: Crab-eating Fox
crab-eating-fox.description: The crab-eating fox is a small canid found in South American forests.

short-eared-dog.name: Short-eared Dog
short-eared-dog.description: The short-eared dog is a small, shy canid found in Amazon rainforests.
short-eared-dog.funFact: 南米の熱帯雨林で唯一のイヌ科動物

bush-dog.name: Bush Dog
bush-dog.description: The bush dog is a small, social canid found in South American forests.
bush-dog.funFact: 最大12頭の群れで生活する

sechuran-fox.name: Sechuran Fox
sechuran-fox.description: The Sechuran fox is a small fox found in the Sechura Desert of South America.
sechuran-fox.funFact: ペルーとエクアドルにのみ生息

darwin-s-fox.name: Darwin's Fox
darwin-s-fox.description: Darwin's fox is a small, critically endangered fox found in Chile.
darwin-s-fox.funFact: チャールズ・ダーウィンによって発見された

hoary-fox.name: Hoary Fox
hoary-fox.description: The hoary fox is a small canid endemic to Brazil.

silver-fox.name: Silver Fox
silver-fox.description: The silver fox is a melanistic variant of the red fox with beautiful silver-tipped fur.

siamese-fox.name: Siamese Fox
siamese-fox.description: The Siamese fox is a small canid found in Southeast Asia.
siamese-fox.funFact: アジアタヌキとも呼ばれる

kit-fox.name: Kit Fox
kit-fox.description: The kit fox is a small, desert-adapted fox with enormous ears.
kit-fox.funFact: 体サイズに対する最大の耳を持つ

swift-fox.name: Swift Fox
swift-fox.description: The swift fox is a small, fast fox found in North American grasslands.
swift-fox.funFact: 時速60kmで走ることができる

serengeti-fox.name: Serengeti Fox
serengeti-fox.description: The Serengeti fox is a small fox found in the African savanna.
serengeti-fox.funFact: ステップキツネとも呼ばれる

gray-fox.name: Gray Fox
gray-fox.description: The gray fox is unique among canids for its ability to climb trees.

earless-fox.name: Earless Fox
earless-fox.description: The earless fox is a small, desert-dwelling fox with reduced ears.
earless-fox.funFact: 非常に小さい耳を持つ

big-eared-fox.name: Big-eared Fox
big-eared-fox.description: The big-eared fox has disproportionately large ears for cooling.
big-eared-fox.funFact: 体温調節用の巨大な耳を持つ

island-fox.name: Island Fox
island-fox.description: The island fox is a small fox endemic to California's Channel Islands.
island-fox.funFact: カリフォルニアのシャネル諸島にのみ生息

koslov-s-fox.name: Koslov's Fox
koslov-s-fox.description: Koslov's fox is a small fox found in the steppes of Central Asia.
koslov-s-fox.funFact: コルサックギツネとも呼ばれる

bat-eared-foxes.name: Bat-eared Foxes
bat-eared-foxes.description: The bat-eared fox has enormous ears used to detect insects beneath the soil.
bat-eared-foxes.funFact: 大きな耳を使って地下の昆虫を見つける

saharan-fox.name: Saharan Fox
saharan-fox.description: The Saharan fox is a small fox adapted to life in the Sahara Desert.
saharan-fox.funFact: フェネックギツネとも呼ばれる

indian-fox.name: Indian Fox
indian-fox.description: The Indian fox is a small fox found in the Indian subcontinent.
indian-fox.funFact: ベンガルギツネとも呼ばれる

persian-fox.name: Persian Fox
persian-fox.description: The Persian fox is a small fox found in the arid regions of the Middle East.

bengal-fox.name: Bengal Fox
bengal-fox.description: The Bengal fox is a small fox found in the grasslands of India.
bengal-fox.funFact: 特徴的な先が黒い尻尾を持つ

ugandan-fox.name: Ugandan Fox
ugandan-fox.description: The Ugandan fox is a small fox endemic to Uganda.

tundra-fox.name: Tundra Fox
tundra-fox.description: The tundra fox is a small fox adapted to life in the Arctic tundra.

mountain-fox.name: Mountain Fox
mountain-fox.description: The mountain fox is a small fox adapted to high-altitude environments.

cozumel-fox.name: Cozumel Fox
cozumel-fox.description: The Cozumel fox is a critically endangered fox found only on Cozumel Island.
cozumel-fox.funFact: コズメル島にのみ生息

gracile-fox.name: Gracile Fox
gracile-fox.description: The gracile fox is a small, slender fox found in South American grasslands.

simien-fox.name: Simien Fox
simien-fox.description: The Simien fox is a rare canid found only in the Ethiopian highlands.
simien-fox.funFact: エチオピアオオカミとも呼ばれる

javan-rhinoceros.name: Javan Rhinoceros
javan-rhinoceros.description: The Javan rhinoceros is one of the rarest large mammals on Earth.
javan-rhinoceros.funFact: 世界で最も希少なサイ

sumatran-rhinoceros.name: Sumatran Rhinoceros
sumatran-rhinoceros.description: The Sumatran rhinoceros is the smallest living rhino, with two horns.

indian-rhinoceros.name: Indian Rhinoceros
indian-rhinoceros.description: The Indian rhinoceros has thick, folded skin resembling armor.

himalayan-tahr.name: Himalayan Tahr
himalayan-tahr.description: The Himalayan tahr is a large ungulate adapted to steep, rocky terrain.

markhor.name: Markhor
markhor.description: The markhor is a large wild goat with distinctive spiral horns.
markhor.funFact: 印象的な螺旋状の角を持つ

blue-sheep.name: Blue Sheep
blue-sheep.description: The blue sheep or bharal is a caprine found in the Himalayas.
blue-sheep.funFact: バーラルとも呼ばれる

barbary-sheep.name: Barbary Sheep
barbary-sheep.description: The Barbary sheep is a caprine adapted to arid mountain environments.
barbary-sheep.funFact: アウダッドとも呼ばれる

musk-deer.name: Musk Deer
musk-deer.description: The musk deer is a small deer known for the musk gland used in perfumes.
musk-deer.funFact: 香水用の麝香を生産する

tufted-deer.name: Tufted Deer
tufted-deer.description: The tufted deer is a small deer with distinctive fang-like canines.
tufted-deer.funFact: 牙のような小さな犬歯を持つ

muntjac.name: Muntjac
muntjac.description: The muntjac is a small deer known for its barking call when alarmed.

reeves-s-muntjac.name: Reeves's Muntjac
reeves-s-muntjac.description: Reeves's muntjac is a small deer introduced to the UK from China.
reeves-s-muntjac.funFact: 中国から英国に導入された

chinese-water-deer.name: Chinese Water Deer
chinese-water-deer.description: The Chinese water deer is known for its distinctive fang-like canines.
chinese-water-deer.funFact: 牙のような長い犬歯を持つ

pere-david-s-deer.name: Pere David's Deer
pere-david-s-deer.description: Père David's deer is an extinct-in-the-wild deer once native to China.
pere-david-s-deer.funFact: 野生では絶滅し、飼育のみで生き残る

sika-deer.name: Sika Deer
sika-deer.description: The sika deer is a deer species with distinctive white spots.
sika-deer.funFact: ニホンジカとも呼ばれる

fallow-deer.name: Fallow Deer
fallow-deer.description: The fallow deer is a deer with distinctive palmate antlers.
fallow-deer.funFact: 特徴的な掌状の角を持つ

red-deer.name: Red Deer
red-deer.description: The red deer is one of the largest deer species, found across Europe and Asia.

reindeer.name: Reindeer
reindeer.description: The reindeer or caribou is a deer species adapted to Arctic conditions.
reindeer.funFact: 両性が角を持つ唯一の鹿種

elk.name: Elk
elk.description: The elk is a large deer species found in North America and Asia.
elk.funFact: ワピティとも呼ばれる

sambar-deer.name: Sambar Deer
sambar-deer.description: The sambar is a large deer found in tropical forests of Asia.

rusa-deer.name: Rusa Deer
rusa-deer.description: The rusa deer is a deer species found in the Indonesian archipelago.
rusa-deer.funFact: インドネシアとフィリピンに生息

red-tailed-hawk.name: Red-tailed Hawk
red-tailed-hawk.description: The red-tailed hawk is the most common hawk in North America. It is recognizable by its brick-red tail and broad, rounded wings. It hunts rodents and rabbits from a perch or while soaring.
red-tailed-hawk.funFact: 映画で他の猛禽類に代わりダブリングされることが多い

northern-saw-whet-owl.name: Northern Saw-whet Owl
northern-saw-whet-owl.description: The northern saw-whet owl is a tiny, nocturnal owl named for its sawing call. Despite its small size, it is a fierce predator of mice and small birds.
northern-saw-whet-owl.funFact: 北米最小のフクロウの1つで、ソーダ缶より軽い

barred-owl.name: Barred Owl
barred-owl.description: The barred owl is a large, stocky owl native to eastern North America. It has dark eyes unlike most other owls and a distinctive hooting call.
barred-owl.funFact: 「誰が料理するの」という独特の鳴き声で知られる

long-eared-owl.name: Long-eared Owl
long-eared-owl.description: The long-eared owl is a medium-sized nocturnal owl with striking orange eyes and very long ear tufts. It is a secretive bird that roosts in dense vegetation.
long-eared-owl.funFact: 非対称的な耳の穴を持ち、完全な暗闇で獲物を特定できる

great-gray-owl.name: Great Gray Owl
great-gray-owl.description: The great gray owl is the tallest owl species in North America with a massive facial disc. Despite its imposing size, it is relatively light and feeds primarily on small rodents.
great-gray-owl.funFact: 北米最高身長のフクロウだが、大部分は羽毛によるもの

burrowing-owl.name: Burrowing Owl
burrowing-owl.description: The burrowing owl is a small, long-legged owl that nests in underground burrows. Unlike most owls, it is active during the day and perches on fence posts to watch for prey.
burrowing-owl.funFact: プレーリードッグやジリスが掘った穴の中で巣を作る

elf-owl.name: Elf Owl
elf-owl.description: The elf owl is the worlds smallest owl, found in the desert Southwest. It nests in holes in saguaro cacti and feeds on insects and small invertebrates.
elf-owl.funFact: 世界最小のフクロウ種で、ピンポン球より軽い

wood-duck.name: Wood Duck
wood-duck.description: The wood duck is one of the most colorful waterfowl in North America. Males display elaborate patterns of green, purple, and white. Unlike most ducks, it nests in tree cavities.
wood-duck.funFact: 子鴨は50フィート以上の高さの木の巣から落ちても無傷

northern-pintail.name: Northern Pintail
northern-pintail.description: The northern pintail is a graceful duck recognized by the males long, pointed tail feathers. It has a chocolate-brown head and white breast stripe.
northern-pintail.funFact: 長い尾を持つ最もエレガントな鴨の1種

green-winged-teal.name: Green-winged Teal
green-winged-teal.description: The green-winged teal is a small, agile duck with a distinctive chestnut head and green eye patch. It feeds by dabbling at the water surface.
green-winged-teal.funFact: 北米最小の浮き食い鴨

canvasback.name: Canvasback
canvasback.description: The canvasback is a large diving duck with a distinctive sloping profile. Males have a white body and reddish-brown head.
canvasback.funFact: 北米最大かつ最速の潜水鴨

snow-goose.name: Snow Goose
snow-goose.description: The snow goose is a medium-sized goose with white plumage and black wingtips. It breeds in the Arctic and winters in southern marshes.
snow-goose.funFact: 渡りの際、群れは数十万に達することがある

greylag-goose.name: Greylag Goose
greylag-goose.description: The greylag goose is a large waterfowl with grey-brown plumage and an orange bill. It is the ancestor of most domestic geese.
greylag-goose.funFact: ヨーロッパのほとんどの家禽種の祖先

trumpeter-swan.name: Trumpeter Swan
trumpeter-swan.description: The trumpeter swan is the largest waterfowl in North America with a wingspan up to 8 feet. Named for its resonant, trumpet-like call, it has recovered from near extinction.
trumpeter-swan.funFact: 北米固有の最も重い鳥

tundra-swan.name: Tundra Swan
tundra-swan.description: The tundra swan is a large, white swan that breeds in the Arctic tundra. It has a distinctive yellow spot near the eye and forms large flocks during migration.
tundra-swan.funFact: 北極の繁殖地と越冬地の間を片道最大4000マイル渡りする

american-robin.name: American Robin
american-robin.description: The American robin is one of the most familiar songbirds in North America. Recognized by its rusty-red breast and melodic song, it is often seen hopping across lawns.
american-robin.funFact: 1日に最大14フィートのミミズを食べることができる

northern-cardinal.name: Northern Cardinal
northern-cardinal.description: The northern cardinal is a vivid red songbird with a distinctive crest and black face. Males are brilliant red while females are warm brown with red accents.
northern-cardinal.funFact: メスも歌うのは北米のスズメ科では珍しい

blue-jay.name: Blue Jay
blue-jay.description: The blue jay is a striking songbird with blue, white, and black plumage and a prominent crest. It is intelligent and vocal, known for its loud calls and bold behavior.
blue-jay.funFact: 赤肩トビの鳴き声を真似て他の鳥を騙すことができる

american-crow.name: American Crow
american-crow.description: The American crow is a large, all-black bird known for its intelligence and adaptability. It uses tools, solves complex problems, and lives in large family groups.
american-crow.funFact: 個々の人間の顔を認識し、恨みを持つことができる

common-raven.name: Common Raven
common-raven.description: The common raven is the largest songbird in North America. Extremely intelligent, it has been observed using tools, solving multi-step puzzles, and manipulating other animals.
common-raven.funFact: 雪の屋根を滑って遊んだり、空中曲技を行ったりする

house-sparrow.name: House Sparrow
house-sparrow.description: The house sparrow is one of the most widespread and familiar birds in the world. Originally from Eurasia, it thrives in close association with human habitation.
house-sparrow.funFact: 1851年に北米に導入され、大陸全体に広がった

european-robin.name: European Robin
european-robin.description: The European robin is a small insectivorous bird with a distinctive orange-red breast. Familiar in gardens across Europe, it is known for its territorial behavior.
european-robin.funFact: イギリスではクリスマスの象徴で、多くのホリデーカードに描かれる

eastern-bluebird.name: Eastern Bluebird
eastern-bluebird.description: The eastern bluebird is a small thrush with brilliant blue plumage on the back and a rusty-red throat and breast. A symbol of happiness, it was saved from decline by nest box programs.
eastern-bluebird.funFact: 紫外線を見ることができ、熟したベリーを見つけるのに役立つ

western-bluebird.name: Western Bluebird
western-bluebird.description: The western bluebird is a small thrush with deep blue plumage and a rusty breast. It nests in cavities and feeds primarily on insects caught on the ground.
western-bluebird.funFact: 古いキツツキの穴で巣を作る数少ないスズメ目の1種

baltimore-oriole.name: Baltimore Oriole
baltimore-oriole.description: The Baltimore oriole is a striking songbird with vivid orange and black plumage. They weave elaborate pendulous nests from plant fibers.
baltimore-oriole.funFact: 巣の作成に最大2週間かかる精巧な吊り巣を織る

scarlet-tanager.name: Scarlet Tanager
scarlet-tanager.description: The scarlet tanager is a medium-sized songbird with brilliant red plumage and black wings during breeding season. It is a shy forest bird.
scarlet-tanager.funFact: メスは冬になるとオリーブ緑に変わり、全く違う鳥に見える

yellow-warbler.name: Yellow Warbler
yellow-warbler.description: The yellow warbler is a small, bright yellow songbird widespread across North America. Its cheerful song is one of the most recognizable spring sounds.
yellow-warbler.funFact: 春に繁殖地に最初に到着するスズメ目の1種

white-throated-sparrow.name: White-throated Sparrow
white-throated-sparrow.description: The white-throated sparrow is a common songbird with a distinctive white throat patch and yellow lores. It has two color morphs that differ in behavior.
white-throated-sparrow.funFact: 2つの色のモルフがほぼ排他的にペアを形成する

dark-eyed-junco.name: Dark-eyed Junco
dark-eyed-junco.description: The dark-eyed junco is a small, slate-colored sparrow common across North America. It is one of the most abundant and widespread forest birds.
dark-eyed-junco.funFact: 冬に南部に現れるためスノーバードと呼ばれる

ruby-throated-hummingbird.name: Ruby-throated Hummingbird
ruby-throated-hummingbird.description: The ruby-throated hummingbird is the only breeding hummingbird in eastern North America. Males have an iridescent ruby-red throat.
ruby-throated-hummingbird.funFact: 1秒間に53回羽を動かし、後方飛行ができる

annas-hummingbird.name: Annas Hummingbird
annas-hummingbird.description: Annas hummingbird is a small, green hummingbird native to western North America. Males have a brilliant rose-pink throat and crown.
annas-hummingbird.funFact: メスは劇的な急降下ディスプレイを行い、音を立てる

black-chinned-hummingbird.name: Black-chinned Hummingbird
black-chinned-hummingbird.description: The black-chinned hummingbird is a small, common hummingbird of the western United States with a velvet-black chin that shows iridescent purple.
black-chinned-hummingbird.funFact: 光の角度が合うと鮮やかな紫色に輝く

belted-kingfisher.name: Belted Kingfisher
belted-kingfisher.description: The belted kingfisher is a stocky, blue-gray bird with a shaggy crest and large dagger-like bill. Females have an additional rusty band across the belly.
belted-kingfisher.funFact: メスの方がメスよりも鮮やかな色合いを持つ数少ない鳥種

great-blue-heron.name: Great Blue Heron
great-blue-heron.description: The great blue heron is the largest heron in North America, with a wingspan up to 6.5 feet. It wades in shallow water to hunt fish.
great-blue-heron.funFact: 獲物を捕らえる完璧な瞬間まで何時間も無動に立つことができる

great-egret.name: Great Egret
great-egret.description: The great egret is a large, all-white heron with a yellow bill and black legs. Its near-extinction for the millinery trade helped spark the conservation movement.
great-egret.funFact: 19世紀に女性の帽子用として乱獲され、絶滅の危機に瀕した

snowy-egret.name: Snowy Egret
snowy-egret.description: The snowy egret is a small, elegant white heron with black legs and vivid yellow feet. During breeding season, it develops long, flowing plumes.
snowy-egret.funFact: 鮮やかな黄色い足を使って泥底から獲物をかき出す

green-heron.name: Green Heron
green-heron.description: The green heron is a small, stocky heron with dark greenish-gray plumage. It is a clever hunter that sometimes uses bait to lure fish.
green-heron.funFact: 餌を水に落として魚を誘う道具を使う数少ない鳥種

american-flamingo.name: American Flamingo
american-flamingo.description: The American flamingo is a large, bright pink wading bird found in the Caribbean and Galapagos with the brightest plumage of all flamingos.
american-flamingo.funFact: 全てのフラミンゴ種の中で最も鮮やかな色彩

sandhill-crane.name: Sandhill Crane
sandhill-crane.description: The sandhill crane is a tall, gray bird with a red crown and long legs. Known for its trumpeting call and spectacular mating dances.
sandhill-crane.funFact: 跳ね、頭を下げ、枝を投げる精巧なダンスを行う

whooping-crane.name: Whooping Crane
whooping-crane.description: The whooping crane is the tallest bird in North America. Named for its loud whooping call, it was saved from extinction through intensive conservation.
whooping-crane.funFact: かつて野生で15羽まで減少し、北米で最も希少な鳥

purple-gallinule.name: Purple Gallinule
purple-gallinule.description: The purple gallinule is a brightly colored marsh bird with purple-blue plumage and a red and yellow bill. It walks gracefully on floating vegetation.
purple-gallinule.funFact: 極端に長いつま先のおかげで睡蓮の葉の上を歩ける

american-coot.name: American Coot
american-coot.description: The American coot is a dark, chicken-like waterbird with a white bill and frontal shield. Despite looking duck-like, it is related to rails.
american-coot.funFact: ゆっくりと水に沈み、首まで潜って隠れることができる

wild-turkey.name: Wild Turkey
wild-turkey.description: The wild turkey is a large, iridescent bird native to North America. Males display elaborate courtship rituals. It is the ancestor of the domesticated turkey.
wild-turkey.funFact: 時速55マイルで飛行し、25マイルで走ることができる

ring-necked-pheasant.name: Ring-necked Pheasant
ring-necked-pheasant.description: The ring-necked pheasant is a colorful game bird originally from Asia, now established across North America and Europe. Males have brilliant copper and green plumage.
ring-necked-pheasant.funFact: メスの鮮やかな羽根は竜のイラストのモデルに使われた

bobwhite-quail.name: Northern Bobwhite
bobwhite-quail.description: The northern bobwhite is a small, compact quail with a distinctive white throat and eyebrow stripe in males. Named for its clear bob-white call.
bobwhite-quail.funFact: 特徴的な2音節の鳴き声にちまって命名された

california-quail.name: California Quail
california-quail.description: The California quail is a small, plump ground bird with a distinctive forward-curving black head plume. It is the state bird of California.
california-quail.funFact: 特徴的な頭の羽根は疑問符のように前方に曲がる

little-blue-penguin.name: Little Blue Penguin
little-blue-penguin.description: The little blue penguin, also known as the fairy penguin, is the smallest species of penguin. Found in New Zealand and southern Australia.
little-blue-penguin.funFact: 世界最小のペンギン種で、高さ約13インチ

brown-kiwi.name: Brown Kiwi
brown-kiwi.description: The brown kiwi is a flightless bird native to New Zealand. It has hair-like feathers, no tail, and a long probing bill with nostrils at the tip.
brown-kiwi.funFact: 卵は体サイズに対して大きく、メスの体重の20%

lyrebird.name: Superb Lyrebird
lyrebird.description: The superb lyrebird is famous for its extraordinary ability to mimic sounds. Males have an elaborate tail that forms a lyre shape during courtship.
lyrebird.funFact: チェーンソー、カメラのシャッター、カーアラームまでほぼ全ての音を模倣できる

cassowary.name: Southern Cassowary
cassowary.description: The southern cassowary is a large, flightless bird with a distinctive blue neck, red wattles, and a bony casque on its head.
cassowary.funFact: 強力な蹴りにより世界で最も危険な鳥とされる

blue-and-yellow-macaw.name: Blue-and-yellow Macaw
blue-and-yellow-macaw.description: The blue-and-yellow macaw is a large parrot with vivid blue upperparts and golden-yellow underparts. It is highly social and can mimic human speech.
blue-and-yellow-macaw.funFact: 時速35マイルで飛行し、強力な嘴で硬い木の実を割る

hyacinth-macaw.name: Hyacinth Macaw
hyacinth-macaw.description: The hyacinth macaw is the largest of all flying parrot species, with stunning cobalt-blue plumage and bright yellow eye rings.
hyacinth-macaw.funFact: 翼開長が4フィートを超える世界最大の飛行オウム

african-grey-parrot.name: African Grey Parrot
african-grey-parrot.description: The African grey parrot is renowned for its exceptional intelligence and ability to mimic human speech. It has grey plumage with a striking red tail.
african-grey-parrot.funFact: 幼児と匹敵する知能を持つ最も知的な鳥種とされる

budgerigar.name: Budgerigar
budgerigar.description: The budgerigar is a small, long-tailed parakeet native to Australia. In the wild, it is green and yellow with black markings.
budgerigar.funFact: 犬と猫に次いで世界で3番目に人気のあるペット

cockatiel.name: Cockatiel
cockatiel.description: The cockatiel is a small parrot native to Australia, recognizable by its prominent crest and orange cheek patches.
cockatiel.funFact: 正確に口笛を吹ける数少ないオウム種

keel-billed-toucan.name: Keel-billed Toucan
keel-billed-toucan.description: The keel-billed toucan is a colorful bird with a massive, rainbow-colored bill. Found in Central and South American rainforests.
keel-billed-toucan.funFact: カラフルな嘴は驚くほど軽く、主にケラチンで蜂の巣構造

toco-toucan.name: Toco Toucan
toco-toucan.description: The toco toucan is the largest toucan species, with a massive orange-yellow bill tipped in black. Found in South American forests.
toco-toucan.funFact: 嘴に体温調節を助ける血管のネットワークがある

great-hornbill.name: Great Hornbill
great-hornbill.description: The great hornbill is one of the largest hornbill species, distinguished by its massive yellow and black casque atop its bill.
great-hornbill.funFact: ペアは抱卵中にメスを樹洞に閉じ込め、 feeding用の小さな裂け目だけ残す

rhinoceros-hornbill.name: Rhinoceros Hornbill
rhinoceros-hornbill.description: The rhinoceros hornbill is a large hornbill with a dramatic upward-curving casque on its bill. Found in Southeast Asian rainforests.
rhinoceros-hornbill.funFact: 上方に弯曲したクブは最大7インチまで成長する

laughing-kookaburra.name: Laughing Kookaburra
laughing-kookaburra.description: The laughing kookaburra is a large kingfisher native to Australia, famous for its distinctive call that sounds like loud, echoing human laughter.
laughing-kookaburra.funFact: 鳴き声は人間の笑い声と全く同じ

pied-kingfisher.name: Pied Kingfisher
pied-kingfisher.description: The pied kingfisher is a black and white kingfisher found across Africa and Asia. It hovers over water before diving to catch fish.
pied-kingfisher.funFact: 潜水前に水上でホバリングできる唯一のカワセミ種

atlantic-puffin.name: Atlantic Puffin
atlantic-puffin.description: The Atlantic puffin is a small seabird with a colorful triangular bill and distinctive black and white plumage. Known as the clown of the sea.
atlantic-puffin.funFact: 特殊な舌と嘴の構造により、一度に10匹以上の魚を運べる

tufted-puffin.name: Tufted Puffin
tufted-puffin.description: The tufted puffin is a small seabird with black plumage, white face patches, and distinctive golden head tufts during breeding season.
tufted-puffin.funFact: 200フィート以上の深さまで潜水して魚を捕まえる

wandering-albatross.name: Wandering Albatross
wandering-albatross.description: The wandering albatross has the largest wingspan of any bird, up to 11.5 feet. It spends most of its life soaring over the Southern Ocean.
wandering-albatross.funFact: 現存する鳥で最大の翼開長、11フィート以上

black-browed-albatross.name: Black-browed Albatross
black-browed-albatross.description: The black-browed albatross is a large seabird with dark upper wings and a white body. Named for the dark stripe through its eye.
black-browed-albatross.funFact: 海上で飛行中に眠ることができる

laysan-albatross.name: Laysan Albatross
laysan-albatross.description: The Laysan albatross is a large seabird of the North Pacific. It breeds primarily on remote Pacific islands.
laysan-albatross.funFact: 世界で最も古い野生鳥は70歳以上のウィズダムという名の鸟

brown-pelican.name: Brown Pelican
brown-pelican.description: The brown pelican is a large waterbird with a massive bill and throat pouch. It is unique among pelicans for plunge-diving from the air.
brown-pelican.funFact: 60フィート以上の高さから潜水し、エアバッグで衝撃を和らげる

american-white-pelican.name: American White Pelican
american-white-pelican.description: The American white pelican is one of the largest North American birds, with a wingspan up to 9 feet. It scoops fish while swimming.
american-white-pelican.funFact: 魚を浅瀬に追い込む協力的な捕鱼を行う

frigatebird.name: Magnificent Frigatebird
frigatebird.description: The magnificent frigatebird is a large seabird with long, angular wings and a deeply forked tail. Males inflate a bright red throat pouch.
frigatebird.funFact: 数週間空中にとどまり、海上で睡眠をとる

northern-gannet.name: Northern Gannet
northern-gannet.description: The northern gannet is the largest seabird in the North Atlantic. It nests in massive colonies on sea cliffs.
northern-gannet.funFact: 130フィートの高さから時速60マイルで水中に突入する

blue-footed-booby.name: Blue-footed Booby
blue-footed-booby.description: The blue-footed booby is a marine bird famous for its vivid blue feet. Found along the Pacific coast of the Americas.
blue-footed-booby.funFact: メスは鮮やかな青い足を交互に上げる精巧なダンスでメスを誘う

red-footed-booby.name: Red-footed Booby
red-footed-booby.description: The red-footed booby is the smallest booby species, with distinctive red feet. It comes in several color morphs.
red-footed-booby.funFact: 最も豊富なブービー種で、樹木で巣を作る唯一の種

great-cormorant.name: Great Cormorant
great-cormorant.description: The great cormorant is a large, dark waterbird found across much of the world. It spreads its wings to dry after fishing.
great-cormorant.funFact: 他の水鳥より背上油が少なく、潜水に適しているが羽の乾燥が必要

common-loon.name: Common Loon
common-loon.description: The common loon is a large waterbird known for its haunting wail across northern lakes. Its solid bones help it dive deep.
common-loon.funFact: 骨が実質的に水中で浮力が少なく、ほとんどの鳥より潜水に適している

arctic-tern.name: Arctic Tern
arctic-tern.description: The Arctic tern migrates farther than any other animal. It experiences more daylight than any other creature.
arctic-tern.funFact: 北極から南極まで年1回渡りし、最大44000マイル

caspian-tern.name: Caspian Tern
caspian-tern.description: The Caspian tern is the worlds largest tern, with a massive red bill and black cap. Found on every continent except Antarctica.

black-skimmer.name: Black Skimmer
black-skimmer.description: The black skimmer is a unique seabird with a distinctive uneven bill. It flies low over water, dragging its bill to catch fish.
black-skimmer.funFact: 下嘴が上嘴より長く、水面をすくって魚を捕まえる

herring-gull.name: Herring Gull
herring-gull.description: The herring gull is one of the most common gulls in the Northern Hemisphere, thriving in coastal and urban environments.
herring-gull.funFact: 目の上の特殊な腺で塩分をろ過し、海水を飲むことができる

laughing-gull.name: Laughing Gull
laughing-gull.description: The laughing gull is a medium-sized gull with a distinctive black head in breeding season and a laughing call.
laughing-gull.funFact: 甲高い人間の笑い声に似た鳴き声にちまって命名

killdeer.name: Killdeer
killdeer.description: The killdeer is a large plover with distinctive black breast bands. It is famous for its broken-wing display.
killdeer.funFact: 偽傷作戦で捕食者を巣から遠ざける

american-woodcock.name: American Woodcock
american-woodcock.description: The American woodcock is a plump shorebird with a long bill. It feeds on earthworms and performs an aerial sky-dance at dusk.
american-woodcock.funFact: 頭の側面に目があり、360度見渡すことができる

red-knot.name: Red Knot
red-knot.description: The red knot is famous for one of the longest migrations in the animal kingdom. It turns rusty-red during breeding season.
red-knot.funFact: 北極から南米の先端まで最大9000マイルnonstopで渡りする

american-avocet.name: American Avocet
american-avocet.description: The American avocet is an elegant wader with a thin, upturned bill and long legs. During breeding season, its head and neck turn rusty-orange.
american-avocet.funFact: 上向きの嘴を左右に振って水中の小さな無脊椎動物を捕まえる

black-necked-stilt.name: Black-necked Stilt
black-necked-stilt.description: The black-necked stilt is a striking wader with black upperparts, white underparts, and extraordinarily long pink legs.
black-necked-stilt.funFact: フラミンゴに次いで2番目に脚の比率が長い鳥

willow-ptarmigan.name: Willow Ptarmigan
willow-ptarmigan.description: The willow ptarmigan is a game bird of the Arctic tundra that changes plumage with the seasons.
willow-ptarmigan.funFact: 季節に合わせて色が変わり、夏は茶色、冬は真っ白

spruce-grouse.name: Spruce Grouse
spruce-grouse.description: The spruce grouse is a forest-dwelling game bird of the boreal region, known for its tameness.
spruce-grouse.funFact: 危険から很少飛ぶため、フォールヘンと呼ばれるほど人懐っこい

ruffed-grouse.name: Ruffed Grouse
ruffed-grouse.description: The ruffed grouse is a popular game bird of eastern North American forests with a distinctive drumming display.
ruffed-grouse.funFact: メスを誘うために羽を素早く叩いてドラミング音を出す

chukar.name: Chukar
chukar.description: The chukar is a rotund game bird native to Eurasia and introduced to North America with distinctive black and white barring.
chukar.funFact: 危険から逃げるとき、飛ぶよりも上り坂を走るのを好む

common-crane.name: Common Crane
common-crane.description: The common crane is a large, elegant wading bird with gray plumage and a red crown patch. Famous for its courtship dances.
common-crane.funFact: 求愛時に跳ね、頭を下げ、羽をひらめさせる精巧なダンスを行う

demoiselle-crane.name: Demoiselle Crane
demoiselle-crane.description: The demoiselle crane is the smallest crane species, elegant and graceful with a black neck and white ear tufts.
demoiselle-crane.funFact: ヒマラヤの渡りで26000フィート以上の高度を飛行する

bearded-vulture.name: Bearded Vulture
bearded-vulture.description: The bearded vulture is the only bird species that feeds almost exclusively on bones.
bearded-vulture.funFact: 骨を食べ、高いところから落として飲み込める大きさに割る

andean-condor.name: Andean Condor
andean-condor.description: The Andean condor is one of the worlds largest flying birds. It soars on thermal currents over the Andes mountains.
andean-condor.funFact: 全ての猛禽類で最大の翼開長、10フィート以上

king-vulture.name: King Vulture
king-vulture.description: The king vulture is a large, colorful vulture with a vividly colored head and a white body.
king-vulture.funFact: マヤ人は人間と神の間のメッセージを運ぶと考えていた

turkey-vulture.name: Turkey Vulture
turkey-vulture.description: The turkey vulture is a large soaring bird with a red, featherless head resembling a wild turkey.
turkey-vulture.funFact: 全ての鳥で最も優れた嗅覚を持ち、数マイル先の死肉を感知できる

american-kestrel.name: American Kestrel
american-kestrel.description: The American kestrel is the smallest and most common falcon in North America. Males have slate-blue wings.
american-kestrel.funFact: 紫外線を見ることができ、げっ歯類の尿の跡を追跡するのに役立つ

merlin.name: Merlin
merlin.description: The merlin is a small, powerful falcon found across the Northern Hemisphere. It pursues small birds in direct flight.
merlin.funFact: ハトを狩る習性からパイジョンホークと呼ばれた

prairie-falcon.name: Prairie Falcon
prairie-falcon.description: The prairie falcon is a large, sandy-brown falcon of the western North American open country.
prairie-falcon.funFact: 水平飛行で時速45マイル以上、急降下ではさらに速い

gyrfalcon.name: Gyrfalcon
gyrfalcon.description: The gyrfalcon is the largest of all falcon species, found in Arctic regions. It was historically prized in falconry for royalty.
gyrfalcon.funFact: 世界最大のハヤブサで、かつて王の鳥とされた

osprey.name: Osprey
osprey.description: The osprey is a large raptor found on every continent except Antarctica. It feeds almost exclusively on fish.
osprey.funFact: 外側のつま先を回転させ、前2本後2本で魚を掴む

northern-harrier.name: Northern Harrier
northern-harrier.description: The northern harrier is a slim raptor that hunts by flying low over open ground, using both sight and sound.
northern-harrier.funFact: フクロウに似た顔のディスクで音から獲物を見つける

coopers-hawk.name: Coopers Hawk
coopers-hawk.description: The Coopers hawk is a medium-sized accipiter that specializes in capturing doves and songbirds in flight.
coopers-hawk.funFact: 密な森林でも高速で獲物を追跡できる俊敏性

sharp-shinned-hawk.name: Sharp-shinned Hawk
sharp-shinned-hawk.description: The sharp-shinned hawk is the smallest accipiter in North America. A rapid, agile flier that hunts small songbirds.
sharp-shinned-hawk.funFact: 北米最小のハイタカで、ジャヤより少し大きい程度

swainsons-hawk.name: Swainsons Hawk
swainsons-hawk.description: The Swainsons hawk is a medium-sized raptor that migrates in enormous flocks to the pampas of Argentina for the winter.
swainsons-hawk.funFact: 数十万の群れで北米から南米へ渡りする

rough-legged-hawk.name: Rough-legged Hawk
rough-legged-hawk.description: The rough-legged hawk breeds in the Arctic tundra and winters in open prairies of North America.
rough-legged-hawk.funFact: つま先まで羽毛で覆われた脚を持ち、北極の寒さに適応

ferruginous-hawk.name: Ferruginous Hawk
ferruginous-hawk.description: The ferruginous hawk is the largest buteo hawk in North America with rust-colored upperparts.
ferruginous-hawk.funFact: 北米最大のハイタカで、翼開長5フィート以上

white-tailed-kite.name: White-tailed Kite
white-tailed-kite.description: The white-tailed kite is a graceful raptor with white plumage, black shoulders, and a forked tail.
white-tailed-kite.funFact: 長時間ホバリングして地面の獲物を探す

mississippi-kite.name: Mississippi Kite
mississippi-kite.description: The Mississippi kite is a small, elegant raptor with pearl-gray plumage that feeds primarily on insects caught in flight.
mississippi-kite.funFact: 大量のゼミや空中の昆虫を食べる

red-winged-blackbird.name: Red-winged Blackbird
red-winged-blackbird.description: The red-winged blackbird is one of the most abundant and widespread birds in North America with bright red and yellow shoulder patches.
red-winged-blackbird.funFact: 北米で最も豊富な鳥の1つで、2億羽以上

brown-headed-cowbird.name: Brown-headed Cowbird
brown-headed-cowbird.description: The brown-headed cowbird is a brood parasite that lays its eggs in the nests of other bird species.
brown-headed-cowbird.funFact: 他の鳥の巣に卵を産む托卵鳥

common-grackle.name: Common Grackle
common-grackle.description: The common grackle is a large, lanky blackbird with iridescent plumage and bright yellow eyes.
common-grackle.funFact: 日光で紫、緑、青銅色に輝く虹色の羽毛を持つ

great-tailed-grackle.name: Great-tailed Grackle
great-tailed-grackle.description: The great-tailed grackle is a large, noisy blackbird with a very long, keel-shaped tail.
great-tailed-grackle.funFact: 翼開長が約18インチで、長い尾が全長の半分を占める

yellow-headed-blackbird.name: Yellow-headed Blackbird
yellow-headed-blackbird.description: The yellow-headed blackbird is a striking songbird with a brilliant yellow-orange head contrasting with a black body.
yellow-headed-blackbird.funFact: メスは沼地の小さな繁殖縄張りを守る

eastern-meadowlark.name: Eastern Meadowlark
eastern-meadowlark.description: The eastern meadowlark is a bright yellow songbird with a distinctive V-shaped black breast band.
eastern-meadowlark.funFact: 西方MEAOWLARKと全く違う歌を持つが外見はほぼ同じ

western-meadowlark.name: Western Meadowlark
western-meadowlark.description: The western meadowlark is a bright yellow songbird with a black V-shaped breast band, the state bird of six states.
western-meadowlark.funFact: 6つの米国州の州鳥で、他の鳥より多い

orchard-oriole.name: Orchard Oriole
orchard-oriole.description: The orchard oriole is a small, chestnut and black songbird. Males have a chestnut body with a black head.
orchard-oriole.funFact: 北米最小のイカリア科で、イエスズメより小さい

bullocks-oriole.name: Bullocks Oriole
bullocks-oriole.description: The Bullocks oriole is a bright orange and black songbird of western North America that weaves hanging basket nests.
bullocks-oriole.funFact: 木の枝からぶら下がる精巧な吊り巣を織る

barn-swallow.name: Barn Swallow
barn-swallow.description: The barn swallow is the most widespread swallow species in the world with a distinctive deeply forked tail.
barn-swallow.funFact: 繁殖地と越冬地の間を最大6000マイル渡りする

tree-swallow.name: Tree Swallow
tree-swallow.description: The tree swallow is a small, iridescent blue-green swallow with white underparts.
tree-swallow.funFact: ベリーを消化できる数少ない北米スズメ目の1種

cliff-swallow.name: Cliff Swallow
cliff-swallow.description: The cliff swallow is a small swallow with a pale rump and squared-off tail that builds enclosed mud nests in colonies.
cliff-swallow.funFact: 数十個体の群体で葫芦形の泥巣を作る

purple-martin.name: Purple Martin
purple-martin.description: The purple martin is the largest North American swallow with iridescent purple-blue plumage in males.
purple-martin.funFact: 北東部では人間が提供する巣箱にほぼ完全に依存

bank-swallow.name: Bank Swallow
bank-swallow.description: The bank swallow is the smallest swallow in North America, nesting in burrows excavated in sandy banks near water.
bank-swallow.funFact: 北米最小のツバメ種で、砂浜に穴を掘って巣を作る

violet-green-swallow.name: Violet-green Swallow
violet-green-swallow.description: The violet-green swallow is a small, colorful swallow with iridescent green and violet upperparts.
violet-green-swallow.funFact: 顔の白い斑点が後頭部まで回り込む

chimney-swift.name: Chimney Swift
chimney-swift.description: The chimney swift is a cigar-shaped, dark gray bird that spends most of its life on the wing.
chimney-swift.funFact: Chimney swifts can spend almost their entire lives in the air, even sleeping while flying.

common-nighthawk.name: Common Nighthawk
common-nighthawk.description: The common nighthawk is a nocturnal bird that feeds on flying insects caught during acrobatic aerial displays.
common-nighthawk.funFact: 口の周りに昆虫を捉える広い漏斗状の小さな羽毛を持つ

eastern-whip-poor-will.name: Eastern Whip-poor-will
eastern-whip-poor-will.description: The eastern whip-poor-will is a nocturnal bird named for its distinctive three-part call.
eastern-whip-poor-will.funFact: 1時間に最大400回鳴き、名前のような鳴き声を繰り返す

greater-roadrunner.name: Greater Roadrunner
greater-roadrunner.description: The greater roadrunner is a large, ground-dwelling cuckoo of the American deserts known for its X-shaped tail.
greater-roadrunner.funFact: 時速20マイルで走り、水なしで生活できる

yellow-billed-cuckoo.name: Yellow-billed Cuckoo
yellow-billed-cuckoo.description: The yellow-billed cuckoo is a slim, long-tailed bird with a curved yellow bill that feeds on caterpillars.
yellow-billed-cuckoo.funFact: 嵐の前に頻繁に鳴くため、レインクロウと呼ばれることがある

hoopoe.name: Eurasian Hoopoe
hoopoe.description: The Eurasian hoopoe is a distinctive bird with cinnamon plumage, black and white wing bars, and a spectacular erectile crest.
hoopoe.funFact: 興奮や警戒時に広げる扇形の冠を持つ

tawny-frogmouth.name: Tawny Frogmouth
tawny-frogmouth.description: The tawny frogmouth is a nocturnal bird of Australia with cryptic plumage that perfectly camouflages it against tree bark.
tawny-frogmouth.funFact: フクロウと間違われることが多いが、実際はヨタカに近い

common-potoo.name: Common Potoo
common-potoo.description: The common potoo is a nocturnal bird of Central and South American forests with an enormous mouth and cryptic plumage.
common-potoo.funFact: 昼間は枝の上に真っ直ぐとまり、切った木の切り株にそっくり

american-goldfinch.name: American Goldfinch
american-goldfinch.description: The American goldfinch is a small, bright yellow songbird with black wings and cap, one of the latest-nesting birds in North America.
american-goldfinch.funFact: 最も遅く巣を作る鳥の1つで、遅くまで繁殖しないことがある

pine-grosbeak.name: Pine Grosbeak
pine-grosbeak.description: The pine grosbeak is a large, plump finch with rosy-pink plumage in males. Found in boreal forests across North America.
pine-grosbeak.funFact: 最も人懐っこい北方林鳥の1つで、近づくことを許容する

evening-grosbeak.name: Evening Grosbeak
evening-grosbeak.description: The evening grosbeak is a large, stocky finch with a massive conical bill and bright yellow body in males.
evening-grosbeak.funFact: 突発的な渡り鳥で、通常の範囲から南方に大量に現れることがある

cassins-finch.name: Cassins Finch
cassins-finch.description: The Cassins finch is a medium-sized finch with rosy-red crown and pinkish wash on the breast, found in mountain forests.
cassins-finch.funFact: 最も最近記述された北米の鳥種で、1861年まで認識されなかった

red-crossbill.name: Red Crossbill
red-crossbill.description: The red crossbill is a finch with a uniquely crossed bill adapted for extracting seeds from conifer cones.
red-crossbill.funFact: 針葉樹の球果から種を取るのに特化した交差した嘴を持つ

pine-siskin.name: Pine Siskin
pine-siskin.description: The pine siskin is a small, streaky brown finch with yellow edging on its wings and tail, an irruptive species.
pine-siskin.funFact: 病気にならずサルモネラ菌を運び、飼育鳥に伝染させることがある

common-redpoll.name: Common Redpoll
common-redpoll.description: The common redpoll is a tiny, streaky finch with a distinctive red cap and pink breast, breeding in Arctic tundra.
common-redpoll.funFact: 種を食べて羽毛を膨らませ、-60華氏度の気温を生き延びられる

hoary-redpoll.name: Hoary Redpoll
hoary-redpoll.description: The hoary redpoll is a tiny Arctic finch, paler and frostier-looking than the common redpoll.
hoary-redpoll.funFact: ほとんどのスズメ目より北方に住む最も丈夫なスズメ目の1種

house-finch.name: House Finch
house-finch.description: The house finch is a small songbird common in urban and suburban areas with red or orange plumage in males.
house-finch.funFact: メスの赤い色はベリーや果物の食餌中の色素から来る

purple-finch.name: Purple Finch
purple-finch.description: The purple finch is a medium-sized finch with rosy-red plumage in males and streaked brown in females.
purple-finch.funFact: ロジャートリーペターソンはメスをラズベリージューに浸かれたと表現

eastern-wood-pewee.name: Eastern Wood-Pewee
eastern-wood-pewee.description: The eastern wood-pewee is a small flycatcher with olive-gray plumage and a distinctive, plaintive whistle.
eastern-wood-pewee.funFact: 鳴き声が非常に特徴的で、種名は歌にちまって付けられた

great-crested-flycatcher.name: Great Crested Flycatcher
great-crested-flycatcher.description: The great crested flycatcher is a large, yellow-bellied flycatcher with a distinctive crest. It always includes snakeskin in its nest.
great-crested-flycatcher.funFact: 常にヘビの皮を巣材に取り入れる

eastern-kingbird.name: Eastern Kingbird
eastern-kingbird.description: The eastern kingbird is a bold flycatcher with dark gray upperparts and a distinctive white tip on its tail.
eastern-kingbird.funFact: 自分より大きい鳥にも攻撃する攻撃的な縄張り行動にちまって命名

eastern-phoebe.name: Eastern Phoebe
eastern-phoebe.description: The eastern phoebe is a small, brownish-gray flycatcher that bobs its tail frequently and often nests on human structures.
eastern-phoebe.funFact: 1840年にオーダボンによって北米で最初にバンドされた鳥

willow-flycatcher.name: Willow Flycatcher
willow-flycatcher.description: The willow flycatcher is a small, inconspicuous flycatcher best known for its distinctive fitz-bew song.
willow-flycatcher.funFact: 他のエンピドラクス属とほぼ同一で、特徴的な鳴き声で識別される

scissor-tailed-flycatcher.name: Scissor-tailed Flycatcher
scissor-tailed-flycatcher.description: The scissor-tailed flycatcher is a distinctive flycatcher with extremely long, forked tail feathers. It is the state bird of Oklahoma.
scissor-tailed-flycatcher.funFact: 尾羽は体の2倍の長さになりうる

vermilion-flycatcher.name: Vermilion Flycatcher
vermilion-flycatcher.description: The vermilion flycatcher is a small, vividly colored flycatcher with males displaying brilliant red plumage and a black mask.
vermilion-flycatcher.funFact: 西半球で最も鮮やかな色彩のモズクの1種

common-merganser.name: Common Merganser
common-merganser.description: The common merganser is a large diving duck with a reddish-brown crested head in females and a dark green head in males. It feeds primarily on fish.
common-merganser.funFact: ギザギザの嘴で滑りやすい魚を掴むのを助ける

hooded-merganser.name: Hooded Merganser
hooded-merganser.description: The hooded merganser is a small, striking diving duck. Males have a bold black and white fan-shaped crest with a rusty flank patch.
hooded-merganser.funFact: 任何の鴨で最も大きな冠を持ち、自由に上げ下げできる

bufflehead.name: Bufflehead
bufflehead.description: The bufflehead is a small, compact diving duck. Males have a striking iridescent green and purple head with large white patches.
bufflehead.funFact: 北米最小の潜水鴨で、古いキツツキの巣で巣を作ることがある

common-goldeneye.name: Common Goldeneye
common-goldeneye.description: The common goldeneye is a medium-sized diving duck with a distinctive round head. Males have a dark green-black head with a white circular patch near the bill.
common-goldeneye.funFact: 巣の中でメスは自分の腹部から脱落した絹毛で卵を覆う

ring-necked-duck.name: Ring-necked Duck
ring-necked-duck.description: The ring-necked duck is a medium-sized diving duck with a distinctive peaked head shape. Males have a black back, gray flanks, and a white breast with a subtle neck ring.
ring-necked-duck.funFact: 名前に反し、首の輪は野外でほぼ見えない

gadwall.name: Gadwall
gadwall.description: The gadwall is a dabbling duck with subtle but elegant plumage. Males are mostly gray with black rear ends, while females are mottled brown.
gadwall.funFact: 「プラインダック」と呼ばれるが、繊細な模様を持つ

blue-winged-teal.name: Blue-winged Teal
blue-winged-teal.description: The blue-winged teal is a small dabbling duck. Males have a slate-blue head with a white crescent in front of the eye. It is one of the earliest migrating ducks.
blue-winged-teal.funFact: 北米で最も早い春渡り鳥と遅い秋渡り鳥の1つ

crested-caracara.name: Crested Caracara
crested-caracara.description: The crested caracara is a distinctive raptor with a black cap, white neck, and orange face. Despite being in the falcon family, it scavenges and forages on the ground.
crested-caracara.funFact: ハヤブサ科だが、ハゲタカのように行動する

palm-nut-vulture.name: Palm-nut Vulture
palm-nut-vulture.description: The palm-nut vulture is a unique raptor of West African palm forests that feeds mainly on the fruit of the oil palm.
palm-nut-vulture.funFact: 植物材料、特にヤシの実を主食とする唯一のハゲタカ種

black-vulture.name: Black Vulture
black-vulture.description: The black vulture is a common New World vulture with black plumage and a bare, dark head. It soars in groups looking for carcasses.
black-vulture.funFact: 優れた視力と嗅覚で死肉を見つける

roseate-spoonbill.name: Roseate Spoonbill
roseate-spoonbill.description: The roseate spoonbill is a large, pink wading bird with a distinctive spatulate bill. It feeds by sweeping its bill through shallow water.
roseate-spoonbill.funFact: 浅瀬でヘラ状の嘴を左右に振って魚や甲殻類を捕まえる

wood-stork.name: Wood Stork
wood-stork.description: The wood stork is a large, white wading bird with a dark, featherless head and a long, curved bill. It is the only stork species breeding in the United States.
wood-stork.funFact: 北米で繁殖する唯一のコウノトリ種で、触覚捕鱼を行う

white-ibis.name: White Ibis
white-ibis.description: The white ibis is a medium-sized wading bird with white plumage, black wing tips, and a distinctive long, curved pink bill.
white-ibis.funFact: 長く曲がった嘴で泥を probing し、触覚だけで獲物を検出できる

limpkin.name: Limpkin
limpkin.description: The limpkin is a large, brown wading bird with white spotting. It is specialized in feeding on apple snails and has a distinctive wailing call.
limpkin.funFact: リンゴマイガイを食べる専門家で、貝殻から貝を抽出するのに特化した嘴

rusty-blackbird.name: Rusty Blackbird
rusty-blackbird.description: The rusty blackbird is a medium-sized blackbird that breeds in boreal wetlands and winters in the southeastern United States. Males are glossy black with rust-colored edges on feathers in fall.
rusty-blackbird.funFact: 過去50年で90%以上減少し、北米で最も急速に減少している鳥

blue-tang.name: Blue Tang
blue-tang.description: The blue tang is a striking royal blue fish with a bright yellow tail and black markings. Found throughout the Indo-Pacific, it feeds primarily on algae and plays an important role in keeping coral reefs healthy.
blue-tang.funFact: 夜間に体色を変えてほぼ見えなくなることができる

mandarinfish.name: Mandarinfish
mandarinfish.description: The mandarinfish is a small, incredibly colorful reef fish with vivid blue, orange, and green patterns. It produces a toxic mucus coating that deters predators and gives it a distinctive smell.
mandarinfish.funFact: 青い色素を生産する2つの脊椎動物の1つ

sixbar-wrasse.name: Sixbar Wrasse
sixbar-wrasse.description: The sixbar wrasse is a slender reef fish with distinctive dark vertical bars across its body. Found throughout the Indo-Pacific, it feeds on small crustaceans and fish.
sixbar-wrasse.funFact: 生涯でメスからオスに性転換できる

yellowtail-coris.name: Yellowtail Coris
yellowtail-coris.description: The yellowtail coris is a colorful wrasse found in coral reefs across the Indo-Pacific. Adults have a green body with yellow tail and red spots, while juveniles are orange.
yellowtail-coris.funFact: 幼魚はオレンジと白の斑点があり、成魚と全く違う見た目

bicolor-angelfish.name: Bicolor Angelfish
bicolor-angelfish.description: The bicolor angelfish features a striking split coloration of dark blue-black on the front half and bright yellow on the rear half. Found in Caribbean reefs, it feeds on algae.
bicolor-angelfish.funFact: コミュニケーション用に大きな音を出すことができる

flame-angelfish.name: Flame Angelfish
flame-angelfish.description: The flame angelfish is a brilliant orange-red fish with black vertical bars native to the Pacific. It is one of the most popular marine aquarium fish.
flame-angelfish.funFact: 小さな水槽では攻撃的になることがある

queen-angelfish.name: Queen Angelfish
queen-angelfish.description: The queen angelfish is a large, stunningly colorful reef fish with blue, yellow, and green hues. Found throughout the tropical western Atlantic, it feeds primarily on sponges.
queen-angelfish.funFact: 額の暗い青い輪が王冠に見えるためこの名がついた

french-angelfish.name: French Angelfish
french-angelfish.description: The French angelfish is a striking black fish with bright yellow-edged scales found in Caribbean reefs. Young individuals are bright yellow but darken as adults.
french-angelfish.funFact: 一夫一婦のペアで生涯一緒に移動する

regal-tang.name: Regal Tang
regal-tang.description: The regal tang, also known as the palette surgeonfish, is a bright blue fish with a yellow tail and black markings. Found across the Indo-Pacific.
regal-tang.funFact: 尾の近くに引っ込み可能な棘があり、痛みのある傷を負わせられる

sohal-surgeonfish.name: Sohal Surgeonfish
sohal-surgeonfish.description: The sohal surgeonfish is a large, gray-blue reef fish with horizontal stripes and sharp scalpel-like spines on its tail. Native to the Red Sea and Persian Gulf.
sohal-surgeonfish.funFact: 極めて縄張り意識が強く、侵入するダイバーを攻撃する

moorish-idol.name: Moorish Idol
moorish-idol.description: The Moorish idol is one of the most recognizable reef fish with its dramatic black, white, and yellow coloration and a long flowing dorsal fin filament.
moorish-idol.funFact: 飼育下では生存が難しく、水族館では長く生きられない

royal-gramma.name: Royal Gramma
royal-gramma.description: The royal gramma, or fairy basslet, has a stunning two-tone coloration with bright purple on the front half and yellow on the rear half. Found in Caribbean caves.
royal-gramma.funFact: 岩の棚の下に逆さまにぶら下がることが多い

longnose-butterflyfish.name: Longnose Butterflyfish
longnose-butterflyfish.description: The longnose butterflyfish is a slender reef fish with a distinctive elongated snout and yellow body with a dark eye band.
longnose-butterflyfish.funFact: 長い嘴でサンゴの隙間にある食物を取る

copperband-butterflyfish.name: Copperband Butterflyfish
copperband-butterflyfish.description: The copperband butterflyfish has a striking pattern of vertical orange bands with black edges on a silver-white body.
copperband-butterflyfish.funFact: 尾の近くに偽の目印を持ち、捕食者を惑わす

foureye-butterflyfish.name: Foureye Butterflyfish
foureye-butterflyfish.description: The foureye butterflyfish gets its name from the prominent black eye spot on each side near its tail, confusing predators.
foureye-butterflyfish.funFact: 大きな目印が捕食者に尾が頭だと錯覚させる

bluegill.name: Bluegill
bluegill.description: The bluegill is a freshwater sunfish native to eastern North America. It has an olive-green body with a distinctive dark spot on the ear flap.
bluegill.funFact: メスは浅瀬に円形の巣を作り、卵を激しく守る

largemouth-bass.name: Largemouth Bass
largemouth-bass.description: The largemouth bass is the largest of the black basses and the most popular freshwater game fish in North America.
largemouth-bass.funFact: 体の半分ほどの獲物を飲み込むほど大きく口を開ける

smallmouth-bass.name: Smallmouth Bass
smallmouth-bass.description: The smallmouth bass is a freshwater fish prized by anglers for its aggressive fighting style.
smallmouth-bass.funFact: 戦闘力で知られ、ブラウニーズやブロンズバックと呼ばれる

rainbow-trout.name: Rainbow Trout
rainbow-trout.description: The rainbow trout is a coldwater fish with an olive-green body and a distinctive pinkish-red stripe along its side.
rainbow-trout.funFact: 環境や気分に合わせて体色の濃度を変えることができる

brook-trout.name: Brook Trout
brook-trout.description: The brook trout, also called speckled trout, has a dark green body with light spots and red spots with blue halos.
brook-trout.funFact: 北米東部の多くで固有のサケ

atlantic-salmon.name: Atlantic Salmon
atlantic-salmon.description: The Atlantic salmon is an anadromous fish born in freshwater, migrates to the ocean, and returns to freshwater to spawn.
atlantic-salmon.funFact: 遡上の産卵回游で滝やダムをジャンプできる

chinook-salmon.name: Chinook Salmon
chinook-salmon.description: The Chinook salmon, also called king salmon, is the largest Pacific salmon with a greenish back and dark spots.
chinook-salmon.funFact: 太平洋サケの中で最大種

coho-salmon.name: Coho Salmon
coho-salmon.description: The coho salmon, also known as silver salmon, has a silver body with black spots and is found throughout the North Pacific.
coho-salmon.funFact: 産卵期に鮮やかな赤色になり、釣り針状の顎になる

pacific-bluefin-tuna.name: Pacific Bluefin Tuna
pacific-bluefin-tuna.description: The Pacific bluefin tuna is a large, fast, pelagic fish found throughout the Pacific Ocean, highly prized in sushi markets.
pacific-bluefin-tuna.funFact: 60日以内に太平洋を横断できる

yellowfin-tuna.name: Yellowfin Tuna
yellowfin-tuna.description: The yellowfin tuna is a large, streamlined ocean fish with bright yellow dorsal and anal fins found in tropical oceans worldwide.
yellowfin-tuna.funFact: 短い爆発で時速40マイルまで泳ぐことができる

atlantic-cod.name: Atlantic Cod
atlantic-cod.description: The Atlantic cod is a large, cold-water fish with a distinctive chin barbel and three dorsal fins, once one of the most important food fish in the world.
atlantic-cod.funFact: 濁った水中でも電気感知で獲物を検出できる

atlantic-grouper.name: Atlantic Grouper
atlantic-grouper.description: The Atlantic grouper is a large, robust reef fish with a wide mouth and thick lips found in warm Atlantic waters.
atlantic-grouper.funFact: 口を突然大きく開いて獲物を丸ごと飲み込む

goliath-grouper.name: Goliath Grouper
goliath-grouper.description: The goliath grouper is the largest bony fish in the Western Atlantic, reaching weights of up to 800 pounds.
goliath-grouper.funFact: 小さな車と同じ重さになりうるほど大きい

red-snapper.name: Red Snapper
red-snapper.description: The red snapper is a bright red reef fish found in the Gulf of Mexico and western Atlantic.
red-snapper.funFact: 50年以上生きることができ、最も長寿のマダイ種

barracuda.name: Barracuda
barracuda.description: The barracuda is a large, predatory fish with a long, streamlined body and razor-sharp teeth found in tropical oceans.
barracuda.funFact: 短い爆発で時速30マイル以上泳ぐことができる

mahi-mahi.name: Mahi-Mahi
mahi-mahi.description: The mahi-mahi is a brightly colored pelagic fish with a golden-green body and blue fins found in tropical oceans.
mahi-mahi.funFact: ドナルドフィッシュとも呼ばれ、イルカと混同しないこと

wahoo.name: Wahoo
wahoo.description: The wahoo is a large, fast pelagic fish related to mackerels with a sleek, torpedo-shaped body and vertical blue bars.
wahoo.funFact: 海洋で最も速い魚の1つで、時速50マイルに達する

sailfish.name: Sailfish
sailfish.description: The sailfish is a large billfish with a spectacular high dorsal fin resembling a sail, found in tropical oceans worldwide.
sailfish.funFact: 海洋で最も速い魚とされ、時速68マイルに達する

blue-marlin.name: Blue Marlin
blue-marlin.description: The blue marlin is one of the largest ocean fish with a distinctive blue upper body and silver-white belly found in tropical Atlantic waters.
blue-marlin.funFact: 1000ポンド以上になり、世界最大の硬骨魚の1つ

nassau-grouper.name: Nassau Grouper
nassau-grouper.description: The Nassau grouper is a large reef fish capable of rapid color changes, now critically endangered from overfishing.
nassau-grouper.funFact: 数秒で周囲に合わせて体色を変えることができる

striped-bass.name: Striped Bass
striped-bass.description: The striped bass is a silver fish with distinctive horizontal dark stripes found along the Atlantic coast.
striped-bass.funFact: 溯河性で、産卵のため数百マイル移動できる

red-drum.name: Red Drum
