eastern-bluebird.description: Eastern Bluebird ist ein Tier. The eastern bluebird is a small thrush with brilliant blue plumage on the back and a rusty-red throat and breast. A symbol of happiness, it was saved from decline by nest box programs.
eastern-bluebird.funFact: Eastern bluebirds can see ultraviolet light, which helps them find ripe berries.

western-bluebird.name: Western Bluebird
western-bluebird.description: Western Bluebird ist ein Tier. The western bluebird is a small thrush with deep blue plumage and a rusty breast. It nests in cavities and feeds primarily on insects caught on the ground.
western-bluebird.funFact: Western bluebirds are one of the few songbirds that nest in old woodpecker holes.

baltimore-oriole.name: Baltimore Oriole
baltimore-oriole.description: Baltimore Oriole ist ein Tier. The Baltimore oriole is a striking songbird with vivid orange and black plumage. They weave elaborate pendulous nests from plant fibers.
baltimore-oriole.funFact: Baltimore orioles weave intricate hanging nests that can take up to two weeks to build.

scarlet-tanager.name: Scarlet Tanager
scarlet-tanager.description: Scarlet Tanager ist ein Tier. The scarlet tanager is a medium-sized songbird with brilliant red plumage and black wings during breeding season. It is a shy forest bird.
scarlet-tanager.funFact: The male scarlet tanager turns olive-green in winter, looking like a completely different bird.

yellow-warbler.name: Yellow Warbler
yellow-warbler.description: Yellow Warbler ist ein Tier. The yellow warbler is a small, bright yellow songbird widespread across North America. Its cheerful song is one of the most recognizable spring sounds.
yellow-warbler.funFact: Yellow warblers are one of the first songbirds to arrive on their breeding grounds in spring.

white-throated-sparrow.name: White-throated Sparrow
white-throated-sparrow.description: White-throated Sparrow ist ein Tier. The white-throated sparrow is a common songbird with a distinctive white throat patch and yellow lores. It has two color morphs that differ in behavior.
white-throated-sparrow.funFact: White-throated sparrows come in two color morphs that pair almost exclusively with each other.

dark-eyed-junco.name: Dark-eyed Junco
dark-eyed-junco.description: Dark-eyed Junco ist ein Tier. The dark-eyed junco is a small, slate-colored sparrow common across North America. It is one of the most abundant and widespread forest birds.
dark-eyed-junco.funFact: Dark-eyed juncos are called snowbirds because they appear in southern states during winter.

ruby-throated-hummingbird.name: Ruby-throated Hummingbird
ruby-throated-hummingbird.description: Ruby-throated Hummingbird ist ein Tier. The ruby-throated hummingbird is the only breeding hummingbird in eastern North America. Males have an iridescent ruby-red throat.
ruby-throated-hummingbird.funFact: Ruby-throated hummingbirds beat their wings 53 times per second and can fly backwards.

annas-hummingbird.name: Annas Hummingbird
annas-hummingbird.description: Annas Hummingbird ist ein Tier. Annas hummingbird is a small, green hummingbird native to western North America. Males have a brilliant rose-pink throat and crown.
annas-hummingbird.funFact: Male Annas hummingbirds perform dramatic diving displays that create an audible chirp.

black-chinned-hummingbird.name: Black-chinned Hummingbird
black-chinned-hummingbird.description: Black-chinned Hummingbird ist ein Tier. The black-chinned hummingbird is a small, common hummingbird of the western United States with a velvet-black chin that shows iridescent purple.
black-chinned-hummingbird.funFact: The black chin of this hummingbird flashes brilliant purple when the light hits it at the right angle.

belted-kingfisher.name: Belted Kingfisher
belted-kingfisher.description: Belted Kingfisher ist ein Tier. The belted kingfisher is a stocky, blue-gray bird with a shaggy crest and large dagger-like bill. Females have an additional rusty band across the belly.
belted-kingfisher.funFact: The belted kingfisher is one of the few bird species where females are more colorful than males.

great-blue-heron.name: Great Blue Heron
great-blue-heron.description: Great Blue Heron ist ein Tier. The great blue heron is the largest heron in North America, with a wingspan up to 6.5 feet. It wades in shallow water to hunt fish.
great-blue-heron.funFact: Great blue herons can stand motionless for hours waiting for the perfect moment to strike prey.

great-egret.name: Great Egret
great-egret.description: Great Egret ist ein Tier. The great egret is a large, all-white heron with a yellow bill and black legs. Its near-extinction for the millinery trade helped spark the conservation movement.
great-egret.funFact: The great egrets long plumes nearly drove it to extinction in the 19th century for use in womens hats.

snowy-egret.name: Snowy Egret
snowy-egret.description: Snowy Egret ist ein Tier. The snowy egret is a small, elegant white heron with black legs and vivid yellow feet. During breeding season, it develops long, flowing plumes.
snowy-egret.funFact: Snowy egrets use their bright yellow feet to stir up prey from muddy bottoms.

green-heron.name: Green Heron
green-heron.description: Green Heron ist ein Tier. The green heron is a small, stocky heron with dark greenish-gray plumage. It is a clever hunter that sometimes uses bait to lure fish.
green-heron.funFact: Green herons are one of the few bird species that use tools, dropping bait on the water to attract fish.

american-flamingo.name: American Flamingo
american-flamingo.description: American Flamingo ist ein Tier. The American flamingo is a large, bright pink wading bird found in the Caribbean and Galapagos with the brightest plumage of all flamingos.
american-flamingo.funFact: American flamingos are the most brightly colored of all flamingo species.

sandhill-crane.name: Sandhill Crane
sandhill-crane.description: Sandhill Crane ist ein Tier. The sandhill crane is a tall, gray bird with a red crown and long legs. Known for its trumpeting call and spectacular mating dances.
sandhill-crane.funFact: Sandhill cranes perform elaborate dances that include jumping, bowing, and tossing sticks.

whooping-crane.name: Whooping Crane
whooping-crane.description: Whooping Crane ist ein Tier. The whooping crane is the tallest bird in North America. Named for its loud whooping call, it was saved from extinction through intensive conservation.
whooping-crane.funFact: Whooping cranes were once down to only 15 birds in the wild, making them one of the rarest birds in North America.

purple-gallinule.name: Purple Gallinule
purple-gallinule.description: Purple Gallinule ist ein Tier. The purple gallinule is a brightly colored marsh bird with purple-blue plumage and a red and yellow bill. It walks gracefully on floating vegetation.
purple-gallinule.funFact: Purple gallinules can walk across lily pads thanks to their extremely long toes.

american-coot.name: American Coot
american-coot.description: American Coot ist ein Tier. The American coot is a dark, chicken-like waterbird with a white bill and frontal shield. Despite looking duck-like, it is related to rails.
american-coot.funFact: American coots can sink slowly into water to hide, submerging up to their necks.

wild-turkey.name: Wild Turkey
wild-turkey.description: Wild Turkey ist ein Tier. The wild turkey is a large, iridescent bird native to North America. Males display elaborate courtship rituals. It is the ancestor of the domesticated turkey.
wild-turkey.funFact: Wild turkeys can fly at speeds up to 55 mph and run at 25 mph.

ring-necked-pheasant.name: Ring-necked Pheasant
ring-necked-pheasant.description: Ring-necked Pheasant ist ein Tier. The ring-necked pheasant is a colorful game bird originally from Asia, now established across North America and Europe. Males have brilliant copper and green plumage.
ring-necked-pheasant.funFact: Male ring-necked pheasants have such vivid plumage that they were once used as models for dragon illustrations.

bobwhite-quail.name: Northern Bobwhite
bobwhite-quail.description: Northern Bobwhite ist ein Tier. The northern bobwhite is a small, compact quail with a distinctive white throat and eyebrow stripe in males. Named for its clear bob-white call.
bobwhite-quail.funFact: The northern bobwhite is named for its distinctive two-note call that sounds like its name.

california-quail.name: California Quail
california-quail.description: California Quail ist ein Tier. The California quail is a small, plump ground bird with a distinctive forward-curving black head plume. It is the state bird of California.
california-quail.funFact: The California quails distinctive head plume curves forward like a question mark.

rockhopper-penguin.name: Rockhopper Penguin
rockhopper-penguin.description: Rockhopper Penguin ist ein Tier. The rockhopper penguin is a small penguin known for its distinctive yellow and black crest feathers. It navigates steep, rocky terrain by hopping.
rockhopper-penguin.funFact: Rockhopper penguins bounce from rock to rock using both feet rather than waddling.

little-blue-penguin.name: Little Blue Penguin
little-blue-penguin.description: Little Blue Penguin ist ein Tier. The little blue penguin, also known as the fairy penguin, is the smallest species of penguin. Found in New Zealand and southern Australia.
little-blue-penguin.funFact: Little blue penguins are the smallest penguin species, standing only about 13 inches tall.

gentoo-penguin.name: Gentoo Penguin
gentoo-penguin.description: Gentoo Penguin ist ein Tier. The gentoo penguin is recognizable by the white stripe across its head and its bright orange-red bill. It is the fastest underwater swimming bird.
gentoo-penguin.funFact: Gentoo penguins are the fastest underwater swimming birds, reaching speeds of 22 mph.

african-penguin.name: African Penguin
african-penguin.description: African Penguin ist ein Tier. The African penguin, also known as the jackass penguin for its donkey-like bray, is the only penguin species that breeds in Africa. It is endangered.
african-penguin.funFact: African penguins are sometimes called jackass penguins because they bray like donkeys.

brown-kiwi.name: Brown Kiwi
brown-kiwi.description: Brown Kiwi ist ein Tier. The brown kiwi is a flightless bird native to New Zealand. It has hair-like feathers, no tail, and a long probing bill with nostrils at the tip.
brown-kiwi.funFact: Kiwi eggs are enormous relative to body size, up to 20% of the females body weight.

lyrebird.name: Superb Lyrebird
lyrebird.description: Superb Lyrebird ist ein Tier. The superb lyrebird is famous for its extraordinary ability to mimic sounds. Males have an elaborate tail that forms a lyre shape during courtship.
lyrebird.funFact: The lyrebird can mimic virtually any sound, including chainsaws, camera shutters, and car alarms.

cassowary.name: Southern Cassowary
cassowary.description: Southern Cassowary ist ein Tier. The southern cassowary is a large, flightless bird with a distinctive blue neck, red wattles, and a bony casque on its head.
cassowary.funFact: The southern cassowary is considered the worlds most dangerous bird due to its powerful kicks.

scarlet-macaw.name: Scarlet Macaw
scarlet-macaw.description: Scarlet Macaw ist ein Tier. The scarlet macaw is a large, colorful parrot with brilliant red, yellow, and blue plumage. Found in Central and South American rainforests.
scarlet-macaw.funFact: Scarlet macaws can live over 75 years in captivity and mate for life.

blue-and-yellow-macaw.name: Blue-and-yellow Macaw
blue-and-yellow-macaw.description: Blue-and-yellow Macaw ist ein Tier. The blue-and-yellow macaw is a large parrot with vivid blue upperparts and golden-yellow underparts. It is highly social and can mimic human speech.
blue-and-yellow-macaw.funFact: Blue-and-yellow macaws can fly at speeds up to 35 mph and use their powerful beaks to crack hard nuts.

hyacinth-macaw.name: Hyacinth Macaw
hyacinth-macaw.description: Hyacinth Macaw ist ein Tier. The hyacinth macaw is the largest of all flying parrot species, with stunning cobalt-blue plumage and bright yellow eye rings.
hyacinth-macaw.funFact: The hyacinth macaw is the largest flying parrot in the world, with a wingspan over 4 feet.

african-grey-parrot.name: African Grey Parrot
african-grey-parrot.description: African Grey Parrot ist ein Tier. The African grey parrot is renowned for its exceptional intelligence and ability to mimic human speech. It has grey plumage with a striking red tail.
african-grey-parrot.funFact: African grey parrots are considered the most intelligent bird species, with cognitive abilities rivaling those of young children.

budgerigar.name: Budgerigar
budgerigar.description: Budgerigar ist ein Tier. The budgerigar is a small, long-tailed parakeet native to Australia. In the wild, it is green and yellow with black markings.
budgerigar.funFact: Budgerigars are the third most popular pet in the world after dogs and cats.

cockatiel.name: Cockatiel
cockatiel.description: Cockatiel ist ein Tier. The cockatiel is a small parrot native to Australia, recognizable by its prominent crest and orange cheek patches.
cockatiel.funFact: Cockatiels are one of the few parrot species that can whistle tunes accurately.

keel-billed-toucan.name: Keel-billed Toucan
keel-billed-toucan.description: Keel-billed Toucan ist ein Tier. The keel-billed toucan is a colorful bird with a massive, rainbow-colored bill. Found in Central and South American rainforests.
keel-billed-toucan.funFact: The toucans colorful bill is surprisingly lightweight, made mostly of keratin with a honeycomb structure.

toco-toucan.name: Toco Toucan
toco-toucan.description: Toco Toucan ist ein Tier. The toco toucan is the largest toucan species, with a massive orange-yellow bill tipped in black. Found in South American forests.
toco-toucan.funFact: The toco toucans bill contains a network of blood vessels that help regulate body temperature.

great-hornbill.name: Great Hornbill
great-hornbill.description: Great Hornbill ist ein Tier. The great hornbill is one of the largest hornbill species, distinguished by its massive yellow and black casque atop its bill.
great-hornbill.funFact: Great hornbill pairs seal the female inside a tree cavity during nesting, leaving only a small slit for feeding.

rhinoceros-hornbill.name: Rhinoceros Hornbill
rhinoceros-hornbill.description: Rhinoceros Hornbill ist ein Tier. The rhinoceros hornbill is a large hornbill with a dramatic upward-curving casque on its bill. Found in Southeast Asian rainforests.
rhinoceros-hornbill.funFact: The rhinoceros hornbills upward-curved casque can grow up to 7 inches long.

laughing-kookaburra.name: Laughing Kookaburra
laughing-kookaburra.description: Laughing Kookaburra ist ein Tier. The laughing kookaburra is a large kingfisher native to Australia, famous for its distinctive call that sounds like loud, echoing human laughter.
laughing-kookaburra.funFact: The laughing kookaburras call sounds exactly like echoing human laughter.

pied-kingfisher.name: Pied Kingfisher
pied-kingfisher.description: Pied Kingfisher ist ein Tier. The pied kingfisher is a black and white kingfisher found across Africa and Asia. It hovers over water before diving to catch fish.
pied-kingfisher.funFact: The pied kingfisher is the only kingfisher species that can hover over water before diving.

atlantic-puffin.name: Atlantic Puffin
atlantic-puffin.description: Atlantic Puffin ist ein Tier. The Atlantic puffin is a small seabird with a colorful triangular bill and distinctive black and white plumage. Known as the clown of the sea.
atlantic-puffin.funFact: Puffins can carry 10 or more fish in their beaks at once thanks to specialized tongue and bill structures.

tufted-puffin.name: Tufted Puffin
tufted-puffin.description: Tufted Puffin ist ein Tier. The tufted puffin is a small seabird with black plumage, white face patches, and distinctive golden head tufts during breeding season.
tufted-puffin.funFact: Tufted puffins can dive to depths of over 200 feet to catch fish.

wandering-albatross.name: Wandering Albatross
wandering-albatross.description: Wandering Albatross ist ein Tier. The wandering albatross has the largest wingspan of any bird, up to 11.5 feet. It spends most of its life soaring over the Southern Ocean.
wandering-albatross.funFact: The wandering albatross has the largest wingspan of any living bird, reaching over 11 feet.

black-browed-albatross.name: Black-browed Albatross
black-browed-albatross.description: Black-browed Albatross ist ein Tier. The black-browed albatross is a large seabird with dark upper wings and a white body. Named for the dark stripe through its eye.
black-browed-albatross.funFact: Black-browed albatrosses can sleep while flying over the ocean.

laysan-albatross.name: Laysan Albatross
laysan-albatross.description: Laysan Albatross ist ein Tier. The Laysan albatross is a large seabird of the North Pacific. It breeds primarily on remote Pacific islands.
laysan-albatross.funFact: The oldest known wild bird in the world is a Laysan albatross named Wisdom, over 70 years old.

brown-pelican.name: Brown Pelican
brown-pelican.description: Brown Pelican ist ein Tier. The brown pelican is a large waterbird with a massive bill and throat pouch. It is unique among pelicans for plunge-diving from the air.
brown-pelican.funFact: Brown pelicans can dive from heights of over 60 feet to catch fish, with air sacs cushioning the impact.

american-white-pelican.name: American White Pelican
american-white-pelican.description: American White Pelican ist ein Tier. The American white pelican is one of the largest North American birds, with a wingspan up to 9 feet. It scoops fish while swimming.
american-white-pelican.funFact: American white pelicans fish cooperatively, herding schools of fish into shallow water.

frigatebird.name: Magnificent Frigatebird
frigatebird.description: Magnificent Frigatebird ist ein Tier. The magnificent frigatebird is a large seabird with long, angular wings and a deeply forked tail. Males inflate a bright red throat pouch.
frigatebird.funFact: Frigatebirds can stay airborne for weeks and sleep while flying over the ocean.

northern-gannet.name: Northern Gannet
northern-gannet.description: Northern Gannet ist ein Tier. The northern gannet is the largest seabird in the North Atlantic. It nests in massive colonies on sea cliffs.
northern-gannet.funFact: Northern gannets plunge-dive from heights of 130 feet, hitting the water at 60 mph.

blue-footed-booby.name: Blue-footed Booby
blue-footed-booby.description: Blue-footed Booby ist ein Tier. The blue-footed booby is a marine bird famous for its vivid blue feet. Found along the Pacific coast of the Americas.
blue-footed-booby.funFact: Male blue-footed boobies perform an elaborate dance, lifting their bright blue feet alternately to attract mates.

red-footed-booby.name: Red-footed Booby
red-footed-booby.description: Red-footed Booby ist ein Tier. The red-footed booby is the smallest booby species, with distinctive red feet. It comes in several color morphs.
red-footed-booby.funFact: Red-footed boobies are the most abundant booby species and the only ones that regularly nest in trees.

great-cormorant.name: Great Cormorant
great-cormorant.description: Great Cormorant ist ein Tier. The great cormorant is a large, dark waterbird found across much of the world. It spreads its wings to dry after fishing.
great-cormorant.funFact: Cormorants have less preen oil than other waterbirds, which helps them dive but requires wing-drying.

common-loon.name: Common Loon
common-loon.description: Common Loon ist ein Tier. The common loon is a large waterbird known for its haunting wail across northern lakes. Its solid bones help it dive deep.
common-loon.funFact: Common loons have solid bones that make them less buoyant and better at diving than most birds.

arctic-tern.name: Arctic Tern
arctic-tern.description: Arctic Tern ist ein Tier. The Arctic tern migrates farther than any other animal. It experiences more daylight than any other creature.
arctic-tern.funFact: Arctic terns migrate from Arctic to Antarctic and back each year, the longest migration of any animal, up to 44,000 miles.

caspian-tern.name: Caspian Tern
caspian-tern.description: Caspian Tern ist ein Tier. The Caspian tern is the worlds largest tern, with a massive red bill and black cap. Found on every continent except Antarctica.
caspian-tern.funFact: The Caspian tern is the largest tern species in the world.

black-skimmer.name: Black Skimmer
black-skimmer.description: Black Skimmer ist ein Tier. The black skimmer is a unique seabird with a distinctive uneven bill. It flies low over water, dragging its bill to catch fish.
black-skimmer.funFact: The black skimmers lower bill is longer than its upper, allowing it to skim fish from the water surface.

herring-gull.name: Herring Gull
herring-gull.description: Herring Gull ist ein Tier. The herring gull is one of the most common gulls in the Northern Hemisphere, thriving in coastal and urban environments.
herring-gull.funFact: Herring gulls can drink saltwater thanks to special glands above their eyes that filter out excess salt.

laughing-gull.name: Laughing Gull
laughing-gull.description: Laughing Gull ist ein Tier. The laughing gull is a medium-sized gull with a distinctive black head in breeding season and a laughing call.
laughing-gull.funFact: Laughing gulls are named for their call that sounds like high-pitched human laughter.

killdeer.name: Killdeer
killdeer.description: Killdeer ist ein Tier. The killdeer is a large plover with distinctive black breast bands. It is famous for its broken-wing display.
killdeer.funFact: Killdeer perform a broken-wing act to lure predators away from their ground nests.

american-woodcock.name: American Woodcock
american-woodcock.description: American Woodcock ist ein Tier. The American woodcock is a plump shorebird with a long bill. It feeds on earthworms and performs an aerial sky-dance at dusk.
american-woodcock.funFact: American woodcocks have eyes on the sides of their heads and can see 360 degrees.

red-knot.name: Red Knot
red-knot.description: Red Knot ist ein Tier. The red knot is famous for one of the longest migrations in the animal kingdom. It turns rusty-red during breeding season.
red-knot.funFact: Red knots migrate up to 9,000 miles nonstop from the Arctic to the tip of South America.

american-avocet.name: American Avocet
american-avocet.description: American Avocet ist ein Tier. The American avocet is an elegant wader with a thin, upturned bill and long legs. During breeding season, its head and neck turn rusty-orange.
american-avocet.funFact: American avocets sweep their upturned bills side to side through water to catch tiny invertebrates.

black-necked-stilt.name: Black-necked Stilt
black-necked-stilt.description: Black-necked Stilt ist ein Tier. The black-necked stilt is a striking wader with black upperparts, white underparts, and extraordinarily long pink legs.
black-necked-stilt.funFact: The black-necked stilt has the second-longest legs relative to body size of any bird, after the flamingo.

willow-ptarmigan.name: Willow Ptarmigan
willow-ptarmigan.description: Willow Ptarmigan ist ein Tier. The willow ptarmigan is a game bird of the Arctic tundra that changes plumage with the seasons.
willow-ptarmigan.funFact: Willow ptarmigan change color with the seasons, brown in summer and pure white in winter.

spruce-grouse.name: Spruce Grouse
spruce-grouse.description: Spruce Grouse ist ein Tier. The spruce grouse is a forest-dwelling game bird of the boreal region, known for its tameness.
spruce-grouse.funFact: Spruce grouse are so tame they are sometimes called fool hens because they rarely fly from danger.

ruffed-grouse.name: Ruffed Grouse
ruffed-grouse.description: Ruffed Grouse ist ein Tier. The ruffed grouse is a popular game bird of eastern North American forests with a distinctive drumming display.
ruffed-grouse.funFact: Male ruffed grouse create a drumming sound by beating their wings rapidly to attract females.

chukar.name: Chukar
chukar.description: Chukar ist ein Tier. The chukar is a rotund game bird native to Eurasia and introduced to North America with distinctive black and white barring.
chukar.funFact: Chukars prefer running uphill to flying when escaping danger.

common-crane.name: Common Crane
common-crane.description: Common Crane ist ein Tier. The common crane is a large, elegant wading bird with gray plumage and a red crown patch. Famous for its courtship dances.
common-crane.funFact: Common cranes perform elaborate dances with jumping, bowing, and wing-flapping during courtship.

demoiselle-crane.name: Demoiselle Crane
demoiselle-crane.description: Demoiselle Crane ist ein Tier. The demoiselle crane is the smallest crane species, elegant and graceful with a black neck and white ear tufts.
demoiselle-crane.funFact: Demoiselle cranes fly at altitudes over 26,000 feet during their Himalayan migration.

bearded-vulture.name: Bearded Vulture
bearded-vulture.description: Bearded Vulture ist ein Tier. The bearded vulture is the only bird species that feeds almost exclusively on bones.
bearded-vulture.funFact: Bearded vultures eat bones, dropping them from great heights to crack them into swallowable pieces.

andean-condor.name: Andean Condor
andean-condor.description: Andean Condor ist ein Tier. The Andean condor is one of the worlds largest flying birds. It soars on thermal currents over the Andes mountains.
andean-condor.funFact: The Andean condor has the largest wingspan of any raptor, reaching over 10 feet.

king-vulture.name: King Vulture
king-vulture.description: King Vulture ist ein Tier. The king vulture is a large, colorful vulture with a vividly colored head and a white body.
king-vulture.funFact: King vultures were believed by the Maya to carry messages between humans and gods.

turkey-vulture.name: Turkey Vulture
turkey-vulture.description: Turkey Vulture ist ein Tier. The turkey vulture is a large soaring bird with a red, featherless head resembling a wild turkey.
turkey-vulture.funFact: Turkey vultures have the best sense of smell of any bird, able to detect carrion from miles away.

american-kestrel.name: American Kestrel
american-kestrel.description: American Kestrel ist ein Tier. The American kestrel is the smallest and most common falcon in North America. Males have slate-blue wings.
american-kestrel.funFact: American kestrels can see ultraviolet light, which helps them track the urine trails of rodents.

merlin.name: Merlin
merlin.description: Merlin ist ein Tier. The merlin is a small, powerful falcon found across the Northern Hemisphere. It pursues small birds in direct flight.
merlin.funFact: Merlins were once known as pigeon hawks due to their habit of hunting pigeons.

prairie-falcon.name: Prairie Falcon
prairie-falcon.description: Prairie Falcon ist ein Tier. The prairie falcon is a large, sandy-brown falcon of the western North American open country.
prairie-falcon.funFact: Prairie falcons can reach speeds over 45 mph in level flight and much faster in a stoop.

gyrfalcon.name: Gyrfalcon
gyrfalcon.description: Gyrfalcon ist ein Tier. The gyrfalcon is the largest of all falcon species, found in Arctic regions. It was historically prized in falconry for royalty.
gyrfalcon.funFact: The gyrfalcon is the largest falcon in the world and was once reserved as a bird of kings.

osprey.name: Osprey
osprey.description: Osprey ist ein Tier. The osprey is a large raptor found on every continent except Antarctica. It feeds almost exclusively on fish.
osprey.funFact: Ospreys have reversible outer toes that allow them to grasp fish with two toes in front and two behind.

northern-harrier.name: Northern Harrier
northern-harrier.description: Northern Harrier ist ein Tier. The northern harrier is a slim raptor that hunts by flying low over open ground, using both sight and sound.
northern-harrier.funFact: Northern harriers have facial discs similar to owls that help them locate prey by sound.

coopers-hawk.name: Coopers Hawk
coopers-hawk.description: Coopers Hawk ist ein Tier. The Coopers hawk is a medium-sized accipiter that specializes in capturing doves and songbirds in flight.
coopers-hawk.funFact: Coopers hawks are agile enough to chase prey through dense forest at high speed.

sharp-shinned-hawk.name: Sharp-shinned Hawk
sharp-shinned-hawk.description: Sharp-shinned Hawk ist ein Tier. The sharp-shinned hawk is the smallest accipiter in North America. A rapid, agile flier that hunts small songbirds.
sharp-shinned-hawk.funFact: The sharp-shinned hawk is the smallest hawk in North America, barely larger than a jay.

swainsons-hawk.name: Swainsons Hawk
swainsons-hawk.description: Swainsons Hawk ist ein Tier. The Swainsons hawk is a medium-sized raptor that migrates in enormous flocks to the pampas of Argentina for the winter.
swainsons-hawk.funFact: Swainsons hawks migrate in massive flocks of hundreds of thousands from North America to South America.

rough-legged-hawk.name: Rough-legged Hawk
rough-legged-hawk.description: Rough-legged Hawk ist ein Tier. The rough-legged hawk breeds in the Arctic tundra and winters in open prairies of North America.
rough-legged-hawk.funFact: Rough-legged hawks have feathered legs all the way to their toes, adapted for Arctic cold.

ferruginous-hawk.name: Ferruginous Hawk
ferruginous-hawk.description: Ferruginous Hawk ist ein Tier. The ferruginous hawk is the largest buteo hawk in North America with rust-colored upperparts.
ferruginous-hawk.funFact: The ferruginous hawk is the largest North American hawk, with a wingspan over 5 feet.

white-tailed-kite.name: White-tailed Kite
white-tailed-kite.description: White-tailed Kite ist ein Tier. The white-tailed kite is a graceful raptor with white plumage, black shoulders, and a forked tail.
white-tailed-kite.funFact: White-tailed kites can hover in place for extended periods while scanning the ground for prey.

mississippi-kite.name: Mississippi Kite
mississippi-kite.description: Mississippi Kite ist ein Tier. The Mississippi kite is a small, elegant raptor with pearl-gray plumage that feeds primarily on insects caught in flight.
mississippi-kite.funFact: Mississippi kites eat enormous quantities of cicadas and other insects caught in mid-air.

red-winged-blackbird.name: Red-winged Blackbird
red-winged-blackbird.description: Red-winged Blackbird ist ein Tier. The red-winged blackbird is one of the most abundant and widespread birds in North America with bright red and yellow shoulder patches.
red-winged-blackbird.funFact: Red-winged blackbirds are one of the most abundant birds in North America, with over 200 million individuals.

brown-headed-cowbird.name: Brown-headed Cowbird
brown-headed-cowbird.description: Brown-headed Cowbird ist ein Tier. The brown-headed cowbird is a brood parasite that lays its eggs in the nests of other bird species.
brown-headed-cowbird.funFact: Brown-headed cowbirds are brood parasites that lay their eggs in other birds nests.

common-grackle.name: Common Grackle
common-grackle.description: Common Grackle ist ein Tier. The common grackle is a large, lanky blackbird with iridescent plumage and bright yellow eyes.
common-grackle.funFact: Common grackles have iridescent feathers that shimmer purple, green, and bronze in the sunlight.

great-tailed-grackle.name: Great-tailed Grackle
great-tailed-grackle.description: Great-tailed Grackle ist ein Tier. The great-tailed grackle is a large, noisy blackbird with a very long, keel-shaped tail.
great-tailed-grackle.funFact: Male great-tailed grackles have a wingspan of nearly 18 inches and their long tails make up half their total length.

yellow-headed-blackbird.name: Yellow-headed Blackbird
yellow-headed-blackbird.description: Yellow-headed Blackbird ist ein Tier. The yellow-headed blackbird is a striking songbird with a brilliant yellow-orange head contrasting with a black body.
yellow-headed-blackbird.funFact: Male yellow-headed blackbirds defend small nesting territories within marshes, sometimes with multiple females.

eastern-meadowlark.name: Eastern Meadowlark
eastern-meadowlark.description: Eastern Meadowlark ist ein Tier. The eastern meadowlark is a bright yellow songbird with a distinctive V-shaped black breast band.
eastern-meadowlark.funFact: The eastern meadowlark looks almost identical to the western meadowlark but has a completely different song.

western-meadowlark.name: Western Meadowlark
western-meadowlark.description: Western Meadowlark ist ein Tier. The western meadowlark is a bright yellow songbird with a black V-shaped breast band, the state bird of six states.
western-meadowlark.funFact: The western meadowlark is the state bird of six different U.S. states, more than any other bird.

orchard-oriole.name: Orchard Oriole
orchard-oriole.description: Orchard Oriole ist ein Tier. The orchard oriole is a small, chestnut and black songbird. Males have a chestnut body with a black head.
orchard-oriole.funFact: The orchard oriole is the smallest icterid in North America, smaller than even the house finch.

bullocks-oriole.name: Bullocks Oriole
bullocks-oriole.description: Bullocks Oriole ist ein Tier. The Bullocks oriole is a bright orange and black songbird of western North America that weaves hanging basket nests.
bullocks-oriole.funFact: Bullocks orioles weave elaborate hanging pouch nests that dangle from tree branches.

barn-swallow.name: Barn Swallow
barn-swallow.description: Barn Swallow ist ein Tier. The barn swallow is the most widespread swallow species in the world with a distinctive deeply forked tail.
barn-swallow.funFact: Barn swallows migrate up to 6,000 miles between their breeding and wintering grounds.

tree-swallow.name: Tree Swallow
tree-swallow.description: Tree Swallow ist ein Tier. The tree swallow is a small, iridescent blue-green swallow with white underparts.
tree-swallow.funFact: Tree swallows are one of the few North American songbirds that can digest berries, allowing them to migrate earlier in spring.

cliff-swallow.name: Cliff Swallow
cliff-swallow.description: Cliff Swallow ist ein Tier. The cliff swallow is a small swallow with a pale rump and squared-off tail that builds enclosed mud nests in colonies.
cliff-swallow.funFact: Cliff swallows build gourd-shaped mud nests in colonies that can number in the hundreds.

purple-martin.name: Purple Martin
purple-martin.description: Purple Martin ist ein Tier. The purple martin is the largest North American swallow with iridescent purple-blue plumage in males.
purple-martin.funFact: Purple martins are almost completely dependent on human-provided nest boxes in the eastern United States.

bank-swallow.name: Bank Swallow
bank-swallow.description: Bank Swallow ist ein Tier. The bank swallow is the smallest swallow in North America, nesting in burrows excavated in sandy banks near water.
bank-swallow.funFact: Bank swallows are the smallest swallow species in North America and nest in burrows dug into sandy banks.

violet-green-swallow.name: Violet-green Swallow
violet-green-swallow.description: Violet-green Swallow ist ein Tier. The violet-green swallow is a small, colorful swallow with iridescent green and violet upperparts.
violet-green-swallow.funFact: Violet-green swallows have white patches on their face that wrap around to the back of their head.

chimney-swift.name: Chimney Swift
chimney-swift.description: Chimney Swift ist ein Tier. The chimney swift is a cigar-shaped, dark gray bird that spends most of its life on the wing.
chimney-swift.funFact: Chimney swifts can spend almost their entire lives in the air, even sleeping while flying.

common-nighthawk.name: Common Nighthawk
common-nighthawk.description: Common Nighthawk ist ein Tier. The common nighthawk is a nocturnal bird that feeds on flying insects caught during acrobatic aerial displays.
common-nighthawk.funFact: Common nighthawks have tiny feathers around their mouth that form a wide funnel for catching insects in flight.

eastern-whip-poor-will.name: Eastern Whip-poor-will
eastern-whip-poor-will.description: Eastern Whip-poor-will ist ein Tier. The eastern whip-poor-will is a nocturnal bird named for its distinctive three-part call.
eastern-whip-poor-will.funFact: Eastern whip-poor-wills can sing up to 400 times per hour, repeating their name-like call all night.

greater-roadrunner.name: Greater Roadrunner
greater-roadrunner.description: Greater Roadrunner ist ein Tier. The greater roadrunner is a large, ground-dwelling cuckoo of the American deserts known for its X-shaped tail.
greater-roadrunner.funFact: Greater roadrunners can run at speeds up to 20 mph and can live without drinking water.

yellow-billed-cuckoo.name: Yellow-billed Cuckoo
yellow-billed-cuckoo.description: Yellow-billed Cuckoo ist ein Tier. The yellow-billed cuckoo is a slim, long-tailed bird with a curved yellow bill that feeds on caterpillars.
yellow-billed-cuckoo.funFact: Yellow-billed cuckoos are sometimes called rain crows because they call more frequently before storms.

hoopoe.name: Eurasian Hoopoe
hoopoe.description: Eurasian Hoopoe ist ein Tier. The Eurasian hoopoe is a distinctive bird with cinnamon plumage, black and white wing bars, and a spectacular erectile crest.
hoopoe.funFact: The hoopoe has a spectacular fan-like crest that it raises when excited or alarmed.

tawny-frogmouth.name: Tawny Frogmouth
tawny-frogmouth.description: Tawny Frogmouth ist ein Tier. The tawny frogmouth is a nocturnal bird of Australia with cryptic plumage that perfectly camouflages it against tree bark.
tawny-frogmouth.funFact: Tawny frogmouths are often mistaken for owls but are actually more closely related to nightjars.

common-potoo.name: Common Potoo
common-potoo.description: Common Potoo ist ein Tier. The common potoo is a nocturnal bird of Central and South American forests with an enormous mouth and cryptic plumage.
common-potoo.funFact: Common potoos perch upright on branches during the day, looking exactly like a broken tree stump.

american-goldfinch.name: American Goldfinch
american-goldfinch.description: American Goldfinch ist ein Tier. The American goldfinch is a small, bright yellow songbird with black wings and cap, one of the latest-nesting birds in North America.
american-goldfinch.funFact: American goldfinches are one of the latest nesting birds, often not breeding until late July.

pine-grosbeak.name: Pine Grosbeak
pine-grosbeak.description: Pine Grosbeak ist ein Tier. The pine grosbeak is a large, plump finch with rosy-pink plumage in males. Found in boreal forests across North America.
pine-grosbeak.funFact: Pine grosbeaks are one of the tamest boreal birds, often allowing close approach.

evening-grosbeak.name: Evening Grosbeak
evening-grosbeak.description: Evening Grosbeak ist ein Tier. The evening grosbeak is a large, stocky finch with a massive conical bill and bright yellow body in males.
evening-grosbeak.funFact: Evening grosbeaks are irruptive migrants, showing up in large numbers far south of their normal range in some years.

cassins-finch.name: Cassins Finch
cassins-finch.description: Cassins Finch ist ein Tier. The Cassins finch is a medium-sized finch with rosy-red crown and pinkish wash on the breast, found in mountain forests.
cassins-finch.funFact: Cassins finches are the most recently described North American bird species, not recognized until 1861.

red-crossbill.name: Red Crossbill
red-crossbill.description: Red Crossbill ist ein Tier. The red crossbill is a finch with a uniquely crossed bill adapted for extracting seeds from conifer cones.
red-crossbill.funFact: Red crossbills have uniquely crossed mandibles specifically adapted for extracting seeds from conifer cones.

pine-siskin.name: Pine Siskin
pine-siskin.description: Pine Siskin ist ein Tier. The pine siskin is a small, streaky brown finch with yellow edging on its wings and tail, an irruptive species.
pine-siskin.funFact: Pine siskins can carry salmonella bacteria without getting sick, which can be transmitted to backyard birds at feeders.

common-redpoll.name: Common Redpoll
common-redpoll.description: Common Redpoll ist ein Tier. The common redpoll is a tiny, streaky finch with a distinctive red cap and pink breast, breeding in Arctic tundra.
common-redpoll.funFact: Common redpolls can survive temperatures of -60 degrees Fahrenheit by eating seeds and fluffing their feathers.

hoary-redpoll.name: Hoary Redpoll
hoary-redpoll.description: Hoary Redpoll ist ein Tier. The hoary redpoll is a tiny Arctic finch, paler and frostier-looking than the common redpoll.
hoary-redpoll.funFact: The hoary redpoll is one of the hardiest songbirds, living further north than almost any other passerine.

house-finch.name: House Finch
house-finch.description: House Finch ist ein Tier. The house finch is a small songbird common in urban and suburban areas with red or orange plumage in males.
house-finch.funFact: Male house finches get their red color from pigments in their diet of berries and fruits.

purple-finch.name: Purple Finch
purple-finch.description: Purple Finch ist ein Tier. The purple finch is a medium-sized finch with rosy-red plumage in males and streaked brown in females.
purple-finch.funFact: Roger Tory Peterson described male purple finches as dipped in raspberry juice.

eastern-wood-pewee.name: Eastern Wood-Pewee
eastern-wood-pewee.description: Eastern Wood-Pewee ist ein Tier. The eastern wood-pewee is a small flycatcher with olive-gray plumage and a distinctive, plaintive whistle.
eastern-wood-pewee.funFact: The eastern wood-pewees call is so distinctive that the species was named after its song.

great-crested-flycatcher.name: Great Crested Flycatcher
great-crested-flycatcher.description: Great Crested Flycatcher ist ein Tier. The great crested flycatcher is a large, yellow-bellied flycatcher with a distinctive crest. It always includes snakeskin in its nest.
great-crested-flycatcher.funFact: Great crested flycatchers always incorporate snakeskin into their nest material.

eastern-kingbird.name: Eastern Kingbird
eastern-kingbird.description: Eastern Kingbird ist ein Tier. The eastern kingbird is a bold flycatcher with dark gray upperparts and a distinctive white tip on its tail.
eastern-kingbird.funFact: Eastern kingbirds are named for their aggressive territorial behavior, attacking birds much larger than themselves.

eastern-phoebe.name: Eastern Phoebe
eastern-phoebe.description: Eastern Phoebe ist ein Tier. The eastern phoebe is a small, brownish-gray flycatcher that bobs its tail frequently and often nests on human structures.
eastern-phoebe.funFact: The eastern phoebe was the first bird ever banded in North America, by Audubon in 1840.

willow-flycatcher.name: Willow Flycatcher
willow-flycatcher.description: Willow Flycatcher ist ein Tier. The willow flycatcher is a small, inconspicuous flycatcher best known for its distinctive fitz-bew song.
willow-flycatcher.funFact: Willow flycatchers are virtually identical to several other Empidonax flycatchers and are best identified by their distinctive FITZ-bew song.

scissor-tailed-flycatcher.name: Scissor-tailed Flycatcher
scissor-tailed-flycatcher.description: Scissor-tailed Flycatcher ist ein Tier. The scissor-tailed flycatcher is a distinctive flycatcher with extremely long, forked tail feathers. It is the state bird of Oklahoma.
scissor-tailed-flycatcher.funFact: The scissor-tailed flycatchers long tail feathers can be twice as long as its body.

vermilion-flycatcher.name: Vermilion Flycatcher
vermilion-flycatcher.description: Vermilion Flycatcher ist ein Tier. The vermilion flycatcher is a small, vividly colored flycatcher with males displaying brilliant red plumage and a black mask.
vermilion-flycatcher.funFact: The vermilion flycatcher is one of the most brilliantly colored flycatchers in the Western Hemisphere.

common-merganser.name: Common Merganser
common-merganser.description: Common Merganser ist ein Tier. The common merganser is a large diving duck with a reddish-brown crested head in females and a dark green head in males. It feeds primarily on fish.
common-merganser.funFact: Common mergansers have serrated bills that help them grip slippery fish while diving underwater.

hooded-merganser.name: Hooded Merganser
hooded-merganser.description: Hooded Merganser ist ein Tier. The hooded merganser is a small, striking diving duck. Males have a bold black and white fan-shaped crest with a rusty flank patch.
hooded-merganser.funFact: Hooded mergansers have the largest crest relative to body size of any duck, which they raise and lower at will.

bufflehead.name: Bufflehead
bufflehead.description: Bufflehead ist ein Tier. The bufflehead is a small, compact diving duck. Males have a striking iridescent green and purple head with large white patches.
bufflehead.funFact: Buffleheads are the smallest diving ducks in North America and often nest in old woodpecker holes.

common-goldeneye.name: Common Goldeneye
common-goldeneye.description: Common Goldeneye ist ein Tier. The common goldeneye is a medium-sized diving duck with a distinctive round head. Males have a dark green-black head with a white circular patch near the bill.
common-goldeneye.funFact: Common goldeneye hens巢巢内产卵后，雌鸟会用自己腹部脱落的绒羽覆盖卵。

ring-necked-duck.name: Ring-necked Duck
ring-necked-duck.description: Ring-necked Duck ist ein Tier. The ring-necked duck is a medium-sized diving duck with a distinctive peaked head shape. Males have a black back, gray flanks, and a white breast with a subtle neck ring.
ring-necked-duck.funFact: Despite its name, the ring-necked duck neck ring is rarely visible in the field.

gadwall.name: Gadwall
gadwall.description: Gadwall ist ein Tier. The gadwall is a dabbling duck with subtle but elegant plumage. Males are mostly gray with black rear ends, while females are mottled brown.
gadwall.funFact: The gadwall is often called the plain duck, but males have an elegant pattern of fine vermiculation visible up close.

blue-winged-teal.name: Blue-winged Teal
blue-winged-teal.description: Blue-winged Teal ist ein Tier. The blue-winged teal is a small dabbling duck. Males have a slate-blue head with a white crescent in front of the eye. It is one of the earliest migrating ducks.
blue-winged-teal.funFact: Blue-winged teal are among the earliest spring migrants and latest fall migrants in North America.

crested-caracara.name: Crested Caracara
crested-caracara.description: Crested Caracara ist ein Tier. The crested caracara is a distinctive raptor with a black cap, white neck, and orange face. Despite being in the falcon family, it scavenges and forages on the ground.
crested-caracara.funFact: Crested caracaras are members of the falcon family but behave more like vultures, often scavenging on carrion.

palm-nut-vulture.name: Palm-nut Vulture
palm-nut-vulture.description: Palm-nut Vulture ist ein Tier. The palm-nut vulture is a unique raptor of West African palm forests that feeds mainly on the fruit of the oil palm.
palm-nut-vulture.funFact: The palm-nut vulture is the only vulture species that feeds primarily on plant material, specifically palm fruits.

black-vulture.name: Black Vulture
black-vulture.description: Black Vulture ist ein Tier. The black vulture is a common New World vulture with black plumage and a bare, dark head. It soars in groups looking for carcasses.
black-vulture.funFact: Black vultures have excellent eyesight and also use their sense of smell to locate carrion.

roseate-spoonbill.name: Roseate Spoonbill
roseate-spoonbill.description: Roseate Spoonbill ist ein Tier. The roseate spoonbill is a large, pink wading bird with a distinctive spatulate bill. It feeds by sweeping its bill through shallow water.
roseate-spoonbill.funFact: Roseate spoonbills sweep their spatulate bills side to side through shallow water to catch small fish and crustaceans.

wood-stork.name: Wood Stork
wood-stork.description: Wood Stork ist ein Tier. The wood stork is a large, white wading bird with a dark, featherless head and a long, curved bill. It is the only stork species breeding in the United States.
wood-stork.funFact: Wood storks are the only stork species that breeds in North America and use tactile feeding to catch prey.

white-ibis.name: White Ibis
white-ibis.description: White Ibis ist ein Tier. The white ibis is a medium-sized wading bird with white plumage, black wing tips, and a distinctive long, curved pink bill.
white-ibis.funFact: White ibises probe mud with their long, curved bills and can detect prey by touch alone.

limpkin.name: Limpkin
limpkin.description: Limpkin ist ein Tier. The limpkin is a large, brown wading bird with white spotting. It is specialized in feeding on apple snails and has a distinctive wailing call.
limpkin.funFact: Limpkins are specialized apple snail eaters, with bills specifically adapted to extract snails from their shells.

rusty-blackbird.name: Rusty Blackbird
rusty-blackbird.description: Rusty Blackbird ist ein Tier. The rusty blackbird is a medium-sized blackbird that breeds in boreal wetlands and winters in the southeastern United States. Males are glossy black with rust-colored edges on feathers in fall.
rusty-blackbird.funFact: The rusty blackbird has declined by over 90% in the past 50 years, making it one of North Americas fastest declining birds.

blue-tang.name: Blue Tang
blue-tang.description: Blue Tang ist ein Tier. The blue tang is a striking royal blue fish with a bright yellow tail and black markings. Found throughout the Indo-Pacific, it feeds primarily on algae and plays an important role in keeping coral reefs healthy.
blue-tang.funFact: Blue tangs can make themselves nearly invisible at night by changing color.

mandarinfish.name: Mandarinfish
mandarinfish.description: Mandarinfish ist ein Tier. The mandarinfish is a small, incredibly colorful reef fish with vivid blue, orange, and green patterns. It produces a toxic mucus coating that deters predators and gives it a distinctive smell.
mandarinfish.funFact: Mandarinfish are one of only two vertebrates known to produce blue pigment.

sixbar-wrasse.name: Sixbar Wrasse
sixbar-wrasse.description: Sixbar Wrasse ist ein Tier. The sixbar wrasse is a slender reef fish with distinctive dark vertical bars across its body. Found throughout the Indo-Pacific, it feeds on small crustaceans and fish.
sixbar-wrasse.funFact: Sixbar wrasses can change sex from female to male during their lifetime.

yellowtail-coris.name: Yellowtail Coris
yellowtail-coris.description: Yellowtail Coris ist ein Tier. The yellowtail coris is a colorful wrasse found in coral reefs across the Indo-Pacific. Adults have a green body with yellow tail and red spots, while juveniles are orange.
yellowtail-coris.funFact: Juvenile yellowtail coris look completely different from adults with orange and white spotting.

bicolor-angelfish.name: Bicolor Angelfish
bicolor-angelfish.description: Bicolor Angelfish ist ein Tier. The bicolor angelfish features a striking split coloration of dark blue-black on the front half and bright yellow on the rear half. Found in Caribbean reefs, it feeds on algae.
bicolor-angelfish.funFact: Bicolor angelfish can make loud popping sounds for communication.

flame-angelfish.name: Flame Angelfish
flame-angelfish.description: Flame Angelfish ist ein Tier. The flame angelfish is a brilliant orange-red fish with black vertical bars native to the Pacific. It is one of the most popular marine aquarium fish.
flame-angelfish.funFact: Flame angelfish can become aggressive when kept in small aquariums.

queen-angelfish.name: Queen Angelfish
queen-angelfish.description: Queen Angelfish ist ein Tier. The queen angelfish is a large, stunningly colorful reef fish with blue, yellow, and green hues. Found throughout the tropical western Atlantic, it feeds primarily on sponges.
queen-angelfish.funFact: Queen angelfish get their name from a dark blue ring on their forehead resembling a crown.

french-angelfish.name: French Angelfish
french-angelfish.description: French Angelfish ist ein Tier. The French angelfish is a striking black fish with bright yellow-edged scales found in Caribbean reefs. Young individuals are bright yellow but darken as adults.
french-angelfish.funFact: French angelfish are often seen in monogamous pairs and travel together for life.

regal-tang.name: Regal Tang
regal-tang.description: Regal Tang ist ein Tier. The regal tang, also known as the palette surgeonfish, is a bright blue fish with a yellow tail and black markings. Found across the Indo-Pacific.
regal-tang.funFact: Regal tangs have a retractable spine near their tail that can inflict painful wounds.

sohal-surgeonfish.name: Sohal Surgeonfish
sohal-surgeonfish.description: Sohal Surgeonfish ist ein Tier. The sohal surgeonfish is a large, gray-blue reef fish with horizontal stripes and sharp scalpel-like spines on its tail. Native to the Red Sea and Persian Gulf.
sohal-surgeonfish.funFact: Sohal surgeonfish are extremely territorial and will attack divers who enter their space.

moorish-idol.name: Moorish Idol
moorish-idol.description: Moorish Idol ist ein Tier. The Moorish idol is one of the most recognizable reef fish with its dramatic black, white, and yellow coloration and a long flowing dorsal fin filament.
moorish-idol.funFact: Moorish idols are notoriously difficult to keep in captivity and rarely survive long in aquariums.

royal-gramma.name: Royal Gramma
royal-gramma.description: Royal Gramma ist ein Tier. The royal gramma, or fairy basslet, has a stunning two-tone coloration with bright purple on the front half and yellow on the rear half. Found in Caribbean caves.
royal-gramma.funFact: Royal grammas often hang upside down under rock ledges.

longnose-butterflyfish.name: Longnose Butterflyfish
longnose-butterflyfish.description: Longnose Butterflyfish ist ein Tier. The longnose butterflyfish is a slender reef fish with a distinctive elongated snout and yellow body with a dark eye band.
longnose-butterflyfish.funFact: The longnose butterflyfish uses its elongated snout to reach into coral crevices for food.

copperband-butterflyfish.name: Copperband Butterflyfish
copperband-butterflyfish.description: Copperband Butterflyfish ist ein Tier. The copperband butterflyfish has a striking pattern of vertical orange bands with black edges on a silver-white body.
copperband-butterflyfish.funFact: Copperband butterflyfish have a false eye spot near their tail to confuse predators.

foureye-butterflyfish.name: Foureye Butterflyfish
foureye-butterflyfish.description: Foureye Butterflyfish ist ein Tier. The foureye butterflyfish gets its name from the prominent black eye spot on each side near its tail, confusing predators.
foureye-butterflyfish.funFact: Foureye butterflyfish have large eye spots that make predators think their tail is their head.

bluegill.name: Bluegill
bluegill.description: Bluegill ist ein Tier. The bluegill is a freshwater sunfish native to eastern North America. It has an olive-green body with a distinctive dark spot on the ear flap.
bluegill.funFact: Male bluegills build circular nests in shallow water and guard the eggs fiercely.

largemouth-bass.name: Largemouth Bass
largemouth-bass.description: Largemouth Bass ist ein Tier. The largemouth bass is the largest of the black basses and the most popular freshwater game fish in North America.
largemouth-bass.funFact: Largemouth bass can open their mouths wide enough to gulp down prey nearly half their size.

smallmouth-bass.name: Smallmouth Bass
smallmouth-bass.description: Smallmouth Bass ist ein Tier. The smallmouth bass is a freshwater fish prized by anglers for its aggressive fighting style.
smallmouth-bass.funFact: Smallmouth bass are known for their fighting ability and are called brownies or bronzebacks.

rainbow-trout.name: Rainbow Trout
rainbow-trout.description: Rainbow Trout ist ein Tier. The rainbow trout is a coldwater fish with an olive-green body and a distinctive pinkish-red stripe along its side.
rainbow-trout.funFact: Rainbow trout can change color intensity based on their environment and mood.

brook-trout.name: Brook Trout
brook-trout.description: Brook Trout ist ein Tier. The brook trout, also called speckled trout, has a dark green body with light spots and red spots with blue halos.
brook-trout.funFact: Brook trout are the only trout native to much of eastern North America.

atlantic-salmon.name: Atlantic Salmon
atlantic-salmon.description: Atlantic Salmon ist ein Tier. The Atlantic salmon is an anadromous fish born in freshwater, migrates to the ocean, and returns to freshwater to spawn.
atlantic-salmon.funFact: Atlantic salmon can jump waterfalls and dams during their upstream spawning migration.

chinook-salmon.name: Chinook Salmon
chinook-salmon.description: Chinook Salmon ist ein Tier. The Chinook salmon, also called king salmon, is the largest Pacific salmon with a greenish back and dark spots.
chinook-salmon.funFact: Chinook salmon are the largest of all Pacific salmon species.

coho-salmon.name: Coho Salmon
coho-salmon.description: Coho Salmon ist ein Tier. The coho salmon, also known as silver salmon, has a silver body with black spots and is found throughout the North Pacific.
coho-salmon.funFact: Coho salmon turn bright red with hooked jaws during spawning season.

pacific-bluefin-tuna.name: Pacific Bluefin Tuna
pacific-bluefin-tuna.description: Pacific Bluefin Tuna ist ein Tier. The Pacific bluefin tuna is a large, fast, pelagic fish found throughout the Pacific Ocean, highly prized in sushi markets.
pacific-bluefin-tuna.funFact: Pacific bluefin tuna can cross the entire Pacific Ocean in less than 60 days.

yellowfin-tuna.name: Yellowfin Tuna
yellowfin-tuna.description: Yellowfin Tuna ist ein Tier. The yellowfin tuna is a large, streamlined ocean fish with bright yellow dorsal and anal fins found in tropical oceans worldwide.
yellowfin-tuna.funFact: Yellowfin tuna can swim at speeds up to 40 miles per hour in short bursts.

atlantic-cod.name: Atlantic Cod
atlantic-cod.description: Atlantic Cod ist ein Tier. The Atlantic cod is a large, cold-water fish with a distinctive chin barbel and three dorsal fins, once one of the most important food fish in the world.
atlantic-cod.funFact: Atlantic cod can detect their prey using electroreception even in murky water.

atlantic-grouper.name: Atlantic Grouper
atlantic-grouper.description: Atlantic Grouper ist ein Tier. The Atlantic grouper is a large, robust reef fish with a wide mouth and thick lips found in warm Atlantic waters.
atlantic-grouper.funFact: Groupers can inhale prey whole by suddenly opening their massive mouths.

goliath-grouper.name: Goliath Grouper
goliath-grouper.description: Goliath Grouper ist ein Tier. The goliath grouper is the largest bony fish in the Western Atlantic, reaching weights of up to 800 pounds.
goliath-grouper.funFact: Goliath groupers are so large they can weigh as much as a small car.

red-snapper.name: Red Snapper
red-snapper.description: Red Snapper ist ein Tier. The red snapper is a bright red reef fish found in the Gulf of Mexico and western Atlantic.
red-snapper.funFact: Red snappers can live over 50 years, making them one of the longest-lived snapper species.

barracuda.name: Barracuda
barracuda.description: Barracuda ist ein Tier. The barracuda is a large, predatory fish with a long, streamlined body and razor-sharp teeth found in tropical oceans.
barracuda.funFact: Barracudas can swim at speeds over 30 miles per hour in short bursts.

mahi-mahi.name: Mahi-Mahi
mahi-mahi.description: Mahi-Mahi ist ein Tier. The mahi-mahi is a brightly colored pelagic fish with a golden-green body and blue fins found in tropical oceans.
mahi-mahi.funFact: Mahi-mahi are also called dorado or dolphinfish, not to be confused with dolphins.

wahoo.name: Wahoo
wahoo.description: Wahoo ist ein Tier. The wahoo is a large, fast pelagic fish related to mackerels with a sleek, torpedo-shaped body and vertical blue bars.
wahoo.funFact: Wahoo are among the fastest fish in the ocean, capable of reaching speeds up to 50 mph.

sailfish.name: Sailfish
sailfish.description: Sailfish ist ein Tier. The sailfish is a large billfish with a spectacular high dorsal fin resembling a sail, found in tropical oceans worldwide.
sailfish.funFact: Sailfish are considered the fastest fish in the ocean, reaching speeds up to 68 mph.

blue-marlin.name: Blue Marlin
blue-marlin.description: Blue Marlin ist ein Tier. The blue marlin is one of the largest ocean fish with a distinctive blue upper body and silver-white belly found in tropical Atlantic waters.
blue-marlin.funFact: Blue marlin can weigh over 1,000 pounds and are among the largest bony fish in the world.

nassau-grouper.name: Nassau Grouper
nassau-grouper.description: Nassau Grouper ist ein Tier. The Nassau grouper is a large reef fish capable of rapid color changes, now critically endangered from overfishing.
nassau-grouper.funFact: Nassau grouper can change color in seconds to match their surroundings.

striped-bass.name: Striped Bass
striped-bass.description: Striped Bass ist ein Tier. The striped bass is a silver fish with distinctive horizontal dark stripes found along the Atlantic coast.
striped-bass.funFact: Striped bass are anadromous and can travel hundreds of miles to spawn.

red-drum.name: Red Drum
red-drum.description: Red Drum ist ein Tier. The red drum, also called redfish, is a copper-bronze fish with a distinctive black spot near the tail.
red-drum.funFact: Red drum are also called channel bass and are the official state fish of North Carolina.

black-drum.name: Black Drum
black-drum.description: Black Drum ist ein Tier. The black drum is a large, dark fish with barbels on its chin that can grow to over 100 pounds.
black-drum.funFact: Black drum can produce loud drumming sounds using muscles on their swim bladder.

channel-catfish.name: Channel Catfish
channel-catfish.description: Channel Catfish ist ein Tier. The channel catfish is the most fished catfish species in North America with a forked tail and whisker-like barbels.
channel-catfish.funFact: Channel catfish have taste buds covering their entire body and can taste food from far away.

blue-catfish.name: Blue Catfish
blue-catfish.description: Blue Catfish ist ein Tier. The blue catfish is the largest species of North American catfish reaching weights of over 100 pounds.
blue-catfish.funFact: Blue catfish can grow over 100 pounds and are the largest freshwater fish in North America.

walking-catfish.name: Walking Catfish
walking-catfish.description: Walking Catfish ist ein Tier. The walking catfish is a freshwater catfish native to Southeast Asia that can breathe air and move across land.
walking-catfish.funFact: Walking catfish can survive out of water for hours and use their pectoral fins to walk on land.

wels-catfish.name: Wels Catfish
wels-catfish.description: Wels Catfish ist ein Tier. The wels catfish is the largest freshwater fish in Europe reaching lengths of over 16 feet with a wide, flat head.
wels-catfish.funFact: Wels catfish have been reported to grow over 16 feet long in rare cases.

eurasian-pike.name: Eurasian Pike
eurasian-pike.description: Eurasian Pike ist ein Tier. The Eurasian pike is a large, ambush predator found throughout Europe, Asia, and northern North America.
eurasian-pike.funFact: Eurasian pike can accelerate from a standstill to 20 mph in less than a tenth of a second.

muskellunge.name: Muskellunge
muskellunge.description: Muskellunge ist ein Tier. The muskellunge, or muskie, is the largest freshwater fish in the pike family found in clear lakes and rivers of North America.
muskellunge.funFact: Muskellunge are also called muskies and are the largest member of the pike family.

walleye.name: Walleye
walleye.description: Walleye ist ein Tier. The walleye is a freshwater fish named for its distinctive, glassy eyes that reflect light found in cool, clear lakes.
walleye.funFact: Walleye have a light-reflecting layer called the tapetum lucidum that makes their eyes glow at night.

common-carp.name: Common Carp
common-carp.description: Common Carp ist ein Tier. The common carp is a large, golden-brown freshwater fish found throughout the world, originally from Eurasia.
common-carp.funFact: Common carp are considered one of the most influential invasive fish species in the world.

grass-carp.name: Grass Carp
grass-carp.description: Grass Carp ist ein Tier. The grass carp is a large freshwater fish native to eastern Asia that feeds almost exclusively on aquatic plants.
grass-carp.funFact: Grass carp can eat up to 40% of their body weight in vegetation each day.

koi-carp.name: Koi
koi-carp.description: Koi ist ein Tier. Koi are ornamental varieties of common carp bred for their vibrant colors and patterns from Japan.
koi-carp.funFact: The most expensive koi ever sold was a Japanese fish named S Legend that sold for $1.8 million.

goldfish.name: Goldfish
goldfish.description: Goldfish ist ein Tier. The goldfish is one of the most popular aquarium fish in the world, domesticated from East Asia over 1,000 years ago.
goldfish.funFact: Goldfish can recognize their owners and can be trained to push levers for food.

tench.name: Tench
tench.description: Tench ist ein Tier. The tench is a freshwater fish with a thick, slimy body and olive-green to bronze coloration found throughout Europe and Asia.
tench.funFact: Tench secrete a mucus that can heal wounds in other fish.

three-spined-stickleback.name: Three-spined Stickleback
three-spined-stickleback.description: Three-spined Stickleback ist ein Tier. The three-spined stickleback is a small, spiny fish found throughout the Northern Hemisphere, males build intricate nests.
three-spined-stickleback.funFact: Male sticklebacks build elaborate nests from water plants and fan the eggs to provide oxygen.

florida-gar.name: Florida Gar
florida-gar.description: Florida Gar ist ein Tier. The Florida gar is a long, slender predatory fish with an elongated snout and armored scales found in Florida and Georgia.
florida-gar.funFact: Florida gar have an elongated snout filled with needle-like teeth and can breathe air.

alligator-gar.name: Alligator Gar
alligator-gar.description: Alligator Gar ist ein Tier. The alligator gar is the largest freshwater fish in North America, reaching over 8 feet long with a long, alligator-like snout.
alligator-gar.funFact: Alligator gar eggs are toxic to humans but consumed by Native Americans after processing.

bowfin.name: Bowfin
bowfin.description: Bowfin ist ein Tier. The bowfin is a primitive freshwater fish with an elongated body and a distinctive long dorsal fin found in eastern North America.
bowfin.funFact: Bowfin are the only surviving member of an ancient order of fish.

chinese-sturgeon.name: Chinese Sturgeon
chinese-sturgeon.description: Chinese Sturgeon ist ein Tier. The Chinese sturgeon is a critically endangered species found only in the Yangtze River that can grow to over 16 feet.
chinese-sturgeon.funFact: Chinese sturgeon have existed for over 140 million years and are called living fossils.

atlantic-sturgeon.name: Atlantic Sturgeon
atlantic-sturgeon.description: Atlantic Sturgeon ist ein Tier. The Atlantic sturgeon is a large, primitive fish with a prehistoric appearance featuring bony plates instead of scales.
atlantic-sturgeon.funFact: Atlantic sturgeon can live over 100 years and were once hunted for their caviar.

arctic-char.name: Arctic Char
arctic-char.description: Arctic Char ist ein Tier. The Arctic char is a cold-water fish related to salmon and trout found in Arctic and subarctic waters.
arctic-char.funFact: Arctic char are the most northerly freshwater fish in the world.

lake-trout.name: Lake Trout
lake-trout.description: Lake Trout ist ein Tier. The lake trout is a large, cold-water salmonid found in deep lakes of northern North America with a forked tail.
lake-trout.funFact: Lake trout can live over 40 years and grow to over 60 pounds.

cutthroat-trout.name: Cutthroat Trout
cutthroat-trout.description: Cutthroat Trout ist ein Tier. The cutthroat trout is a cold-water fish native to western North America, named for red-orange slash marks under its lower jaw.
cutthroat-trout.funFact: Cutthroat trout are named for the distinctive red slash under their jaw.

golden-trout.name: Golden Trout
golden-trout.description: Golden Trout ist ein Tier. The golden trout is a subspecies of rainbow trout found in high-altitude mountain streams of California with golden-yellow body.
golden-trout.funFact: Golden trout are the official state fish of California and are found only in a few remote streams.

oceanic-whitetip-shark.name: Oceanic Whitetip Shark
oceanic-whitetip-shark.description: Oceanic Whitetip Shark ist ein Tier. The oceanic whitetip shark is a large, slow-moving pelagic shark with distinctive white-tipped fins, critically endangered.
oceanic-whitetip-shark.funFact: Oceanic whitetip sharks were responsible for more human casualties than any other species during World War II.

blacktip-shark.name: Blacktip Shark
blacktip-shark.description: Blacktip Shark ist ein Tier. The blacktip shark is a medium-sized shark with distinctive black tips on all its fins found in warm coastal waters.
blacktip-shark.funFact: Blacktip sharks are known for their dramatic breaching behavior, spinning out of the water.

scalloped-hammerhead.name: Scalloped Hammerhead
scalloped-hammerhead.description: Scalloped Hammerhead ist ein Tier. The scalloped hammerhead is one of the most common hammerhead species with a distinctive scalloped leading edge on its head.
scalloped-hammerhead.funFact: Scalloped hammerheads form massive schools of hundreds during their annual migration.

thresher-shark.name: Thresher Shark
thresher-shark.description: Thresher Shark ist ein Tier. The thresher shark is a distinctive shark with an extremely long upper tail that can be as long as its body found in open ocean.
thresher-shark.funFact: Thresher sharks use their extremely long tail whip to stun schools of fish.

basking-shark.name: Basking Shark
basking-shark.description: Basking Shark ist ein Tier. The basking shark is the second largest fish in the world, filter-feeding on plankton with an enormous mouth over 3 feet wide.
basking-shark.funFact: Basking sharks are the second largest fish in the world, after whale sharks.

nurse-shark.name: Nurse Shark
nurse-shark.description: Nurse Shark ist ein Tier. The nurse shark is a sluggish, bottom-dwelling shark with barbels near its nostrils that help detect prey hidden in sand.
nurse-shark.funFact: Nurse sharks can pump water over their gills while resting on the ocean floor.

zebra-shark.name: Zebra Shark
zebra-shark.description: Zebra Shark ist ein Tier. The zebra shark is a distinctive shark with dark spots on a tan body found on tropical coral reefs of the Indo-Pacific.
zebra-shark.funFact: Zebra sharks change from striped as juveniles to spotted as adults.

epaulette-shark.name: Epaulette Shark
epaulette-shark.description: Epaulette Shark ist ein Tier. The epaulette shark is a small reef shark that can walk on its fins across the reef flat found in the Indo-Pacific.
epaulette-shark.funFact: Epaulette sharks can walk on their fins across the reef flat at low tide.

angel-shark.name: Angel Shark
angel-shark.description: Angel Shark ist ein Tier. The angel shark is a flattened shark that lies buried in sand on the ocean floor, critically endangered due to habitat loss.
angel-shark.funFact: Angel sharks can bury themselves completely in sand to ambush passing prey.

southern-stingray.name: Southern Stingray
southern-stingray.description: Southern Stingray ist ein Tier. The southern stingray is a large, diamond-shaped ray found in shallow tropical waters of the western Atlantic.
southern-stingray.funFact: Southern stingrays can deliver a venomous barb sting that can cause severe pain.

cownose-ray.name: Cownose Ray
cownose-ray.description: Cownose Ray ist ein Tier. The cownose ray is a distinctive ray with a unique head shape resembling a cow's nose, forming large schools during migration.
cownose-ray.funFact: Cownose rays migrate in massive schools of thousands along the Atlantic coast.

eagle-ray.name: Spotted Eagle Ray
eagle-ray.description: Spotted Eagle Ray ist ein Tier. The spotted eagle ray is a large ray with distinctive white spots on a dark body found in tropical and subtropical oceans.
eagle-ray.funFact: Spotted eagle rays can leap several feet out of the water.

viperfish.name: Viperfish
viperfish.description: Viperfish ist ein Tier. The viperfish is a deep-sea predator with extremely long, needle-like teeth and a bioluminescent photophore along its body.
viperfish.funFact: Viperfish have extremely long, needle-like teeth that are so long they don't fit inside their mouths.

gulper-eel.name: Gulper Eel
gulper-eel.description: Gulper Eel ist ein Tier. The gulper eel is a deep-sea fish with an enormous, loosely hinged mouth and a long, whip-like tail found in deep ocean waters.
gulper-eel.funFact: Gulper eels have enormous mouths that can open wide enough to swallow prey larger than themselves.

lungfish.name: Lungfish
lungfish.description: Lungfish ist ein Tier. The lungfish is a freshwater fish with both gills and primitive lungs, one of the closest living relatives to tetrapods found in Africa, South America, and Australia.
lungfish.funFact: Lungfish can breathe air and survive out of water for months by burrowing into mud.

coelacanth.name: Coelacanth
coelacanth.description: Coelacanth ist ein Tier. The coelacanth is a living fossil, a lobe-finned fish once thought extinct that was rediscovered off the coast of South Africa in 1938.
coelacanth.funFact: Coelacanths were thought to be extinct for 66 million years until rediscovered in 1938.

red-bellied-piranha.name: Red-bellied Piranha
red-bellied-piranha.description: Red-bellied Piranha ist ein Tier. The red-bellied piranha is a freshwater fish native to South America known for its sharp teeth and powerful jaws found in rivers and lakes.
red-bellied-piranha.funFact: Red-bellied piranhas can strip a carcass to bone in minutes with their razor-sharp teeth.

arapaima.name: Arapaima
arapaima.description: Arapaima ist ein Tier. The arapaima is one of the largest freshwater fish in the world, reaching lengths of over 10 feet, found in the Amazon basin.
arapaima.funFact: Arapaima are among the largest freshwater fish in the world and can breathe air.

arowana.name: Arowana
arowana.description: Arowana ist ein Tier. The arowana is a freshwater fish with large, metallic scales and an upward-pointing mouth found in tropical rivers of South America, Asia, and Australia.
arowana.funFact: Arowana can jump up to 6 feet out of the water to catch prey on overhanging branches.

knifefish.name: Black Ghost Knifefish
knifefish.description: Black Ghost Knifefish ist ein Tier. The black ghost knifefish is a freshwater fish with an elongated, laterally compressed body and a distinctive anal fin used for propulsion.
knifefish.funFact: Black ghost knifefish use weak electric fields to navigate and find prey in dark, murky water.

betta.name: Betta
betta.description: Betta ist ein Tier. The betta, or Siamese fighting fish, is a small freshwater fish with flowing fins and vibrant colors native to Southeast Asia.
betta.funFact: Male bettas build bubble nests at the water surface for their eggs.

discus.name: Discus
discus.description: Discus ist ein Tier. The discus is a freshwater fish with a distinctive disc-shaped body found in the Amazon basin, popular in aquariums for its vibrant colors.
discus.funFact: Discus parents produce a mucus secretion that their young feed on for the first few weeks.

oscarr.name: Oscar
oscarr.description: Oscar ist ein Tier. The oscar is a large cichlid native to South America with a dark body and orange-red markings, popular in aquariums for its personality.
oscarr.funFact: Oscars are highly intelligent fish that can recognize their owners.

angelfish-freshwater.name: Freshwater Angelfish
angelfish-freshwater.description: Freshwater Angelfish ist ein Tier. The freshwater angelfish is a popular aquarium fish with a distinctive triangular body shape and long, flowing fins native to the Amazon basin.
angelfish-freshwater.funFact: Freshwater angelfish are actually cichlids, not related to marine angelfish.

convict-cichlid.name: Convict Cichlid
convict-cichlid.description: Convict Cichlid ist ein Tier. The convict cichlid is a small freshwater fish with distinctive black vertical stripes on a light body found in Central America.
convict-cichlid.funFact: Convict cichlids are devoted parents that aggressively defend their young.

peacock-cichlid.name: Peacock Cichlid
peacock-cichlid.description: Peacock Cichlid ist ein Tier. The peacock cichlid is a colorful freshwater fish found in Lake Malawi with males displaying vibrant blues, reds, and golds.
peacock-cichlid.funFact: Male peacock cichlids display brilliant blue, red, and gold colors during breeding.

lionfish.name: Lionfish
lionfish.description: Lionfish ist ein Tier. The lionfish is a venomous marine fish with distinctive red, white, and brown stripes and fan-like pectoral fins found in tropical reefs.
lionfish.funFact: Lionfish venomous spines can cause extreme pain and their venom is heat-stable.

stonefish.name: Stonefish
stonefish.description: Stonefish ist ein Tier. The stonefish is the most venomous fish in the world, masters of camouflage resembling rocks on the ocean floor found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.
stonefish.funFact: Stonefish are the most venomous fish in the world, their sting can be fatal to humans.

leafy-seadragon.name: Leafy Seadragon
leafy-seadragon.description: Leafy Seadragon ist ein Tier. The leafy seadragon is a marine fish related to seahorses with leaf-like appendages providing perfect camouflage in kelp forests.
leafy-seadragon.funFact: Leafy seadragons have no stomach or teeth and must eat almost constantly.

weedy-seadragon.name: Weedy Seadragon
weedy-seadragon.description: Weedy Seadragon ist ein Tier. The weedy seadragon is a marine fish related to seahorses with small leaf-like appendages found in kelp forests of southern Australia.
weedy-seadragon.funFact: Weedy seadragons carry their eggs on the male's tail until they hatch.

boxfish.name: Yellow Boxfish
boxfish.description: Yellow Boxfish ist ein Tier. The yellow boxfish is a small, cube-shaped reef fish with bright yellow coloration and black spots found in the Indo-Pacific.
boxfish.funFact: Boxfish can release a toxin when stressed that can kill other fish in an aquarium.

cowfish.name: Longhorn Cowfish
cowfish.description: Longhorn Cowfish ist ein Tier. The longhorn cowfish is a distinctive reef fish with horn-like spines on its head and a boxy, armored body found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.
cowfish.funFact: Longhorn cowfish have two horn-like spines protruding from their head.

trunkfish.name: Spotted Trunkfish
trunkfish.description: Spotted Trunkfish ist ein Tier. The spotted trunkfish is a small, box-shaped reef fish with white spots on a dark body found in Caribbean coral reefs.
trunkfish.funFact: Trunkfish can squirt a toxic substance from their skin when threatened.

filefish.name: Scrawled Filefish
filefish.description: Scrawled Filefish ist ein Tier. The scrawled filefish is a marine fish with a distinctive elongated body and blue spots found in tropical Atlantic waters.
filefish.funFact: Filefish can change color and pattern to match their surroundings.

triggerfish.name: Queen Triggerfish
triggerfish.description: Queen Triggerfish ist ein Tier. The queen triggerfish is a large, colorful reef fish with distinctive blue lines on its face and a trigger spine on its dorsal fin.
triggerfish.funFact: Triggerfish have a spine on their dorsal fin that can be locked in an upright position.

leatherjacket.name: Slender Leatherjacket
