leatherjacket.description: Slender Leatherjacket ist ein Tier. The slender leatherjacket is a small marine fish with a compressed body and rough skin found in coastal waters worldwide.
leatherjacket.funFact: Leatherjackets have rough, sandpaper-like skin used by early settlers as sandpaper.

parrotfish.name: Stoplight Parrotfish
parrotfish.description: Stoplight Parrotfish ist ein Tier. The stoplight parrotfish is a colorful reef fish with a beak-like mouth used to scrape algae from coral found in Caribbean reefs.
parrotfish.funFact: Parrotfish excrete digested coral as fine white sand, creating tropical beaches.

wrasse.name: Cleaner Wrasse
wrasse.description: Cleaner Wrasse ist ein Tier. The cleaner wrasse is a small reef fish with a distinctive blue stripe that sets up cleaning stations to remove parasites from larger fish.
wrasse.funFact: Cleaner wrasses set up cleaning stations where larger fish line up to have parasites removed.

tuskfish.name: Ornate Tuskfish
tuskfish.description: Ornate Tuskfish ist ein Tier. The ornate tuskfish is a colorful reef fish with distinctive blue and orange markings found in the Indo-Pacific.
tuskfish.funFact: Tuskfish use rocks as anvils to crack open shellfish for food.

grouper-marbled.name: Marbled Grouper
grouper-marbled.description: Marbled Grouper ist ein Tier. The marbled grouper is a large reef fish with a marbled pattern found in tropical Indo-Pacific coral reefs.
grouper-marbled.funFact: Marbled groupers form massive spawning aggregations of thousands of individuals.

wrasse-humphead.name: Humphead Wrasse
wrasse-humphead.description: Humphead Wrasse ist ein Tier. The humphead wrasse is the largest living wrasse species with a distinctive hump on its forehead found in Indo-Pacific coral reefs.
wrasse-humphead.funFact: Humphead wrasses can live over 30 years and are the largest living labrid fish.

coral-grouper.name: Coral Grouper
coral-grouper.description: Coral Grouper ist ein Tier. The coral grouper is a large reef fish with a reddish body and blue spots found in tropical Indo-Pacific coral reefs.
coral-grouper.funFact: Coral groupers hunt cooperatively with moray eels, using head shakes to signal the eel to flush out prey.

cardinalfish.name: Banggai Cardinalfish
cardinalfish.description: Banggai Cardinalfish ist ein Tier. The Banggai cardinalfish is a small, striking reef fish with black and white stripes and long fins found only in the Banggai Islands of Indonesia.
cardinalfish.funFact: Male Banggai cardinalfish mouthbrood the eggs until they hatch.

damselfish.name: Garibaldi Damselfish
damselfish.description: Garibaldi Damselfish ist ein Tier. The garibaldi is a bright orange damselfish found in kelp forests of the eastern Pacific, the official marine fish of California.
damselfish.funFact: Male garibaldi build and tend elaborate nests of algae to attract mates.

sergeant-major.name: Sergeant Major
sergeant-major.description: Sergeant Major ist ein Tier. The sergeant major is a small reef fish with five black vertical bars on a light body found in tropical Atlantic waters.
sergeant-major.funFact: Male sergeant majors turn dark purple when guarding their eggs.

goby.name: Neon Goby
goby.description: Neon Goby ist ein Tier. The neon goby is a tiny reef fish with a bright blue stripe that sets up cleaning stations to remove parasites from larger fish.
goby.funFact: Neon gobies set up cleaning stations and remove parasites from larger fish.

blenny.name: Midas Blenny
blenny.description: Midas Blenny ist ein Tier. The Midas blenny is a small, golden-yellow reef fish that mimics cleaner wrasses for protection found in Indo-Pacific coral reefs.
blenny.funFact: Midas blennies often join schools of cleaner wrasses to avoid predation.

scorpionfish.name: Tasseled Scorpionfish
scorpionfish.description: Tasseled Scorpionfish ist ein Tier. The tasseled scorpionfish is a venomous reef fish with elaborate skin flaps providing excellent camouflage found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.
scorpionfish.funFact: Scorpionfish are masters of camouflage, resembling algae-covered rocks on the reef.

flathead.name: Bartail Flathead
flathead.description: Bartail Flathead ist ein Tier. The bartail flathead is a bottom-dwelling marine fish with a flattened head and body found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.
flathead.funFact: Flathead are ambush predators that bury themselves in sand to surprise prey.

grunt.name: Blue-striped Grunt
grunt.description: Blue-striped Grunt ist ein Tier. The blue-striped grunt is a small reef fish with distinctive blue horizontal stripes found in Caribbean coral reefs.
grunt.funFact: Grunts get their name from the sound they make by grinding their teeth.

tang.name: Clown Tang
tang.description: Clown Tang ist ein Tier. The clown tang is a bright blue surgeonfish with white and black markings found in coral reefs of the Indo-Pacific.
tang.funFact: Clown tangs are extremely territorial and can be aggressive toward other fish.

squirrelfish.name: Squirrelfish
squirrelfish.description: Squirrelfish ist ein Tier. The squirrelfish is a small, red reef fish with large eyes found in tropical coral reefs worldwide, active at night.
squirrelfish.funFact: Squirrelfish have large eyes adapted for nocturnal hunting.

sweep.name: Sweep
sweep.description: Sweep ist ein Tier. The sweep is a small, silvery fish with a distinctive deep body found in temperate rocky reefs of the Indo-Pacific.
sweep.funFact: Sweep are named for their distinctive sweeping swimming motion.

leatherjacket-freshwater.name: New Zealand Magpie
leatherjacket-freshwater.description: New Zealand Magpie ist ein Tier. The New Zealand magpie is a small freshwater fish with a compressed body and rough skin found in rivers and lakes of New Zealand.
leatherjacket-freshwater.funFact: New Zealand magpie are freshwater leatherjackets found only in New Zealand.

john-dory.name: John Dory
john-dory.description: John Dory ist ein Tier. The John Dory is a marine fish with a distinctive oval body and dark lateral spot found in temperate coastal waters of the Indo-Pacific.
john-dory.funFact: John Dory have a distinctive dark spot on each side that looks like a thumbprint.

boarfish.name: Longsnout Boarfish
boarfish.description: Longsnout Boarfish ist ein Tier. The longsnout boarfish is a distinctive reef fish with a long, tubular snout and black and white stripes found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.
boarfish.funFact: Boarfish use their elongated snout to extract small invertebrates from coral crevices.

bigeye.name: Bigeye
bigeye.description: Bigeye ist ein Tier. The bigeye is a small reef fish with disproportionately large eyes found in tropical coral reefs worldwide, active at night.
bigeye.funFact: Bigeyes have extremely large eyes adapted for nocturnal feeding.

soldierfish.name: Blackbar Soldierfish
soldierfish.description: Blackbar Soldierfish ist ein Tier. The blackbar soldierfish is a small, red reef fish with a distinctive black bar behind its gill cover found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.
soldierfish.funFact: Soldierfish are nocturnal and hide in reef crevices during the day.

green-anole.name: Green Anole
green-anole.description: Green Anole ist ein Tier. The green anole is a small arboreal lizard native to the southeastern United States. Often called the American chameleon, it can shift its skin color between green and brown. Males display a pinkish-red dewlap under their throat during courtship or territorial displays.
green-anole.funFact: Green anoles can change color from bright green to brown based on mood, temperature, or social signals.

saltwater-crocodile.name: Saltwater Crocodile
saltwater-crocodile.description: Saltwater Crocodile ist ein Tier. The saltwater crocodile is the largest living reptile and has the strongest bite force ever measured. Found in coastal regions from eastern India to Australia, it is an opportunistic apex predator. Adults can survive in both saltwater and freshwater environments.
saltwater-crocodile.funFact: Saltwater crocodiles have the strongest bite force of any living animal, estimated at over 3700 psi.

reticulated-python.name: Reticulated Python
reticulated-python.description: Reticulated Python ist ein Tier. The reticulated python is a non-venomous constrictor and the longest snake in the world. Native to Southeast Asia, it is found in rainforests, rivers, and even near human settlements. It kills prey by constriction and can swallow animals much larger than its head.
reticulated-python.funFact: The reticulated python is the longest snake in the world, with some individuals exceeding 23 feet.

panther-chameleon.name: Panther Chameleon
panther-chameleon.description: Panther Chameleon ist ein Tier. The panther chameleon is a vibrant species native to Madagascar's tropical rainforests. Males display vivid colors ranging from blue, green, and yellow to red. They use their long, sticky tongues to catch insects with remarkable accuracy.
panther-chameleon.funFact: Chameleons change color primarily for communication and temperature regulation, not camouflage.

american-alligator.name: American Alligator
american-alligator.description: American Alligator ist ein Tier. The American alligator is a large crocodilian native to the southeastern United States. Once endangered, it has made a remarkable recovery through conservation efforts. It inhabits freshwater environments and is an opportunistic predator of fish, birds, and mammals.
american-alligator.funFact: American alligators can regulate their body temperature by opening their mouths to cool down, known as gaping.

leopard-gecko.name: Leopard Gecko
leopard-gecko.description: Leopard Gecko ist ein Tier. The leopard gecko is a small, nocturnal lizard native to the rocky deserts and grasslands of South Asia. Unlike many geckos, it has movable eyelids and can blink. It is one of the most popular pet reptiles due to its docile temperament.
leopard-gecko.funFact: Leopard geckos can store fat in their tails, which can detach if grabbed by a predator and later regrow.

eastern-diamondback-rattlesnake.name: Eastern Diamondback Rattlesnake
eastern-diamondback-rattlesnake.description: Eastern Diamondback Rattlesnake ist ein Tier. The eastern diamondback rattlesnake is the largest venomous snake in North America. Found in the coastal scrublands and pine flatwoods of the southeastern United States, it uses its diamond-shaped dorsal pattern as camouflage. Its rattle serves as an auditory warning to potential threats.
eastern-diamondback-rattlesnake.funFact: The eastern diamondback rattlesnake's rattle can vibrate up to 50 times per second as a warning signal.

gila-monster.name: Gila Monster
gila-monster.description: Gila Monster ist ein Tier. The Gila monster is one of only a few venomous lizards in the world, native to the deserts of the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico. It has a stout body with bead-like scales in black and pink, orange, or yellow patterns. It spends most of its life underground.
gila-monster.funFact: The Gila monster's venom contains a compound used in a drug to treat type 2 diabetes.

leatherback-sea-turtle.name: Leatherback Sea Turtle
leatherback-sea-turtle.description: Leatherback Sea Turtle ist ein Tier. The leatherback sea turtle is the largest living turtle and the fourth heaviest reptile. Unlike other sea turtles, it has a flexible, leathery carapace instead of a hard shell. It dives to depths exceeding 3,000 feet and feeds almost exclusively on jellyfish.
leatherback-sea-turtle.funFact: Leatherback sea turtles are the largest turtles in the world and have existed for over 100 million years.

boomslang.name: Boomslang
boomslang.description: Boomslang ist ein Tier. The boomslang is a highly venomous rear-fanged snake native to sub-Saharan Africa. Males are typically bright green while females are brown. It is arboreal, spending most of its time in trees, and feeds on birds, chameleons, and small mammals.
boomslang.funFact: Boomslang venom prevents blood clotting, causing victims to bleed from every orifice.

indian-cobra.name: Indian Cobra
indian-cobra.description: Indian Cobra ist ein Tier. The Indian cobra is one of the 'big four' venomous snakes responsible for the most snakebite deaths in India. It is iconic for its hood, which it displays when threatened. It is found across the Indian subcontinent in a variety of habitats.
indian-cobra.funFact: The Indian cobra's iconic hood markings are thought to resemble eyes, deterring predators from attacking from behind.

rhinoceros-iguana.name: Rhinoceros Iguana
rhinoceros-iguana.description: Rhinoceros Iguana ist ein Tier. The rhinoceros iguana is a large, heavy-bodied lizard endemic to the Caribbean island of Hispaniola. It is named for the bony, horn-like outgrowths on its snout. It inhabits dry, rocky areas and feeds on leaves, flowers, and fruit.
rhinoceros-iguana.funFact: Rhinoceros iguanas get their name from the horn-like scales on their snouts, which resemble rhinoceros horns.

emerald-tree-boa.name: Emerald Tree Boa
emerald-tree-boa.description: Emerald Tree Boa ist ein Tier. The emerald tree boa is a bright green, non-venomous constrictor native to the rainforests of South America. It spends almost its entire life coiled on branches, waiting to ambush birds and small mammals. Its white markings along the spine help break up its silhouette.
emerald-tree-boa.funFact: Emerald tree boas have heat-sensing pits along their lips to detect warm-blooded prey in the dark.

gharial.name: Gharial
gharial.description: Gharial ist ein Tier. The gharial is a critically endangered crocodilian with a distinctive long, thin snout adapted for catching fish. Once found across the Indian subcontinent, it is now restricted to a few rivers in India and Nepal. It is one of the largest crocodilian species.
gharial.funFact: Gharials have the longest and thinnest snouts of any crocodilian, perfectly shaped for catching fish.

mexican-beaded-lizard.name: Mexican Beaded Lizard
mexican-beaded-lizard.description: Mexican Beaded Lizard ist ein Tier. The Mexican beaded lizard is a large, venomous lizard found in the dry forests and thorn scrub of Mexico and Guatemala. It has black skin with yellow or pinkish banding and bead-like scales. It is nocturnal and spends most of its time in burrows.
mexican-beaded-lizard.funFact: The Mexican beaded lizard is one of only a few venomous lizards and can deliver a painful, though rarely fatal, bite.

desert-tortoise.name: Desert Tortoise
desert-tortoise.description: Desert Tortoise ist ein Tier. The desert tortoise is a species of tortoise native to the Mojave and Sonoran Deserts. It spends up to 95% of its life underground in burrows that can be over 30 feet long. It is well adapted to extreme heat and arid conditions.
desert-tortoise.funFact: Desert tortoises can store over a liter of water in their bladders and reabsorb it during droughts.

tokay-gecko.name: Tokay Gecko
tokay-gecko.description: Tokay Gecko ist ein Tier. The tokay gecko is a large gecko native to Southeast Asia, known for its loud, distinctive call. Males are territorial and aggressive, often found on walls and ceilings of buildings. It is widely used in traditional medicine in some Asian cultures.
tokay-gecko.funFact: Tokay geckos can produce one of the loudest calls of any gecko, heard up to a mile away.

king-snake.name: Eastern King Snake
king-snake.description: Eastern King Snake ist ein Tier. The eastern king snake is a powerful, non-venomous constrictor found across the eastern United States. It has a distinctive chain-link pattern of white or yellow bands on a dark background. It is immune to the venom of many pit vipers.
king-snake.funFact: King snakes are called 'kings' because they regularly eat other snakes, including venomous rattlesnakes.

blue-tongued-skink.name: Blue-Tongued Skink
blue-tongued-skink.description: Blue-Tongued Skink ist ein Tier. The blue-tongued skink is a group of lizards native to Australia, Tasmania, and New Guinea. They are known for their distinctive blue tongues, which they display as a defense mechanism. They are omnivorous, eating insects, snails, and vegetation.
blue-tongued-skink.funFact: Blue-tongued skinks flash their bright blue tongues to startle predators into backing away.

american-crocodile.name: American Crocodile
american-crocodile.description: American Crocodile ist ein Tier. The American crocodile is found in the coastal regions of the Americas, from southern Florida to northern South America. It is less aggressive than the saltwater crocodile and prefers brackish and saltwater habitats. It is lighter in color than most crocodiles.
american-crocodile.funFact: American crocodiles are more tolerant of saltwater than alligators, which is why they are found in coastal habitats.

asian-water-monitor.name: Asian Water Monitor
asian-water-monitor.description: Asian Water Monitor ist ein Tier. The Asian water monitor is a large lizard native to Southeast Asia, commonly found near water. It is an opportunistic carnivore feeding on fish, frogs, birds, and carrion. It is one of the most common monitor lizards in the world.
asian-water-monitor.funFact: Asian water monitors are excellent swimmers and can hold their breath for up to 30 minutes.

eastern-hognose-snake.name: Eastern Hognose Snake
eastern-hognose-snake.description: Eastern Hognose Snake ist ein Tier. The eastern hognose snake is a non-venomous colubrid found across eastern North America. It has an upturned snout used for burrowing. When threatened, it may flatten its neck like a cobra or play dead with theatrical drama.
eastern-hognose-snake.funFact: Hognose snakes are famous for playing dead when threatened, rolling onto their backs with their mouths open.

sailfin-lizard.name: Sailfin Lizard
sailfin-lizard.description: Sailfin Lizard ist ein Tier. The sailfin lizard is a semi-aquatic agamid lizard found in the Philippines and Indonesia. Males have large dorsal crests that resemble sails. They are often found near water and can run bipedally across water surfaces when startled.
sailfin-lizard.funFact: Sailfin lizards can run across the surface of water for short distances using their flattened, fringed toes.

texas-rat-snake.name: Texas Rat Snake
texas-rat-snake.description: Texas Rat Snake ist ein Tier. The Texas rat snake is a large, non-venomous colubrid native to Texas and the south-central United States. It is a powerful constrictor that feeds primarily on rodents. It is highly adaptable and found in a wide range of habitats.
texas-rat-snake.funFact: Texas rat snakes are excellent climbers and have been found in trees more than 40 feet high.

gopher-tortoise.name: Gopher Tortoise
gopher-tortoise.description: Gopher Tortoise ist ein Tier. The gopher tortoise is a keystone species of the southeastern United States, known for digging extensive burrows. These burrows provide critical shelter for over 350 other species, including the eastern indigo snake. It is a slow-moving herbivore.
gopher-tortoise.funFact: Gopher tortoise burrows can be over 40 feet long and provide shelter for more than 350 other species.

bush-viper.name: Bush Viper
bush-viper.description: Bush Viper ist ein Tier. The bush viper is a venomous, arboreal viper found in the tropical rainforests of equatorial Africa. It has distinctive leaf-shaped, keeled scales in various colors. It is nocturnal and uses its prehensile tail to hang from branches while hunting.
bush-viper.funFact: Bush vipers have keeled, leaf-like scales that give them a spiky, dragon-like appearance unique among snakes.

pancake-tortoise.name: Pancake Tortoise
pancake-tortoise.description: Pancake Tortoise ist ein Tier. The pancake tortoise is a critically endangered species with a uniquely flat, flexible shell. Found in the rocky outcrops of East Africa, it wedges itself into crevices when threatened. It is one of the fastest tortoise species relative to its size.
pancake-tortoise.funFact: Pancake tortoises have flat, flexible shells that allow them to wedge themselves into rock crevices to escape predators.

cottonmouth.name: Cottonmouth
cottonmouth.description: Cottonmouth ist ein Tier. The cottonmouth, or water moccasin, is a venomous pit viper found in the wetlands of the southeastern United States. It is the only venomous water snake in North America. It is often found swimming with its head above water.
cottonmouth.funFact: Cottonmouths get their name from the white, cotton-like lining of their mouth, which they display as a warning.

cuban-crocodile.name: Cuban Crocodile
cuban-crocodile.description: Cuban Crocodile ist ein Tier. The Cuban crocodile is a critically endangered species found only in the Zapata Swamp and Isle of Youth in Cuba. It is highly aggressive and more terrestrial than other crocodiles. It can gallop on land and is known for its distinctive horned ridges.
cuban-crocodile.funFact: Cuban crocodiles are the most terrestrial of the New World crocodiles and can gallop like a horse.

yellow-bellied-slider.name: Yellow-Bellied Slider
yellow-bellied-slider.description: Yellow-Bellied Slider ist ein Tier. The yellow-bellied slider is a semi-aquatic turtle native to the southeastern United States. It has a dark shell with yellow stripes and a distinctive yellow patch on its plastron. It is one of the most common turtle species in pet trade.
yellow-bellied-slider.funFact: Yellow-bellied sliders can bask on logs for hours, using the sun to regulate their body temperature and digest food.

western-diamondback-rattlesnake.name: Western Diamondback Rattlesnake
western-diamondback-rattlesnake.description: Western Diamondback Rattlesnake ist ein Tier. The western diamondback rattlesnake is one of the most dangerous snakes in North America. Found across the southwestern United States and Mexico, it is responsible for the majority of snakebite fatalities in the region. Its rattle serves as a warning when threatened.
western-diamondback-rattlesnake.funFact: Western diamondback rattlesnakes add a new segment to their rattle each time they shed their skin.

caiman-lizard.name: Caiman Lizard
caiman-lizard.description: Caiman Lizard ist ein Tier. The caiman lizard is a semi-aquatic lizard found in the swamps and rivers of South America. It has a flattened tail for swimming and powerful jaws for crushing snail shells. Its skin resembles that of a caiman, hence its name.
caiman-lizard.funFact: Caiman lizards have powerful jaws and thick, armored scales that resemble those of caiman crocodilians.

carpet-python.name: Carpet Python
carpet-python.description: Carpet Python ist ein Tier. The carpet python is a large, non-venomous snake found across Australia and New Guinea. It has a variable pattern of dark bands on a lighter background. It is arboreal and commonly found in trees and on the roofs of houses.
carpet-python.funFact: Carpet pythons are nocturnal hunters that use heat-sensing pits to detect warm-blooded prey in total darkness.

brown-basilisk.name: Brown Basilisk
brown-basilisk.description: Brown Basilisk ist ein Tier. The brown basilisk is a large lizard found in the tropical rainforests of Central America. It has a distinctive crest on its head and can run bipedally across water. It is semi-arboreal and often found near streams and rivers.
brown-basilisk.funFact: Brown basilisks can run across water using their long toes and fringed scales, earning them the nickname 'Jesus Christ lizard'.

dumerils-boa.name: Dumeril's Boa
dumerils-boa.description: Dumeril's Boa ist ein Tier. Dumeril's boa is a heavy-bodied, non-venomous snake endemic to Madagascar. It has a tan and brown pattern that provides excellent camouflage on the forest floor. It is a ground-dwelling ambush predator feeding on mammals and birds.
dumerils-boa.funFact: Dumeril's boa can reduce its metabolic rate to survive extended periods without food, going months between meals.

sulcata-tortoise.name: African Spurred Tortoise
sulcata-tortoise.description: African Spurred Tortoise ist ein Tier. The African spurred tortoise is the third-largest tortoise species in the world, native to the Sahel region of Africa. It is named for the large, pointed spurs on its legs. It digs deep burrows to escape desert temperatures.
sulcata-tortoise.funFact: Sulcata tortoises dig extensive burrows up to 10 feet deep to escape the extreme heat of the African savanna.

common-caiman.name: Common Caiman
common-caiman.description: Common Caiman ist ein Tier. The common caiman is a medium-sized crocodilian found throughout Central and South America. It is one of the most widespread crocodilian species. It feeds primarily on fish and invertebrates and is often found in large groups basking on riverbanks.
common-caiman.funFact: Common caimans have a bony ridge between their eyes that acts like a built-in pair of sunglasses in bright sunlight.

western-hognose-snake.name: Western Hognose Snake
western-hognose-snake.description: Western Hognose Snake ist ein Tier. The western hognose snake is a small, non-venomous snake with an upturned snout used for burrowing. Found in the sandy prairies of central North America, it is known for its dramatic threat display. It feeds primarily on toads and small rodents.
western-hognose-snake.funFact: Western hognose snakes flatten their heads and hiss loudly when threatened, but their bluff rarely escalates to biting.

forest-cobra.name: Forest Cobra
forest-cobra.description: Forest Cobra ist ein Tier. The forest cobra is the largest cobra species, found in the tropical forests and savannas of central and western Africa. It is highly venomous and can spit venom accurately. It is a strong swimmer and often found near bodies of water.
forest-cobra.funFact: The forest cobra is the largest true cobra species and an excellent swimmer, often found near water.

veiled-chameleon.name: Veiled Chameleon
veiled-chameleon.description: Veiled Chameleon ist ein Tier. The veiled chameleon is one of the most popular pet chameleon species, native to Yemen and Saudi Arabia. Males have a distinctive tall casque on their heads. It is an arboreal species that feeds on insects by projecting its long, sticky tongue.
veiled-chameleon.funFact: Male veiled chameleons have a tall casque on their heads that may help channel dew drops into their mouths.

rough-scaled-sand-boa.name: Rough-Scaled Sand Boa
rough-scaled-sand-boa.description: Rough-Scaled Sand Boa ist ein Tier. The rough-scaled sand boa is a small, non-venomous constrictor found in the arid deserts of South Asia. It has a stout body adapted for burrowing and spends most of its time beneath the sand. It feeds primarily on rodents and small lizards.
rough-scaled-sand-boa.funFact: Sand boas spend most of their lives buried underground, with only their eyes and snout visible above the sand.

philippine-crocodile.name: Philippine Crocodile
philippine-crocodile.description: Philippine Crocodile ist ein Tier. The Philippine crocodile is a critically endangered species endemic to the Philippines. It is the most endangered crocodilian in the world, with a wild population estimated at fewer than 100 individuals. It inhabits freshwater rivers, lakes, and marshes.
philippine-crocodile.funFact: The Philippine crocodile is the most endangered crocodilian in the world, with fewer than 100 left in the wild.

rainbow-boa.name: Rainbow Boa
rainbow-boa.description: Rainbow Boa ist ein Tier. The rainbow boa is a non-venomous constrictor found in the rainforests of South America. Its name comes from the iridescent sheen of its scales, which refract light to create a rainbow effect. It is a terrestrial species found on the forest floor.
rainbow-boa.funFact: Rainbow boas have iridescent scales that refract light, creating a stunning rainbow shimmer in the sun.

giant-plated-lizard.name: Giant Plated Lizard
giant-plated-lizard.description: Giant Plated Lizard ist ein Tier. The giant plated lizard is a large, robust lizard found in the rocky outcrops of southern and eastern Africa. It has heavy, plate-like scales and a powerful tail. It is semi-arboreal and feeds on insects, small vertebrates, and fruit.
giant-plated-lizard.funFact: Giant plated lizards wedge themselves into rock crevices and inflate their bodies, making them nearly impossible to extract.

black-spiny-tailed-iguana.name: Black Spiny-Tailed Iguana
black-spiny-tailed-iguana.description: Black Spiny-Tailed Iguana ist ein Tier. The black spiny-tailed iguana is the fastest lizard in the world, reaching speeds of 21 mph. Native to Central America, it is found on rocky cliffs, walls, and in urban areas. It is an omnivorous species that feeds on plants and small animals.
black-spiny-tailed-iguana.funFact: The black spiny-tailed iguana is the fastest lizard in the world, capable of running at 21 mph.

burmese-python.name: Burmese Python
burmese-python.description: Burmese Python ist ein Tier. The Burmese python is one of the five largest snakes in the world, native to Southeast Asia. It is a popular pet species but has become a significant invasive species in the Florida Everglades. It is a powerful constrictor that feeds on mammals and birds.
burmese-python.funFact: Burmese pythons are one of the largest snake species and have become a destructive invasive species in the Florida Everglades.

ornate-box-turtle.name: Ornate Box Turtle
ornate-box-turtle.description: Ornate Box Turtle ist ein Tier. The ornate box turtle is a small, terrestrial turtle native to the prairies of central North America. It has a domed shell with intricate yellow and orange patterns. It can fully close its hinged plastron to protect itself from predators.
ornate-box-turtle.funFact: Ornate box turtles can completely seal their hinged plastron shut, trapping themselves inside their shell for protection.

common-house-gecko.name: Common House Gecko
common-house-gecko.description: Common House Gecko ist ein Tier. The common house gecko is a small, nocturnal lizard found throughout the tropical and subtropical regions of the world. It is commonly seen on walls and ceilings of buildings, hunting insects. Its toe pads allow it to climb smooth vertical surfaces.
common-house-gecko.funFact: Common house geckos are one of the most widespread lizard species on Earth, found on every continent except Antarctica.

sidewinder-rattlesnake.name: Sidewinder Rattlesnake
sidewinder-rattlesnake.description: Sidewinder Rattlesnake ist ein Tier. The sidewinder rattlesnake is a venomous pit viper adapted to desert life in the southwestern United States. It uses a distinctive sidewinding locomotion that leaves J-shaped tracks in the sand. It buries itself in sand to ambush prey and escape heat.
sidewinder-rattlesnake.funFact: Sidewinders move using a unique S-shaped locomotion that minimizes contact with hot desert sand.

chinese-water-dragon.name: Chinese Water Dragon
chinese-water-dragon.description: Chinese Water Dragon ist ein Tier. The Chinese water dragon is an arboreal agamid lizard found near streams in the forests of southeastern China. Males display vibrant green with white and orange markings. It is an excellent swimmer and can hold its breath for up to an hour.
chinese-water-dragon.funFact: Chinese water dragons can drop from heights of 40 feet and land safely on branches below.

west-african-dwarf-crocodile.name: West African Dwarf Crocodile
west-african-dwarf-crocodile.description: West African Dwarf Crocodile ist ein Tier. The West African dwarf crocodile is the smallest living crocodile species, found in the swamps and rivers of western and central Africa. It is nocturnal and highly terrestrial, digging burrows for shelter. It feeds primarily on fish, crustaceans, and insects.
west-african-dwarf-crocodile.funFact: West African dwarf crocodiles are the most terrestrial of all crocodilians and dig deep burrows to rest in during the day.

cape-cobra.name: Cape Cobra
cape-cobra.description: Cape Cobra ist ein Tier. The Cape cobra is one of the most dangerous cobras in Africa, found in the shrublands and fynbos of southern Africa. It is highly venomous with potent neurotoxin. It is a diurnal species and an excellent climber.
cape-cobra.funFact: Cape cobras are highly venomous and are responsible for the most snakebite deaths in southern Africa.

crested-iguana.name: Crested Iguana
crested-iguana.description: Crested Iguana ist ein Tier. The crested iguana is a critically endangered species endemic to the dry forests of western Madagascar. It has a distinctive high dorsal crest and is one of the rarest iguanas in the world. It is primarily herbivorous, feeding on leaves and fruit.
crested-iguana.funFact: Crested iguanas can change color from green to black based on temperature and social context.

argentine-tegu.name: Argentine Black and White Tegu
argentine-tegu.description: Argentine Black and White Tegu ist ein Tier. The Argentine black and white tegu is a large, omnivorous lizard native to South America. It has distinctive black and white banding and a robust body. It feeds on a wide variety of foods including insects, small animals, fruit, and eggs.
argentine-tegu.funFact: Argentine tegus can regulate their body temperature during the reproductive season without relying solely on external heat.

king-brown-snake.name: King Brown Snake
king-brown-snake.description: King Brown Snake ist ein Tier. The king brown snake, also known as the mulga snake, is one of Australia's most widespread and dangerous snakes. Despite its name, it belongs to the black snake genus Pseudechis. It is responsible for more snakebite deaths in Australia than any other species.
king-brown-snake.funFact: The king brown snake is technically a black snake, not a brown snake, and is in the genus Pseudechis.

false-gharial.name: False Gharial
false-gharial.description: False Gharial ist ein Tier. The false gharial is a critically endangered crocodilian found in the rivers and swamps of Southeast Asia. It has a distinctive long, narrow snout and is one of the largest crocodilian species. It is a specialist fish-eater with a unique jaw structure.
false-gharial.funFact: The false gharial has a narrow snout similar to the true gharial but is not closely related to it.

indian-star-tortoise.name: Indian Star Tortoise
indian-star-tortoise.description: Indian Star Tortoise ist ein Tier. The Indian star tortoise is a small to medium-sized tortoise native to India and Sri Lanka. It has distinctive star-shaped patterns on its carapace that radiate from the center of each scute. It is a popular species in the illegal pet trade.
indian-star-tortoise.funFact: Indian star tortoises have star-shaped patterns on their shells that help with camouflage and thermoregulation.

green-anaconda.name: Green Anaconda
green-anaconda.description: Green Anaconda ist ein Tier. The green anaconda is the heaviest and one of the longest snakes in the world, found in the swamps and rivers of South America. It is a non-venomous constrictor that feeds on deer, capybaras, and even jaguars. It spends most of its time in water.
green-anaconda.funFact: The green anaconda is the heaviest snake in the world, with some individuals weighing over 220 pounds.

tuatara.name: Tuatara
tuatara.description: Tuatara ist ein Tier. The tuatara is a reptile endemic to New Zealand and the only surviving member of the order Rhynchocephalia. Often called a living fossil, it has remained virtually unchanged for 200 million years. It has a third eye on top of its head that detects light changes.
tuatara.funFact: Tuatara are the last surviving members of an order of reptiles that lived alongside dinosaurs over 200 million years ago.

eastern-water-dragon.name: Eastern Water Dragon
eastern-water-dragon.description: Eastern Water Dragon ist ein Tier. The eastern water dragon is a large agamid lizard found along rivers and creeks in eastern Australia. Males have a distinctive red chest and a spiny crest along their back. It is semi-aquatic and an excellent swimmer.
eastern-water-dragon.funFact: Eastern water dragons can swim underwater for up to 90 minutes, closing a special membrane to keep water out of their eyes.

spider-tortoise.name: Spider Tortoise
spider-tortoise.description: Spider Tortoise ist ein Tier. The spider tortoise is a critically endangered species endemic to the dry spiny forests of southern Madagascar. It has distinctive yellow radiating patterns on its dark shell that resemble a spider's web. It is one of the smallest tortoise species in the world.
spider-tortoise.funFact: Spider tortoises are named for the radiating yellow lines on their shells that resemble a spider's web.

russian-tortoise.name: Russian Tortoise
russian-tortoise.description: Russian Tortoise ist ein Tier. The Russian tortoise is a small species native to the arid steppes of Central Asia. It is one of the most cold-tolerant tortoise species, surviving harsh winters by brumating underground. It is popular in the pet trade due to its small size and hardy nature.
russian-tortoise.funFact: Russian tortoises can survive extreme temperatures by brumating underground for up to 6 months during harsh winters.

cat-eyed-snake.name: Cat-Eyed Snake
cat-eyed-snake.description: Cat-Eyed Snake ist ein Tier. The cat-eyed snake is a small, rear-fanged snake found in the tropical rainforests of Central and South America. It has distinctive vertical pupils and is primarily nocturnal. It feeds on frogs, lizards, and small mammals.
cat-eyed-snake.funFact: Cat-eyed snakes have vertical pupils like cats, giving them excellent night vision for hunting in the dark rainforest.

arabian-chameleon.name: Arabian Chameleon
arabian-chameleon.description: Arabian Chameleon ist ein Tier. The Arabian chameleon is a species of chameleon native to the Arabian Peninsula. It is adapted to arid conditions, unlike most chameleon species. It has a casque on its head and can change color for communication and thermoregulation.
arabian-chameleon.funFact: Arabian chameleons are one of the few chameleon species adapted to live in hot, arid desert conditions.

spotted-turtle.name: Spotted Turtle
spotted-turtle.description: Spotted Turtle ist ein Tier. The spotted turtle is one of the smallest turtles in North America, found in shallow, slow-moving waters. It has a smooth, dark shell with distinctive yellow or orange spots. It is a long-lived species that can survive for over a century.
spotted-turtle.funFact: Spotted turtles have yellow spots on their dark shells that become more numerous with age, like counting tree rings.

banded-krait.name: Banded Krait
banded-krait.description: Banded Krait ist ein Tier. The banded krait is a highly venomous elapid found in South and Southeast Asia. It has distinctive black and yellow bands and is primarily nocturnal. It feeds on other snakes, including venomous species, and is responsible for many snakebite deaths in Asia.
banded-krait.funFact: Banded kraits are twice as venomous as cobras and often cannibalize other snakes, including other kraits.

golden-skink.name: Golden Skink
golden-skink.description: Golden Skink ist ein Tier. The golden skink is a small, fast-moving lizard found in tropical forests and gardens across South and Southeast Asia. It has a metallic, iridescent body that gives it a golden appearance. It is diurnal and feeds on insects and small invertebrates.
golden-skink.funFact: Golden skinks have a metallic, iridescent sheen that makes them look like they are coated in gold.

broad-snouted-caiman.name: Broad-Snouted Caiman
broad-snouted-caiman.description: Broad-Snouted Caiman ist ein Tier. The broad-snouted caiman is a medium-sized crocodilian found in the freshwater habitats of South America. It has a broad, flat snout adapted for catching fish and invertebrates. It builds vegetation mounds to incubate its eggs.
broad-snouted-caiman.funFact: Broad-snouted caimans build mounds of vegetation to incubate their eggs, using decomposition heat to warm them.

copperhead.name: Copperhead
copperhead.description: Copperhead ist ein Tier. The copperhead is a venomous pit viper found across the eastern United States. It has a distinctive copper-colored head and hourglass-shaped crossbands. It is responsible for the most snakebite cases in North America, though fatalities are rare.
copperhead.funFact: Copperheads account for the majority of venomous snakebites in the United States, though their venom is rarely fatal.

radiated-tortoise.name: Radiated Tortoise
radiated-tortoise.description: Radiated Tortoise ist ein Tier. The radiated tortoise is a critically endangered species endemic to Madagascar. It has a high-domed shell with striking yellow star-shaped patterns radiating from the center of each scute. It is threatened by habitat loss and poaching for food and the pet trade.
radiated-tortoise.funFact: Radiated tortoises can live for over 100 years, with some individuals reportedly reaching 188 years of age.

blue-racer.name: Blue Racer
blue-racer.description: Blue Racer ist ein Tier. The blue racer is a fast-moving, non-venomous colubrid found across the central United States and southern Ontario. It has a distinctive blue-grey dorsal color and a white or cream underside. It is diurnal and feeds on rodents, frogs, and other snakes.
blue-racer.funFact: Blue racers are one of the fastest snakes in North America, capable of speeds up to 10 mph.

side-blotched-lizard.name: Side-Blotched Lizard
side-blotched-lizard.description: Side-Blotched Lizard ist ein Tier. The side-blotched lizard is a small lizard found in the deserts and grasslands of western North America. It is famous in evolutionary biology for its rock-paper-scissors mating strategy. Males have three throat colors that correspond to different mating tactics.
side-blotched-lizard.funFact: Male side-blotched lizards use a rock-paper-scissors strategy with three throat colors to compete for mates.

nile-monitor.name: Nile Monitor
nile-monitor.description: Nile Monitor ist ein Tier. The Nile monitor is a large, powerful lizard found throughout sub-Saharan Africa near water. It is semi-aquatic and feeds on fish, frogs, birds, eggs, and carrion. It has a forked tongue used for detecting prey in the water.
nile-monitor.funFact: Nile monitors are excellent swimmers and can hold their breath for up to an hour while submerged underwater.

canebrake-rattlesnake.name: Canebrake Rattlesnake
canebrake-rattlesnake.description: Canebrake Rattlesnake ist ein Tier. The canebrake rattlesnake, a subspecies of the timber rattlesnake, is found in the forests and swamps of the southeastern United States. It has a distinctive pinkish-brown color with dark crossbands. It is a dangerous venomous pit viper.
canebrake-rattlesnake.funFact: Canebrake rattlesnakes have a silent rattle compared to other rattlesnake species, often delivering strikes without warning.

yellow-footed-tortoise.name: Yellow-Footed Tortoise
yellow-footed-tortoise.description: Yellow-Footed Tortoise ist ein Tier. The yellow-footed tortoise is a medium-sized tortoise native to the Amazon Basin of South America. It has distinctive yellow or orange scales on its legs and head. It feeds primarily on fallen fruit and plays an important ecological role in seed dispersal.
yellow-footed-tortoise.funFact: Yellow-footed tortoises play a crucial role in seed dispersal in the Amazon, helping to regenerate the rainforest.

puff-adder.name: Puff Adder
puff-adder.description: Puff Adder ist ein Tier. The puff adder is a venomous viper found throughout sub-Saharan Africa. It relies on its excellent camouflage and will not flee when approached, leading to many defensive strikes. It is an ambush predator that strikes with incredible speed.
puff-adder.funFact: Puff adders are responsible for more snakebite deaths in Africa than any other snake due to their excellent camouflage.

eastern-green-mamba.name: Eastern Green Mamba
eastern-green-mamba.description: Eastern Green Mamba ist ein Tier. The eastern green mamba is a fast, highly venomous elapid found in the coastal forests of eastern and southern Africa. It is bright green, blending perfectly with the forest canopy. Unlike the black mamba, it is arboreal and rarely comes to the ground.
eastern-green-mamba.funFact: Eastern green mambas are arboreal and rarely descend to the ground, spending their lives in the forest canopy.

cape-dwarf-chameleon.name: Cape Dwarf Chameleon
cape-dwarf-chameleon.description: Cape Dwarf Chameleon ist ein Tier. The Cape dwarf chameleon is a small chameleon endemic to the Western Cape of South Africa. It has independently rotating eyes, a prehensile tail, and a long, sticky tongue for catching insects. It can change color for communication and thermoregulation.
cape-dwarf-chameleon.funFact: Cape dwarf chameleons have independently moving eyes that can rotate 180 degrees, giving them a 360-degree field of vision.

chinese-alligator.name: Chinese Alligator
chinese-alligator.description: Chinese Alligator ist ein Tier. The Chinese alligator is a critically endangered species, one of only two alligator species in the world. Found in eastern China, it is smaller than the American alligator and has bony plates on its eyelids. Wild populations are critically low.
chinese-alligator.funFact: Chinese alligators are the most endangered crocodilian species, with fewer than 150 individuals remaining in the wild.

snouted-cobra.name: Snouted Cobra
snouted-cobra.description: Snouted Cobra ist ein Tier. The snouted cobra is a large, highly venomous snake found across southern Africa. It has a distinctive upturned snout and can spit venom accurately. It is found in a wide variety of habitats and feeds on rodents, birds, and other snakes.
snouted-cobra.funFact: Snouted cobras can spit venom accurately up to 2 meters, aiming for the eyes of perceived threats.

common-wall-lizard.name: Common Wall Lizard
common-wall-lizard.description: Common Wall Lizard ist ein Tier. The common wall lizard is a small, agile lizard found across Europe and introduced to North America. It is commonly seen basking on stone walls and buildings. It feeds on insects, spiders, and small invertebrates.
common-wall-lizard.funFact: Common wall lizards have been introduced to North America from Europe and are now thriving in cities like Toronto and Vancouver.

brown-tree-snake.name: Brown Tree Snake
brown-tree-snake.description: Brown Tree Snake ist ein Tier. The brown tree snake is an arboreal, rear-fanged snake native to Australia and New Guinea. It has become one of the world's most destructive invasive species on Guam, where it has eliminated most of the island's native bird species. It is nocturnal and feeds on birds, lizards, and mammals.
brown-tree-snake.funFact: The brown tree snake has driven at least 10 bird species to extinction on Guam after accidentally introduced there.

angulate-tortoise.name: Angulate Tortoise
angulate-tortoise.description: Angulate Tortoise ist ein Tier. The angulate tortoise is a small tortoise found in the fynbos and karoo shrublands of southern Africa. It has a distinctive upturned front margin to its shell. It is well adapted to the Mediterranean climate of the Western Cape region.
angulate-tortoise.funFact: Angulate tortoises are the most southerly distributed tortoise species in Africa, found even in the cool, wet Western Cape.

savannah-monitor.name: Savannah Monitor
savannah-monitor.description: Savannah Monitor ist ein Tier. The savannah monitor is a medium-sized monitor lizard found across sub-Saharan Africa. It is a ground-dwelling species that digs burrows for shelter. It feeds on insects, small mammals, and reptiles, and is popular in the exotic pet trade.
savannah-monitor.funFact: Savannah monitors can slow their metabolism so much that they can survive on as few as three large meals per year.

white-lipped-pit-viper.name: White-Lipped Pit Viper
white-lipped-pit-viper.description: White-Lipped Pit Viper ist ein Tier. The white-lipped pit viper is a venomous snake found in the tropical rainforests of Southeast Asia. It has a distinctive white or yellow line along its upper lip and is primarily arboreal. It is a nocturnal ambush predator that feeds on rodents and birds.
white-lipped-pit-viper.funFact: White-lipped pit vipers have heat-sensing pits between their eyes and nostrils that detect warm-blooded prey in complete darkness.

alabama-red-bellied-cooter.name: Alabama Red-Bellied Cooter
alabama-red-bellied-cooter.description: Alabama Red-Bellied Cooter ist ein Tier. The Alabama red-bellied cooter is an endangered freshwater turtle endemic to Alabama and Georgia. It has a dark shell with a distinctive red or orange plastron. It is found in rivers, lakes, and ponds with abundant aquatic vegetation.
alabama-red-bellied-cooter.funFact: Alabama red-bellied cooters can bask for hours, using the sun to synthesize vitamin D3 for shell health.

amazon-tree-boa.name: Amazon Tree Boa
amazon-tree-boa.description: Amazon Tree Boa ist ein Tier. The Amazon tree boa is a small, arboreal constrictor found throughout the Amazon rainforest. It is nocturnal and feeds on birds and small mammals. It has an extremely variable color pattern, ranging from yellow to red to brown.
amazon-tree-boa.funFact: Amazon tree boas are incredibly variable in color and pattern, with no two individuals looking exactly alike.

california-kingsnake.name: California Kingsnake
california-kingsnake.description: California Kingsnake ist ein Tier. The California kingsnake is a popular, non-venomous constrictor found across the western United States. It has a banded pattern of brown and white or yellow. It is an opportunistic feeder that readily eats rattlesnakes, making it beneficial to humans.
california-kingsnake.funFact: California kingsnakes are immune to rattlesnake venom and regularly prey upon rattlesnakes in the wild.

clouded-monitor.name: Clouded Monitor
clouded-monitor.description: Clouded Monitor ist ein Tier. The clouded monitor is a medium-sized monitor lizard found in the tropical rainforests of Southeast Asia. It is arboreal and has a long, slender body adapted for climbing. It feeds on insects, small mammals, and birds.
clouded-monitor.funFact: Clouded monitors are arboreal and have sharp claws that allow them to climb vertical tree trunks with ease.

brazilian-rainbow-boa.name: Brazilian Rainbow Boa
brazilian-rainbow-boa.description: Brazilian Rainbow Boa ist ein Tier. The Brazilian rainbow boa is a medium-sized, non-venomous constrictor found in the rainforests of South America. Its name comes from the stunning iridescent sheen of its scales. It is primarily terrestrial and feeds on rodents, birds, and bats.
brazilian-rainbow-boa.funFact: Brazilian rainbow boas have iridescent scales that create a holographic rainbow effect when exposed to light.

northern-cuirassated-lizard.name: Northern Cuirassated Lizard
northern-cuirassated-lizard.description: Northern Cuirassated Lizard ist ein Tier. The northern cuirassated lizard is a small lizard found in the rocky hillsides of Mexico. It has distinctive bony armor plates called osteoderms covering its body. It is diurnal and feeds on insects and small invertebrates.
northern-cuirassated-lizard.funFact: Northern cuirassated lizards have bony armor plates called osteoderms that provide protection from predators.

desert-iguana.name: Desert Iguana
desert-iguana.description: Desert Iguana ist ein Tier. The desert iguana is a medium-sized lizard found in the deserts of the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico. It is one of the most heat-tolerant lizards, active at temperatures that force other reptiles to seek shade. It feeds primarily on leaves and flowers.
desert-iguana.funFact: Desert iguanas can tolerate body temperatures up to 120°F, making them one of the most heat-tolerant lizards.

false-water-cobra.name: False Water Cobra
false-water-cobra.description: False Water Cobra ist ein Tier. The false water cobra is a large, semi-aquatic colubrid found in the wetlands of South America. It displays a cobra-like hood when threatened, despite being only mildly venomous. It is an excellent swimmer and feeds on fish, frogs, and small mammals.
false-water-cobra.funFact: False water cobras flatten their necks like true cobras when threatened, despite being only mildly venomous.

garter-snake.name: Common Garter Snake
garter-snake.description: Common Garter Snake ist ein Tier. The common garter snake is one of the most widespread snakes in North America, found in gardens, meadows, and woodlands. It has distinctive longitudinal stripes. Despite being mildly venomous, it is harmless to humans and beneficial as pest control.
garter-snake.funFact: Garter snakes are mildly venomous but harmless to humans, making them one of the most common backyard snakes.

shingleback-skink.name: Shingleback Skink
shingleback-skink.description: Shingleback Skink ist ein Tier. The shingleback skink is a large, slow-moving lizard found in the woodlands and grasslands of southern Australia. It has rough, pinecone-like scales and a short, fat tail that resembles its head, confusing predators. It is one of the few reptile species that mate for life.
shingleback-skink.funFact: Shingleback skinks mate for life and reunite with the same partner every breeding season.

mozambique-spitting-cobra.name: Mozambique Spitting Cobra
mozambique-spitting-cobra.description: Mozambique Spitting Cobra ist ein Tier. The Mozambique spitting cobra is a highly venomous elapid found across eastern and southern Africa. It is one of the most dangerous snakes in the region, responsible for many snakebite cases. It can spit venom accurately into the eyes of perceived threats.
mozambique-spitting-cobra.funFact: Mozambique spitting cobras can spit venom accurately up to 3 meters, targeting the eyes of threats.

american-bullfrog.name: American Bullfrog
american-bullfrog.description: American Bullfrog ist ein Tier. The American Bullfrog is the largest frog in North America. They are powerful swimmers and aggressive predators, known for their deep jug-o-rum calls that can be heard up to a mile away.
american-bullfrog.funFact: American Bullfrogs can eat almost anything they can fit in their mouths, including other frogs, birds, and even snakes.

glass-frog.name: Glass Frog
glass-frog.description: Glass Frog ist ein Tier. Glass Frogs are remarkable amphibians with translucent ventral skin. Found in Central and South America, they spend most of their lives in trees and descend only to breed near fast-flowing streams.
glass-frog.funFact: Glass Frogs have transparent abdominal skin that allows you to see their beating heart and internal organs.

pacman-frog.name: Pacman Frog
pacman-frog.description: Pacman Frog ist ein Tier. The Pacman Frog, also known as the Argentine Horned Frog, is a popular pet species known for its large mouth and sedentary lifestyle. They are ambush predators that sit and wait for prey to pass by.
pacman-frog.funFact: Pacman Frogs are named after the video game character due to their enormous mouths and round bodies.

budgetts-frog.name: Budgett's Frog
budgetts-frog.description: Budgett's Frog ist ein Tier. Budgett's Frog is a flattened, broad-bodied frog found in South America. They are known for their aggressive defensive behavior, including inflating, screaming, and biting when disturbed.
budgetts-frog.funFact: Budgett's Frogs inflate their bodies and scream when threatened to appear larger and more intimidating.

whites-tree-frog.name: White's Tree Frog
whites-tree-frog.description: White's Tree Frog ist ein Tier. White's Tree Frog, also known as the Dumpy Tree Frog, is one of the most docile and popular amphibian pets. Native to Australia and New Guinea, they are known for their placid temperament and ability to thrive in captivity.
whites-tree-frog.funFact: White's Tree Frogs have fatty deposits above their eyes that look like eyebrows, giving them a perpetual smile.

african-dwarf-frog.name: African Dwarf Frog
african-dwarf-frog.description: African Dwarf Frog ist ein Tier. African Dwarf Frogs are tiny, fully aquatic amphibians that never leave the water. They are social creatures that do best in groups and are popular aquarium pets due to their small size and active nature.
african-dwarf-frog.funFact: African Dwarf Frogs are fully aquatic and spend their entire lives underwater, unlike most frogs.

amazon-milk-frog.name: Amazon Milk Frog
amazon-milk-frog.description: Amazon Milk Frog ist ein Tier. The Amazon Milk Frog is a large tree frog found in the Amazon rainforest. They have a distinctive black and white or blue and white banded pattern and are named for the milky toxic substance they secrete.
amazon-milk-frog.funFact: Amazon Milk Frogs secrete a milky white toxin when threatened and can change color from light to dark blue.

gray-tree-frog.name: Gray Tree Frog
gray-tree-frog.description: Gray Tree Frog ist ein Tier. The Gray Tree Frog is a small, arboreal frog native to eastern North America. They have bumpy skin that resembles tree bark and bright yellow-orange patches on the inside of their hind legs.
gray-tree-frog.funFact: Gray Tree Frogs can change color from gray to green depending on their environment and activity level.

spring-peeper.name: Spring Peeper
spring-peeper.description: Spring Peeper ist ein Tier. Spring Peepers are tiny tree frogs whose chorus marks the arrival of spring in eastern North America. Their characteristic X-shaped marking on their back helps identify them among other small frogs.
spring-peeper.funFact: The Spring Peeper's high-pitched peeping call can be heard from over a mile away during breeding season.

wood-frog.name: Wood Frog
wood-frog.description: Wood Frog ist ein Tier. Wood Frogs are remarkable for their ability to freeze during winter and thaw out alive in spring. Found across North America, they have a distinctive dark mask marking behind each eye.
wood-frog.funFact: Wood Frogs can survive being frozen solid, with up to 65% of their body water turning to ice.

american-toad.name: American Toad
american-toad.description: American Toad ist ein Tier. The American Toad is one of the most common and widespread toads in North America. They have warty skin, parotoid glands that produce a mild toxin, and can live for over a decade in the wild.
american-toad.funFact: A single American Toad can eat up to 1,000 insects per day, making them excellent garden pest controllers.

cane-toad.name: Cane Toad
cane-toad.description: Cane Toad ist ein Tier. The Cane Toad is a large, toxic toad native to Central and South America. It has become one of the most successful invasive amphibians, spreading across Australia, the Caribbean, and Pacific islands.
cane-toad.funFact: Cane Toads were introduced to Australia in 1935 to control beetles but became one of the worst invasive species in the world.

fire-bellied-toad.name: Fire-Bellied Toad
fire-bellied-toad.description: Fire-Bellied Toad ist ein Tier. Fire-Bellied Toads are small, semi-aquatic toads with bumpy olive-green backs and vivid orange or red bellies. They are popular pets and are known for their aposematic coloration that warns predators of their toxins.
fire-bellied-toad.funFact: Fire-Bellied Toads display their bright orange-red bellies when threatened in a behavior called the unken reflex.

desert-rain-frog.name: Desert Rain Frog
desert-rain-frog.description: Desert Rain Frog ist ein Tier. The Desert Rain Frog is a tiny, round frog that burrows into sand along the coast of South Africa and Namibia. They spend most of their lives underground and emerge only to feed and breed during foggy conditions.
desert-rain-frog.funFact: Desert Rain Frogs let out a high-pitched squeak when threatened, sounding like a dog toy.

goliath-frog.name: Goliath Frog
goliath-frog.description: Goliath Frog ist ein Tier. The Goliath Frog, or Conraua goliath, is the world's largest frog. Found only in Cameroon and Equatorial Guinea, these massive amphibians inhabit fast-flowing rivers and are threatened by habitat loss and hunting.
goliath-frog.funFact: The Goliath Frog is the largest living frog in the world, weighing up to 7 pounds and spanning over a foot long.

mountain-chicken-frog.name: Mountain Chicken Frog
mountain-chicken-frog.description: Mountain Chicken Frog ist ein Tier. The Mountain Chicken Frog is one of the largest frogs in the Caribbean, found only on Dominica and Montserrat. They are critically endangered due to the chytrid fungus and habitat destruction.
mountain-chicken-frog.funFact: Despite their name, Mountain Chicken Frogs are not chickens but are called so because their leg meat tastes like chicken.

spadefoot-toad.name: Spadefoot Toad
spadefoot-toad.description: Spadefoot Toad ist ein Tier. Spadefoot Toads are adapted to arid environments with specialized keratinized spades on their hind feet for burrowing. They spend most of their lives underground and breed explosively in temporary rain pools.
spadefoot-toad.funFact: Spadefoot Toads can burrow underground and remain dormant for up to nine months, emerging only when it rains.

natterjack-toad.name: Natterjack Toad
natterjack-toad.description: Natterjack Toad ist ein Tier. The Natterjack Toad is a medium-sized toad found across Europe. Unlike most toads, they run rather than hop and are known for their loud, rasping calls during breeding season.
natterjack-toad.funFact: Natterjack Toads are one of the loudest European amphibians, with calls that can be heard over a mile away.

midwife-toad.name: Midwife Toad
midwife-toad.description: Midwife Toad ist ein Tier. Midwife Toads are small, nocturnal toads named for the male's paternal behavior of carrying eggs on his hind legs. Found across Europe, they have a distinctive high-pitched beep-like call.
midwife-toad.funFact: Male Midwife Toads carry the eggs wrapped around their hind legs until they are ready to hatch.

european-tree-frog.name: European Tree Frog
european-tree-frog.description: European Tree Frog ist ein Tier. The European Tree Frog is a small, bright green frog with a distinctive dark stripe along each side. They are excellent climbers and are often found in gardens, orchards, and damp woodlands.
european-tree-frog.funFact: European Tree Frogs have adhesive toe pads that allow them to climb smooth surfaces, including glass.

leopard-frog.name: Leopard Frog
leopard-frog.description: Leopard Frog ist ein Tier. The Leopard Frog gets its name from the distinctive dark spots covering its green or brown body. Found across North America, they are strong jumpers and swimmers that inhabit a variety of wetland habitats.
leopard-frog.funFact: Leopard Frogs can jump up to 20 times their body length in a single leap.

strawberry-poison-dart-frog.name: Strawberry Poison Dart Frog
strawberry-poison-dart-frog.description: Strawberry Poison Dart Frog ist ein Tier. The Strawberry Poison Dart Frog, also known as the Blue Jeans Frog, is a small but vividly colored amphibian found in Central America. Males carry tadpoles on their backs to suitable pools of water.
strawberry-poison-dart-frog.funFact: The Strawberry Poison Dart Frog has over 30 color morphs, ranging from red with blue legs to green with yellow spots.

dyeing-poison-dart-frog.name: Dyeing Poison Dart Frog
dyeing-poison-dart-frog.description: Dyeing Poison Dart Frog ist ein Tier. The Dyeing Poison Dart Frog is a variable species with striking color patterns. Found in South America, they were named for the use of their skin secretions by indigenous peoples to dye feathers and textiles.
dyeing-poison-dart-frog.funFact: The Dyeing Poison Dart Frog was named because indigenous people used its toxins to dye fabric.

harlequin-toad.name: Harlequin Toad
harlequin-toad.description: Harlequin Toad ist ein Tier. Harlequin Toads are a diverse group of brightly colored toads found in Central and South America. Many species are critically endangered or believed extinct due to the chytrid fungus and habitat loss.
harlequin-toad.funFact: Many Harlequin Toad species were thought to be extinct until small populations were rediscovered in recent years.

pickerel-frog.name: Pickerel Frog
pickerel-frog.description: Pickerel Frog ist ein Tier. The Pickerel Frog is a brownish frog with two parallel rows of dark rectangular spots down its back. Found in eastern North America, they are one of the few frogs whose skin secretions are toxic to other amphibians.
pickerel-frog.funFact: Pickerel Frogs produce a toxin that can irritate human skin and is lethal to other frogs.

cherry-tree-frog.name: Cherry Tree Frog
cherry-tree-frog.description: Cherry Tree Frog ist ein Tier. The Cherry Tree Frog is a small European tree frog known for its distinctive call that sounds like a cherry pit being clicked. They are excellent climbers with adhesive toe pads.
cherry-tree-frog.funFact: Cherry Tree Frogs can change color from bright green to brown depending on their surroundings.

asian-common-toad.name: Asian Common Toad
asian-common-toad.description: Asian Common Toad ist ein Tier. The Asian Common Toad is a widespread toad found across South and Southeast Asia. They are highly adaptable to urban environments and are often found in gardens, drains, and agricultural areas.
asian-common-toad.funFact: Asian Common Toads are extremely adaptable and thrive in human-modified environments across Southeast Asia.

clown-tree-frog.name: Clown Tree Frog
clown-tree-frog.description: Clown Tree Frog ist ein Tier. The Clown Tree Frog is a colorful, medium-sized tree frog found in the Amazon rainforest. They have striking patterns of brown, green, and cream that provide excellent camouflage against tree bark.
clown-tree-frog.funFact: Clown Tree Frogs are named for their playful, acrobatic movements through the trees.

gliding-tree-frog.name: Gliding Tree Frog
gliding-tree-frog.description: Gliding Tree Frog ist ein Tier. The Gliding Tree Frog has evolved enlarged adhesive toe pads and partially webbed feet that allow it to glide through the rainforest canopy. Found in Central America, they are active at night.
gliding-tree-frog.funFact: Gliding Tree Frogs can spread their enlarged toe pads and webbed feet to glide between trees.

black-legged-poison-frog.name: Black-Legged Poison Frog
black-legged-poison-frog.description: Black-Legged Poison Frog ist ein Tier. The Black-Legged Poison Frog is a small, toxic frog found in the rainforests of Colombia. They are known for their complex parental care behaviors and striking black and yellow coloration.
black-legged-poison-frog.funFact: Black-Legged Poison Frogs exhibit biparental care, with both parents tending to their eggs and tadpoles.

red-backed-poison-frog.name: Red-Backed Poison Frog
red-backed-poison-frog.description: Red-Backed Poison Frog ist ein Tier. The Red-Backed Poison Frog is a small, brightly colored amphibian found in the Amazon rainforest. Their vivid red or orange back serves as a warning to potential predators.
red-backed-poison-frog.funFact: Red-Backed Poison Frogs use their bright coloration to warn predators of their skin toxins in a strategy called aposematism.

splashback-poison-frog.name: Splashback Poison Frog
splashback-poison-frog.description: Splashback Poison Frog ist ein Tier. The Splashback Poison Frog is a small amphibian with vivid coloration that varies from green to blue to yellow. Found in South America, they carry tadpoles on their backs to water-filled bromeliads.
splashback-poison-frog.funFact: Splashback Poison Frogs get their name from their colorful backs that look like paint splashes.

cane-turtle-frog.name: Cane Turtle Frog
cane-turtle-frog.description: Cane Turtle Frog ist ein Tier. The Cane Turtle Frog is a small, flattened frog found in South America. They are often found in agricultural areas, particularly sugarcane fields, and have a distinctive flattened appearance.
cane-turtle-frog.funFact: Cane Turtle Frogs have a flattened body shape that allows them to hide under rocks and logs.

malaysian-horned-frog.name: Malaysian Horned Frog
malaysian-horned-frog.description: Malaysian Horned Frog ist ein Tier. The Malaysian Horned Frog is a medium-sized frog with distinctive horn-like projections above each eye. Found in Southeast Asian rainforests, they are well-camouflaged among dead leaves on the forest floor.
malaysian-horned-frog.funFact: Malaysian Horned Frogs have horn-like projections above their eyes that help break up their outline among leaf litter.

hampire-poison-dart-frog.name: Hampire Poison Dart Frog
hampire-poison-dart-frog.description: Hampire Poison Dart Frog ist ein Tier. The Hamphire Poison Dart Frog is a small, strikingly colored amphibian found in South America. Their bold pattern serves as a warning to predators of their toxic skin secretions.
hampire-poison-dart-frog.funFact: Hampire Poison Dart Frogs are named after the Harry Potter character due to their striking black and orange pattern.

brazilian-horned-frog.name: Brazilian Horned Frog
brazilian-horned-frog.description: Brazilian Horned Frog ist ein Tier. The Brazilian Horned Frog is a medium-sized frog with horn-like projections above its eyes. Found in the Amazon rainforest, they are well-camouflaged and lie in wait to ambush passing prey.
brazilian-horned-frog.funFact: Brazilian Horned Frogs are ambush predators that can remain motionless for hours waiting for prey.

hairy-frog.name: Hairy Frog
hairy-frog.description: Hairy Frog ist ein Tier. The Hairy Frog, also known as the Trichobatrachus, is a unique amphibian found in Central Africa. Males develop hair-like dermal papillae on their flanks and thighs during the breeding season.
hairy-frog.funFact: Male Hairy Frogs grow hair-like skin projections during breeding season to help absorb oxygen from water.

tomato-frog.name: Tomato Frog
tomato-frog.description: Tomato Frog ist ein Tier. The Tomato Frog is a bright red-orange frog found in Madagascar. When threatened, they inflate their bodies and secrete a sticky white substance that can temporarily immobilize predators.
tomato-frog.funFact: Tomato Frogs secrete a thick, white substance that can glue a predator's mouth shut.

marsupial-frog.name: Marsupial Frog
marsupial-frog.description: Marsupial Frog ist ein Tier. The Marsupial Frog is a remarkable amphibian found in the Andes mountains. Females have a dorsal pouch where they carry their eggs until they develop into froglets, bypassing the tadpole stage.
marsupial-frog.funFact: Female Marsupial Frogs carry their eggs in a pouch on their back, similar to marsupial mammals.

foam-nest-frog.name: Foam Nest Frog
foam-nest-frog.description: Foam Nest Frog ist ein Tier. Foam Nest Frogs are found across Africa and South America. They are named for their unique breeding behavior where both sexes whip up a foam nest to protect their eggs from drying out.
foam-nest-frog.funFact: Foam Nest Frogs create a frothy nest by beating their hind legs to whip up a foam that protects their eggs.

surinam-toad.name: Surinam Toad
surinam-toad.description: Surinam Toad ist ein Tier. The Surinam Toad is a flat, bottom-dwelling amphibian found in South America. Females have a remarkable reproductive strategy where eggs are embedded in the skin of their backs until they emerge as fully formed froglets.
surinam-toad.funFact: Female Surinam Toads have eggs embedded in the skin of their backs, where they develop into froglets.

tiger-salamander.name: Tiger Salamander
tiger-salamander.description: Tiger Salamander ist ein Tier. The Tiger Salamander is the largest terrestrial salamander in North America. They have distinctive yellow or olive markings on a dark background and spend most of their lives underground in burrows.
tiger-salamander.funFact: Tiger Salamanders are one of the longest-lived amphibians, with some individuals living over 20 years in captivity.

eastern-newt.name: Eastern Newt
eastern-newt.description: Eastern Newt ist ein Tier. The Eastern Newt has a complex life cycle with three distinct stages: aquatic larva, terrestrial red eft, and aquatic adult. Found in eastern North America, they produce tetrodotoxin in their skin.
eastern-newt.funFact: The juvenile Eastern Newt, called a red eft, is brightly colored to warn predators of its toxins.

hellbender.name: Hellbender
hellbender.description: Hellbender ist ein Tier. The Hellbender is the largest salamander in North America, reaching up to two feet long. Found in clean, fast-flowing streams of the eastern United States, they are declining due to pollution and habitat loss.
hellbender.funFact: Hellbenders absorb oxygen through their wrinkly skin and are an indicator species for water quality.

olm.name: Olm
olm.description: Olm ist ein Tier. The Olm is a blind, cave-dwelling salamander found in the caves of southern Europe. It has no eyes, is depigmented, and can live for over 100 years, making it one of the longest-lived vertebrates.
olm.funFact: Olms can survive without food for up to 10 years and are among the longest-lived amphibians.

fire-salamander.name: Fire Salamander
fire-salamander.description: Fire Salamander ist ein Tier. The Fire Salamander is one of Europe's most recognizable amphibians with its striking black body and bright yellow or orange markings. Found in central and southern Europe, they secrete samandarin, a neurotoxin.
fire-salamander.funFact: Fire Salamanders were once believed to be born from fire and could extinguish flames with their cold bodies.

spotted-salamander.name: Spotted Salamander
spotted-salamander.description: Spotted Salamander ist ein Tier. The Spotted Salamander is a large, robust salamander found in eastern North America. They have distinctive yellow spots on a dark background and are one of the few vertebrates known to have algae living inside their cells.
spotted-salamander.funFact: Spotted Salamanders have a symbiotic relationship with algae that lives inside their cells.

red-backed-salamander.name: Red-Backed Salamander
red-backed-salamander.description: Red-Backed Salamander ist ein Tier. The Red-Backed Salamander is the most common and abundant salamander in eastern North America. They are entirely lungless, breathing through their moist skin, and come in both red-backed and lead-backed color phases.
red-backed-salamander.funFact: Red-Backed Salamanders breathe entirely through their skin and have no lungs or gills as adults.

mudpuppy.name: Mudpuppy
mudpuppy.description: Mudpuppy ist ein Tier. The Mudpuppy is a fully aquatic salamander found in eastern North America. They retain their bushy red external gills throughout life and are nocturnal hunters that use sensory barbels to find prey.
mudpuppy.funFact: Mudpuppies retain their external gills throughout their entire lives, a condition called neoteny.

rough-skinned-newt.name: Rough-Skinned Newt
rough-skinned-newt.description: Rough-Skinned Newt ist ein Tier. The Rough-Skinned Newt is a highly toxic amphibian found along the Pacific coast of North America. They produce tetrodotoxin, the same toxin found in pufferfish, and advertise their toxicity with bright orange undersides.
rough-skinned-newt.funFact: Rough-Skinned Newts produce enough tetrodotoxin to kill several adult humans.

alpine-salamander.name: Alpine Salamander
alpine-salamander.description: Alpine Salamander ist ein Tier. The Alpine Salamander is found in the mountains of central and southern Europe. Unlike most amphibians, they give birth to live young that have completed their development inside the mother's body.
alpine-salamander.funFact: Alpine Salamanders are entirely viviparous, giving birth to fully developed young rather than laying eggs.

great-crested-newt.name: Great Crested Newt
great-crested-newt.description: Great Crested Newt ist ein Tier. The Great Crested Newt is the largest newt species in Europe. Males develop a distinctive crest during breeding season and have a white flash on their tail. They are legally protected in many countries.
great-crested-newt.funFact: Male Great Crested Newts develop a jagged crest along their back during breeding season.

marbled-salamander.name: Marbled Salamander
marbled-salamander.description: Marbled Salamander ist ein Tier. The Marbled Salamander is a small, stocky salamander with distinctive white or gray crossbands on a dark background. Found in eastern North America, they are one of the few salamanders that guard their eggs.
marbled-salamander.funFact: Female Marbled Salamanders stay with their eggs and guard them until they hatch.

long-toed-salamander.name: Long-Toed Salamander
long-toed-salamander.description: Long-Toed Salamander ist ein Tier. The Long-Toed Salamander is a small salamander found across western North America. They have a characteristic stripe running down their back and long toes that give them their name.
long-toed-salamander.funFact: Long-Toed Salamanders can have up to 13 toes on their hind feet, more than most salamanders.

slimy-salamander.name: Slimy Salamander
slimy-salamander.description: Slimy Salamander ist ein Tier. The Slimy Salamander is a medium-sized lungless salamander found in the eastern United States. They secrete a sticky white substance from their skin that helps deter predators.
slimy-salamander.funFact: Slimy Salamanders secrete a sticky, glue-like substance from their skin that is difficult to remove.

red-salamander.name: Red Salamander
red-salamander.description: Red Salamander ist ein Tier. The Red Salamander is a brightly colored amphibian found in the Appalachian region of the eastern United States. Adults have a distinctive red to orange coloration with scattered black spots.
red-salamander.funFact: Red Salamanders are one of the largest lungless salamanders in North America.

lesser-siren.name: Lesser Siren
lesser-siren.description: Lesser Siren ist ein Tier. The Lesser Siren is a fully aquatic salamander with external gills found in the southeastern United States. They lack hind legs and can survive drought by burrowing into mud and entering a dormant state.
lesser-siren.funFact: Lesser Sirens can breathe through their gills and also through their skin, and can survive drying by burrowing into mud.

greater-siren.name: Greater Siren
greater-siren.description: Greater Siren ist ein Tier. The Greater Siren is a large, fully aquatic salamander with external gills found in the coastal plains of the southeastern United States. They lack hind limbs and can grow up to three feet long.
greater-siren.funFact: Greater Sirens are the largest species in the Sirenidae family and can exceed three feet in length.

three-toed-amphiuma.name: Three-Toed Amphiuma
three-toed-amphiuma.description: Three-Toed Amphiuma ist ein Tier. The Three-Toed Amphiuma is a fully aquatic salamander found in the southeastern United States. It has an eel-like body with three tiny, non-functional toes on each vestigial limb.
three-toed-amphiuma.funFact: Three-Toed Amphiumas have vestigial legs that are so small they are almost impossible to see.

waterdog.name: Waterdog
waterdog.description: Waterdog ist ein Tier. The Waterdog is a fully aquatic salamander found in eastern North America. Like the mudpuppy, it retains its external gills throughout life and is an important indicator of stream health.
waterdog.funFact: Waterdogs retain their external gills throughout their lives, a condition known as neoteny.

spring-salamander.name: Spring Salamander
spring-salamander.description: Spring Salamander ist ein Tier. The Spring Salamander is a large, robust salamander found in cold mountain streams of eastern North America. They have a distinctive salmon or orange coloration with dark reticulations.
spring-salamander.funFact: Spring Salamanders are one of the few salamander species that can live their entire lives in water.

cave-salamander.name: Cave Salamander
cave-salamander.description: Cave Salamander ist ein Tier. The Cave Salamander is a brightly colored salamander with orange to red body and black spots. Found in caves and rocky areas of the eastern United States, they are excellent climbers.
