cave-salamander.funFact: Cave Salamanders can climb vertical rock faces using their specialized toe pads.

arboreal-salamander.name: Arboreal Salamander
arboreal-salamander.description: Arboreal Salamander ist ein Tier. The Arboreal Salamander is a lungless salamander found in the coastal mountains of California. They are excellent climbers, spending much of their time in oak trees and rock crevices.
arboreal-salamander.funFact: Arboreal Salamanders can climb trees and have prehensile tails for gripping branches.

ensatina.name: Ensatina
ensatina.description: Ensatina ist ein Tier. The Ensatina is a colorful salamander found along the Pacific coast of North America. They are famous in evolutionary biology as an example of a ring species, with different color morphs forming a circle around California's Central Valley.
ensatina.funFact: Ensatina salamanders form a ring species around California's Central Valley, with different subspecies at each end.

slender-salamander.name: Slender Salamander
slender-salamander.description: Slender Salamander ist ein Tier. The Slender Salamander is a small, lungless salamander found in California. They have long, thin bodies and can coil into a spiral when disturbed or to prevent water loss.
slender-salamander.funFact: Slender Salamanders can coil into a tight spiral to conserve moisture.

ringed-salamander.name: Ringed Salamander
ringed-salamander.description: Ringed Salamander ist ein Tier. The Ringed Salamander is a large, dark salamander with yellow or white rings or spots. Found in the Ozark Plateau region of the United States, they are one of the few salamanders that breed in the fall.
ringed-salamander.funFact: Ringed Salamanders migrate to breed during autumn rains, one of the few fall-breeding amphibians.

flatwoods-salamander.name: Flatwoods Salamander
flatwoods-salamander.description: Flatwoods Salamander ist ein Tier. The Flatwoods Salamander is a small, threatened salamander found in the longleaf pine forests of the southeastern United States. They breed in temporary fishless ponds and are declining due to habitat loss.
flatwoods-salamander.funFact: Flatwoods Salamanders have a distinctive dark crossband pattern that helps them camouflage on the forest floor.

dusky-salamander.name: Dusky Salamander
dusky-salamander.description: Dusky Salamander ist ein Tier. The Dusky Salamander is a medium-sized lungless salamander found in eastern North America. They are variable in color and pattern and are often found near streams and springs.
dusky-salamander.funFact: Dusky Salamanders can autotomize their tails when threatened, which continue to wiggle and distract predators.

four-toed-salamander.name: Four-Toed Salamander
four-toed-salamander.description: Four-Toed Salamander ist ein Tier. The Four-Toed Salamander is a small salamander found in bogs and wetlands of eastern North America. They are the only salamander in their range with four toes on their hind feet.
four-toed-salamander.funFact: Four-Toed Salamanders have only four toes on their hind feet, unlike most salamanders which have five.

gulf-coast-salamander.name: Gulf Coast Salamander
gulf-coast-salamander.description: Gulf Coast Salamander ist ein Tier. The Gulf Coast Salamander is a small salamander found in the coastal lowlands of the southeastern United States. They are often found in bottomland hardwood forests and can tolerate mildly saline conditions.
gulf-coast-salamander.funFact: Gulf Coast Salamanders are one of the few salamander species that can tolerate slightly brackish water.

tropical-caecilian.name: Tropical Caecilian
tropical-caecilian.description: Tropical Caecilian ist ein Tier. Tropical Caecilians are limbless, serpentine amphibians found in tropical regions of the world. They live underground or in leaf litter, feeding on small invertebrates, and are the least known order of amphibians.
tropical-caecilian.funFact: Caecilians are often mistaken for snakes or worms, but they are actually limbless amphibians.

boulengers-caecilian.name: Boulenger's Caecilian
boulengers-caecilian.description: Boulenger's Caecilian ist ein Tier. Boulenger's Caecilian is one of the largest caecilian species, found in South America. These burrowing amphibians have ring-like grooves along their body and tiny, non-functional eyes buried beneath the skin.
boulengers-caecilian.funFact: Boulenger's Caecilians have minute vestigial eyes that can detect light but not form images.

ringed-caecilian.name: Ringed Caecilian
ringed-caecilian.description: Ringed Caecilian ist ein Tier. The Ringed Caecilian is a limbless amphibian found in South America and the Caribbean. They have a distinctive ring-like pattern on their body and use a chemosensory tentacle to find prey in the soil.
ringed-caecilian.funFact: Ringed Caecilians have a unique sensory organ called a tentacle that helps them detect prey underground.

luna-moth.name: Luna Moth
luna-moth.description: Luna Moth ist ein Tier. The luna moth is a large, pale green moth with long tail-like hindwings. It is nocturnal and attracted to light, and adults do not feed, dedicating their brief adult lives entirely to reproduction.
luna-moth.funFact: Luna moths do not have mouths and cannot eat as adults, living only on stored energy.

atlas-moth.name: Atlas Moth
atlas-moth.description: Atlas Moth ist ein Tier. The atlas moth is the largest moth species, with a wingspan that can exceed 12 inches. Its wings have snake-head-shaped tips that deter predators, and like other giant moths, adults do not feed.
atlas-moth.funFact: The atlas moth is one of the largest insects in the world by wing area.

swallowtail-butterfly.name: Eastern Tiger Swallowtail
swallowtail-butterfly.description: Eastern Tiger Swallowtail ist ein Tier. The eastern tiger swallowtail is a large, bright yellow butterfly with distinctive black tiger stripes. It is one of the most common and recognizable butterflies in eastern North America.
swallowtail-butterfly.funFact: Female swallowtails can mimic the toxic pipevine swallowtail to avoid predators.

hawk-moth.name: Hawk Moth
hawk-moth.description: Hawk Moth ist ein Tier. Hawk moths, also known as sphinx moths, are powerful fliers with streamlined bodies. Many species have extremely long proboscises for feeding on deep-throated flowers while hovering.
hawk-moth.funFact: Hawk moths are among the fastest flying insects, capable of hovering like hummingbirds.

painted-lady-butterfly.name: Painted Lady Butterfly
painted-lady-butterfly.description: Painted Lady Butterfly ist ein Tier. The painted lady is one of the most widespread butterflies on Earth, found on every continent except Antarctica. It is a strong migrant and a common visitor to gardens.
painted-lady-butterfly.funFact: Painted ladies migrate across the Sahara Desert and the Mediterranean Sea.

blue-morpho-butterfly.name: Blue Morpho Butterfly
blue-morpho-butterfly.description: Blue Morpho Butterfly ist ein Tier. The blue morpho is a brilliantly iridescent blue butterfly found in tropical rainforests. Its metallic blue wings are visible from great distances and are produced by light diffraction rather than pigment.
blue-morpho-butterfly.funFact: The morpho's blue color is not pigment but structural coloration from microscopic scales.

glasswing-butterfly.name: Glasswing Butterfly
glasswing-butterfly.description: Glasswing Butterfly ist ein Tier. The glasswing butterfly has remarkably transparent wings with only a thin dark border. The transparency is caused by tiny nanopillar structures on the wings that prevent light reflection.
glasswing-butterfly.funFact: The glasswing butterfly has nearly transparent wings due to nanopillar structures.

cecropia-moth.name: Cecropia Moth
cecropia-moth.description: Cecropia Moth ist ein Tier. The cecropia moth is North America's largest moth with wingspans reaching 7 inches. It has striking red, orange, and white markings and, like other giant moths, adults do not feed.
cecropia-moth.funFact: The cecropia moth is the largest native moth in North America.

io-moth.name: Io Moth
io-moth.description: Io Moth ist ein Tier. The io moth is a beautiful silk moth with large eyespots on each wing. Males are yellow while females are reddish-brown, and both sexes flash their eyespots when threatened.
io-moth.funFact: Each wing of the io moth has a large, striking eyespot that deters predators.

polyphemus-moth.name: Polyphemus Moth
polyphemus-moth.description: Polyphemus Moth ist ein Tier. The polyphemus moth is a large, tan-colored silk moth with distinctive eyespots on its hindwings. It is named after the Cyclops of Greek mythology due to the large eyespots.
polyphemus-moth.funFact: The polyphemus moth is named after the one-eyed Greek giant Polyphemus.

viceroy-butterfly.name: Viceroy Butterfly
viceroy-butterfly.description: Viceroy Butterfly ist ein Tier. The viceroy butterfly closely resembles the monarch and was long thought to be a mimic. It is now known to be somewhat distasteful to predators, making it a Müllerian mimic.
viceroy-butterfly.funFact: Viceroys mimic the toxic monarch butterfly for protection from predators.

red-admiral-butterfly.name: Red Admiral Butterfly
red-admiral-butterfly.description: Red Admiral Butterfly ist ein Tier. The red admiral is a striking black butterfly with bold red-orange bands and white spots. It is a strong flier found worldwide and often visits rotting fruit and tree sap.
red-admiral-butterfly.funFact: Red admirals are territorial and will chase other butterflies from their favorite basking spots.

great-spangled-fritillary.name: Great Spangled Fritillary
great-spangled-fritillary.description: Great Spangled Fritillary ist ein Tier. The great spangled fritillary is a large, orange butterfly with distinctive silver-spotted underwings. Its larvae feed on various violet species while adults nectar on milkweed and coneflowers.
great-spangled-fritillary.funFact: Fritillary caterpillars feed exclusively on violets, which is how the group got its name.

clouded-yellow-butterfly.name: Clouded Yellow
clouded-yellow-butterfly.description: Clouded Yellow ist ein Tier. The clouded yellow is a bright golden butterfly common across Europe and parts of Asia. It is a strong migratory species that sometimes appears in large numbers in areas outside its normal range.
clouded-yellow-butterfly.funFact: Clouded yellows are strong migrants that can travel hundreds of miles.

comma-butterfly.name: Comma Butterfly
comma-butterfly.description: Comma Butterfly ist ein Tier. The comma butterfly has uniquely ragged wing edges that help camouflage it as a dead leaf. It has a distinctive white comma-shaped mark on its dark brown underwings.
comma-butterfly.funFact: The comma butterfly is named for the small white comma-shaped mark on its underwings.

mourning-cloak-butterfly.name: Mourning Cloak Butterfly
mourning-cloak-butterfly.description: Mourning Cloak Butterfly ist ein Tier. The mourning cloak is one of the longest-lived butterflies, surviving up to 11 months. It overwinters as an adult and is often the first butterfly seen in spring, with dark wings bordered in yellow.
mourning-cloak-butterfly.funFact: The mourning cloak is one of the longest-lived butterflies and overwinters as an adult.

zebra-longwing-butterfly.name: Zebra Longwing Butterfly
zebra-longwing-butterfly.description: Zebra Longwing Butterfly ist ein Tier. The zebra longwing is a distinctive butterfly with black wings marked by pale yellow stripes. It is unique among butterflies in that adults can digest pollen, extending their lifespan significantly.
zebra-longwing-butterfly.funFact: Zebra longwings are the state butterfly of Florida and can live on pollen alone.

snowflake-butterfly.name: Snowflake Butterfly
snowflake-butterfly.description: Snowflake Butterfly ist ein Tier. The snowflake butterfly is a delicate white butterfly found in tropical forests. Its mostly white wings with small dark tips give it a graceful appearance as it glides through forest understory.
snowflake-butterfly.funFact: The snowflake butterfly has mostly white wings with delicate black tips.

resurrection-butterfly.name: Resurrection Butterfly
resurrection-butterfly.description: Resurrection Butterfly ist ein Tier. The resurrection butterfly, known as Kuroneko Yamane in Japan, is a medium-sized butterfly with distinctive markings. It has deep cultural significance in Japan as a symbol of love and resurrection.
resurrection-butterfly.funFact: The resurrection butterfly is considered a symbol of rebirth in Japanese culture.

cabbage-white-butterfly.name: Small White Butterfly
cabbage-white-butterfly.description: Small White Butterfly ist ein Tier. The small white butterfly is a widespread species often found in gardens and agricultural areas. Its caterpillars are major pests of cabbage and other brassica crops.
cabbage-white-butterfly.funFact: The small white is one of the most common butterflies in the world and a notorious garden pest.

atlas-beetle.name: Atlas Beetle
atlas-beetle.description: Atlas Beetle ist ein Tier. The atlas beetle is a large rhinoceros beetle native to Southeast Asian rainforests. Males have three prominent horns used in combat for mates, and they are among the strongest insects relative to size.
atlas-beetle.funFact: Atlas beetles can carry objects 850 times their own body weight.

goliath-beetle.name: Goliath Beetle
goliath-beetle.description: Goliath Beetle ist ein Tier. The goliath beetle is one of the largest and heaviest insects on Earth, found in African tropical forests. They feed on fruit and tree sap, and their larvae are among the heaviest grubs known.
goliath-beetle.funFact: Goliath beetles are among the heaviest insects in the world.

rhinoceros-beetle.name: Western Hercules Beetle
rhinoceros-beetle.description: Western Hercules Beetle ist ein Tier. The western hercules beetle is a large rhinoceros beetle found in the hardwood forests of North America. Males have a distinctive horn used for wrestling other males during mating season.
rhinoceros-beetle.funFact: Rhinoceros beetles can lift objects 850 times their own body weight.

stag-beetle.name: Stag Beetle
stag-beetle.description: Stag Beetle ist ein Tier. Stag beetles are named for the large, antler-like mandibles of the males. They spend most of their lives as larvae feeding on decaying wood underground before emerging as impressive adults.
stag-beetle.funFact: Male stag beetles use their enormous mandibles to wrestle rivals for mates.

dung-beetle.name: Scarab Dung Beetle
dung-beetle.description: Scarab Dung Beetle ist ein Tier. Dung beetles roll animal droppings into balls for food or breeding. They are essential decomposers that help recycle nutrients back into the soil and reduce parasite populations in pastures.
dung-beetle.funFact: Dung beetles navigate using the Milky Way, the first insects found to use stars.

tiger-beetle.name: Six-Spotted Tiger Beetle
tiger-beetle.description: Six-Spotted Tiger Beetle ist ein Tier. Tiger beetles are fast-running predatory beetles with large eyes and powerful jaws. They are voracious hunters of smaller insects and are often found on open, sunlit ground.
tiger-beetle.funFact: Tiger beetles run so fast they go temporarily blind because their eyes cannot process images quickly enough.

longhorn-beetle.name: Asian Longhorned Beetle
longhorn-beetle.description: Asian Longhorned Beetle ist ein Tier. The Asian longhorned beetle is an invasive species that attacks a wide variety of hardwood trees. It has distinctive black and white markings and very long antennae that exceed its body length.
longhorn-beetle.funFact: The Asian longhorned beetle can kill healthy hardwood trees by tunneling through their bark.

click-beetle.name: Click Beetle
click-beetle.description: Click Beetle ist ein Tier. Click beetles have a unique clicking mechanism on their thorax that allows them to snap and launch into the air when overturned. Their larvae, called wireworms, are important soil dwellers.
click-beetle.funFact: Click beetles can launch themselves into the air with a clicking mechanism without using their legs.

bombardier-beetle.name: Bombardier Beetle
bombardier-beetle.description: Bombardier Beetle ist ein Tier. The bombardier beetle defends itself by ejecting a hot, noxious chemical spray from its abdomen with an audible pop. The spray reaches temperatures near boiling and repels predators effectively.
bombardier-beetle.funFact: Bombardier beetles spray a boiling chemical spray at 212 degrees Fahrenheit from their abdomen.

june-bug.name: June Bug
june-bug.description: June Bug ist ein Tier. June bugs are chunky, brown beetles that emerge in late spring. They are attracted to lights at night and their larvae, known as white grubs, feed on grass roots and can damage lawns.
june-bug.funFact: June bugs are clumsy fliers and often bounce off windows and walls.

whirligig-beetle.name: Whirligig Beetle
whirligig-beetle.description: Whirligig Beetle ist ein Tier. Whirligig beetles are aquatic beetles that spin rapidly on the surface of calm water. They have split eyes adapted for both aerial and aquatic vision and are social insects that form groups.
whirligig-beetle.funFact: Whirligig beetles have four eyes: two for seeing above water and two for seeing below.

diving-beetle.name: Predaceous Diving Beetle
diving-beetle.description: Predaceous Diving Beetle ist ein Tier. Predaceous diving beetles are streamlined aquatic predators that hunt tadpoles, small fish, and other insects underwater. They trap air beneath their elytra for extended submerged hunting.
diving-beetle.funFact: Diving beetles carry an air bubble under their wing covers to breathe underwater.

oil-beetle.name: Oil Beetle
oil-beetle.description: Oil Beetle ist ein Tier. Oil beetles are flightless blister beetles that produce cantharidin, a toxic oily substance, from their joints. Their larvae parasitize solitary bees and develop inside their nests.
oil-beetle.funFact: Oil beetles secrete oily droplets from their joints that repel predators and can blister human skin.

bess-beetle.name: Bess Beetle
bess-beetle.description: Bess Beetle ist ein Tier. Bess beetles are large, shiny black beetles that live in decaying wood. They exhibit parental care, with adults feeding and caring for their larvae, which is unusual for beetles.
bess-beetle.funFact: Bess beetles communicate by rubbing their abdomen to make squeaking sounds.

bark-beetle.name: Mountain Pine Beetle
bark-beetle.description: Mountain Pine Beetle ist ein Tier. Mountain pine beetles are tiny bark beetles that bore into pine trees and introduce blue-stain fungi. Massive outbreaks have devastated millions of acres of forest in western North America.
bark-beetle.funFact: Mountain pine beetle outbreaks can kill millions of acres of forest in a single year.

sacred-scarab-beetle.name: Sacred Scarab Beetle
sacred-scarab-beetle.description: Sacred Scarab Beetle ist ein Tier. The sacred scarab beetle rolls dung into balls and was revered in ancient Egyptian culture as a symbol of rebirth and the sun's daily journey across the sky.
sacred-scarab-beetle.funFact: Ancient Egyptians revered the scarab as a symbol of the sun god Khepri.

carrion-beetle.name: American Carrion Beetle
carrion-beetle.description: American Carrion Beetle ist ein Tier. The American carrion beetle is a large, flat beetle that feeds on dead animals and snails. It plays an important ecological role in recycling nutrients back into the ecosystem.
carrion-beetle.funFact: Carrion beetles can locate a dead animal from over a mile away using chemical sensors.

patrol-bess-beetle.name: Patrol Bess Beetle
patrol-bess-beetle.description: Patrol Bess Beetle ist ein Tier. The patrol bess beetle is a large, glossy black beetle found in tropical rainforests. Like other passalid beetles, both parents work together to feed and care for their larvae.
patrol-bess-beetle.funFact: Patrol bess beetles produce sounds by rubbing ridges on their abdomen when disturbed.

eyed-click-beetle.name: Eyed Click Beetle
eyed-click-beetle.description: Eyed Click Beetle ist ein Tier. The eyed click beetle is a large click beetle with distinctive eyespots on its pronotum. When threatened, it clicks and flips into the air to right itself or escape danger.
eyed-click-beetle.funFact: The eyed click beetle has two large eyespots on its thorax that startle predators.

rose-chafer.name: Rose Chafer
rose-chafer.description: Rose Chafer ist ein Tier. The rose chafer is a metallic green beetle that feeds on flowers, especially roses and fruit blossoms. Despite being considered a pest, its larvae help decompose organic matter in soil.
rose-chafer.funFact: Rose chafers can fly with their elytra closed, using only their hind wings.

japanese-beetle.name: Japanese Beetle
japanese-beetle.description: Japanese Beetle ist ein Tier. The Japanese beetle is a highly invasive pest that skeletonizes leaves and damages turf with its white grub larvae. It is native to Japan and has become a devastating pest in North America.
japanese-beetle.funFact: Japanese beetles release aggregation pheromones that attract more beetles to feed.

colorado-potato-beetle.name: Colorado Potato Beetle
colorado-potato-beetle.description: Colorado Potato Beetle ist ein Tier. The Colorado potato beetle is a major agricultural pest that feeds on potatoes, tomatoes, and eggplants. It has developed resistance to over 50 different insecticides.
colorado-potato-beetle.funFact: The Colorado potato beetle is one of the most insecticide-resistant pests in the world.

lily-beetle.name: Scarlet Lily Beetle
lily-beetle.description: Scarlet Lily Beetle ist ein Tier. The scarlet lily beetle is a bright red pest of lily plants. Both adults and larvae feed on leaves, stems, and flowers, and the larvae cover themselves in their own excrement for protection.
lily-beetle.funFact: Lily beetles are bright red, making them easy to spot on green leaves.

elm-beetle.name: Elm Leaf Beetle
elm-beetle.description: Elm Leaf Beetle ist ein Tier. The elm leaf beetle skeletonizes elm tree leaves and is a significant urban pest. Adults often overwinter inside buildings, emerging in spring to feed on newly emerged elm leaves.
elm-beetle.funFact: Elm leaf beetles can enter homes through small cracks and hibernate indoors during winter.

fire-ant.name: Red Imported Fire Ant
fire-ant.description: Red Imported Fire Ant ist ein Tier. Red imported fire ants are invasive ants native to South America that deliver painful stings causing burning welts. They build large mound nests and can survive flooding by forming floating colonies.
fire-ant.funFact: Fire ant colonies can form living rafts that float on water for weeks during floods.

leafcutter-ant.name: Leafcutter Ant
leafcutter-ant.description: Leafcutter Ant ist ein Tier. Leafcutter ants cut and carry pieces of leaves back to their nests to feed a special fungus that they cultivate. They are sophisticated farmers with complex division of labor among castes.
leafcutter-ant.funFact: Leafcutter ants are the largest consumers of vegetation in the Neotropics.

bullet-ant.name: Bullet Ant
bullet-ant.description: Bullet Ant ist ein Tier. The bullet ant gets its name from the intense pain of its sting, which has been compared to being shot. Indigenous tribes use bullet ant stings in coming-of-age rituals.
bullet-ant.funFact: The bullet ant's sting is rated as the most painful insect sting in the world.

army-ant.name: Army Ant
army-ant.description: Army Ant ist ein Tier. Army ants are nomadic predators that form massive raiding swarms. They do not build permanent nests but instead form living bivouacs made of their own bodies while the colony rests.
army-ant.funFact: Army ant colonies of millions move in massive raiding columns that devour everything in their path.

trap-jaw-ant.name: Trap-Jaw Ant
trap-jaw-ant.description: Trap-Jaw Ant ist ein Tier. Trap-jaw ants have spring-loaded mandibles that snap shut at incredible speeds to capture prey and can also use the force to launch themselves into the air to escape predators.
trap-jaw-ant.funFact: Trap-jaw ants can snap their mandibles at speeds exceeding 140 mph.

weaver-ant.name: Weaver Ant
weaver-ant.description: Weaver Ant ist ein Tier. Weaver ants build elaborate nests by weaving living leaves together using silk produced by their larvae. They are aggressive defenders of their territory and tend honeydew-producing insects.
weaver-ant.funFact: Weaver ants use their own larvae as living glue guns to stitch leaves together.

honeybee.name: Western Honeybee
honeybee.description: Western Honeybee ist ein Tier. The western honeybee is the world's most important pollinator of agricultural crops. They live in highly organized colonies with complex social structures and produce honey and beeswax.
honeybee.funFact: A single honeybee colony can visit over 225,000 flowers to produce one pound of honey.

bumblebee.name: Common Bumblebee
bumblebee.description: Common Bumblebee ist ein Tier. Bumblebees are robust, fuzzy bees important for pollinating wildflowers and crops. They are capable of buzz pollination, vibrating their flight muscles to release pollen from flowers.
bumblebee.funFact: Bumblebees can fly in colder temperatures than most bees due to their ability to thermoregulate.

carpenter-bee.name: Eastern Carpenter Bee
carpenter-bee.description: Eastern Carpenter Bee ist ein Tier. Carpenter bees are large, solitary bees that bore into untreated wood to create nesting tunnels. Despite their intimidating size, they are gentle and rarely sting, preferring to hover near structures.
carpenter-bee.funFact: Carpenter bees drill perfectly round holes in wood to create nesting galleries.

paper-wasp.name: European Paper Wasp
paper-wasp.description: European Paper Wasp ist ein Tier. Paper wasps are slender wasps with long legs that build open-comb umbrella-shaped nests from wood pulp. They are beneficial predators of caterpillars but will sting if their nest is threatened.
paper-wasp.funFact: Paper wasps build their nests from chewed wood fibers mixed with saliva.

yellow-jacket.name: Common Yellow Jacket
yellow-jacket.description: Common Yellow Jacket ist ein Tier. Yellow jackets are aggressive wasps known for their bright yellow and black markings. They build enclosed paper nests and are notorious for scavenging at picnics and outdoor events.
yellow-jacket.funFact: Yellow jacket colonies can grow to contain 4,000 or more workers by late summer.

bald-faced-hornet.name: Bald-Faced Hornet
bald-faced-hornet.description: Bald-Faced Hornet ist ein Tier. Despite its name, the bald-faced hornet is actually a yellowjacket, not a true hornet. It builds large, enclosed paper nests high in trees and is known for its aggressive defense of its colony.
bald-faced-hornet.funFact: Bald-faced hornets can spray venom from their stingers up to several feet.

european-hornet.name: European Hornet
european-hornet.description: European Hornet ist ein Tier. The European hornet is the largest social wasp in Europe and an invasive species in North America. Queens can reach 1.4 inches in length, and colonies can contain up to 1,000 workers.
european-hornet.funFact: European hornets are attracted to light and will often fly into homes at night.

tarantula-hawk-wasp.name: Tarantula Hawk Wasp
tarantula-hawk-wasp.description: Tarantula Hawk Wasp ist ein Tier. The tarantula hawk is a large, metallic blue-black wasp that hunts tarantulas to serve as live food for its larvae. Its sting is excruciatingly painful but rarely dangerous to humans.
tarantula-hawk-wasp.funFact: The tarantula hawk has one of the most painful insect stings in the world.

cuckoo-wasp.name: Cuckoo Wasp
cuckoo-wasp.description: Cuckoo Wasp ist ein Tier. Cuckoo wasps are brilliant metallic blue or green parasitoids that lay their eggs in the nests of other bees and wasps. Their larvae consume the host's eggs or larvae and stored food.
cuckoo-wasp.funFact: Cuckoo wasps can curl into a ball when threatened, using their armored exoskeleton for protection.

ichneumon-wasp.name: Giant Ichneumon Wasp
ichneumon-wasp.description: Giant Ichneumon Wasp ist ein Tier. Giant ichneumon wasps are parasitoids that use their extremely long ovipositors to drill into wood and lay eggs inside wood-boring beetle larvae. Despite their fearsome appearance, they cannot sting humans.
ichneumon-wasp.funFact: The giant ichneumon's ovipositor can be longer than its body and drills through wood to reach beetle larvae.

asian-giant-hornet.name: Asian Giant Hornet
asian-giant-hornet.description: Asian Giant Hornet ist ein Tier. The Asian giant hornet, nicknamed the murder hornet, is the world's largest hornet. Its powerful sting delivers potent venom and it is a devastating predator of honeybee colonies.
asian-giant-hornet.funFact: The Asian giant hornet can decapitate an entire honeybee colony in hours.

sweat-bee.name: Sweat Bee
sweat-bee.description: Sweat Bee ist ein Tier. Sweat bees are small, often metallic-colored bees attracted to human perspiration for its salt content. They are important pollinators and nest in the ground or in hollow stems.
sweat-bee.funFact: Some sweat bees have metallic green or blue bodies that shimmer in the sunlight.

mason-bee.name: Blue Orchard Mason Bee
mason-bee.description: Blue Orchard Mason Bee ist ein Tier. The blue orchard mason bee is a solitary bee that nests in hollow tubes and crevices. It is a far more efficient pollinator than honeybees, visiting far more flowers per hour.
mason-bee.funFact: Mason bees are 100 times more efficient at pollinating than honeybees.

mining-bee.name: Tawny Mining Bee
mining-bee.description: Tawny Mining Bee ist ein Tier. Mining bees are solitary ground-nesting bees that excavate tunnels in soil. They emerge in spring and are important early-season pollinators of fruit trees and wildflowers.
mining-bee.funFact: Mining bees create small volcano-shaped mounds of soil at their nest entrances.

golden-digger-wasp.name: Golden Digger Wasp
golden-digger-wasp.description: Golden Digger Wasp ist ein Tier. The golden digger wasp is a large, metallic golden wasp that hunts grasshoppers and crickets. It buries paralyzed prey in underground nests for its developing larvae.
golden-digger-wasp.funFact: Golden digger wasps paralyze grasshoppers and crickets to feed their larvae alive.

mud-dauber-wasp.name: Mud Dauber Wasp
mud-dauber-wasp.description: Mud Dauber Wasp ist ein Tier. Mud dauber wasps are solitary wasps that construct tubular mud nests on sheltered surfaces. They hunt and paralyze spiders to stock each cell for their developing young.
mud-dauber-wasp.funFact: Mud daubers stock their nests with paralyzed spiders for their developing larvae.

horned-mason-bee.name: Horned Mason Bee
horned-mason-bee.description: Horned Mason Bee ist ein Tier. The horned mason bee is a solitary bee that nests in hollow stems and bee hotels. Males have distinctive facial horns and both sexes are important early-season pollinators.
horned-mason-bee.funFact: Male horned mason bees have small horns on their faces used in mating displays.

wool-carder-bee.name: Wool Carder Bee
wool-carder-bee.description: Wool Carder Bee ist ein Tier. Wool carder bees are solitary bees that collect plant hairs to line their nest cells. Males aggressively defend patches of fuzzy plants where females forage for nesting material.
wool-carder-bee.funFact: Wool carder bees scrape plant hairs to line their nests, hence their name.

cicada-killer-wasp.name: Cicada Killer Wasp
cicada-killer-wasp.description: Cicada Killer Wasp ist ein Tier. The cicada killer is a massive solitary wasp that hunts cicadas to provision its underground nest. Despite its intimidating size, it rarely stings humans unless provoked.
cicada-killer-wasp.funFact: The cicada killer is the largest wasp in North America and can be over 2 inches long.

red-velvet-ant.name: Red Velvet Ant
red-velvet-ant.description: Red Velvet Ant ist ein Tier. The red velvet ant is a wingless female wasp with a dense covering of bright red hairs. Despite its ant-like appearance, it is a parasitoid wasp whose sting is extremely painful.
red-velvet-ant.funFact: The velvet ant is actually a wingless wasp with one of the most painful stings in the insect world.

cuckoo-bumblebee.name: Cuckoo Bumblebee
cuckoo-bumblebee.description: Cuckoo Bumblebee ist ein Tier. Cuckoo bumblebees are social parasites that take over the nests of other bumblebee species. The female cuckoo bumblebee displaces the host queen and lays her own eggs for the workers to tend.
cuckoo-bumblebee.funFact: Cuckoo bumblebees infiltrate other bumblebee nests and lay their eggs for the host to raise.

mosquito.name: Asian Tiger Mosquito
mosquito.description: Asian Tiger Mosquito ist ein Tier. The Asian tiger mosquito is an invasive species that can transmit dengue, chikungunya, and Zika viruses. It is identified by its distinctive black and white striped body and legs.
mosquito.funFact: Only female mosquitoes bite, needing blood protein to produce eggs.

house-fly.name: Common House Fly
house-fly.description: Common House Fly ist ein Tier. The common house fly is one of the most widespread insects, closely associated with humans. It has sponging mouthparts for liquid feeding and can transmit numerous diseases.
house-fly.funFact: House flies taste with their feet and can detect food from miles away.

fruit-fly.name: Common Fruit Fly
fruit-fly.description: Common Fruit Fly ist ein Tier. The common fruit fly is tiny but remarkably important in scientific research. They reproduce rapidly and share many genes with humans, making them invaluable for studying genetics and disease.
fruit-fly.funFact: Fruit flies are one of the most important model organisms in genetics research.

crane-fly.name: Crane Fly
crane-fly.description: Crane Fly ist ein Tier. Crane flies are delicate, long-legged insects that resemble oversized mosquitoes. Adults are harmless and many do not feed at all, while their larvae, known as leatherjackets, live in soil.
crane-fly.funFact: Crane flies are often mistakenly called giant mosquitoes but do not bite or suck blood.

horsefly.name: Horse Fly
horsefly.description: Horse Fly ist ein Tier. Horse flies are large, powerful fliers with razor-sharp mouthparts that slash skin to feed on blood. Only females bite, and their painful bites can transmit diseases to livestock and humans.
horsefly.funFact: Horse flies are among the fastest flying insects, reaching speeds up to 90 mph.

bot-fly.name: Human Bot Fly
bot-fly.description: Human Bot Fly ist ein Tier. The human bot fly is a parasitic insect whose larvae develop beneath the skin of mammals, including humans. Adults do not bite; instead, they hijack mosquitoes to deliver their eggs to hosts.
bot-fly.funFact: Bot fly larvae develop under human skin, creating painful boils called myiasis.

hover-fly.name: Common Hover Fly
hover-fly.description: Common Hover Fly ist ein Tier. Hover flies are beneficial pollinators that mimic the appearance of stinging insects for protection. Their larvae are important predators of aphids, making them valuable in pest control.
hover-fly.funFact: Hover flies mimic bees and wasps for protection but are completely harmless.

black-fly.name: Black Fly
black-fly.description: Black Fly ist ein Tier. Black flies are tiny but relentless biting insects that breed in flowing water. In some regions they transmit river blindness and are considered one of the most important disease vectors.
black-fly.funFact: Black fly swarms can be so dense that they suffocate livestock by blocking their airways.

damselfly.name: Blue-Tailed Damselfly
damselfly.description: Blue-Tailed Damselfly ist ein Tier. Damselflies are slender, delicate relatives of dragonflies that hold their wings together above their body when resting. They are important aquatic ecosystem indicators and voracious mosquito predators.
damselfly.funFact: Damselflies fold their wings along their bodies when at rest, unlike dragonflies.

blue-dasher-dragonfly.name: Blue Dasher Dragonfly
blue-dasher-dragonfly.description: Blue Dasher Dragonfly ist ein Tier. The blue dasher is a small, common dragonfly with a blue-green body and distinctive wing pattern. It is an agile aerial predator that catches mosquitoes and other small insects on the wing.
blue-dasher-dragonfly.funFact: Blue dashers can fly backwards and hover in place like a helicopter.

emperor-dragonfly.name: Emperor Dragonfly
emperor-dragonfly.description: Emperor Dragonfly ist ein Tier. The emperor dragonfly is one of the largest and most powerful dragonflies in Europe. It patrols territories over water and feeds voraciously on mosquitoes, flies, and other flying insects.
emperor-dragonfly.funFact: Emperor dragonflies can eat their own body weight in insects every day.

four-spotted-chaser.name: Four-Spotted Chaser
four-spotted-chaser.description: Four-Spotted Chaser ist ein Tier. The four-spotted chaser is a robust dragonfly with distinctive dark spots on its wings. It is an aggressive territorial species that perches on vegetation to ambush passing prey.
four-spotted-chaser.funFact: Four-spotted chasers are among the first dragonflies to emerge in spring.

robber-fly.name: Robber Fly
robber-fly.description: Robber Fly ist ein Tier. Robber flies are aerial predators that intercept prey in flight. They inject victims with saliva that paralyzes and digests their insides, then suck out the liquefied contents.
robber-fly.funFact: Robber flies can capture and eat insects as large as dragonflies and grasshoppers.

marmalade-hoverfly.name: Marmalade Hoverfly
marmalade-hoverfly.description: Marmalade Hoverfly ist ein Tier. The marmalade hoverfly is a bee-mimic hoverfly that is an important pollinator. Its larvae are voracious aphid predators, making it doubly valuable in gardens and agriculture.
marmalade-hoverfly.funFact: Marmalade hoverflies migrate thousands of miles across Europe each year.

common-mosquito.name: Common Mosquito
common-mosquito.description: Common Mosquito ist ein Tier. Mosquitoes are small, buzzing flies that transmit deadly diseases including malaria, dengue, and Zika. Only females bite to obtain blood for egg production, while males feed on nectar.
common-mosquito.funFact: Mosquitoes are responsible for more human deaths than any other animal in history.

biting-midge.name: Biting Midge
biting-midge.description: Biting Midge ist ein Tier. Biting midges are tiny flies that deliver disproportionately painful bites. They are among the smallest biting flies and can be major pests in coastal and tropical regions.
biting-midge.funFact: Biting midges, or no-see-ums, are so small they can pass through standard window screens.

deer-fly.name: Deer Fly
deer-fly.description: Deer Fly ist ein Tier. Deer flies are fast-flying, aggressive biters with patterned wings. They transmit tularemia and can cause severe allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.
deer-fly.funFact: Deer flies are attracted to dark colors and carbon dioxide, similar to mosquitoes.

cattle-bot-fly.name: Cattle Bot Fly
cattle-bot-fly.description: Cattle Bot Fly ist ein Tier. The cattle bot fly is a parasitic fly whose larvae develop in the throats of cattle. Adults are bee-like in appearance and do not feed, living only long enough to reproduce.
cattle-bot-fly.funFact: Cattle bot fly larvae attach to the tongues and throat of cattle, causing significant irritation.

orchid-mantis.name: Orchid Mantis
orchid-mantis.description: Orchid Mantis ist ein Tier. The orchid mantis is a stunning pink and white mantis that mimics orchid flowers to ambush pollinators. It is considered one of the most beautiful insects in the world.
orchid-mantis.funFact: The orchid mantis looks so much like a flower that pollinators land directly on it.

ghost-mantis.name: Ghost Mantis
ghost-mantis.description: Ghost Mantis ist ein Tier. The ghost mantis is a master of camouflage with a body shaped and colored to resemble a dried leaf. It sways gently to mimic a leaf in the wind, hiding from both predators and prey.
ghost-mantis.funFact: The ghost mantis looks exactly like a dried, dead leaf, making it nearly invisible.

leaf-mantis.name: Dead Leaf Mantis
leaf-mantis.description: Dead Leaf Mantis ist ein Tier. The dead leaf mantis is a large, spectacular mantis with a flattened body resembling a dead leaf. It is an ambush predator that waits motionless for prey to come within striking distance.
leaf-mantis.funFact: The dead leaf mantis has irregular body edges that perfectly replicate a torn, decaying leaf.

walking-stick.name: Common Walking Stick
walking-stick.description: Common Walking Stick ist ein Tier. Walking sticks are elongated, camouflaged insects that resemble twigs or branches. They are nocturnal herbivores that rely on their extraordinary disguise to avoid detection by predators.
walking-stick.funFact: Walking sticks can regenerate lost limbs during molts and some species produce toxic defensive chemicals.

giant-walking-stick.name: Giant Walking Stick
giant-walking-stick.description: Giant Walking Stick ist ein Tier. The giant walking stick, also known as Chan's megastick, is the longest insect species, with females reaching over 14 inches including legs. It is native to Borneo's tropical rainforests.
giant-walking-stick.funFact: The giant walking stick holds the record for the longest insect in the world.

american-cockroach.name: American Cockroach
american-cockroach.description: American Cockroach ist ein Tier. The American cockroach is the largest common cockroach found in human habitations. Despite its name, it originated in Africa and is now found worldwide in warm, moist environments.
american-cockroach.funFact: Cockroaches can survive for weeks without food and hold their breath for 40 minutes.

german-cockroach.name: German Cockroach
german-cockroach.description: German Cockroach ist ein Tier. The German cockroach is the most troublesome indoor cockroach species worldwide. It reproduces rapidly, is resistant to many insecticides, and contaminates food and surfaces with pathogens.
german-cockroach.funFact: German cockroaches can produce up to 30,000 offspring in a single year from one female.

madagascar-hissing-cockroach.name: Madagascar Hissing Cockroach
madagascar-hissing-cockroach.description: Madagascar Hissing Cockroach ist ein Tier. The Madagascar hissing cockroach is one of the largest cockroach species, reaching 3 inches long. It is famous for the loud hissing sound it produces when disturbed, used for defense and communication.
madagascar-hissing-cockroach.funFact: Madagascar hissing cockroaches produce a loud hiss by forcing air through specialized breathing holes.

oriental-cockroach.name: Oriental Cockroach
oriental-cockroach.description: Oriental Cockroach ist ein Tier. The oriental cockroach is a large, dark species that prefers cool, damp environments. It is a scavenger that feeds on decaying organic matter and is associated with poor sanitation.
oriental-cockroach.funFact: Oriental cockroaches are sometimes called water bugs because they prefer damp, dark environments.

eastern-subterranean-termite.name: Eastern Subterranean Termite
eastern-subterranean-termite.description: Eastern Subterranean Termite ist ein Tier. Eastern subterranean termites are the most destructive termite species in North America. They live in underground colonies and build mud tubes to reach wood structures above ground.
eastern-subterranean-termite.funFact: Subterranean termite colonies can contain millions of individuals working together.

formosan-termite.name: Formosan Subterranean Termite
formosan-termite.description: Formosan Subterranean Termite ist ein Tier. The Formosan termite is one of the most destructive termite species, capable of consuming enormous amounts of wood. Unlike most termites, it can build above-ground nests, making it especially destructive.
formosan-termite.funFact: Formosan termites build carton nests above ground and can consume a foot of 2x4 lumber in about five months.

dampwood-termite.name: Dampwood Termite
dampwood-termite.description: Dampwood Termite ist ein Tier. Dampwood termites infest moist, decaying wood and are indicators of excessive moisture problems. They are larger than subterranean termites and do not build mud tubes.
dampwood-termite.funFact: Dampwood termites are the largest North American termites and do not require soil contact.

drywood-termite.name: Drywood Termite
drywood-termite.description: Drywood Termite ist ein Tier. Drywood termites live entirely within the wood they consume and do not require soil contact. They are difficult to detect and treat because colonies can be scattered throughout a structure.
drywood-termite.funFact: Drywood termites kick out tiny fecal pellets called frass that accumulate below infested wood.

cicada.name: Periodical Cicada
cicada.description: Periodical Cicada ist ein Tier. Periodical cicadas are famous for their synchronized mass emergences every 13 or 17 years. They are the longest-lived insects and their emergences create deafening choruses heard for miles.
cicada.funFact: Periodical cicadas emerge in synchronized broods of billions after 13 or 17 years underground.

dog-day-cicada.name: Dog-Day Cicada
dog-day-cicada.description: Dog-Day Cicada ist ein Tier. Dog-day cicadas are annual cicadas that emerge each summer, unlike their periodical cousins. Their loud buzzing songs fill late summer afternoons in eastern North America.
dog-day-cicada.funFact: Dog-day cicadas get their name because they emerge during the dog days of summer.

masked-devil-cicada.name: Masked Devil Cicada
masked-devil-cicada.description: Masked Devil Cicada ist ein Tier. The masked devil cicada is an Australian species known for its distinctive facial markings. Like other cicadas, it spends years underground before emerging for a brief, noisy adult life.
masked-devil-cicada.funFact: Some Australian cicada species have the loudest insect calls, exceeding 120 decibels.

leafhopper.name: Brown Planthopper
leafhopper.description: Brown Planthopper ist ein Tier. The brown planthopper is a major pest of rice crops in Asia. It feeds on plant sap and transmits the devastating rice ragged stunt virus and rice grassy stunt virus.
leafhopper.funFact: Brown planthoppers can jump 70 times their body length in a single leap.

spittlebug.name: Meadow Spittlebug
spittlebug.description: Meadow Spittlebug ist ein Tier. Spittlebugs get their name from the frothy foam masses their nymphs produce on plant stems. These nymphs, called froghoppers, are sap-sucking insects that can transmit plant diseases.
spittlebug.funFact: Spittlebug nymphs produce foamy saliva masses called cuckoo spit to protect themselves.

aphid.name: Green Peach Aphid
aphid.description: Green Peach Aphid ist ein Tier. The green peach aphid is one of the most destructive agricultural pests worldwide. It reproduces rapidly through asexual reproduction and transmits over 100 plant viruses.
aphid.funFact: Aphids can produce up to 80 offspring per female without mating through parthenogenesis.

bed-bug.name: Common Bed Bug
bed-bug.description: Common Bed Bug ist ein Tier. Bed bugs are parasitic insects that feed on human blood at night. They hide in mattress seams, furniture, and wall cracks, and their populations have surged worldwide due to pesticide resistance.
bed-bug.funFact: Bed bugs can survive for over a year without feeding and are resistant to many pesticides.

kissing-bug.name: Triatomine Bug
kissing-bug.description: Triatomine Bug ist ein Tier. Triatomine bugs, also known as kissing bugs, are vectors of Chagas disease. They feed on blood at night and transmit the parasite Trypanosoma cruzi through their feces.
kissing-bug.funFact: Kissing bugs are called so because they often bite people on the face while they sleep.

stink-bug.name: Brown Marmorated Stink Bug
stink-bug.description: Brown Marmorated Stink Bug ist ein Tier. The brown marmorated stink bug is an invasive species from Asia that has become a major agricultural pest in North America. It damages fruit crops and invades homes in winter seeking shelter.
stink-bug.funFact: Stink bugs release a foul-smelling chemical from glands on their thorax when disturbed.

box-elder-bug.name: Box Elder Bug
box-elder-bug.description: Box Elder Bug ist ein Tier. Box elder bugs are black insects with red markings that feed on box elder tree seeds. They become nuisances in fall when they cluster on buildings seeking warmth for winter.
box-elder-bug.funFact: Box elder bugs aggregate in huge numbers on warm south-facing walls in autumn.

water-strider.name: Common Water Strider
water-strider.description: Common Water Strider ist ein Tier. Water striders are insects that glide across the surface of calm water using surface tension. Their hydrophobic leg hairs create air cushions that keep them afloat while they hunt prey.
water-strider.funFact: Water striders can walk on water due to microscopic hairs on their legs that trap air.

giant-water-bug.name: Giant Water Bug
giant-water-bug.description: Giant Water Bug ist ein Tier. Giant water bugs are large, flat-bodied aquatic predators that prey on fish, frogs, and snakes. Males carry eggs on their backs and are sometimes called electric-light bugs for their attraction to lights.
giant-water-bug.funFact: Giant water bugs are called toe-biters and can deliver an extremely painful bite.

american-grasshopper.name: American Bird Grasshopper
american-grasshopper.description: American Bird Grasshopper ist ein Tier. The American bird grasshopper is a large, strong-flying grasshopper that feeds on a wide variety of plants. It gets its name from its bird-like flight and large size.
american-grasshopper.funFact: Bird grasshoppers are strong fliers and can travel significant distances during migrations.

desert-locust.name: Desert Locust
desert-locust.description: Desert Locust ist ein Tier. The desert locust is the most destructive of all locust species. Under certain conditions it transforms from a solitary grasshopper into a gregarious swarming phase capable of devastating crops.
desert-locust.funFact: Desert locust swarms can cover 460 square miles and contain 40 to 80 billion insects.

mormon-cricket.name: Mormon Cricket
mormon-cricket.description: Mormon Cricket ist ein Tier. The Mormon cricket is not a cricket but a large shield-backed katydid that forms migrating bands of billions. They were named after Mormon settlers whose crops they devastated in the 1840s.
mormon-cricket.funFact: Despite their name, Mormon crickets are actually shield-backed katydids, not true crickets.

field-cricket.name: Field Cricket
field-cricket.description: Field Cricket ist ein Tier. Field crickets are known for their distinctive chirping songs produced by males to attract mates. They are omnivorous scavengers that feed on plants, fungi, and other insects.
field-cricket.funFact: Male field crickets chirp by rubbing their wings together, and you can estimate temperature by counting chirps.

katydid.name: True Katydid
katydid.description: True Katydid ist ein Tier. True katydids are named after their call, said to sound like Katy-did, Katy-didn't. They are leaf-mimicking insects that produce loud, clicking songs at ultrasonic frequencies.
katydid.funFact: Katydid songs are ultrasonic, making them difficult for humans to hear without special equipment.

mole-cricket.name: European Mole Cricket
mole-cricket.description: European Mole Cricket ist ein Tier. Mole crickets are burrowing insects with powerful, shovel-like forelegs adapted for digging through soil. They damage lawns and crops by feeding on roots and disrupting soil structure.
mole-cricket.funFact: Mole crickets can swim and fly, making them highly mobile pests of turfgrass.

snowy-tree-cricket.name: Snowy Tree Cricket
snowy-tree-cricket.description: Snowy Tree Cricket ist ein Tier. The snowy tree cricket produces a pure, musical trill and is famous for its temperature-dependent chirping rate. Dolbear's Law uses its chirps to estimate ambient temperature.
snowy-tree-cricket.funFact: The snowy tree cricket is known as the thermometer cricket because chirp rate correlates with temperature.

human-head-louse.name: Human Head Louse
human-head-louse.description: Human Head Louse ist ein Tier. Human head lice are parasitic insects that live on the scalp and feed on blood. They are wingless and highly adapted to life on humans, spreading through direct head-to-head contact.
human-head-louse.funFact: Head lice have been companions of humans for at least 10,000 years.

body-louse.name: Human Body Louse
body-louse.description: Human Body Louse ist ein Tier. Human body lice live in clothing and emerge to feed on blood. Unlike head lice, they can transmit serious diseases including typhus, trench fever, and relapsing fever.
body-louse.funFact: Body lice have been used to track human migration patterns through DNA analysis.

human-flea.name: Human Flea
human-flea.description: Human Flea ist ein Tier. The human flea, Pulex irritans, is the original flea species associated with humans. It is a blood-feeding parasite that can transmit diseases and has been a companion of humans for millennia.
human-flea.funFact: Fleas can jump up to 150 times their body length, equivalent to a human jumping over a skyscraper.

cat-flea.name: Cat Flea
cat-flea.description: Cat Flea ist ein Tier. The cat flea is the most common flea species affecting domestic cats and dogs. Despite its name, it infests many mammal species and can cause allergic dermatitis and transmit tapeworms.
cat-flea.funFact: Cat fleas are the most common flea species on domestic pets worldwide.

oriental-rat-flea.name: Oriental Rat Flea
oriental-rat-flea.description: Oriental Rat Flea ist ein Tier. The oriental rat flea is historically the most important disease vector among fleas, having transmitted bubonic plague during the Black Death. It feeds primarily on rats and other rodents.
oriental-rat-flea.funFact: The oriental rat flea was the primary vector of bubonic plague during the Black Death.

brown-recluse-spider.name: Brown Recluse Spider
brown-recluse-spider.description: Brown Recluse Spider ist ein Tier. The brown recluse spider has a violin-shaped marking on its cephalothorax and venom that can cause tissue death. It is reclusive and bites only when pressed against skin.
brown-recluse-spider.funFact: Brown recluse venom can cause necrotic lesions that take months to heal.

wolf-spider.name: Common Wolf Spider
wolf-spider.description: Common Wolf Spider ist ein Tier. Wolf spiders are agile, ground-hunting spiders that do not build webs. They have excellent vision and chase down their prey, and females are notable for carrying their young on their backs.
wolf-spider.funFact: Wolf spider mothers carry their egg sacs and spiderlings on their backs.

jumping-spider.name: Bold Jumping Spider
jumping-spider.description: Bold Jumping Spider ist ein Tier. Bold jumping spiders are charismatic, fuzzy spiders with large forward-facing eyes. They are active hunters that stalk prey and leap to capture it, displaying complex courtship dances.
jumping-spider.funFact: Jumping spiders have the best vision of any spider and can jump 50 times their body length.

orb-weaver-spider.name: Garden Orb Weaver Spider
orb-weaver-spider.description: Garden Orb Weaver Spider ist ein Tier. Garden orb weavers are among the most common web-building spiders. They create distinctive circular webs and are beneficial predators of flying insects in gardens and natural areas.
orb-weaver-spider.funFact: Orb weavers rebuild their webs almost every night, consuming the old silk to recycle the proteins.

peacock-spider.name: Peacock Spider
peacock-spider.description: Peacock Spider ist ein Tier. Peacock spiders are tiny jumping spiders famous for the males' spectacular iridescent abdominal flaps used in elaborate courtship dances. Females will eat males who fail to impress.
peacock-spider.funFact: Male peacock spiders perform elaborate dance displays with colorful abdominal flaps to court females.

brazilian-wandering-spider.name: Brazilian Wandering Spider
brazilian-wandering-spider.description: Brazilian Wandering Spider ist ein Tier. The Brazilian wandering spider is considered the world's most venomous spider. Unlike web-building spiders, it actively wanders the forest floor at night and can deliver a medically significant bite.
brazilian-wandering-spider.funFact: The Brazilian wandering spider has the most potent venom of any spider and is listed in Guinness World Records.

emperor-scorpion.name: Emperor Scorpion
emperor-scorpion.description: Emperor Scorpion ist ein Tier. The emperor scorpion is one of the largest scorpion species and one of the most popular in the pet trade. Despite its intimidating size, its venom is relatively mild and it is generally docile.
emperor-scorpion.funFact: Emperor scorpions glow bright blue-green under ultraviolet light.

bark-scorpion.name: Arizona Bark Scorpion
bark-scorpion.description: Arizona Bark Scorpion ist ein Tier. The Arizona bark scorpion is the most dangerous scorpion in North America. It is unique among scorpions in its ability to climb walls and ceilings, often entering homes through plumbing.
bark-scorpion.funFact: Arizona bark scorpions are the most venomous scorpion in North America and can climb walls and ceilings.

deathstalker-scorpion.name: Deathstalker Scorpion
deathstalker-scorpion.description: Deathstalker Scorpion ist ein Tier. The deathstalker is one of the most venomous scorpions in the world. Its potent neurotoxic venom can be fatal to humans, but its venom compounds show promise in medical research.
deathstalker-scorpion.funFact: The deathstalker's venom contains compounds being researched for use in cancer treatment.

spotted-lanternfly.name: Spotted Lanternfly
spotted-lanternfly.description: Spotted Lanternfly ist ein Tier. The spotted lanternfly is an invasive planthopper from Asia that feeds on over 70 plant species, threatening agriculture. Adults have distinctive spotted wings and bright red hind wings.
spotted-lanternfly.funFact: Spotted lanternflies can lay up to 50 eggs on almost any flat surface.

wheel-bug.name: Wheel Bug
wheel-bug.description: Wheel Bug ist ein Tier. The wheel bug is a large, beneficial predatory insect with a distinctive semicircular crest on its thorax. It uses its proboscis to inject digestive enzymes into prey and is a natural pest controller.
wheel-bug.funFact: The wheel bug gets its name from the distinctive cogwheel-like crest on its thorax.

sawfly.name: Rose Slug Sawfly
sawfly.description: Rose Slug Sawfly ist ein Tier. Sawflies are wasp-like insects whose larvae feed on plant foliage, resembling caterpillars. The rose slug sawfly can skeletonize rose leaves, causing significant damage to gardens.
sawfly.funFact: Sawfly larvae look like caterpillars but have more than five pairs of prolegs.

antlion.name: Antlion
antlion.description: Antlion ist ein Tier. Antlions are insects whose larvae are famous for digging conical pitfall traps in sand. They wait at the bottom of the pit for prey to fall in, then inject digestive enzymes.
antlion.funFact: Antlion larvae dig conical pit traps in sand to catch ants and other small insects.

lacewing.name: Green Lacewing
lacewing.description: Green Lacewing ist ein Tier. Green lacewings are delicate, golden-green insects with lace-like wings. Their larvae are voracious predators of aphids and other soft-bodied pests, making them valuable biological control agents.
lacewing.funFact: Lacewing larvae are called aphid lions and can each consume 200 aphids per week.

dobsonfly.name: Eastern Dobsonfly
dobsonfly.description: Eastern Dobsonfly ist ein Tier. The eastern dobsonfly is a large, impressive insect with enormous wings and males have extremely long mandibles. The aquatic larvae are important food for trout and indicators of stream health.
dobsonfly.funFact: Dobsonfly larvae, called hellgrammites, are indicators of good water quality.

mayfly.name: Mayfly
mayfly.description: Mayfly ist ein Tier. Mayflies are aquatic insects with extremely short adult lifespans dedicated solely to reproduction. Their larvae are important indicators of water quality and food for fish.
mayfly.funFact: Adult mayflies have vestigial mouthparts and cannot eat, living only long enough to mate.

earwig.name: Common European Earwig
earwig.description: Common European Earwig ist ein Tier. The common European earwig is a nocturnal insect with distinctive pincer-like cerci on its abdomen. Despite myths, earwigs do not burrow into human ears, and mothers provide notable parental care.
earwig.funFact: Earwig mothers guard their eggs and clean them to prevent fungal growth.

silverfish.name: Common Silverfish
silverfish.description: Common Silverfish ist ein Tier. Silverfish are small, wingless, silver-colored insects that damage paper, textiles, and food. They are nocturnal and thrive in warm, humid environments like bathrooms and basements.
silverfish.funFact: Silverfish are among the most primitive wingless insects, virtually unchanged for 400 million years.

firebrat.name: Firebrat
firebrat.description: Firebrat ist ein Tier. Firebrats are close relatives of silverfish that prefer much warmer environments. They are found near heat sources like furnaces and water heaters and feed on starchy materials.
firebrat.funFact: Firebrats prefer temperatures above 90 degrees Fahrenheit and can survive scorching conditions.

jumping-bristletail.name: Jumping Bristletail
jumping-bristletail.description: Jumping Bristletail ist ein Tier. Jumping bristletails are small, wingless insects that can jump by curling their abdomen. They are found in moist environments and feed on algae, lichens, and decaying plant matter.
jumping-bristletail.funFact: Jumping bristletails are among the most ancient insects, with a fossil record dating back 400 million years.

snakefly.name: Snakefly
snakefly.description: Snakefly ist ein Tier. Snakeflies are predatory insects with an elongated prothorax that gives them a snake-like appearance. Both adults and larvae are beneficial predators of pest insects on trees.
snakefly.funFact: Snakefly larvae can crawl backwards at high speed to escape threats.

cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.name: Bombus Bob
cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.description: Bombus Bob ist ein Tier. This cuckoo bumblebee species is a social parasite that takes over nests of other bumblebee species. The female enters a host nest, kills or displaces the queen, and uses the existing workers.
cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.funFact: Some cuckoo bumblebee species have been reclassified as entirely separate species from their hosts.

musk-bee.name: Musk Bee
musk-bee.description: Musk Bee ist ein Tier. The musk bee is a solitary ground-nesting bee known for its distinctive musky scent. It emerges in late summer and is an important pollinator of goldenrod and other fall wildflowers.
musk-bee.funFact: Musk bees produce a distinctive lemony scent when disturbed.

alkali-bee.name: Alkali Bee
alkali-bee.description: Alkali Bee ist ein Tier. The alkali bee is a solitary ground-nesting bee that prefers alkaline soils near salt flats. It is an excellent pollinator of alfalfa and has been managed commercially for this purpose.
alkali-bee.funFact: Alkali bees prefer salty, alkaline soil for nesting and can form massive aggregations.

carpenter-ant.name: Black Carpenter Ant
carpenter-ant.description: Black Carpenter Ant ist ein Tier. Black carpenter ants are large ants that excavate nests in moist, decaying wood. Unlike termites, they do not consume wood but can cause structural damage by hollowing out timbers.
carpenter-ant.funFact: Carpenter ants do not eat wood but excavate it to create nesting galleries.

pharaoh-ant.name: Pharaoh Ant
pharaoh-ant.description: Pharaoh Ant ist ein Tier. Pharaoh ants are tiny, pale-colored invasive ants that are particularly problematic in hospitals and food facilities. They form huge colonies with multiple queens and bud frequently.
pharaoh-ant.funFact: Pharaoh ants can nest in extremely small spaces and are known to spread disease in hospitals.

odorous-house-ant.name: Odorous House Ant
odorous-house-ant.description: Odorous House Ant ist ein Tier. Odorous house ants are common household ants that emit a distinctive coconut-like odor when crushed. They form large colonies and frequently nest inside walls and under floors.
odorous-house-ant.funFact: Odorous house ants smell like crushed coconut when squished.

blue-ringed-octopus.name: Blue-Ringed Octopus
blue-ringed-octopus.description: Blue-Ringed Octopus ist ein Tier. The blue-ringed octopus is a small but deadly cephalopod native to coral reefs. Despite its diminutive size, its bright blue rings serve as a warning of its highly potent venom.
blue-ringed-octopus.funFact: Its venom contains tetrodotoxin, potent enough to kill 26 humans.

mimic-octopus.name: Mimic Octopus
mimic-octopus.description: Mimic Octopus ist ein Tier. The mimic octopus is a master of disguise, capable of altering its shape, color, and behavior to resemble other marine animals. It was only discovered in 1998 off the coast of Indonesia.
mimic-octopus.funFact: Can impersonate over 15 different species including lionfish and sea snakes.

colossal-squid.name: Colossal Squid
colossal-squid.description: Colossal Squid ist ein Tier. The colossal squid is one of the largest invertebrates on Earth, inhabiting the frigid deep waters of the Antarctic. Its massive eyes are adapted to detect light in the perpetual darkness of the deep sea.
colossal-squid.funFact: Has the largest eyes of any animal, up to 10 inches in diameter.

humboldt-squid.name: Humboldt Squid
humboldt-squid.description: Humboldt Squid ist ein Tier. The Humboldt squid is a large, aggressive cephalopod named after the Humboldt Current. It hunts in packs and is known for its rapid growth rate and voracious appetite.
humboldt-squid.funFact: Also called the jumbo squid or red devil for its aggressive nature.

giant-squid.name: Giant Squid
giant-squid.description: Giant Squid ist ein Tier. The giant squid is one of the most mysterious creatures of the deep ocean. With eyes the size of dinner plates and tentacles reaching over 40 feet, it is a legendary predator of the abyss.
giant-squid.funFact: Was considered a mythical creature until first photographed alive in 2004.

firefly-squid.name: Firefly Squid
firefly-squid.description: Firefly Squid ist ein Tier. The firefly squid is a small cephalopod famous for its bioluminescence. Each spring millions gather in Toyama Bay, Japan, creating a spectacular natural light show.
firefly-squid.funFact: Produces its own light through bioluminescent organs called photophores.

caribbean-reef-octopus.name: Caribbean Reef Octopus
caribbean-reef-octopus.description: Caribbean Reef Octopus ist ein Tier. The Caribbean reef octopus is a nocturnal predator that hunts crustaceans and small fish among coral formations. Its chromatophores allow rapid color changes for communication and camouflage.
caribbean-reef-octopus.funFact: Has two-thirds of its neurons in its arms rather than its brain.

flamboyant-cuttlefish.name: Flamboyant Cuttlefish
flamboyant-cuttlefish.description: Flamboyant Cuttlefish ist ein Tier. The flamboyant cuttlefish is a small, vibrantly colored cephalopod that walks along the seafloor on its tentacles. It displays pulsating patterns of yellow, maroon, and white as a warning to predators.
flamboyant-cuttlefish.funFact: One of only two known poisonous cephalopods.

common-cuttlefish.name: Common Cuttlefish
common-cuttlefish.description: Common Cuttlefish ist ein Tier. The common cuttlefish is a highly intelligent cephalopod with W-shaped pupils and an internal cuttlebone used for buoyancy. It is renowned for its extraordinary ability to change color and texture.
common-cuttlefish.funFact: Can hypnotize prey with rapidly changing color patterns.

chambered-nautilus.name: Chambered Nautilus
chambered-nautilus.description: Chambered Nautilus ist ein Tier. The chambered nautilus is a cephalopod often called a living fossil, having existed since before the dinosaurs. Its beautiful spiral shell is divided into chambers used for buoyancy control.
chambered-nautilus.funFact: Has remained virtually unchanged for over 500 million years.

argonaut.name: Argonaut
argonaut.description: Argonaut ist ein Tier. The argonaut, or paper nautilus, is a pelagic octopus where only females produce a delicate calcareous shell. Males are much smaller and lack shells entirely.
argonaut.funFact: Females create a paper-thin shell for egg protection, the only octopus to do so.

vampire-squid.name: Vampire Squid
vampire-squid.description: Vampire Squid ist ein Tier. The vampire squid inhabits the deep ocean's oxygen minimum zones. Despite its name, it feeds on marine snow rather than prey, and can turn itself inside out as a defense mechanism.
vampire-squid.funFact: Is neither a true squid nor a true octopus but occupies its own order.

strawberry-squid.name: Strawberry Squid
strawberry-squid.description: Strawberry Squid ist ein Tier. The strawberry squid is a deep-sea cephalopod covered in light-producing photophores. Its red coloring is invisible in the deep ocean, providing effective camouflage against predators.
strawberry-squid.funFact: Has photophores covering its body that produce a strawberry-red glow to camouflage against predators.

cockatoo-squid.name: Cockatoo Squid
cockatoo-squid.description: Cockatoo Squid ist ein Tier. The cockatoo squid is a small, translucent deep-sea cephalopod that inflates its body like a balloon when threatened. Its distinctive appearance resembles a cockatoo with its arms raised.
cockatoo-squid.funFact: Inflates its body with seawater to appear larger and more intimidating to predators.

pajama-squid.name: Pajama Squid
pajama-squid.description: Pajama Squid ist ein Tier. The pajama squid is a small, nocturnal cephalopod with distinctive black and white stripes. It buries itself in sand during the day and emerges at night to hunt small crustaceans.
pajama-squid.funFact: Has a distinctive black-and-white striped pattern resembling striped pajamas.

bobtail-squid.name: Bobtail Squid
bobtail-squid.description: Bobtail Squid ist ein Tier. Bobtail squids are small, round cephalopods that partner with bioluminescent bacteria. The bacteria produce light that matches the moonlight from above, eliminating the squid's shadow.
bobtail-squid.funFact: Harbors bioluminescent bacteria in a specialized light organ for counter-illumination camouflage.

pygmy-squid.name: Pygmy Squid
pygmy-squid.description: Pygmy Squid ist ein Tier. The pygmy squid is one of the smallest cephalopods, reaching barely an inch long. It uses a special adhesive gland to attach itself to seagrass blades, waiting to ambush passing prey.
pygmy-squid.funFact: Uses a sticky gland on its nose to attach itself to seagrass blades.

american-lobster.name: American Lobster
american-lobster.description: American Lobster ist ein Tier. The American lobster is a large marine crustacean prized as a delicacy. It uses its powerful claws for defense and crushing prey, and can regenerate lost limbs during molting.
american-lobster.funFact: Can live over 100 years and keep growing throughout its life.

european-lobster.name: European Lobster
european-lobster.description: European Lobster ist ein Tier. The European lobster is a large, deep-blue crustacean found along rocky coastlines. It is a solitary nocturnal hunter that preys on fish, crabs, and mollusks.
european-lobster.funFact: Can weigh up to 28 pounds and is one of the largest crustaceans in European waters.

spiny-lobster.name: Spiny Lobster
spiny-lobster.description: Spiny Lobster ist ein Tier. Spiny lobsters are colorful crustaceans found in tropical marine environments. Unlike true lobsters, they lack large front claws and instead rely on their spiny antennae and a unique alarm call.
spiny-lobster.funFact: Lacks large claws and instead produces loud rasping sounds to deter predators.

slipper-lobster.name: Slipper Lobster
slipper-lobster.description: Slipper Lobster ist ein Tier. Slipper lobsters are robust crustaceans recognized by their flattened, slipper-shaped antennae. They are bottom-dwellers that hunt mollusks and other invertebrates at night.
slipper-lobster.funFact: Has distinctive plate-like antennae that resemble slipper soles.

mantis-shrimp.name: Mantis Shrimp
mantis-shrimp.description: Mantis Shrimp ist ein Tier. The mantis shrimp is a strikingly colored crustacean with the fastest punch in the animal kingdom. It possesses the most complex eyes known, with 16 types of color receptors compared to humans' three.
mantis-shrimp.funFact: Can punch with the force of a .22 caliber bullet, breaking aquarium glass.

peacock-mantis-shrimp.name: Peacock Mantis Shrimp
peacock-mantis-shrimp.description: Peacock Mantis Shrimp ist ein Tier. The peacock mantis shrimp is one of the most colorful and formidable predators in the reef. Its club-like appendages strike with incredible speed and force, capable of shattering glass aquariums.
peacock-mantis-shrimp.funFact: Can see 16 types of color receptors and perceives ultraviolet and polarized light.

spearer-mantis-shrimp.name: Spearer Mantis Shrimp
spearer-mantis-shrimp.description: Spearer Mantis Shrimp ist ein Tier. Spearer mantis shrimp are ambush predators that wait at the entrance of their mud burrows. They strike passing prey with barbed, spear-like appendages that can impale fish in milliseconds.
spearer-mantis-shrimp.funFact: Has barbed, spear-like appendages for impaling soft-bodied prey like fish.

blue-crab.name: Blue Crab
blue-crab.description: Blue Crab ist ein Tier. The blue crab is a commercially important species found along the Atlantic coast of North America. It is an aggressive swimmer and opportunistic feeder that plays a key role in estuarine ecosystems.
blue-crab.funFact: Named for its bright blue claws used in mating displays.

king-crab.name: Red King Crab
king-crab.description: Red King Crab ist ein Tier. The red king crab is one of the largest crabs in the world, prized commercially in Alaska and Russia. Its massive, spiny legs can span over five feet and it can walk up to 100 miles during its annual migration.
king-crab.funFact: Its spiny shell can span over 5 feet from leg tip to leg tip.

japanese-spider-crab.name: Japanese Spider Crab
japanese-spider-crab.description: Japanese Spider Crab ist ein Tier. The Japanese spider crab holds the record for the largest leg span of any living arthropod. Despite its enormous size, it is a gentle giant that scavenges on the ocean floor.
japanese-spider-crab.funFact: Has the largest leg span of any arthropod, up to 12 feet across.

hermit-crab.name: Hermit Crab
hermit-crab.description: Hermit Crab ist ein Tier. Hermit crabs are decapod crustaceans that use abandoned snail shells to protect their soft abdomens. They are social animals often found in groups, and play dead when threatened.
hermit-crab.funFact: Must find and upgrade to larger shells as it grows throughout its life.

coconut-crab.name: Coconut Crab
coconut-crab.description: Coconut Crab ist ein Tier. The coconut crab is the largest terrestrial arthropod, capable of cracking coconuts with its powerful claws. Despite its name, it lives primarily on land but must return to the sea to reproduce.
coconut-crab.funFact: Has the strongest grip of any animal, strong enough to crack open coconuts.

snow-crab.name: Snow Crab
snow-crab.description: Snow Crab ist ein Tier. The snow crab is a cold-water species that lives on sandy and muddy bottoms. It is an important commercial species in both the Atlantic and Pacific, known for its sweet, tender meat.
snow-crab.funFact: Can tolerate near-freezing water temperatures as low as 0.5 degrees Celsius.

fiddler-crab.name: Fiddler Crab
fiddler-crab.description: Fiddler Crab ist ein Tier. Fiddler crabs are small semiterrestrial crabs recognized by the male's single oversized claw used in elaborate mating dances. They are important ecosystem engineers in mangrove and marsh habitats.
fiddler-crab.funFact: Males have one enormous claw they wave to attract mates.

mud-crab.name: Mud Crab
mud-crab.description: Mud Crab ist ein Tier. The mud crab is a robust species found in mangrove ecosystems across the Indo-Pacific. It is one of the most commercially important crabs in aquaculture, prized for its sweet, firm meat.
mud-crab.funFact: Can grow to 5 pounds and has claws strong enough to sever a human finger.

atlantic-ghost-crab.name: Atlantic Ghost Crab
atlantic-ghost-crab.description: Atlantic Ghost Crab ist ein Tier. Ghost crabs are pale, fast-moving crustaceans that burrow in sandy beaches. They are mostly nocturnal and use their large stalked eyes and acute hearing to detect predators and prey.
atlantic-ghost-crab.funFact: Can run up to 10 mph and has stalked eyes that provide 360-degree vision.

tropical-hermit-crab.name: Tropical Hermit Crab
tropical-hermit-crab.description: Tropical Hermit Crab ist ein Tier. Tropical hermit crabs are colorful land-dwelling crustaceans that inhabit beaches and coastal forests. They are highly social and often form shell exchange chains to ensure all members have appropriate shelter.
tropical-hermit-crab.funFact: Some individuals live in groups of over 100, sharing shells in a chain.

coconut-hermit-crab.name: Coconut Hermit Crab
coconut-hermit-crab.description: Coconut Hermit Crab ist ein Tier. The coconut hermit crab is a large land-dwelling species that inhabits tropical island beaches. It is known for its habit of using coconut shells as mobile homes and feeding on fallen coconuts.
coconut-hermit-crab.funFact: Often found in coconut shells and can grow large enough to use coconut husks as shelters.

zebra-fiddler-crab.name: Zebra Fiddler Crab
zebra-fiddler-crab.description: Zebra Fiddler Crab ist ein Tier. The zebra fiddler crab is named for the distinctive stripes on its carapace. Males perform elaborate claw-waving displays to attract females and defend territory on tropical mudflats.
zebra-fiddler-crab.funFact: Males wave their oversized claw in a unique rhythm specific to their species.

great-spider-crab.name: Great Spider Crab
great-spider-crab.description: Great Spider Crab ist ein Tier. The great spider crab is a camouflaged crustacean that attaches organisms to its shell for disguise. It migrates in large numbers to shallow waters for mating each autumn.
great-spider-crab.funFact: Often decorates its shell with sponges and algae for camouflage.

swimming-crab.name: Portunus Swimming Crab
swimming-crab.description: Portunus Swimming Crab ist ein Tier. Swimming crabs are agile crustaceans with modified rear legs that function as paddles. They are aggressive predators that can pursue prey through the water column with remarkable speed.
swimming-crab.funFact: Has paddle-shaped back legs that allow it to swim rapidly through the water.

common-shore-shrimp.name: Common Shore Shrimp
common-shore-shrimp.description: Common Shore Shrimp ist ein Tier. Common shore shrimp are small crustaceans inhabiting the turbulent intertidal zone. They use specialized appendages to cling to rocks and forage among algae and barnacles for food.
common-shore-shrimp.funFact: Can cling tightly to rocks to survive powerful wave action.

antarctic-krill.name: Antarctic Krill
antarctic-krill.description: Antarctic Krill ist ein Tier. Antarctic krill are small crustaceans that form the foundation of the Antarctic marine food web. Swarms can contain billions of individuals and are a critical food source for whales, seals, and penguins.
antarctic-krill.funFact: Forms swarms of billions of individuals visible from space.

pacific-krill.name: Pacific Krill
