pacific-krill.description: Pacific Krill ist ein Tier. Pacific krill are tiny shrimp-like crustaceans that swarm in massive numbers in the North Pacific. They are essential to the marine food web, feeding on phytoplankton and being consumed by larger marine life.
pacific-krill.funFact: Is the primary food source for North Pacific right whales.

atlantic-krill.name: Atlantic Krill
atlantic-krill.description: Atlantic Krill ist ein Tier. Atlantic krill are small pelagic crustaceans found throughout the North Atlantic. They are a keystone species, supporting populations of cod, herring, whales, and numerous seabirds.
atlantic-krill.funFact: Forms dense swarms that can extend for miles and contain trillions of individuals.

giant-amphipod.name: Giant Amphipod
giant-amphipod.description: Giant Amphipod ist ein Tier. Giant amphipods are deep-sea crustaceans found in ocean trenches up to 10,000 meters deep. Their enormous size compared to shallow-water relatives is an example of deep-sea gigantism.
giant-amphipod.funFact: Can grow up to 20 times larger than typical amphipods.

giant-isopod.name: Giant Isopod
giant-isopod.description: Giant Isopod ist ein Tier. Giant isopods are deep-sea crustaceans that can grow up to 14 inches long. They are scavengers that feed on whale falls and other organic material that sinks to the ocean floor.
giant-isopod.funFact: Can survive up to 5 years without eating by slowing its metabolism.

lions-mane-jellyfish.name: Lion's Mane Jellyfish
lions-mane-jellyfish.description: Lion's Mane Jellyfish ist ein Tier. The lion's mane jellyfish is the largest known jellyfish species. Its mass of long, trailing tentacles resembles a lion's mane and can extend far beyond its bell diameter.
lions-mane-jellyfish.funFact: Tentacles can exceed 120 feet, rivaling the blue whale in length.

portuguese-man-of-war.name: Portuguese Man-of-War
portuguese-man-of-war.description: Portuguese Man-of-War ist ein Tier. The Portuguese man-of-war is a siphonophore, not a true jellyfish. Its iconic blue float sails on the surface while trailing long, venomous tentacles that can deliver an extremely painful sting.
portuguese-man-of-war.funFact: Is actually a colony of four specialized organisms called zooids, not a single animal.

pacific-sea-nettle.name: Pacific Sea Nettle
pacific-sea-nettle.description: Pacific Sea Nettle ist ein Tier. The Pacific sea nettle is a large, visually striking jellyfish with a rusty-orange bell and long, coiling tentacles. It feeds on zooplankton, fish eggs, and other jellyfish.
pacific-sea-nettle.funFact: Its golden-brown bell and long trailing tentacles make it one of the most beautiful jellyfish.

upside-down-jellyfish.name: Upside-Down Jellyfish
upside-down-jellyfish.description: Upside-Down Jellyfish ist ein Tier. The upside-down jellyfish, or Cassiopea, lies bell-down on the substrate to maximize photosynthesis by its symbiotic algae. It pulses gently to circulate water and capture food particles.
upside-down-jellyfish.funFact: Rests upside-down on the seafloor to expose symbiotic algae to sunlight.

immortal-jellyfish.name: Immortal Jellyfish
immortal-jellyfish.description: Immortal Jellyfish ist ein Tier. The immortal jellyfish, Turritopsis dohrnii, is biologically immortal. When stressed or aging, it reverts to its polyp form and begins its life cycle anew, making it the only known creature capable of true rejuvenation.
immortal-jellyfish.funFact: Can revert from its adult form back to its juvenile polyp stage, effectively reversing aging.

sea-wasp.name: Sea Wasp
sea-wasp.description: Sea Wasp ist ein Tier. The sea wasp, or Chironex fleckeri, is the largest and most dangerous box jellyfish. Its nearly invisible body and incredibly potent venom make it one of the deadliest creatures in the ocean.
sea-wasp.funFact: Considered the most venomous marine animal, capable of killing a human in minutes.

compass-jellyfish.name: Compass Jellyfish
compass-jellyfish.description: Compass Jellyfish ist ein Tier. The compass jellyfish is easily identified by the brown radiating lines on its translucent bell that resemble compass markings. It feeds on small fish and other jellyfish.
compass-jellyfish.funFact: Has distinctive brown V-shaped markings on its bell resembling a compass rose.

fried-egg-jellyfish.name: Fried Egg Jellyfish
fried-egg-jellyfish.description: Fried Egg Jellyfish ist ein Tier. The fried egg jellyfish, or Cotylorhiza tuberculata, is a visually striking species with a bell that looks remarkably like a fried egg. Despite its large size, its sting is relatively mild.
fried-egg-jellyfish.funFact: Its bell closely resembles a fried egg, with a yellow center surrounded by white.

blood-belly-comb-jelly.name: Blood Belly Comb Jelly
blood-belly-comb-jelly.description: Blood Belly Comb Jelly ist ein Tier. The blood belly comb jelly is a deep-water ctenophore found in the Mediterranean. When threatened, it produces vivid red bioluminescence, creating a spectacular display in the dark waters.
blood-belly-comb-jelly.funFact: Produces brilliant red bioluminescence when disturbed.

atolla-jellyfish.name: Atolla Jellyfish
atolla-jellyfish.description: Atolla Jellyfish ist ein Tier. The Atolla jellyfish inhabits the deep ocean and is famous for its burglar alarm display. When attacked, it produces a rotating wheel of blue bioluminescence to attract larger predators that may attack its attacker.
atolla-jellyfish.funFact: Produces a pinwheel of bioluminescent light when attacked, known as a burglar alarm.

spotted-jelly.name: Spotted Jelly
spotted-jelly.description: Spotted Jelly ist ein Tier. The spotted jelly is a rhizostome jellyfish with a translucent bell covered in brown spots. It feeds on plankton and small organisms using oral arms lined with tiny mouth openings.
spotted-jelly.funFact: Has distinctive brown spots on its translucent bell that give it its name.

mauve-stinger.name: Mauve Stinger
mauve-stinger.description: Mauve Stinger ist ein Tier. The mauve stinger is a deep-water jellyfish with a distinctive reddish-purple bell covered in nematocyst clusters. It forms massive blooms in open ocean waters.
mauve-stinger.funFact: Can bloom in massive swarms that disrupt fisheries and aquaculture operations.

staghorn-coral.name: Staghorn Coral
staghorn-coral.description: Staghorn Coral ist ein Tier. Staghorn coral is a critically endangered branching coral species. Once dominant in Caribbean reefs, its populations have declined by over 80% due to disease, bleaching, and predation.
staghorn-coral.funFact: Can grow up to 8 inches per year, making it one of the fastest-growing corals.

brain-coral.name: Brain Coral
brain-coral.description: Brain Coral ist ein Tier. Brain coral is named for its spherical shape and the winding grooves on its surface that resemble a human brain. It is a slow-growing but extremely long-lived reef-building species.
brain-coral.funFact: Can live for nearly a millennium, making it one of the longest-lived organisms on Earth.

elkhorn-coral.name: Elkhorn Coral
elkhorn-coral.description: Elkhorn Coral ist ein Tier. Elkhorn coral is a critically endangered species that once formed vast reefs throughout the Caribbean. Its large, branching colonies provide essential habitat for hundreds of reef species.
elkhorn-coral.funFact: Named for its broad, antler-like branches that resemble elk horns.

pillar-coral.name: Pillar Coral
pillar-coral.description: Pillar Coral ist ein Tier. Pillar coral is one of the rarest reef-building corals, distinguished by its tall, cylindrical columns that rise from the reef. It is listed as critically endangered with populations plummeting.
pillar-coral.funFact: One of the rarest corals, with no known young produced since 1998 in Florida.

fire-coral.name: Fire Coral
fire-coral.description: Fire Coral ist ein Tier. Fire coral is a colony-forming hydrozoan that looks like true coral but delivers a painful sting on contact. Its smooth, branching colonies are typically brown, yellow, or reddish in color.
fire-coral.funFact: Not a true coral but a colony of hydrozoans that delivers a painful sting.

blue-coral.name: Blue Coral
blue-coral.description: Blue Coral ist ein Tier. Blue coral is a unique reef-building species with a distinctive blue skeleton. It is one of the few corals that can survive in turbid, low-light environments where other corals cannot.
blue-coral.funFact: The only reef-building coral with a blue skeleton, caused by iron salts in its skeleton.

mushroom-coral.name: Mushroom Coral
mushroom-coral.description: Mushroom Coral ist ein Tier. Mushroom corals are solitary, free-living scleractinian corals shaped like mushrooms. Unlike colonial species, each is a single polyp that can detach and roll across the substrate.
mushroom-coral.funFact: Unlike most corals, mushroom corals are free-living and can move short distances.

black-coral.name: Black Coral
black-coral.description: Black Coral ist ein Tier. Black corals are deep-water colonial organisms with a black or dark brown skeleton. They are among the longest-lived organisms on Earth, with some colonies surviving for millennia.
black-coral.funFact: Some colonies have been dated to over 4,000 years old, making them the oldest living organisms on Earth.

sea-pen.name: Sea Pen
sea-pen.description: Sea Pen ist ein Tier. Sea pens are colonial cnidarians that resemble old-fashioned quill pens. They anchor in soft sediment and can produce bioluminescent waves of light that travel along their colonies.
sea-pen.funFact: Is a colony of polyps anchored in sediment, with some species producing bioluminescent waves when disturbed.

sea-whip.name: Sea Whip
sea-whip.description: Sea Whip ist ein Tier. Sea whips are octocoral colonies that grow in long, whip-like branches. They are filter feeders that extend polyps into the current to capture plankton and organic particles.
sea-whip.funFact: Some species produce a compound used in cancer research.

sunflower-sea-star.name: Sunflower Sea Star
sunflower-sea-star.description: Sunflower Sea Star ist ein Tier. The sunflower sea star is one of the largest and fastest sea stars, but populations have crashed by over 90% due to sea star wasting disease. It is now listed as critically endangered.
sunflower-sea-star.funFact: Can have up to 24 arms and is one of the largest sea stars in the world.

crown-of-thorns-starfish.name: Crown-of-Thorns Starfish
crown-of-thorns-starfish.description: Crown-of-Thorns Starfish ist ein Tier. The crown-of-thorns starfish is a large, multi-armed sea star covered in venomous spines. It is a significant coral predator whose population outbreaks can devastate reef ecosystems.
crown-of-thorns-starfish.funFact: Can consume up to 10 square feet of coral per year.

blue-sea-star.name: Blue Sea Star
blue-sea-star.description: Blue Sea Star ist ein Tier. The blue sea star is a strikingly colored echinoderm that lives on sandy substrates. It feeds on small invertebrates buried in the sand and can regenerate lost arms.
blue-sea-star.funFact: Its brilliant blue color comes from a pigment that may protect against UV radiation.

leather-star.name: Leather Star
leather-star.description: Leather Star ist ein Tier. The leather star is a smooth-skinned sea star found on rocky reefs. It has a distinctive reddish-brown color and a unique garlic-like odor when handled.
leather-star.funFact: Has a smooth, leathery texture unlike the rough surface of most sea stars.

common-brittle-star.name: Common Brittle Star
common-brittle-star.description: Common Brittle Star ist ein Tier. Brittle stars are echinoderms with a distinct central disc and five long, slender arms. They are more agile than sea stars, moving by writhing their arms across the seabed.
common-brittle-star.funFact: Can detach an arm to escape predators, later regenerating it.

giant-basket-star.name: Giant Basket Star
giant-basket-star.description: Giant Basket Star ist ein Tier. The giant basket star is a spectacular echinoderm with a complex network of branching arms. At night, it unfurls its arms into the current to capture plankton and small crustaceans.
giant-basket-star.funFact: Has thousands of branching arm tips that can entrap plankton and small organisms.

feather-star.name: Feather Star
feather-star.description: Feather Star ist ein Tier. Feather stars are mobile crinoids that cling to coral or swim through the water column. Their feathery arms filter plankton from passing currents, and they can detach to relocate when conditions change.
feather-star.funFact: Can swim by rhythmically waving its feathery arms through the water.

crinoid-feather-star.name: Crinoid Feather Star
crinoid-feather-star.description: Crinoid Feather Star ist ein Tier. Crinoid feather stars are ancient echinoderms related to sea lilies. They perch on coral heads and wave their feathery arms to capture passing plankton from ocean currents.
crinoid-feather-star.funFact: Can detach from its substrate and swim to relocate when conditions are unfavorable.

disk-brittle-star.name: Disk-Brittle Star
disk-brittle-star.description: Disk-Brittle Star ist ein Tier. The disk-brittle star is a small, agile echinoderm found in rock crevices and under stones. It is an opportunistic feeder that can regenerate lost body parts rapidly.
disk-brittle-star.funFact: Can regenerate entire arms and even the central disc if detached.

purple-sea-urchin.name: Purple Sea Urchin
purple-sea-urchin.description: Purple Sea Urchin ist ein Tier. The purple sea urchin is a spiny echinoderm that inhabits rocky shores. It uses its five-toothed jaw, Aristotle's lantern, to scrape algae and even excavate burrows in solid rock.
purple-sea-urchin.funFact: Can bore into solid rock using its specialized jaw apparatus called Aristotle's lantern.

long-spined-sea-urchin.name: Long-Spined Sea Urchin
long-spined-sea-urchin.description: Long-Spined Sea Urchin ist ein Tier. Long-spined sea urchins are tropical echinoderms with extremely long, sharp spines that provide excellent defense. They play a critical role in controlling algal growth on coral reefs.
long-spined-sea-urchin.funFact: Spines can be over a foot long and are mildly venomous.

pencil-urchin.name: Pencil Urchin
pencil-urchin.description: Pencil Urchin ist ein Tier. Pencil urchins are named for their thick, cylindrical spines that look like colored pencils. They inhabit tropical reefs where they graze on algae using their complex jaw apparatus.
pencil-urchin.funFact: Has thick, blunt spines that resemble pencils, unlike typical sharp urchin spines.

green-sea-urchin.name: Green Sea Urchin
green-sea-urchin.description: Green Sea Urchin ist ein Tier. The green sea urchin is a cold-water species found on rocky substrates. It is an important herbivore in kelp forest ecosystems, controlling algal growth and providing food for sea otters.
green-sea-urchin.funFact: Can live for over 30 years, making it one of the longest-lived sea urchins.

flower-urchin.name: Flower Urchin
flower-urchin.description: Flower Urchin ist ein Tier. The flower urchin is one of the most dangerous sea urchins, covered in venomous flower-shaped pedicellariae. Despite its beautiful appearance, contact causes intense pain and potential tissue damage.
flower-urchin.funFact: Covered in flower-like structures called pedicellariae that deliver a painful venom.

sand-dollar.name: Sand Dollar
sand-dollar.description: Sand Dollar ist ein Tier. Sand dollars are flat, burrowing sea urchins found on sandy ocean floors. Their flattened bodies and fine spines allow them to bury themselves just beneath the sediment surface.
sand-dollar.funFact: The petal-like pattern on its skeleton is actually five sets of tube feet used for breathing.

carpenter-sea-urchin.name: Carpenter Sea Urchin
carpenter-sea-urchin.description: Carpenter Sea Urchin ist ein Tier. The carpenter sea urchin is named for its ability to excavate burrows in solid coral rock. Its powerful Aristotle's lantern allows it to bore into reef substrates for shelter.
carpenter-sea-urchin.funFact: Has particularly strong teeth that can bore through solid coral rock.

fire-urchin.name: Fire Urchin
fire-urchin.description: Fire Urchin ist ein Tier. The fire urchin is a striking red echinoderm with venomous spines that deliver an intensely painful sting. Despite its danger, it provides a symbiotic home for certain shrimp and crabs.
fire-urchin.funFact: Has venomous spines that cause intense burning pain, resembling a fire ant sting.

slate-pencil-urchin.name: Slate Pencil Urchin
slate-pencil-urchin.description: Slate Pencil Urchin ist ein Tier. Slate pencil urchins are named for their thick, blunt spines that resemble slate pencils. These colorful echinoderms inhabit tropical reefs where they graze on algae.
slate-pencil-urchin.funFact: Has thick, blunt spines that were historically used as writing instruments.

tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.name: Tiger Tail Sea Cucumber
tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.description: Tiger Tail Sea Cucumber ist ein Tier. The tiger tail sea cucumber is a large, conspicuous species with distinctive dark stripes. It is an important bioturbator, processing sediment and recycling nutrients in tropical marine ecosystems.
tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.funFact: Can eject sticky, toxic tubules from its body to entangle predators.

lolly-sea-cucumber.name: Lolly Sea Cucumber
lolly-sea-cucumber.description: Lolly Sea Cucumber ist ein Tier. The lolly sea cucumber is a small, cylindrical species that processes sand and sediment on tropical reefs. It plays a vital role in reef health by recycling organic matter.
lolly-sea-cucumber.funFact: Has a distinctive tube-like body that resembles a lollipop.

pacific-sea-cucumber.name: Pacific Sea Cucumber
pacific-sea-cucumber.description: Pacific Sea Cucumber ist ein Tier. The Pacific sea cucumber is an ecologically important detritivore that processes vast quantities of sediment. It is commercially harvested and considered a culinary delicacy in many Asian cultures.
pacific-sea-cucumber.funFact: Is commercially harvested as a delicacy in Asian cuisine, known as beche-de-mer.

black-sea-cucumber.name: Black Sea Cucumber
black-sea-cucumber.description: Black Sea Cucumber ist ein Tier. The black sea cucumber is a large, commercially valuable species found on tropical reefs. It ejects its internal organs as a defense mechanism and later regenerates them completely.
black-sea-cucumber.funFact: Can detach and regrow its internal organs when stressed, a process called evisceration.

teatfish-sea-cucumber.name: Teatfish Sea Cucumber
teatfish-sea-cucumber.description: Teatfish Sea Cucumber ist ein Tier. The teatfish is a large, highly valued sea cucumber that has been overexploited for the Asian beche-de-mer trade. Its distinctive nipple-like projections give it its common name.
teatfish-sea-cucumber.funFact: One of the most commercially valuable sea cucumber species, sold as beche-de-mer.

red-sea-cucumber.name: Red Sea Cucumber
red-sea-cucumber.description: Red Sea Cucumber ist ein Tier. The red sea cucumber is a common species in Pacific kelp forests. It grazes on detritus and algae on rocky substrates, playing an important role in nutrient cycling.
red-sea-cucumber.funFact: Uses tube feet along its underside to slowly crawl across the seafloor.

christmas-tree-worm.name: Christmas Tree Worm
christmas-tree-worm.description: Christmas Tree Worm ist ein Tier. Christmas tree worms are tubeworms that burrow into living coral colonies. Their colorful, spiral-shaped radioles filter plankton from the water and can retract instantly when disturbed.
christmas-tree-worm.funFact: Can retract its colorful spiral plumes into its tube in less than a second.

giant-tubeworm.name: Giant Tube Worm
giant-tubeworm.description: Giant Tube Worm ist ein Tier. Giant tube worms are extraordinary deep-sea organisms that thrive at hydrothermal vents. They rely on chemosynthetic bacteria housed in a special organ called the trophosome for all nutrition.
giant-tubeworm.funFact: Has no mouth, stomach, or gut, relying entirely on symbiotic bacteria for nutrition.

feather-duster-worm.name: Feather Duster Worm
feather-duster-worm.description: Feather Duster Worm ist ein Tier. Feather duster worms are sedentary polychaetes that construct tubes on reef surfaces. Their spectacular crown of feathery tentacles filters plankton and can retract rapidly when threatened.
feather-duster-worm.funFact: Its feathery crown of tentacles is used for both feeding and respiration.

bearded-fireworm.name: Bearded Fireworm
bearded-fireworm.description: Bearded Fireworm ist ein Tier. The bearded fireworm is a predatory polychaete with venomous bristles called chaetae. Contact with these white, hair-like structures causes severe pain, inflammation, and numbness.
bearded-fireworm.funFact: Has hollow, venom-filled bristles that cause intense burning pain on contact.

blue-glaucus.name: Blue Glaucus
blue-glaucus.description: Blue Glaucus ist ein Tier. The blue glaucus, or blue dragon, is a tiny, vibrant blue sea slug that floats upside-down on the ocean surface. It stores stinging cells from its prey for its own defense.
blue-glaucus.funFact: Floats upside-down on the surface tension of the water, using stored air bubbles.

spanish-dancer.name: Spanish Dancer
spanish-dancer.description: Spanish Dancer ist ein Tier. The Spanish dancer is one of the largest and most colorful nudibranchs. When swimming, it unfurls its brilliant red and white mantle in a mesmerizing undulating display.
spanish-dancer.funFact: Named for its spectacular undulating swimming motion that resembles a flamenco dancer.

leaf-sheep.name: Leaf Sheep
leaf-sheep.description: Leaf Sheep ist ein Tier. The leaf sheep, or Costasiella kuroshimae, is a tiny sea slug that can photosynthesize like a plant. It steals chloroplasts from the algae it eats and stores them in its body to produce energy.
leaf-sheep.funFact: Is one of the only animals capable of photosynthesis, stealing chloroplasts from algae.

sea-butterfly.name: Sea Butterfly
sea-butterfly.description: Sea Butterfly ist ein Tier. Sea butterflies are tiny marine snails that swim through the open ocean by flapping their wing-like shell extensions. They are an important food source for fish, whales, and seabirds.
sea-butterfly.funFact: Swims by flapping its wing-like shell extensions, resembling a butterfly in flight.

sea-angel.name: Sea Angel
sea-angel.description: Sea Angel ist ein Tier. Sea angels are gelatinous, transparent marine gastropods that lack shells. They swim through cold ocean waters by flapping wing-like appendages and prey on sea butterflies.
sea-angel.funFact: Is a shell-less snail that swims with graceful wing-like movements.

sea-hare.name: California Sea Hare
sea-hare.description: California Sea Hare ist ein Tier. The California sea hare is a large marine gastropod named for its ear-like rhinophores. It feeds on kelp and seaweed and can release a cloud of purple ink as a defense mechanism.
sea-hare.funFact: Can release a cloud of purple ink when threatened, confusing predators.

giant-clam.name: Giant Clam
giant-clam.description: Giant Clam ist ein Tier. The giant clam is the largest living bivalve mollusk, reaching over four feet in length. Its colorful mantle harbors symbiotic algae that provide much of its nutrition through photosynthesis.
giant-clam.funFact: Can weigh over 500 pounds and live for more than 100 years.

geoduck.name: Geoduck
geoduck.description: Geoduck ist ein Tier. The geoduck is the largest burrowing clam in the world, with a siphon that can extend three feet. Native to the Pacific Northwest, it is a prized delicacy in Asian cuisine.
geoduck.funFact: Can live for over 160 years, making it one of the longest-living animals on Earth.

atlantic-surf-clam.name: Atlantic Surf Clam
atlantic-surf-clam.description: Atlantic Surf Clam ist ein Tier. The Atlantic surf clam is a large bivalve found on sandy substrates. It uses its powerful foot to burrow and can explosively eject itself from the sand when threatened by predators.
atlantic-surf-clam.funFact: Can propel itself out of the sand using its muscular foot when disturbed.

bay-scallop.name: Bay Scallop
bay-scallop.description: Bay Scallop ist ein Tier. Bay scallops are small, fan-shaped bivalves that live in shallow coastal waters. Unlike most clams, they can swim by rapidly clapping their valves, ejecting water for propulsion.
bay-scallop.funFact: Can swim short distances by rapidly clapping its shell valves together.

blue-mussel.name: Blue Mussel
blue-mussel.description: Blue Mussel ist ein Tier. Blue mussels are filter-feeding bivalves that attach to rocks with strong byssal threads. They form dense beds that provide habitat for numerous other species and are commercially cultivated.
blue-mussel.funFact: Attaches to rocks using strong byssal threads, forming dense beds of thousands.

thorny-oyster.name: Thorny Oyster
thorny-oyster.description: Thorny Oyster ist ein Tier. The thorny oyster is a large, spiny bivalve that cements itself to reef substrates. Its long, sharp spines protect it from predators and can cause painful wounds if touched.
thorny-oyster.funFact: Shell is covered in long, sharp spines that deter predators.

lion-paw-scallop.name: Lion Paw Scallop
lion-paw-scallop.description: Lion Paw Scallop ist ein Tier. The lion paw scallop is a large, colorful bivalve with a distinctive ridged shell. It can swim by clapping its valves and is found in kelp forests along the Pacific coast.
lion-paw-scallop.funFact: Named for its ridged, colorful shell that resembles a lion's paw.

nautilus-pompilius.name: Nautilus Pompilius
nautilus-pompilius.description: Nautilus Pompilius ist ein Tier. Nautilus pompilius is a cephalopod with a beautiful, spiraled shell that has inspired artists and mathematicians for centuries. It is a living fossil, virtually unchanged for 500 million years.
nautilus-pompilius.funFact: Shell follows a logarithmic spiral, one of nature's most perfect mathematical forms.

paper-nautilus.name: Paper Nautilus
paper-nautilus.description: Paper Nautilus ist ein Tier. The paper nautilus is an argonaut octopus in which only females produce a fragile, calcareous shell. Males are much smaller and shell-less, using a specialized arm to transfer sperm.
paper-nautilus.funFact: Females create a delicate, paper-thin shell for egg protection.

atlantic-horseshoe-crab.name: Atlantic Horseshoe Crab
atlantic-horseshoe-crab.description: Atlantic Horseshoe Crab ist ein Tier. The Atlantic horseshoe crab is a marine arthropod often called a living fossil. Despite its name, it is more closely related to spiders and scorpions than to true crabs.
atlantic-horseshoe-crab.funFact: Has been virtually unchanged for 450 million years, predating the dinosaurs.

japanese-horseshoe-crab.name: Japanese Horseshoe Crab
japanese-horseshoe-crab.description: Japanese Horseshoe Crab ist ein Tier. The Japanese horseshoe crab is an endangered species whose unique blue blood is vital to modern medicine. The substance in its blood detects bacterial endotoxins in pharmaceuticals and medical devices.
japanese-horseshoe-crab.funFact: Its blue blood contains Limulus Amebocyte Lysate, used to test for bacterial contamination in medical equipment.

indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.name: Indo-Pacific Horseshoe Crab
indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.description: Indo-Pacific Horseshoe Crab ist ein Tier. The Indo-Pacific horseshoe crab is an endangered marine arthropod found in Southeast Asian coastal waters. Like its Atlantic relative, it has blue blood containing valuable immune cells.
indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.funFact: Is the only horseshoe crab species found in Asian coastal waters.

sea-squirt-tunicate.name: Sea Squirt
sea-squirt-tunicate.description: Sea Squirt ist ein Tier. Sea squirts are tunicates, marine invertebrates that are surprisingly closely related to vertebrates. As larvae they have a notochord, which they lose as adults when they attach to surfaces and become filter feeders.
sea-squirt-tunicate.funFact: Is more closely related to vertebrates than most invertebrates, being a chordate.

marine-flatworm.name: Marine Flatworm
marine-flatworm.description: Marine Flatworm ist ein Tier. Marine flatworms are colorful, soft-bodied invertebrates that glide across reef surfaces. Despite their simple appearance, they are active predators that can deliver venomous bites.
marine-flatworm.funFact: Can regenerate an entire organism from a fragment as small as 1/200th of its body.

sea-pen-glow.name: Deep-Sea Pennatula
sea-pen-glow.description: Deep-Sea Pennatula ist ein Tier. The deep-sea pennatula is a species of sea pen that inhabits deep muddy bottoms. When disturbed, it produces stunning bioluminescent waves that ripple along its colony.
sea-pen-glow.funFact: Produces bioluminescent waves that travel along its colony when physically disturbed.

dodo.name: Dodo
dodo.description: Dodo ist ein Tier. The dodo was a large, flightless bird native to the island of Mauritius in the Indian Ocean. It was related to pigeons and doves but evolved to be completely flightless with no natural predators.
dodo.funFact: The dodo was a flightless bird from Mauritius that went extinct in the late 17th century due to hunting and invasive species.

woolly-mammoth.name: Woolly Mammoth
woolly-mammoth.description: Woolly Mammoth ist ein Tier. The woolly mammoth was a species of elephant covered in thick fur that lived during the Pleistocene epoch. They roamed the cold tundra regions of North America, Europe, and Asia.
woolly-mammoth.funFact: Woolly mammoths coexisted with early humans and their remains are still found frozen in Siberian permafrost.

passenger-pigeon.name: Passenger Pigeon
passenger-pigeon.description: Passenger Pigeon ist ein Tier. The passenger pigeon was once the most abundant bird in North America, with flocks containing billions of individuals. Systematic hunting and habitat destruction led to its extinction in 1914.
passenger-pigeon.funFact: Passenger pigeons once numbered in the billions and their flocks would darken the sky for hours as they flew overhead.

tasmanian-tiger.name: Tasmanian Tiger
tasmanian-tiger.description: Tasmanian Tiger ist ein Tier. The Tasmanian tiger, or thylacine, was a carnivorous marsupial native to Tasmania, Australia, and New Guinea. The last known individual died in captivity in 1936.
tasmanian-tiger.funFact: Despite being called a tiger, it was actually a marsupial more closely related to kangaroos than to big cats.

quagga.name: Quagga
quagga.description: Quagga ist ein Tier. The quagga was a subspecies of plains zebra that lived in South Africa. It was distinguished by its limited striping pattern, with stripes only on the head and front body.
quagga.funFact: The quagga was half-zebra, half-horse with stripes only on the front half of its body. The last one died in 1883.

pig.name: Pig
pig.description: The domestic pig is a stout-bodied farm animal raised worldwide for meat and known for its intelligence and social nature.
pig.funFact: Pigs are highly intelligent and can learn tricks like dogs

sheep.name: Sheep
sheep.description: Sheep are woolly ruminants raised for wool, meat and milk, known for flocking behavior.
sheep.funFact: Sheep can recognize up to 50 faces for years

goat.name: Goat
goat.description: Goats are hardy farm animals known for climbing and curiosity, raised for milk, meat and fiber.
goat.funFact: Goats have rectangular pupils for wide vision

horse.name: Horse
horse.description: The horse is a large domesticated hoofed mammal used for riding, work and sport.
horse.funFact: Horses can sleep both standing and lying down

donkey.name: Donkey
donkey.description: Donkeys are sturdy equids used as working animals, known for endurance and strong memory.
donkey.funFact: Donkeys have incredible memory and remember places for 25 years

chicken.name: Chicken
chicken.description: Chickens are domesticated fowl raised for eggs and meat, the most numerous bird on Earth.

duck.name: Duck
duck.description: Ducks are waterfowl raised on farms and found wild on ponds and rivers.
duck.funFact: Duck feathers are waterproof due to oil coating

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.description: Turkeys are large North American game birds domesticated for meat.
turkey.funFact: Turkeys can change head color with mood

alpaca.name: Alpaca
alpaca.description: Alpacas are South American camelids raised for soft fleece, similar to llamas but smaller.
alpaca.funFact: Alpaca fleece is 3x warmer than sheep wool

llama.name: Llama
llama.description: Llamas are domesticated camelids from the Andes used as pack animals and for wool.
llama.funFact: Llamas hum to communicate with each other

unicorn.name: Unicorn
unicorn.description: The unicorn is a legendary horse-like creature with a single spiraled horn, symbol of purity and magic.
unicorn.funFact: Unicorn horns were said to purify poisoned water

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.description: Dragons are legendary giant reptiles with wings and fire breath, guardians of treasure in folklore.
dragon.funFact: Dragons were said to hoard gold and breathe fire

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.description: The phoenix is a mythical fire bird that cyclically regenerates by rising from its ashes.
phoenix.funFact: The phoenix rises from its own ashes every 500 years

griffin.name: Griffin
griffin.description: The griffin has the body of a lion and head and wings of an eagle, a majestic guardian beast.
griffin.funFact: Griffins were said to guard gold mines

pegasus.name: Pegasus
pegasus.description: Pegasus is a winged horse of Greek mythology, born from Medusa and symbol of inspiration.
pegasus.funFact: Pegasus was born from Medusa's blood

mermaid.name: Mermaid
mermaid.description: Mermaids are half-human, half-fish beings who lure sailors with enchanting songs.
mermaid.funFact: Mermaid tears were believed to be pearls

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.description: The Kraken is a colossal sea monster resembling a giant squid, feared by sailors.
kraken.funFact: The Kraken was said to drag entire ships underwater

fairy.name: Fairy
fairy.description: Fairies are tiny winged folk who live in forests and use magic to protect nature.
fairy.funFact: Fairies were said to be 6 inches tall

piranha.funFact: A mordida pode exercer pressao de ate 300 vezes o seu peso
piranha.name: Piranha
piranha.description: The piranha is a freshwater fish native to South American rivers known for its sharp teeth and powerful jaws found in tropical and subtropical waters.

electric-eel.name: Electric Eel
electric-eel.description: The electric eel is a freshwater fish capable of generating powerful electric shocks used for hunting and self-defense found in South American rivers.

komodo-dragon.name: Dragão-de-Komodo
komodo-dragon.description: The Komodo dragon is the largest living lizard in the world, found on a few Indonesian islands. It is an apex predator capable of taking down deer, pigs, and even water buffalo. Young Komodo dragons spend their first years in trees to avoid predation by adults.
komodo-dragon.funFact: Dragões-de-Komodo possuem glândulas de veneno que entregam toxinas que previnem a coagulação do sangue em suas presas.

king-cobra.name: Cobra-real
king-cobra.description: The king cobra is the world's longest venomous snake, capable of reaching lengths over 13 feet. Found in the tropical forests of South and Southeast Asia, it primarily feeds on other snakes. Its venom is potent enough to kill an elephant.
king-cobra.funFact: A cobra-rei é a única cobra que consta ninhos para seus ovos, guardando-os ferozmente até que eclodam.

green-sea-turtle.name: Tartaruga-verde
green-sea-turtle.description: Green sea turtles are among the largest sea turtles in the world and the only herbivorous marine turtle species. They migrate long distances between feeding grounds and nesting beaches, returning to the same beach where they were born.
green-sea-turtle.funFact: Tartarugas-marinhas-verdes obtêm seu nome da cor verde de sua gordura corporal, que vem de sua dieta rica em algas.

green-iguana.name: Iguana-verde
green-iguana.description: The green iguana is a large, arboreal herbivorous lizard native to Central and South America. It is excellent at swimming and can hold its breath for up to 30 minutes. Juveniles are bright green while adults may turn orange or dull grey.
green-iguana.funFact: Iguanas-verdes podem cair de alturas de 12-15 metros e sobreviver desacelerando sua descida com a cauda.

boa-constrictor.name: Jiboia
boa-constrictor.description: The boa constrictor is a large, non-venomous constrictor found throughout Central and South America. It is a highly adaptable species found in rainforests, savannas, and even near human habitations. It kills prey by constriction and is a popular species in captivity.
boa-constrictor.funFact: Jiboias-constritoras dão à luz filhotes vivos em vez de botar ovos, com ninhadas às vezes ultrapassando 60 filhotes.

black-mamba.name: Mamba-negra
black-mamba.description: The black mamba is the fastest snake in the world and one of the most venomous. Found in eastern and southern Africa, it can reach speeds of 12 mph and strike with incredible accuracy. Its venom is neurotoxic and can be fatal without antivenom.
black-mamba.funFact: Apesar de seu nome, a mamba-negra não é preta mas cinza-esverdeada; o nome refere-se ao interior azul-escuro-preto de sua boca.

bearded-dragon.name: Dragão-barbudo
bearded-dragon.description: The central bearded dragon is a popular pet lizard native to the arid regions of central Australia. It displays a darkened beard when threatened or during social interactions. It basks on rocks and branches, absorbing heat to regulate its body temperature.
bearded-dragon.funFact: Dragões-barbudos sopram suas escamas espinhosas da garganta e abrem suas bocas para parecerem maiores quando ameaçados.

nile-crocodile.name: Crocodilo-do-Nilo
nile-crocodile.description: The Nile crocodile is one of the largest crocodilian species and is considered the most dangerous to humans. Found throughout sub-Saharan Africa, it is an apex predator of rivers and lakes. It can go months without eating and has the most powerful bite of any living animal.
nile-crocodile.funFact: Crocodilos-do-Nilo são considerados a espécie de crocodilo mais perigosa para humanos, com um estimado de 1000 ataques por ano.

ball-python.name: Píton-real
ball-python.description: The ball python is a non-venomous constrictor native to the grasslands of western and central Africa. It is the most popular pet snake in the world due to its docile temperament and manageable size. It has hundreds of color morphs bred in captivity.
ball-python.funFact: Pítons-bola se enrolam em uma bola com a cabeça protegida no centro quando assustadas, daí seu nome.

red-eared-slider.name: Tartaruga-de-orelha-vermelha
red-eared-slider.description: The red-eared slider is a semi-aquatic turtle native to the Mississippi Valley region of the United States. It is the most popular pet turtle in the world and has become a significant invasive species on every continent except Antarctica. It has a distinctive red stripe behind each eye.
red-eared-slider.funFact: Deslizantes-de-orelha-vermelha são a espécie de tartaruga mais amplamente distribuída do mundo, considerada uma das 100 espécies invasoras globais.

emperor-penguin.name: Pinguim-imperador
emperor-penguin.description: The emperor penguin is the tallest and heaviest of all living penguins. It breeds during the Antarctic winter, with males incubating the egg for about 65 days.
emperor-penguin.funFact: Pinguins-imperadores podem mergulhar a profundidades superiores a 550 metros e prender a respiração por mais de 20 minutos.

king-penguin.name: Pinguim-rei
king-penguin.description: The king penguin is the second-largest penguin species, found on sub-Antarctic islands with striking orange and silver markings.
king-penguin.funFact: Pais-pinguim-reis podem passar até duas semanas sem comer enquanto chocam seus ovos.

bald-eagle.name: Águia-calva
bald-eagle.description: The bald eagle is a bird of prey found in North America and a national symbol of the United States. It is a large raptor with a distinctive white head and tail contrasting with a dark brown body.
bald-eagle.funFact: Águias-carecas podem girar suas cabeças 180 graus para detectar presas.

golden-eagle.name: Águia-real
golden-eagle.description: The golden eagle is one of the largest and most powerful raptors in North America and Eurasia. Named for the golden-brown plumage on its head and neck, it hunts primarily rabbits and hares.
golden-eagle.funFact: Águias-douradas podem atingir velocidades superiores a 320 km/h ao mergulhar sobre presas.

peregrine-falcon.funFact: O animal mais rapido do mundo em queda livre
peregrine-falcon.name: Peregrine Falcon
peregrine-falcon.description: The peregrine falcon is a widespread bird of prey known for its incredible speed during its hunting dive. It feeds primarily on medium-sized birds caught in flight.

barn-owl.name: Coruja-das-torres
barn-owl.description: The barn owl is a nocturnal raptor found on every continent except Antarctica. Known for its heart-shaped face and ghostly white plumage, it is an exceptionally efficient hunter of rodents.
barn-owl.funFact: Corujas-do-ceu podem localizar presas na escuridão total usando apenas sua incrível audição.

mallard.name: Pato-real
mallard.description: The mallard is the most common and widespread duck in the Northern Hemisphere. Males have a distinctive iridescent green head, while females are mottled brown.
mallard.funFact: Todos os patos domésticos são descendentes do pato-real selvagem, exceto o pato-moscovita.

canada-goose.name: Ganso-do-canadá
canada-goose.description: The Canada goose is a large waterfowl native to North America, recognized by its black head and neck with white chinstrap. Highly adaptable, it is known for its V-formation flight.
canada-goose.funFact: Gansos-do-canadá acasalam para a vida e podem viver juntos por mais de 20 anos.

mute-swan.name: Cisne-mudo
mute-swan.description: The mute swan is one of the largest flying birds, with pure white plumage and an orange bill with a black knob. It is known for its graceful S-shaped neck posture.
mute-swan.funFact: Cisnes-mudos podem ser defensores agressivos de seus ninhos, investindo contra intrusos.

flamingo.funFact: Nasce branco e ganha cor pelo alimento
flamingo.name: Greater Flamingo
flamingo.description: The greater flamingo is the largest and most widespread flamingo species. Its pink plumage, long legs, and curved bill are unmistakable.

ostrich.funFact: Tem olhos maiores que o cerebro
ostrich.name: Common Ostrich
ostrich.description: The common ostrich is the largest living bird, native to Africa. Unable to fly, it has powerful legs and can run at sustained speeds of 30 mph.

emu.name: Emu
emu.description: The emu is the second-largest living bird, native to Australia. It is flightless with vestigial wings. The male emu performs all parental duties.
emu.funFact: Machos de emus chocam os ovos e criam os filhotes sozinhos por até 18 meses.

monarch-butterfly.name: Monarch Butterfly
monarch-butterfly.description: The monarch butterfly is one of the most recognizable butterflies in North America, known for its striking orange and black wing pattern. It is famous for its incredible long-distance migration across thousands of miles.

ladybug.funFact: Uma joaninha pode comer ate 5000 aphids na vida
ladybug.name: Seven-Spotted Ladybug
ladybug.description: Ladybugs are small, round beetles valued by gardeners for their appetite for aphids and other plant pests. Their bright red coloration with black spots warns predators of their bitter taste.

sloth.name: Preguiça
sloth.description: Sloths are slow-moving tree-dwelling mammals known for their lazy lifestyle.

axolotl.name: Axolotl
axolotl.description: The Axolotl is a neotenic salamander that retains its larval features throughout life, including external gills. Found only in Lake Xochimilco in Mexico, it is critically endangered in the wild but widely bred in captivity.

incredible-frog.name: Rã incrível
incredible-frog.description: The Incredible Frog is a small tree frog found in the rainforests of Central America. They have specialized finger and toe pads that allow them to control their descent when jumping between trees.
incredible-frog.funFact: A rã-incrível pode estender seus dedos das mãos e dos pés para desacelerar sua descida ao pular de galhos altos.

lemur.name: Lêmure
lemur.description: O lêmure é um primata endêmico de Madagascar.

meerkat.name: Suricata
meerkat.description: Meerkats are social mongooses that live in the Kalahari Desert.

mongoose.name: Mangusto
mongoose.description: Mongooses are small carnivores known for their ability to fight snakes.
mongoose.funFact: Imune a alguns venenos de cobras

praying-mantis.name: Louva-a-deus
praying-mantis.description: The Chinese praying mantis is a large, elongated predatory insect with triangular head and powerful raptorial front legs. It is a sit-and-wait ambush predator of other insects.
praying-mantis.funFact: Louva-deuses podem girar suas cabeças 180 graus para procurar presas.

dragonfly.name: Libélula
dragonfly.description: Dragonflies are ancient aerial predators with enormous compound eyes and two pairs of independently controlled wings. They are among the most efficient hunters in the insect world.
dragonfly.funFact: Libélulas podem voar em todas as seis direções e pairar como um helicóptero.

firefly.name: Vaga-lume
firefly.description: Fireflies are beetles famous for their bioluminescent abdomens used to attract mates. Both adults and larvae produce light through a chemical reaction involving luciferin and luciferase.
firefly.funFact: Larvas de vagalumes também brilham, e algumas produzem luz para afastar predadores.

black-widow-spider.name: Viúva-negra
black-widow-spider.description: The southern black widow is one of North America's most venomous spiders. Females are recognized by the red hourglass marking on their abdomen and sometimes eat the male after mating.
black-widow-spider.funFact: O veneno da viúva-negra é 15 vezes mais forte que o de uma cascavel, mas menos é injetado.

tarantula.name: Tarântula
tarantula.description: The Mexican red-kneed tarantula is a large, docile spider popular in the pet trade. It has urticating hairs on its abdomen that it can flick at threats, causing skin irritation.
tarantula.funFact: Tarântulas urinam por suas presas, usando fluido digestivo em vez de água.

giant-pacific-octopus.name: Polvo-gigante
giant-pacific-octopus.description: The giant Pacific octopus is the largest known octopus species, renowned for its intelligence and ability to solve puzzles. It has three hearts, blue blood, and eight dexterous arms lined with suckers.
giant-pacific-octopus.funFact: Pode mudar de cor e textura em milissegundos para se misturar com o ambiente.

common-octopus.name: Polvo-comum
common-octopus.description: The common octopus is a highly intelligent marine invertebrate with excellent eyesight and problem-solving abilities. It uses ink clouds and camouflage as primary defense mechanisms.
common-octopus.funFact: Pode se comprimir através de qualquer abertura maior que seu bico.

moon-jellyfish.name: Água-viva-lua
moon-jellyfish.description: Moon jellyfish are one of the most common and widely distributed jellyfish species. Their translucent bells pulse gently through coastal waters, feeding on plankton and small organisms.
moon-jellyfish.funFact: Pode se reproduzir tanto sexualmente quanto assexuadamente, permitindo explosões populacionais.

box-jellyfish.name: Água-viva-caixa
box-jellyfish.description: Box jellyfish are among the most venomous creatures on Earth. Their nearly transparent, cube-shaped bells and up to 60 tentacles make them difficult to spot in tropical waters.
box-jellyfish.funFact: Possui 24 olhos, incluindo dois que podem formar imagens, diferente da maioria das águas-vivas.

common-starfish.name: Estrela-do-mar
common-starfish.description: The common starfish is one of the most recognizable sea stars, with five arms and a tough, spiny surface. It feeds on mussels and oysters by everting its stomach through its mouth.
common-starfish.funFact: Pode virar seu estômago do avesso para digirir presas externamente.

blue-poison-dart-frog.name: Rã-dardo-azul
blue-poison-dart-frog.description: The Blue Poison Dart Frog is a small, brilliantly colored amphibian found in the rainforests of Suriname. Their vivid blue coloration warns predators of their potent skin toxins.
blue-poison-dart-frog.funFact: Rãs-dart-venenosa-azuis obtêm sua toxicidade das formigas e ácaros que comem na natureza.

golden-poison-dart-frog.name: Rã-dardo-dourada
golden-poison-dart-frog.description: The Golden Poison Dart Frog is the most toxic vertebrate on Earth. Found only in Colombia, its bright yellow skin contains batrachotoxin, a potent neurotoxin used by indigenous people to poison blowgun darts.
golden-poison-dart-frog.funFact: Uma única rã-dart-venenosa-dourada carrega toxina suficiente para matar 10 homens adultos.

red-eyed-tree-frog.name: Rã-de-olho-vermelho
red-eyed-tree-frog.description: The Red-Eyed Tree Frog is one of the most iconic rainforest amphibians. With vibrant green bodies, blue and yellow striped sides, and stunning red eyes, they are a symbol of tropical biodiversity.
red-eyed-tree-frog.funFact: Rãs-arbóreas-de-olhos-vermelhos exibem seus olhos vermelhos brilhantes para assustar predadores, dando-lhes uma chance de escapar.

green-basilisk.name: Basilisco-verde
green-basilisk.description: The green basilisk is a striking lizard found in the tropical rainforests of Central America. Males have impressive crests on their heads, backs, and tails. It is famous for its ability to run bipedally across water surfaces for short distances.
green-basilisk.funFact: O basilisco-verde também é chamado de lagarto-Jesus-Cristo porque pode correr sobre a superfície da água.

thorny-devil.name: Diabo-espinhoso
thorny-devil.description: The thorny devil is a small, spiny lizard native to the arid deserts of central Australia. Its entire body is covered in conical spines that provide defense against predators. Its skin has microscopic channels that collect water and transport it to its mouth.
thorny-devil.funFact: Diabos-espinhosos possuem micro-canais em sua pele que canalizam água de qualquer parte do corpo diretamente para suas bocas.

common-snapping-turtle.name: Tartaruga-mordedora
common-snapping-turtle.description: The common snapping turtle is a large, freshwater turtle found across eastern North America. It has a powerful beak-like jaw and a long, prehistoric-looking tail. Unlike most turtles, it cannot fully retract into its shell, making it more aggressive on land.
common-snapping-turtle.funFact: Tartarugas-mordedoras-comuns podem estender seus pescoços quase ao comprimento de suas conchas para atacar presas ou ameaças.

alligator-snapping-turtle.name: Tartaruga-mordedora-de-aligátor
alligator-snapping-turtle.description: The alligator snapping turtle is the largest freshwater turtle in North America. It has a massive head, a hooked beak, and a shell with three prominent ridges. It is an ambush predator that lies motionless on the river bottom with its mouth open.
alligator-snapping-turtle.funFact: Tartarugas-mordedoras-de-aligator possuem um apêndice semelhante a uma minhoca em sua língua que atrai peixes diretamente para suas bocas.

okapi.funFact: Parente vivo mais proximo da girafa
okapi.name: Okapi
okapi.description: O okapi é um parente vivo da girafa, encontrado nas florestas da África Central, com listras zebroides nas pernas.

yak.funFact: Consegue sobreviver em altitudes acima de 6000m
yak.name: Iaque
yak.description: O iaque é um grande mamífero com pelos longos encontrado nas regiões montanhosas da Ásia Central.

domestic-cattle.funFact: Existem mais de 1 bilhao de gado no mundo
domestic-cattle.name: Gado Doméstico
domestic-cattle.description: O gado doméstico é criado para carne, leite e couro em todo o mundo.

gaur.funFact: A maior especie de gado selvagem do mundo
gaur.name: Gaur
gaur.description: O gaur é o maior bovino selvagem do mundo, encontrado nas florestas do sul da Ásia.

saiga-antelope.name: Antílope Saiga
saiga-antelope.description: O antílope saiga é conhecido por seu nariz incomumente grande e bulboso.

addax.name: Adax
addax.description: O adax é um antílope do deserto adaptado a altas temperaturas e pouca água.

oryx.funFact: Consegue sobreviver sem agua por meses
oryx.name: Oryx
oryx.description: O oryx é um antílope do deserto com chifres longos e retos.

clouded-leopard.funFact: Tem os maiores caninos em relacao ao tamanho do corpo
clouded-leopard.name: Leopardo das Nuvens
clouded-leopard.description: O leopardo das nuvens é um felino pequeno com manchas em forma de nuvem.

serval.funFact: Consegue pular mais de 3 metros de altura
serval.name: Serval
serval.description: O serval é um felino africano com pernas longas e orelhas grandes.

caracal.funFact: Consegue pular ate 3 metros para pegar passaros
caracal.name: Caracal
caracal.description: O caracal é um felino conhecido por suas orelhas com tufos de pelos pretos.

pallas-s-cat.funFact: Tem o pelo mais espesso de qualquer especie de gato
pallas-s-cat.name: Gato de Pallas
pallas-s-cat.description: O gato de Pallas é um pequeno felino selvagem da Ásia Central.

sand-cat.name: Gato do Deserto
sand-cat.description: O gato do deserto é o único felino que vive exclusivamente em desertos.

fishing-cat.funFact: Adora agua e nada muito bem
fishing-cat.name: Gato Pescador
fishing-cat.description: O gato pescador é um felino semi-aquático que caça peixes.

american-black-bear.name: Urso-negro-americano
american-black-bear.description: O urso-negro-americano é o urso mais comum na América do Norte.

asian-black-bear.funFact: Tambem chamado de urso da lua por sua marca no peito
asian-black-bear.name: Urso-negro-asiático
asian-black-bear.description: O urso-negro-asiático é conhecido por sua mancha branca em forma de V no peito.

spectacled-bear.funFact: A unica especie de urso na America do Sul
spectacled-bear.name: Urso de Óculos
spectacled-bear.description: O urso de óculos é o único urso da América do Sul, com marcas faciais distintas.

sun-bear.funFact: A menor especie de urso do mundo
sun-bear.name: Urso-sol
sun-bear.description: O urso-sol é o menor urso do mundo, encontrado no Sudeste Asiático.

sloth-bear.funFact: Usa os labios para sugar insetos
sloth-bear.name: Urso-preguiça
sloth-bear.description: O urso-preguiça é um urso insetívoro encontrado no sul da Ásia.

andean-bear.funFact: Tambem chamado de urso de oculos
andean-bear.name: Urso Andino
andean-bear.description: O urso andino é o único urso da América do Sul, também conhecido como urso de óculos.

arctic-wolf.name: Lobo Ártico
arctic-wolf.description: O lobo ártico é uma subespécie do lobo-cinzento que vive no Ártico.

african-wild-dog.funFact: Tem a maior taxa de sucesso de caça entre qualquer predador
african-wild-dog.name: Cão Selvagem Africano
african-wild-dog.description: O cão selvagem africano é um predador em grupo altamente eficiente.

jackal.funFact: Frequentemente visto seguindo leoes para se alimentar de carnica
jackal.name: Chacal
jackal.description: O chacal é um canídeo omnívoro encontrado na África e Eurásia.

maned-wolf.funFact: O canideo selvagem mais alto da America do Sul
maned-wolf.name: Lobo-de-crina
maned-wolf.description: O lobo-de-crina é um canídeo sul-americano com pernas longas e pelagem avermelhada.

western-gorilla.funFact: Parente mais proximo dos humanos (98% do DNA)
western-gorilla.name: Gorila-ocidental
western-gorilla.description: O gorila ocidental é um grande símio encontrado na África Central.

eastern-gorilla.name: Gorila-oriental
eastern-gorilla.description: O gorila oriental é o maior primata vivo, encontrado na África Central.

bonobo.funFact: Mais intimamente relacionado aos humanos do que os chimpanzes
bonobo.name: Bonobo
bonobo.description: O bonobo é um grande símio pacífico encontrado na República Democrática do Congo.

siamang.funFact: Tem um saco na garganta que amplifica os chamados
siamang.name: Siamang
siamang.description: O siamang é o maior gibão, conhecido por sua bolsa gular.

gibbon.funFact: Consegue balancar pelas arvores em alta velocidade
gibbon.name: Gibão
gibbon.description: O gibão é um primata arbóreo encontrado no Sudeste Asiático.

mandrill.name: Mandril
mandrill.description: O mandril é o maior macaco do mundo, conhecido por suas faces coloridas.

proboscis-monkey.funFact: Tem um nariz grande e carnudo
proboscis-monkey.name: Macaco-probóscide
proboscis-monkey.description: O macaco-probóscide é um macaco com nariz grande e bulboso.

spider-monkey.funFact: Tem uma cauda preensil que funciona como um quinto membro
spider-monkey.name: Macaco-aranha
spider-monkey.description: O macaco-aranha é um primata arbóreo com braços longos e cauda preênsil.

capuchin-monkey.name: Macaco-prego
capuchin-monkey.description: O macaco-prego é um macaco inteligente que usa ferramentas.

indri.name: Indri
indri.description: O indri é o maior lêmure vivo, conhecido por seu canto alto.

tarsier.funFact: Tem os maiores olhos em relacao ao tamanho do corpo de qualquer mamifero
tarsier.name: Tarsier
tarsier.description: O tarsier é um pequeno primata com olhos enormes.

aye-aye.funFact: Bate nas arvores para encontrar insetos
aye-aye.name: Aye-aye
aye-aye.description: O aye-aye é um lêmure noturno com um dedo longo e fino.

sperm-whale.funFact: Tem o maior cerebro de qualquer animal
sperm-whale.name: Cachalote
sperm-whale.description: O cachalote é o maior dentado do mundo.

dugong.funFact: O unico mamifero marinho estritamente herbivoro
dugong.name: Dugongo
dugong.description: O dugongo é um grande mamífero marinho herbívoro encontrado no Indo-Pacífico.

elephant-seal.funFact: Consegue segurar a respiracao por 2 horas
elephant-seal.name: Elefante-marinho
elephant-seal.description: O elefante-marinho é o maior pinípedo do mundo.

leopard-seal.funFact: Predador de topo na agua antartica
leopard-seal.name: Leopardo-marinho
leopard-seal.description: O leopardo-marinho é um predador ágil da Antártica.

harp-seal.name: Phoca groenlandica
harp-seal.description: A Phoca groenlandica é um pinípedo do Ártico conhecida por sua pelagem prateada.

sea-otter.name: Lontra-marinha
sea-otter.description: A lontra-marinha é um mamífero marinho que usa ferramentas.

hawaiian-monk-seal.funFact: Uma das focas mais raras do mundo
hawaiian-monk-seal.name: Monge-do-havaí
hawaiian-monk-seal.description: O monge-do-havaí é um pinípedo ameaçado de extinção.

steller-sea-lion.funFact: O maior das focas com orelhas
steller-sea-lion.name: Leão-marinho-de-steller
steller-sea-lion.description: O leão-marinho-de-steller é o maior otarídeo do mundo.

crested-porcupine.funFact: Os espinhos podem ter ate 35 cm de comprimento
crested-porcupine.name: Porco-espinho-de-crista
crested-porcupine.description: O porco-espinho-de-crista é um roedor com espinhos longos.

naked-mole-rat.funFact: Consegue viver decadas mais que roedores de tamanho semelhante
naked-mole-rat.name: Rato-toupeira-pelado
naked-mole-rat.description: O rato-toupeira-pelado é um roedor sem pelos que vive em colônias.

prairie-dog.funFact: Tem um sistema complexo de comunicacao
prairie-dog.name: Cão-da-pradaria
prairie-dog.description: O cão-da-pradaria é um roedor social que vive em grandes colônias.

indian-flying-fox.name: Raposa-voadora-indiana
indian-flying-fox.description: A raposa-voadora-indiana é um grande morcego frugívoro.

little-brown-bat.description: O morcego-marrom é um pequeno morcego insetívoro.

great-horned-owl.name: Great Horned Owl
great-horned-owl.description: The great horned owl is a powerful nocturnal predator with distinctive ear tufts and deep hooting calls. It is highly adaptable and preys on a wide range of animals.

snowy-owl.funFact: Diferente da maioria das corujas, corujas-nevasca são diurnas e caçam durante o dia.
snowy-owl.name: Snowy Owl
snowy-owl.description: The snowy owl is a large, white owl of the Arctic tundra. Unlike most owl species, it hunts during the day, feeding primarily on lemmings. Males become whiter as they age.

northern-saw-whet-owl.funFact: A coruja-serradeira-do-norte é uma das menores corujas da América do Norte, pesando menos que uma lata de refrigerante.
northern-saw-whet-owl.name: Northern Saw-whet Owl
northern-saw-whet-owl.description: The northern saw-whet owl is a tiny, nocturnal owl named for its sawing call. Despite its small size, it is a fierce predator of mice and small birds.

barred-owl.funFact: Corujas-listadas são conhecidas por seu canto distinto que soa como 'Quem cozinha para você'.
barred-owl.name: Barred Owl
barred-owl.description: The barred owl is a large, stocky owl native to eastern North America. It has dark eyes unlike most other owls and a distinctive hooting call.

long-eared-owl.funFact: Corujas-de-orelhas-longas possuem aberturas auditivas assimétricas que permitem localizar presas na escuridão total.
long-eared-owl.name: Long-eared Owl
long-eared-owl.description: The long-eared owl is a medium-sized nocturnal owl with striking orange eyes and very long ear tufts. It is a secretive bird that roosts in dense vegetation.

great-gray-owl.funFact: A coruja-cinza-grande é a coruja mais alta da América do Norte, embora grande parte de seu tamanho sejam penas.
great-gray-owl.name: Great Gray Owl
great-gray-owl.description: The great gray owl is the tallest owl species in North America with a massive facial disc. Despite its imposing size, it is relatively light and feeds primarily on small rodents.

burrowing-owl.funFact: Corujas-cavadoras fazem ninhos subterrâneos em tocas cavadas por cães-da-pradaria ou esquilos.
burrowing-owl.name: Burrowing Owl
burrowing-owl.description: The burrowing owl is a small, long-legged owl that nests in underground burrows. Unlike most owls, it is active during the day and perches on fence posts to watch for prey.

elf-owl.funFact: A coruja-elfo é a menor espécie de coruja do mundo, pesando menos que uma bola de pingue-pongue.
elf-owl.name: Elf Owl
elf-owl.description: The elf owl is the worlds smallest owl, found in the desert Southwest. It nests in holes in saguaro cacti and feeds on insects and small invertebrates.

wood-duck.funFact: Filhotes de pato-mergulhador podem pular de ninhos em árvores de até 15 metros de altura sem se machucar.
wood-duck.name: Wood Duck
wood-duck.description: The wood duck is one of the most colorful waterfowl in North America. Males display elaborate patterns of green, purple, and white. Unlike most ducks, it nests in tree cavities.

northern-pintail.funFact: A cauda longa do pato-rabo-fino o torna um dos patos mais elegantes em voo.
northern-pintail.name: Northern Pintail
northern-pintail.description: The northern pintail is a graceful duck recognized by the males long, pointed tail feathers. It has a chocolate-brown head and white breast stripe.

green-winged-teal.funFact: O pato-de-asas-verdes é o menor pato mergulhador da América do Norte.
green-winged-teal.name: Green-winged Teal
green-winged-teal.description: The green-winged teal is a small, agile duck with a distinctive chestnut head and green eye patch. It feeds by dabbling at the water surface.

canvasback.funFact: O pato-canvas é o maior e mais rápido pato mergulhador da América do Norte.
canvasback.name: Canvasback
canvasback.description: The canvasback is a large diving duck with a distinctive sloping profile. Males have a white body and reddish-brown head.

snow-goose.funFact: Bandos de gansos-das-neves podem ter centenas de milhares de indivíduos durante a migração.
snow-goose.name: Snow Goose
snow-goose.description: The snow goose is a medium-sized goose with white plumage and black wingtips. It breeds in the Arctic and winters in southern marshes.

greylag-goose.funFact: O ganso-cinza é o ancestral da maioria das raças de gansos domésticos da Europa.
greylag-goose.name: Greylag Goose
greylag-goose.description: The greylag goose is a large waterfowl with grey-brown plumage and an orange bill. It is the ancestor of most domestic geese.

trumpeter-swan.funFact: O cisne-trombeteiro é a ave nativa mais pesada da América do Norte.
trumpeter-swan.name: Trumpeter Swan
trumpeter-swan.description: The trumpeter swan is the largest waterfowl in North America with a wingspan up to 8 feet. Named for its resonant, trumpet-like call, it has recovered from near extinction.

tundra-swan.funFact: Cisnes-das-tundras migram até 6.400 km entre áreas de reprodução árticas e áreas de invernada.
tundra-swan.name: Tundra Swan
tundra-swan.description: The tundra swan is a large, white swan that breeds in the Arctic tundra. It has a distinctive yellow spot near the eye and forms large flocks during migration.

american-robin.funFact: Tordos-americanos podem comer 4 metros de minhocas em um único dia.
american-robin.name: American Robin
american-robin.description: The American robin is one of the most familiar songbirds in North America. Recognized by its rusty-red breast and melodic song, it is often seen hopping across lawns.

northern-cardinal.funFact: Fêmeas de cardeal-do-norte também cantam, o que é raro entre aves canoras da América do Norte.
northern-cardinal.name: Northern Cardinal
northern-cardinal.description: The northern cardinal is a vivid red songbird with a distinctive crest and black face. Males are brilliant red while females are warm brown with red accents.

blue-jay.funFact: Pode imitar a voz de predadores
blue-jay.name: Blue Jay
blue-jay.description: The blue jay is a striking songbird with blue, white, and black plumage and a prominent crest. It is intelligent and vocal, known for its loud calls and bold behavior.

american-crow.funFact: Corvos-americanos podem reconhecer rostos humanos individuais e guardar rancor.
american-crow.name: American Crow
american-crow.description: The American crow is a large, all-black bird known for its intelligence and adaptability. It uses tools, solves complex problems, and lives in large family groups.

common-raven.funFact: Corvos podem deslizar por telhados cobertos de neve por diversão e realizar acrobacias aéreas.
common-raven.name: Common Raven
common-raven.description: The common raven is the largest songbird in North America. Extremely intelligent, it has been observed using tools, solving multi-step puzzles, and manipulating other animals.

house-sparrow.funFact: Pardais-domésticos foram introduzidos na América do Norte em 1851 e desde então se espalharam pelo continente.
house-sparrow.name: House Sparrow
house-sparrow.description: The house sparrow is one of the most widespread and familiar birds in the world. Originally from Eurasia, it thrives in close association with human habitation.

european-robin.funFact: O petro americano é um símbolo de Natal na Grã-Bretanha e aparece em muitos cartões festivos.
european-robin.name: European Robin
european-robin.description: The European robin is a small insectivorous bird with a distinctive orange-red breast. Familiar in gardens across Europe, it is known for its territorial behavior.

eastern-bluebird.funFact: Sabiás-orientais podem enxergar luz ultravioleta, o que ajuda a encontrar frutas maduras.
eastern-bluebird.name: Eastern Bluebird
eastern-bluebird.description: The eastern bluebird is a small thrush with brilliant blue plumage on the back and a rusty-red throat and breast. A symbol of happiness, it was saved from decline by nest box programs.

western-bluebird.funFact: Sabiás-ocidentais são uma das poucas aves canoras que fazem ninhos em buracos velhos de pica-paus.
western-bluebird.name: Western Bluebird
western-bluebird.description: The western bluebird is a small thrush with deep blue plumage and a rusty breast. It nests in cavities and feeds primarily on insects caught on the ground.

baltimore-oriole.funFact: Ímpetus-do-baltimore tecem ninhos pendurados intrincados que podem levar até duas semanas para construir.
baltimore-oriole.name: Baltimore Oriole
baltimore-oriole.description: The Baltimore oriole is a striking songbird with vivid orange and black plumage. They weave elaborate pendulous nests from plant fibers.

scarlet-tanager.funFact: O macho do cardeal-virgem torna-se verde-oliva no inverno, parecendo uma ave completamente diferente.
scarlet-tanager.name: Scarlet Tanager
scarlet-tanager.description: The scarlet tanager is a medium-sized songbird with brilliant red plumage and black wings during breeding season. It is a shy forest bird.

yellow-warbler.funFact: Futuros-amarelos são uma das primeiras aves canoras a chegar em seus territórios de reprodução na primavera.
yellow-warbler.name: Yellow Warbler
yellow-warbler.description: The yellow warbler is a small, bright yellow songbird widespread across North America. Its cheerful song is one of the most recognizable spring sounds.

white-throated-sparrow.funFact: Fogoeiros-de-garganta-branca vêm em duas formas de cores que se emparelham quase exclusivamente entre si.
white-throated-sparrow.name: White-throated Sparrow
white-throated-sparrow.description: The white-throated sparrow is a common songbird with a distinctive white throat patch and yellow lores. It has two color morphs that differ in behavior.

dark-eyed-junco.funFact: Juncos-de-olhos-pretos são chamados de aves-de-neve porque aparecem nos estados do sul durante o inverno.
dark-eyed-junco.name: Dark-eyed Junco
dark-eyed-junco.description: The dark-eyed junco is a small, slate-colored sparrow common across North America. It is one of the most abundant and widespread forest birds.

ruby-throated-hummingbird.funFact: Colibris-de-garganta-vermelha batem as asas 53 vezes por segundo e podem voar para trás.
ruby-throated-hummingbird.name: Ruby-throated Hummingbird
ruby-throated-hummingbird.description: The ruby-throated hummingbird is the only breeding hummingbird in eastern North America. Males have an iridescent ruby-red throat.

annas-hummingbird.funFact: Machos de colibris-de-anna realizam exibições de mergulho dramáticas que criam um trinado audível.
annas-hummingbird.name: Annas Hummingbird
annas-hummingbird.description: Annas hummingbird is a small, green hummingbird native to western North America. Males have a brilliant rose-pink throat and crown.

black-chinned-hummingbird.funFact: O queixo preto deste colibri brilha em púrpura brilhante quando a luz o atinge no ângulo certo.
black-chinned-hummingbird.name: Black-chinned Hummingbird
black-chinned-hummingbird.description: The black-chinned hummingbird is a small, common hummingbird of the western United States with a velvet-black chin that shows iridescent purple.

belted-kingfisher.funFact: O guardião-ruivo é uma das poucas espécies de aves em que as fêmeas são mais coloridas que os machos.
belted-kingfisher.name: Belted Kingfisher
belted-kingfisher.description: The belted kingfisher is a stocky, blue-gray bird with a shaggy crest and large dagger-like bill. Females have an additional rusty band across the belly.

great-blue-heron.funFact: Garças-azuis-grandes podem ficar imóveis por horas esperando o momento perfeito para atacar presas.
great-blue-heron.name: Great Blue Heron
great-blue-heron.description: The great blue heron is the largest heron in North America, with a wingspan up to 6.5 feet. It wades in shallow water to hunt fish.

great-egret.funFact: As longas plumas de garças-brancas-grandes quase a levaram à extinção no século XIX para uso em chapéus femininos.
great-egret.name: Great Egret
great-egret.description: The great egret is a large, all-white heron with a yellow bill and black legs. Its near-extinction for the millinery trade helped spark the conservation movement.

snowy-egret.funFact: Garças-brancas-pequenas usam seus pés amarelos brilhantes para agitar presas do fundo lamacento.
snowy-egret.name: Snowy Egret
snowy-egret.description: The snowy egret is a small, elegant white heron with black legs and vivid yellow feet. During breeding season, it develops long, flowing plumes.

green-heron.funFact: Garças-verdes são uma das poucas espécies de aves que usam ferramentas, deixando iscas na água para atrair peixes.
green-heron.name: Green Heron
green-heron.description: The green heron is a small, stocky heron with dark greenish-gray plumage. It is a clever hunter that sometimes uses bait to lure fish.

american-flamingo.funFact: Flamingos-americanos são os mais brilhantemente coloridos de todas as espécies de flamingo.
american-flamingo.name: American Flamingo
american-flamingo.description: The American flamingo is a large, bright pink wading bird found in the Caribbean and Galapagos with the brightest plumage of all flamingos.

sandhill-crane.funFact: Grous-de-colina realizam danças elaboradas que incluem pular, se curvar e jogar gravetos.
sandhill-crane.name: Sandhill Crane
sandhill-crane.description: The sandhill crane is a tall, gray bird with a red crown and long legs. Known for its trumpeting call and spectacular mating dances.

whooping-crane.funFact: Grous-americanos já chegaram a ter apenas 15 pássaros na natureza, tornando-se um dos mais raros da América do Norte.
whooping-crane.name: Whooping Crane
whooping-crane.description: The whooping crane is the tallest bird in North America. Named for its loud whooping call, it was saved from extinction through intensive conservation.

purple-gallinule.funFact: Galinhas-azuis podem andar sobre folhas de nymphaea graças aos seus dedos extremamente longos.
purple-gallinule.name: Purple Gallinule
purple-gallinule.description: The purple gallinule is a brightly colored marsh bird with purple-blue plumage and a red and yellow bill. It walks gracefully on floating vegetation.

american-coot.funFact: Galinhas-d'água-americanas podem se afundar lentamente na água para se esconder, submergindo até o pescoço.
american-coot.name: American Coot
american-coot.description: The American coot is a dark, chicken-like waterbird with a white bill and frontal shield. Despite looking duck-like, it is related to rails.

wild-turkey.funFact: Perus-selvagens podem voar a velocidades de até 88 km/h e correr a 40 km/h.
wild-turkey.name: Wild Turkey
wild-turkey.description: The wild turkey is a large, iridescent bird native to North America. Males display elaborate courtship rituals. It is the ancestor of the domesticated turkey.

ring-necked-pheasant.funFact: Machos de faisão-de-pescoço-anelado possuem plumagem tão viva que foram usados como modelos para ilustrações de dragões.
ring-necked-pheasant.name: Ring-necked Pheasant
ring-necked-pheasant.description: The ring-necked pheasant is a colorful game bird originally from Asia, now established across North America and Europe. Males have brilliant copper and green plumage.

bobwhite-quail.funFact: O codorniz-cobiçado é nomeado por seu canto distinto de duas notas que soa como seu nome.
bobwhite-quail.name: Northern Bobwhite
bobwhite-quail.description: The northern bobwhite is a small, compact quail with a distinctive white throat and eyebrow stripe in males. Named for its clear bob-white call.

california-quail.funFact: A plumagem distinta da cabeça da codorniz-da-califórnia se curva para frente como um ponto de interrogação.
california-quail.name: California Quail
california-quail.description: The California quail is a small, plump ground bird with a distinctive forward-curving black head plume. It is the state bird of California.

rockhopper-penguin.funFact: Pinguins-saltadores saltam de pedra em pedra usando ambos os pés em vez de andar cambaleando.
rockhopper-penguin.name: Rockhopper Penguin
rockhopper-penguin.description: The rockhopper penguin is a small penguin known for its distinctive yellow and black crest feathers. It navigates steep, rocky terrain by hopping.

little-blue-penguin.funFact: Pinguins-azuis-pequenos são a menor espécie de pinguim, com apenas 33 cm de altura.
little-blue-penguin.name: Little Blue Penguin
little-blue-penguin.description: The little blue penguin, also known as the fairy penguin, is the smallest species of penguin. Found in New Zealand and southern Australia.

gentoo-penguin.funFact: Pinguins-gentoo são as aves que nadam mais debaixo d'água, atingindo velocidades de 35 km/h.
gentoo-penguin.name: Gentoo Penguin
gentoo-penguin.description: The gentoo penguin is recognizable by the white stripe across its head and its bright orange-red bill. It is the fastest underwater swimming bird.

african-penguin.funFact: Pinguins-africanos às vezes são chamados de pinguins-jumento porque rebuzinam como jumentos.
african-penguin.name: African Penguin
african-penguin.description: The African penguin, also known as the jackass penguin for its donkey-like bray, is the only penguin species that breeds in Africa. It is endangered.

brown-kiwi.funFact: Ovos de kiwi são enormes em relação ao tamanho do corpo, até 20% do peso da fêmea.
brown-kiwi.name: Brown Kiwi
brown-kiwi.description: The brown kiwi is a flightless bird native to New Zealand. It has hair-like feathers, no tail, and a long probing bill with nostrils at the tip.

lyrebird.funFact: A ave-lira pode imitar virtualmente qualquer som, incluindo motosserras, obturadores de câmera e alarmes de carros.
lyrebird.name: Superb Lyrebird
lyrebird.description: The superb lyrebird is famous for its extraordinary ability to mimic sounds. Males have an elaborate tail that forms a lyre shape during courtship.

cassowary.funFact: O casuário-do-sul é considerado a ave mais perigosa do mundo devido a seus chutes poderosos.
cassowary.name: Southern Cassowary
cassowary.description: The southern cassowary is a large, flightless bird with a distinctive blue neck, red wattles, and a bony casque on its head.

scarlet-macaw.funFact: Araras-escarlatas podem viver mais de 75 anos em cativeiro e acasalam para a vida.
scarlet-macaw.name: Scarlet Macaw
scarlet-macaw.description: The scarlet macaw is a large, colorful parrot with brilliant red, yellow, and blue plumage. Found in Central and South American rainforests.

blue-and-yellow-macaw.funFact: Araras-azuis-e-amarelas podem voar a velocidades de até 56 km/h e usar seus bicos poderosos para quebrar nozes duras.
blue-and-yellow-macaw.name: Blue-and-yellow Macaw
blue-and-yellow-macaw.description: The blue-and-yellow macaw is a large parrot with vivid blue upperparts and golden-yellow underparts. It is highly social and can mimic human speech.

hyacinth-macaw.funFact: A arara-azul-grande é o maior papagaio voador do mundo, com envergadura superior a 1,2 metro.
hyacinth-macaw.name: Hyacinth Macaw
hyacinth-macaw.description: The hyacinth macaw is the largest of all flying parrot species, with stunning cobalt-blue plumage and bright yellow eye rings.

african-grey-parrot.funFact: Papagaios-cinzentos-africanos são considerados a espécie de ave mais inteligente, com habilidades cognitivas comparáveis às de crianças pequenas.
african-grey-parrot.name: African Grey Parrot
african-grey-parrot.description: The African grey parrot is renowned for its exceptional intelligence and ability to mimic human speech. It has grey plumage with a striking red tail.

budgerigar.funFact: Agapornis são o terceiro animal de estimação mais popular do mundo, depois de cães e gatos.
budgerigar.name: Budgerigar
budgerigar.description: The budgerigar is a small, long-tailed parakeet native to Australia. In the wild, it is green and yellow with black markings.

cockatiel.funFact: Agapornis são uma das poucas espécies de papagaios que podem assobiar melodias com precisão.
cockatiel.name: Cockatiel
cockatiel.description: The cockatiel is a small parrot native to Australia, recognizable by its prominent crest and orange cheek patches.
