keel-billed-toucan.funFact: O bico colorido do tucano é surpreendentemente leve, feito principalmente de queratina com estrutura de favo de mel.
keel-billed-toucan.name: Keel-billed Toucan
keel-billed-toucan.description: The keel-billed toucan is a colorful bird with a massive, rainbow-colored bill. Found in Central and South American rainforests.

toco-toucan.funFact: O bico do tucano-toco contém uma rede de vasos sanguíneos que ajudam a regular a temperatura corporal.
toco-toucan.name: Toco Toucan
toco-toucan.description: The toco toucan is the largest toucan species, with a massive orange-yellow bill tipped in black. Found in South American forests.

great-hornbill.funFact: Casais de calau密封 o macho dentro de uma cavidade durante o ninho, deixando apenas uma pequena fenda para alimentação.
great-hornbill.name: Great Hornbill
great-hornbill.description: The great hornbill is one of the largest hornbill species, distinguished by its massive yellow and black casque atop its bill.

rhinoceros-hornbill.funFact: O casco curvado para cima do calau-rinoceronte pode crescer até 18 cm de comprimento.
rhinoceros-hornbill.name: Rhinoceros Hornbill
rhinoceros-hornbill.description: The rhinoceros hornbill is a large hornbill with a dramatic upward-curving casque on its bill. Found in Southeast Asian rainforests.

laughing-kookaburra.funFact: O chamado da gaivota-risível soa exatamente como gargalhadas humanas ecoando.
laughing-kookaburra.name: Laughing Kookaburra
laughing-kookaburra.description: The laughing kookaburra is a large kingfisher native to Australia, famous for its distinctive call that sounds like loud, echoing human laughter.

pied-kingfisher.funFact: O martin-pescador-malhado é a única espécie de martin-pescador que pode ficar parado sobre a água antes de mergulhar.
pied-kingfisher.name: Pied Kingfisher
pied-kingfisher.description: The pied kingfisher is a black and white kingfisher found across Africa and Asia. It hovers over water before diving to catch fish.

atlantic-puffin.funFact: Pápacos podem carregar 10 ou mais peixes em seus bicos ao mesmo tempo graças a estruturas especializadas de língua e bico.
atlantic-puffin.name: Atlantic Puffin
atlantic-puffin.description: The Atlantic puffin is a small seabird with a colorful triangular bill and distinctive black and white plumage. Known as the clown of the sea.

tufted-puffin.funFact: Pápacos-de-crista podem mergulhar a profundidades superiores a 60 metros para pegar peixes.
tufted-puffin.name: Tufted Puffin
tufted-puffin.description: The tufted puffin is a small seabird with black plumage, white face patches, and distinctive golden head tufts during breeding season.

wandering-albatross.funFact: O albatroz-vagante possui a maior envergadura de qualquer ave viva, ultrapassando 3,5 metros.
wandering-albatross.name: Wandering Albatross
wandering-albatross.description: The wandering albatross has the largest wingspan of any bird, up to 11.5 feet. It spends most of its life soaring over the Southern Ocean.

black-browed-albatross.funFact: Albatrozes-de-sobrancelha-preta podem dormir enquanto voam sobre o oceano.
black-browed-albatross.name: Black-browed Albatross
black-browed-albatross.description: The black-browed albatross is a large seabird with dark upper wings and a white body. Named for the dark stripe through its eye.

laysan-albatross.funFact: A ave selvagem mais velha conhecida do mundo é um albatroz-de-Laysan chamado Sabedoria, com mais de 70 anos.
laysan-albatross.name: Laysan Albatross
laysan-albatross.description: The Laysan albatross is a large seabird of the North Pacific. It breeds primarily on remote Pacific islands.

brown-pelican.funFact: Pelicanos-pardos podem mergulhar de alturas superiores a 18 metros para pegar peixes, com bolsas de ar amortecendo o impacto.
brown-pelican.name: Brown Pelican
brown-pelican.description: The brown pelican is a large waterbird with a massive bill and throat pouch. It is unique among pelicans for plunge-diving from the air.

american-white-pelican.funFact: Pelicanos-brancos-americanos pescam cooperativamente, conduzindo cardumes de peixes para águas rasas.
american-white-pelican.name: American White Pelican
american-white-pelican.description: The American white pelican is one of the largest North American birds, with a wingspan up to 9 feet. It scoops fish while swimming.

frigatebird.funFact: Fragatas podem permanecer no ar por semanas e dormir enquanto voam sobre o oceano.
frigatebird.name: Magnificent Frigatebird
frigatebird.description: The magnificent frigatebird is a large seabird with long, angular wings and a deeply forked tail. Males inflate a bright red throat pouch.

northern-gannet.funFact: Mergulhões-do-norte mergulham de alturas de 40 metros, atingindo a água a 97 km/h.
northern-gannet.name: Northern Gannet
northern-gannet.description: The northern gannet is the largest seabird in the North Atlantic. It nests in massive colonies on sea cliffs.

blue-footed-booby.funFact: Machos de bobos-de-pés-azuis realizam uma dança elaborada, levantando alternadamente seus pés azuis brilhantes para atrair fêmeas.
blue-footed-booby.name: Blue-footed Booby
blue-footed-booby.description: The blue-footed booby is a marine bird famous for its vivid blue feet. Found along the Pacific coast of the Americas.

red-footed-booby.funFact: Bobos-de-pés-vermelhos são a espécie de boba mais abundante e os únicos que regularmente fazem ninhos em árvores.
red-footed-booby.name: Red-footed Booby
red-footed-booby.description: The red-footed booby is the smallest booby species, with distinctive red feet. It comes in several color morphs.

great-cormorant.funFact: Corvos-marinhos têm menos óleo de limpeza que outras aves aquáticas, o que ajuda a mergulhar mas requer secagem de asas.
great-cormorant.name: Great Cormorant
great-cormorant.description: The great cormorant is a large, dark waterbird found across much of the world. It spreads its wings to dry after fishing.

common-loon.funFact: Guai-cobres-comuns possuem ossos sólidos que os tornam menos flutuantes e melhores em mergulho que a maioria das aves.
common-loon.name: Common Loon
common-loon.description: The common loon is a large waterbird known for its haunting wail across northern lakes. Its solid bones help it dive deep.

arctic-tern.funFact: Trilhas-meltas-do-ártico migram do Ártico para a Antártida e retornam a cada ano, a migração mais longa de qualquer animal, até 70.000 km.
arctic-tern.name: Arctic Tern
arctic-tern.description: The Arctic tern migrates farther than any other animal. It experiences more daylight than any other creature.

caspian-tern.funFact: A gaivina-do-mar-Cáspio é a maior espécie de gaivina do mundo.
caspian-tern.name: Caspian Tern
caspian-tern.description: The Caspian tern is the worlds largest tern, with a massive red bill and black cap. Found on every continent except Antarctica.

black-skimmer.funFact: O bico inferior do간.settingsbico-de-lâmina-preta é mais longo que o superior, permitindo que deslize peixes sobre a superfície da água.
black-skimmer.name: Black Skimmer
black-skimmer.description: The black skimmer is a unique seabird with a distinctive uneven bill. It flies low over water, dragging its bill to catch fish.

herring-gull.funFact: Gaivotas-ardósia podem beber água do mar graças a glândulas especiais acima de seus olhos que filtram o excesso de sal.
herring-gull.name: Herring Gull
herring-gull.description: The herring gull is one of the most common gulls in the Northern Hemisphere, thriving in coastal and urban environments.

laughing-gull.funFact: Gaivotas-ridentes são nomeadas por seu canto que soa como gargalhadas humanas agudas.
laughing-gull.name: Laughing Gull
laughing-gull.description: The laughing gull is a medium-sized gull with a distinctive black head in breeding season and a laughing call.

killdeer.funFact: Batuiras realizam uma atuação de asa quebrada para afastar predadores de seus ninhos no chão.
killdeer.name: Killdeer
killdeer.description: The killdeer is a large plover with distinctive black breast bands. It is famous for its broken-wing display.

american-woodcock.funFact: Sabiwiras-americanas possuem olhos nos lados de suas cabeças e podem enxergar 360 graus.
american-woodcock.name: American Woodcock
american-woodcock.description: The American woodcock is a plump shorebird with a long bill. It feeds on earthworms and performs an aerial sky-dance at dusk.

red-knot.funFact: Calidris-canutus migram até 14.000 km sem parar do Ártico para a ponta da América do Sul.
red-knot.name: Red Knot
red-knot.description: The red knot is famous for one of the longest migrations in the animal kingdom. It turns rusty-red during breeding season.

american-avocet.funFact: Avoantes-americanos varrem seus bicos voltados para cima de um lado para o outro na água para pegar pequenos invertebrados.
american-avocet.name: American Avocet
american-avocet.description: The American avocet is an elegant wader with a thin, upturned bill and long legs. During breeding season, its head and neck turn rusty-orange.

black-necked-stilt.funFact: O pernilongo-de-pescoço-preto possui as segunda-maiores pernas em relação ao tamanho do corpo de qualquer ave, depois do flamingo.
black-necked-stilt.name: Black-necked Stilt
black-necked-stilt.description: The black-necked stilt is a striking wader with black upperparts, white underparts, and extraordinarily long pink legs.

willow-ptarmigan.funFact: Pדמוs-de-salix mudam de cor com as estações, castanho no verão e branco puro no inverno.
willow-ptarmigan.name: Willow Ptarmigan
willow-ptarmigan.description: The willow ptarmigan is a game bird of the Arctic tundra that changes plumage with the seasons.

spruce-grouse.funFact: Tetrazes-de-abeto são tão mansos que às vezes são chamados de galinhas tolas porque raramente voam do perigo.
spruce-grouse.name: Spruce Grouse
spruce-grouse.description: The spruce grouse is a forest-dwelling game bird of the boreal region, known for its tameness.

ruffed-grouse.funFact: Machos de tetraz-de-pescoço-anelado criam um som de tambor batendo as asas rapidamente para atrair fêmeas.
ruffed-grouse.name: Ruffed Grouse
ruffed-grouse.description: The ruffed grouse is a popular game bird of eastern North American forests with a distinctive drumming display.

chukar.funFact: Perdizes-chukar preferem correr colina acima a voar quando escapam do perigo.
chukar.name: Chukar
chukar.description: The chukar is a rotund game bird native to Eurasia and introduced to North America with distinctive black and white barring.

common-crane.funFact: Grous-comuns realizam danças elaboradas com pulos, reverências e bater de asas durante o cortejo.
common-crane.name: Common Crane
common-crane.description: The common crane is a large, elegant wading bird with gray plumage and a red crown patch. Famous for its courtship dances.

demoiselle-crane.funFact: Grous-dama voam em altitudes superiores a 8.000 metros durante sua migração pelo Himalaia.
demoiselle-crane.name: Demoiselle Crane
demoiselle-crane.description: The demoiselle crane is the smallest crane species, elegant and graceful with a black neck and white ear tufts.

bearded-vulture.funFact: Gypaetus-barbatus comem ossos, deixando-os cair de grandes alturas para quebrá-los em pedaços engolíveis.
bearded-vulture.name: Bearded Vulture
bearded-vulture.description: The bearded vulture is the only bird species that feeds almost exclusively on bones.

andean-condor.funFact: O condor-andino possui a maior envergadura de qualquer rapina, ultrapassando 3 metros.
andean-condor.name: Andean Condor
andean-condor.description: The Andean condor is one of the worlds largest flying birds. It soars on thermal currents over the Andes mountains.

king-vulture.funFact: Urubus-reis eram considerados pelos maias como mensageiros entre humanos e deuses.
king-vulture.name: King Vulture
king-vulture.description: The king vulture is a large, colorful vulture with a vividly colored head and a white body.

turkey-vulture.funFact: Urubus-de-cabeça-vermelha possuem o melhor olfato de qualquer ave, capazes de detectar carniça a quilômetros de distância.
turkey-vulture.name: Turkey Vulture
turkey-vulture.description: The turkey vulture is a large soaring bird with a red, featherless head resembling a wild turkey.

american-kestrel.funFact: Quissetes-americanos podem ver luz ultravioleta, o que ajuda a rastrear os rastros de urina de roedores.
american-kestrel.name: American Kestrel
american-kestrel.description: The American kestrel is the smallest and most common falcon in North America. Males have slate-blue wings.

merlin.funFact: Esmerilhões eram conhecidos como falcões-pombos devido ao hábito de caçar pombos.
merlin.name: Merlin
merlin.description: The merlin is a small, powerful falcon found across the Northern Hemisphere. It pursues small birds in direct flight.

prairie-falcon.funFact: Falcões-da-pradária podem atingir velocidades superiores a 72 km/h em voo nivelado e muito mais rápidos em mergulho.
prairie-falcon.name: Prairie Falcon
prairie-falcon.description: The prairie falcon is a large, sandy-brown falcon of the western North American open country.

gyrfalcon.funFact: O falcão-gerifalte é o maior falcão do mundo e era reservado como ave de reis.
gyrfalcon.name: Gyrfalcon
gyrfalcon.description: The gyrfalcon is the largest of all falcon species, found in Arctic regions. It was historically prized in falconry for royalty.

osprey.funFact: Gaviões-pescadores possuem dedos externos reversíveis que permitem agarrar peixes com dois dedos na frente e dois atrás.
osprey.name: Osprey
osprey.description: The osprey is a large raptor found on every continent except Antarctica. It feeds almost exclusively on fish.

northern-harrier.funFact: Gaviões-do-norte possuem discos faciais semelhantes aos de corujas que ajudam a localizar presas pelo som.
northern-harrier.name: Northern Harrier
northern-harrier.description: The northern harrier is a slim raptor that hunts by flying low over open ground, using both sight and sound.

coopers-hawk.funFact: Gaviões-de-cooper são ágeis o suficiente para perseguir presas em florestas densas em alta velocidade.
coopers-hawk.name: Coopers Hawk
coopers-hawk.description: The Coopers hawk is a medium-sized accipiter that specializes in capturing doves and songbirds in flight.

sharp-shinned-hawk.funFact: O gavião-pequeno é o menor gavião da América do Norte, pouco maior que um sabiá.
sharp-shinned-hawk.name: Sharp-shinned Hawk
sharp-shinned-hawk.description: The sharp-shinned hawk is the smallest accipiter in North America. A rapid, agile flier that hunts small songbirds.

swainsons-hawk.funFact: Gaviões-de-Swainson migram em bandos massivos de centenas de milhares da América do Norte para a América do Sul.
swainsons-hawk.name: Swainsons Hawk
swainsons-hawk.description: The Swainsons hawk is a medium-sized raptor that migrates in enormous flocks to the pampas of Argentina for the winter.

rough-legged-hawk.funFact: Gaviões-de-pernas-peludas possuem pernas com penas até os dedos, adaptadas para o frio ártico.
rough-legged-hawk.name: Rough-legged Hawk
rough-legged-hawk.description: The rough-legged hawk breeds in the Arctic tundra and winters in open prairies of North America.

ferruginous-hawk.funFact: O gavião-ferrugíneo é o maior gavião da América do Norte, com envergadura superior a 1,5 metro.
ferruginous-hawk.name: Ferruginous Hawk
ferruginous-hawk.description: The ferruginous hawk is the largest buteo hawk in North America with rust-colored upperparts.

white-tailed-kite.funFact: Pássaros-de-cauda-branca podem ficar parados no ar por longos períodos enquanto examinam o solo em busca de presas.
white-tailed-kite.name: White-tailed Kite
white-tailed-kite.description: The white-tailed kite is a graceful raptor with white plumage, black shoulders, and a forked tail.

mississippi-kite.funFact: Milhafes-do-Mississippi comem enormes quantidades de cigarras e outros insetos capturados no ar.
mississippi-kite.name: Mississippi Kite
mississippi-kite.description: The Mississippi kite is a small, elegant raptor with pearl-gray plumage that feeds primarily on insects caught in flight.

red-winged-blackbird.funFact: Tricolores-de-asas-vermelhas são uma das aves mais abundantes da América do Norte, com mais de 200 milhões de indivíduos.
red-winged-blackbird.name: Red-winged Blackbird
red-winged-blackbird.description: The red-winged blackbird is one of the most abundant and widespread birds in North America with bright red and yellow shoulder patches.

brown-headed-cowbird.funFact: Icterus-de-cabeça-marrom são parasitas de ninhada que põem seus ovos em ninhos de outras aves.
brown-headed-cowbird.name: Brown-headed Cowbird
brown-headed-cowbird.description: The brown-headed cowbird is a brood parasite that lays its eggs in the nests of other bird species.

common-grackle.funFact: Quiscalus-comuns possuem penas iridescentes que brilham em púrpura, verde e bronze à luz do sol.
common-grackle.name: Common Grackle
common-grackle.description: The common grackle is a large, lanky blackbird with iridescent plumage and bright yellow eyes.

great-tailed-grackle.funFact: Machos de quiscalus-de-cauda-grande possuem envergadura de quase 45 cm e suas caudas longas representam metade de seu comprimento total.
great-tailed-grackle.name: Great-tailed Grackle
great-tailed-grackle.description: The great-tailed grackle is a large, noisy blackbird with a very long, keel-shaped tail.

yellow-headed-blackbird.funFact: Machos de icterus-de-cabeça-amarela defendem pequenos territórios de ninhos em pântanos, às vezes com múltiplas fêmeas.
yellow-headed-blackbird.name: Yellow-headed Blackbird
yellow-headed-blackbird.description: The yellow-headed blackbird is a striking songbird with a brilliant yellow-orange head contrasting with a black body.

eastern-meadowlark.funFact: O lázaro-do-leste parece quase idêntico ao lázaro-do-oeste, mas tem um canto completamente diferente.
eastern-meadowlark.name: Eastern Meadowlark
eastern-meadowlark.description: The eastern meadowlark is a bright yellow songbird with a distinctive V-shaped black breast band.

western-meadowlark.funFact: O lázaro-do-oeste é a ave do estado de seis estados americanos diferentes, mais que qualquer outra ave.
western-meadowlark.name: Western Meadowlark
western-meadowlark.description: The western meadowlark is a bright yellow songbird with a black V-shaped breast band, the state bird of six states.

orchard-oriole.funFact: O icterus-do-pomar é o menor icterídeo da América do Norte, menor até que o pardal-doméstico.
orchard-oriole.name: Orchard Oriole
orchard-oriole.description: The orchard oriole is a small, chestnut and black songbird. Males have a chestnut body with a black head.

bullocks-oriole.funFact: Ímpetus-de-Bullock tecem ninhos suspensos elaborados que pendem dos galhos das árvores.
bullocks-oriole.name: Bullocks Oriole
bullocks-oriole.description: The Bullocks oriole is a bright orange and black songbird of western North America that weaves hanging basket nests.

barn-swallow.funFact: Andorinhas-do-celeiro migram até 9.600 km entre seus territórios de reprodução e invernada.
barn-swallow.name: Barn Swallow
barn-swallow.description: The barn swallow is the most widespread swallow species in the world with a distinctive deeply forked tail.

tree-swallow.funFact: Andorinhas-de-árvore são uma das poucas aves canoras da América do Norte que podem digerir frutas, permitindo que migrem mais cedo na primavera.
tree-swallow.name: Tree Swallow
tree-swallow.description: The tree swallow is a small, iridescent blue-green swallow with white underparts.

cliff-swallow.funFact: Andorinhas-de-rocha constam ninhos de lama em forma de cabaça em colônias que podem ter centenas de indivíduos.
cliff-swallow.name: Cliff Swallow
cliff-swallow.description: The cliff swallow is a small swallow with a pale rump and squared-off tail that builds enclosed mud nests in colonies.

purple-martin.funFact: Andorinhas-roxas são quase completamente dependentes de caixas de ninho fornecidas por humanos no leste dos Estados Unidos.
purple-martin.name: Purple Martin
purple-martin.description: The purple martin is the largest North American swallow with iridescent purple-blue plumage in males.

bank-swallow.funFact: Andorinhas-de-banco são a menor espécie de andorinha na América do Norte e fazem ninhos em tocas cavadas em bancos arenosos.
bank-swallow.name: Bank Swallow
bank-swallow.description: The bank swallow is the smallest swallow in North America, nesting in burrows excavated in sandy banks near water.

violet-green-swallow.funFact: Andorinhas-violetas-verdes possuem manchas brancas em seu rosto que se estendem até a parte de trás de suas cabeças.
violet-green-swallow.name: Violet-green Swallow
violet-green-swallow.description: The violet-green swallow is a small, colorful swallow with iridescent green and violet upperparts.

chimney-swift.funFact: Andorinhas-de-chaminé podem passar quase toda sua vida no ar, até dormindo enquanto voam.
chimney-swift.name: Chimney Swift
chimney-swift.description: The chimney swift is a cigar-shaped, dark gray bird that spends most of its life on the wing.

common-nighthawk.funFact: Bacurau-comuns possuem pequenas penas ao redor de sua boca que formam um funil largo para capturar insetos em voo.
common-nighthawk.name: Common Nighthawk
common-nighthawk.description: The common nighthawk is a nocturnal bird that feeds on flying insects caught during acrobatic aerial displays.

eastern-whip-poor-will.funFact: Noitibós-do-leste podem cantar até 400 vezes por hora, repetindo seu canto semelhante ao nome durante toda a noite.
eastern-whip-poor-will.name: Eastern Whip-poor-will
eastern-whip-poor-will.description: The eastern whip-poor-will is a nocturnal bird named for its distinctive three-part call.

greater-roadrunner.funFact: Corredores-de-estrada podem correr a velocidades de até 32 km/h e podem viver sem beber água.
greater-roadrunner.name: Greater Roadrunner
greater-roadrunner.description: The greater roadrunner is a large, ground-dwelling cuckoo of the American deserts known for its X-shaped tail.

yellow-billed-cuckoo.funFact: Cucos-de-bico-amarelo às vezes são chamados de corvos-da-chuva porque cantam com mais frequência antes de tempestades.
yellow-billed-cuckoo.name: Yellow-billed Cuckoo
yellow-billed-cuckoo.description: The yellow-billed cuckoo is a slim, long-tailed bird with a curved yellow bill that feeds on caterpillars.

hoopoe.funFact: O poup-po-poupe possui uma crista espetacular em forma de leque que ergue quando excitado ou alarmado.
hoopoe.name: Eurasian Hoopoe
hoopoe.description: The Eurasian hoopoe is a distinctive bird with cinnamon plumage, black and white wing bars, and a spectacular erectile crest.

tawny-frogmouth.funFact: Papo-de-peru são frequentemente confundidos com corujas, mas são na verdade mais relacionados com noitibós.
tawny-frogmouth.name: Tawny Frogmouth
tawny-frogmouth.description: The tawny frogmouth is a nocturnal bird of Australia with cryptic plumage that perfectly camouflages it against tree bark.

common-potoo.funFact: Urutaus-comuns pousam eretos nos galhos durante o dia, parecendo exatamente com um toco de árvore quebrado.
common-potoo.name: Common Potoo
common-potoo.description: The common potoo is a nocturnal bird of Central and South American forests with an enormous mouth and cryptic plumage.

american-goldfinch.funFact: Cartaxos-americanos são uma das aves que fazem ninhos mais tardios, frequentemente não se reproduzindo até fins de julho.
american-goldfinch.name: American Goldfinch
american-goldfinch.description: The American goldfinch is a small, bright yellow songbird with black wings and cap, one of the latest-nesting birds in North America.

pine-grosbeak.funFact: Papa-capim-avermelhados são uma das aves boreais mais mansas, frequentemente permitindo aproximação próxima.
pine-grosbeak.name: Pine Grosbeak
pine-grosbeak.description: The pine grosbeak is a large, plump finch with rosy-pink plumage in males. Found in boreal forests across North America.

evening-grosbeak.funFact: Papa-capim-noturnos são migrantes irruptivos, aparecendo em grandes números ao sul de sua área normal em alguns anos.
evening-grosbeak.name: Evening Grosbeak
evening-grosbeak.description: The evening grosbeak is a large, stocky finch with a massive conical bill and bright yellow body in males.

cassins-finch.funFact: Papa-capim-de-Cassin são a espécie de ave norte-americana mais recentemente descrita, não reconhecida até 1861.
cassins-finch.name: Cassins Finch
cassins-finch.description: The Cassins finch is a medium-sized finch with rosy-red crown and pinkish wash on the breast, found in mountain forests.

red-crossbill.funFact: Bico-rei-vermelhos possuem mandíbulas cruzadas de forma única, especificamente adaptadas para extrair sementes de cones de coníferas.
red-crossbill.name: Red Crossbill
red-crossbill.description: The red crossbill is a finch with a uniquely crossed bill adapted for extracting seeds from conifer cones.

pine-siskin.funFact: Papa-capim-de-pinheiro podem carregar bactérias de salmonela sem adoecer, o que pode ser transmitido a aves em comedouros.
pine-siskin.name: Pine Siskin
pine-siskin.description: The pine siskin is a small, streaky brown finch with yellow edging on its wings and tail, an irruptive species.

common-redpoll.funFact: Papa-capim-comuns podem sobreviver a temperaturas de -51°C comendo sementes e fofocando suas penas.
common-redpoll.name: Common Redpoll
common-redpoll.description: The common redpoll is a tiny, streaky finch with a distinctive red cap and pink breast, breeding in Arctic tundra.

hoary-redpoll.funFact: O papa-capim-cinza é uma das aves canoras mais resistentes, vivendo mais ao norte que quase qualquer outra passeriforme.
hoary-redpoll.name: Hoary Redpoll
hoary-redpoll.description: The hoary redpoll is a tiny Arctic finch, paler and frostier-looking than the common redpoll.

house-finch.funFact: Machos de cardeal-doméstico obtêm sua cor vermelha de pigmentos em sua dieta de frutas e bagas.
house-finch.name: House Finch
house-finch.description: The house finch is a small songbird common in urban and suburban areas with red or orange plumage in males.

purple-finch.funFact: Roger Tory Peterson descreveu machos de cardeal-roxo como mergulhados em suco de framboesa.
purple-finch.name: Purple Finch
purple-finch.description: The purple finch is a medium-sized finch with rosy-red plumage in males and streaked brown in females.

eastern-wood-pewee.funFact: O canto do papa-mosca-de-madeira-do-leste é tão distinto que a espécie foi nomeada por sua canção.
eastern-wood-pewee.name: Eastern Wood-Pewee
eastern-wood-pewee.description: The eastern wood-pewee is a small flycatcher with olive-gray plumage and a distinctive, plaintive whistle.

great-crested-flycatcher.funFact: Papa-moscas-de-crista-grande sempre incorporam pele de cobra em seus materiais de ninho.
great-crested-flycatcher.name: Great Crested Flycatcher
great-crested-flycatcher.description: The great crested flycatcher is a large, yellow-bellied flycatcher with a distinctive crest. It always includes snakeskin in its nest.

eastern-kingbird.funFact: Suçuaranas-do-leste são nomeadas por seu comportamento territorial agressivo, atacando aves muito maiores que elas.
eastern-kingbird.name: Eastern Kingbird
eastern-kingbird.description: The eastern kingbird is a bold flycatcher with dark gray upperparts and a distinctive white tip on its tail.

eastern-phoebe.funFact: O papa-mosca-do-leste foi a primeira ave a ser anilhada na América do Norte, por Audubon em 1840.
eastern-phoebe.name: Eastern Phoebe
eastern-phoebe.description: The eastern phoebe is a small, brownish-gray flycatcher that bobs its tail frequently and often nests on human structures.

willow-flycatcher.funFact: Papa-moscas-de-salix são virtualmente idênticos a vários outros papa-moscas Empidonax e são melhor identificados por seu canto distinto FITZ-bew.
willow-flycatcher.name: Willow Flycatcher
willow-flycatcher.description: The willow flycatcher is a small, inconspicuous flycatcher best known for its distinctive fitz-bew song.

scissor-tailed-flycatcher.funFact: As longas penas da cauda do papa-mosca-de-tesoura podem ser duas vezes mais longas que seu corpo.
scissor-tailed-flycatcher.name: Scissor-tailed Flycatcher
scissor-tailed-flycatcher.description: The scissor-tailed flycatcher is a distinctive flycatcher with extremely long, forked tail feathers. It is the state bird of Oklahoma.

vermilion-flycatcher.funFact: O papa-mosca-de-carmim é um dos papa-moscas mais brilhantemente coloridos do Hemisfério Ocidental.
vermilion-flycatcher.name: Vermilion Flycatcher
vermilion-flycatcher.description: The vermilion flycatcher is a small, vividly colored flycatcher with males displaying brilliant red plumage and a black mask.

common-merganser.funFact: Mergans-comuns possuem bicos serrilhados que ajudam a segurar peixes escorregadios ao mergulhar debaixo d'água.
common-merganser.name: Common Merganser
common-merganser.description: The common merganser is a large diving duck with a reddish-brown crested head in females and a dark green head in males. It feeds primarily on fish.

hooded-merganser.funFact: Mergans-de-capuz possuem a maior crista em relação ao tamanho do corpo de qualquer pato, que erguem e abaixam à vontade.
hooded-merganser.name: Hooded Merganser
hooded-merganser.description: The hooded merganser is a small, striking diving duck. Males have a bold black and white fan-shaped crest with a rusty flank patch.

bufflehead.funFact: Pato-mergulhão-de-cabeça-preta é o menor pato mergulhador da América do Norte e frequentemente faz ninhos em buracos velhos de pica-paus.
bufflehead.name: Bufflehead
bufflehead.description: The bufflehead is a small, compact diving duck. Males have a striking iridescent green and purple head with large white patches.

common-goldeneye.funFact: Após colocar ovos no ninho, a fêmea do pato-olho-dourado cobre os ovos com penugem de seu próprio abdômen.
common-goldeneye.name: Common Goldeneye
common-goldeneye.description: The common goldeneye is a medium-sized diving duck with a distinctive round head. Males have a dark green-black head with a white circular patch near the bill.

ring-necked-duck.funFact: Apesar de seu nome, o anel no pescoço do pato-de-pescoço-anelado é raramente visível em campo.
ring-necked-duck.name: Ring-necked Duck
ring-necked-duck.description: The ring-necked duck is a medium-sized diving duck with a distinctive peaked head shape. Males have a black back, gray flanks, and a white breast with a subtle neck ring.

gadwall.funFact: O pato-rei frequentemente é chamado de pato simples, mas os machos possuem um padrão elegante de fina vermiculação visível de perto.
gadwall.name: Gadwall
gadwall.description: The gadwall is a dabbling duck with subtle but elegant plumage. Males are mostly gray with black rear ends, while females are mottled brown.

blue-winged-teal.funFact: Patos-de-asas-azuis estão entre os primeiros migrantes de primavera e últimos de outono na América do Norte.
blue-winged-teal.name: Blue-winged Teal
blue-winged-teal.description: The blue-winged teal is a small dabbling duck. Males have a slate-blue head with a white crescent in front of the eye. It is one of the earliest migrating ducks.

crested-caracara.funFact: Carcarás-de-crista são membros da família dos falcões, mas se comportam mais como urubus, frequentemente se alimentando de carniça.
crested-caracara.name: Crested Caracara
crested-caracara.description: The crested caracara is a distinctive raptor with a black cap, white neck, and orange face. Despite being in the falcon family, it scavenges and forages on the ground.

palm-nut-vulture.funFact: O urubu-de-palmeira é a única espécie de urubu que se alimenta principalmente de material vegetal, especificamente frutos de palmeira.
palm-nut-vulture.name: Palm-nut Vulture
palm-nut-vulture.description: The palm-nut vulture is a unique raptor of West African palm forests that feeds mainly on the fruit of the oil palm.

black-vulture.funFact: Urubus-negros possuem excelente visão e também usam seu olfato para localizar carniça.
black-vulture.name: Black Vulture
black-vulture.description: The black vulture is a common New World vulture with black plumage and a bare, dark head. It soars in groups looking for carcasses.

roseate-spoonbill.funFact: Guará-rosas varrem seus bicos em forma de colher de um lado para o outro em águas rasas para pegar pequenos peixes e crustáceos.
roseate-spoonbill.name: Roseate Spoonbill
roseate-spoonbill.description: The roseate spoonbill is a large, pink wading bird with a distinctive spatulate bill. It feeds by sweeping its bill through shallow water.

wood-stork.funFact: Cabeças-de-tanino são a única espécie de cegonha que se reproduz na América do Norte e usa alimentação tátil para capturar presas.
wood-stork.name: Wood Stork
wood-stork.description: The wood stork is a large, white wading bird with a dark, featherless head and a long, curved bill. It is the only stork species breeding in the United States.

white-ibis.funFact: Ibises-brancos sondam a lama com seus bicos longos e curvos e podem detectar presas apenas pelo tato.
white-ibis.name: White Ibis
white-ibis.description: The white ibis is a medium-sized wading bird with white plumage, black wing tips, and a distinctive long, curved pink bill.

limpkin.funFact: Caracará-pardais são comedores especializados de caramujos, com bicos especificamente adaptados para extrair caracóis de suas conchas.
limpkin.name: Limpkin
limpkin.description: The limpkin is a large, brown wading bird with white spotting. It is specialized in feeding on apple snails and has a distinctive wailing call.

rusty-blackbird.funFact: O quiscalus-enferrujado diminuiu mais de 90% nos últimos 50 anos, tornando-se uma das aves que mais diminui rápido da América do Norte.
rusty-blackbird.name: Rusty Blackbird
rusty-blackbird.description: The rusty blackbird is a medium-sized blackbird that breeds in boreal wetlands and winters in the southeastern United States. Males are glossy black with rust-colored edges on feathers in fall.

blue-tang.funFact: Peixes-azuis podem se tornar quase invisíveis à noite mudando de cor.
blue-tang.name: Blue Tang
blue-tang.description: The blue tang is a striking royal blue fish with a bright yellow tail and black markings. Found throughout the Indo-Pacific, it feeds primarily on algae and plays an important role in keeping coral reefs healthy.

mandarinfish.funFact: Peixes-mandarim são um dos apenas dois vertebrados conhecidos por produzir pigmento azul.
mandarinfish.name: Mandarinfish
mandarinfish.description: The mandarinfish is a small, incredibly colorful reef fish with vivid blue, orange, and green patterns. It produces a toxic mucus coating that deters predators and gives it a distinctive smell.

sixbar-wrasse.funFact: Peixes-labris-de-seis-listras podem mudar de sexo de fêmea para macho durante sua vida.
sixbar-wrasse.name: Sixbar Wrasse
sixbar-wrasse.description: The sixbar wrasse is a slender reef fish with distinctive dark vertical bars across its body. Found throughout the Indo-Pacific, it feeds on small crustaceans and fish.

yellowtail-coris.funFact: Peixes-labris-de-cauda-amarela juvenis parecem completamente diferentes dos adultos com manchas laranjas e brancas.
yellowtail-coris.name: Yellowtail Coris
yellowtail-coris.description: The yellowtail coris is a colorful wrasse found in coral reefs across the Indo-Pacific. Adults have a green body with yellow tail and red spots, while juveniles are orange.

bicolor-angelfish.funFact: Peixes-anjo-bicôlores podem produzir sons altos de estouro para comunicação.
bicolor-angelfish.name: Bicolor Angelfish
bicolor-angelfish.description: The bicolor angelfish features a striking split coloration of dark blue-black on the front half and bright yellow on the rear half. Found in Caribbean reefs, it feeds on algae.

flame-angelfish.funFact: Peixes-anjo-de-chama podem se tornar agressivos quando mantidos em pequenos aquários.
flame-angelfish.name: Flame Angelfish
flame-angelfish.description: The flame angelfish is a brilliant orange-red fish with black vertical bars native to the Pacific. It is one of the most popular marine aquarium fish.

queen-angelfish.funFact: Peixes-anjo-rainha obtêm seu nome de um anel azul-escuro em sua testa semelhante a uma coroa.
queen-angelfish.name: Queen Angelfish
queen-angelfish.description: The queen angelfish is a large, stunningly colorful reef fish with blue, yellow, and green hues. Found throughout the tropical western Atlantic, it feeds primarily on sponges.

french-angelfish.funFact: Peixes-anjo-franceses são frequentemente vistos em pares monogâmicos e viajam juntos pela vida.
french-angelfish.name: French Angelfish
french-angelfish.description: The French angelfish is a striking black fish with bright yellow-edged scales found in Caribbean reefs. Young individuals are bright yellow but darken as adults.

regal-tang.funFact: Peixes-rainha possuem um espinho retrátil perto de sua cauda que pode causar feridas dolorosas.
regal-tang.name: Regal Tang
regal-tang.description: The regal tang, also known as the palette surgeonfish, is a bright blue fish with a yellow tail and black markings. Found across the Indo-Pacific.

sohal-surgeonfish.funFact: Peixes-cirurgião-de-Sohal são extremamente territoriais e atacam mergulhadores que entram em seu espaço.
sohal-surgeonfish.name: Sohal Surgeonfish
sohal-surgeonfish.description: The sohal surgeonfish is a large, gray-blue reef fish with horizontal stripes and sharp scalpel-like spines on its tail. Native to the Red Sea and Persian Gulf.

moorish-idol.funFact: Peixes-bandeira são notoriamente difíceis de manter em cativeiro e raramente sobrevivem muito em aquários.
moorish-idol.name: Moorish Idol
moorish-idol.description: The Moorish idol is one of the most recognizable reef fish with its dramatic black, white, and yellow coloration and a long flowing dorsal fin filament.

royal-gramma.funFact: Peixes-grama-reis frequentemente pendem de cabeça para baixo sob saliências rochosas.
royal-gramma.name: Royal Gramma
royal-gramma.description: The royal gramma, or fairy basslet, has a stunning two-tone coloration with bright purple on the front half and yellow on the rear half. Found in Caribbean caves.

longnose-butterflyfish.funFact: Peixe-borboleta-de-bico-longo usa seu focinho alongado para alcançar fendas de coral em busca de comida.
longnose-butterflyfish.name: Longnose Butterflyfish
longnose-butterflyfish.description: The longnose butterflyfish is a slender reef fish with a distinctive elongated snout and yellow body with a dark eye band.

copperband-butterflyfish.funFact: Peixes-borboleta-de-cobre possuem uma mancha falsa de olho perto de sua cauda para confundir predadores.
copperband-butterflyfish.name: Copperband Butterflyfish
copperband-butterflyfish.description: The copperband butterflyfish has a striking pattern of vertical orange bands with black edges on a silver-white body.

foureye-butterflyfish.funFact: Peixes-borboleta-de-quatro-olhos possuem grandes manchas de olho que fazem predadores pensarem que sua cauda é sua cabeça.
foureye-butterflyfish.name: Foureye Butterflyfish
foureye-butterflyfish.description: The foureye butterflyfish gets its name from the prominent black eye spot on each side near its tail, confusing predators.

bluegill.funFact: Machos de peixe-sol-de-bico-azul constam ninhos circulares em águas rasas e guardam ferozmente os ovos.
bluegill.name: Bluegill
bluegill.description: The bluegill is a freshwater sunfish native to eastern North America. It has an olive-green body with a distinctive dark spot on the ear flap.

largemouth-bass.funFact: Achigãs-de-boca-larga podem abrir suas bocas tão amplas que podem engolir presas quase metade de seu tamanho.
largemouth-bass.name: Largemouth Bass
largemouth-bass.description: The largemouth bass is the largest of the black basses and the most popular freshwater game fish in North America.

smallmouth-bass.funFact: Achigãs-de-boca-pequena são conhecidos por sua capacidade de luta e são chamados de marones ou costeletas-de-bronze.
smallmouth-bass.name: Smallmouth Bass
smallmouth-bass.description: The smallmouth bass is a freshwater fish prized by anglers for its aggressive fighting style.

rainbow-trout.funFact: Trutas-arco-íris podem mudar a intensidade da cor com base em seu ambiente e humor.
rainbow-trout.name: Rainbow Trout
rainbow-trout.description: The rainbow trout is a coldwater fish with an olive-green body and a distinctive pinkish-red stripe along its side.

brook-trout.funFact: Trutas-de-riacho são a única truta nativa de grande parte da América do Norte oriental.
brook-trout.name: Brook Trout
brook-trout.description: The brook trout, also called speckled trout, has a dark green body with light spots and red spots with blue halos.

atlantic-salmon.funFact: Salmões-do-Atlântico podem pular cachoeiras e represas durante sua migração reprodutiva rio acima.
atlantic-salmon.name: Atlantic Salmon
atlantic-salmon.description: The Atlantic salmon is an anadromous fish born in freshwater, migrates to the ocean, and returns to freshwater to spawn.

chinook-salmon.funFact: Salmões-chinook são os maiores de todas as espécies de salmão do Pacífico.
chinook-salmon.name: Chinook Salmon
chinook-salmon.description: The Chinook salmon, also called king salmon, is the largest Pacific salmon with a greenish back and dark spots.

coho-salmon.funFact: Salmões-coho tornam-se vermelho-claro com mandíbulas em gancho durante a temporada de desova.
coho-salmon.name: Coho Salmon
coho-salmon.description: The coho salmon, also known as silver salmon, has a silver body with black spots and is found throughout the North Pacific.

pacific-bluefin-tuna.funFact: Atuns-azuis-do-Pacífico podem cruzar o oceano Pacífico inteiro em menos de 60 dias.
pacific-bluefin-tuna.name: Pacific Bluefin Tuna
pacific-bluefin-tuna.description: The Pacific bluefin tuna is a large, fast, pelagic fish found throughout the Pacific Ocean, highly prized in sushi markets.

yellowfin-tuna.funFact: Atuns-de-rabilho-amarelo podem nadar a velocidades de até 64 km/h em rajadas curtas.
yellowfin-tuna.name: Yellowfin Tuna
yellowfin-tuna.description: The yellowfin tuna is a large, streamlined ocean fish with bright yellow dorsal and anal fins found in tropical oceans worldwide.

atlantic-cod.funFact: Bacalhaus-do-Atlântico podem detectar presas usando eletroreceição mesmo em água turva.
atlantic-cod.name: Atlantic Cod
atlantic-cod.description: The Atlantic cod is a large, cold-water fish with a distinctive chin barbel and three dorsal fins, once one of the most important food fish in the world.

atlantic-grouper.funFact: Garoupas podem inalar presas inteiras abrindo repentinamente suas enormes bocas.
atlantic-grouper.name: Atlantic Grouper
atlantic-grouper.description: The Atlantic grouper is a large, robust reef fish with a wide mouth and thick lips found in warm Atlantic waters.

goliath-grouper.funFact: Garoupas-golias são tão grandes que podem pesar tanto quanto um pequeno carro.
goliath-grouper.name: Goliath Grouper
goliath-grouper.description: The goliath grouper is the largest bony fish in the Western Atlantic, reaching weights of up to 800 pounds.

red-snapper.funFact: Vermelhos-do-Atlântico podem viver mais de 50 anos, tornando-se uma das espécies de snapper mais longevas.
red-snapper.name: Red Snapper
red-snapper.description: The red snapper is a bright red reef fish found in the Gulf of Mexico and western Atlantic.

barracuda.funFact: Pode nadar a mais de 55 km/h
barracuda.name: Barracuda
barracuda.description: The barracuda is a large, predatory fish with a long, streamlined body and razor-sharp teeth found in tropical oceans.

mahi-mahi.funFact: Mahi-mahis também são chamados de dourados ou peixes-golfinho, não confundir com golfinhos.
mahi-mahi.name: Mahi-Mahi
mahi-mahi.description: The mahi-mahi is a brightly colored pelagic fish with a golden-green body and blue fins found in tropical oceans.

wahoo.funFact: Atuns-estripados estão entre os peixes mais rápidos do oceano, capazes de atingir velocidades de até 80 km/h.
wahoo.name: Wahoo
wahoo.description: The wahoo is a large, fast pelagic fish related to mackerels with a sleek, torpedo-shaped body and vertical blue bars.

sailfish.funFact: Peixes-vela são considerados os peixes mais rápidos do oceano, atingindo velocidades de até 110 km/h.
sailfish.name: Sailfish
sailfish.description: The sailfish is a large billfish with a spectacular high dorsal fin resembling a sail, found in tropical oceans worldwide.

blue-marlin.funFact: Marlins-azuis podem pesar mais de 450 kg e estão entre os maiores peixes ósseos do mundo.
blue-marlin.name: Blue Marlin
blue-marlin.description: The blue marlin is one of the largest ocean fish with a distinctive blue upper body and silver-white belly found in tropical Atlantic waters.

nassau-grouper.funFact: Garoupas-de-Nassau podem mudar de cor em segundos para corresponder ao seu entorno.
nassau-grouper.name: Nassau Grouper
nassau-grouper.description: The Nassau grouper is a large reef fish capable of rapid color changes, now critically endangered from overfishing.

striped-bass.funFact: Achigãs-de-listra são anádromos e podem viajar centenas de milhas para desovar.
striped-bass.name: Striped Bass
striped-bass.description: The striped bass is a silver fish with distinctive horizontal dark stripes found along the Atlantic coast.

red-drum.funFact: Tambores-vermelhos também são chamados de achigãs-de-canal e são o peixe oficial do estado da Carolina do Norte.
red-drum.name: Red Drum
red-drum.description: The red drum, also called redfish, is a copper-bronze fish with a distinctive black spot near the tail.

black-drum.funFact: Tambores-pretos podem produzir sons altos de tambor usando músculos em sua bexiga natatória.
black-drum.name: Black Drum
black-drum.description: The black drum is a large, dark fish with barbels on its chin that can grow to over 100 pounds.

channel-catfish.funFact: Pintados-de-cauda-redonda possuem papilhas gustativas cobrindo todo seu corpo e podem sentir comida de longe.
channel-catfish.name: Channel Catfish
channel-catfish.description: The channel catfish is the most fished catfish species in North America with a forked tail and whisker-like barbels.

blue-catfish.funFact: Pintados-de-cauda-redonda-azuis podem crescer mais de 45 kg e são o maior peixe de água doce da América do Norte.
blue-catfish.name: Blue Catfish
blue-catfish.description: The blue catfish is the largest species of North American catfish reaching weights of over 100 pounds.

walking-catfish.funFact: Pintados-andantes podem sobreviver fora da água por horas e usar suas barbatanas peitorais para andar em terra.
walking-catfish.name: Walking Catfish
walking-catfish.description: The walking catfish is a freshwater catfish native to Southeast Asia that can breathe air and move across land.

wels-catfish.funFact: Reportou-se que bagres-europeus crescem mais de 5 metros em casos raros.
wels-catfish.name: Wels Catfish
wels-catfish.description: The wels catfish is the largest freshwater fish in Europe reaching lengths of over 16 feet with a wide, flat head.

eurasian-pike.funFact: Escalares-europeus podem acelerar de parados a 32 km/h em menos de um décimo de segundo.
eurasian-pike.name: Eurasian Pike
eurasian-pike.description: The Eurasian pike is a large, ambush predator found throughout Europe, Asia, and northern North America.

muskellunge.funFact: Muskies também são chamados de muskies e são o maior membro da família dos escaleres.
muskellunge.name: Muskellunge
muskellunge.description: The muskellunge, or muskie, is the largest freshwater fish in the pike family found in clear lakes and rivers of North America.

walleye.funFact: Olhos-de-perca possuem uma camada reflexiva chamada tapetum lucidum que faz seus olhos brilharem à noite.
walleye.name: Walleye
walleye.description: The walleye is a freshwater fish named for its distinctive, glassy eyes that reflect light found in cool, clear lakes.

common-carp.funFact: Carpas-comuns são consideradas uma das espécies de peixes invasores mais influentes do mundo.
common-carp.name: Common Carp
common-carp.description: The common carp is a large, golden-brown freshwater fish found throughout the world, originally from Eurasia.

grass-carp.funFact: Carpas-de-jardim podem comer até 40% de seu peso corporal em vegetação a cada dia.
grass-carp.name: Grass Carp
grass-carp.description: The grass carp is a large freshwater fish native to eastern Asia that feeds almost exclusively on aquatic plants.

koi-carp.funFact: O koi mais caro já vendido foi um peixe japonês chamado S Legend que foi vendido por US$ 1,8 milhão.
koi-carp.name: Koi
koi-carp.description: Koi are ornamental varieties of common carp bred for their vibrant colors and patterns from Japan.

goldfish.funFact: Pode se lembrar de 3 meses de treinamento
goldfish.name: Goldfish
goldfish.description: The goldfish is one of the most popular aquarium fish in the world, domesticated from East Asia over 1,000 years ago.

tench.funFact: Tenchas secretam um muco que pode curar ferimentos em outros peixes.
tench.name: Tench
tench.description: The tench is a freshwater fish with a thick, slimy body and olive-green to bronze coloration found throughout Europe and Asia.

three-spined-stickleback.funFact: Machos de espinhosos-de-três-espinhos constam ninhos elaborados de plantas aquáticas e abanam os ovos para fornecer oxigênio.
three-spined-stickleback.name: Three-spined Stickleback
three-spined-stickleback.description: The three-spined stickleback is a small, spiny fish found throughout the Northern Hemisphere, males build intricate nests.

florida-gar.funFact: Peixes-cachorra-da-Flórida possuem um focinho alongado cheio de dentes como agulhas e podem respirar ar.
florida-gar.name: Florida Gar
florida-gar.description: The Florida gar is a long, slender predatory fish with an elongated snout and armored scales found in Florida and Georgia.

alligator-gar.funFact: Ovos de peixe-cachorra-de-alligator são tóxicos para humanos, mas consumidos por nativos americanos após processamento.
alligator-gar.name: Alligator Gar
alligator-gar.description: The alligator gar is the largest freshwater fish in North America, reaching over 8 feet long with a long, alligator-like snout.

bowfin.funFact: Amias são o único sobrevivente de uma ordem antiga de peixes.
bowfin.name: Bowfin
bowfin.description: The bowfin is a primitive freshwater fish with an elongated body and a distinctive long dorsal fin found in eastern North America.

chinese-sturgeon.funFact: Esturjões-chineses existem há mais de 140 milhões de anos e são chamados de fósseis vivos.
chinese-sturgeon.name: Chinese Sturgeon
chinese-sturgeon.description: The Chinese sturgeon is a critically endangered species found only in the Yangtze River that can grow to over 16 feet.

atlantic-sturgeon.funFact: Esturjões-do-Atlântico podem viver mais de 100 anos e foram um vez caçados por seu caviar.
atlantic-sturgeon.name: Atlantic Sturgeon
atlantic-sturgeon.description: The Atlantic sturgeon is a large, primitive fish with a prehistoric appearance featuring bony plates instead of scales.

arctic-char.funFact: Trutas-do-Ártico são os peixes de água doce mais setentrionais do mundo.
arctic-char.name: Arctic Char
arctic-char.description: The Arctic char is a cold-water fish related to salmon and trout found in Arctic and subarctic waters.

lake-trout.funFact: Trutas-de-lago podem viver mais de 40 anos e crescer mais de 27 kg.
lake-trout.name: Lake Trout
lake-trout.description: The lake trout is a large, cold-water salmonid found in deep lakes of northern North America with a forked tail.

cutthroat-trout.funFact: Trutas-cortadas são nomeadas pela distinta marca vermelha sob sua mandíbula.
cutthroat-trout.name: Cutthroat Trout
cutthroat-trout.description: The cutthroat trout is a cold-water fish native to western North America, named for red-orange slash marks under its lower jaw.

golden-trout.funFact: Trutas-douradas são o peixe oficial do estado da Califórnia e são encontradas apenas em alguns riachos remotos.
golden-trout.name: Golden Trout
golden-trout.description: The golden trout is a subspecies of rainbow trout found in high-altitude mountain streams of California with golden-yellow body.

oceanic-whitetip-shark.funFact: Tubarões-de-ponta-branca-oceânicos foram responsáveis por mais baixas humanas do que qualquer outra espécie durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial.
oceanic-whitetip-shark.name: Oceanic Whitetip Shark
oceanic-whitetip-shark.description: The oceanic whitetip shark is a large, slow-moving pelagic shark with distinctive white-tipped fins, critically endangered.

blacktip-shark.funFact: Tubarões-de-ponta-preta são conhecidos por seu comportamento dramático de saltar, girando para fora da água.
blacktip-shark.name: Blacktip Shark
blacktip-shark.description: The blacktip shark is a medium-sized shark with distinctive black tips on all its fins found in warm coastal waters.

scalloped-hammerhead.funFact: Tubarões-martelo-formados formam escolas massivas de centenas durante sua migração anual.
scalloped-hammerhead.name: Scalloped Hammerhead
scalloped-hammerhead.description: The scalloped hammerhead is one of the most common hammerhead species with a distinctive scalloped leading edge on its head.

thresher-shark.funFact: Tubarões-raptores usam seu chicote de cauda extremamente longo para aturdir cardumes de peixes.
thresher-shark.name: Thresher Shark
thresher-shark.description: The thresher shark is a distinctive shark with an extremely long upper tail that can be as long as its body found in open ocean.

basking-shark.funFact: Tubarões-frade são o segundo maior peixe do mundo, depois dos tubarões-baleia.
basking-shark.name: Basking Shark
basking-shark.description: The basking shark is the second largest fish in the world, filter-feeding on plankton with an enormous mouth over 3 feet wide.

nurse-shark.funFact: Tubarões-enfermeiros podem bombear água sobre suas guelras enquanto descansam no fundo do oceano.
nurse-shark.name: Nurse Shark
nurse-shark.description: The nurse shark is a sluggish, bottom-dwelling shark with barbels near its nostrils that help detect prey hidden in sand.

zebra-shark.funFact: Tubarões-zebra mudam de listrados quando jovens para manchados quando adultos.
zebra-shark.name: Zebra Shark
zebra-shark.description: The zebra shark is a distinctive shark with dark spots on a tan body found on tropical coral reefs of the Indo-Pacific.

epaulette-shark.funFact: Tubarões-de-epolete podem andar com suas barbatanas sobre a planície do recife durante a maré baixa.
epaulette-shark.name: Epaulette Shark
epaulette-shark.description: The epaulette shark is a small reef shark that can walk on its fins across the reef flat found in the Indo-Pacific.

angel-shark.funFact: Tubarões-angelo podem se enterrar completamente na areia para emboscar presas que passam.
angel-shark.name: Angel Shark
angel-shark.description: The angel shark is a flattened shark that lies buried in sand on the ocean floor, critically endangered due to habitat loss.

southern-stingray.funFact: Arraias-do-sul podem infligir uma picada venenosa que pode causar dor severa.
southern-stingray.name: Southern Stingray
southern-stingray.description: The southern stingray is a large, diamond-shaped ray found in shallow tropical waters of the western Atlantic.

cownose-ray.funFact: Arraias-de-nariz-de-vaca migram em escolas massivas de milhares ao longo da costa atlântica.
cownose-ray.name: Cownose Ray
cownose-ray.description: The cownose ray is a distinctive ray with a unique head shape resembling a cow's nose, forming large schools during migration.

eagle-ray.funFact: Arraias-manta-pintadas podem saltar vários pés para fora da água.
eagle-ray.name: Spotted Eagle Ray
eagle-ray.description: The spotted eagle ray is a large ray with distinctive white spots on a dark body found in tropical and subtropical oceans.

viperfish.funFact: Peixes-víbora possuem dentes extremamente longos, semelhantes a agulhas, tão longos que não cabem em suas bocas.
viperfish.name: Viperfish
viperfish.description: The viperfish is a deep-sea predator with extremely long, needle-like teeth and a bioluminescent photophore along its body.

gulper-eel.funFact: Enguias-gulper possuem bocas enormes que podem se abrir o suficiente para engolir presas maiores que elas mesmas.
gulper-eel.name: Gulper Eel
gulper-eel.description: The gulper eel is a deep-sea fish with an enormous, loosely hinged mouth and a long, whip-like tail found in deep ocean waters.

lungfish.funFact: Peixes-pulmão podem respirar ar e sobreviver fora da água por meses enterrando-se na lama.
lungfish.name: Lungfish
lungfish.description: The lungfish is a freshwater fish with both gills and primitive lungs, one of the closest living relatives to tetrapods found in Africa, South America, and Australia.

coelacanth.funFact: Celacantos foram considerados extintos há 66 milhões de anos até serem redescobertos em 1938.
coelacanth.name: Coelacanth
coelacanth.description: The coelacanth is a living fossil, a lobe-finned fish once thought extinct that was rediscovered off the coast of South Africa in 1938.

red-bellied-piranha.funFact: Piranhas-de-barriga-vermelha podem desossar uma carcaça em minutos com seus dentes afiados.
red-bellied-piranha.name: Red-bellied Piranha
red-bellied-piranha.description: The red-bellied piranha is a freshwater fish native to South America known for its sharp teeth and powerful jaws found in rivers and lakes.

arapaima.funFact: Arapaimas estão entre os maiores peixes de água doce do mundo e podem respirar ar.
arapaima.name: Arapaima
arapaima.description: The arapaima is one of the largest freshwater fish in the world, reaching lengths of over 10 feet, found in the Amazon basin.

arowana.funFact: Arowanas podem pular até 1,8 metro da água para pegar presas em galhos que se projetam.
arowana.name: Arowana
arowana.description: The arowana is a freshwater fish with large, metallic scales and an upward-pointing mouth found in tropical rivers of South America, Asia, and Australia.

knifefish.funFact: Peixes-faca-fantasma-negros usam campos elétricos fracos para navegar e encontrar presas em água escura e turva.
knifefish.name: Black Ghost Knifefish
knifefish.description: The black ghost knifefish is a freshwater fish with an elongated, laterally compressed body and a distinctive anal fin used for propulsion.

betta.funFact: Machos de bettas constam ninhos de bolhas na superfície da água para seus ovos.
betta.name: Betta
betta.description: The betta, or Siamese fighting fish, is a small freshwater fish with flowing fins and vibrant colors native to Southeast Asia.

discus.funFact: Pais-de-discus produzem uma secreção mucosa que seus filhotes se alimentam nas primeiras semanas.
discus.name: Discus
discus.description: The discus is a freshwater fish with a distinctive disc-shaped body found in the Amazon basin, popular in aquariums for its vibrant colors.

oscarr.funFact: Oscars são peixes altamente inteligentes que podem reconhecer seus donos.
oscarr.name: Oscar
oscarr.description: The oscar is a large cichlid native to South America with a dark body and orange-red markings, popular in aquariums for its personality.

angelfish-freshwater.funFact: Peixes-anjo-de-água-doce são na verdade ciclídeos, não relacionados com peixes-anjo-marinhos.
angelfish-freshwater.name: Freshwater Angelfish
angelfish-freshwater.description: The freshwater angelfish is a popular aquarium fish with a distinctive triangular body shape and long, flowing fins native to the Amazon basin.

convict-cichlid.funFact: Ciclídeos-prisioneiros são pais devotados que defendem agressivamente seus filhotes.
convict-cichlid.name: Convict Cichlid
convict-cichlid.description: The convict cichlid is a small freshwater fish with distinctive black vertical stripes on a light body found in Central America.

peacock-cichlid.funFact: Machos de ciclídeos-pavão exibem cores brilhantes de azul, vermelho e ouro durante a reprodução.
peacock-cichlid.name: Peacock Cichlid
peacock-cichlid.description: The peacock cichlid is a colorful freshwater fish found in Lake Malawi with males displaying vibrant blues, reds, and golds.

lionfish.funFact: Espinhos venenosos de peixes-leão podem causar dor extrema e seu veneno é estável ao calor.
lionfish.name: Lionfish
lionfish.description: The lionfish is a venomous marine fish with distinctive red, white, and brown stripes and fan-like pectoral fins found in tropical reefs.

stonefish.funFact: Peixes-pedra são os peixes mais venenosos do mundo, sua picada pode ser fatal para humanos.
stonefish.name: Stonefish
stonefish.description: The stonefish is the most venomous fish in the world, masters of camouflage resembling rocks on the ocean floor found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

leafy-seadragon.funFact: Dragões-marinhos-folhosos não possuem estômago ou dentes e devem comer quase constantemente.
leafy-seadragon.name: Leafy Seadragon
leafy-seadragon.description: The leafy seadragon is a marine fish related to seahorses with leaf-like appendages providing perfect camouflage in kelp forests.

weedy-seadragon.funFact: Dragões-marinhos-verdes carregam seus ovos na cauda do macho até que eclodam.
weedy-seadragon.name: Weedy Seadragon
weedy-seadragon.description: The weedy seadragon is a marine fish related to seahorses with small leaf-like appendages found in kelp forests of southern Australia.

boxfish.funFact: Peixes-caixa podem liberar uma toxina quando estressados que pode matar outros peixes em um aquário.
boxfish.name: Yellow Boxfish
boxfish.description: The yellow boxfish is a small, cube-shaped reef fish with bright yellow coloration and black spots found in the Indo-Pacific.

cowfish.funFact: Peixes-boi-de-chifre-longo possuem dois espinhos semelhantes a chifres protrudindo de suas cabeças.
cowfish.name: Longhorn Cowfish
cowfish.description: The longhorn cowfish is a distinctive reef fish with horn-like spines on its head and a boxy, armored body found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

trunkfish.funFact: Peixes-tronco podem borrifar uma substância tóxica de sua pele quando ameaçados.
trunkfish.name: Spotted Trunkfish
trunkfish.description: The spotted trunkfish is a small, box-shaped reef fish with white spots on a dark body found in Caribbean coral reefs.

filefish.funFact: Peixes-lixa podem mudar de cor e padrão para corresponder ao seu entorno.
filefish.name: Scrawled Filefish
filefish.description: The scrawled filefish is a marine fish with a distinctive elongated body and blue spots found in tropical Atlantic waters.

triggerfish.funFact: Peixes-gatilho possuem um espinho em sua barbatana dorsal que pode ser travado em posição vertical.
triggerfish.name: Queen Triggerfish
triggerfish.description: The queen triggerfish is a large, colorful reef fish with distinctive blue lines on its face and a trigger spine on its dorsal fin.

leatherjacket.funFact: Peixes-de-couro possuem pele áspera semelhante a lixa usada por colonos como lixa.
leatherjacket.name: Slender Leatherjacket
leatherjacket.description: The slender leatherjacket is a small marine fish with a compressed body and rough skin found in coastal waters worldwide.

parrotfish.funFact: Peixes-papagaio excretam coral digerido como areia branca fina, criando praias tropicais.
parrotfish.name: Stoplight Parrotfish
parrotfish.description: The stoplight parrotfish is a colorful reef fish with a beak-like mouth used to scrape algae from coral found in Caribbean reefs.

wrasse.funFact: Peixes-labris-limpeza estabelecem estações de limpeza onde peixes maiores fazem fila para ter parasitas removidos.
wrasse.name: Cleaner Wrasse
wrasse.description: The cleaner wrasse is a small reef fish with a distinctive blue stripe that sets up cleaning stations to remove parasites from larger fish.

tuskfish.funFact: Peixes-porco usam pedras como bigornas para quebrar moluscos para comida.
tuskfish.name: Ornate Tuskfish
tuskfish.description: The ornate tuskfish is a colorful reef fish with distinctive blue and orange markings found in the Indo-Pacific.

grouper-marbled.funFact: Garoupas-marmoreadas formam agregações massivas de desova com milhares de indivíduos.
grouper-marbled.name: Marbled Grouper
grouper-marbled.description: The marbled grouper is a large reef fish with a marbled pattern found in tropical Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

wrasse-humphead.funFact: Peixes-labris-de-crista podem viver mais de 30 anos e são os maiores peixes labrídeos vivos.
wrasse-humphead.name: Humphead Wrasse
wrasse-humphead.description: The humphead wrasse is the largest living wrasse species with a distinctive hump on its forehead found in Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

coral-grouper.funFact: Garoupas-de-coral caçam cooperativamente com enguias-moré, usando sacudidas de cabeça para sinalizar a enguia para expulsar presas.
coral-grouper.name: Coral Grouper
coral-grouper.description: The coral grouper is a large reef fish with a reddish body and blue spots found in tropical Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

cardinalfish.funFact: Machos de peixes-cardeal-de-Banggai incubam os ovos na boca até que eclodam.
cardinalfish.name: Banggai Cardinalfish
cardinalfish.description: The Banggai cardinalfish is a small, striking reef fish with black and white stripes and long fins found only in the Banggai Islands of Indonesia.

damselfish.funFact: Machos de garibaldi constam e cuidam de ninhos elaborados de algas para atrair parceiras.
damselfish.name: Garibaldi Damselfish
damselfish.description: The garibaldi is a bright orange damselfish found in kelp forests of the eastern Pacific, the official marine fish of California.

sergeant-major.funFact: Machos de sargentos-maiores tornam-se roxo-escuro quando guardam seus ovos.
sergeant-major.name: Sergeant Major
sergeant-major.description: The sergeant major is a small reef fish with five black vertical bars on a light body found in tropical Atlantic waters.

goby.funFact: Peixes-gobius-de-neon estabelecem estações de limpeza e removem parasitas de peixes maiores.
goby.name: Neon Goby
goby.description: The neon goby is a tiny reef fish with a bright blue stripe that sets up cleaning stations to remove parasites from larger fish.

blenny.funFact: Peixes-blennius-de-Midas frequentemente se juntam a escolas de peixes-labris-limpeza para evitar predação.
blenny.name: Midas Blenny
blenny.description: The Midas blenny is a small, golden-yellow reef fish that mimics cleaner wrasses for protection found in Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

scorpionfish.funFact: Peixes-escorpião são mestres da camuflagem, parecidos com rochas cobertas de algas no recife.
scorpionfish.name: Tasseled Scorpionfish
scorpionfish.description: The tasseled scorpionfish is a venomous reef fish with elaborate skin flaps providing excellent camouflage found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

flathead.funFact: Cabeça-chata são predadores de emboscada que se enterram na areia para surpreender presas.
flathead.name: Bartail Flathead
flathead.description: The bartail flathead is a bottom-dwelling marine fish with a flattened head and body found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

grunt.funFact: Peixes-grunto obtêm seu nome do som que fazem ao rangir seus dentes.
grunt.name: Blue-striped Grunt
grunt.description: The blue-striped grunt is a small reef fish with distinctive blue horizontal stripes found in Caribbean coral reefs.

tang.funFact: Peixes-rainha-palhaço são extremamente territoriais e podem ser agressivos em relação a outros peixes.
tang.name: Clown Tang
tang.description: The clown tang is a bright blue surgeonfish with white and black markings found in coral reefs of the Indo-Pacific.

squirrelfish.funFact: Peixes-esquilo possuem olhos grandes adaptados para caça noturna.
squirrelfish.name: Squirrelfish
squirrelfish.description: The squirrelfish is a small, red reef fish with large eyes found in tropical coral reefs worldwide, active at night.

sweep.funFact: Peixes-varredura são nomeados por seu movimento de natação distinto de varredura.
sweep.name: Sweep
sweep.description: The sweep is a small, silvery fish with a distinctive deep body found in temperate rocky reefs of the Indo-Pacific.

leatherjacket-freshwater.funFact: Tuiuiús da Nova Zelândia são peixes-de-couro-de-água-doce encontrados apenas na Nova Zelândia.
leatherjacket-freshwater.name: New Zealand Magpie
leatherjacket-freshwater.description: The New Zealand magpie is a small freshwater fish with a compressed body and rough skin found in rivers and lakes of New Zealand.

john-dory.funFact: Peixes-São-Pedro possuem uma mancha escura distinta em cada lado que parece uma impressão digital.
john-dory.name: John Dory
john-dory.description: The John Dory is a marine fish with a distinctive oval body and dark lateral spot found in temperate coastal waters of the Indo-Pacific.

boarfish.funFact: Peixes-javali usam seu focinho alongado para extrair pequenos invertebrados de fendas de coral.
boarfish.name: Longsnout Boarfish
boarfish.description: The longsnout boarfish is a distinctive reef fish with a long, tubular snout and black and white stripes found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

bigeye.funFact: Olhos-grandes possuem olhos extremamente grandes adaptados para alimentação noturna.
bigeye.name: Bigeye
bigeye.description: The bigeye is a small reef fish with disproportionately large eyes found in tropical coral reefs worldwide, active at night.

soldierfish.funFact: Peixes-soldado são noturnos e se escondem em fendas de recife durante o dia.
soldierfish.name: Blackbar Soldierfish
soldierfish.description: The blackbar soldierfish is a small, red reef fish with a distinctive black bar behind its gill cover found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

green-anole.funFact: Anolis-verdes podem mudar de cor de verde-claro para castanho com base em humor, temperatura ou sinais sociais.
green-anole.name: Green Anole
green-anole.description: The green anole is a small arboreal lizard native to the southeastern United States. Often called the American chameleon, it can shift its skin color between green and brown. Males display a pinkish-red dewlap under their throat during courtship or territorial displays.

saltwater-crocodile.funFact: Crocodilos-de-água-salgada possuem a força de mordida mais forte de qualquer animal vivo, estimada em mais de 25.000 N.
saltwater-crocodile.name: Saltwater Crocodile
saltwater-crocodile.description: The saltwater crocodile is the largest living reptile and has the strongest bite force ever measured. Found in coastal regions from eastern India to Australia, it is an opportunistic apex predator. Adults can survive in both saltwater and freshwater environments.

reticulated-python.funFact: A píton-reticulada é a cobra mais longa do mundo, com alguns indivíduos ultrapassando 7 metros.
reticulated-python.name: Reticulated Python
reticulated-python.description: The reticulated python is a non-venomous constrictor and the longest snake in the world. Native to Southeast Asia, it is found in rainforests, rivers, and even near human settlements. It kills prey by constriction and can swallow animals much larger than its head.

panther-chameleon.funFact: Camaleões mudam de cor principalmente para comunicação e regulação de temperatura, não para camuflagem.
panther-chameleon.name: Panther Chameleon
panther-chameleon.description: The panther chameleon is a vibrant species native to Madagascar's tropical rainforests. Males display vivid colors ranging from blue, green, and yellow to red. They use their long, sticky tongues to catch insects with remarkable accuracy.

american-alligator.funFact: Jacarés-americanos podem regular sua temperatura corporal abrindo suas bocas para esfriar, conhecido como gaping.
american-alligator.name: American Alligator
american-alligator.description: The American alligator is a large crocodilian native to the southeastern United States. Once endangered, it has made a remarkable recovery through conservation efforts. It inhabits freshwater environments and is an opportunistic predator of fish, birds, and mammals.

leopard-gecko.funFact: Geckos-leopardo podem armazenar gordura em suas caudas, que podem se destacar se agarradas por um predador e depois regenerar.
leopard-gecko.name: Leopard Gecko
leopard-gecko.description: The leopard gecko is a small, nocturnal lizard native to the rocky deserts and grasslands of South Asia. Unlike many geckos, it has movable eyelids and can blink. It is one of the most popular pet reptiles due to its docile temperament.

eastern-diamondback-rattlesnake.funFact: O chocalho da cascavel-de-diamante-do-leste pode vibrar até 50 vezes por segundo como sinal de alerta.
eastern-diamondback-rattlesnake.name: Eastern Diamondback Rattlesnake
eastern-diamondback-rattlesnake.description: The eastern diamondback rattlesnake is the largest venomous snake in North America. Found in the coastal scrublands and pine flatwoods of the southeastern United States, it uses its diamond-shaped dorsal pattern as camouflage. Its rattle serves as an auditory warning to potential threats.

gila-monster.funFact: O veneno do monstro-de-Gila contém um composto usado em um medicamento para tratar diabetes tipo 2.
gila-monster.name: Gila Monster
gila-monster.description: The Gila monster is one of only a few venomous lizards in the world, native to the deserts of the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico. It has a stout body with bead-like scales in black and pink, orange, or yellow patterns. It spends most of its life underground.

leatherback-sea-turtle.funFact: Tartarugas-marinhas-de-couro são as maiores tartarugas do mundo e existem há mais de 100 milhões de anos.
leatherback-sea-turtle.name: Leatherback Sea Turtle
leatherback-sea-turtle.description: The leatherback sea turtle is the largest living turtle and the fourth heaviest reptile. Unlike other sea turtles, it has a flexible, leathery carapace instead of a hard shell. It dives to depths exceeding 3,000 feet and feeds almost exclusively on jellyfish.

boomslang.funFact: O veneno de boomslang previne a coagulação do sangue, fazendo as vítimas sangrarem de todas as aberturas.
boomslang.name: Boomslang
boomslang.description: The boomslang is a highly venomous rear-fanged snake native to sub-Saharan Africa. Males are typically bright green while females are brown. It is arboreal, spending most of its time in trees, and feeds on birds, chameleons, and small mammals.

indian-cobra.funFact: As marcas icônicas na hood da cobra-indiana são pensadas para se assemelhar a olhos, dissuadindo predadores de atacar por trás.
indian-cobra.name: Indian Cobra
indian-cobra.description: The Indian cobra is one of the 'big four' venomous snakes responsible for the most snakebite deaths in India. It is iconic for its hood, which it displays when threatened. It is found across the Indian subcontinent in a variety of habitats.

rhinoceros-iguana.funFact: Iguanas-rinoceronte obtêm seu nome das escamas semelhantes a chifres em seus focinhos, que se assemelham a chifres de rinoceronte.
rhinoceros-iguana.name: Rhinoceros Iguana
rhinoceros-iguana.description: The rhinoceros iguana is a large, heavy-bodied lizard endemic to the Caribbean island of Hispaniola. It is named for the bony, horn-like outgrowths on its snout. It inhabits dry, rocky areas and feeds on leaves, flowers, and fruit.

emerald-tree-boa.funFact: Jiboias-de-esmeralda possuem fossas de detecção de calor ao longo de seus lábios para detectar presas de sangue quente no escuro.
emerald-tree-boa.name: Emerald Tree Boa
emerald-tree-boa.description: The emerald tree boa is a bright green, non-venomous constrictor native to the rainforests of South America. It spends almost its entire life coiled on branches, waiting to ambush birds and small mammals. Its white markings along the spine help break up its silhouette.

gharial.funFact: Gaviais possuem os focinhos mais longos e finos de qualquer crocodiliano, perfeitamente formatados para pegar peixes.
gharial.name: Gharial
gharial.description: The gharial is a critically endangered crocodilian with a distinctive long, thin snout adapted for catching fish. Once found across the Indian subcontinent, it is now restricted to a few rivers in India and Nepal. It is one of the largest crocodilian species.

mexican-beaded-lizard.funFact: O lagarto-de-mexilhão-mexicano é um dos poucos lagartos venenosos e pode entregar uma mordida dolorosa, embora raramente fatal.
mexican-beaded-lizard.name: Mexican Beaded Lizard
mexican-beaded-lizard.description: The Mexican beaded lizard is a large, venomous lizard found in the dry forests and thorn scrub of Mexico and Guatemala. It has black skin with yellow or pinkish banding and bead-like scales. It is nocturnal and spends most of its time in burrows.

desert-tortoise.funFact: Tartarugas-do-deserto podem armazenar mais de um litro de água em suas bexigas e reabsolvê-la durante secas.
desert-tortoise.name: Desert Tortoise
desert-tortoise.description: The desert tortoise is a species of tortoise native to the Mojave and Sonoran Deserts. It spends up to 95% of its life underground in burrows that can be over 30 feet long. It is well adapted to extreme heat and arid conditions.

tokay-gecko.funFact: Geckos-tokay podem produzir um dos chamados mais altos de qualquer gecko, ouvido a até 1,6 km de distância.
tokay-gecko.name: Tokay Gecko
tokay-gecko.description: The tokay gecko is a large gecko native to Southeast Asia, known for its loud, distinctive call. Males are territorial and aggressive, often found on walls and ceilings of buildings. It is widely used in traditional medicine in some Asian cultures.

king-snake.funFact: Cobras-reis são chamadas de 'reis' porque regularmente comem outras cobras, incluindo cascaveis venenosas.
king-snake.name: Eastern King Snake
king-snake.description: The eastern king snake is a powerful, non-venomous constrictor found across the eastern United States. It has a distinctive chain-link pattern of white or yellow bands on a dark background. It is immune to the venom of many pit vipers.

blue-tongued-skink.funFact: Skinks-de-língua-azul exibem suas línguas azuis brilhantes para assustar predadores e fazê-los recuar.
blue-tongued-skink.name: Blue-Tongued Skink
blue-tongued-skink.description: The blue-tongued skink is a group of lizards native to Australia, Tasmania, and New Guinea. They are known for their distinctive blue tongues, which they display as a defense mechanism. They are omnivorous, eating insects, snails, and vegetation.

american-crocodile.funFact: Crocodilos-americanos são mais tolerantes à água salgada que jacarés, razão pela qual são encontrados em habitats costeiros.
american-crocodile.name: American Crocodile
american-crocodile.description: The American crocodile is found in the coastal regions of the Americas, from southern Florida to northern South America. It is less aggressive than the saltwater crocodile and prefers brackish and saltwater habitats. It is lighter in color than most crocodiles.

asian-water-monitor.funFact: Varanos-aquáticos-asiáticos são excelentes nadadores e podem prender a respiração por até 30 minutos.
asian-water-monitor.name: Asian Water Monitor
asian-water-monitor.description: The Asian water monitor is a large lizard native to Southeast Asia, commonly found near water. It is an opportunistic carnivore feeding on fish, frogs, birds, and carrion. It is one of the most common monitor lizards in the world.

eastern-hognose-snake.funFact: Cobras-hog são famosas por fazerem de mortas quando ameaçadas, rolando para trás com as bocas abertas.
eastern-hognose-snake.name: Eastern Hognose Snake
