colorado-potato-beetle.description: The Colorado potato beetle is a major agricultural pest that feeds on potatoes, tomatoes, and eggplants. It has developed resistance to over 50 different insecticides.

lily-beetle.funFact: Besouros-de-lírio são vermelho-claro, tornando-os fáceis de encontrar em folhas verdes.
lily-beetle.name: Scarlet Lily Beetle
lily-beetle.description: The scarlet lily beetle is a bright red pest of lily plants. Both adults and larvae feed on leaves, stems, and flowers, and the larvae cover themselves in their own excrement for protection.

elm-beetle.funFact: Besouros-de-folha-de-olmo podem entrar em casas por pequenas rachaduras e hibernar no interior durante o inverno.
elm-beetle.name: Elm Leaf Beetle
elm-beetle.description: The elm leaf beetle skeletonizes elm tree leaves and is a significant urban pest. Adults often overwinter inside buildings, emerging in spring to feed on newly emerged elm leaves.

fire-ant.funFact: Colônias de formigas-de-fogo podem formar jangadas vivas que flutuam na água por semanas durante inundações.
fire-ant.name: Red Imported Fire Ant
fire-ant.description: Red imported fire ants are invasive ants native to South America that deliver painful stings causing burning welts. They build large mound nests and can survive flooding by forming floating colonies.

leafcutter-ant.funFact: Formigas-cortadoras-de-folhas são os maiores consumidores de vegetação nos Neotrópicos.
leafcutter-ant.name: Leafcutter Ant
leafcutter-ant.description: Leafcutter ants cut and carry pieces of leaves back to their nests to feed a special fungus that they cultivate. They are sophisticated farmers with complex division of labor among castes.

bullet-ant.funFact: A picada da formiga-bala é classificada como a picada de inseto mais dolorosa do mundo.
bullet-ant.name: Bullet Ant
bullet-ant.description: The bullet ant gets its name from the intense pain of its sting, which has been compared to being shot. Indigenous tribes use bullet ant stings in coming-of-age rituals.

army-ant.funFact: Colônias de formigas-exército de milhões se movem em colunas de assalto massivas que devoram tudo em seu caminho.
army-ant.name: Army Ant
army-ant.description: Army ants are nomadic predators that form massive raiding swarms. They do not build permanent nests but instead form living bivouacs made of their own bodies while the colony rests.

trap-jaw-ant.funFact: Formigas-de-mandíbula-armadilha podem fechar suas mandíbulas a velocidades superiores a 225 km/h.
trap-jaw-ant.name: Trap-Jaw Ant
trap-jaw-ant.description: Trap-jaw ants have spring-loaded mandibles that snap shut at incredible speeds to capture prey and can also use the force to launch themselves into the air to escape predators.

weaver-ant.funFact: Formigas-tecedeiras usam suas próprias larvas como pistolas de cola vivas para costurar folhas juntas.
weaver-ant.name: Weaver Ant
weaver-ant.description: Weaver ants build elaborate nests by weaving living leaves together using silk produced by their larvae. They are aggressive defenders of their territory and tend honeydew-producing insects.

honeybee.funFact: Uma única colônia de abelhas pode visitar mais de 225.000 flores para produzir um quilo de mel.
honeybee.name: Western Honeybee
honeybee.description: The western honeybee is the world's most important pollinator of agricultural crops. They live in highly organized colonies with complex social structures and produce honey and beeswax.

bumblebee.funFact: Mamangavas podem voar em temperaturas mais frias que a maioria das abelhas devido à sua capacidade de termorregulação.
bumblebee.name: Common Bumblebee
bumblebee.description: Bumblebees are robust, fuzzy bees important for pollinating wildflowers and crops. They are capable of buzz pollination, vibrating their flight muscles to release pollen from flowers.

carpenter-bee.funFact: Abelhas-carpinteiras perfuram buracos perfeitamente redondos na madeira para criar galerias de ninhos.
carpenter-bee.name: Eastern Carpenter Bee
carpenter-bee.description: Carpenter bees are large, solitary bees that bore into untreated wood to create nesting tunnels. Despite their intimidating size, they are gentle and rarely sting, preferring to hover near structures.

paper-wasp.funFact: Vespas-de-papel constam seus ninhos de fibras de madeira mastigadas misturadas com saliva.
paper-wasp.name: European Paper Wasp
paper-wasp.description: Paper wasps are slender wasps with long legs that build open-comb umbrella-shaped nests from wood pulp. They are beneficial predators of caterpillars but will sting if their nest is threatened.

yellow-jacket.funFact: Colônias de vespas-jaquetas-amarelas podem crescer para conter 4.000 ou mais operárias no final do verão.
yellow-jacket.name: Common Yellow Jacket
yellow-jacket.description: Yellow jackets are aggressive wasps known for their bright yellow and black markings. They build enclosed paper nests and are notorious for scavenging at picnics and outdoor events.

bald-faced-hornet.funFact: Vespas-de-rosto-baldes podem borrifar veneno de seus ferrões por vários pés.
bald-faced-hornet.name: Bald-Faced Hornet
bald-faced-hornet.description: Despite its name, the bald-faced hornet is actually a yellowjacket, not a true hornet. It builds large, enclosed paper nests high in trees and is known for its aggressive defense of its colony.

european-hornet.funFact: Vespas-europeias são atraídas por luz e frequentemente voam para casas à noite.
european-hornet.name: European Hornet
european-hornet.description: The European hornet is the largest social wasp in Europe and an invasive species in North America. Queens can reach 1.4 inches in length, and colonies can contain up to 1,000 workers.

tarantula-hawk-wasp.funFact: A vespa-abelha-de-tarântula possui uma das picadas de inseto mais dolorosas do mundo.
tarantula-hawk-wasp.name: Tarantula Hawk Wasp
tarantula-hawk-wasp.description: The tarantula hawk is a large, metallic blue-black wasp that hunts tarantulas to serve as live food for its larvae. Its sting is excruciatingly painful but rarely dangerous to humans.

cuckoo-wasp.funFact: Vespas-cuco podem se enrolar em uma bola quando ameaçadas, usando seu exoesqueleto blindado para proteção.
cuckoo-wasp.name: Cuckoo Wasp
cuckoo-wasp.description: Cuckoo wasps are brilliant metallic blue or green parasitoids that lay their eggs in the nests of other bees and wasps. Their larvae consume the host's eggs or larvae and stored food.

ichneumon-wasp.funFact: O ovipositor da vespa-ichneumon-gigante pode ser maior que seu corpo e perfura madeira para alcançar larvas de besouros.
ichneumon-wasp.name: Giant Ichneumon Wasp
ichneumon-wasp.description: Giant ichneumon wasps are parasitoids that use their extremely long ovipositors to drill into wood and lay eggs inside wood-boring beetle larvae. Despite their fearsome appearance, they cannot sting humans.

asian-giant-hornet.funFact: A vespa-gigante-asiática pode decapitar uma colônia inteira de abelhas em horas.
asian-giant-hornet.name: Asian Giant Hornet
asian-giant-hornet.description: The Asian giant hornet, nicknamed the murder hornet, is the world's largest hornet. Its powerful sting delivers potent venom and it is a devastating predator of honeybee colonies.

sweat-bee.funFact: Algumas abelhas-de-suor possuem corpos metálicos verde ou azul que cintilam sob a luz do sol.
sweat-bee.name: Sweat Bee
sweat-bee.description: Sweat bees are small, often metallic-colored bees attracted to human perspiration for its salt content. They are important pollinators and nest in the ground or in hollow stems.

mason-bee.funFact: Abelhas-maçonarias são 100 vezes mais eficientes na polinização que abelhas-de-mel.
mason-bee.name: Blue Orchard Mason Bee
mason-bee.description: The blue orchard mason bee is a solitary bee that nests in hollow tubes and crevices. It is a far more efficient pollinator than honeybees, visiting far more flowers per hour.

mining-bee.funFact: Abelhas-mineradoras criam pequenos montes de terra em forma de vulcão nas entradas de seus ninhos.
mining-bee.name: Tawny Mining Bee
mining-bee.description: Mining bees are solitary ground-nesting bees that excavate tunnels in soil. They emerge in spring and are important early-season pollinators of fruit trees and wildflowers.

golden-digger-wasp.funFact: Vespas-cavadoras-douradas paralisam gafanhotos e grilos para alimentar suas larvas vivas.
golden-digger-wasp.name: Golden Digger Wasp
golden-digger-wasp.description: The golden digger wasp is a large, metallic golden wasp that hunts grasshoppers and crickets. It buries paralyzed prey in underground nests for its developing larvae.

mud-dauber-wasp.funFact: Vespas-oleiras abastecem seus ninhos com aranhas paralisadas para suas larvas em desenvolvimento.
mud-dauber-wasp.name: Mud Dauber Wasp
mud-dauber-wasp.description: Mud dauber wasps are solitary wasps that construct tubular mud nests on sheltered surfaces. They hunt and paralyze spiders to stock each cell for their developing young.

horned-mason-bee.funFact: Machos de abelhas-maçonarias-de-chifres possuem pequenos chifres em seus rostos usados em exibições de acasalamento.
horned-mason-bee.name: Horned Mason Bee
horned-mason-bee.description: The horned mason bee is a solitary bee that nests in hollow stems and bee hotels. Males have distinctive facial horns and both sexes are important early-season pollinators.

wool-carder-bee.funFact: Abelhas-de-lã rasgam pelos de plantas para forrar seus ninhos, daí seu nome.
wool-carder-bee.name: Wool Carder Bee
wool-carder-bee.description: Wool carder bees are solitary bees that collect plant hairs to line their nest cells. Males aggressively defend patches of fuzzy plants where females forage for nesting material.

cicada-killer-wasp.funFact: O matador-de-cicadas é a maior vespa da América do Norte e pode ter mais de 5 cm de comprimento.
cicada-killer-wasp.name: Cicada Killer Wasp
cicada-killer-wasp.description: The cicada killer is a massive solitary wasp that hunts cicadas to provision its underground nest. Despite its intimidating size, it rarely stings humans unless provoked.

red-velvet-ant.funFact: A formiga-de-veludo-vermelho é na verdade uma vespa sem asas com uma das picadas mais dolorosas do mundo dos insetos.
red-velvet-ant.name: Red Velvet Ant
red-velvet-ant.description: The red velvet ant is a wingless female wasp with a dense covering of bright red hairs. Despite its ant-like appearance, it is a parasitoid wasp whose sting is extremely painful.

cuckoo-bumblebee.funFact: Mamangavas-cuco infiltram-se em ninhos de outras mamangavas e colocam seus ovos para o hospedeiro criar.
cuckoo-bumblebee.name: Cuckoo Bumblebee
cuckoo-bumblebee.description: Cuckoo bumblebees are social parasites that take over the nests of other bumblebee species. The female cuckoo bumblebee displaces the host queen and lays her own eggs for the workers to tend.

mosquito.funFact: Apenas fêmeas de mosquitos mordem, precisando de proteína de sangue para produzir ovos.
mosquito.name: Asian Tiger Mosquito
mosquito.description: The Asian tiger mosquito is an invasive species that can transmit dengue, chikungunya, and Zika viruses. It is identified by its distinctive black and white striped body and legs.

house-fly.funFact: Moscas-de-casa provam com seus pés e podem detectar comida a milhas de distância.
house-fly.name: Common House Fly
house-fly.description: The common house fly is one of the most widespread insects, closely associated with humans. It has sponging mouthparts for liquid feeding and can transmit numerous diseases.

fruit-fly.funFact: Moscas-da-fruta são um dos organismos modelo mais importantes em pesquisa genética.
fruit-fly.name: Common Fruit Fly
fruit-fly.description: The common fruit fly is tiny but remarkably important in scientific research. They reproduce rapidly and share many genes with humans, making them invaluable for studying genetics and disease.

crane-fly.funFact: Tipúlidos são frequentemente chamados erradamente de mosquitos-gigantes, mas não mordem ou sugar sangue.
crane-fly.name: Crane Fly
crane-fly.description: Crane flies are delicate, long-legged insects that resemble oversized mosquitoes. Adults are harmless and many do not feed at all, while their larvae, known as leatherjackets, live in soil.

horsefly.funFact: Moscas-de-cavalo estão entre os insetos mais rápidos em voo, atingindo velocidades de até 145 km/h.
horsefly.name: Horse Fly
horsefly.description: Horse flies are large, powerful fliers with razor-sharp mouthparts that slash skin to feed on blood. Only females bite, and their painful bites can transmit diseases to livestock and humans.

bot-fly.funFact: Larvas-de-mosca-de-bot desenvolvem-se sob a pele humana, criando furúnculos dolorosos chamados miíase.
bot-fly.name: Human Bot Fly
bot-fly.description: The human bot fly is a parasitic insect whose larvae develop beneath the skin of mammals, including humans. Adults do not bite; instead, they hijack mosquitoes to deliver their eggs to hosts.

hover-fly.funFact: Sírfidos imitam abelhas e vespas para proteção, mas são completamente inofensivos.
hover-fly.name: Common Hover Fly
hover-fly.description: Hover flies are beneficial pollinators that mimic the appearance of stinging insects for protection. Their larvae are important predators of aphids, making them valuable in pest control.

black-fly.funFact: Enxames de moscas-pretas podem ser tão densos que sufocam gado bloqueando suas vias aéreas.
black-fly.name: Black Fly
black-fly.description: Black flies are tiny but relentless biting insects that breed in flowing water. In some regions they transmit river blindness and are considered one of the most important disease vectors.

damselfly.funFact: Agrionídeos dobram suas asas ao longo de seus corpos quando em repouso, diferente das libélulas.
damselfly.name: Blue-Tailed Damselfly
damselfly.description: Damselflies are slender, delicate relatives of dragonflies that hold their wings together above their body when resting. They are important aquatic ecosystem indicators and voracious mosquito predators.

blue-dasher-dragonfly.funFact: Libélulas-azuis podem voar para trás e pairar no lugar como um helicóptero.
blue-dasher-dragonfly.name: Blue Dasher Dragonfly
blue-dasher-dragonfly.description: The blue dasher is a small, common dragonfly with a blue-green body and distinctive wing pattern. It is an agile aerial predator that catches mosquitoes and other small insects on the wing.

emperor-dragonfly.funFact: Libélulas-imperador podem comer seu próprio peso em insetos todos os dias.
emperor-dragonfly.name: Emperor Dragonfly
emperor-dragonfly.description: The emperor dragonfly is one of the largest and most powerful dragonflies in Europe. It patrols territories over water and feeds voraciously on mosquitoes, flies, and other flying insects.

four-spotted-chaser.funFact: Libélulas-de-quatro-manchas estão entre as primeiras libélulas a emergir na primavera.
four-spotted-chaser.name: Four-Spotted Chaser
four-spotted-chaser.description: The four-spotted chaser is a robust dragonfly with distinctive dark spots on its wings. It is an aggressive territorial species that perches on vegetation to ambush passing prey.

robber-fly.funFact: Moscas-ladrões podem capturar e comer insetos grandes como libélulas e gafanhotos.
robber-fly.name: Robber Fly
robber-fly.description: Robber flies are aerial predators that intercept prey in flight. They inject victims with saliva that paralyzes and digests their insides, then suck out the liquefied contents.

marmalade-hoverfly.funFact: Sírfidos-de-marmelo migram milhares de milhas pela Europa todos os anos.
marmalade-hoverfly.name: Marmalade Hoverfly
marmalade-hoverfly.description: The marmalade hoverfly is a bee-mimic hoverfly that is an important pollinator. Its larvae are voracious aphid predators, making it doubly valuable in gardens and agriculture.

common-mosquito.funFact: Mosquitos são responsáveis por mais mortes humanas do que qualquer outro animal da história.
common-mosquito.name: Common Mosquito
common-mosquito.description: Mosquitoes are small, buzzing flies that transmit deadly diseases including malaria, dengue, and Zika. Only females bite to obtain blood for egg production, while males feed on nectar.

biting-midge.funFact: Ceratopogonídeos, ou mosquitos-invisíveis, são tão pequenos que podem passar por telas de janela padrão.
biting-midge.name: Biting Midge
biting-midge.description: Biting midges are tiny flies that deliver disproportionately painful bites. They are among the smallest biting flies and can be major pests in coastal and tropical regions.

deer-fly.funFact: Moscas-de-veado são atraídas por cores escuras e dióxido de carbono, semelhantes a mosquitos.
deer-fly.name: Deer Fly
deer-fly.description: Deer flies are fast-flying, aggressive biters with patterned wings. They transmit tularemia and can cause severe allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

cattle-bot-fly.funFact: Larvas-de-mosca-de-gado se fixam na língua e garganta de gado, causando irritação significativa.
cattle-bot-fly.name: Cattle Bot Fly
cattle-bot-fly.description: The cattle bot fly is a parasitic fly whose larvae develop in the throats of cattle. Adults are bee-like in appearance and do not feed, living only long enough to reproduce.

orchid-mantis.funFact: O louva-deuses-de-orquídea parece tanto uma flor que polinizadores pousam diretamente nele.
orchid-mantis.name: Orchid Mantis
orchid-mantis.description: The orchid mantis is a stunning pink and white mantis that mimics orchid flowers to ambush pollinators. It is considered one of the most beautiful insects in the world.

ghost-mantis.funFact: O louva-deuses-fantasma parece exatamente uma folha seca e morta, tornando-o quase invisível.
ghost-mantis.name: Ghost Mantis
ghost-mantis.description: The ghost mantis is a master of camouflage with a body shaped and colored to resemble a dried leaf. It sways gently to mimic a leaf in the wind, hiding from both predators and prey.

leaf-mantis.funFact: O louva-deuses-de-folha-morta possui bordas corporais irregulares que replicam perfeitamente uma folha rasgada e em decomposição.
leaf-mantis.name: Dead Leaf Mantis
leaf-mantis.description: The dead leaf mantis is a large, spectacular mantis with a flattened body resembling a dead leaf. It is an ambush predator that waits motionless for prey to come within striking distance.

walking-stick.funFact: Bacuris podem regenerar membros perdidos durante a muda e algumas espécies produzem químicos defensivos tóxicos.
walking-stick.name: Common Walking Stick
walking-stick.description: Walking sticks are elongated, camouflaged insects that resemble twigs or branches. They are nocturnal herbivores that rely on their extraordinary disguise to avoid detection by predators.

giant-walking-stick.funFact: O bacuri-gigante detém o recorde do maior inseto do mundo.
giant-walking-stick.name: Giant Walking Stick
giant-walking-stick.description: The giant walking stick, also known as Chan's megastick, is the longest insect species, with females reaching over 14 inches including legs. It is native to Borneo's tropical rainforests.

american-cockroach.funFact: Baratas podem sobreviver por semanas sem comida e prender a respiração por 40 minutos.
american-cockroach.name: American Cockroach
american-cockroach.description: The American cockroach is the largest common cockroach found in human habitations. Despite its name, it originated in Africa and is now found worldwide in warm, moist environments.

german-cockroach.funFact: Baratas-alemãs podem produzir até 30.000 descendentes em um único ano a partir de uma fêmea.
german-cockroach.name: German Cockroach
german-cockroach.description: The German cockroach is the most troublesome indoor cockroach species worldwide. It reproduces rapidly, is resistant to many insecticides, and contaminates food and surfaces with pathogens.

madagascar-hissing-cockroach.funFact: Baratas-ronronadoras-de-Madagascar produzem um chiado alto forçando ar por furos respiratórios especializados.
madagascar-hissing-cockroach.name: Madagascar Hissing Cockroach
madagascar-hissing-cockroach.description: The Madagascar hissing cockroach is one of the largest cockroach species, reaching 3 inches long. It is famous for the loud hissing sound it produces when disturbed, used for defense and communication.

oriental-cockroach.funFact: Baratas-orientais são às vezes chamadas de bug-d'água porque preferem ambientes úmidos e escuros.
oriental-cockroach.name: Oriental Cockroach
oriental-cockroach.description: The oriental cockroach is a large, dark species that prefers cool, damp environments. It is a scavenger that feeds on decaying organic matter and is associated with poor sanitation.

eastern-subterranean-termite.funFact: Colônias de cupins-subterrâneos podem conter milhões de indivíduos trabalhando juntos.
eastern-subterranean-termite.name: Eastern Subterranean Termite
eastern-subterranean-termite.description: Eastern subterranean termites are the most destructive termite species in North America. They live in underground colonies and build mud tubes to reach wood structures above ground.

formosan-termite.funFact: Cupins-formosanos constam ninhos de cartão acima do solo e podem consumir 30 cm de madeira 2x4 em cerca de cinco meses.
formosan-termite.name: Formosan Subterranean Termite
formosan-termite.description: The Formosan termite is one of the most destructive termite species, capable of consuming enormous amounts of wood. Unlike most termites, it can build above-ground nests, making it especially destructive.

dampwood-termite.funFact: Cupins-de-madeira-úmida são os maiores cupins da América do Norte e não requerem contato com o solo.
dampwood-termite.name: Dampwood Termite
dampwood-termite.description: Dampwood termites infest moist, decaying wood and are indicators of excessive moisture problems. They are larger than subterranean termites and do not build mud tubes.

drywood-termite.funFact: Cupins-de-madeira-seca expulsam pequenas pellets fecais chamados frass que se acumulam sob a madeira infestada.
drywood-termite.name: Drywood Termite
drywood-termite.description: Drywood termites live entirely within the wood they consume and do not require soil contact. They are difficult to detect and treat because colonies can be scattered throughout a structure.

cicada.funFact: Cicadas-periódicas emergem em ninhadas sincronizadas de bilhões após 13 ou 17 anos no subsolo.
cicada.name: Periodical Cicada
cicada.description: Periodical cicadas are famous for their synchronized mass emergences every 13 or 17 years. They are the longest-lived insects and their emergences create deafening choruses heard for miles.

dog-day-cicada.funFact: Cicadas-de-dias-de-cão obtêm seu nome porque emergem durante os dias de calor do verão.
dog-day-cicada.name: Dog-Day Cicada
dog-day-cicada.description: Dog-day cicadas are annual cicadas that emerge each summer, unlike their periodical cousins. Their loud buzzing songs fill late summer afternoons in eastern North America.

masked-devil-cicada.funFact: Algumas espécies de cicadas-australianas possuem os chamados de insetos mais altos, ultrapassando 120 decibéis.
masked-devil-cicada.name: Masked Devil Cicada
masked-devil-cicada.description: The masked devil cicada is an Australian species known for its distinctive facial markings. Like other cicadas, it spends years underground before emerging for a brief, noisy adult life.

leafhopper.funFact: Cigarrinhas-marrom podem pular 70 vezes o comprimento de seu corpo em um único salto.
leafhopper.name: Brown Planthopper
leafhopper.description: The brown planthopper is a major pest of rice crops in Asia. It feeds on plant sap and transmits the devastating rice ragged stunt virus and rice grassy stunt virus.

spittlebug.funFact: Ninfas-de-cigarrinha-de-espuma produzem massas de saliva espumosa chamadas espuma-de-cuco para se proteger.
spittlebug.name: Meadow Spittlebug
spittlebug.description: Spittlebugs get their name from the frothy foam masses their nymphs produce on plant stems. These nymphs, called froghoppers, are sap-sucking insects that can transmit plant diseases.

aphid.funFact: Pulgões podem produzir até 80 descendentes por fêmea sem acasalamento por partenogênese.
aphid.name: Green Peach Aphid
aphid.description: The green peach aphid is one of the most destructive agricultural pests worldwide. It reproduces rapidly through asexual reproduction and transmits over 100 plant viruses.

bed-bug.funFact: Percevejos-de-cama podem sobreviver por mais de um ano sem se alimentar e são resistentes a muitos pesticidas.
bed-bug.name: Common Bed Bug
bed-bug.description: Bed bugs are parasitic insects that feed on human blood at night. They hide in mattress seams, furniture, and wall cracks, and their populations have surged worldwide due to pesticide resistance.

kissing-bug.funFact: Percevejos-beijo são chamados assim porque frequentemente mordem pessoas no rosto enquanto dormem.
kissing-bug.name: Triatomine Bug
kissing-bug.description: Triatomine bugs, also known as kissing bugs, are vectors of Chagas disease. They feed on blood at night and transmit the parasite Trypanosoma cruzi through their feces.

stink-bug.funFact: Percevejos-maçã-de-odour liberam uma substância química com cheiro desagradável de glândulas em seu tórax quando perturbados.
stink-bug.name: Brown Marmorated Stink Bug
stink-bug.description: The brown marmorated stink bug is an invasive species from Asia that has become a major agricultural pest in North America. It damages fruit crops and invades homes in winter seeking shelter.

box-elder-bug.funFact: Percevejos-de-ácer-agregam-se em números enormes em paredes quentes voltadas para o sul no outono.
box-elder-bug.name: Box Elder Bug
box-elder-bug.description: Box elder bugs are black insects with red markings that feed on box elder tree seeds. They become nuisances in fall when they cluster on buildings seeking warmth for winter.

water-strider.funFact: Percevejos-d'água podem andar na água devido a pelos microscópicos em suas pernas que aprisionam ar.
water-strider.name: Common Water Strider
water-strider.description: Water striders are insects that glide across the surface of calm water using surface tension. Their hydrophobic leg hairs create air cushions that keep them afloat while they hunt prey.

giant-water-bug.funFact: Percevejos-d'água-gigantes são chamados de mordedores-de-dedos e podem dar uma mordida extremamente dolorosa.
giant-water-bug.name: Giant Water Bug
giant-water-bug.description: Giant water bugs are large, flat-bodied aquatic predators that prey on fish, frogs, and snakes. Males carry eggs on their backs and are sometimes called electric-light bugs for their attraction to lights.

american-grasshopper.funFact: Gafanhotos-passarinho são voadores fortes e podem viajar distâncias significativas durante migrações.
american-grasshopper.name: American Bird Grasshopper
american-grasshopper.description: The American bird grasshopper is a large, strong-flying grasshopper that feeds on a wide variety of plants. It gets its name from its bird-like flight and large size.

desert-locust.funFact: Enxames de gafanhotos-do-deserto podem cobrir 1.200 km² e conter 40 a 80 bilhões de insetos.
desert-locust.name: Desert Locust
desert-locust.description: The desert locust is the most destructive of all locust species. Under certain conditions it transforms from a solitary grasshopper into a gregarious swarming phase capable of devastating crops.

mormon-cricket.funFact: Apesar de seu nome, grilos-mormons são na verdade gafanhotos-de-olho-grosso, não grilos verdadeiros.
mormon-cricket.name: Mormon Cricket
mormon-cricket.description: The Mormon cricket is not a cricket but a large shield-backed katydid that forms migrating bands of billions. They were named after Mormon settlers whose crops they devastated in the 1840s.

field-cricket.funFact: Grilos-de-campo machos cantam esfregando suas asas juntas, e você pode estimar a temperatura contando os cantos.
field-cricket.name: Field Cricket
field-cricket.description: Field crickets are known for their distinctive chirping songs produced by males to attract mates. They are omnivorous scavengers that feed on plants, fungi, and other insects.

katydid.funFact: Cantos de cigarra-saltadora são ultrassônicos, tornando-os difíceis para humanos ouvirem sem equipamento especial.
katydid.name: True Katydid
katydid.description: True katydids are named after their call, said to sound like Katy-did, Katy-didn't. They are leaf-mimicking insects that produce loud, clicking songs at ultrasonic frequencies.

mole-cricket.funFact: Grilos-toupeira podem nadar e voar, tornando-se pragas altamente móveis de relva.
mole-cricket.name: European Mole Cricket
mole-cricket.description: Mole crickets are burrowing insects with powerful, shovel-like forelegs adapted for digging through soil. They damage lawns and crops by feeding on roots and disrupting soil structure.

snowy-tree-cricket.funFact: O grilo-de-árvore-nevado é conhecido como grilo-termômetro porque a taxa de canto se correlaciona com a temperatura.
snowy-tree-cricket.name: Snowy Tree Cricket
snowy-tree-cricket.description: The snowy tree cricket produces a pure, musical trill and is famous for its temperature-dependent chirping rate. Dolbear's Law uses its chirps to estimate ambient temperature.

human-head-louse.funFact: Piolhos-de-cabeça são companheiros humanos há pelo menos 10.000 anos.
human-head-louse.name: Human Head Louse
human-head-louse.description: Human head lice are parasitic insects that live on the scalp and feed on blood. They are wingless and highly adapted to life on humans, spreading through direct head-to-head contact.

body-louse.funFact: Piolhos-de-corpo foram usados para rastrear padrões de migração humana através de análise de DNA.
body-louse.name: Human Body Louse
body-louse.description: Human body lice live in clothing and emerge to feed on blood. Unlike head lice, they can transmit serious diseases including typhus, trench fever, and relapsing fever.

human-flea.funFact: Pulgas podem pular até 150 vezes o comprimento de seu corpo, equivalente a um humano pulando sobre um arranha-céu.
human-flea.name: Human Flea
human-flea.description: The human flea, Pulex irritans, is the original flea species associated with humans. It is a blood-feeding parasite that can transmit diseases and has been a companion of humans for millennia.

cat-flea.funFact: Pulgas-de-gato são a espécie de pulga mais comum em animais de estimação domésticos em todo o mundo.
cat-flea.name: Cat Flea
cat-flea.description: The cat flea is the most common flea species affecting domestic cats and dogs. Despite its name, it infests many mammal species and can cause allergic dermatitis and transmit tapeworms.

oriental-rat-flea.funFact: A pulga-rato-oriental foi o principal vetor da peste bubônica durante a Peste Negra.
oriental-rat-flea.name: Oriental Rat Flea
oriental-rat-flea.description: The oriental rat flea is historically the most important disease vector among fleas, having transmitted bubonic plague during the Black Death. It feeds primarily on rats and other rodents.

brown-recluse-spider.funFact: O veneno de aranha-marrom-reclusa pode causar lesões necróticas que levam meses para cicatrizar.
brown-recluse-spider.name: Brown Recluse Spider
brown-recluse-spider.description: The brown recluse spider has a violin-shaped marking on its cephalothorax and venom that can cause tissue death. It is reclusive and bites only when pressed against skin.

wolf-spider.funFact: Mães de aranha-lobo carregam seus sacos de ovos e filhotes em suas costas.
wolf-spider.name: Common Wolf Spider
wolf-spider.description: Wolf spiders are agile, ground-hunting spiders that do not build webs. They have excellent vision and chase down their prey, and females are notable for carrying their young on their backs.

jumping-spider.funFact: Aranhas-saltadoras possuem a melhor visão de qualquer aranha e podem pular 50 vezes o comprimento de seu corpo.
jumping-spider.name: Bold Jumping Spider
jumping-spider.description: Bold jumping spiders are charismatic, fuzzy spiders with large forward-facing eyes. They are active hunters that stalk prey and leap to capture it, displaying complex courtship dances.

orb-weaver-spider.funFact: Teias-de-aranha reconstruem suas teias quase todas as noites, consumindo a seda velha para reciclar as proteínas.
orb-weaver-spider.name: Garden Orb Weaver Spider
orb-weaver-spider.description: Garden orb weavers are among the most common web-building spiders. They create distinctive circular webs and are beneficial predators of flying insects in gardens and natural areas.

peacock-spider.funFact: Machos de aranhas-pavão realizam exibições de dança elaboradas com abas coloridas no abdômen para cortejar fêmeas.
peacock-spider.name: Peacock Spider
peacock-spider.description: Peacock spiders are tiny jumping spiders famous for the males' spectacular iridescent abdominal flaps used in elaborate courtship dances. Females will eat males who fail to impress.

brazilian-wandering-spider.funFact: A aranha-andarilho-brasileira possui o veneno mais potente de qualquer aranha e está listada no Guinness World Records.
brazilian-wandering-spider.name: Brazilian Wandering Spider
brazilian-wandering-spider.description: The Brazilian wandering spider is considered the world's most venomous spider. Unlike web-building spiders, it actively wanders the forest floor at night and can deliver a medically significant bite.

emperor-scorpion.funFact: Escorpiões-imperador brilham azul-esverdeado sob luz ultravioleta.
emperor-scorpion.name: Emperor Scorpion
emperor-scorpion.description: The emperor scorpion is one of the largest scorpion species and one of the most popular in the pet trade. Despite its intimidating size, its venom is relatively mild and it is generally docile.

bark-scorpion.funFact: Escorpiões-de-casca-do-Arizona são o escorpiao mais venenoso da América do Norte e podem escalar paredes e tetos.
bark-scorpion.name: Arizona Bark Scorpion
bark-scorpion.description: The Arizona bark scorpion is the most dangerous scorpion in North America. It is unique among scorpions in its ability to climb walls and ceilings, often entering homes through plumbing.

deathstalker-scorpion.funFact: O veneno de deathstalker contém compostos que estão sendo pesquisados para uso no tratamento do câncer.
deathstalker-scorpion.name: Deathstalker Scorpion
deathstalker-scorpion.description: The deathstalker is one of the most venomous scorpions in the world. Its potent neurotoxic venom can be fatal to humans, but its venom compounds show promise in medical research.

spotted-lanternfly.funFact: Moscas-lanterna-pintadas podem colocar até 50 ovos em quase qualquer superfície plana.
spotted-lanternfly.name: Spotted Lanternfly
spotted-lanternfly.description: The spotted lanternfly is an invasive planthopper from Asia that feeds on over 70 plant species, threatening agriculture. Adults have distinctive spotted wings and bright red hind wings.

wheel-bug.funFact: O besouro-roe-obtém seu nome da crista distinta semelhante a engrenagem em seu tórax.
wheel-bug.name: Wheel Bug
wheel-bug.description: The wheel bug is a large, beneficial predatory insect with a distinctive semicircular crest on its thorax. It uses its proboscis to inject digestive enzymes into prey and is a natural pest controller.

sawfly.funFact: Larvas-de-serra parecem lagartas, mas possuem mais de cinco pares de pernas falsas.
sawfly.name: Rose Slug Sawfly
sawfly.description: Sawflies are wasp-like insects whose larvae feed on plant foliage, resembling caterpillars. The rose slug sawfly can skeletonize rose leaves, causing significant damage to gardens.

antlion.funFact: Larvas-de-formiga-leão cavam armadilhas côncavos na areia para pegar formigas e outros pequenos insetos.
antlion.name: Antlion
antlion.description: Antlions are insects whose larvae are famous for digging conical pitfall traps in sand. They wait at the bottom of the pit for prey to fall in, then inject digestive enzymes.

lacewing.funFact: Larvas-de- crustáceo-de-lace são chamadas de leões-de-pulgão e cada uma pode consumir 200 pulgões por semana.
lacewing.name: Green Lacewing
lacewing.description: Green lacewings are delicate, golden-green insects with lace-like wings. Their larvae are voracious predators of aphids and other soft-bodied pests, making them valuable biological control agents.

dobsonfly.funFact: Larvas-de-dobsonfly, chamadas de hellgrammites, são indicadores de boa qualidade da água.
dobsonfly.name: Eastern Dobsonfly
dobsonfly.description: The eastern dobsonfly is a large, impressive insect with enormous wings and males have extremely long mandibles. The aquatic larvae are important food for trout and indicators of stream health.

mayfly.funFact: Efêmeras adultas possuem partes bucais vestigiais e não podem comer, vivendo apenas tempo suficiente para se reproduzirem.
mayfly.name: Mayfly
mayfly.description: Mayflies are aquatic insects with extremely short adult lifespans dedicated solely to reproduction. Their larvae are important indicators of water quality and food for fish.

earwig.funFact: Mães-de-tesourinha guardam seus ovos e os limpam para prevenir o crescimento de fungos.
earwig.name: Common European Earwig
earwig.description: The common European earwig is a nocturnal insect with distinctive pincer-like cerci on its abdomen. Despite myths, earwigs do not burrow into human ears, and mothers provide notable parental care.

silverfish.funFact: Peixes-prata estão entre os insetos sem asas mais primitivos, virtualmente inalterados há 400 milhões de anos.
silverfish.name: Common Silverfish
silverfish.description: Silverfish are small, wingless, silver-colored insects that damage paper, textiles, and food. They are nocturnal and thrive in warm, humid environments like bathrooms and basements.

firebrat.funFact: Squirmos-de-fogo preferem temperaturas acima de 32°C e podem sobreviver a condições escaldantes.
firebrat.name: Firebrat
firebrat.description: Firebrats are close relatives of silverfish that prefer much warmer environments. They are found near heat sources like furnaces and water heaters and feed on starchy materials.

jumping-bristletail.funFact: Squirmos-saltadores estão entre os insetos mais antigos, com registro fóssil datando de 400 milhões de anos.
jumping-bristletail.name: Jumping Bristletail
jumping-bristletail.description: Jumping bristletails are small, wingless insects that can jump by curling their abdomen. They are found in moist environments and feed on algae, lichens, and decaying plant matter.

snakefly.funFact: Larvas-de-serpente-fuge podem rastejar para trás em alta velocidade para escapar de ameaças.
snakefly.name: Snakefly
snakefly.description: Snakeflies are predatory insects with an elongated prothorax that gives them a snake-like appearance. Both adults and larvae are beneficial predators of pest insects on trees.

cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.funFact: Algumas espécies de mamangavas-cuco foram reclassificadas como espécies inteiramente separadas de seus hospedeiros.
cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.name: Bombus Bob
cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.description: This cuckoo bumblebee species is a social parasite that takes over nests of other bumblebee species. The female enters a host nest, kills or displaces the queen, and uses the existing workers.

musk-bee.funFact: Abelhas-de-almíscar produzem um aroma distinto de limão quando perturbadas.
musk-bee.name: Musk Bee
musk-bee.description: The musk bee is a solitary ground-nesting bee known for its distinctive musky scent. It emerges in late summer and is an important pollinator of goldenrod and other fall wildflowers.

alkali-bee.funFact: Abelhas-alcáli preferem solo salgado e alcalino para nidificação e podem formar agregações massivas.
alkali-bee.name: Alkali Bee
alkali-bee.description: The alkali bee is a solitary ground-nesting bee that prefers alkaline soils near salt flats. It is an excellent pollinator of alfalfa and has been managed commercially for this purpose.

carpenter-ant.funFact: Formigas-carpinteiras não comem madeira, mas a escavam para criar galerias de ninhos.
carpenter-ant.name: Black Carpenter Ant
carpenter-ant.description: Black carpenter ants are large ants that excavate nests in moist, decaying wood. Unlike termites, they do not consume wood but can cause structural damage by hollowing out timbers.

pharaoh-ant.funFact: Formigas-de-faraó podem nidificar em espaços extremamente pequenos e são conhecidas por espalhar doenças em hospitais.
pharaoh-ant.name: Pharaoh Ant
pharaoh-ant.description: Pharaoh ants are tiny, pale-colored invasive ants that are particularly problematic in hospitals and food facilities. They form huge colonies with multiple queens and bud frequently.

odorous-house-ant.funFact: Formigas-de-cheiro-de-casa cheiram a coco triturado quando esmagadas.
odorous-house-ant.name: Odorous House Ant
odorous-house-ant.description: Odorous house ants are common household ants that emit a distinctive coconut-like odor when crushed. They form large colonies and frequently nest inside walls and under floors.

blue-ringed-octopus.funFact: Seu veneno contém tetrodotoxina, potente o suficiente para matar 26 humanos.
blue-ringed-octopus.name: Blue-Ringed Octopus
blue-ringed-octopus.description: The blue-ringed octopus is a small but deadly cephalopod native to coral reefs. Despite its diminutive size, its bright blue rings serve as a warning of its highly potent venom.

mimic-octopus.funFact: Pode personificar mais de 15 espécies diferentes, incluindo peixes-leão e cobras-marinhas.
mimic-octopus.name: Mimic Octopus
mimic-octopus.description: The mimic octopus is a master of disguise, capable of altering its shape, color, and behavior to resemble other marine animals. It was only discovered in 1998 off the coast of Indonesia.

colossal-squid.funFact: Possui os maiores olhos de qualquer animal, com até 25 cm de diâmetro.
colossal-squid.name: Colossal Squid
colossal-squid.description: The colossal squid is one of the largest invertebrates on Earth, inhabiting the frigid deep waters of the Antarctic. Its massive eyes are adapted to detect light in the perpetual darkness of the deep sea.

humboldt-squid.funFact: Também chamado de lula-jumbo ou diabo-vermelho por sua natureza agressiva.
humboldt-squid.name: Humboldt Squid
humboldt-squid.description: The Humboldt squid is a large, aggressive cephalopod named after the Humboldt Current. It hunts in packs and is known for its rapid growth rate and voracious appetite.

giant-squid.funFact: Foi considerada uma criatura mítica até ser fotografada viva pela primeira vez em 2004.
giant-squid.name: Giant Squid
giant-squid.description: The giant squid is one of the most mysterious creatures of the deep ocean. With eyes the size of dinner plates and tentacles reaching over 40 feet, it is a legendary predator of the abyss.

firefly-squid.funFact: Produz sua própria luz através de órgãos bioluminescentes chamados fotóforos.
firefly-squid.name: Firefly Squid
firefly-squid.description: The firefly squid is a small cephalopod famous for its bioluminescence. Each spring millions gather in Toyama Bay, Japan, creating a spectacular natural light show.

caribbean-reef-octopus.funFact: Possui dois terços de seus neurônios em seus braços em vez de seu cérebro.
caribbean-reef-octopus.name: Caribbean Reef Octopus
caribbean-reef-octopus.description: The Caribbean reef octopus is a nocturnal predator that hunts crustaceans and small fish among coral formations. Its chromatophores allow rapid color changes for communication and camouflage.

flamboyant-cuttlefish.funFact: Um dos poucos cefalópodes venenosos conhecidos.
flamboyant-cuttlefish.name: Flamboyant Cuttlefish
flamboyant-cuttlefish.description: The flamboyant cuttlefish is a small, vibrantly colored cephalopod that walks along the seafloor on its tentacles. It displays pulsating patterns of yellow, maroon, and white as a warning to predators.

common-cuttlefish.funFact: Pode hipnotizar presas com padrões de cores que mudam rapidamente.
common-cuttlefish.name: Common Cuttlefish
common-cuttlefish.description: The common cuttlefish is a highly intelligent cephalopod with W-shaped pupils and an internal cuttlebone used for buoyancy. It is renowned for its extraordinary ability to change color and texture.

chambered-nautilus.funFact: Permaneceu virtualmente inalterado por mais de 500 milhões de anos.
chambered-nautilus.name: Chambered Nautilus
chambered-nautilus.description: The chambered nautilus is a cephalopod often called a living fossil, having existed since before the dinosaurs. Its beautiful spiral shell is divided into chambers used for buoyancy control.

argonaut.funFact: Fêmeas criam uma casca fina como papel para proteção dos ovos, o único polvo a fazer isso.
argonaut.name: Argonaut
argonaut.description: The argonaut, or paper nautilus, is a pelagic octopus where only females produce a delicate calcareous shell. Males are much smaller and lack shells entirely.

vampire-squid.funFact: Não é nem uma lula verdadeira nem um polvo verdadeiro, mas ocupa sua própria ordem.
vampire-squid.name: Vampire Squid
vampire-squid.description: The vampire squid inhabits the deep ocean's oxygen minimum zones. Despite its name, it feeds on marine snow rather than prey, and can turn itself inside out as a defense mechanism.

strawberry-squid.funFact: Possui fotóforos cobrindo seu corpo que produzem um brilho vermelho-morangos para camuflar contra predadores.
strawberry-squid.name: Strawberry Squid
strawberry-squid.description: The strawberry squid is a deep-sea cephalopod covered in light-producing photophores. Its red coloring is invisible in the deep ocean, providing effective camouflage against predators.

cockatoo-squid.funFact: Infla seu corpo com água do mar para parecer maior e mais intimidante para predadores.
cockatoo-squid.name: Cockatoo Squid
cockatoo-squid.description: The cockatoo squid is a small, translucent deep-sea cephalopod that inflates its body like a balloon when threatened. Its distinctive appearance resembles a cockatoo with its arms raised.

pajama-squid.funFact: Possui um padrão listrado preto e branco distinto semelhante a pijamas listrados.
pajama-squid.name: Pajama Squid
pajama-squid.description: The pajama squid is a small, nocturnal cephalopod with distinctive black and white stripes. It buries itself in sand during the day and emerges at night to hunt small crustaceans.

bobtail-squid.funFact: Abriga bactérias bioluminescentes em um órgão luminoso especializado para camuflagem por contrailuminação.
bobtail-squid.name: Bobtail Squid
bobtail-squid.description: Bobtail squids are small, round cephalopods that partner with bioluminescent bacteria. The bacteria produce light that matches the moonlight from above, eliminating the squid's shadow.

pygmy-squid.funFact: Usa uma glândula pegajosa em seu nariz para se fixar em folhas de capim-marinho.
pygmy-squid.name: Pygmy Squid
pygmy-squid.description: The pygmy squid is one of the smallest cephalopods, reaching barely an inch long. It uses a special adhesive gland to attach itself to seagrass blades, waiting to ambush passing prey.

american-lobster.funFact: Pode viver mais de 100 anos e continuar crescendo ao longo de sua vida.
american-lobster.name: American Lobster
american-lobster.description: The American lobster is a large marine crustacean prized as a delicacy. It uses its powerful claws for defense and crushing prey, and can regenerate lost limbs during molting.

european-lobster.funFact: Pode pesar até 12 kg e é um dos maiores crustáceos das águas europeias.
european-lobster.name: European Lobster
european-lobster.description: The European lobster is a large, deep-blue crustacean found along rocky coastlines. It is a solitary nocturnal hunter that preys on fish, crabs, and mollusks.

spiny-lobster.funFact: Não possui grandes garras e em vez disso produz sons altos e ásperos para afastar predadores.
spiny-lobster.name: Spiny Lobster
spiny-lobster.description: Spiny lobsters are colorful crustaceans found in tropical marine environments. Unlike true lobsters, they lack large front claws and instead rely on their spiny antennae and a unique alarm call.

slipper-lobster.funFact: Possui antenas distintas semelhantes a placas que se assemelham a solas de chinelo.
slipper-lobster.name: Slipper Lobster
slipper-lobster.description: Slipper lobsters are robust crustaceans recognized by their flattened, slipper-shaped antennae. They are bottom-dwellers that hunt mollusks and other invertebrates at night.

mantis-shrimp.funFact: Pode socar com a força de uma bala de calibre 22, quebrando vidro de aquário.
mantis-shrimp.name: Mantis Shrimp
mantis-shrimp.description: The mantis shrimp is a strikingly colored crustacean with the fastest punch in the animal kingdom. It possesses the most complex eyes known, with 16 types of color receptors compared to humans' three.

peacock-mantis-shrimp.funFact: Pode ver 16 tipos de receptores de cores e percebe luz ultravioleta e polarizada.
peacock-mantis-shrimp.name: Peacock Mantis Shrimp
peacock-mantis-shrimp.description: The peacock mantis shrimp is one of the most colorful and formidable predators in the reef. Its club-like appendages strike with incredible speed and force, capable of shattering glass aquariums.

spearer-mantis-shrimp.funFact: Possui apêndices semelhantes a lanças com farpas para empalar presas de corpo mole como peixes.
spearer-mantis-shrimp.name: Spearer Mantis Shrimp
spearer-mantis-shrimp.description: Spearer mantis shrimp are ambush predators that wait at the entrance of their mud burrows. They strike passing prey with barbed, spear-like appendages that can impale fish in milliseconds.

blue-crab.funFact: Nomeado por suas garras azuis brilhantes usadas em exibições de acasalamento.
blue-crab.name: Blue Crab
blue-crab.description: The blue crab is a commercially important species found along the Atlantic coast of North America. It is an aggressive swimmer and opportunistic feeder that plays a key role in estuarine ecosystems.

king-crab.funFact: Sua casca espinhosa pode ter mais de 1,5 metro de ponta a ponta das pernas.
king-crab.name: Red King Crab
king-crab.description: The red king crab is one of the largest crabs in the world, prized commercially in Alaska and Russia. Its massive, spiny legs can span over five feet and it can walk up to 100 miles during its annual migration.

japanese-spider-crab.funFact: Possui a maior envergadura de pernas de qualquer artrópode, com até 3,7 metros de diâmetro.
japanese-spider-crab.name: Japanese Spider Crab
japanese-spider-crab.description: The Japanese spider crab holds the record for the largest leg span of any living arthropod. Despite its enormous size, it is a gentle giant that scavenges on the ocean floor.

hermit-crab.funFact: Deve encontrar e atualizar para conchas maiores ao longo de sua vida.
hermit-crab.name: Hermit Crab
hermit-crab.description: Hermit crabs are decapod crustaceans that use abandoned snail shells to protect their soft abdomens. They are social animals often found in groups, and play dead when threatened.

coconut-crab.funFact: Possui a maior força de qualquer animal, forte o suficiente para quebrar coco.
coconut-crab.name: Coconut Crab
coconut-crab.description: The coconut crab is the largest terrestrial arthropod, capable of cracking coconuts with its powerful claws. Despite its name, it lives primarily on land but must return to the sea to reproduce.

snow-crab.funFact: Pode tolerar temperaturas de água próximas ao congelamento, tão baixas quanto 0,5 grau Celsius.
snow-crab.name: Snow Crab
snow-crab.description: The snow crab is a cold-water species that lives on sandy and muddy bottoms. It is an important commercial species in both the Atlantic and Pacific, known for its sweet, tender meat.

fiddler-crab.funFact: Machos possuem uma garra enorme que acenam para atrair fêmeas.
fiddler-crab.name: Fiddler Crab
fiddler-crab.description: Fiddler crabs are small semiterrestrial crabs recognized by the male's single oversized claw used in elaborate mating dances. They are important ecosystem engineers in mangrove and marsh habitats.

mud-crab.funFact: Pode crescer até 2 kg e possui garras fortes o suficiente para cortar um dedo humano.
mud-crab.name: Mud Crab
mud-crab.description: The mud crab is a robust species found in mangrove ecosystems across the Indo-Pacific. It is one of the most commercially important crabs in aquaculture, prized for its sweet, firm meat.

atlantic-ghost-crab.funFact: Pode correr até 16 km/h e possui olhos pedunculados que proporcionam visão de 360 graus.
atlantic-ghost-crab.name: Atlantic Ghost Crab
atlantic-ghost-crab.description: Ghost crabs are pale, fast-moving crustaceans that burrow in sandy beaches. They are mostly nocturnal and use their large stalked eyes and acute hearing to detect predators and prey.

tropical-hermit-crab.funFact: Alguns indivíduos vivem em grupos de mais de 100, compartilhando conchas em uma cadeia.
tropical-hermit-crab.name: Tropical Hermit Crab
tropical-hermit-crab.description: Tropical hermit crabs are colorful land-dwelling crustaceans that inhabit beaches and coastal forests. They are highly social and often form shell exchange chains to ensure all members have appropriate shelter.

coconut-hermit-crab.funFact: Frequentemente encontrado em cascas de coco e pode crescer o suficiente para usar cascas de coco como abrigos.
coconut-hermit-crab.name: Coconut Hermit Crab
coconut-hermit-crab.description: The coconut hermit crab is a large land-dwelling species that inhabits tropical island beaches. It is known for its habit of using coconut shells as mobile homes and feeding on fallen coconuts.

zebra-fiddler-crab.funFact: Machos acenam suas garras fora do tamanho em um ritmo único específico de sua espécie.
zebra-fiddler-crab.name: Zebra Fiddler Crab
zebra-fiddler-crab.description: The zebra fiddler crab is named for the distinctive stripes on its carapace. Males perform elaborate claw-waving displays to attract females and defend territory on tropical mudflats.

great-spider-crab.funFact: Frequentemente decora sua casca com esponjas e algas para camuflagem.
great-spider-crab.name: Great Spider Crab
great-spider-crab.description: The great spider crab is a camouflaged crustacean that attaches organisms to its shell for disguise. It migrates in large numbers to shallow waters for mating each autumn.

swimming-crab.funFact: Possui pernas traseiras em forma de remo que lhe permitem nadar rapidamente pela água.
swimming-crab.name: Portunus Swimming Crab
swimming-crab.description: Swimming crabs are agile crustaceans with modified rear legs that function as paddles. They are aggressive predators that can pursue prey through the water column with remarkable speed.

common-shore-shrimp.funFact: Pode se agarrar firmemente a rochas para sobreviver à ação poderosa das ondas.
common-shore-shrimp.name: Common Shore Shrimp
common-shore-shrimp.description: Common shore shrimp are small crustaceans inhabiting the turbulent intertidal zone. They use specialized appendages to cling to rocks and forage among algae and barnacles for food.

antarctic-krill.funFact: Forma enxames de bilhões de indivíduos visíveis do espaço.
antarctic-krill.name: Antarctic Krill
antarctic-krill.description: Antarctic krill are small crustaceans that form the foundation of the Antarctic marine food web. Swarms can contain billions of individuals and are a critical food source for whales, seals, and penguins.

pacific-krill.funFact: É a principal fonte de alimento para baleias-francas-do-Pacífico.
pacific-krill.name: Pacific Krill
pacific-krill.description: Pacific krill are tiny shrimp-like crustaceans that swarm in massive numbers in the North Pacific. They are essential to the marine food web, feeding on phytoplankton and being consumed by larger marine life.

atlantic-krill.funFact: Forma enxames densos que podem se estender por milhas e conter trilhões de indivíduos.
atlantic-krill.name: Atlantic Krill
atlantic-krill.description: Atlantic krill are small pelagic crustaceans found throughout the North Atlantic. They are a keystone species, supporting populations of cod, herring, whales, and numerous seabirds.

giant-amphipod.funFact: Pode crescer até 20 vezes maior que anfípodes típicos.
giant-amphipod.name: Giant Amphipod
giant-amphipod.description: Giant amphipods are deep-sea crustaceans found in ocean trenches up to 10,000 meters deep. Their enormous size compared to shallow-water relatives is an example of deep-sea gigantism.

giant-isopod.funFact: Pode sobreviver até 5 anos sem comer desacelerando seu metabolismo.
giant-isopod.name: Giant Isopod
giant-isopod.description: Giant isopods are deep-sea crustaceans that can grow up to 14 inches long. They are scavengers that feed on whale falls and other organic material that sinks to the ocean floor.

lions-mane-jellyfish.funFact: Tentáculos podem ultrapassar 37 metros, rivalizando com a baleia-azul em comprimento.
lions-mane-jellyfish.name: Lion's Mane Jellyfish
lions-mane-jellyfish.description: The lion's mane jellyfish is the largest known jellyfish species. Its mass of long, trailing tentacles resembles a lion's mane and can extend far beyond its bell diameter.

portuguese-man-of-war.funFact: Na verdade é uma colônia de quatro organismos especializados chamados zooides, não um único animal.
portuguese-man-of-war.name: Portuguese Man-of-War
portuguese-man-of-war.description: The Portuguese man-of-war is a siphonophore, not a true jellyfish. Its iconic blue float sails on the surface while trailing long, venomous tentacles that can deliver an extremely painful sting.

pacific-sea-nettle.funFact: Sua campânula marrom-dourada e longos tentáculos arrastados a tornam uma das águas-vivas mais bonitas.
pacific-sea-nettle.name: Pacific Sea Nettle
pacific-sea-nettle.description: The Pacific sea nettle is a large, visually striking jellyfish with a rusty-orange bell and long, coiling tentacles. It feeds on zooplankton, fish eggs, and other jellyfish.

upside-down-jellyfish.funFact: Repousa de cabeça para baixo no fundo do mar para expor algas simbióticas à luz solar.
upside-down-jellyfish.name: Upside-Down Jellyfish
upside-down-jellyfish.description: The upside-down jellyfish, or Cassiopea, lies bell-down on the substrate to maximize photosynthesis by its symbiotic algae. It pulses gently to circulate water and capture food particles.

immortal-jellyfish.funFact: Pode reverter de sua forma adulta para seu estágio juvenil de pólipo, revertendo efetivamente o envelhecimento.
immortal-jellyfish.name: Immortal Jellyfish
immortal-jellyfish.description: The immortal jellyfish, Turritopsis dohrnii, is biologically immortal. When stressed or aging, it reverts to its polyp form and begins its life cycle anew, making it the only known creature capable of true rejuvenation.

sea-wasp.funFact: Considerado o animal marinho mais venenoso, capaz de matar um humano em minutos.
sea-wasp.name: Sea Wasp
sea-wasp.description: The sea wasp, or Chironex fleckeri, is the largest and most dangerous box jellyfish. Its nearly invisible body and incredibly potent venom make it one of the deadliest creatures in the ocean.

compass-jellyfish.funFact: Possui marcas castanhas em V distintas em sua campânula semelhantes a uma rosa dos ventos.
compass-jellyfish.name: Compass Jellyfish
compass-jellyfish.description: The compass jellyfish is easily identified by the brown radiating lines on its translucent bell that resemble compass markings. It feeds on small fish and other jellyfish.

fried-egg-jellyfish.funFact: Sua campânula se assemelha muito a um ovo frito, com um centro amarelo cercado de branco.
fried-egg-jellyfish.name: Fried Egg Jellyfish
fried-egg-jellyfish.description: The fried egg jellyfish, or Cotylorhiza tuberculata, is a visually striking species with a bell that looks remarkably like a fried egg. Despite its large size, its sting is relatively mild.

blood-belly-comb-jelly.funFact: Produz bioluminescência vermelha brilhante quando perturbado.
blood-belly-comb-jelly.name: Blood Belly Comb Jelly
blood-belly-comb-jelly.description: The blood belly comb jelly is a deep-water ctenophore found in the Mediterranean. When threatened, it produces vivid red bioluminescence, creating a spectacular display in the dark waters.

atolla-jellyfish.funFact: Produz um pinhão de luz bioluminescente quando atacado, conhecido como alarme de ladrão.
atolla-jellyfish.name: Atolla Jellyfish
atolla-jellyfish.description: The Atolla jellyfish inhabits the deep ocean and is famous for its burglar alarm display. When attacked, it produces a rotating wheel of blue bioluminescence to attract larger predators that may attack its attacker.

spotted-jelly.funFact: Possui manchas castanhas distintas em sua campânula translúcida que lhe dão seu nome.
spotted-jelly.name: Spotted Jelly
spotted-jelly.description: The spotted jelly is a rhizostome jellyfish with a translucent bell covered in brown spots. It feeds on plankton and small organisms using oral arms lined with tiny mouth openings.

mauve-stinger.funFact: Pode florescer em enxames massivos que prejudicam operações de pesca e aquicultura.
mauve-stinger.name: Mauve Stinger
mauve-stinger.description: The mauve stinger is a deep-water jellyfish with a distinctive reddish-purple bell covered in nematocyst clusters. It forms massive blooms in open ocean waters.

staghorn-coral.funFact: Pode crescer até 20 cm por ano, tornando-se um dos corais de crescimento mais rápido.
staghorn-coral.name: Staghorn Coral
staghorn-coral.description: Staghorn coral is a critically endangered branching coral species. Once dominant in Caribbean reefs, its populations have declined by over 80% due to disease, bleaching, and predation.

brain-coral.funFact: Pode viver por quase um milênio, tornando-se um dos organismos mais longevos da Terra.
brain-coral.name: Brain Coral
brain-coral.description: Brain coral is named for its spherical shape and the winding grooves on its surface that resemble a human brain. It is a slow-growing but extremely long-lived reef-building species.

elkhorn-coral.funFact: Nomeado por seus ramos largos semelhantes a chifres de alce.
elkhorn-coral.name: Elkhorn Coral
elkhorn-coral.description: Elkhorn coral is a critically endangered species that once formed vast reefs throughout the Caribbean. Its large, branching colonies provide essential habitat for hundreds of reef species.

pillar-coral.funFact: Um dos corais mais raros, sem jovens conhecidos produzidos desde 1998 na Flórida.
pillar-coral.name: Pillar Coral
pillar-coral.description: Pillar coral is one of the rarest reef-building corals, distinguished by its tall, cylindrical columns that rise from the reef. It is listed as critically endangered with populations plummeting.

fire-coral.funFact: Não é um coral verdadeiro, mas uma colônia de hidrozoários que causa uma picada dolorosa.
fire-coral.name: Fire Coral
fire-coral.description: Fire coral is a colony-forming hydrozoan that looks like true coral but delivers a painful sting on contact. Its smooth, branching colonies are typically brown, yellow, or reddish in color.

blue-coral.funFact: O único coral construtor de recife com um esqueleto azul, causado por sais de ferro em seu esqueleto.
blue-coral.name: Blue Coral
blue-coral.description: Blue coral is a unique reef-building species with a distinctive blue skeleton. It is one of the few corals that can survive in turbid, low-light environments where other corals cannot.

mushroom-coral.funFact: Diferente da maioria dos corais, cogumelos-marinhos são livres e podem se mover por curtas distâncias.
mushroom-coral.name: Mushroom Coral
mushroom-coral.description: Mushroom corals are solitary, free-living scleractinian corals shaped like mushrooms. Unlike colonial species, each is a single polyp that can detach and roll across the substrate.

black-coral.funFact: Algumas colônias foram datadas com mais de 4.000 anos, tornando-se os organismos vivos mais antigos da Terra.
black-coral.name: Black Coral
black-coral.description: Black corals are deep-water colonial organisms with a black or dark brown skeleton. They are among the longest-lived organisms on Earth, with some colonies surviving for millennia.

sea-pen.funFact: É uma colônia de pólipos ancorados em sedimentos, com algumas espécies produzindo ondas bioluminescentes quando perturbadas.
sea-pen.name: Sea Pen
sea-pen.description: Sea pens are colonial cnidarians that resemble old-fashioned quill pens. They anchor in soft sediment and can produce bioluminescent waves of light that travel along their colonies.

sea-whip.funFact: Algumas espécies produzem um composto usado em pesquisa contra o câncer.
sea-whip.name: Sea Whip
sea-whip.description: Sea whips are octocoral colonies that grow in long, whip-like branches. They are filter feeders that extend polyps into the current to capture plankton and organic particles.

sunflower-sea-star.funFact: Pode ter até 24 braços e é uma das estrelas-do-mar maiores do mundo.
sunflower-sea-star.name: Sunflower Sea Star
sunflower-sea-star.description: The sunflower sea star is one of the largest and fastest sea stars, but populations have crashed by over 90% due to sea star wasting disease. It is now listed as critically endangered.

crown-of-thorns-starfish.funFact: Pode consumir até 1 metro quadrado de coral por ano.
crown-of-thorns-starfish.name: Crown-of-Thorns Starfish
crown-of-thorns-starfish.description: The crown-of-thorns starfish is a large, multi-armed sea star covered in venomous spines. It is a significant coral predator whose population outbreaks can devastate reef ecosystems.

blue-sea-star.funFact: Sua cor azul brilhante vem de um pigmento que pode proteger contra radiação UV.
blue-sea-star.name: Blue Sea Star
blue-sea-star.description: The blue sea star is a strikingly colored echinoderm that lives on sandy substrates. It feeds on small invertebrates buried in the sand and can regenerate lost arms.

leather-star.funFact: Possui uma textura lisa e courosa, diferente da superfície áspera da maioria das estrelas-do-mar.
leather-star.name: Leather Star
leather-star.description: The leather star is a smooth-skinned sea star found on rocky reefs. It has a distinctive reddish-brown color and a unique garlic-like odor when handled.

common-brittle-star.funFact: Pode destacar um braço para escapar de predadores, regenerando-o depois.
common-brittle-star.name: Common Brittle Star
common-brittle-star.description: Brittle stars are echinoderms with a distinct central disc and five long, slender arms. They are more agile than sea stars, moving by writhing their arms across the seabed.

giant-basket-star.funFact: Possui milhares de pontas de braços ramificados que podem prender plânctons e pequenos organismos.
giant-basket-star.name: Giant Basket Star
giant-basket-star.description: The giant basket star is a spectacular echinoderm with a complex network of branching arms. At night, it unfurls its arms into the current to capture plankton and small crustaceans.

feather-star.funFact: Pode nadar agitando ritmicamente seus braços penosos através da água.
feather-star.name: Feather Star
feather-star.description: Feather stars are mobile crinoids that cling to coral or swim through the water column. Their feathery arms filter plankton from passing currents, and they can detach to relocate when conditions change.

crinoid-feather-star.funFact: Pode se destacar de seu substrato e nadar para se realocar quando as condições são desfavoráveis.
crinoid-feather-star.name: Crinoid Feather Star
crinoid-feather-star.description: Crinoid feather stars are ancient echinoderms related to sea lilies. They perch on coral heads and wave their feathery arms to capture passing plankton from ocean currents.

disk-brittle-star.funFact: Pode regenerar braços inteiros e até o disco central se destacado.
disk-brittle-star.name: Disk-Brittle Star
disk-brittle-star.description: The disk-brittle star is a small, agile echinoderm found in rock crevices and under stones. It is an opportunistic feeder that can regenerate lost body parts rapidly.

purple-sea-urchin.funFact: Pode perfurar rocha sólida usando seu aparelho de mandíbula especializado chamado lanternas de Aristóteles.
purple-sea-urchin.name: Purple Sea Urchin
purple-sea-urchin.description: The purple sea urchin is a spiny echinoderm that inhabits rocky shores. It uses its five-toothed jaw, Aristotle's lantern, to scrape algae and even excavate burrows in solid rock.

long-spined-sea-urchin.funFact: Espinhos podem ter mais de 30 cm de comprimento e são levemente venenosos.
long-spined-sea-urchin.name: Long-Spined Sea Urchin
long-spined-sea-urchin.description: Long-spined sea urchins are tropical echinoderms with extremely long, sharp spines that provide excellent defense. They play a critical role in controlling algal growth on coral reefs.

pencil-urchin.funFact: Possui espinhos grossos e rombudos que se assemelham a lápis, diferente dos espinhos pontiagudos típicos de ouriços.
pencil-urchin.name: Pencil Urchin
pencil-urchin.description: Pencil urchins are named for their thick, cylindrical spines that look like colored pencils. They inhabit tropical reefs where they graze on algae using their complex jaw apparatus.

green-sea-urchin.funFact: Pode viver mais de 30 anos, tornando-se um dos ouriços-do-mar mais longevos.
green-sea-urchin.name: Green Sea Urchin
green-sea-urchin.description: The green sea urchin is a cold-water species found on rocky substrates. It is an important herbivore in kelp forest ecosystems, controlling algal growth and providing food for sea otters.

flower-urchin.funFact: Coberto por estruturas semelhantes a flores chamadas pedicelários que causam uma picada dolorosa.
flower-urchin.name: Flower Urchin
flower-urchin.description: The flower urchin is one of the most dangerous sea urchins, covered in venomous flower-shaped pedicellariae. Despite its beautiful appearance, contact causes intense pain and potential tissue damage.

sand-dollar.funFact: O padrão semelhante a pétalas em seu esqueleto são na verdade cinco conjuntos de pés tubulares usados para respiração.
sand-dollar.name: Sand Dollar
sand-dollar.description: Sand dollars are flat, burrowing sea urchins found on sandy ocean floors. Their flattened bodies and fine spines allow them to bury themselves just beneath the sediment surface.

carpenter-sea-urchin.funFact: Possui dentes particularmente fortes que podem perfurar coral rochoso sólido.
carpenter-sea-urchin.name: Carpenter Sea Urchin
carpenter-sea-urchin.description: The carpenter sea urchin is named for its ability to excavate burrows in solid coral rock. Its powerful Aristotle's lantern allows it to bore into reef substrates for shelter.

fire-urchin.funFact: Possui espinhos venenosos que causam ardência intensa, semelhante à picada de formiga-de-fogo.
fire-urchin.name: Fire Urchin
fire-urchin.description: The fire urchin is a striking red echinoderm with venomous spines that deliver an intensely painful sting. Despite its danger, it provides a symbiotic home for certain shrimp and crabs.

slate-pencil-urchin.funFact: Possui espinhos grossos e rombudos que historicamente foram usados como instrumentos de escrita.
slate-pencil-urchin.name: Slate Pencil Urchin
slate-pencil-urchin.description: Slate pencil urchins are named for their thick, blunt spines that resemble slate pencils. These colorful echinoderms inhabit tropical reefs where they graze on algae.

tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.funFact: Pode ejetar tubos pegajosos e tóxicos de seu corpo para prender predadores.
tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.name: Tiger Tail Sea Cucumber
tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.description: The tiger tail sea cucumber is a large, conspicuous species with distinctive dark stripes. It is an important bioturbator, processing sediment and recycling nutrients in tropical marine ecosystems.

lolly-sea-cucumber.funFact: Possui uma forma corporal tubular distinta que se assemelha a um pirulito.
lolly-sea-cucumber.name: Lolly Sea Cucumber
lolly-sea-cucumber.description: The lolly sea cucumber is a small, cylindrical species that processes sand and sediment on tropical reefs. It plays a vital role in reef health by recycling organic matter.

pacific-sea-cucumber.funFact: É colhido comercialmente como iguaria na culinária asiática, conhecido como beche-de-mer.
pacific-sea-cucumber.name: Pacific Sea Cucumber
pacific-sea-cucumber.description: The Pacific sea cucumber is an ecologically important detritivore that processes vast quantities of sediment. It is commercially harvested and considered a culinary delicacy in many Asian cultures.

black-sea-cucumber.funFact: Pode destacar e regenerar seus órgãos internos quando estressado, um processo chamado evisceração.
black-sea-cucumber.name: Black Sea Cucumber
black-sea-cucumber.description: The black sea cucumber is a large, commercially valuable species found on tropical reefs. It ejects its internal organs as a defense mechanism and later regenerates them completely.

teatfish-sea-cucumber.funFact: Uma das espécies de pepino-do-mar mais valiosas comercialmente, vendido como beche-de-mer.
teatfish-sea-cucumber.name: Teatfish Sea Cucumber
teatfish-sea-cucumber.description: The teatfish is a large, highly valued sea cucumber that has been overexploited for the Asian beche-de-mer trade. Its distinctive nipple-like projections give it its common name.

red-sea-cucumber.funFact: Usa pés tubulares ao longo de sua parte inferior para rastejar lentamente pelo fundo do mar.
red-sea-cucumber.name: Red Sea Cucumber
red-sea-cucumber.description: The red sea cucumber is a common species in Pacific kelp forests. It grazes on detritus and algae on rocky substrates, playing an important role in nutrient cycling.

christmas-tree-worm.funFact: Pode retrair suas plumas coloridas em espiral para dentro de seu tubo em menos de um segundo.
christmas-tree-worm.name: Christmas Tree Worm
christmas-tree-worm.description: Christmas tree worms are tubeworms that burrow into living coral colonies. Their colorful, spiral-shaped radioles filter plankton from the water and can retract instantly when disturbed.

giant-tubeworm.funFact: Não possui boca, estômago ou intestino, dependendo inteiramente de bactérias simbióticas para nutrição.
giant-tubeworm.name: Giant Tube Worm
giant-tubeworm.description: Giant tube worms are extraordinary deep-sea organisms that thrive at hydrothermal vents. They rely on chemosynthetic bacteria housed in a special organ called the trophosome for all nutrition.

feather-duster-worm.funFact: Sua coroa penosa de tentáculos é usada tanto para alimentação quanto para respiração.
feather-duster-worm.name: Feather Duster Worm
feather-duster-worm.description: Feather duster worms are sedentary polychaetes that construct tubes on reef surfaces. Their spectacular crown of feathery tentacles filters plankton and can retract rapidly when threatened.

bearded-fireworm.funFact: Possui cerdas ocas cheias de veneno que causam ardência intensa ao contato.
bearded-fireworm.name: Bearded Fireworm
bearded-fireworm.description: The bearded fireworm is a predatory polychaete with venomous bristles called chaetae. Contact with these white, hair-like structures causes severe pain, inflammation, and numbness.

blue-glaucus.funFact: Flutua de cabeça para baixo na tensão superficial da água, usando bolhas de ar armazenadas.
blue-glaucus.name: Blue Glaucus
blue-glaucus.description: The blue glaucus, or blue dragon, is a tiny, vibrant blue sea slug that floats upside-down on the ocean surface. It stores stinging cells from its prey for its own defense.

spanish-dancer.funFact: Nomeado por seu espetacular movimento ondulante de natação que se assemelha a uma bailarina flamenga.
spanish-dancer.name: Spanish Dancer
spanish-dancer.description: The Spanish dancer is one of the largest and most colorful nudibranchs. When swimming, it unfurls its brilliant red and white mantle in a mesmerizing undulating display.

leaf-sheep.funFact: É um dos poucos animais capazes de fotossíntese, roubando cloroplastos de algas.
leaf-sheep.name: Leaf Sheep
leaf-sheep.description: The leaf sheep, or Costasiella kuroshimae, is a tiny sea slug that can photosynthesize like a plant. It steals chloroplasts from the algae it eats and stores them in its body to produce energy.

sea-butterfly.funFact: Nada batendo suas extensões de concha semelhantes a asas, assemelhando-se a uma borboleta em voo.
sea-butterfly.name: Sea Butterfly
sea-butterfly.description: Sea butterflies are tiny marine snails that swim through the open ocean by flapping their wing-like shell extensions. They are an important food source for fish, whales, and seabirds.

sea-angel.funFact: É um caracol sem concha que nada com movimentos graciosos semelhantes a asas.
sea-angel.name: Sea Angel
sea-angel.description: Sea angels are gelatinous, transparent marine gastropods that lack shells. They swim through cold ocean waters by flapping wing-like appendages and prey on sea butterflies.

sea-hare.funFact: Pode liberar uma nuvem de tinta roxa quando ameaçado, confundindo predadores.
sea-hare.name: California Sea Hare
sea-hare.description: The California sea hare is a large marine gastropod named for its ear-like rhinophores. It feeds on kelp and seaweed and can release a cloud of purple ink as a defense mechanism.

giant-clam.funFact: Pode pesar mais de 225 kg e viver por mais de 100 anos.
giant-clam.name: Giant Clam
giant-clam.description: The giant clam is the largest living bivalve mollusk, reaching over four feet in length. Its colorful mantle harbors symbiotic algae that provide much of its nutrition through photosynthesis.

geoduck.funFact: Pode viver por mais de 160 anos, tornando-se um dos animais mais longevos da Terra.
geoduck.name: Geoduck
geoduck.description: The geoduck is the largest burrowing clam in the world, with a siphon that can extend three feet. Native to the Pacific Northwest, it is a prized delicacy in Asian cuisine.

atlantic-surf-clam.funFact: Pode se projetar para fora da areia usando seu pé muscular quando perturbado.
atlantic-surf-clam.name: Atlantic Surf Clam
atlantic-surf-clam.description: The Atlantic surf clam is a large bivalve found on sandy substrates. It uses its powerful foot to burrow and can explosively eject itself from the sand when threatened by predators.

bay-scallop.funFact: Pode nadar por curtas distâncias batendo rapidamente suas valvas de concha.
bay-scallop.name: Bay Scallop
bay-scallop.description: Bay scallops are small, fan-shaped bivalves that live in shallow coastal waters. Unlike most clams, they can swim by rapidly clapping their valves, ejecting water for propulsion.

blue-mussel.funFact: Se fixa em rochas usando filamentos bisseiros fortes, formando leitos densos de milhares.
blue-mussel.name: Blue Mussel
blue-mussel.description: Blue mussels are filter-feeding bivalves that attach to rocks with strong byssal threads. They form dense beds that provide habitat for numerous other species and are commercially cultivated.

thorny-oyster.funFact: Concha coberta por espinhos longos e afiados que afastam predadores.
thorny-oyster.name: Thorny Oyster
thorny-oyster.description: The thorny oyster is a large, spiny bivalve that cements itself to reef substrates. Its long, sharp spines protect it from predators and can cause painful wounds if touched.

lion-paw-scallop.funFact: Nomeado por sua concha colorida e carenada que se assemelha a uma pata de leão.
lion-paw-scallop.name: Lion Paw Scallop
lion-paw-scallop.description: The lion paw scallop is a large, colorful bivalve with a distinctive ridged shell. It can swim by clapping its valves and is found in kelp forests along the Pacific coast.
