nautilus-pompilius.funFact: Concha segue uma espiral logarítmica, uma das formas matemáticas mais perfeitas da natureza.
nautilus-pompilius.name: Nautilus Pompilius
nautilus-pompilius.description: Nautilus pompilius is a cephalopod with a beautiful, spiraled shell that has inspired artists and mathematicians for centuries. It is a living fossil, virtually unchanged for 500 million years.

paper-nautilus.funFact: Fêmeas criam uma concha delicada e fina como papel para proteção dos ovos.
paper-nautilus.name: Paper Nautilus
paper-nautilus.description: The paper nautilus is an argonaut octopus in which only females produce a fragile, calcareous shell. Males are much smaller and shell-less, using a specialized arm to transfer sperm.

atlantic-horseshoe-crab.funFact: Permaneceu virtualmente inalterado por 450 milhões de anos, anterior aos dinossauros.
atlantic-horseshoe-crab.name: Atlantic Horseshoe Crab
atlantic-horseshoe-crab.description: The Atlantic horseshoe crab is a marine arthropod often called a living fossil. Despite its name, it is more closely related to spiders and scorpions than to true crabs.

japanese-horseshoe-crab.funFact: Seu sangue azul contém Lisado de Amebócitos de Limulus, usado para testar contaminação bacteriana em equipamentos médicos.
japanese-horseshoe-crab.name: Japanese Horseshoe Crab
japanese-horseshoe-crab.description: The Japanese horseshoe crab is an endangered species whose unique blue blood is vital to modern medicine. The substance in its blood detects bacterial endotoxins in pharmaceuticals and medical devices.

indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.funFact: É a única espécie de caranguejo-ferradura encontrada nas águas costeiras asiáticas.
indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.name: Indo-Pacific Horseshoe Crab
indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.description: The Indo-Pacific horseshoe crab is an endangered marine arthropod found in Southeast Asian coastal waters. Like its Atlantic relative, it has blue blood containing valuable immune cells.

sea-squirt-tunicate.funFact: É mais intimamente relacionado a vertebrados que a maioria dos invertebrados, sendo um cordado.
sea-squirt-tunicate.name: Sea Squirt
sea-squirt-tunicate.description: Sea squirts are tunicates, marine invertebrates that are surprisingly closely related to vertebrates. As larvae they have a notochord, which they lose as adults when they attach to surfaces and become filter feeders.

marine-flatworm.funFact: Pode regenerar um organismo inteiro a partir de um fragmento tão pequeno quanto 1/200 de seu corpo.
marine-flatworm.name: Marine Flatworm
marine-flatworm.description: Marine flatworms are colorful, soft-bodied invertebrates that glide across reef surfaces. Despite their simple appearance, they are active predators that can deliver venomous bites.

sea-pen-glow.funFact: Produz ondas bioluminescentes que viajam ao longo de sua colônia quando fisicamente perturbado.
sea-pen-glow.name: Deep-Sea Pennatula
sea-pen-glow.description: The deep-sea pennatula is a species of sea pen that inhabits deep muddy bottoms. When disturbed, it produces stunning bioluminescent waves that ripple along its colony.

dodo.funFact: O dodô era uma ave voadora de Maurício que se extinguiu no final do século XVII devido à caça e espécies invasoras.
dodo.name: Dodo
dodo.description: The dodo was a large, flightless bird native to the island of Mauritius in the Indian Ocean. It was related to pigeons and doves but evolved to be completely flightless with no natural predators.

woolly-mammoth.funFact: Mamutes lanudos coexistiram com humanos primitivos e seus restos ainda são encontrados congelados no permafrost siberiano.
woolly-mammoth.name: Woolly Mammoth
woolly-mammoth.description: The woolly mammoth was a species of elephant covered in thick fur that lived during the Pleistocene epoch. They roamed the cold tundra regions of North America, Europe, and Asia.

passenger-pigeon.funFact: Pombos-passageiros já foram bilhões e seus bandos escureciam o céu por horas enquanto voavam acima.
passenger-pigeon.name: Passenger Pigeon
passenger-pigeon.description: The passenger pigeon was once the most abundant bird in North America, with flocks containing billions of individuals. Systematic hunting and habitat destruction led to its extinction in 1914.

tasmanian-tiger.funFact: Apesar de ser chamado de tigre, era na verdade um marsupial mais relacionado com cangurus do que com grandes gatos.
tasmanian-tiger.name: Tasmanian Tiger
tasmanian-tiger.description: The Tasmanian tiger, or thylacine, was a carnivorous marsupial native to Tasmania, Australia, and New Guinea. The last known individual died in captivity in 1936.

quagga.funFact: O quagga era meio zebra, meio cavalo com listras apenas na metade frontal do corpo. O último morreu em 1883.
quagga.name: Quagga
quagga.description: The quagga was a subspecies of plains zebra that lived in South Africa. It was distinguished by its limited striping pattern, with stripes only on the head and front body.

pig.name: Pig
pig.description: The domestic pig is a stout-bodied farm animal raised worldwide for meat and known for its intelligence and social nature.
pig.funFact: Pigs are highly intelligent and can learn tricks like dogs

sheep.name: Sheep
sheep.description: Sheep are woolly ruminants raised for wool, meat and milk, known for flocking behavior.
sheep.funFact: Sheep can recognize up to 50 faces for years

goat.name: Goat
goat.description: Goats are hardy farm animals known for climbing and curiosity, raised for milk, meat and fiber.
goat.funFact: Goats have rectangular pupils for wide vision

horse.name: Horse
horse.description: The horse is a large domesticated hoofed mammal used for riding, work and sport.
horse.funFact: Horses can sleep both standing and lying down

donkey.name: Donkey
donkey.description: Donkeys are sturdy equids used as working animals, known for endurance and strong memory.
donkey.funFact: Donkeys have incredible memory and remember places for 25 years

chicken.name: Chicken
chicken.description: Chickens are domesticated fowl raised for eggs and meat, the most numerous bird on Earth.

duck.name: Duck
duck.description: Ducks are waterfowl raised on farms and found wild on ponds and rivers.
duck.funFact: Duck feathers are waterproof due to oil coating

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.description: Turkeys are large North American game birds domesticated for meat.
turkey.funFact: Turkeys can change head color with mood

alpaca.name: Alpaca
alpaca.description: Alpacas are South American camelids raised for soft fleece, similar to llamas but smaller.
alpaca.funFact: Alpaca fleece is 3x warmer than sheep wool

llama.name: Llama
llama.description: Llamas are domesticated camelids from the Andes used as pack animals and for wool.
llama.funFact: Llamas hum to communicate with each other

unicorn.name: Unicorn
unicorn.description: The unicorn is a legendary horse-like creature with a single spiraled horn, symbol of purity and magic.
unicorn.funFact: Unicorn horns were said to purify poisoned water

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.description: Dragons are legendary giant reptiles with wings and fire breath, guardians of treasure in folklore.
dragon.funFact: Dragons were said to hoard gold and breathe fire

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.description: The phoenix is a mythical fire bird that cyclically regenerates by rising from its ashes.
phoenix.funFact: The phoenix rises from its own ashes every 500 years

griffin.name: Griffin
griffin.description: The griffin has the body of a lion and head and wings of an eagle, a majestic guardian beast.
griffin.funFact: Griffins were said to guard gold mines

pegasus.name: Pegasus
pegasus.description: Pegasus is a winged horse of Greek mythology, born from Medusa and symbol of inspiration.
pegasus.funFact: Pegasus was born from Medusa's blood

mermaid.name: Mermaid
mermaid.description: Mermaids are half-human, half-fish beings who lure sailors with enchanting songs.
mermaid.funFact: Mermaid tears were believed to be pearls

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.description: The Kraken is a colossal sea monster resembling a giant squid, feared by sailors.
kraken.funFact: The Kraken was said to drag entire ships underwater

fairy.name: Fairy
fairy.description: Fairies are tiny winged folk who live in forests and use magic to protect nature.
fairy.funFact: Fairies were said to be 6 inches tall

t-rex.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
t-rex.description: Tyrannosaurus rex was a massive predatory dinosaur of the Late Cretaceous with tiny arms and powerful jaws.
t-rex.funFact: T-Rex had the strongest bite of any terrestrial animal

triceratops.name: Triceratops
triceratops.description: Triceratops was a horned dinosaur with three facial horns and a large frill for defense.
triceratops.funFact: Triceratops had three horns and a bony frill

stegosaurus.name: Stegosaurus
stegosaurus.description: Stegosaurus had distinctive kite-shaped plates along its back and spiked tail.
stegosaurus.funFact: Stegosaurus had a brain the size of a dog's

velociraptor.name: Velociraptor
velociraptor.description: Velociraptor was a feathered predatory dinosaur that hunted in packs.
velociraptor.funFact: Velociraptor was actually turkey-sized, not 2m tall

brachiosaurus.name: Brachiosaurus
brachiosaurus.description: Brachiosaurus was a giant long-necked sauropod that could reach high treetops.
brachiosaurus.funFact: Brachiosaurus was as tall as a 4-story building

pterodactyl.name: Pterodactyl
pterodactyl.description: Pterodactylus was a flying reptile with a wingspan up to 1m that soared over coasts.
pterodactyl.funFact: Pterodactyls were not dinosaurs but flying reptiles

ankylosaurus.name: Ankylosaurus
ankylosaurus.description: Ankylosaurus was an armored dinosaur covered in bony plates with a massive tail club.
ankylosaurus.funFact: Ankylosaurus had a club tail that could break T-Rex bones

brontosaurus.name: Brontosaurus
brontosaurus.description: Brontosaurus was a massive sauropod long thought to be Apatosaurus but now recognized again.

saber-toothed-tiger.name: Saber-Toothed Tiger
saber-toothed-tiger.description: Smilodon, the saber-toothed cat, had enormous curved canines for slashing prey.

hydra.name: Hydra
hydra.description: The Hydra is a multi-headed serpent of Greek myth slain by Heracles.
hydra.funFact: Cutting one head makes two more grow

cerberus.name: Cerberus
cerberus.description: Cerberus is the three-headed dog that guards the entrance to the Greek underworld.
cerberus.funFact: Cerberus guarded the gates of the Underworld

minotaur.name: Minotaur
minotaur.description: The Minotaur is half-man, half-bull imprisoned in the Cretan labyrinth.
minotaur.funFact: The Minotaur lived in a labyrinth on Crete

basilisk.name: Basilisk
basilisk.description: The basilisk is a legendary serpent king whose glance is lethal.
basilisk.funFact: Basilisk gaze could turn victims to stone

leviathan.name: Leviathan
leviathan.description: Leviathan is a colossal sea serpent of Hebrew mythology embodying chaos of the ocean.
leviathan.funFact: Leviathan could create whirlpools that sank ships

thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
thunderbird.description: The Thunderbird is a giant legendary bird of Native American lore that creates thunder.
thunderbird.funFact: Thunderbird wings were said to create thunder

kitsune.name: Kitsune
kitsune.description: Kitsune are nine-tailed fox spirits in Japanese folklore, shape-shifters of great magic.
kitsune.funFact: Kitsune gains a tail every 100 years, up to nine

nessie.name: Loch Ness Monster
nessie.description: Nessie is the legendary long-necked creature said to inhabit Scotland's Loch Ness.
nessie.funFact: First sighting of Nessie was in 565 AD

lop-rabbit.name: Lop Rabbit
lop-rabbit.description: Lop rabbits are domestic bunnies with long floppy ears, beloved as gentle pets.
lop-rabbit.funFact: Lop rabbits' ears flop due to a genetic mutation

persian-cat.name: Persian Cat
persian-cat.description: Persian cats are fluffy long-haired cats with flat faces, known for calm temperament.
persian-cat.funFact: Persian cats are one of the oldest cat breeds

corgi.name: Corgi
corgi.description: Corgis are short-legged Welsh herding dogs famous for cute looks and loyalty.
corgi.funFact: Corgis were herding dogs despite short legs

baby-otter.name: Baby Otter
baby-otter.description: Baby otters are incredibly cute pups that hold hands while sleeping to not drift apart.
baby-otter.funFact: Baby otters cannot swim at birth and must be taught

pika-cute.name: Pika
pika-cute.description: Pikas are tiny mountain hamster-like mammals that make hay piles for winter.
pika-cute.funFact: Pikas say 'meh' and collect tiny haystacks

fennec-cute.name: Fennec Fox
fennec-cute.description: Fennec foxes are desert foxes with enormous ears, often called the cutest fox.
fennec-cute.funFact: Fennec fox kits have oversized ears like their parents

quokka-cute.name: Quokka
quokka-cute.description: Quokkas are small marsupials from Australia famous for selfies and smiles.
quokka-cute.funFact: Quokkas always look like they are smiling

axolotl-cute.name: Axolotl
axolotl-cute.description: Axolotls are cute neotenic salamanders that keep external gills and smile.
axolotl-cute.funFact: Axolotls can regenerate their hearts and brains

hedgehog-cute.name: Hedgehog
hedgehog-cute.description: Hedgehogs are small spiny mammals that curl up when scared, adored for cuteness.
hedgehog-cute.funFact: Hedgehogs have 5000 spines and curl into a ball

sugar-glider-cute.name: Sugar Glider
sugar-glider-cute.description: Sugar gliders are tiny marsupials with a membrane that lets them glide, big-eyed and cute.
sugar-glider-cute.funFact: Sugar gliders can glide 50 meters between trees

centaur.name: Centaur
centaur.description: The centaur is half-human, half-horse, known for wisdom and archery in Greek mythology.
centaur.funFact: Centaurs were expert archers and healers

satyr.name: Satyr
satyr.description: Satyrs are half-goat, half-human forest spirits who love music and revelry.
satyr.funFact: Satyrs played flutes that enchanted travelers

wyvern.name: Wyvern
wyvern.description: The wyvern is a winged dragon with two legs and a barbed tail, often guarding castles.
wyvern.funFact: Wyverns have two legs unlike four-legged dragons

djinn.name: Djinn
djinn.description: Djinn are magical smoke-formed beings from Arabian lore who inhabit deserts and grant wishes.
djinn.funFact: Djinn were said to grant three wishes

golem.name: Golem
golem.description: The golem is a clay giant brought to life by Hebrew magic to protect its creator.
golem.funFact: Golems are animated by a word on their forehead

banshee.name: Banshee
banshee.description: The banshee is a wailing female spirit from Irish folklore whose cry warns of death.
banshee.funFact: Hearing a banshee wail foretold death

leprechaun.name: Leprechaun
leprechaun.description: Leprechauns are tiny shoemaking fairies from Irish myth who hide pots of gold.
leprechaun.funFact: Leprechauns hide gold at the end of rainbows

nymph.name: Nymph
nymph.description: Nymphs are nature spirits inhabiting rivers, trees and mountains in Greek lore.
nymph.funFact: Nymphs could live inside trees or rivers

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.description: The werewolf is a human cursed to become a wolf under the full moon.

yeti.name: Yeti
yeti.description: The Yeti, or Abominable Snowman, is a giant ape-like cryptid of the Himalayas.
yeti.funFact: Yeti footprints can be 45 cm long

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.description: Goblins are small, clever, green-skinned tricksters living in caves and mines.
goblin.funFact: Goblins were master miners and craftsmen

troll.name: Troll
troll.description: Trolls are giant, slow-witted brutes who live under bridges and mountains.
troll.funFact: Trolls turn to stone in sunlight

roc.name: Roc
roc.description: The Roc is a gigantic bird of Arabian myth so large it can carry elephants.
roc.funFact: Roc eggs were said to be 15 meters around

sphinx.name: Sphinx
sphinx.description: The Sphinx has a lion's body, human head and eagle wings, guardian of riddles.
sphinx.funFact: The Sphinx asked riddles to travelers

chimera.name: Chimera
chimera.description: The Chimera is a fire-breathing hybrid of lion, goat and serpent from Greek myth.
chimera.funFact: Chimera had a lion head, goat body and snake tail

siren.name: Siren
siren.description: Sirens are enchanting half-bird, half-women whose songs doom sailors.
siren.funFact: Sirens lured sailors to shipwreck with songs

harpy.name: Harpy
harpy.description: The Harpy is half-woman, half-bird, a swift wind spirit that steals offerings.
harpy.funFact: Harpies were winds spirits that snatched souls

garuda.name: Garuda
garuda.description: Garuda is a giant eagle-like deity, mount of Vishnu and enemy of serpents.
garuda.funFact: Garuda is the king of birds in Hindu myth

qilin.name: Qilin
qilin.description: The Qilin is a gentle Chinese unicorn-deer with dragon scales that brings good fortune.
qilin.funFact: Qilin appears only during peaceful reigns

fenrir.name: Fenrir
fenrir.description: Fenrir is the monstrous wolf of Norse myth destined to devour Odin at Ragnarok.
fenrir.funFact: Fenrir was chained by the gods with magic ribbon

jormungandr.name: Jörmungandr
jormungandr.description: Jörmungandr is the World Serpent of Norse myth, so huge it bites its own tail around Earth.

cyclops.name: Cyclops
cyclops.description: The Cyclops is a one-eyed giant blacksmith of Greek myth who forged divine weapons.

medusa.name: Medusa
medusa.description: Medusa is a Gorgon with snakes for hair whose gaze petrifies victims.
medusa.funFact: Medusa's gaze turned people to stone

anubis.name: Anubis
anubis.description: Anubis is the jackal-headed Egyptian god who guides souls to the afterlife.
anubis.funFact: Anubis weighed hearts against a feather

allosaurus.name: Allosaurus
allosaurus.description: Allosaurus was the top predator of Jurassic North America before T. rex.
allosaurus.funFact: Allosaurus had 32 teeth shaped like steak knives

spinosaurus.name: Spinosaurus
spinosaurus.description: Spinosaurus was a semi-aquatic fish-eating dinosaur larger than T. rex with a distinctive sail.
spinosaurus.funFact: Spinosaurus had a sail 1.8m tall on its back

diplodocus.name: Diplodocus
diplodocus.description: Diplodocus was an extremely long-necked sauropod with a whip-like tail.
diplodocus.funFact: Diplodocus had a tail with 80 vertebrae

parasaurolophus.name: Parasaurolophus
parasaurolophus.description: Parasaurolophus was a crested hadrosaur that could make loud calls through its hollow crest.
parasaurolophus.funFact: Its crest acted like a trumpet

iguanodon.name: Iguanodon
iguanodon.description: Iguanodon was one of the first dinosaurs discovered, with distinctive thumb spikes.
iguanodon.funFact: Iguanodon had thumb spikes for defense

archaeopteryx.name: Archaeopteryx
archaeopteryx.description: Archaeopteryx was a feathered dinosaur-bird that could glide between trees 150 million years ago.
archaeopteryx.funFact: Archaeopteryx is the earliest known bird

mosasaurus.name: Mosasaurus
mosasaurus.description: Mosasaurus was a giant marine reptile that ruled Late Cretaceous seas.
mosasaurus.funFact: Mosasaurus had double-hinged jaws like a snake

plesiosaurus.name: Plesiosaurus
plesiosaurus.description: Plesiosaurus was a long-necked marine reptile that swam with four powerful flippers.
plesiosaurus.funFact: Plesiosaurus had four flippers and a long neck

dimetrodon.name: Dimetrodon
dimetrodon.description: Dimetrodon was a sail-backed synapsid predator that lived 40 million years before T. rex.

woolly-rhino.name: Woolly Rhino
woolly-rhino.description: The woolly rhinoceros was a shaggy-coated rhino that roamed Ice Age Eurasia alongside mammoths.

irish-elk.name: Irish Elk
irish-elk.description: Irish Elk was the largest deer ever, with enormous antlers that spanned over 3 meters.

dire-wolf.name: Dire Wolf
dire-wolf.description: Dire Wolf was a large Ice Age wolf that hunted in packs across North America.
dire-wolf.funFact: Dire wolves were 30% heavier than gray wolves

painted-frog.name: 물방개
painted-frog.description: 물방개는 지중해 지역에 서식하는 중형 개구리입니다.
painted-frog.funFact: 물방개는 기수(염수)를 견딜 수 있으며 때때로 해안 서식지에서 발견됩니다.

african-elephant.name: 아프리카코끼리
african-elephant.description: 아프리카코끼리는现存する最大的陆上動物です。

lion.name: 사자
lion.description: 사자는 사회적 그룹으로 생활하는 유일한 고양이과입니다.

giraffe.name: 기린
giraffe.description: 기린은现存する最高的陆上動物です。
giraffe.funFact: 지구상에서 가장 키가 큰 육상 동물입니다.

asian-elephant.name: 아시아코끼리
asian-elephant.description: The Asian elephant is smaller than its African cousin, with smaller ears and a more domed head.
asian-elephant.funFact: 아프리카 사촌보다 작은 귀와 더 둥근 머리를 가지고 있습니다.

white-rhinoceros.name: 흰코뿔소
white-rhinoceros.description: The white rhinoceros is the largest of the five rhino species, known for its wide mouth adapted for grazing.
white-rhinoceros.funFact: 코뿔소 다섯 종 중 가장 큰 종으로, 방목에 적응한 넓은 입으로 유명합니다.

black-rhinoceros.name: 검은코뿔소
black-rhinoceros.description: The black rhinoceros is a browser with a hooked upper lip, known for its aggressive temperament.
black-rhinoceros.funFact: 갈고리 모양의 윗입술을 가진 초식동물로, 공격적인 성격으로 유명합니다.

hippopotamus.name: 하마
hippopotamus.description: The hippopotamus is a large semi-aquatic mammal that spends most of its day in water to keep cool.
hippopotamus.funFact: 체온을 유지하기 위해 하루 대부분을 물속에서 보내는大型 반수생 포유류입니다.

cape-buffalo.name: 카프버팔로
cape-buffalo.description: The Cape buffalo is a large bovid known for its unpredictable nature and massive curved horns.
cape-buffalo.funFact: 예측 불가능한 성격과 거대한 곡면 뿔로 유명한大型 소과 동물입니다.

american-bison.name: 미국들소
american-bison.description: The American bison is the largest land mammal in North America, once roaming the Great Plains in massive herds.
american-bison.funFact: 북미에서 가장 큰 육상 포유류로, 한때 거대한 떼를 이루고 대평원을 배회했습니다.

water-buffalo.name: 물소
water-buffalo.description: The water buffalo is a large bovid widely used in agriculture throughout Asia.
water-buffalo.funFact: 아시아 전역에서 농업에 널리 사용되는大型 소과 동물입니다.

leopard.name: 표범
leopard.description: The leopard is a powerful, agile big cat known for its rosette-patterned coat.
leopard.funFact: 장미꽃 무늬 무늬의 털로 유명한 강력하고 민첩한大型 고양이과 동물입니다.

snow-leopard.name: 눈표범
snow-leopard.description: The snow leopard is a solitary big cat adapted to life in cold, mountainous regions of Central Asia.
snow-leopard.funFact: 중앙아시아의 추운 산악 지역에서 생활하도록 적응한 고독한大型 고양이과 동물입니다.

jaguar.name: 재규어
jaguar.description: The jaguar is a stocky, muscular cat with a powerful bite, capable of piercing turtle shells.
jaguar.funFact: 거북이 껍데기를 뚫을 수 있는 강력한 힘을 가진 뚱뚱하고 근육질의 고양이과 동물입니다.

cougar.name: 퓨마
cougar.description: The cougar is a large cat native to the Americas, known by many names including puma and mountain lion.
cougar.funFact: 퓨마, 산사자 등 여러 이름으로 불리는 아메리카 대륙이 원산지인 큰 고양이과 동물입니다.

brown-bear.name: 갈곰
brown-bear.description: The brown bear is one of the largest bear species, found across North America, Europe, and Asia.
brown-bear.funFact: 북미, 유럽, 아시아 전역에 분포하는 가장 큰 곰 종 중 하나입니다.

grizzly-bear.name: 그리즐리곰
grizzly-bear.description: The grizzly bear is a North American subspecies of brown bear, known for its distinctive shoulder hump.
grizzly-bear.funFact: 어깨의 특징적인 융기로 유명한 북미산 갈곰의 아종입니다.

polar-bear.name: 북극곰
polar-bear.description: The polar bear is a large bear native to the Arctic, adapted to life on sea ice.
polar-bear.funFact: 북극이 원산지인 큰 곰으로, 해빙에서의 생활에 적응했습니다.

giant-panda.name: 자이언트판다
giant-panda.description: The giant panda is a bear native to China, famous for its black and white coloring and bamboo diet.
giant-panda.funFact: 중국이 원산지인 곰으로, 흑백 색상과 대나무 식단으로 유명합니다.

gray-wolf.name: 늑대
gray-wolf.description: The gray wolf is the largest wild member of the canine family, living in packs.
gray-wolf.funFact: 무리를 지어 생활하는 개과에서 가장 큰 야생 구성원입니다.

red-fox.name: 붉여여우
red-fox.description: The red fox is the largest true fox, found across the entire Northern Hemisphere.
red-fox.funFact: 북반구 전역에 분포하는 가장 큰 여우입니다.

fennec-fox.name: 페넥여우
fennec-fox.description: The fennec fox is the smallest fox, with enormous ears that help regulate body temperature.
fennec-fox.funFact: 체온 조절에 도움을 주는 거대한 귀를 가진 가장 작은 여우입니다.

arctic-fox.name: 북극여우
arctic-fox.description: The Arctic fox has a white coat in winter and brown in summer for camouflage.
arctic-fox.funFact: 겨울에는 흰 털을, 여름에는 갈색 털을 가지고 위장합니다.

coyote.name: 코요태
coyote.description: The coyote is a highly adaptable canid found throughout North America.
coyote.funFact: 북미 전역에 분포하는 매우 적응력이 뛰어난 개과 동물입니다.

dingo.name: 디ン고
dingo.description: The dingo is a wild dog found in Australia, believed to have arrived with humans 4000 years ago.
dingo.funFact: 호주에서 발견되는 야생 개로, 4000년 전 인간과 함께 도착한 것으로 추정됩니다.

chimpanzee.name: 침팬지
chimpanzee.description: The chimpanzee is our closest living relative, sharing about 98% of our DNA.
chimpanzee.funFact: 우리 DNA의 약 98%를 공유하는 가장 가까운 친척입니다.

orangutan.name: 오랑우탄
orangutan.description: Orangutans are highly intelligent great apes that spend most of their time in trees.
orangutan.funFact: 나무에서 대부분의 시간을 보내는 매우 지능적인 영장류입니다.

blue-whale.name: 흰긴수염고래
blue-whale.description: The blue whale is the largest animal ever to have lived, with a heart the size of a small car.
blue-whale.funFact: 지구상에서 가장 큰 동물로, 작은 자동차 크기의 심장을 가지고 있습니다.

humpback-whale.name: 혹등고래
humpback-whale.description: The humpback whale is known for its spectacular breaching and complex vocalizations.

killer-whale.name: 범고래
killer-whale.description: The killer whale or orca is the largest member of the dolphin family.

bottlenose-dolphin.name: 큰돌고래
bottlenose-dolphin.description: The bottlenose dolphin is one of the most well-known and intelligent marine mammals.
bottlenose-dolphin.funFact: 가장 잘 알려진 지능적인 해양 포유류 중 하나입니다.

narwhal.name: 일각고래
narwhal.description: The narwhal is an Arctic whale known for its long, spiral tusk.
narwhal.funFact: 긴 나선형 상아로 유명한 북극 고래입니다.

beluga-whale.name: 벨루가고래
beluga-whale.description: The beluga whale is a small, white Arctic whale known for its expressive face.
beluga-whale.funFact: 표현력 풍부한 얼굴로 유명한 작은 흰색 북극 고래입니다.

manatee.name: 마나ティー
manatee.description: Manatees are gentle, herbivorous marine mammals that inhabit shallow coastal waters.
manatee.funFact: 얕은 연안 해역에 서식하는 온순한 초식 해양 포유류입니다.

walrus.name: 바다코끼리
walrus.description: The walrus is a large pinniped with distinctive long tusks used for hauling out on ice.
walrus.funFact: 빙하에서 끌어올리기에 사용되는 긴 상아로 유명한大型鳍足류입니다.

capybara.name: 카피바라
capybara.description: The capybara is the largest living rodent, a semi-aquatic mammal found in South America.
capybara.funFact: 남미에서 발견되는 가장 큰 설치류로, 반수생 포유류입니다.

beaver.name: 비버
beaver.description: Beavers are large rodents known for building dams and lodges.
beaver.funFact: 댐과 오두막을 짓는 것으로 유명한 큰 설치류입니다.

porcupine.name: 호저
porcupine.description: Porcupines are rodents covered in sharp quills used for defense.
porcupine.funFact: 방어에 사용되는 날카로운 가시로 덮인 설치류입니다.

squirrel.name: 다람쥐
squirrel.description: Squirrels are small rodents known for their bushy tails and tree-dwelling habits.
squirrel.funFact: 털이 많은 꼬리와 나무 생활 습관으로 유명한 작은 설치류입니다.

chinchilla.name: チンチラ
chinchilla.description: Chinchillas are small rodents with incredibly soft fur, native to the Andes.
chinchilla.funFact: 안데스 산맥이 원산지인 부드러운 털을 가진 작은 설치류입니다.

guinea-pig.name: 기니피그
guinea-pig.description: Guinea pigs are small, friendly rodents originally from South America.

hamster.name: 햄스터
hamster.description: Hamsters are small, nocturnal rodents known for their cheek pouches and burrowing behavior.
hamster.funFact: 볼 주머니와 굴 땅 파기 행동으로 유명한 작은 야행성 설치류입니다.

mouse.name: 생쥐
mouse.description: Mice are small rodents found worldwide, important in scientific research.
mouse.funFact: 전 세계에 분포하며 과학 연구에 중요한 작은 설치류입니다.

rat.name: 쥐
rat.description: Rats are intelligent rodents that have adapted to live alongside humans.
rat.funFact: 인간 옆에서 생활하도록 적응한 지능적인 설치류입니다.

red-kangaroo.name: 캥거루
red-kangaroo.description: The red kangaroo is the largest living marsupial, found throughout Australia.
red-kangaroo.funFact: 호주 전역에 분포하는 가장 큰 활여류입니다.

koala.name: 코알라
koala.description: The koala is an arboreal marsupial that feeds almost exclusively on eucalyptus leaves.

wombat.name: 워ombat
wombat.description: Wombats are sturdy, burrowing marsupials with tough rear ends for defense.
wombat.funFact: 튼튼하고 굴을 파는 활여류로, 방어를 위한 단단한 뒷부분을 가지고 있습니다.

otter.name: 수달
otter.description: Otters are playful, semi-aquatic mammals known for their dense fur and tool use.
otter.funFact: 조밀한 털과 도구 사용으로 유명한 장난스러운 반수생 포유류입니다.

wolverine.name: #+#社会责任
wolverine.description: The wolverine is a powerful, stocky mustelid known for its strength and ferocity.
wolverine.funFact: 힘과 용맹으로 유명한 강력하고 뚱뚱한 족제비과 동물입니다.

honey-badger.name: 꿀곰
honey-badger.description: The honey badger is known for its fearlessness and thick skin that resists bee stings.
honey-badger.funFact: 두려움을 모르는 성격과 벌 sting에 저항하는 두꺼운 가죽으로 유명합니다.

raccoon.name: 너구리
raccoon.description: Raccoons are clever, adaptable mammals known for their masked faces and dexterous front paws.
raccoon.funFact: 변장한 얼굴과 능숙한 앞발로 유명한 영리하고 적응력이 뛰어난 포유류입니다.

red-panda.name: 레드판다
red-panda.description: The red panda is a small arboreal mammal with reddish-brown fur and a ringed tail.
red-panda.funFact: 붉은 갈색 털과 고리 모양 꼬리를 가진 작은 수목성 포유류입니다.

hedgehog.name: 고슴도치
hedgehog.description: Hedgehogs are small, spiny mammals found across Europe, Asia, and Africa.
hedgehog.funFact: 유럽, 아시아, 아프리카 전역에 분포하는 작은 가시 포유류입니다.

clownfish.name: clownfish
clownfish.description: Clownfish are vibrant orange fish with white bands that live symbiotically among sea anemone tentacles. They gain protection from predators while providing the anemone with food scraps and increased water circulation.
clownfish.funFact: 흰 줄무늬가 있는 밝은 주황색 물고기로, 말미.HtmlControls tentacles에서 공생합니다.

seahorse.name: 말가오리
seahorse.description: The seahorse is a small marine fish with a horse-like head, prehensile tail, and upright swimming posture found in shallow coastal waters worldwide.
seahorse.funFact: 말 머리, 잡는 꼬리, 수직 수영 자세를 가진 작은 해양 물고기입니다.

tiger-shark.name: 호랑이상어
tiger-shark.description: The tiger shark is a large predator with distinctive dark vertical stripes found in tropical and subtropical oceans worldwide.
tiger-shark.funFact: 열대 및 아열대 전역의 바다에 분포하는 어두운 세로 줄무늬로 유명한大型 포식자입니다.

bull-shark.name: 황소상어
bull-shark.description: The bull shark is a large, stocky shark found in warm, shallow coastal waters and occasionally in freshwater rivers.
bull-shark.funFact: 따뜻한 얕은 연안 해역과 가끔 담수 강에서 발견되는 뚱뚱하고 근육질의 상어입니다.

hammerhead-shark.name: 망치상어
hammerhead-shark.description: The hammerhead shark is a distinctive shark with a wide, flattened head that gives it a hammer-like appearance found in warm waters.
hammerhead-shark.funFact: 따뜻한 해역에 분포하는 넓고 납작한 머리를 가진 독특한 상어입니다.

whale-shark.name: 고래상어
whale-shark.description: The whale shark is the largest fish in the world, reaching over 40 feet, a gentle filter feeder found in tropical oceans.
whale-shark.funFact: 세계에서 가장 큰 물고기로, 40피트 이상 자라며 온대 바다에서 서식하는 온순한 여과 포식자입니다.

great-white-shark.name: 대white상어
great-white-shark.description: The great white shark is the world's largest known predatory fish, an apex predator found in coastal and offshore waters worldwide.
great-white-shark.funFact: 세계에서 가장 잘 알려진 포식성 물고기로, 연안과 원양 해역에 분포하는 정점 포식자입니다.

manta-ray.name: 만타
manta-ray.description: The manta ray is one of the largest rays in the world with a wingspan that can exceed 20 feet, a gentle filter feeder.
manta-ray.funFact: 날개 길이가 20피트를 초과할 수 있는 세계에서 가장 큰 가오리 중 하나로, 온순한 여과 포식자입니다.

anglerfish.name: 바다장어
anglerfish.description: The Atlantic anglerfish is a deep-sea fish with a distinctive bioluminescent lure that attracts prey found on the deep ocean floor.
anglerfish.funFact: 심해 저층에서 발견되는 생물 발광 미끼로 먹이를 유인하는 독특한 심해 물고기입니다.

pufferfish.name: 복어
pufferfish.description: The pufferfish is a marine fish capable of inflating its body to several times its normal size as a defense mechanism, found in tropical and subtropical waters.
pufferfish.funFact: 열대 및 아열대 해역에 분포하며 방어 기전으로 몸을 여러 배로 부풀릴 수 있는 해양 물고기입니다.

piranha.name: 피라냐
piranha.description: The piranha is a freshwater fish native to South American rivers known for its sharp teeth and powerful jaws found in tropical and subtropical waters.
piranha.funFact: 날카로운 이빨과 강력한 턱으로 유명한 남미 강이 원산지의 담수물고기입니다.

electric-eel.name: 전기뱀장어
electric-eel.description: The electric eel is a freshwater fish capable of generating powerful electric shocks used for hunting and self-defense found in South American rivers.
electric-eel.funFact: 남미 강에서 발견되는 사냥과 자기 방어에 사용되는 강력한 전기 충격을 생성할 수 있는 담수물고기입니다.

komodo-dragon.name: 코모도왕도마뱀
komodo-dragon.description: The Komodo dragon is the largest living lizard in the world, found on a few Indonesian islands. It is an apex predator capable of taking down deer, pigs, and even water buffalo. Young Komodo dragons spend their first years in trees to avoid predation by adults.
komodo-dragon.funFact: 세계에서 가장 큰 왕도마뱀으로, 인도네시아 몇 개 섬에서 발견되는 정점 포식자입니다.

king-cobra.name: 킹코브라
king-cobra.description: The king cobra is the world's longest venomous snake, capable of reaching lengths over 13 feet. Found in the tropical forests of South and Southeast Asia, it primarily feeds on other snakes. Its venom is potent enough to kill an elephant.
king-cobra.funFact: 세계에서 가장 긴 독사로, 13피트 이상까지 자랄 수 있습니다.

green-sea-turtle.name: green 바다거북
green-sea-turtle.description: Green sea turtles are among the largest sea turtles in the world and the only herbivorous marine turtle species. They migrate long distances between feeding grounds and nesting beaches, returning to the same beach where they were born.
green-sea-turtle.funFact: 세계에서 가장 큰 바다거북 중 하나로, 유일한 초식 해양 거북이 종입니다.

green-iguana.name: green iguana
green-iguana.description: The green iguana is a large, arboreal herbivorous lizard native to Central and South America. It is excellent at swimming and can hold its breath for up to 30 minutes. Juveniles are bright green while adults may turn orange or dull grey.
green-iguana.funFact: 중앙 및 남미가 원산지인 큰 수목성 초식 도마뱀으로, 수영에 뛰어납니다.

boa-constrictor.name: 비단구렁이
boa-constrictor.description: The boa constrictor is a large, non-venomous constrictor found throughout Central and South America. It is a highly adaptable species found in rainforests, savannas, and even near human habitations. It kills prey by constriction and is a popular species in captivity.
boa-constrictor.funFact: 중앙 및 남미 전역에 분포하는 비독성 교살자로, 적응력이 뛰어납니다.

black-mamba.name: 블랙맨바
black-mamba.description: The black mamba is the fastest snake in the world and one of the most venomous. Found in eastern and southern Africa, it can reach speeds of 12 mph and strike with incredible accuracy. Its venom is neurotoxic and can be fatal without antivenom.
black-mamba.funFact: 세계에서 가장 빠르고 가장 독이 강한 뱀 중 하나로, 동남아프리카에 분포합니다.

ball-python.name: 왕뱀
ball-python.description: The ball python is a non-venomous constrictor native to the grasslands of western and central Africa. It is the most popular pet snake in the world due to its docile temperament and manageable size. It has hundreds of color morphs bred in captivity.
ball-python.funFact: 아프리카 서부 및 중부 초원이 원산지인 비독성 교살자로, 세계에서 가장 인기 있는 애완뱀입니다.

red-eared-slider.name: 붉은귀거북
red-eared-slider.description: The red-eared slider is a semi-aquatic turtle native to the Mississippi Valley region of the United States. It is the most popular pet turtle in the world and has become a significant invasive species on every continent except Antarctica. It has a distinctive red stripe behind each eye.
red-eared-slider.funFact: 미시시피 계곡이 원산지인 반수생 거북이로, 세계에서 가장 인기 있는 애완 거북이입니다.

emperor-penguin.name: 왕펭귄
emperor-penguin.description: The emperor penguin is the tallest and heaviest of all living penguins. It breeds during the Antarctic winter, with males incubating the egg for about 65 days.
emperor-penguin.funFact: 가장 크고 무거운 펭귄으로, 남극 겨울 동안 번식합니다.

king-penguin.name: 킹펭귄
king-penguin.description: The king penguin is the second-largest penguin species, found on sub-Antarctic islands with striking orange and silver markings.
king-penguin.funFact: 두 번째로 큰 펭귄 종으로, 눈에 띄는 주황색과 은색 무늬를 가지고 있습니다.

bald-eagle.name: 흰머리독수리
bald-eagle.description: The bald eagle is a bird of prey found in North America and a national symbol of the United States. It is a large raptor with a distinctive white head and tail contrasting with a dark brown body.
bald-eagle.funFact: 북미에 분포하는 맹금류로, 미국의 국가 상징입니다.

golden-eagle.name: 왕독수리
golden-eagle.description: The golden eagle is one of the largest and most powerful raptors in North America and Eurasia. Named for the golden-brown plumage on its head and neck, it hunts primarily rabbits and hares.
golden-eagle.funFact: 북미와 유라시아에서 가장 크고 강력한 맹금류 중 하나입니다.

peregrine-falcon.name: 매
peregrine-falcon.description: The peregrine falcon is a widespread bird of prey known for its incredible speed during its hunting dive. It feeds primarily on medium-sized birds caught in flight.
peregrine-falcon.funFact: 사냥 다이빙 중 믿을 수 없이 빠른 속도로 유명한 널리 분포하는 맹금류입니다.

barn-owl.name: 소.owl
barn-owl.description: The barn owl is a nocturnal raptor found on every continent except Antarctica. Known for its heart-shaped face and ghostly white plumage, it is an exceptionally efficient hunter of rodents.
barn-owl.funFact: 심장 모양 얼굴과 유령 같은 흰 깃털로 유명한 야행성 맹금류입니다.

mallard.name: 오리
mallard.description: The mallard is the most common and widespread duck in the Northern Hemisphere. Males have a distinctive iridescent green head, while females are mottled brown.
mallard.funFact: 북반구에서 가장 흔하고 널리 분포하는 오리로, 수컷은 녹색 머리를 가지고 있습니다.

canada-goose.name: 캐나다거위
canada-goose.description: The Canada goose is a large waterfowl native to North America, recognized by its black head and neck with white chinstrap. Highly adaptable, it is known for its V-formation flight.
canada-goose.funFact: 북미가 원산지인 큰 수조류로, V자 대형 비행으로 유명합니다.

mute-swan.name: 고니
mute-swan.description: The mute swan is one of the largest flying birds, with pure white plumage and an orange bill with a black knob. It is known for its graceful S-shaped neck posture.
mute-swan.funFact: 純白 깃털과 주황색 부리를 가진 가장 큰 비행 조류 중 하나입니다.

flamingo.name: flamingo
flamingo.description: The greater flamingo is the largest and most widespread flamingo species. Its pink plumage, long legs, and curved bill are unmistakable.
flamingo.funFact: 가장 크고 널리 분포하는 플라밍고 종으로, 분홍색 깃털과 긴 다리로 유명합니다.

ostrich.name: 타조
ostrich.description: The common ostrich is the largest living bird, native to Africa. Unable to fly, it has powerful legs and can run at sustained speeds of 30 mph.
ostrich.funFact: 비행할 수 없는 세계에서 가장 큰 살아있는 조류로, 강력한 다리를 가지고 있습니다.

emu.name: emu
emu.description: The emu is the second-largest living bird, native to Australia. It is flightless with vestigial wings. The male emu performs all parental duties.
emu.funFact: 호주가 원산지인 두 번째로 큰 살아있는 조류로, 비행할 수 없습니다.

monarch-butterfly.name: 왕나비
monarch-butterfly.description: The monarch butterfly is one of the most recognizable butterflies in North America, known for its striking orange and black wing pattern. It is famous for its incredible long-distance migration across thousands of miles.
monarch-butterfly.funFact: 북미에서 가장 잘 알려진 나비 중 하나로, 눈에 띄는 주황색과 검은색 날개 무늬로 유명합니다.

ladybug.name: 무당벌레
ladybug.description: Ladybugs are small, round beetles valued by gardeners for their appetite for aphids and other plant pests. Their bright red coloration with black spots warns predators of their bitter taste.
ladybug.funFact: 진딧물과 다른 식물 해충을 잡아먹는 것으로 정원사에게 사랑받는 작은 둥근 딱정이벌레입니다.

sloth.name: 나무늘보
sloth.description: Sloths are slow-moving tree-dwelling mammals known for their lazy lifestyle.
sloth.funFact: 느리게 움직이는 수목성 포유류로, 나태한 생활 방식으로 유명합니다.

axolotl.name: 아홀로틀
axolotl.description: The Axolotl is a neotenic salamander that retains its larval features throughout life, including external gills. Found only in Lake Xochimilco in Mexico, it is critically endangered in the wild but widely bred in captivity.
axolotl.funFact: 외부 아가미를 포함한 유충 특징을 평생 유지하는 미성숙 영양 상태의 도롱뇽입니다.

incredible-frog.name: 놀라운개구리
incredible-frog.description: The Incredible Frog is a small tree frog found in the rainforests of Central America. They have specialized finger and toe pads that allow them to control their descent when jumping between trees.
incredible-frog.funFact: 중앙아메리카 열대우림에서 발견되는 작은 나무 개구리로, 손가락과 발가락 패드를 전개하여 나무 사이 점프를 제어할 수 있습니다.

lemur.name: 여우원숭이
lemur.description: Lemurs are a diverse group of primates found only on the island of Madagascar.
lemur.funFact: 마다가스카르 섬에서만 발견되는 다양한 영장류 그룹입니다.

meerkat.name: 미어캣
meerkat.description: Meerkats are social mongooses that live in the Kalahari Desert.

mongoose.name: 몽구스
mongoose.description: Mongooses are small carnivores known for their ability to fight snakes.
mongoose.funFact: 뱀과 싸우는 능력으로 유명한 작은 육식동물입니다.

praying-mantis.name: 사마귀
praying-mantis.description: The Chinese praying mantis is a large, elongated predatory insect with triangular head and powerful raptorial front legs. It is a sit-and-wait ambush predator of other insects.
praying-mantis.funFact: 머리를 180도 회전하여 먹이를 스캔할 수 있는 사마귀입니다.

dragonfly.name: 잠자리
dragonfly.description: Dragonflies are ancient aerial predators with enormous compound eyes and two pairs of independently controlled wings. They are among the most efficient hunters in the insect world.
dragonfly.funFact: 모든 여섯 방향으로 비행하고 헬리콥터처럼 호버할 수 있는 잠자리입니다.

firefly.name: 반딧불이
firefly.description: Fireflies are beetles famous for their bioluminescent abdomens used to attract mates. Both adults and larvae produce light through a chemical reaction involving luciferin and luciferase.
firefly.funFact: 낮에도 빛을 발하는 애벌레를 포함하여 유충과 성충 모두 빛을 내는 반딧불이입니다.

black-widow-spider.name: 검은미망인
black-widow-spider.description: The southern black widow is one of North America's most venomous spiders. Females are recognized by the red hourglass marking on their abdomen and sometimes eat the male after mating.
black-widow-spider.funFact: 독이 15배 더 강하지만 주입량이 적은 검은미망인 거미입니다.

tarantula.name: 타란튤라
tarantula.description: The Mexican red-kneed tarantula is a large, docile spider popular in the pet trade. It has urticating hairs on its abdomen that it can flick at threats, causing skin irritation.

giant-pacific-octopus.name: 대문어
giant-pacific-octopus.description: The giant Pacific octopus is the largest known octopus species, renowned for its intelligence and ability to solve puzzles. It has three hearts, blue blood, and eight dexterous arms lined with suckers.
giant-pacific-octopus.funFact: 밀리초 만에 색상과 질감을 변경하여 주변과 융합할 수 있는 대문어입니다.

common-octopus.name: 문어
common-octopus.description: The common octopus is a highly intelligent marine invertebrate with excellent eyesight and problem-solving abilities. It uses ink clouds and camouflage as primary defense mechanisms.
common-octopus.funFact: 부리보다 큰 모든 구멍을 통과할 수 있는 문어입니다.

moon-jellyfish.name: 해파리
moon-jellyfish.description: Moon jellyfish are one of the most common and widely distributed jellyfish species. Their translucent bells pulse gently through coastal waters, feeding on plankton and small organisms.
moon-jellyfish.funFact: 성적으로나 무성적으로 번식하여 인구 폭발이 가능한 해파리입니다.

box-jellyfish.name: 상자해파리
box-jellyfish.description: Box jellyfish are among the most venomous creatures on Earth. Their nearly transparent, cube-shaped bells and up to 60 tentacles make them difficult to spot in tropical waters.
box-jellyfish.funFact: 이미지를 형성할 수 있는 두 개의 눈을 포함하여 24개의 눈을 가진 상자해파리입니다.

common-starfish.name: 불가사리
common-starfish.description: The common starfish is one of the most recognizable sea stars, with five arms and a tough, spiny surface. It feeds on mussels and oysters by everting its stomach through its mouth.
common-starfish.funFact: 위를 안쪽으로 뒤집어 먹이를 외부에서 소화할 수 있는 불가사리입니다.

blue-poison-dart-frog.name: 파란독화살개구리
blue-poison-dart-frog.description: The Blue Poison Dart Frog is a small, brilliantly colored amphibian found in the rainforests of Suriname. Their vivid blue coloration warns predators of their potent skin toxins.
blue-poison-dart-frog.funFact: Ǟ폰 강에서 발견되는 작은 찬란하게 색칠된 양서류입니다.

golden-poison-dart-frog.name: 금빛독화살개구리
golden-poison-dart-frog.description: The Golden Poison Dart Frog is the most toxic vertebrate on Earth. Found only in Colombia, its bright yellow skin contains batrachotoxin, a potent neurotoxin used by indigenous people to poison blowgun darts.
golden-poison-dart-frog.funFact: 지구상에서 가장 독이 강한 척추동물로, 콜롬비아에서만 발견됩니다.

red-eyed-tree-frog.name: 붉은눈나무개구리
red-eyed-tree-frog.description: The Red-Eyed Tree Frog is one of the most iconic rainforest amphibians. With vibrant green bodies, blue and yellow striped sides, and stunning red eyes, they are a symbol of tropical biodiversity.
red-eyed-tree-frog.funFact: 붉은 눈, 녹색 몸통, 파란색과 노란색 줄무늬가 있는 상징적인 열대우림 양서류입니다.

green-basilisk.name: 바실리스크
green-basilisk.description: The green basilisk is a striking lizard found in the tropical rainforests of Central America. Males have impressive crests on their heads, backs, and tails. It is famous for its ability to run bipedally across water surfaces for short distances.
green-basilisk.funFact: 중앙아메리카 열대우림에서 발견되는 놀라운 도마뱀으로, 물 표면을 이족보행으로 달릴 수 있습니다.

thorny-devil.name: 가시도마뱀
thorny-devil.description: The thorny devil is a small, spiny lizard native to the arid deserts of central Australia. Its entire body is covered in conical spines that provide defense against predators. Its skin has microscopic channels that collect water and transport it to its mouth.
thorny-devil.funFact: 호주 중부의 건조 사막이 원산지인 작은 가시 도마뱀으로, 전신이 원추형 가시로 덮여 있습니다.

common-snapping-turtle.name: 거북이
common-snapping-turtle.description: The common snapping turtle is a large, freshwater turtle found across eastern North America. It has a powerful beak-like jaw and a long, prehistoric-looking tail. Unlike most turtles, it cannot fully retract into its shell, making it more aggressive on land.
common-snapping-turtle.funFact: 강력한 부리 모양 턱과 긴 고대 모양 꼬리를 가진 큰 담수 거북이입니다.

alligator-snapping-turtle.name: 악어거북
alligator-snapping-turtle.description: The alligator snapping turtle is the largest freshwater turtle in North America. It has a massive head, a hooked beak, and a shell with three prominent ridges. It is an ambush predator that lies motionless on the river bottom with its mouth open.

mountain-fox.name: Mountain Fox
mountain-fox.description: The mountain fox is a small fox adapted to high-altitude environments.

cozumel-fox.name: Cozumel Fox
cozumel-fox.description: The Cozumel fox is a critically endangered fox found only on Cozumel Island.

gracile-fox.name: Gracile Fox
gracile-fox.description: The gracile fox is a small, slender fox found in South American grasslands.

simien-fox.name: Simien Fox
simien-fox.description: The Simien fox is a rare canid found only in the Ethiopian highlands.

javan-rhinoceros.name: Javan Rhinoceros
javan-rhinoceros.description: The Javan rhinoceros is one of the rarest large mammals on Earth.

sumatran-rhinoceros.name: Sumatran Rhinoceros
sumatran-rhinoceros.description: The Sumatran rhinoceros is the smallest living rhino, with two horns.

indian-rhinoceros.name: Indian Rhinoceros
indian-rhinoceros.description: The Indian rhinoceros has thick, folded skin resembling armor.

himalayan-tahr.name: Himalayan Tahr
himalayan-tahr.description: The Himalayan tahr is a large ungulate adapted to steep, rocky terrain.

markhor.name: Markhor
markhor.description: The markhor is a large wild goat with distinctive spiral horns.

blue-sheep.name: Blue Sheep
blue-sheep.description: The blue sheep or bharal is a caprine found in the Himalayas.

barbary-sheep.name: Barbary Sheep
barbary-sheep.description: The Barbary sheep is a caprine adapted to arid mountain environments.

musk-deer.name: Musk Deer
musk-deer.description: The musk deer is a small deer known for the musk gland used in perfumes.

tufted-deer.name: Tufted Deer
tufted-deer.description: The tufted deer is a small deer with distinctive fang-like canines.

muntjac.name: Muntjac
muntjac.description: The muntjac is a small deer known for its barking call when alarmed.

reeves-s-muntjac.name: Reeves's Muntjac
reeves-s-muntjac.description: Reeves's muntjac is a small deer introduced to the UK from China.

chinese-water-deer.name: Chinese Water Deer
chinese-water-deer.description: The Chinese water deer is known for its distinctive fang-like canines.

pere-david-s-deer.name: Pere David's Deer
pere-david-s-deer.description: Père David's deer is an extinct-in-the-wild deer once native to China.

sika-deer.name: Sika Deer
sika-deer.description: The sika deer is a deer species with distinctive white spots.

fallow-deer.name: Fallow Deer
fallow-deer.description: The fallow deer is a deer with distinctive palmate antlers.

red-deer.name: Red Deer
red-deer.description: The red deer is one of the largest deer species, found across Europe and Asia.

reindeer.name: Reindeer
reindeer.funFact: 양성 모두 녹용이 있는 유일한 사슴
reindeer.description: The reindeer or caribou is a deer species adapted to Arctic conditions.

elk.name: Elk
elk.description: The elk is a large deer species found in North America and Asia.

sambar-deer.name: Sambar Deer
sambar-deer.description: The sambar is a large deer found in tropical forests of Asia.

rusa-deer.name: Rusa Deer
rusa-deer.description: The rusa deer is a deer species found in the Indonesian archipelago.

red-tailed-hawk.name: Red-tailed Hawk
red-tailed-hawk.funFact: 할리우드 영화에서 독수리 소리로 자주 사용됨
red-tailed-hawk.description: The red-tailed hawk is the most common hawk in North America. It is recognizable by its brick-red tail and broad, rounded wings. It hunts rodents and rabbits from a perch or while soaring.

great-horned-owl.name: Great Horned Owl
great-horned-owl.description: The great horned owl is a powerful nocturnal predator with distinctive ear tufts and deep hooting calls. It is highly adaptable and preys on a wide range of animals.

snowy-owl.name: Snowy Owl
snowy-owl.description: The snowy owl is a large, white owl of the Arctic tundra. Unlike most owl species, it hunts during the day, feeding primarily on lemmings. Males become whiter as they age.

northern-saw-whet-owl.name: Northern Saw-whet Owl
northern-saw-whet-owl.funFact: 북미에서 가장 작은 올빼미 중 하나, 캔보다 가벼움
northern-saw-whet-owl.description: The northern saw-whet owl is a tiny, nocturnal owl named for its sawing call. Despite its small size, it is a fierce predator of mice and small birds.

barred-owl.name: Barred Owl
barred-owl.description: The barred owl is a large, stocky owl native to eastern North America. It has dark eyes unlike most other owls and a distinctive hooting call.

long-eared-owl.name: Long-eared Owl
long-eared-owl.funFact: 비대칭적인 귀 구멍으로 완전한 어둠에서도 먹이를 정확히 찾음
long-eared-owl.description: The long-eared owl is a medium-sized nocturnal owl with striking orange eyes and very long ear tufts. It is a secretive bird that roosts in dense vegetation.

great-gray-owl.name: Great Gray Owl
great-gray-owl.funFact: 북미에서 가장 키가 큰 올빼미, 깃털이大部分 크기
great-gray-owl.description: The great gray owl is the tallest owl species in North America with a massive facial disc. Despite its imposing size, it is relatively light and feeds primarily on small rodents.

burrowing-owl.name: Burrowing Owl
burrowing-owl.description: The burrowing owl is a small, long-legged owl that nests in underground burrows. Unlike most owls, it is active during the day and perches on fence posts to watch for prey.

elf-owl.name: Elf Owl
elf-owl.funFact: 세계에서 가장 작은 올빼미, 탁구공보다 가벼움
elf-owl.description: The elf owl is the worlds smallest owl, found in the desert Southwest. It nests in holes in saguaro cacti and feeds on insects and small invertebrates.

wood-duck.name: Wood Duck
wood-duck.funFact: 나무 둥지에서 15m 높이로 뛰어내려도 다치지 않음
wood-duck.description: The wood duck is one of the most colorful waterfowl in North America. Males display elaborate patterns of green, purple, and white. Unlike most ducks, it nests in tree cavities.

northern-pintail.name: Northern Pintail
northern-pintail.funFact: 긴 꼬리로 가장 우아한 오리 중 하나
northern-pintail.description: The northern pintail is a graceful duck recognized by the males long, pointed tail feathers. It has a chocolate-brown head and white breast stripe.

green-winged-teal.name: Green-winged Teal
green-winged-teal.description: The green-winged teal is a small, agile duck with a distinctive chestnut head and green eye patch. It feeds by dabbling at the water surface.

canvasback.name: Canvasback
canvasback.funFact: 북미에서 가장 크고 빠른 잠수 오리
canvasback.description: The canvasback is a large diving duck with a distinctive sloping profile. Males have a white body and reddish-brown head.

snow-goose.name: Snow Goose
snow-goose.funFact: 이동 시 수십만 마리까지 무리 지음
snow-goose.description: The snow goose is a medium-sized goose with white plumage and black wingtips. It breeds in the Arctic and winters in southern marshes.

greylag-goose.name: Greylag Goose
greylag-goose.description: The greylag goose is a large waterfowl with grey-brown plumage and an orange bill. It is the ancestor of most domestic geese.

trumpeter-swan.name: Trumpeter Swan
trumpeter-swan.description: The trumpeter swan is the largest waterfowl in North America with a wingspan up to 8 feet. Named for its resonant, trumpet-like call, it has recovered from near extinction.

tundra-swan.name: Tundra Swan
tundra-swan.description: The tundra swan is a large, white swan that breeds in the Arctic tundra. It has a distinctive yellow spot near the eye and forms large flocks during migration.

american-robin.name: American Robin
american-robin.funFact: 하루에 4m 이상의 지렁이를 먹을 수 있음
american-robin.description: The American robin is one of the most familiar songbirds in North America. Recognized by its rusty-red breast and melodic song, it is often seen hopping across lawns.

northern-cardinal.name: Northern Cardinal
northern-cardinal.description: The northern cardinal is a vivid red songbird with a distinctive crest and black face. Males are brilliant red while females are warm brown with red accents.

blue-jay.name: Blue Jay
blue-jay.funFact: 다른 새를 속이기 위해 붉은어깨솔깃 소리를 흉내냄
blue-jay.description: The blue jay is a striking songbird with blue, white, and black plumage and a prominent crest. It is intelligent and vocal, known for its loud calls and bold behavior.

american-crow.name: American Crow
american-crow.funFact: 개별 인간 얼굴을 인식하고 원한을 품을 수 있음
american-crow.description: The American crow is a large, all-black bird known for its intelligence and adaptability. It uses tools, solves complex problems, and lives in large family groups.

common-raven.name: Common Raven
common-raven.funFact: 눈 덮인 지붕에서 미끄러지며 재주넘기를 함
common-raven.description: The common raven is the largest songbird in North America. Extremely intelligent, it has been observed using tools, solving multi-step puzzles, and manipulating other animals.

house-sparrow.name: House Sparrow
house-sparrow.funFact: 1851년 북미에 도입된 후 대륙 전체로 퍼짐
house-sparrow.description: The house sparrow is one of the most widespread and familiar birds in the world. Originally from Eurasia, it thrives in close association with human habitation.

european-robin.name: European Robin
european-robin.funFact: 영국에서 크리스마스의 상징, 많은 카드에 등장
european-robin.description: The European robin is a small insectivorous bird with a distinctive orange-red breast. Familiar in gardens across Europe, it is known for its territorial behavior.

eastern-bluebird.name: Eastern Bluebird
eastern-bluebird.funFact: 자외선을 볼 수 있어 익은 열매를 찾는 데 도움
eastern-bluebird.description: The eastern bluebird is a small thrush with brilliant blue plumage on the back and a rusty-red throat and breast. A symbol of happiness, it was saved from decline by nest box programs.

western-bluebird.name: Western Bluebird
western-bluebird.funFact: 옛 지 spotsotretrait 구멍에서 둥지를 트는 드문 새
western-bluebird.description: The western bluebird is a small thrush with deep blue plumage and a rusty breast. It nests in cavities and feeds primarily on insects caught on the ground.

baltimore-oriole.name: Baltimore Oriole
baltimore-oriole.funFact: 정교한 매달린 둥지를 짓는 데 2주가 걸릴 수 있음
baltimore-oriole.description: The Baltimore oriole is a striking songbird with vivid orange and black plumage. They weave elaborate pendulous nests from plant fibers.

scarlet-tanager.name: Scarlet Tanager
scarlet-tanager.funFact: 수컷이 겨울철 올리브그리색으로 변해 완전히 다른 새처럼 보임
scarlet-tanager.description: The scarlet tanager is a medium-sized songbird with brilliant red plumage and black wings during breeding season. It is a shy forest bird.

yellow-warbler.name: Yellow Warbler
yellow-warbler.funFact: 봄에 번식지에 가장 먼저 도착하는 새 중 하나
yellow-warbler.description: The yellow warbler is a small, bright yellow songbird widespread across North America. Its cheerful song is one of the most recognizable spring sounds.

white-throated-sparrow.name: White-throated Sparrow
white-throated-sparrow.funFact: 두 가지 색상 형태가 거의 전적으로 서로 짝을 이룸
white-throated-sparrow.description: The white-throated sparrow is a common songbird with a distinctive white throat patch and yellow lores. It has two color morphs that differ in behavior.

dark-eyed-junco.name: Dark-eyed Junco
dark-eyed-junco.funFact: 겨울철 남부 주에 나타나 눈새라고 불림
dark-eyed-junco.description: The dark-eyed junco is a small, slate-colored sparrow common across North America. It is one of the most abundant and widespread forest birds.

ruby-throated-hummingbird.name: Ruby-throated Hummingbird
ruby-throated-hummingbird.funFact: 초당 53번 날개를 움직이고 후진 비행 가능
ruby-throated-hummingbird.description: The ruby-throated hummingbird is the only breeding hummingbird in eastern North America. Males have an iridescent ruby-red throat.

annas-hummingbird.name: Annas Hummingbird
annas-hummingbird.funFact: 수컷이 인상적인 다이빙 과시를 통해 소리를 냄
annas-hummingbird.description: Annas hummingbird is a small, green hummingbird native to western North America. Males have a brilliant rose-pink throat and crown.

black-chinned-hummingbird.name: Black-chinned Hummingbird
black-chinned-hummingbird.description: The black-chinned hummingbird is a small, common hummingbird of the western United States with a velvet-black chin that shows iridescent purple.

belted-kingfisher.name: Belted Kingfisher
belted-kingfisher.funFact: 암컷이 수컷보다 더 화려한 드문 새 종
belted-kingfisher.description: The belted kingfisher is a stocky, blue-gray bird with a shaggy crest and large dagger-like bill. Females have an additional rusty band across the belly.

great-blue-heron.name: Great Blue Heron
great-blue-heron.funFact: 완벽한 순간을 위해 몇 시간 동안 멈추어 서 있을 수 있음
great-blue-heron.description: The great blue heron is the largest heron in North America, with a wingspan up to 6.5 feet. It wades in shallow water to hunt fish.

great-egret.name: Great Egret
great-egret.funFact: 깃털 때문에 19세기 여성 모자용으로 거의 멸종 위기
great-egret.description: The great egret is a large, all-white heron with a yellow bill and black legs. Its near-extinction for the millinery trade helped spark the conservation movement.

snowy-egret.name: Snowy Egret
snowy-egret.funFact: 밝은 노란색 발로 진흙 속 먹이를 쫓음
snowy-egret.description: The snowy egret is a small, elegant white heron with black legs and vivid yellow feet. During breeding season, it develops long, flowing plumes.

green-heron.name: Green Heron
green-heron.funFact: 미끼를 물에 떨어뜨려 물고기를 유인하는 도구 사용 새
green-heron.description: The green heron is a small, stocky heron with dark greenish-gray plumage. It is a clever hunter that sometimes uses bait to lure fish.

american-flamingo.name: American Flamingo
american-flamingo.funFact: 모든 플라밍고 중 가장 밝은 색상
american-flamingo.description: The American flamingo is a large, bright pink wading bird found in the Caribbean and Galapagos with the brightest plumage of all flamingos.

sandhill-crane.name: Sandhill Crane
sandhill-crane.funFact: 뛰기, 절하기, 막대기 던지기 등 화려한 춤을 추함
sandhill-crane.description: The sandhill crane is a tall, gray bird with a red crown and long legs. Known for its trumpeting call and spectacular mating dances.

whooping-crane.name: Whooping Crane
whooping-crane.funFact: 한때 야생에서 15마리만 남아 북미에서 가장 희귀한 새
whooping-crane.description: The whooping crane is the tallest bird in North America. Named for its loud whooping call, it was saved from extinction through intensive conservation.

purple-gallinule.name: Purple Gallinule
purple-gallinule.funFact: 극도로 긴 발가락으로 연꽃 잎 위를 걸을 수 있음
purple-gallinule.description: The purple gallinule is a brightly colored marsh bird with purple-blue plumage and a red and yellow bill. It walks gracefully on floating vegetation.

american-coot.name: American Coot
american-coot.funFact: 목까지 잠수하여 물 속에 숨을 수 있음
american-coot.description: The American coot is a dark, chicken-like waterbird with a white bill and frontal shield. Despite looking duck-like, it is related to rails.

wild-turkey.name: Wild Turkey
wild-turkey.funFact: 시속 88km로 비행하고 시속 40km로 달릴 수 있음
wild-turkey.description: The wild turkey is a large, iridescent bird native to North America. Males display elaborate courtship rituals. It is the ancestor of the domesticated turkey.

ring-necked-pheasant.name: Ring-necked Pheasant
ring-necked-pheasant.funFact: 화려한 깃털로 한때 용 그림의 모델로 사용됨
ring-necked-pheasant.description: The ring-necked pheasant is a colorful game bird originally from Asia, now established across North America and Europe. Males have brilliant copper and green plumage.

bobwhite-quail.name: Northern Bobwhite
bobwhite-quail.funFact: 독특한 두 음절 울음소리에서 이름이 유래
bobwhite-quail.description: The northern bobwhite is a small, compact quail with a distinctive white throat and eyebrow stripe in males. Named for its clear bob-white call.

california-quail.name: California Quail
california-quail.description: The California quail is a small, plump ground bird with a distinctive forward-curving black head plume. It is the state bird of California.

rockhopper-penguin.name: Rockhopper Penguin
rockhopper-penguin.funFact: 오리걸음 대신 양발로 바위 사이를 뜀
rockhopper-penguin.description: The rockhopper penguin is a small penguin known for its distinctive yellow and black crest feathers. It navigates steep, rocky terrain by hopping.

little-blue-penguin.name: Little Blue Penguin
little-blue-penguin.funFact: 세계에서 가장 작은 펭귄, 약 33cm 크기
little-blue-penguin.description: The little blue penguin, also known as the fairy penguin, is the smallest species of penguin. Found in New Zealand and southern Australia.

gentoo-penguin.name: Gentoo Penguin
gentoo-penguin.description: The gentoo penguin is recognizable by the white stripe across its head and its bright orange-red bill. It is the fastest underwater swimming bird.

african-penguin.name: African Penguin
african-penguin.description: The African penguin, also known as the jackass penguin for its donkey-like bray, is the only penguin species that breeds in Africa. It is endangered.

brown-kiwi.name: Brown Kiwi
brown-kiwi.description: The brown kiwi is a flightless bird native to New Zealand. It has hair-like feathers, no tail, and a long probing bill with nostrils at the tip.

lyrebird.name: Superb Lyrebird
lyrebird.funFact: 전동톱, 카메라 셔터, 자동차 경보기 등 모든 소리를 흉내냄
lyrebird.description: The superb lyrebird is famous for its extraordinary ability to mimic sounds. Males have an elaborate tail that forms a lyre shape during courtship.

cassowary.name: Southern Cassowary
cassowary.funFact: 강력한 발차기로 세계에서 가장 위험한 새로 여겨짐
cassowary.description: The southern cassowary is a large, flightless bird with a distinctive blue neck, red wattles, and a bony casque on its head.

scarlet-macaw.name: Scarlet Macaw
scarlet-macaw.funFact: 사육 시 75년 이상 살고 평생 짝을 맺음
scarlet-macaw.description: The scarlet macaw is a large, colorful parrot with brilliant red, yellow, and blue plumage. Found in Central and South American rainforests.

blue-and-yellow-macaw.name: Blue-and-yellow Macaw
blue-and-yellow-macaw.funFact: 시속 56km로 비행하고 강한 부리로 단단한 견과류를 깨움
blue-and-yellow-macaw.description: The blue-and-yellow macaw is a large parrot with vivid blue upperparts and golden-yellow underparts. It is highly social and can mimic human speech.

hyacinth-macaw.name: Hyacinth Macaw
hyacinth-macaw.funFact: 날개 폭 1.2m 이상의 세계 최대 비행 앵무새
hyacinth-macaw.description: The hyacinth macaw is the largest of all flying parrot species, with stunning cobalt-blue plumage and bright yellow eye rings.

african-grey-parrot.name: African Grey Parrot
african-grey-parrot.funFact: 어린 아이와 비견되는 인지 능력을 가진 가장 지능적인 새
african-grey-parrot.description: The African grey parrot is renowned for its exceptional intelligence and ability to mimic human speech. It has grey plumage with a striking red tail.

budgerigar.name: Budgerigar
budgerigar.funFact: 개와 고양이에 이어 세계에서 세 번째로 인기 있는 애완동물
budgerigar.description: The budgerigar is a small, long-tailed parakeet native to Australia. In the wild, it is green and yellow with black markings.

cockatiel.name: Cockatiel
cockatiel.funFact: 정확한 음악을 휘파람으로 부를 수 있는 드문 앵무새
cockatiel.description: The cockatiel is a small parrot native to Australia, recognizable by its prominent crest and orange cheek patches.

keel-billed-toucan.name: Keel-billed Toucan
keel-billed-toucan.funFact: 가볍고 벌집 구조로 이루어진 다채로운 부리
keel-billed-toucan.description: The keel-billed toucan is a colorful bird with a massive, rainbow-colored bill. Found in Central and South American rainforests.

toco-toucan.name: Toco Toucan
toco-toucan.funFact: 체온 조절을 돕는 혈관 네트워크가 부리에 있음
toco-toucan.description: The toco toucan is the largest toucan species, with a massive orange-yellow bill tipped in black. Found in South American forests.

great-hornbill.name: Great Hornbill
great-hornbill.funFact: 번식기 암컷을 나무 구멍에 가두고 작은 틈으로 먹이를 제공
great-hornbill.description: The great hornbill is one of the largest hornbill species, distinguished by its massive yellow and black casque atop its bill.

rhinoceros-hornbill.name: Rhinoceros Hornbill
rhinoceros-hornbill.description: The rhinoceros hornbill is a large hornbill with a dramatic upward-curving casque on its bill. Found in Southeast Asian rainforests.

laughing-kookaburra.name: Laughing Kookaburra
laughing-kookaburra.description: The laughing kookaburra is a large kingfisher native to Australia, famous for its distinctive call that sounds like loud, echoing human laughter.

pied-kingfisher.name: Pied Kingfisher
pied-kingfisher.funFact: 물속으로 잠수하기 전 물 위를 머물 수 있는 유일한 물총새
pied-kingfisher.description: The pied kingfisher is a black and white kingfisher found across Africa and Asia. It hovers over water before diving to catch fish.

atlantic-puffin.name: Atlantic Puffin
atlantic-puffin.funFact: 혀와 부리 구조로 한 번에 10마리 이상의 물고기를 운반
atlantic-puffin.description: The Atlantic puffin is a small seabird with a colorful triangular bill and distinctive black and white plumage. Known as the clown of the sea.

tufted-puffin.name: Tufted Puffin
tufted-puffin.description: The tufted puffin is a small seabird with black plumage, white face patches, and distinctive golden head tufts during breeding season.

wandering-albatross.name: Wandering Albatross
wandering-albatross.funFact: 모든 현존 새 중 가장 큰 날개 폭, 3.5m 이상
wandering-albatross.description: The wandering albatross has the largest wingspan of any bird, up to 11.5 feet. It spends most of its life soaring over the Southern Ocean.

black-browed-albatross.name: Black-browed Albatross
black-browed-albatross.description: The black-browed albatross is a large seabird with dark upper wings and a white body. Named for the dark stripe through its eye.

laysan-albatross.name: Laysan Albatross
laysan-albatross.funFact: 가장 오래된 야생 새는 70살 이상의 지혜라는 이름의 알바트로스
laysan-albatross.description: The Laysan albatross is a large seabird of the North Pacific. It breeds primarily on remote Pacific islands.

brown-pelican.name: Brown Pelican
brown-pelican.funFact: 18m 이상 높이에서 다이빙하여 물고기를 잡고 공기 주머니로 충격을 완화
brown-pelican.description: The brown pelican is a large waterbird with a massive bill and throat pouch. It is unique among pelicans for plunge-diving from the air.

american-white-pelican.name: American White Pelican
american-white-pelican.funFact: 물고기 떼를 얕은 물로 몰아 협력하여 사냥
american-white-pelican.description: The American white pelican is one of the largest North American birds, with a wingspan up to 9 feet. It scoops fish while swimming.

frigatebird.name: Magnificent Frigatebird
frigatebird.funFact: 몇 주 동안 공중에 머물면서 바다 위를 비행하며 수면
frigatebird.description: The magnificent frigatebird is a large seabird with long, angular wings and a deeply forked tail. Males inflate a bright red throat pouch.

northern-gannet.name: Northern Gannet
northern-gannet.description: The northern gannet is the largest seabird in the North Atlantic. It nests in massive colonies on sea cliffs.

blue-footed-booby.name: Blue-footed Booby
blue-footed-booby.funFact: 짝을 유인하기 위해 밝은 파란 발을 번갈아 들어 올리는 춤
blue-footed-booby.description: The blue-footed booby is a marine bird famous for its vivid blue feet. Found along the Pacific coast of the Americas.

red-footed-booby.name: Red-footed Booby
red-footed-booby.funFact: 가장 풍부한 부비새 종이자 나무에 둥지를 트는 유일한 종
red-footed-booby.description: The red-footed booby is the smallest booby species, with distinctive red feet. It comes in several color morphs.

great-cormorant.name: Great Cormorant
great-cormorant.funFact: 깃털에 기름이 적어 잠수에 유리하지만 날개 건조가 필요
great-cormorant.description: The great cormorant is a large, dark waterbird found across much of the world. It spreads its wings to dry after fishing.

common-loon.name: Common Loon
common-loon.funFact: 뼈가 단단하여 부력이 적고 대부분의 새보다 잠수에 능숙
common-loon.description: The common loon is a large waterbird known for its haunting wail across northern lakes. Its solid bones help it dive deep.

arctic-tern.name: Arctic Tern
arctic-tern.funFact: 매년 극지방에서 남극까지 70,000km 이동, 가장 긴 이동 거리
arctic-tern.description: The Arctic tern migrates farther than any other animal. It experiences more daylight than any other creature.

caspian-tern.name: Caspian Tern
caspian-tern.description: The Caspian tern is the worlds largest tern, with a massive red bill and black cap. Found on every continent except Antarctica.

black-skimmer.name: Black Skimmer
black-skimmer.funFact: 아랫부리가 윗부리보다 길어 수면 위를 미끄러져 물고기를 잡음
black-skimmer.description: The black skimmer is a unique seabird with a distinctive uneven bill. It flies low over water, dragging its bill to catch fish.

herring-gull.name: Herring Gull
herring-gull.funFact: 눈 위 특수 샘으로 염분을 걸러내 해수를 마실 수 있음
herring-gull.description: The herring gull is one of the most common gulls in the Northern Hemisphere, thriving in coastal and urban environments.

laughing-gull.name: Laughing Gull
laughing-gull.funFact: 높은 사람의 웃음소리와 같은 울음소리에서 이름이 유래
laughing-gull.description: The laughing gull is a medium-sized gull with a distinctive black head in breeding season and a laughing call.

killdeer.name: Killdeer
killdeer.funFact: 다친 척하여 포식자를 둥지에서 멀리 유인
killdeer.description: The killdeer is a large plover with distinctive black breast bands. It is famous for its broken-wing display.

american-woodcock.name: American Woodcock
american-woodcock.funFact: 눈이 머리 양쪽에 있어 360도를 볼 수 있음
american-woodcock.description: The American woodcock is a plump shorebird with a long bill. It feeds on earthworms and performs an aerial sky-dance at dusk.

red-knot.name: Red Knot
red-knot.description: The red knot is famous for one of the longest migrations in the animal kingdom. It turns rusty-red during breeding season.

american-avocet.name: American Avocet
american-avocet.funFact: 위로 휜 부리를 물 속에서 옆으로 쓸어 작은 무척추동물을 잡음
american-avocet.description: The American avocet is an elegant wader with a thin, upturned bill and long legs. During breeding season, its head and neck turn rusty-orange.

black-necked-stilt.name: Black-necked Stilt
black-necked-stilt.funFact: 플라밍고에 이어 체격 대비 두 번째로 긴 다리
black-necked-stilt.description: The black-necked stilt is a striking wader with black upperparts, white underparts, and extraordinarily long pink legs.

willow-ptarmigan.name: Willow Ptarmigan
willow-ptarmigan.funFact: 계절에 따라 색상이 변함, 여름 갈색 겨울 순백
willow-ptarmigan.description: The willow ptarmigan is a game bird of the Arctic tundra that changes plumage with the seasons.

spruce-grouse.name: Spruce Grouse
spruce-grouse.funFact: 위험에도 거의 날지 않아 바보닭이라고 불림
spruce-grouse.description: The spruce grouse is a forest-dwelling game bird of the boreal region, known for its tameness.

ruffed-grouse.name: Ruffed Grouse
ruffed-grouse.funFact: 수컷이 빠르게 날개를 쳐서 드럼 소리를 내어 암컷을 유인
ruffed-grouse.description: The ruffed grouse is a popular game bird of eastern North American forests with a distinctive drumming display.

chukar.name: Chukar
chukar.funFact: 위험 시 비행보다 언덕을 오르는 것을 선호
chukar.description: The chukar is a rotund game bird native to Eurasia and introduced to North America with distinctive black and white barring.

common-crane.name: Common Crane
common-crane.funFact: 짝짓기 시 뛰기, 절하기, 날개 퍼덕이기 등 화려한 춤
common-crane.description: The common crane is a large, elegant wading bird with gray plumage and a red crown patch. Famous for its courtship dances.

demoiselle-crane.name: Demoiselle Crane
demoiselle-crane.funFact: 히말라야 이동 시 8000m 이상 고도에서 비행
demoiselle-crane.description: The demoiselle crane is the smallest crane species, elegant and graceful with a black neck and white ear tufts.

bearded-vulture.name: Bearded Vulture
bearded-vulture.funFact: 뼈를 먹고 높은 곳에서 떨어뜨려 삼킬 수 있는 조각으로 만듦
bearded-vulture.description: The bearded vulture is the only bird species that feeds almost exclusively on bones.

andean-condor.name: Andean Condor
andean-condor.funFact: 모든 맹금류 중 가장 큰 날개 폭, 3m 이상
andean-condor.description: The Andean condor is one of the worlds largest flying birds. It soars on thermal currents over the Andes mountains.

king-vulture.name: King Vulture
king-vulture.description: The king vulture is a large, colorful vulture with a vividly colored head and a white body.

turkey-vulture.name: Turkey Vulture
turkey-vulture.funFact: 모든 새 중 가장 후각이 뛰어나 수 마일 떨어진 사체를 감지
turkey-vulture.description: The turkey vulture is a large soaring bird with a red, featherless head resembling a wild turkey.

american-kestrel.name: American Kestrel
american-kestrel.funFact: 자외선을 보아 설치류의 소변 흔적을 추적
american-kestrel.description: The American kestrel is the smallest and most common falcon in North America. Males have slate-blue wings.

merlin.name: Merlin
merlin.funFact: 비둘기를 사냥하는 습성으로 한때 비둘기 매라고 불림
merlin.description: The merlin is a small, powerful falcon found across the Northern Hemisphere. It pursues small birds in direct flight.

prairie-falcon.name: Prairie Falcon
prairie-falcon.funFact: 직선 비행 시 시속 72km 이상 도달 가능
prairie-falcon.description: The prairie falcon is a large, sandy-brown falcon of the western North American open country.

gyrfalcon.name: Gyrfalcon
gyrfalcon.funFact: 세계에서 가장 큰 매, 한때 왕의 새로 지정됨
gyrfalcon.description: The gyrfalcon is the largest of all falcon species, found in Arctic regions. It was historically prized in falconry for royalty.

osprey.name: Osprey
osprey.funFact: 발가락을 앞 2개 뒤 2개로 나누어 물고기를 잡을 수 있음
osprey.description: The osprey is a large raptor found on every continent except Antarctica. It feeds almost exclusively on fish.

northern-harrier.name: Northern Harrier
northern-harrier.funFact: 올비마냥 얼굴 디스크로 소리로 먹이를 찾음
northern-harrier.description: The northern harrier is a slim raptor that hunts by flying low over open ground, using both sight and sound.

coopers-hawk.name: Coopers Hawk
coopers-hawk.funFact: 빽빽한 숲에서도 높은 속도로 먹이를 추적할 수 있음
coopers-hawk.description: The Coopers hawk is a medium-sized accipiter that specializes in capturing doves and songbirds in flight.

sharp-shinned-hawk.name: Sharp-shinned Hawk
sharp-shinned-hawk.funFact: 북미에서 가장 작은 매, 솔딱지보다 조금 큰 크기
sharp-shinned-hawk.description: The sharp-shinned hawk is the smallest accipiter in North America. A rapid, agile flier that hunts small songbirds.

swainsons-hawk.name: Swainsons Hawk
swainsons-hawk.funFact: 수십만 마리가 북미에서 남미로 대규모 이동
swainsons-hawk.description: The Swainsons hawk is a medium-sized raptor that migrates in enormous flocks to the pampas of Argentina for the winter.

rough-legged-hawk.name: Rough-legged Hawk
rough-legged-hawk.funFact: 발가락까지 깃털이 덮여 극지방 추위에 적응
rough-legged-hawk.description: The rough-legged hawk breeds in the Arctic tundra and winters in open prairies of North America.

ferruginous-hawk.name: Ferruginous Hawk
ferruginous-hawk.funFact: 북미에서 가장 큰 매, 날개 폭 1.5m 이상
ferruginous-hawk.description: The ferruginous hawk is the largest buteo hawk in North America with rust-colored upperparts.

white-tailed-kite.name: White-tailed Kite
white-tailed-kite.funFact: 먹이를 찾기 위해 오랫동안 공중에 머무름
white-tailed-kite.description: The white-tailed kite is a graceful raptor with white plumage, black shoulders, and a forked tail.

mississippi-kite.name: Mississippi Kite
mississippi-kite.funFact: 매미와 공중에서 잡은 곤충을 대량으로 먹음
mississippi-kite.description: The Mississippi kite is a small, elegant raptor with pearl-gray plumage that feeds primarily on insects caught in flight.

red-winged-blackbird.name: Red-winged Blackbird
red-winged-blackbird.funFact: 북미에서 가장 풍부한 새, 2억 마리 이상
red-winged-blackbird.description: The red-winged blackbird is one of the most abundant and widespread birds in North America with bright red and yellow shoulder patches.

brown-headed-cowbird.name: Brown-headed Cowbird
brown-headed-cowbird.funFact: 다른 새의 둥지에 알을 낳는 브루드 기생
brown-headed-cowbird.description: The brown-headed cowbird is a brood parasite that lays its eggs in the nests of other bird species.

common-grackle.name: Common Grackle
common-grackle.funFact: 햇빛 아래 보라, 녹색, 청동색으로 반짝이는 깃털
common-grackle.description: The common grackle is a large, lanky blackbird with iridescent plumage and bright yellow eyes.

great-tailed-grackle.name: Great-tailed Grackle
great-tailed-grackle.funFact: 수컷의 날개 폭 45cm, 긴 꼬리가 전체 길이의 절반
great-tailed-grackle.description: The great-tailed grackle is a large, noisy blackbird with a very long, keel-shaped tail.

yellow-headed-blackbird.name: Yellow-headed Blackbird
yellow-headed-blackbird.funFact: 수컷이 습지 내 작은 번식 영역을 방어
yellow-headed-blackbird.description: The yellow-headed blackbird is a striking songbird with a brilliant yellow-orange head contrasting with a black body.

eastern-meadowlark.name: Eastern Meadowlark
eastern-meadowlark.funFact: 서쪽_generate_와 거의 같지만 완전히 다른 노래를 가짐
eastern-meadowlark.description: The eastern meadowlark is a bright yellow songbird with a distinctive V-shaped black breast band.

western-meadowlark.name: Western Meadowlark
western-meadowlark.funFact: 6개 미국 주의 주조로 어떤 새보다 더 많음
western-meadowlark.description: The western meadowlark is a bright yellow songbird with a black V-shaped breast band, the state bird of six states.

orchard-oriole.name: Orchard Oriole
orchard-oriole.funFact: 북미에서 가장 작은 찌르레기과, 집참새보다 작음
orchard-oriole.description: The orchard oriole is a small, chestnut and black songbird. Males have a chestnut body with a black head.

bullocks-oriole.name: Bullocks Oriole
bullocks-oriole.funFact: 나뭇가지에 매달린 정교한 주머니 둥지를 짬
bullocks-oriole.description: The Bullocks oriole is a bright orange and black songbird of western North America that weaves hanging basket nests.

barn-swallow.name: Barn Swallow
barn-swallow.description: The barn swallow is the most widespread swallow species in the world with a distinctive deeply forked tail.

tree-swallow.name: Tree Swallow
tree-swallow.funFact: 열매를 소화할 수 있어 봄에 더 일찍 이동 가능
tree-swallow.description: The tree swallow is a small, iridescent blue-green swallow with white underparts.

cliff-swallow.name: Cliff Swallow
cliff-swallow.funFact: 수백 마리가 군집을 이루어 박형 점토 둥지를 건설
cliff-swallow.description: The cliff swallow is a small swallow with a pale rump and squared-off tail that builds enclosed mud nests in colonies.

purple-martin.name: Purple Martin
purple-martin.funFact: 동부 미국에서 거의 완전히 인공 둥지 상자에 의존
purple-martin.description: The purple martin is the largest North American swallow with iridescent purple-blue plumage in males.

bank-swallow.name: Bank Swallow
bank-swallow.funFact: 북미에서 가장 작은 제비, 모래 bank에 둥지를 틀음
bank-swallow.description: The bank swallow is the smallest swallow in North America, nesting in burrows excavated in sandy banks near water.

violet-green-swallow.name: Violet-green Swallow
