forest-cobra.name: 森林眼镜蛇
forest-cobra.description: 森林眼镜蛇是非洲最大的眼镜蛇，体长可超过2.5米。

veiled-chameleon.funFact: 雄性头上有高冠，可能帮助引导露水到嘴里
veiled-chameleon.name: 高冠变色龙

mountain-chicken-frog.funFact: 腿肉尝起来像鸡肉因此得名
mountain-chicken-frog.name: 山鸡蛙
mountain-chicken-frog.description: 山鸡蛙是加勒比海岛屿的大型蛙类，因过度捕捞而濒危。

spadefoot-toad.funFact: 能地下蛰伏长达九个月，仅下雨时出现
spadefoot-toad.name: 铲足蟾
spadefoot-toad.description: 铲足蟾是穴居的蟾蜍，后足有铲状突起适合挖掘。

natterjack-toad.funFact: 欧洲最响的两栖动物之一，叫声可超一英里
natterjack-toad.name: 黄条蟾蜍
natterjack-toad.description: 黄条蟾蜍是欧洲的蟾蜍，背部有黄色条纹，善于奔跑。

midwife-toad.funFact: 雄性将卵缠在后腿上直到准备孵化
midwife-toad.name: 产婆蟾
midwife-toad.description: 产婆蟾是欧洲的蟾蜍，雄性将卵缠绕在后腿上直到孵化。

european-tree-frog.funFact: 脚趾有粘性垫，能爬光滑表面包括玻璃
european-tree-frog.name: 欧洲树蛙
european-tree-frog.description: 欧洲树蛙是小型树蛙，脚趾有吸盘，善于攀爬。

leopard-frog.name: 豹蛙
leopard-frog.description: 豹蛙是北美常见的蛙类，身体有黑色斑点似豹纹。

strawberry-poison-dart-frog.funFact: 有超过30种颜色形态，从红腿到绿黄斑
strawberry-poison-dart-frog.name: 草莓箭毒蛙
strawberry-poison-dart-frog.description: 草莓箭毒蛙是中美洲的箭毒蛙，身体红色，皮肤含有毒素。

dyeing-poison-dart-frog.funFact: 因原住民用其毒素染布料而得名
dyeing-poison-dart-frog.name: 染色箭毒蛙
dyeing-poison-dart-frog.description: 染色箭毒蛙是南美洲的箭毒蛙，颜色变化大，皮肤含有毒素。

harlequin-toad.funFact: 许多种类被认为已灭绝，近年重新发现小种群
harlequin-toad.name: 丑角蟾蜍
harlequin-toad.description: 丑角蟾蜍是南美洲的蟾蜍，身体有鲜艳的花纹，皮肤含有毒素。

pickerel-frog.funFact: 产生的毒素能刺激人类皮肤，对其他蛙致命
pickerel-frog.name: 豹蛙
pickerel-frog.description: 豹蛙是北美常见的蛙类，身体有方形斑点。

cherry-tree-frog.funFact: 能根据环境从亮绿变棕色
cherry-tree-frog.name: 樱桃树蛙
cherry-tree-frog.description: 樱桃树蛙是小型树蛙，身体红色似樱桃。

asian-common-toad.funFact: 极适应性强，在东南亚人类改造环境中繁盛
asian-common-toad.name: 亚洲蟾蜍
asian-common-toad.description: 亚洲蟾蜍是亚洲常见的蟾蜍，皮肤有疣状突起。

clown-tree-frog.funFact: 因其在树间嬉戏般的杂技动作而得名
clown-tree-frog.name: 小丑树蛙
clown-tree-frog.description: 小丑树蛙是色彩艳丽的树蛙，身体有橙色和棕色条纹。

gliding-tree-frog.funFact: 能展开扩大的趾垫和蹼足在树间滑翔
gliding-tree-frog.name: 飞树蛙
gliding-tree-frog.description: 飞树蛙是中美洲的树蛙，趾间有蹼可以滑翔。

black-legged-poison-frog.funFact: 双亲共同照料卵和蝌蚪
black-legged-poison-frog.name: 黑腿箭毒蛙
black-legged-poison-frog.description: 黑腿箭毒蛙是南美洲的箭毒蛙，腿部黑色，皮肤含有毒素。

red-backed-poison-frog.funFact: 用鲜艳颜色警告皮肤毒素，称为警戒色
red-backed-poison-frog.name: 红背箭毒蛙
red-backed-poison-frog.description: 红背箭毒蛙是南美洲的箭毒蛙，背部红色，皮肤含有毒素。

splashback-poison-frog.funFact: 因背部色彩像泼溅颜料而得名
splashback-poison-frog.name: 泼溅箭毒蛙
splashback-poison-frog.description: 泼溅箭毒蛙是南美洲的箭毒蛙，背部有泼溅状花纹。

cane-turtle-frog.funFact: 扁平体形能藏在石头和木头下
cane-turtle-frog.name: 蔗蟾
cane-turtle-frog.description: 蔗蟾是澳大利亚的蟾蜍，善于挖掘，分布在干燥地区。

malaysian-horned-frog.funFact: 眼上方角状突起帮助在落叶中打破轮廓
malaysian-horned-frog.name: 马来西亚角蛙
malaysian-horned-frog.description: 马来西亚角蛙是东南亚的蛙类，头部有角状突起，善于伪装成落叶。

hampire-poison-dart-frog.funFact: 因黑白橙色斑纹像哈利波特角色而得名
hampire-poison-dart-frog.name: 汉彼箭毒蛙
hampire-poison-dart-frog.description: 汉彼箭毒蛙是南美洲的箭毒蛙，颜色变化大，皮肤含有毒素。

brazilian-horned-frog.funFact: 伏击捕食者，能一动不动数小时等待猎物
brazilian-horned-frog.name: 巴西角蛙
brazilian-horned-frog.description: 巴西角蛙是南美洲的蛙类，头部有角状突起，善于伪装。

hairy-frog.funFact: 繁殖季节雄性长毛状皮肤突起帮助从水中吸氧
hairy-frog.name: 毛蛙
hairy-frog.description: 毛蛙是非洲的蛙类，繁殖期雄性身体两侧会长出类似毛发的皮肤突起。

tomato-frog.funFact: 分泌浓稠白色物质能粘住捕食者的嘴
tomato-frog.name: 番茄蛙
tomato-frog.description: 番茄蛙是马达加斯加的蛙类，身体红色似番茄。

marsupial-frog.funFact: 雌性在背囊中携带卵，类似有袋哺乳动物
marsupial-frog.name: 有袋蛙
marsupial-frog.description: 有袋蛙是南美洲的蛙类，雌性将卵放在背部的育儿袋中孵化。

foam-nest-frog.funFact: 用后腿搅拌产生泡沫巢保护卵
foam-nest-frog.name: 泡沫巢蛙
foam-nest-frog.description: 泡沫巢蛙是非洲和亚洲的蛙类，在水面上方建造泡沫巢产卵。

surinam-toad.funFact: 雌性背皮中嵌入卵，幼蛙在那里发育
surinam-toad.name: 苏里南蟾蜍
surinam-toad.description: 苏里南蟾蜍是南美洲的蟾蜍，雌性将卵嵌入背部皮肤中孵化。

tiger-salamander.funFact: 最长寿的两栖动物之一，圈养可活超20年
tiger-salamander.name: 虎纹钝口螈
tiger-salamander.description: 虎纹钝口螈是北美最大的蝾螈之一，身体有黄色条纹。

eastern-newt.funFact: 幼体叫红色水蜥，鲜艳颜色警告捕食者其毒素
eastern-newt.name: 东方蝾螈
eastern-newt.description: 东方蝾螈是北美常见的蝾螈，皮肤含有毒素。

hellbender.name: 美洲大鲵
hellbender.description: 美洲大鲵是北美最大的蝾螈，体长可超过60厘米。

olm.funFact: 能超10年不进食，是最长寿的两栖动物之一
olm.name: 洞螈
olm.description: 洞螈是欧洲的穴居蝾螈，终身生活在黑暗的洞穴中，寿命可超过100年。

fire-salamander.funFact: 曾被认为生于火中，冰冷身体能灭火
fire-salamander.name: 火蝾螈
fire-salamander.description: 火蝾螈是欧洲常见的蝾螈，身体黑色带黄色斑点，皮肤含有毒素。

spotted-salamander.funFact: 与生活在细胞内的藻类有共生关系
spotted-salamander.name: 斑点钝口螈
spotted-salamander.description: 斑点钝口螈是北美东部的蝾螈，身体黑色带黄色斑点。

red-backed-salamander.funFact: 完全通过皮肤呼吸，成体无肺无鳃
red-backed-salamander.name: 红背蝾螈
red-backed-salamander.description: 红背蝾螈是北美东部最常见的蝾螈，背部有红色或灰色条纹。

mudpuppy.funFact: 有外鳃的水生两栖动物
mudpuppy.name: 泥狗
mudpuppy.description: 泥狗是北美终身水生的蝾螈，外鳃明显，以甲壳类为食。

rough-skinned-newt.funFact: 产生的河豚毒素足以杀死几个成年人
rough-skinned-newt.name: 粗皮渍螈
rough-skinned-newt.description: 粗皮渍螈是北美西部的蝾螈，皮肤粗糙含有剧毒的河鲀毒素。

alpine-salamander.funFact: 完全胎生，直接产下发育完全的幼体
alpine-salamander.name: 高山蝾螈
alpine-salamander.description: 高山蝾螈是欧洲阿尔卑斯山的蝾螈，能适应高海拔环境，胎生。

great-crested-newt.funFact: 繁殖季节雄性背部发育锯齿状冠
great-crested-newt.name: 大冠蝾螈
great-crested-newt.description: 大冠蝾螈是欧洲最大的蝾螈，繁殖期雄性有冠状背鳍。

marbled-salamander.funFact: 雌性会守在卵旁直到孵化
marbled-salamander.name: 大理石钝口螈
marbled-salamander.description: 大理石钝口螈是北美东部的蝾螈，身体有白色或灰色条纹。

long-toed-salamander.name: 长趾钝口螈
long-toed-salamander.description: 长趾钝口螈是北美西部的蝾螈，脚趾较长。

slimy-salamander.funFact: 皮肤分泌难以清除的粘性胶状物质
slimy-salamander.name: 粘蝾螈
slimy-salamander.description: 粘蝾螈是北美东部的蝾螈，皮肤能分泌粘稠的防御物质。

red-salamander.funFact: 北美最大的无肺蝾螈之一
red-salamander.name: 红蝾螈
red-salamander.description: 红蝾螈是北美东部的蝾螈，身体红色带黑色斑点。

lesser-siren.funFact: 能用鳃和皮肤呼吸，能钻入泥中度过干旱
lesser-siren.name: 小鳗螈
lesser-siren.description: 小鳗螈是北美南部的水生蝾螈，外形似鳗鱼，后肢退化。

greater-siren.funFact: 蝾螈科最大的种类，体长可超三英尺
greater-siren.name: 大鳗螈
greater-siren.description: 大鳗螈是北美最大的水生蝾螈，体长可超过90厘米。

three-toed-amphiuma.funFact: 退化的腿极小几乎看不见
three-toed-amphiuma.name: 三趾两栖鲵
three-toed-amphiuma.description: 三趾两栖鲵是北美南部的水生蝾螈，体型似鳗鱼。

waterdog.funFact: 终生保留外鳃，这种现象叫幼态延续
waterdog.name: 水犬
waterdog.description: 水犬是北美东部的水生蝾螈，外鳃明显，以甲壳类为食。

spring-salamander.funFact: 少数能终生生活在水中的蝾螈之一
spring-salamander.name: 春螈
spring-salamander.description: 春螈是北美西部的蝾螈，身体红色或橙色。

cave-salamander.funFact: 能用特化趾垫攀爬垂直岩面
cave-salamander.name: 洞螈
cave-salamander.description: 洞螈是北美洲的洞穴蝾螈，身体橙色带黑色斑点。

arboreal-salamander.funFact: 能爬树，有卷曲尾巴抓握树枝
arboreal-salamander.name: 树栖蝾螈
arboreal-salamander.description: 树栖蝾螈是北美西部的蝾螈，善于攀爬树木。

ensatina.funFact: 围绕加州中央谷地形成环形物种
ensatina.name: 环纹蝾螈
ensatina.description: 环纹蝾螈是北美西部的蝾螈，身体有环状花纹。

slender-salamander.funFact: 能卷成紧密螺旋以保持水分
slender-salamander.name: 细蝾螈
slender-salamander.description: 细蝾螈是北美西部的小型蝾螈，身体细长。

ringed-salamander.funFact: 秋季雨中迁徙繁殖，少数秋繁两栖动物之一
ringed-salamander.name: 环纹钝口螈
ringed-salamander.description: 环纹钝口螈是北美东部的蝾螈，身体有黄色环纹。

flatwoods-salamander.funFact: 有独特的深色十字纹帮助伪装
flatwoods-salamander.name: 林地蝾螈
flatwoods-salamander.description: 林地蝾螈是北美东南部的蝾螈，身体有条纹，是濒危物种。

dusky-salamander.funFact: 受威胁时能自断尾巴，尾巴继续扭动迷惑捕食者
dusky-salamander.name: 暗色蝾螈
dusky-salamander.description: 暗色蝾螈是北美东部的蝾螈，颜色暗淡。

four-toed-salamander.funFact: 后脚只有四个趾，不同于多数蝾螈的五个
four-toed-salamander.name: 四趾蝾螈
four-toed-salamander.description: 四趾蝾螈是北美东部的小型蝾螈，后肢有四趾。

gulf-coast-salamander.funFact: 少数能耐受微咸水的蝾螈之一
gulf-coast-salamander.name: 墨西哥湾蝾螈
gulf-coast-salamander.description: 墨西哥湾蝾螈是北美东南部的蝾螈，分布在墨西哥湾沿岸地区。

tropical-caecilian.funFact: 常被误认为蛇或蠕虫，实际是无肢两栖动物
tropical-caecilian.name: 热带蚓螈
tropical-caecilian.description: 热带蚓螈是南美洲的无足两栖动物，外形似蚯蚓。

boulengers-caecilian.funFact: 有微小退化眼，能感光但不能成像
boulengers-caecilian.name: 布氏蚓螈
boulengers-caecilian.description: 布氏蚓螈是南美洲的无足两栖动物，生活在热带雨林的土壤中。

ringed-caecilian.funFact: 有独特的触角感觉器官，帮助探测地下猎物
ringed-caecilian.name: 环纹蚓螈
ringed-caecilian.description: 环纹蚓螈是南美洲的无足两栖动物，身体有环状花纹。

luna-moth.funFact: 成虫无口不能进食，仅靠储存能量存活
luna-moth.name: 月神蛾
luna-moth.description: 月神蛾是北美洲最大的蛾类之一，翅膀绿色，尾部有长尾突。

atlas-moth.funFact: 按翼面积是世界上最大的昆虫之一
atlas-moth.name: 乌桕大蚕蛾
atlas-moth.description: 乌桕大蚕蛾是世界上最大的蛾类之一，翼展可超过25厘米。

swallowtail-butterfly.funFact: 雌性能拟态有毒的管道燕尾蝶避敌
swallowtail-butterfly.name: 凤蝶
swallowtail-butterfly.description: 凤蝶是色彩艳丽的蝴蝶种类，尾部有燕尾状突起。

hawk-moth.funFact: 最快的飞行昆虫之一，能像蜂鸟一样悬停
hawk-moth.name: 天蛾
hawk-moth.description: 天蛾是大型蛾类，善于悬停飞行采蜜。

painted-lady-butterfly.funFact: 迁徙穿越撒哈拉沙漠和地中海
painted-lady-butterfly.name: 小红蛱蝶
painted-lady-butterfly.description: 小红蛱蝶是世界上分布最广的蝴蝶之一，能进行长距离迁徙。

blue-morpho-butterfly.funFact: 蓝色不是色素而是微观鳞片的结构色
blue-morpho-butterfly.name: 大蓝闪蝶
blue-morpho-butterfly.description: 大蓝闪蝶是南美洲的大型蝴蝶，翅膀蓝色有金属光泽。

glasswing-butterfly.funFact: 因纳米柱结构翅膀近乎透明
glasswing-butterfly.name: 透翅蝶
glasswing-butterfly.description: 透翅蝶是中美洲的蝴蝶，翅膀透明可以看到背景。

cecropia-moth.name: 多音大蚕蛾
cecropia-moth.description: 多音大蚕蛾是北美最大的蛾类之一，成虫不进食。

io-moth.funFact: 每翅有大而醒目的眼斑驱敌
io-moth.name: 伊俄蛾
io-moth.description: 伊俄蛾是北美常见的蛾类，翅膀有大眼斑用于威吓天敌。

polyphemus-moth.funFact: 以独眼希腊巨人波吕斐摩斯命名
polyphemus-moth.name: 多眼蝶蛾
polyphemus-moth.description: 多眼蝶蛾是北美大型蛾类，翅膀有大眼斑似波吕斐摩斯的眼睛。

viceroy-butterfly.funFact: 拟态有毒的帝王蝶以避敌
viceroy-butterfly.name: 总督蝶
viceroy-butterfly.description: 总督蝶拟态帝王蝶以避免捕食，翅膀橙色和黑色。

red-admiral-butterfly.funFact: 领地性强，会驱赶其他蝴蝶离开晒太阳点
red-admiral-butterfly.name: 红将军蝶
red-admiral-butterfly.description: 红将军蝶是北半球常见的蝴蝶，翅膀黑色带红色和白色条纹。

great-spangled-fritillary.funFact: 毛毛虫专食紫罗兰，因此得名
great-spangled-fritillary.name: 大豹斑蝶
great-spangled-fritillary.description: 大豹斑蝶是北美常见的蝴蝶，翅膀橙色带黑色斑点。

clouded-yellow-butterfly.funFact: 强迁徙者，能飞行数百英里
clouded-yellow-butterfly.name: 硫磺蝶
clouded-yellow-butterfly.description: 硫磺蝶是欧洲和亚洲的蝴蝶，翅膀黄色或橙色。

comma-butterfly.funFact: 因后翅上白色逗号状标记而得名
comma-butterfly.name: 钩蛱蝶
comma-butterfly.description: 钩蛱蝶是欧洲和亚洲的蝴蝶，翅膀边缘呈不规则形状。

mourning-cloak-butterfly.funFact: 寿命最长的蝴蝶之一，以成虫越冬
mourning-cloak-butterfly.name: 孔雀蛱蝶
mourning-cloak-butterfly.description: 孔雀蛱蝶是北美最早的春季蝴蝶之一，翅膀深红色。

zebra-longwing-butterfly.funFact: 佛罗里达州蝶，能仅靠花粉存活
zebra-longwing-butterfly.name: 斑马长翅蝶
zebra-longwing-butterfly.description: 斑马长翅蝶是佛罗里达州的州蝶，翅膀黑色带黄色条纹。

snowflake-butterfly.funFact: 翅膀大部分白色，末端有精致黑边
snowflake-butterfly.name: 雪花蝶
snowflake-butterfly.description: 雪花蝶是北美洲的蝴蝶，翅膀白色带黑色斑点。

resurrection-butterfly.funFact: 在日本文化中被视为重生的象征
resurrection-butterfly.name: 复活蝶
resurrection-butterfly.description: 复活蝶是中美洲的蝴蝶，以枯木上的真菌为食。

cabbage-white-butterfly.funFact: 最常见的蝴蝶之一，也是著名的花园害虫
cabbage-white-butterfly.name: 菜粉蝶
cabbage-white-butterfly.description: 菜粉蝶是最常见的蝴蝶之一，幼虫为菜青虫，以十字花科植物为食。

atlas-beetle.funFact: 能搬运自身体重850倍的物体
atlas-beetle.name: 阿特拉斯大兜虫
atlas-beetle.description: 阿特拉斯大兜虫是东南亚的大型甲虫，雄性有巨大的角状突起。

goliath-beetle.funFact: 世界上最重的昆虫之一
goliath-beetle.name: 巨犀金龟
goliath-beetle.description: 巨犀金龟是世界上最大的甲虫之一，体重可超过100克。

rhinoceros-beetle.funFact: 能举起自身体重850倍的物体
rhinoceros-beetle.name: 独角仙
rhinoceros-beetle.description: 独角仙是大型甲虫，雄性头部有角状突起，以树汁为食。

stag-beetle.funFact: 雄性用巨大颚与对手摔跤竞争配偶
stag-beetle.name: 锹甲
stag-beetle.description: 锹甲是大型甲虫，雄性有巨大的颚状突起，以树汁为食。

dung-beetle.funFact: 用银河导航，是首批被发现使用星星的昆虫
dung-beetle.name: 屎壳郎
dung-beetle.description: 屎壳郎是能推粪球的甲虫，将粪球作为食物和产卵场所。

tiger-beetle.funFact: 跑得太快暂时失明，眼睛无法快速处理图像
tiger-beetle.name: 虎甲
tiger-beetle.description: 虎甲是凶猛的捕食性甲虫，善于奔跑，是世界上跑得最快的昆虫之一。

longhorn-beetle.funFact: 亚洲长角甲虫能通过蛀食树皮杀死健康硬木
longhorn-beetle.name: 天牛
longhorn-beetle.description: 天牛是大型甲虫，触角很长，幼虫蛀食树木。

click-beetle.funFact: 不用腿就能用咔嗒机制弹射到空中
click-beetle.name: 叩头虫
click-beetle.description: 叩头虫能发出咔嗒声并弹跳到空中，幼虫为金针虫。

bombardier-beetle.funFact: 从腹部喷射212华氏度的沸腾化学喷雾
bombardier-beetle.name: 气步甲
bombardier-beetle.description: 气步甲能喷射高温的化学混合物防御敌人，温度可达100°C。

june-bug.funFact: 飞行笨拙常撞窗户和墙壁
june-bug.name: 六月金龟
june-bug.description: 六月金龟是北美常见的金龟子，夜间趋光，幼虫为蛴螬。

whirligig-beetle.funFact: 四只眼：两只看水上，两只看水下
whirligig-beetle.name: 豉甲
whirligig-beetle.description: 豉甲是水面上的甲虫，能在水面快速旋转游泳。

diving-beetle.funFact: 翅壳下携带气泡在水下呼吸
diving-beetle.name: 龙虱
diving-beetle.description: 龙虱是水生甲虫，善于潜水，以蝌蚪和小鱼为食。

oil-beetle.funFact: 关节分泌油滴驱敌并能起水泡
oil-beetle.name: 芫菁
oil-beetle.description: 芫菁是能分泌芫菁素的甲虫，幼虫寄生在蜜蜂巢中。

bess-beetle.funFact: 通过摩擦腹部发出吱吱声交流
bess-beetle.name: 珍珠甲虫
bess-beetle.description: 珍珠甲虫是大型甲虫，身体黑色有光泽，幼虫以腐木为食。

bark-beetle.funFact: 山松甲虫爆发能一年杀死数百万英亩森林
bark-beetle.name: 小蠹虫
bark-beetle.description: 小蠹虫是蛀食树皮的甲虫，能传播真菌导致树木死亡。

sacred-scarab-beetle.funFact: 古埃及人尊圣甲虫为太阳神赫利俄斯的象征
sacred-scarab-beetle.name: 圣甲虫
sacred-scarab-beetle.description: 圣甲虫是古埃及崇拜的甲虫，推粪球的行为被象征为太阳的循环。

carrion-beetle.funFact: 能从一英里外用化学传感器定位死动物
carrion-beetle.name: 埋葬虫
carrion-beetle.description: 埋葬虫能将动物尸体埋入地下作为食物，为后代提供营养。

patrol-bess-beetle.funFact: 受惊时通过摩擦腹部发声
patrol-bess-beetle.name: 巡逻甲虫
patrol-bess-beetle.description: 巡逻甲虫是大型甲虫，以腐木为食，幼虫在腐木中发育。

eyed-click-beetle.funFact: 胸部有两个大眼斑惊吓捕食者
eyed-click-beetle.name: 眼斑叩头虫
eyed-click-beetle.description: 眼斑叩头虫能发出咔嗒声并弹跳，翅膀上有大眼斑用于威吓天敌。

rose-chafer.funFact: 能合拢鞘翅仅用后翅飞行
rose-chafer.name: 花金龟
rose-chafer.description: 花金龟是色彩艳丽的金龟子，以花蜜和花粉为食。

japanese-beetle.funFact: 释放聚集信息素吸引更多甲虫取食
japanese-beetle.name: 日本金龟子
japanese-beetle.description: 日本金龟子是北美入侵性害虫，以植物叶片为食。

colorado-potato-beetle.funFact: 世界上最具杀虫剂抗性的害虫之一
colorado-potato-beetle.name: 科罗拉多马铃薯甲虫
colorado-potato-beetle.description: 科罗马铃薯甲虫是马铃薯的重要害虫，已对多种杀虫剂产生抗性。

lily-beetle.funFact: 鲜红色，在绿叶上很容易发现
lily-beetle.name: 百合叶甲虫
lily-beetle.description: 百合叶甲虫是百合花的害虫，身体红色，以百合叶片为食。

elm-beetle.funFact: 能通过小裂缝进入室内，冬季在室内冬眠
elm-beetle.name: 榆叶甲虫
elm-beetle.description: 榆叶甲虫是榆树的害虫，以榆树叶片为食。

fire-ant.funFact: 蚁群能形成活筏在洪水中漂浮数周
fire-ant.name: 火蚁
fire-ant.description: 火蚁是入侵性蚂蚁，叮咬后引起灼烧般的疼痛，原产于南美洲。

leafcutter-ant.funFact: 新热带区最大的植被消耗者
leafcutter-ant.name: 切叶蚁
leafcutter-ant.description: 切叶蚁能切割树叶带回巢穴培养真菌作为食物，是自然界中的农业专家。

bullet-ant.funFact: 叮咬被评为世界上最痛的昆虫叮咬
bullet-ant.name: 子弹蚁
bullet-ant.description: 子弹蚁叮咬后疼痛似被子弹击中，是世界上叮咬最痛的昆虫之一。

army-ant.funFact: 数百万蚁群以巨大掠食纵队横扫一切
army-ant.name: 行军蚁
army-ant.description: 行军蚁是群居的蚂蚁，能形成庞大的蚁群迁徙。

trap-jaw-ant.funFact: 能以超140英里时速合拢颚
trap-jaw-ant.name: 陷阱颚蚁
trap-jaw-ant.description: 陷阱颚蚁拥有速度极快的颚部，能弹射到空中逃避危险。

weaver-ant.funFact: 用幼虫当活胶枪缝合树叶
weaver-ant.name: 织叶蚁
weaver-ant.description: 织叶蚁能用幼虫分泌的丝线将树叶缝合在一起建造巢穴。

honeybee.funFact: 单个蜂群需访问超22.5万朵花才能产一磅蜜
honeybee.name: 蜜蜂
honeybee.description: 蜜蜂是重要的授粉昆虫，能酿造蜂蜜，蜂群由蜂王、雄蜂和工蜂组成。

bumblebee.funFact: 能在比多数蜜蜂更低的温度下飞行
bumblebee.name: 熊蜂
bumblebee.description: 熊蜂是大型蜂类，身体多毛，善于buzz授粉，以花蜜为食。

carpenter-bee.funFact: 在木头中钻完美圆孔创建筑巢通道
carpenter-bee.name: 木蜂
carpenter-bee.description: 木蜂是大型蜂类，能在木材中钻洞筑巢，以花蜜为食。

paper-wasp.funFact: 用咀嚼的木纤维混合唾液筑巢
paper-wasp.name: 马蜂
paper-wasp.description: 马蜂是群居的胡蜂，能建造纸质巢穴，以昆虫为食。

yellow-jacket.funFact: 夏末群落可增长到4000或更多工蜂
yellow-jacket.name: 黄蜂
yellow-jacket.description: 黄蜂是群居的胡蜂，身体黄黑相间，性情凶猛。

bald-faced-hornet.funFact: 能从刺中喷射毒液数英尺远
bald-faced-hornet.name: 白脸大黄蜂
bald-faced-hornet.description: 白脸大黄蜂是北美常见的大型胡蜂，面部白色，能建造大型纸质巢穴。

european-hornet.funFact: 趋光性强，常在夜间飞入室内
european-hornet.name: 欧洲大黄蜂
european-hornet.description: 欧洲大黄蜂是欧洲最大的胡蜂，体长可超过3厘米。

tarantula-hawk-wasp.funFact: 拥有世界上最痛的昆虫叮咬之一
tarantula-hawk-wasp.name: 蛛蜂
tarantula-hawk-wasp.description: 蛛蜂是大型胡蜂，能捕猎蜘蛛作为幼虫的食物，叮咬极其疼痛。

cuckoo-wasp.funFact: 受威胁时能蜷成球，用装甲外骨骼保护
cuckoo-wasp.name: 蜂螺
cuckoo-wasp.description: 蜂螺是寄生性胡蜂，将卵产在其他胡蜂的巢穴中。

ichneumon-wasp.funFact: 产卵管可比体长更长，钻入木头到达甲虫幼虫
ichneumon-wasp.name: 姬蜂
ichneumon-wasp.description: 姬蜂是寄生性蜂类，将卵产在昆虫幼虫体内，是重要的天敌昆虫。

asian-giant-hornet.funFact: 能在数小时内消灭整个蜜蜂群
asian-giant-hornet.name: 中华大虎头蜂
asian-giant-hornet.description: 中华大虎头蜂是世界上最大的胡蜂，体长可超过5厘米。

sweat-bee.funFact: 有些汗蜂身体呈金属绿或蓝色，阳光下闪闪发光
sweat-bee.name: 汗蜂
sweat-bee.description: 汗蜂是小型蜂类，被人类汗液中的盐分吸引，以花蜜为食。

mason-bee.name: 壁蜂
mason-bee.description: 壁蜂是独居蜂类，用泥土筑巢，是高效的授粉昆虫。

mining-bee.funFact: 在巢穴入口创建小火山形土堆
mining-bee.name: 地蜂
mining-bee.description: 地蜂是独居蜂类，在地下挖洞筑巢，是重要的授粉昆虫。

golden-digger-wasp.funFact: 将蝗虫和蟋蟀麻痹喂养幼虫
golden-digger-wasp.name: 金掘土蜂
golden-digger-wasp.description: 金掘土蜂是大型蜂类，能挖掘地洞，捕猎昆虫作为幼虫的食物。

mud-dauber-wasp.funFact: 用麻痹的蜘蛛储备巢穴喂养幼虫
mud-dauber-wasp.name: 泥蜂
mud-dauber-wasp.description: 泥蜂是独居蜂类，用泥巴筑巢，捕猎蜘蛛作为幼虫的食物。

horned-mason-bee.funFact: 雄性脸上有用于求偶展示的小角
horned-mason-bee.name: 角壁蜂
horned-mason-bee.description: 角壁蜂是独居蜂类，头部有角状突起，用泥土筑巢。

wool-carder-bee.funFact: 刮植物绒毛铺巢，因此得名
wool-carder-bee.name: 切绒毛蜂
wool-carder-bee.description: 切绒毛蜂是独居蜂类，能从植物上切取绒毛用于筑巢。

cicada-killer-wasp.funFact: 北美最大的黄蜂，可超2英寸长
cicada-killer-wasp.name: 蝉猎蜂
cicada-killer-wasp.description: 蝉猎蜂是大型蜂类，能捕猎蝉作为幼虫的食物，是北美最大的蜂类之一。

red-velvet-ant.funFact: 实际是无翅黄蜂，有昆虫界最痛的叮咬之一
red-velvet-ant.name: 红绒蚁
red-velvet-ant.description: 红绒蚁实际上是无翅的雌性蜂，身体红色绒毛，叮咬极其疼痛。

cuckoo-bumblebee.funFact: 潜入其他熊蜂巢，产卵由宿主抚养
cuckoo-bumblebee.name: 寄生熊蜂
cuckoo-bumblebee.description: 寄生熊蜂是寄生性的蜂类，将卵产在其他熊蜂的巢穴中。

mosquito.funFact: 只有雌蚊叮咬，需要血液蛋白质产卵
mosquito.name: 蚊子
mosquito.description: 蚊子是吸血昆虫，能传播疟疾、登革热等疾病，分布广泛。

house-fly.funFact: 用脚尝味，能从数英里外探测食物
house-fly.name: 家蝇
house-fly.description: 家蝇是最常见的苍蝇，以腐烂有机物为食，能传播疾病。

fruit-fly.funFact: 遗传研究中最重要的模式生物之一
fruit-fly.name: 果蝇
fruit-fly.description: 果蝇是小型蝇类，以腐烂水果为食，是遗传学研究的重要模式生物。

crane-fly.funFact: 常被误称为巨型蚊子但不叮咬或吸血
crane-fly.name: 大蚊
crane-fly.description: 大蚊是大型蝇类，外形似蚊子但不吸血，幼虫生活在土壤中。

horsefly.funFact: 最快的飞行昆虫之一，时速达90英里
horsefly.name: 牛虻
horsefly.description: 牛虻是大型吸血蝇类，叮咬疼痛，以哺乳动物的血液为食。

bot-fly.funFact: 幼虫在人皮肤下发育，引起疼痛的脓肿
bot-fly.name: 皮蝇
bot-fly.description: 皮蝇的幼虫寄生在哺乳动物的皮肤下，以组织液为食。

hover-fly.funFact: 拟态蜜蜂和黄蜂但完全无害
hover-fly.name: 食蚜蝇
hover-fly.description: 食蚜蝇是益虫，成虫模仿蜜蜂，幼虫以蚜虫为食。

black-fly.funFact: 黑蝇群密集到能堵塞牲畜呼吸道使其窒息
black-fly.name: 蚋
black-fly.description: 蚋是小型吸血昆虫，能传播盘尾丝虫病，分布在世界各地的溪流附近。

damselfly.funFact: 休息时翅膀沿身体折叠，不同于蜻蜓
damselfly.name: 豆娘
damselfly.description: 豆娘是类似蜻蜓的小型昆虫，飞行时翅膀折叠，以蚊子为食。

blue-dasher-dragonfly.funFact: 能倒飞和像直升机一样悬停
blue-dasher-dragonfly.name: 蓝额疏脉蜻
blue-dasher-dragonfly.description: 蓝额疏脉蜻是北美常见的蜻蜓，雄性腹部蓝色。

emperor-dragonfly.funFact: 每天能吃掉与自身体重等量的昆虫
emperor-dragonfly.name: 帝王蜻蜓
emperor-dragonfly.description: 帝王蜻蜓是欧洲最大的蜻蜓之一，身体蓝色。

four-spotted-chaser.funFact: 春季最早羽化的蜻蜓之一
four-spotted-chaser.name: 四斑蜻蜓
four-spotted-chaser.description: 四斑蜻蜓是欧亚大陆常见的蜻蜓，翅膀有四个暗色斑点。

robber-fly.funFact: 能捕获并吃掉蜻蜓和蝗虫一样大的昆虫
robber-fly.name: 食虫虻
robber-fly.description: 食虫虻是凶猛的捕食性蝇类，能捕捉飞行中的昆虫。

marmalade-hoverfly.funFact: 每年迁徙横跨欧洲数千英里
marmalade-hoverfly.name: 橘色食蚜蝇
marmalade-hoverfly.description: 橘色食蚜蝇是常见的食蚜蝇，身体橙色和黑色，幼虫以蚜虫为食。

common-mosquito.funFact: 蚊子造成的死亡超过历史上任何其他动物
common-mosquito.name: 普通蚊
common-mosquito.description: 普通蚊是常见的吸血昆虫，能传播多种疾病。

biting-midge.name: 蠓
biting-midge.description: 蠓是小型吸血昆虫，叮咬后引起瘙痒，能传播病毒。

deer-fly.funFact: 被深色和二氧化碳吸引，类似蚊子
deer-fly.name: 鹿蝇
deer-fly.description: 鹿蝇是中型吸血蝇类，叮咬疼痛，以哺乳动物的血液为食。

cattle-bot-fly.funFact: 幼虫附着在牛的舌头和喉咙上，造成严重刺激
cattle-bot-fly.name: 牛皮蝇
cattle-bot-fly.description: 牛皮蝇的幼虫寄生在牛的皮肤下，是畜牧业的重要害虫。

orchid-mantis.funFact: 外形极像花朵，传粉者直接降落在它身上
orchid-mantis.name: 兰花螳螂
orchid-mantis.description: 兰花螳螂是色彩艳丽的螳螂，模拟兰花花瓣伪装，善于伏击猎物。

ghost-mantis.funFact: 外形像干枯的树叶，几乎隐形
ghost-mantis.name: 幽灵螳螂
ghost-mantis.description: 幽灵螳螂外形似枯叶，善于伪装，以昆虫为食。

leaf-mantis.funFact: 枯叶螳螂不规则体缘完美复制撕裂腐叶
leaf-mantis.name: 叶螳螂
leaf-mantis.description: 叶螳螂外形似树叶，善于伪装伏击猎物。

walking-stick.funFact: 蜕皮时能再生失去的肢体，某些种类产生有毒防御化学物质
walking-stick.name: 竹节虫
walking-stick.description: 竹节虫外形似树枝，善于伪装，以植物叶片为食，是拟态的典型代表。

giant-walking-stick.funFact: 持有世界最长昆虫的记录
giant-walking-stick.name: 巨竹节虫
giant-walking-stick.description: 巨竹节虫是世界上最大的昆虫之一，体长可超过30厘米。

american-cockroach.funFact: 能数周不进食，屏息40分钟
american-cockroach.name: 美洲大蠊
american-cockroach.description: 美洲大蠊是常见的蟑螂种类，体型较大，以腐烂有机物为食。

german-cockroach.funFact: 一只雌性一年可产多达30000个后代
german-cockroach.name: 德国小蠊
german-cockroach.description: 德国小蠊是最常见的室内蟑螂，繁殖力强，以食物残渣为食。

madagascar-hissing-cockroach.funFact: 通过特化呼吸孔用力呼气产生响亮嘶嘶声
madagascar-hissing-cockroach.name: 马达加斯加发声蟑螂
madagascar-hissing-cockroach.description: 马达加斯加发声蟑螂能发出嘶嘶声，体型较大，以腐烂水果为食。

oriental-cockroach.funFact: 有时被称为水虫，因为偏爱阴暗潮湿环境
oriental-cockroach.name: 东方蜚蠊
oriental-cockroach.description: 东方蜚蠊是常见的室内蟑螂，身体黑色，以腐烂有机物为食。

eastern-subterranean-termite.funFact: 地下白蚁群落可含数百万协作个体
eastern-subterranean-termite.name: 东部地下白蚁
eastern-subterranean-termite.description: 东部地下白蚁是北美最重要的害虫之一，以木材为食。

formosan-termite.funFact: 在地面以上筑巢，约五个月能消耗一根2x4木材
formosan-termite.name: 台湾乳白蚁
formosan-termite.description: 台湾乳白蚁是入侵性白蚁种类，以木材为食，能造成严重的建筑损害。

dampwood-termite.funFact: 北美最大的白蚁，不需要接触土壤
dampwood-termite.name: 湿木白蚁
dampwood-termite.description: 湿木白蚁生活在潮湿的木材中，以腐烂木材为食。

drywood-termite.funFact: 踢出叫 frass 的微小粪粒堆积在受感染木材下方
drywood-termite.name: 干木白蚁
drywood-termite.description: 干木白蚁能生活在干燥的木材中，以木材为食，是重要的害虫。

cicada.funFact: 周期蝉在地下13或17年后同步羽化，数量达数十亿
cicada.name: 蝉
cicada.description: 蝉是能发出响亮鸣声的昆虫，幼虫在地下生活多年，成虫寿命仅数周。

dog-day-cicada.funFact: 因在夏季三伏天出现而得名
dog-day-cicada.name: 伏天蝉
dog-day-cicada.description: 伏天蝉是北美常见的蝉类，在炎热的夏季鸣叫，以树汁为食。

masked-devil-cicada.funFact: 某些澳洲蝉种叫声超120分贝
masked-devil-cicada.name: 面具蝉
masked-devil-cicada.description: 面具蝉是澳大利亚的蝉类，面部有黑色斑纹，以树汁为食。

leafhopper.funFact: 褐飞虱单次跳跃可达体长70倍
leafhopper.name: 叶蝉
leafhopper.description: 叶蝉是小型昆虫，以植物汁液为食，能传播植物病毒。

spittlebug.funFact: 若虫产生泡沫唾液团叫杜鹃唾液保护自己
spittlebug.name: 沫蝉
spittlebug.description: 沫蝉的若虫分泌白色泡沫保护自己，以植物汁液为食。

aphid.funFact: 蚜虫无需交配即可产下多达80个后代
aphid.name: 蚜虫
aphid.description: 蚜虫是小型昆虫，以植物汁液为食，能传播植物病毒，是重要的农业害虫。

bed-bug.funFact: 能超一年不进食存活，对许多杀虫剂有抗性
bed-bug.name: 臭虫
bed-bug.description: 臭虫是吸血昆虫，夜间叮咬人类和动物吸血，是重要的卫生害虫。

kissing-bug.funFact: 因常在人睡觉时咬脸而得名
kissing-bug.name: 猎蝽
kissing-bug.description: 猎蝽是吸血昆虫，叮咬人类嘴唇附近，能传播恰加斯病。

stink-bug.funFact: 受扰时从胸部腺体释放恶臭化学物质
stink-bug.name: 蝽象
stink-bug.description: 蝽象是能释放臭味的昆虫，以植物汁液为食。

box-elder-bug.funFact: 秋季大量聚集在温暖的朝南墙壁上
box-elder-bug.name: 槭树蝽
box-elder-bug.description: 槭树蝽是常见的蝽类，以槭树汁液为食，秋季常进入室内。

water-strider.funFact: 因腿上锁住空气的微毛能在水面行走
water-strider.name: 水黾
water-strider.description: 水黾能在水面行走，利用水的表面张力，以落入水面的小虫为食。

giant-water-bug.funFact: 被称为咬趾虫，叮咬极其疼痛
giant-water-bug.name: 田鳖
giant-water-bug.description: 田鳖是大型水生昆虫，能捕猎蝌蚪和小鱼，以唾液注射消化酶。

american-grasshopper.funFact: 鸟蝗是强飞行者，迁徙时能飞行很远
american-grasshopper.name: 美洲蚱蜢
american-grasshopper.description: 美洲蚱蜢是常见的蝗虫，以植物为食，大量出现时能造成严重的农业损害。

desert-locust.funFact: 蝗群能覆盖460平方英里，含400至800亿只昆虫
desert-locust.name: 沙漠蝗虫
desert-locust.description: 沙漠蝗虫是能形成蝗灾的昆虫，大量聚集时能摧毁农作物。

mormon-cricket.funFact: 虽然叫蟋蟀，实际是盾背螽斯
mormon-cricket.name: 摩门蟋蟀
mormon-cricket.description: 摩门蟋蟀实际上是螽斯而非蟋蟀，能形成大规模迁徙群。

field-cricket.funFact: 雄蟋蟀摩擦翅膀鸣叫，可通过计数估算温度
field-cricket.name: 田蟋蟀
field-cricket.description: 田蟋蟀是常见的蟋蟀，雄性通过摩擦翅膀发出鸣叫。

katydid.funFact: 螽斯的歌声是超声波的，人类很难听到
katydid.name: 螽斯
katydid.description: 螽斯是类似蟋蟀的昆虫，以植物叶片为食，雄性能发出响亮的鸣叫声。

mole-cricket.funFact: 能游泳和飞行，是草坪高度流动的害虫
mole-cricket.name: 蝼蛄
mole-cricket.description: 蝼蛄是穴居昆虫，前足似铲适合挖掘，以植物根部为食，是农业害虫。

snowy-tree-cricket.funFact: 因鸣叫频率与温度相关被称为温度计蟋蟀
snowy-tree-cricket.name: 雪树蟋蟀
snowy-tree-cricket.description: 雪树蟋蟀是北美常见的蟋蟀，鸣叫声可用来测量温度。

human-head-louse.name: 头虱
human-head-louse.description: 头虱是寄生在人类头发中的虱子，以血液为食，能传播疾病。

body-louse.funFact: 通过DNA分析被用于追踪人类迁徙模式
body-louse.name: 体虱
body-louse.description: 体虱是寄生在人类衣物上的虱子，以血液为食，能传播斑疹伤寒等疾病。

human-flea.funFact: 能跳体长150倍，相当于人跳过摩天大楼
human-flea.name: 人蚤
human-flea.description: 人蚤是寄生在人类身上的跳蚤，以血液为食，能传播鼠疫等疾病。

cat-flea.funFact: 全球家养宠物上最常见的跳蚤种类
cat-flea.name: 猫蚤
cat-flea.description: 猫蚤是常见的宠物寄生虫，以猫和狗的血液为食。

oriental-rat-flea.funFact: 黑死病期间鼠疫的主要传播媒介
oriental-rat-flea.name: 印鼠客蚤
oriental-rat-flea.description: 印鼠客蚤是传播鼠疫的主要媒介，寄生在老鼠身上。

brown-recluse-spider.funFact: 毒液可引起需数月愈合的坏死性病变
brown-recluse-spider.name: 棕色遁蛛
brown-recluse-spider.description: 棕色遁蛛是毒性较强的蜘蛛，叮咬后可引起组织坏死。

wolf-spider.name: 狼蛛
wolf-spider.description: 狼蛛是不结网的蜘蛛，善于奔跑捕猎，雌性背负幼蛛。

jumping-spider.funFact: 所有蜘蛛中视力最好，能跳体长50倍
jumping-spider.name: 跳蛛
jumping-spider.description: 跳蛛是色彩艳丽的小型蜘蛛，善于跳跃捕猎，是蜘蛛中种类最多的一科。

orb-weaver-spider.funFact: 几乎每晚重建网，吃掉旧丝回收蛋白质
orb-weaver-spider.name: 圆网蛛
orb-weaver-spider.description: 圆网蛛能编织圆形的网捕猎昆虫，是最常见的结网蜘蛛。

peacock-spider.funFact: 雄性用彩色腹部瓣表演复杂舞蹈求偶
peacock-spider.name: 孔雀蜘蛛
peacock-spider.description: 孔雀蜘蛛是澳大利亚的小型跳蛛，雄性能展开色彩艳丽的腹部进行求偶舞蹈。

brazilian-wandering-spider.funFact: 毒性最强的蜘蛛，列入吉尼斯世界纪录
brazilian-wandering-spider.name: 巴西游走蛛
brazilian-wandering-spider.description: 巴西游走蛛是世界上毒性最强的蜘蛛之一，不结网，夜间活动。

emperor-scorpion.funFact: 紫外光下发出亮蓝绿光
emperor-scorpion.name: 帝王蝎
emperor-scorpion.description: 帝王蝎是体型最大的蝎子之一，性情温顺，以昆虫为食。

bark-scorpion.funFact: 北美最毒的蝎子，能爬墙和天花板
bark-scorpion.name: 树皮蝎
bark-scorpion.description: 树皮蝎是北美常见的蝎子，能攀爬墙壁和树木，叮咬有毒。

deathstalker-scorpion.funFact: 毒液含有正在研究用于癌症治疗的化合物
deathstalker-scorpion.name: 死亡毒蝎
deathstalker-scorpion.description: 死亡毒蝎是毒性最强的蝎子之一，叮咬可致命。

spotted-lanternfly.funFact: 能在几乎任何平面上产多达50个卵
spotted-lanternfly.name: 斑衣蜡蝉
spotted-lanternfly.description: 斑衣蜡蝉是入侵性害虫，以多种植物汁液为食，原产于亚洲。

wheel-bug.funFact: 因胸部独特的齿轮状冠而得名
wheel-bug.name: 轮蝽
wheel-bug.description: 轮蝽是大型捕食性蝽类，背部有齿轮状突起，以昆虫为食，是益虫。

sawfly.funFact: 幼虫像毛毛虫但有五对以上的腹足
sawfly.name: 叶蜂
sawfly.description: 叶蜂是类似黄蜂的昆虫，幼虫似毛虫，以植物叶片为食。

antlion.funFact: 幼虫在沙中挖漏斗陷阱捕蚂蚁
antlion.name: 蚁蛉
antlion.description: 蚁蛉的幼虫会挖掘漏斗形陷阱捕捉蚂蚁，成虫类似蜻蜓。

lacewing.funFact: 幼虫叫蚜狮，每周能吃200只蚜虫
lacewing.name: 草蛉
lacewing.description: 草蛉是益虫，幼虫以蚜虫为食，成虫翅膀透明似纱。

dobsonfly.funFact: 幼虫叫 hellgrammite，是水质良好的指示物
dobsonfly.name: 鱼蛉
dobsonfly.description: 鱼蛉是大型水生昆虫，幼虫为水生，以水生昆虫为食。

mayfly.funFact: 成虫口器退化不能进食，只活到交配为止
mayfly.name: 蜉蝣
mayfly.description: 蜉蝣是寿命最短的昆虫之一，成虫仅存活数小时至数天。

earwig.funFact: 蠼螋母亲守卫卵并清洁以防真菌生长
earwig.name: 蠼螋
earwig.description: 蠼螋是夜行性昆虫，尾部有钳状突起，以植物和小型昆虫为食。

silverfish.funFact: 最原始的无翅昆虫之一，4亿年几乎未变
silverfish.name: 衣鱼
silverfish.description: 衣鱼是原始的无翅昆虫，以淀粉类物质为食，常出现在书籍和衣物中。

firebrat.funFact: 偏好90华氏度以上温度，能耐受极热条件
firebrat.name: 家衣鱼
firebrat.description: 家衣鱼是类似衣鱼的昆虫，喜欢温暖的环境，以淀粉类物质为食。

jumping-bristletail.funFact: 最古老的昆虫之一，化石记录可追溯到4亿年前
jumping-bristletail.name: 跳蛃
jumping-bristletail.description: 跳蛃是原始的无翅昆虫，善于跳跃，以藻类和地衣为食。

snakefly.funFact: 幼虫能高速向后爬行以逃避威胁
snakefly.name: 蛇蛉
snakefly.description: 蛇蛉是捕食性昆虫，头部延长似蛇，以蚜虫为食。

cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.funFact: 某些杜鹃熊蜂种已被重新归类为与宿主完全不同的种
cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.name: 寄生熊蜂
cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.description: 寄生熊蜂是寄生性的蜂类，将卵产在其他熊蜂的巢穴中。

musk-bee.funFact: 受扰时产生独特的柠檬香味
musk-bee.name: 麝蜂
musk-bee.description: 麝蜂是独居蜂类，能分泌麝香味，以花蜜为食。

alkali-bee.funFact: 偏好含盐碱性土壤筑巢，能形成大规模聚集
alkali-bee.name: 碱蜂
alkali-bee.description: 碱蜂是独居蜂类，在碱性土壤中筑巢，是重要的授粉昆虫。

carpenter-ant.funFact: 不吃木头但挖掘木头建巢室
carpenter-ant.name: 木蚁
carpenter-ant.description: 木蚁能在木材中筑巢，以树汁和昆虫为食。

pharaoh-ant.funFact: 能在极小空间筑巢，以在医院传播疾病闻名
pharaoh-ant.name: 法老蚁
pharaoh-ant.description: 法老蚁是常见的室内蚂蚁，体型小，以食物残渣为食。

odorous-house-ant.funFact: 捏碎时闻起来像碎椰子
odorous-house-ant.name: 臭屋蚁
odorous-house-ant.description: 臭屋蚁受到干扰时会释放腐烂的气味，以食物残渣为食。

blue-ringed-octopus.funFact: 毒液含河豚毒素，足以杀死26人
blue-ringed-octopus.name: 蓝环章鱼
blue-ringed-octopus.description: 蓝环章鱼是世界上毒性最强的海洋生物之一，受到威胁时蓝色环纹闪烁。

mimic-octopus.funFact: 能模仿超15种不同物种包括狮子鱼和海蛇
mimic-octopus.name: 拟态章鱼
mimic-octopus.description: 拟态章鱼能模仿至少15种其他海洋生物的外形。

colossal-squid.funFact: 所有动物中最大的眼睛，直径达10英寸
colossal-squid.name: 大王酸浆鱿
colossal-squid.description: 大王酸浆鱿是世界上最大的无脊椎动物之一，体长可超过12米。

humboldt-squid.funFact: 也叫巨型鱿鱼或红色恶魔，因攻击性得名
humboldt-squid.name: 洪堡鱿鱼
humboldt-squid.description: 洪堡鱿鱼是大型鱿鱼，体长可超过2米，性情凶猛。

giant-squid.funFact: 2004年首次拍到活体前被认为是神话生物
giant-squid.name: 大王乌贼
giant-squid.description: 大王乌贼是世界上最大的无脊椎动物之一，传说中的海怪原型。

firefly-squid.funFact: 通过叫发光器的生物发光器官自体发光
firefly-squid.name: 萤火虫鱿鱼
firefly-squid.description: 萤火虫鱿鱼能发出蓝色的生物光，体长仅约7厘米。

caribbean-reef-octopus.funFact: 三分之二的神经元在臂中而非大脑
caribbean-reef-octopus.name: 加勒比珊瑚章鱼
caribbean-reef-octopus.description: 加勒比珊瑚章鱼是小型章鱼，能改变体色伪装。

flamboyant-cuttlefish.funFact: 仅知的两种有毒头足类之一
flamboyant-cuttlefish.name: 火焰花枝
flamboyant-cuttlefish.description: 火焰花枝是色彩艳丽的头足类动物，能在海底行走。

common-cuttlefish.funFact: 能用快速变化的颜色图案催眠猎物
common-cuttlefish.name: 欧洲墨鱼
common-cuttlefish.description: 欧洲墨鱼是常见的头足类动物，能迅速改变体色和纹理。

chambered-nautilus.funFact: 已存在超过5亿年，几乎未变
chambered-nautilus.name: 鹦鹉螺
chambered-nautilus.description: 鹦鹉螺是古老的头足类动物，拥有螺旋状外壳，被称为活化石。

argonaut.funFact: 雌性创造薄纸状壳保护卵，唯一这样做的章鱼
argonaut.name: 船蛸
argonaut.description: 船蛸是雌性有薄壳的章鱼，壳用于保护卵，能漂浮在海面上。

vampire-squid.funFact: 既非真鱿鱼也非真章鱼，占据自己的目
vampire-squid.name: 吸血乌贼
vampire-squid.description: 吸血乌贼是深海头足类动物，全身红色，以海雪为食。

strawberry-squid.funFact: 全身发光器产生草莓红色光伪装
strawberry-squid.name: 草莓鱿鱼
strawberry-squid.description: 草莓鱿鱼是深海头足类动物，身体红色似草莓。

cockatoo-squid.funFact: 吸入海水膨胀身体以显得更大
cockatoo-squid.name: 凤头鱿鱼
cockatoo-squid.description: 凤头鱿鱼是深海头足类动物，头部有鳍似凤头。

pajama-squid.funFact: 独特的黑白条纹图案像条纹睡衣
pajama-squid.name: 睡衣鱿鱼
pajama-squid.description: 睡衣鱿鱼是小型头足类动物，身体黑色带白色条纹似睡衣。

bobtail-squid.funFact: 在特化发光器官中培育发光细菌用于反照明伪装
bobtail-squid.name: 短尾鱿鱼
bobtail-squid.description: 短尾鱿鱼是小型头足类动物，与发光细菌共生。

pygmy-squid.funFact: 用鼻上粘性腺体附着海草叶
pygmy-squid.name: 矮鱿鱼
pygmy-squid.description: 矮鱿鱼是世界上最小的头足类动物之一，体长仅约2厘米。

american-lobster.name: 美洲龙虾
american-lobster.description: 美洲龙虾是大型龙虾，钳子巨大，以鱼类为食，是珍贵的食用海鲜。

european-lobster.funFact: 可重达28磅，欧洲水域最大甲壳类之一
european-lobster.name: 欧洲龙虾
european-lobster.description: 欧洲龙虾是大西洋东北部的龙虾，是珍贵的食用海鲜。

spiny-lobster.funFact: 没有大螯，用响亮的刮擦声驱敌
spiny-lobster.name: 刺龙虾
spiny-lobster.description: 刺龙虾没有大钳子，触角长，以海藻为食。

slipper-lobster.funFact: 有独特的板状触角，像拖鞋底
slipper-lobster.name: 蝉虾
slipper-lobster.description: 蝉虾是扁平的龙虾，触角呈铲状，以贝类为食。

mantis-shrimp.funFact: 能以.22口径子弹的力量出拳，打破水族箱玻璃
mantis-shrimp.name: 雀尾螳螂虾
mantis-shrimp.description: 螳螂虾拥有速度极快的前肢，能击碎贝壳甚至玻璃。

peacock-mantis-shrimp.funFact: 能看到16种颜色感受器，感知紫外线和偏振光
peacock-mantis-shrimp.name: 孔雀螳螂虾
peacock-mantis-shrimp.description: 孔雀螳螂虾是色彩最艳丽的螳螂虾，前肢速度极快。

spearer-mantis-shrimp.funFact: 有带倒刺的矛状附肢刺穿软体猎物
spearer-mantis-shrimp.name: 刺螳螂虾
spearer-mantis-shrimp.description: 刺螳螂虾前肢有刺状突起，用于刺穿猎物。

blue-crab.funFact: 因用于求偶展示的亮蓝色螯而得名
blue-crab.name: 蓝蟹
blue-crab.description: 蓝蟹是大西洋西部常见的蟹类，螯蓝色，是重要的食用蟹。

king-crab.funFact: 带刺的壳展开可达5英尺宽
king-crab.name: 帝王蟹
king-crab.description: 帝王蟹是大型蟹类，腿长可超过1米，是珍贵的食用海鲜。

japanese-spider-crab.funFact: 所有节肢动物中最大腿展，可达12英尺
japanese-spider-crab.name: 日本蜘蛛蟹
japanese-spider-crab.description: 日本蜘蛛蟹是世界上最大的节肢动物，腿展可超过3米。

hermit-crab.funFact: 成长过程中必须寻找更大的壳
hermit-crab.name: 寄居蟹
hermit-crab.description: 寄居蟹是使用空贝壳保护柔软腹部的蟹类。

coconut-crab.funFact: 拥有动物中最强的握力，能夹开椰子
coconut-crab.name: 椰子蟹
coconut-crab.description: 椰子蟹是世界上最大的陆生节肢动物，能爬树摘椰子。

snow-crab.funFact: 能耐受接近冰点的0.5度水温
snow-crab.name: 雪蟹
snow-crab.description: 雪蟹是北太平洋的大型蟹类，腿长，是重要的食用蟹。

fiddler-crab.funFact: 雄性有一只超大螯挥动吸引配偶
fiddler-crab.name: 招潮蟹
fiddler-crab.description: 招潮蟹雄性有一只巨大的螯用于求偶舞蹈。

mud-crab.funFact: 可长到5磅，螯强到能切断人手指
mud-crab.name: 青蟹
mud-crab.description: 青蟹是大型蟹类，螯强大，是重要的食用蟹。

atlantic-ghost-crab.funFact: 时速达10英里，柄眼提供360度视野
atlantic-ghost-crab.name: 大西洋幽灵蟹
atlantic-ghost-crab.description: 大西洋幽灵蟹是夜行性蟹类，善于奔跑。

tropical-hermit-crab.funFact: 有些个体成群超100只，链式共享贝壳
tropical-hermit-crab.name: 热带寄居蟹
tropical-hermit-crab.description: 热带寄居蟹是色彩艳丽的寄居蟹，使用空贝壳保护腹部。

coconut-hermit-crab.funFact: 常住在椰子壳中，长大后用椰子壳当庇护所
coconut-hermit-crab.name: 椰子寄居蟹
coconut-hermit-crab.description: 椰子寄居蟹是最大的寄居蟹种类，能使用椰子壳作为庇护所。

zebra-fiddler-crab.funFact: 雄性以物种特有的节奏挥动超大螯
zebra-fiddler-crab.name: 斑马招潮蟹
zebra-fiddler-crab.description: 斑马招潮蟹是色彩艳丽的招潮蟹，身体有黑白条纹。

great-spider-crab.funFact: 常装饰壳上海绵和藻类伪装
great-spider-crab.name: 大蜘蛛蟹
great-spider-crab.description: 大蜘蛛蟹是大型蟹类，腿长，以贝类为食。

swimming-crab.funFact: 后腿呈桨状，能快速游泳
swimming-crab.name: 梭子蟹
swimming-crab.description: 梭子蟹是善于游泳的蟹类，最后一对足呈桨状。

common-shore-shrimp.funFact: 能紧紧抓住岩石以抵御强浪
common-shore-shrimp.name: 滨虾
common-shore-shrimp.description: 滨虾是沿海常见的小型虾类，以藻类和有机碎屑为食。

antarctic-krill.funFact: 形成数十亿个体的群体，从太空可见
antarctic-krill.name: 南极磷虾
antarctic-krill.description: 南极磷虾是南极海域的关键物种，是鲸类和企鹅的主要食物来源。

pacific-krill.funFact: 北太平洋露脊鲸的主要食物来源
pacific-krill.name: 太平洋磷虾
pacific-krill.description: 太平洋磷虾是太平洋的小型甲壳类，是海洋食物链的重要环节。

atlantic-krill.funFact: 形成可延伸数英里、含数万亿个体的密集群体
atlantic-krill.name: 大西洋磷虾
atlantic-krill.description: 大西洋磷虾是北大西洋的小型甲壳类，是海洋生物的重要食物来源。

giant-amphipod.funFact: 能长到普通端足类的20倍大
giant-amphipod.name: 巨型端足类
giant-amphipod.description: 巨型端足类是深海的大型甲壳类，体长可超过30厘米。

giant-isopod.funFact: 能通过降低代谢率超5年不进食
giant-isopod.name: 巨型等足虫
giant-isopod.description: 巨型等足虫是深海的大型甲壳类，体长可超过50厘米，以腐肉为食。

lions-mane-jellyfish.funFact: 触手可超120英尺，与蓝鲸长度匹敌
lions-mane-jellyfish.name: 狮鬃水母
lions-mane-jellyfish.description: 狮鬃水母是世界上最大的水母之一，触手长度可超过30米。

portuguese-man-of-war.funFact: 实际上是四种特化生物的群体，非单一动物
portuguese-man-of-war.name: 僧帽水母
portuguese-man-of-war.description: 僧帽水母实际上是群居的水螅体而非水母，触手含有剧毒。

pacific-sea-nettle.funFact: 金褐色钟体和长拖触手使其成为最美水母之一
pacific-sea-nettle.name: 太平洋海刺水母
pacific-sea-nettle.description: 太平洋海刺水母是色彩艳丽的水母，身体橙色，触手长。

upside-down-jellyfish.funFact: 倒卧海底暴露共生藻类给阳光
upside-down-jellyfish.name: 倒立水母
upside-down-jellyfish.description: 倒立水母常倒置在海底，触手朝上，体内有共生藻类。

immortal-jellyfish.funFact: 能从成体退回到幼体水螅体阶段，逆转衰老
immortal-jellyfish.name: 灯塔水母
immortal-jellyfish.description: 灯塔水母被认为是生物学上永生的生物，能从成体逆转回幼体状态。

sea-wasp.funFact: 被认为是最毒的海洋动物，几分钟内可致人死亡
sea-wasp.name: 澳大利亚箱形水母
sea-wasp.description: 澳大利亚箱形水母是世界上毒性最强的水母之一，叮咬可致命。

compass-jellyfish.funFact: 钟体上有棕色V形标记，像罗盘
compass-jellyfish.name: 指南针水母
compass-jellyfish.description: 指南针水母身体有褐色的指南针状条纹，触手含有毒刺细胞。

fried-egg-jellyfish.funFact: 钟体极像煎蛋，黄色中心被白色包围
fried-egg-jellyfish.name: 煎蛋水母
fried-egg-jellyfish.description: 煎蛋水母身体中央隆起似蛋黄，周围白色似蛋白。

blood-belly-comb-jelly.funFact: 受扰时产生鲜红的生物发光
blood-belly-comb-jelly.name: 血腹梳水母
blood-belly-comb-jelly.description: 血腹梳水母身体红色，能发出生物光。

atolla-jellyfish.funFact: 受攻击时产生生物发光光轮，称为窃贼警报
atolla-jellyfish.name: 深海红水母
atolla-jellyfish.description: 深海红水母生活在深海中，能发出蓝色的生物光用于防御。

spotted-jelly.funFact: 半透明钟体上有独特的棕色斑点而得名
spotted-jelly.name: 斑点水母
spotted-jelly.description: 斑点水母身体有白色斑点，以浮游生物为食。

mauve-stinger.funFact: 能大量爆发干扰渔业和水产养殖
mauve-stinger.name: 紫水母
mauve-stinger.description: 紫水母是色彩艳丽的水母，身体紫色，触手含有毒刺细胞。

staghorn-coral.funFact: 每年能长8英寸，是生长最快的珊瑚之一
staghorn-coral.name: 鹿角珊瑚
staghorn-coral.description: 鹿角珊瑚是常见的造礁珊瑚，形态似鹿角，是珊瑚礁的重要组成部分。

brain-coral.funFact: 能活近千年，是最长寿的生物之一
brain-coral.name: 脑珊瑚
brain-coral.description: 脑珊瑚表面有类似大脑的沟回，是珊瑚礁的常见种类，寿命可达数百年。

elkhorn-coral.funFact: 因类似鹿角的宽枝而得名
elkhorn-coral.name: 鹿角珊瑚
elkhorn-coral.description: 鹿角珊瑚是大西洋的造礁珊瑚，因白化而濒危。

pillar-coral.funFact: 最稀有的珊瑚之一，自1998年以来佛罗里达无已知幼体
pillar-coral.name: 柱状珊瑚
pillar-coral.description: 柱状珊瑚呈柱状生长，因白化和疾病而极度濒危。

fire-coral.funFact: 非真珊瑚而是水螅群体，造成疼痛刺伤
fire-coral.name: 火珊瑚
fire-coral.description: 火珊瑚是水螅虫而非真正的珊瑚，触碰会引起灼烧般的疼痛。

blue-coral.funFact: 唯一有蓝色骨骼的造礁珊瑚，因骨骼中铁盐
blue-coral.name: 蓝珊瑚
blue-coral.description: 蓝珊瑚是能分泌蓝色骨骼的珊瑚，是受保护的物种。

mushroom-coral.funFact: 不同于多数珊瑚，自由生活能短距离移动
mushroom-coral.name: 蕈珊瑚
mushroom-coral.description: 蕈珊瑚是单体珊瑚，形态似蘑菇，能自由移动。

black-coral.funFact: 某些群体被测龄超4000年，是地球上最古老的生物
black-coral.name: 黑珊瑚
black-coral.description: 黑珊瑚是深海珊瑚，骨骼黑色，寿命可达数千年，是制作珠宝的材料。

sea-pen.funFact: 是锚定在沉积物中的珊瑚虫群体，受扰时部分种类发生物发光波
sea-pen.name: 海鳃
sea-pen.description: 海鳃是群居的刺胞动物，形态似羽毛笔，能发出生物光。

sea-whip.funFact: 某些种类产生用于癌症研究的化合物
sea-whip.name: 柳珊瑚
sea-whip.description: 柳珊瑚是群居的刺胞动物，形态似鞭子，是海洋生物的栖息地。

sunflower-sea-star.funFact: 最多可达24条腕，是世界上最大的海星之一
sunflower-sea-star.name: 向日葵海星
sunflower-sea-star.description: 向日葵海星是大型海星，腕足多达24条，以海胆为食。

crown-of-thorns-starfish.funFact: 每年能消耗10平方英尺珊瑚
crown-of-thorns-starfish.name: 长棘海星
crown-of-thorns-starfish.description: 长棘海星以珊瑚为食，大量出现时能摧毁珊瑚礁。

blue-sea-star.funFact: 亮蓝色来自可能防紫外线的色素
blue-sea-star.name: 蓝海星
blue-sea-star.description: 蓝海星是色彩艳丽的海星，身体蓝色，以藻类为食。

leather-star.funFact: 表面光滑有皮革质感，不同于多数海星的粗糙表面
leather-star.name: 皮革海星
leather-star.description: 皮革海星身体表面光滑似皮革，以有机碎屑为食。

common-brittle-star.name: 蛇尾
common-brittle-star.description: 蛇尾是常见的棘皮动物，腕足细长似蛇尾，善于快速移动。

giant-basket-star.funFact: 数千分支腕尖能困住浮游生物和小生物
giant-basket-star.name: 篮星
giant-basket-star.description: 篮星是大型蛇尾，腕足分支形成篮状，以浮游生物为食。

feather-star.funFact: 能有节奏地挥动羽毛状腕游泳
feather-star.name: 海百合
feather-star.description: 海百合是古老的棘皮动物，腕足似羽毛，能自由游泳或附着在物体上。

crinoid-feather-star.funFact: 能从基质脱离游泳，在条件不利时迁移
crinoid-feather-star.name: 羽星
crinoid-feather-star.description: 羽星是海百合的一种，腕足似羽毛，以浮游生物为食。

disk-brittle-star.funFact: 即使中央盘脱离也能再生整个腕
disk-brittle-star.name: 盘蛇尾
disk-brittle-star.description: 盘蛇尾是蛇尾的一种，中央盘较大，腕足较短。

purple-sea-urchin.funFact: 能用叫亚里士多德灯的特化颌钻入岩石
purple-sea-urchin.name: 紫海胆
purple-sea-urchin.description: 紫海胆是太平洋东部常见的海胆，棘刺紫色，以藻类为食。

long-spined-sea-urchin.funFact: 刺可超一英尺长，有轻度毒性
long-spined-sea-urchin.name: 长棘海胆
long-spined-sea-urchin.description: 长棘海胆棘刺极长，能控制藻类生长，是珊瑚礁生态系统的重要物种。

pencil-urchin.funFact: 粗钝刺像铅笔，不同于典型尖刺海胆
pencil-urchin.name: 铅笔海胆
pencil-urchin.description: 铅笔海胆棘刺粗短似铅笔，以藻类为食。

green-sea-urchin.funFact: 能活超30年，是最长寿的海胆之一
green-sea-urchin.name: 绿海胆
green-sea-urchin.description: 绿海胆是北大西洋常见的海胆，棘刺绿色，是重要的商业海产。

flower-urchin.funFact: 覆满花状结构叫叉棘，注入剧痛毒液
flower-urchin.name: 花海胆
flower-urchin.description: 花海胆棘刺似花瓣，色彩艳丽，但含有剧毒。

sand-dollar.funFact: 骨架上的花瓣状图案实际是五组管足
sand-dollar.name: 海钱
sand-dollar.description: 海钱是扁平的海胆，身体圆盘状，善于在沙中挖掘。

carpenter-sea-urchin.funFact: 特别强的牙能钻穿坚固珊瑚岩
carpenter-sea-urchin.name: 木匠海胆
carpenter-sea-urchin.description: 木匠海胆能在岩石中钻洞，以藻类为食。

fire-urchin.funFact: 有毒刺造成剧烈灼痛，像火蚁叮咬
fire-urchin.name: 火海胆
fire-urchin.description: 火海胆棘刺红色，含有剧毒，触碰会引起剧烈疼痛。

slate-pencil-urchin.funFact: 粗钝刺曾被用作书写工具
slate-pencil-urchin.name: 石笔海胆
slate-pencil-urchin.description: 石笔海胆棘刺粗短似石笔，以藻类为食。

tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.funFact: 能从体内弹出粘性有毒管足缠住捕食者
tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.name: 虎尾海参
tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.description: 虎尾海参是大型海参，身体有虎纹状花纹，以有机碎屑为食。

lolly-sea-cucumber.funFact: 有独特的管状身体，像棒棒糖
lolly-sea-cucumber.name: 棒海参
lolly-sea-cucumber.description: 棒海参是小型海参，身体似棒状，以有机碎屑为食。

pacific-sea-cucumber.funFact: 在亚洲菜系中作为珍贵食材被捕捞
pacific-sea-cucumber.name: 太平洋海参
pacific-sea-cucumber.description: 太平洋海参是重要的食用海参，以有机碎屑为食。

black-sea-cucumber.funFact: 受压时能脱离并再生内脏，称为排脏
black-sea-cucumber.name: 黑海参
black-sea-cucumber.description: 黑海参是大型海参，身体黑色，以有机碎屑为食。

teatfish-sea-cucumber.funFact: 最有商业价值的海参种类之一
teatfish-sea-cucumber.name: 乳参
teatfish-sea-cucumber.description: 乳参是重要的食用海参，身体有乳头状突起，以有机碎屑为食。

red-sea-cucumber.funFact: 用腹面管足在海底缓慢爬行
red-sea-cucumber.name: 红海参
red-sea-cucumber.description: 红海参是色彩艳丽的海参，身体红色，以有机碎屑为食。

christmas-tree-worm.funFact: 能在不到一秒内将彩色螺旋羽冠收回管中
christmas-tree-worm.name: 圣诞树管虫
christmas-tree-worm.description: 圣诞树管虫是色彩艳丽的多毛类动物，鳃冠似圣诞树，以浮游生物为食。

giant-tubeworm.funFact: 无口、无胃、无肠，完全依赖共生细菌获取营养
giant-tubeworm.name: 管虫
giant-tubeworm.description: 管虫是深海热泉的代表性生物，体内有共生细菌能利用硫化物。

feather-duster-worm.funFact: 羽毛状触手冠用于进食和呼吸
feather-duster-worm.name: 羽毛管虫
feather-duster-worm.description: 羽毛管虫是多毛类动物，鳃冠似羽毛，以浮游生物为食。

bearded-fireworm.funFact: 中空带毒刚毛接触即引起剧烈灼痛
bearded-fireworm.name: 火虫
bearded-fireworm.description: 火虫是多毛类动物，身体两侧有刺毛能注入毒素。

blue-glaucus.funFact: 利用储存气泡在水面张力上倒浮
blue-glaucus.name: 蓝龙海蛞蝓
blue-glaucus.description: 蓝龙海蛞蝓是色彩艳丽的海蛞蝓，身体蓝色，能漂浮在海面。

spanish-dancer.funFact: 因壮观的波浪状游泳动作像弗拉门戈舞者而得名
spanish-dancer.name: 西班牙舞娘
spanish-dancer.description: 西班牙舞娘是大型海蛞蝓，身体红色，在水中游泳时似舞者。

leaf-sheep.funFact: 少数能进行光合作用的动物之一，偷取藻类叶绿体
leaf-sheep.name: 叶羊
leaf-sheep.description: 叶羊是色彩艳丽的海蛞蝓，身体似绿色的小绵羊，能进行光合作用。

sea-butterfly.funFact: 拍动翼状壳延伸游泳，像飞行中的蝴蝶
sea-butterfly.name: 翼足类
sea-butterfly.description: 翼足类是小型浮游软体动物，有翼状的足能游泳。

sea-angel.funFact: 无壳的蜗牛，用优雅翼状动作游泳
sea-angel.name: 海天使
sea-angel.description: 海天使是透明的浮游软体动物，身体似天使，以翼足类为食。

sea-hare.funFact: 受威胁时释放紫色墨汁迷惑捕食者
sea-hare.name: 海兔
sea-hare.description: 海兔是大型海蛞蝓，头部有兔耳状的触角，能分泌紫色墨汁防御。

giant-clam.name: 砗磲
giant-clam.description: 砗磲是最大的双壳贝类，壳长可超过1米，体内有共生藻类。

geoduck.funFact: 能活超160年，是最长寿动物之一
geoduck.name: 象拔蚌
geoduck.description: 象拔蚌是大型双壳贝类，水管似象鼻，是珍贵的食用海鲜。

atlantic-surf-clam.funFact: 受惊时能用肌肉足将自己推出沙子
atlantic-surf-clam.name: 大西洋蛤蜊
atlantic-surf-clam.description: 大西洋蛤蜊是大型双壳贝类，以浮游生物为食，是重要的商业贝类。

bay-scallop.funFact: 能快速开合壳瓣游泳短距离
bay-scallop.name: 海湾扇贝
bay-scallop.description: 海湾扇贝是常见的扇贝种类，以浮游生物为食，是重要的商业贝类。

blue-mussel.funFact: 用强韧丝附着岩石，形成数千个密集群落
blue-mussel.name: 紫贻贝
blue-mussel.description: 紫贻贝是常见的双壳贝类，以浮游生物为食，是重要的商业贝类。

thorny-oyster.funFact: 壳上覆满长而尖的刺以抵御捕食者
thorny-oyster.name: 刺牡蛎
thorny-oyster.description: 刺牡蛎是壳上有棘刺的牡蛎，以浮游生物为食。

lion-paw-scallop.funFact: 因壳上类似狮爪的脊状彩色纹而得名
lion-paw-scallop.name: 狮掌扇贝
lion-paw-scallop.description: 狮掌扇贝是色彩艳丽的扇贝，壳上有似狮掌的花纹。

nautilus-pompilius.funFact: 壳遵循对数螺旋，自然界最完美的数学形式之一
nautilus-pompilius.name: 鹦鹉螺
nautilus-pompilius.description: 鹦鹉螺是古老的头足类动物，拥有螺旋状外壳，被称为活化石，生活在深海中。

paper-nautilus.funFact: 雌性创造精致薄纸状壳保护卵
paper-nautilus.name: 船蛸
paper-nautilus.description: 船蛸是雌性有薄壳的章鱼，壳用于保护卵，能漂浮在海面上。

atlantic-horseshoe-crab.funFact: 存在超4.5亿年，比恐龙还早
atlantic-horseshoe-crab.name: 大西洋鲎
atlantic-horseshoe-crab.description: 大西洋鲎是古老的节肢动物，被称为活化石，血液含有铜，用于医学检测，分布在大西洋沿岸。

japanese-horseshoe-crab.funFact: 蓝色血液含有鲎试剂，用于医学检测
japanese-horseshoe-crab.name: 中华鲎
japanese-horseshoe-crab.description: 中华鲎是东亚常见的鲎类，血液含有铜，用于医学检测，分布在亚洲东部的海域中。

indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.funFact: 唯一在亚洲沿海水域发现的鲎
indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.name: 南方鲎
indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.description: 南方鲎是东南亚的鲎类，体型较小，血液含有铜，分布在印度洋和太平洋的热带海域。

sea-squirt-tunicate.funFact: 比多数无脊椎动物更接近脊椎动物
sea-squirt-tunicate.name: 海鞘
sea-squirt-tunicate.description: 海鞘是固着生活的脊索动物幼体有脊索，成体固着在岩石上，以浮游生物为食，分布广泛。

marine-flatworm.funFact: 能从1/200体大的碎片再生整个生物
marine-flatworm.name: 海洋扁虫
marine-flatworm.description: 海洋扁虫是色彩艳丽的扁形动物，身体扁平，以有机碎屑为食，分布在世界各地的海洋中。

sea-pen-glow.funFact: 物理扰动时产生沿群体传播的生物发光波
sea-pen-glow.name: 发光海鳃
sea-pen-glow.description: 发光海鳃是能发出生物光的海鳃，形态似羽毛笔，生活在软海底，以浮游生物为食。

dodo.funFact: 来自毛里求斯的不会飞的鸟，17世纪因狩猎和入侵物种灭绝
dodo.name: 渡渡鸟
dodo.description: 渡渡鸟是毛里求斯特有的不会飞的鸟类，因人类捕杀和外来物种入侵而于17世纪灭绝。

woolly-mammoth.funFact: 与早期人类共存，遗骸仍在西伯利亚永冻土中发现
woolly-mammoth.name: 猛犸象
woolly-mammoth.description: 猛犸象是冰河时期的大型哺乳动物，全身覆盖长毛，约4000年前灭绝，是冰河时期的代表性物种。

passenger-pigeon.funFact: 曾达数十亿只，鸟群飞过能遮天数小时
passenger-pigeon.name: 旅鸽
passenger-pigeon.description: 旅鸽曾是北美数量最多的鸟类，因过度捕杀于1914年灭绝，最后一只名为玛莎。

tasmanian-tiger.funFact: 虽然叫虎，实际是有袋类，与袋鼠更近
tasmanian-tiger.name: 袋狼
tasmanian-tiger.description: 袋狼又称塔斯马尼亚虎，是已灭绝的有袋类食肉动物，最后一只于1936年在动物园中死亡。

quagga.funFact: 半斑马半马，仅前半身有条纹，最后一匹1883年死亡
quagga.name: 斑驴
quagga.description: 斑驴是已灭绝的南非亚种，上半身似马，下半身似斑马，因过度捕杀于19世纪灭绝。

pig.name: Pig
pig.description: The domestic pig is a stout-bodied farm animal raised worldwide for meat and known for its intelligence and social nature.
pig.funFact: Pigs are highly intelligent and can learn tricks like dogs

sheep.name: Sheep
sheep.description: Sheep are woolly ruminants raised for wool, meat and milk, known for flocking behavior.
sheep.funFact: Sheep can recognize up to 50 faces for years

goat.name: Goat
goat.description: Goats are hardy farm animals known for climbing and curiosity, raised for milk, meat and fiber.
goat.funFact: Goats have rectangular pupils for wide vision

horse.name: Horse
horse.description: The horse is a large domesticated hoofed mammal used for riding, work and sport.
horse.funFact: Horses can sleep both standing and lying down

donkey.name: Donkey
donkey.description: Donkeys are sturdy equids used as working animals, known for endurance and strong memory.
donkey.funFact: Donkeys have incredible memory and remember places for 25 years

chicken.name: Chicken
chicken.description: Chickens are domesticated fowl raised for eggs and meat, the most numerous bird on Earth.

duck.name: Duck
duck.description: Ducks are waterfowl raised on farms and found wild on ponds and rivers.
duck.funFact: Duck feathers are waterproof due to oil coating

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.description: Turkeys are large North American game birds domesticated for meat.
turkey.funFact: Turkeys can change head color with mood

alpaca.name: Alpaca
alpaca.description: Alpacas are South American camelids raised for soft fleece, similar to llamas but smaller.
alpaca.funFact: Alpaca fleece is 3x warmer than sheep wool

llama.name: Llama
llama.description: Llamas are domesticated camelids from the Andes used as pack animals and for wool.
llama.funFact: Llamas hum to communicate with each other

unicorn.name: Unicorn
unicorn.description: The unicorn is a legendary horse-like creature with a single spiraled horn, symbol of purity and magic.
unicorn.funFact: Unicorn horns were said to purify poisoned water

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.description: Dragons are legendary giant reptiles with wings and fire breath, guardians of treasure in folklore.
dragon.funFact: Dragons were said to hoard gold and breathe fire

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.description: The phoenix is a mythical fire bird that cyclically regenerates by rising from its ashes.
phoenix.funFact: The phoenix rises from its own ashes every 500 years

griffin.name: Griffin
griffin.description: The griffin has the body of a lion and head and wings of an eagle, a majestic guardian beast.
griffin.funFact: Griffins were said to guard gold mines

pegasus.name: Pegasus
pegasus.description: Pegasus is a winged horse of Greek mythology, born from Medusa and symbol of inspiration.
pegasus.funFact: Pegasus was born from Medusa's blood

mermaid.name: Mermaid
mermaid.description: Mermaids are half-human, half-fish beings who lure sailors with enchanting songs.
mermaid.funFact: Mermaid tears were believed to be pearls

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.description: The Kraken is a colossal sea monster resembling a giant squid, feared by sailors.
kraken.funFact: The Kraken was said to drag entire ships underwater

fairy.name: Fairy
fairy.description: Fairies are tiny winged folk who live in forests and use magic to protect nature.
fairy.funFact: Fairies were said to be 6 inches tall

t-rex.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
t-rex.description: Tyrannosaurus rex was a massive predatory dinosaur of the Late Cretaceous with tiny arms and powerful jaws.
t-rex.funFact: T-Rex had the strongest bite of any terrestrial animal

triceratops.name: Triceratops
triceratops.description: Triceratops was a horned dinosaur with three facial horns and a large frill for defense.
triceratops.funFact: Triceratops had three horns and a bony frill

stegosaurus.name: Stegosaurus
stegosaurus.description: Stegosaurus had distinctive kite-shaped plates along its back and spiked tail.
stegosaurus.funFact: Stegosaurus had a brain the size of a dog's

velociraptor.name: Velociraptor
velociraptor.description: Velociraptor was a feathered predatory dinosaur that hunted in packs.
velociraptor.funFact: Velociraptor was actually turkey-sized, not 2m tall

brachiosaurus.name: Brachiosaurus
brachiosaurus.description: Brachiosaurus was a giant long-necked sauropod that could reach high treetops.
brachiosaurus.funFact: Brachiosaurus was as tall as a 4-story building

pterodactyl.name: Pterodactyl
pterodactyl.description: Pterodactylus was a flying reptile with a wingspan up to 1m that soared over coasts.
pterodactyl.funFact: Pterodactyls were not dinosaurs but flying reptiles

ankylosaurus.name: Ankylosaurus
ankylosaurus.description: Ankylosaurus was an armored dinosaur covered in bony plates with a massive tail club.
ankylosaurus.funFact: Ankylosaurus had a club tail that could break T-Rex bones

brontosaurus.name: Brontosaurus
brontosaurus.description: Brontosaurus was a massive sauropod long thought to be Apatosaurus but now recognized again.

saber-toothed-tiger.name: Saber-Toothed Tiger
saber-toothed-tiger.description: Smilodon, the saber-toothed cat, had enormous curved canines for slashing prey.

hydra.name: Hydra
hydra.description: The Hydra is a multi-headed serpent of Greek myth slain by Heracles.
hydra.funFact: Cutting one head makes two more grow

cerberus.name: Cerberus
cerberus.description: Cerberus is the three-headed dog that guards the entrance to the Greek underworld.
cerberus.funFact: Cerberus guarded the gates of the Underworld

minotaur.name: Minotaur
minotaur.description: The Minotaur is half-man, half-bull imprisoned in the Cretan labyrinth.
minotaur.funFact: The Minotaur lived in a labyrinth on Crete

basilisk.name: Basilisk
basilisk.description: The basilisk is a legendary serpent king whose glance is lethal.
basilisk.funFact: Basilisk gaze could turn victims to stone

leviathan.name: Leviathan
leviathan.description: Leviathan is a colossal sea serpent of Hebrew mythology embodying chaos of the ocean.
leviathan.funFact: Leviathan could create whirlpools that sank ships

thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
thunderbird.description: The Thunderbird is a giant legendary bird of Native American lore that creates thunder.
thunderbird.funFact: Thunderbird wings were said to create thunder

kitsune.name: Kitsune
kitsune.description: Kitsune are nine-tailed fox spirits in Japanese folklore, shape-shifters of great magic.
kitsune.funFact: Kitsune gains a tail every 100 years, up to nine

nessie.name: Loch Ness Monster
nessie.description: Nessie is the legendary long-necked creature said to inhabit Scotland's Loch Ness.
nessie.funFact: First sighting of Nessie was in 565 AD

lop-rabbit.name: Lop Rabbit
lop-rabbit.description: Lop rabbits are domestic bunnies with long floppy ears, beloved as gentle pets.
lop-rabbit.funFact: Lop rabbits' ears flop due to a genetic mutation

persian-cat.name: Persian Cat
persian-cat.description: Persian cats are fluffy long-haired cats with flat faces, known for calm temperament.
persian-cat.funFact: Persian cats are one of the oldest cat breeds

corgi.name: Corgi
corgi.description: Corgis are short-legged Welsh herding dogs famous for cute looks and loyalty.
corgi.funFact: Corgis were herding dogs despite short legs

baby-otter.name: Baby Otter
baby-otter.description: Baby otters are incredibly cute pups that hold hands while sleeping to not drift apart.
baby-otter.funFact: Baby otters cannot swim at birth and must be taught

pika-cute.name: Pika
pika-cute.description: Pikas are tiny mountain hamster-like mammals that make hay piles for winter.
pika-cute.funFact: Pikas say 'meh' and collect tiny haystacks

fennec-cute.name: Fennec Fox
fennec-cute.description: Fennec foxes are desert foxes with enormous ears, often called the cutest fox.
fennec-cute.funFact: Fennec fox kits have oversized ears like their parents

quokka-cute.name: Quokka
quokka-cute.description: Quokkas are small marsupials from Australia famous for selfies and smiles.
quokka-cute.funFact: Quokkas always look like they are smiling

axolotl-cute.name: Axolotl
axolotl-cute.description: Axolotls are cute neotenic salamanders that keep external gills and smile.
axolotl-cute.funFact: Axolotls can regenerate their hearts and brains

hedgehog-cute.name: Hedgehog
hedgehog-cute.description: Hedgehogs are small spiny mammals that curl up when scared, adored for cuteness.
hedgehog-cute.funFact: Hedgehogs have 5000 spines and curl into a ball

sugar-glider-cute.name: Sugar Glider
sugar-glider-cute.description: Sugar gliders are tiny marsupials with a membrane that lets them glide, big-eyed and cute.
sugar-glider-cute.funFact: Sugar gliders can glide 50 meters between trees

centaur.name: Centaur
centaur.description: The centaur is half-human, half-horse, known for wisdom and archery in Greek mythology.
centaur.funFact: Centaurs were expert archers and healers

satyr.name: Satyr
satyr.description: Satyrs are half-goat, half-human forest spirits who love music and revelry.
satyr.funFact: Satyrs played flutes that enchanted travelers

wyvern.name: Wyvern
wyvern.description: The wyvern is a winged dragon with two legs and a barbed tail, often guarding castles.
wyvern.funFact: Wyverns have two legs unlike four-legged dragons

djinn.name: Djinn
djinn.description: Djinn are magical smoke-formed beings from Arabian lore who inhabit deserts and grant wishes.
djinn.funFact: Djinn were said to grant three wishes

golem.name: Golem
golem.description: The golem is a clay giant brought to life by Hebrew magic to protect its creator.
golem.funFact: Golems are animated by a word on their forehead

banshee.name: Banshee
banshee.description: The banshee is a wailing female spirit from Irish folklore whose cry warns of death.
banshee.funFact: Hearing a banshee wail foretold death

leprechaun.name: Leprechaun
leprechaun.description: Leprechauns are tiny shoemaking fairies from Irish myth who hide pots of gold.
leprechaun.funFact: Leprechauns hide gold at the end of rainbows

nymph.name: Nymph
nymph.description: Nymphs are nature spirits inhabiting rivers, trees and mountains in Greek lore.
nymph.funFact: Nymphs could live inside trees or rivers

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.description: The werewolf is a human cursed to become a wolf under the full moon.

yeti.name: Yeti
yeti.description: The Yeti, or Abominable Snowman, is a giant ape-like cryptid of the Himalayas.
yeti.funFact: Yeti footprints can be 45 cm long

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.description: Goblins are small, clever, green-skinned tricksters living in caves and mines.
goblin.funFact: Goblins were master miners and craftsmen

troll.name: Troll
troll.description: Trolls are giant, slow-witted brutes who live under bridges and mountains.
troll.funFact: Trolls turn to stone in sunlight

roc.name: Roc
roc.description: The Roc is a gigantic bird of Arabian myth so large it can carry elephants.
roc.funFact: Roc eggs were said to be 15 meters around

sphinx.name: Sphinx
sphinx.description: The Sphinx has a lion's body, human head and eagle wings, guardian of riddles.
sphinx.funFact: The Sphinx asked riddles to travelers

chimera.name: Chimera
chimera.description: The Chimera is a fire-breathing hybrid of lion, goat and serpent from Greek myth.
chimera.funFact: Chimera had a lion head, goat body and snake tail

siren.name: Siren
siren.description: Sirens are enchanting half-bird, half-women whose songs doom sailors.
siren.funFact: Sirens lured sailors to shipwreck with songs

harpy.name: Harpy
harpy.description: The Harpy is half-woman, half-bird, a swift wind spirit that steals offerings.
harpy.funFact: Harpies were winds spirits that snatched souls

garuda.name: Garuda
garuda.description: Garuda is a giant eagle-like deity, mount of Vishnu and enemy of serpents.
garuda.funFact: Garuda is the king of birds in Hindu myth

qilin.name: Qilin
qilin.description: The Qilin is a gentle Chinese unicorn-deer with dragon scales that brings good fortune.
qilin.funFact: Qilin appears only during peaceful reigns

fenrir.name: Fenrir
fenrir.description: Fenrir is the monstrous wolf of Norse myth destined to devour Odin at Ragnarok.
fenrir.funFact: Fenrir was chained by the gods with magic ribbon

jormungandr.name: Jörmungandr
jormungandr.description: Jörmungandr is the World Serpent of Norse myth, so huge it bites its own tail around Earth.

cyclops.name: Cyclops
cyclops.description: The Cyclops is a one-eyed giant blacksmith of Greek myth who forged divine weapons.

medusa.name: Medusa
medusa.description: Medusa is a Gorgon with snakes for hair whose gaze petrifies victims.
medusa.funFact: Medusa's gaze turned people to stone

anubis.name: Anubis
anubis.description: Anubis is the jackal-headed Egyptian god who guides souls to the afterlife.
anubis.funFact: Anubis weighed hearts against a feather

allosaurus.name: Allosaurus
allosaurus.description: Allosaurus was the top predator of Jurassic North America before T. rex.
allosaurus.funFact: Allosaurus had 32 teeth shaped like steak knives

spinosaurus.name: Spinosaurus
spinosaurus.description: Spinosaurus was a semi-aquatic fish-eating dinosaur larger than T. rex with a distinctive sail.
spinosaurus.funFact: Spinosaurus had a sail 1.8m tall on its back

diplodocus.name: Diplodocus
diplodocus.description: Diplodocus was an extremely long-necked sauropod with a whip-like tail.
diplodocus.funFact: Diplodocus had a tail with 80 vertebrae

parasaurolophus.name: Parasaurolophus
parasaurolophus.description: Parasaurolophus was a crested hadrosaur that could make loud calls through its hollow crest.
parasaurolophus.funFact: Its crest acted like a trumpet

iguanodon.name: Iguanodon
iguanodon.description: Iguanodon was one of the first dinosaurs discovered, with distinctive thumb spikes.
iguanodon.funFact: Iguanodon had thumb spikes for defense

archaeopteryx.name: Archaeopteryx
archaeopteryx.description: Archaeopteryx was a feathered dinosaur-bird that could glide between trees 150 million years ago.
archaeopteryx.funFact: Archaeopteryx is the earliest known bird

mosasaurus.name: Mosasaurus
mosasaurus.description: Mosasaurus was a giant marine reptile that ruled Late Cretaceous seas.
mosasaurus.funFact: Mosasaurus had double-hinged jaws like a snake

plesiosaurus.name: Plesiosaurus
plesiosaurus.description: Plesiosaurus was a long-necked marine reptile that swam with four powerful flippers.
plesiosaurus.funFact: Plesiosaurus had four flippers and a long neck

dimetrodon.name: Dimetrodon
dimetrodon.description: Dimetrodon was a sail-backed synapsid predator that lived 40 million years before T. rex.

woolly-rhino.name: Woolly Rhino
woolly-rhino.description: The woolly rhinoceros was a shaggy-coated rhino that roamed Ice Age Eurasia alongside mammoths.

irish-elk.name: Irish Elk
irish-elk.description: Irish Elk was the largest deer ever, with enormous antlers that spanned over 3 meters.

dire-wolf.name: Dire Wolf
dire-wolf.description: Dire Wolf was a large Ice Age wolf that hunted in packs across North America.
dire-wolf.funFact: Dire wolves were 30% heavier than gray wolves

painted-frog.name: 彩蛙
painted-frog.description: 彩蛙是一種中等體型的青蛙，分佈在地中海地區。

african-elephant.funFact: 地球上最大的陸地動物
african-elephant.name: 非洲象
african-elephant.description: 非洲象是一種哺乳動物。The African elephant is the largest living terrestrial animal, distinguished by its massive size, long trunk, and impressive tusks.

lion.funFact: 唯一群居生活的貓科動物
lion.name: 獅子
lion.description: 獅子是一種哺乳動物。The lion is a social big cat, the only one to live in groups called prides.

tiger.name: 老虎
tiger.description: 老虎是一種哺乳動物。The tiger is the largest living cat species, with distinctive orange coat and black stripes.

giraffe.name: 長頸鹿
giraffe.description: 長頸鹿是一種哺乳動物。The giraffe is the tallest living terrestrial animal, using its long neck to reach high branches.

asian-elephant.name: 亞洲象
asian-elephant.description: 亞洲象是一種哺乳動物。The Asian elephant is smaller than its African cousin, with smaller ears and a more domed head.

white-rhinoceros.name: 白犀牛
white-rhinoceros.description: 白犀牛是一種哺乳動物。The white rhinoceros is the largest of the five rhino species, known for its wide mouth adapted for grazing.

black-rhinoceros.funFact: 受到威脅時非常具有攻擊性
black-rhinoceros.name: 黑犀牛
black-rhinoceros.description: 黑犀牛是一種哺乳動物。The black rhinoceros is a browser with a hooked upper lip, known for its aggressive temperament.

hippopotamus.funFact: 能在水下屏住呼吸5分鐘
hippopotamus.name: 河馬
hippopotamus.description: 河馬是一種哺乳動物。The hippopotamus is a large semi-aquatic mammal that spends most of its day in water to keep cool.

cape-buffalo.name: 非洲水牛
cape-buffalo.description: 非洲水牛是一種哺乳動物。The Cape buffalo is a large bovid known for its unpredictable nature and massive curved horns.

american-bison.funFact: 曾經在北美有3000萬到6000萬頭
american-bison.name: 美洲野牛
american-bison.description: 美洲野牛是一種哺乳動物。The American bison is the largest land mammal in North America, once roaming the Great Plains in massive herds.

water-buffalo.funFact: 亞洲水稻種植不可缺少
water-buffalo.name: 水牛
water-buffalo.description: 水牛是一種哺乳動物。The water buffalo is a large bovid widely used in agriculture throughout Asia.

leopard.funFact: 能將體重兩倍的獵物拖上樹
leopard.name: 花豹
leopard.description: 花豹是一種哺乳動物。The leopard is a powerful, agile big cat known for its rosette-patterned coat.

snow-leopard.funFact: 不能像其他大貓一樣咆哮
snow-leopard.name: 雪豹
snow-leopard.description: 雪豹是一種哺乳動物。The snow leopard is a solitary big cat adapted to life in cold, mountainous regions of Central Asia.

jaguar.funFact: 咬合力在所有大貓中最強
jaguar.name: 美洲豹
jaguar.description: 美洲豹是一種哺乳動物。The jaguar is a stocky, muscular cat with a powerful bite, capable of piercing turtle shells.

cougar.funFact: 也被稱為美洲獅或山獅
cougar.name: 美洲獅
cougar.description: 美洲獅是一種哺乳動物。The cougar is a large cat native to the Americas, known by many names including puma and mountain lion.

brown-bear.name: 棕熊
brown-bear.description: 棕熊是一種哺乳動物。The brown bear is one of the largest bear species, found across North America, Europe, and Asia.

grizzly-bear.name: 灰熊
grizzly-bear.description: 灰熊是一種哺乳動物。The grizzly bear is a North American subspecies of brown bear, known for its distinctive shoulder hump.

polar-bear.funFact: 游泳健將，可以連續游好幾天
polar-bear.name: 北極熊
polar-bear.description: 北極熊是一種哺乳動物。The polar bear is a large bear native to the Arctic, adapted to life on sea ice.

giant-panda.name: 大熊貓
giant-panda.description: 大熊貓是一種哺乳動物。The giant panda is a bear native to China, famous for its black and white coloring and bamboo diet.

gray-wolf.name: 灰狼
gray-wolf.description: 灰狼是一種哺乳動物。The gray wolf is the largest wild member of the canine family, living in packs.

red-fox.funFact: 分布最廣的野生食肉動物
red-fox.name: 赤狐
red-fox.description: 赤狐是一種哺乳動物。The red fox is the largest true fox, found across the entire Northern Hemisphere.

fennec-fox.name: 耳廓狐
fennec-fox.description: 耳廓狐是一種哺乳動物。The fennec fox is the smallest fox, with enormous ears that help regulate body temperature.

arctic-fox.name: 北極狐
arctic-fox.description: 北極狐是一種哺乳動物。The Arctic fox has a white coat in winter and brown in summer for camouflage.

coyote.name: 郊狼
coyote.description: 郊狼是一種哺乳動物。The coyote is a highly adaptable canid found throughout North America.

dingo.funFact: 澳大利亞最大的陸地捕食者
dingo.name: 澳洲野犬
dingo.description: 澳洲野犬是一種哺乳動物。The dingo is a wild dog found in Australia, believed to have arrived with humans 4000 years ago.

chimpanzee.name: 黑猩猩
chimpanzee.description: 黑猩猩是一種哺乳動物。The chimpanzee is our closest living relative, sharing about 98% of our DNA.

orangutan.name: 紅毛猩猩
orangutan.description: 紅毛猩猩是一種哺乳動物。Orangutans are highly intelligent great apes that spend most of their time in trees.

blue-whale.funFact: 地球上存在過的最大動物
blue-whale.name: 藍鯨
blue-whale.description: 藍鯨是一種哺乳動物。The blue whale is the largest animal ever to have lived, with a heart the size of a small car.

humpback-whale.name: 座頭鯨
humpback-whale.description: 座頭鯨是一種哺乳動物。The humpback whale is known for its spectacular breaching and complex vocalizations.

killer-whale.name: 虎鯨
killer-whale.description: 虎鯨是一種哺乳動物。The killer whale or orca is the largest member of the dolphin family.

bottlenose-dolphin.name: 寬吻海豚
bottlenose-dolphin.description: 寬吻海豚是一種哺乳動物。The bottlenose dolphin is one of the most well-known and intelligent marine mammals.

narwhal.funFact: 有長長的螺旋狀長牙（改造的牙齒）
narwhal.name: 獨角鯨
narwhal.description: 獨角鯨是一種哺乳動物。The narwhal is an Arctic whale known for its long, spiral tusk.

beluga-whale.name: 白鯨
beluga-whale.description: 白鯨是一種哺乳動物。The beluga whale is a small, white Arctic whale known for its expressive face.

manatee.name: 海牛
manatee.description: 海牛是一種哺乳動物。Manatees are gentle, herbivorous marine mammals that inhabit shallow coastal waters.

walrus.funFact: 能降低心率以在冷水中生存
walrus.name: 海象
walrus.description: 海象是一種哺乳動物。The walrus is a large pinniped with distinctive long tusks used for hauling out on ice.

capybara.funFact: 世界上最大的齧齒動物
capybara.name: 水豚
capybara.description: 水豚是一種哺乳動物。The capybara is the largest living rodent, a semi-aquatic mammal found in South America.

beaver.funFact: 建造能創造整個生態系統的水壩
beaver.name: 河狸
beaver.description: 河狸是一種哺乳動物。Beavers are large rodents known for building dams and lodges.

porcupine.name: 豪豬
porcupine.description: 豪豬是一種哺乳動物。Porcupines are rodents covered in sharp quills used for defense.

squirrel.name: 松鼠
squirrel.description: 松鼠是一種哺乳動物。Squirrels are small rodents known for their bushy tails and tree-dwelling habits.

chinchilla.funFact: 所有陸地哺乳動物中最濃密的毛皮
chinchilla.name: 絨鼠
chinchilla.description: 絨鼠是一種哺乳動物。Chinchillas are small rodents with incredibly soft fur, native to the Andes.

guinea-pig.name: 天竺鼠
guinea-pig.description: 天竺鼠是一種哺乳動物。Guinea pigs are small, friendly rodents originally from South America.

hamster.funFact: 能用臉頰攜帶與自身體重相同的食物
hamster.name: 倉鼠
hamster.description: 倉鼠是一種哺乳動物。Hamsters are small, nocturnal rodents known for their cheek pouches and burrowing behavior.

mouse.name: 老鼠
mouse.description: 老鼠是一種哺乳動物。Mice are small rodents found worldwide, important in scientific research.

rat.name: 大鼠
rat.description: 大鼠是一種哺乳動物。Rats are intelligent rodents that have adapted to live alongside humans.

red-kangaroo.name: 紅袋鼠
red-kangaroo.description: 紅袋鼠是一種哺乳動物。The red kangaroo is the largest living marsupial, found throughout Australia.

koala.name: 無尾熊
koala.description: 無尾熊是一種哺乳動物。The koala is an arboreal marsupial that feeds almost exclusively on eucalyptus leaves.

wombat.name: 袋熊
wombat.description: 袋熊是一種哺乳動物。Wombats are sturdy, burrowing marsupials with tough rear ends for defense.

otter.name: 水獺
otter.description: Otters are playful, semi-aquatic mammals known for their dense fur and tool use.
otter.funFact: 擁有哺乳動物中最濃密的毛皮

wolverine.name: 狼獾
wolverine.description: The wolverine is a powerful, stocky mustelid known for its strength and ferocity.

honey-badger.name: 蜜獾
honey-badger.description: The honey badger is known for its fearlessness and thick skin that resists bee stings.

raccoon.name: 浣熊
raccoon.description: Raccoons are clever, adaptable mammals known for their masked faces and dexterous front paws.

red-panda.name: 小貓熊
red-panda.description: The red panda is a small arboreal mammal with reddish-brown fur and a ringed tail.

hedgehog.name: 刺蝟
hedgehog.description: 刺蝟是一種哺乳動物。Hedgehogs are small, spiny mammals found across Europe, Asia, and Africa.

clownfish.funFact: 全部出生時是雄性，占主導地位的變為雌性
clownfish.name: 小丑魚
clownfish.description: 小丑魚是一種魚類。Clownfish are vibrant orange fish with white bands that live symbiotically among sea anemone tentacles. They gain protection from predators while providing the anemone with food scraps and increased water circulation.

seahorse.name: 海馬
seahorse.description: The seahorse is a small marine fish with a horse-like head, prehensile tail, and upright swimming posture found in shallow coastal waters worldwide.

tiger-shark.name: 虎鯊
tiger-shark.description: The tiger shark is a large predator with distinctive dark vertical stripes found in tropical and subtropical oceans worldwide.
tiger-shark.funFact: 虎鯊被稱為海洋的垃圾桶，因為牠們幾乎什麼都吃。

bull-shark.name: 公牛鯊
bull-shark.description: The bull shark is a large, stocky shark found in warm, shallow coastal waters and occasionally in freshwater rivers.

hammerhead-shark.name: 雙髻鯊
hammerhead-shark.description: The hammerhead shark is a distinctive shark with a wide, flattened head that gives it a hammer-like appearance found in warm waters.

whale-shark.name: 鯨鯊
whale-shark.description: The whale shark is the largest fish in the world, reaching over 40 feet, a gentle filter feeder found in tropical oceans.

great-white-shark.name: 大白鯊
great-white-shark.description: The great white shark is the world's largest known predatory fish, an apex predator found in coastal and offshore waters worldwide.

manta-ray.name: 蝠魟
manta-ray.description: The manta ray is one of the largest rays in the world with a wingspan that can exceed 20 feet, a gentle filter feeder.

anglerfish.name: 鮟鱇魚
anglerfish.description: The Atlantic anglerfish is a deep-sea fish with a distinctive bioluminescent lure that attracts prey found on the deep ocean floor.
anglerfish.funFact: 用生物發光誘餌吸引獵物

pufferfish.name: 河豚
pufferfish.description: 河豚是一種魚類。The pufferfish is a marine fish capable of inflating its body to several times its normal size as a defense mechanism, found in tropical and subtropical waters.

piranha.funFact: 咬合力可達其體重300倍的壓力
piranha.name: 水虎鱼
piranha.description: 水虎鱼是一種魚類。The piranha is a freshwater fish native to South American rivers known for its sharp teeth and powerful jaws found in tropical and subtropical waters.

electric-eel.name: 电鳗
electric-eel.description: 电鳗是一種魚類。The electric eel is a freshwater fish capable of generating powerful electric shocks used for hunting and self-defense found in South American rivers.

komodo-dragon.name: 科莫多巨蜥
komodo-dragon.description: The Komodo dragon is the largest living lizard in the world, found on a few Indonesian islands. It is an apex predator capable of taking down deer, pigs, and even water buffalo. Young Komodo dragons spend their first years in trees to avoid predation by adults.

king-cobra.name: 眼鏡王蛇
king-cobra.description: The king cobra is the world's longest venomous snake, capable of reaching lengths over 13 feet. Found in the tropical forests of South and Southeast Asia, it primarily feeds on other snakes. Its venom is potent enough to kill an elephant.

green-sea-turtle.name: 綠海龜
green-sea-turtle.description: Green sea turtles are among the largest sea turtles in the world and the only herbivorous marine turtle species. They migrate long distances between feeding grounds and nesting beaches, returning to the same beach where they were born.

green-iguana.name: 綠鬣蜥
green-iguana.description: The green iguana is a large, arboreal herbivorous lizard native to Central and South America. It is excellent at swimming and can hold its breath for up to 30 minutes. Juveniles are bright green while adults may turn orange or dull grey.
green-iguana.funFact: 優秀的游泳者，能屏息30分鐘

boa-constrictor.name: 蚺蛇
boa-constrictor.description: The boa constrictor is a large, non-venomous constrictor found throughout Central and South America. It is a highly adaptable species found in rainforests, savannas, and even near human habitations. It kills prey by constriction and is a popular species in captivity.

black-mamba.name: 黑曼巴蛇
black-mamba.description: The black mamba is the fastest snake in the world and one of the most venomous. Found in eastern and southern Africa, it can reach speeds of 12 mph and strike with incredible accuracy. Its venom is neurotoxic and can be fatal without antivenom.

ball-python.name: 球蟒
ball-python.description: The ball python is a non-venomous constrictor native to the grasslands of western and central Africa. It is the most popular pet snake in the world due to its docile temperament and manageable size. It has hundreds of color morphs bred in captivity.
ball-python.funFact: 世界上最受歡迎的寵物蛇

red-eared-slider.name: 紅耳龜
red-eared-slider.description: The red-eared slider is a semi-aquatic turtle native to the Mississippi Valley region of the United States. It is the most popular pet turtle in the world and has become a significant invasive species on every continent except Antarctica. It has a distinctive red stripe behind each eye.

emperor-penguin.name: 帝企鵝
emperor-penguin.description: The emperor penguin is the tallest and heaviest of all living penguins. It breeds during the Antarctic winter, with males incubating the egg for about 65 days.

king-penguin.name: 國王企鵝
king-penguin.description: The king penguin is the second-largest penguin species, found on sub-Antarctic islands with striking orange and silver markings.
king-penguin.funFact: 國王企鵝父母在孵蛋期間可長達兩週不進食。

bald-eagle.name: 白頭海雕
bald-eagle.description: The bald eagle is a bird of prey found in North America and a national symbol of the United States. It is a large raptor with a distinctive white head and tail contrasting with a dark brown body.

golden-eagle.name: 金雕
golden-eagle.description: The golden eagle is one of the largest and most powerful raptors in North America and Eurasia. Named for the golden-brown plumage on its head and neck, it hunts primarily rabbits and hares.
golden-eagle.funFact: 俯衝速度超過240公里/小時

peregrine-falcon.funFact: 自由落體中最快的動物
peregrine-falcon.name: 遊隼
peregrine-falcon.description: 遊隼是一種鳥類。The peregrine falcon is a widespread bird of prey known for its incredible speed during its hunting dive. It feeds primarily on medium-sized birds caught in flight.

barn-owl.name: 倉鴞
barn-owl.description: The barn owl is a nocturnal raptor found on every continent except Antarctica. Known for its heart-shaped face and ghostly white plumage, it is an exceptionally efficient hunter of rodents.

mallard.name: 綠頭鴨
mallard.description: The mallard is the most common and widespread duck in the Northern Hemisphere. Males have a distinctive iridescent green head, while females are mottled brown.
mallard.funFact: 除了番鴨外，所有家鴨都是野綠頭鴨的後代。

canada-goose.name: 加拿大雁
canada-goose.description: The Canada goose is a large waterfowl native to North America, recognized by its black head and neck with white chinstrap. Highly adaptable, it is known for its V-formation flight.
canada-goose.funFact: 加拿大雁終生配對，能共同生活超過二十年。

mute-swan.name: 疣鼻天鵝
mute-swan.description: The mute swan is one of the largest flying birds, with pure white plumage and an orange bill with a black knob. It is known for its graceful S-shaped neck posture.
mute-swan.funFact: 疣鼻天鵝可能是巢穴的猛烈防禦者，會衝向入侵者。

flamingo.funFact: 出生時是白色的，通過食物獲得顏色
flamingo.name: 火烈鳥
flamingo.description: 火烈鳥是一種鳥類。The greater flamingo is the largest and most widespread flamingo species. Its pink plumage, long legs, and curved bill are unmistakable.

ostrich.name: 鴕鳥
ostrich.description: 鴕鳥是一種鳥類。The common ostrich is the largest living bird, native to Africa. Unable to fly, it has powerful legs and can run at sustained speeds of 30 mph.

emu.name: 鴯鶓
emu.description: The emu is the second-largest living bird, native to Australia. It is flightless with vestigial wings. The male emu performs all parental duties.
emu.funFact: 雄鴯鶓負責孵蛋和單獨撫育雛鳥長達十八個月。

monarch-butterfly.name: 帝王蝶
monarch-butterfly.description: 帝王蝶是一種昆蟲。The monarch butterfly is one of the most recognizable butterflies in North America, known for its striking orange and black wing pattern. It is famous for its incredible long-distance migration across thousands of miles.

ladybug.funFact: 一隻瓢蟲一生能吃5000隻蚜蟲
ladybug.name: 瓢虫
ladybug.description: 瓢虫是一種昆蟲。Ladybugs are small, round beetles valued by gardeners for their appetite for aphids and other plant pests. Their bright red coloration with black spots warns predators of their bitter taste.

sloth.name: 樹懶
sloth.description: Sloths are slow-moving tree-dwelling mammals known for their lazy lifestyle.

axolotl.name: 墨西哥钝口螈
axolotl.description: 墨西哥钝口螈是一種兩棲動物。The Axolotl is a neotenic salamander that retains its larval features throughout life, including external gills. Found only in Lake Xochimilco in Mexico, it is critically endangered in the wild but widely bred in captivity.

incredible-frog.name: 神奇青蛙
incredible-frog.description: The Incredible Frog is a small tree frog found in the rainforests of Central America. They have specialized finger and toe pads that allow them to control their descent when jumping between trees.
incredible-frog.funFact: 奇異蛙能伸展手指和腳趾從高處跳下時減緩降落速度。

lemur.name: 狐猴
lemur.description: 狐猴是一種哺乳動物。Lemurs are a diverse group of primates found only on the island of Madagascar.

meerkat.name: 狐獴
meerkat.description: Meerkats are social mongooses that live in the Kalahari Desert.

mongoose.name: 貓鼬
mongoose.description: Mongooses are small carnivores known for their ability to fight snakes.

praying-mantis.name: 螳螂
praying-mantis.description: The Chinese praying mantis is a large, elongated predatory insect with triangular head and powerful raptorial front legs. It is a sit-and-wait ambush predator of other insects.
praying-mantis.funFact: 螳螂能將頭部旋轉一百八十度來掃描獵物。

dragonfly.name: 蜻蜓
dragonfly.description: Dragonflies are ancient aerial predators with enormous compound eyes and two pairs of independently controlled wings. They are among the most efficient hunters in the insect world.
dragonfly.funFact: 蜻蜓能朝六個方向飛行，並像直升機一樣懸停。

firefly.name: 螢火蟲
firefly.description: Fireflies are beetles famous for their bioluminescent abdomens used to attract mates. Both adults and larvae produce light through a chemical reaction involving luciferin and luciferase.
firefly.funFact: 螢火蟲幼蟲也會發光，部分物種利用光來驅趕掠食者。

black-widow-spider.name: 黑寡婦蜘蛛
black-widow-spider.description: The southern black widow is one of North America's most venomous spiders. Females are recognized by the red hourglass marking on their abdomen and sometimes eat the male after mating.
black-widow-spider.funFact: 黑寡婦的毒液毒性是響尾蛇的十五倍，但注射量較少。

tarantula.name: 捕鳥蛛
tarantula.description: The Mexican red-kneed tarantula is a large, docile spider popular in the pet trade. It has urticating hairs on its abdomen that it can flick at threats, causing skin irritation.
tarantula.funFact: 狼蛛從毒牙處排尿，使用消化液而非水。

giant-pacific-octopus.name: 太平洋巨型章魚
giant-pacific-octopus.description: The giant Pacific octopus is the largest known octopus species, renowned for its intelligence and ability to solve puzzles. It has three hearts, blue blood, and eight dexterous arms lined with suckers.
giant-pacific-octopus.funFact: 能在毫秒內改變顏色和紋理以融入周遭環境。

common-octopus.name: 普通章魚
common-octopus.description: The common octopus is a highly intelligent marine invertebrate with excellent eyesight and problem-solving abilities. It uses ink clouds and camouflage as primary defense mechanisms.
common-octopus.funFact: 能穿過任何大於其喙部的開口。

moon-jellyfish.name: 海月水母
moon-jellyfish.description: Moon jellyfish are one of the most common and widely distributed jellyfish species. Their translucent bells pulse gently through coastal waters, feeding on plankton and small organisms.
moon-jellyfish.funFact: 月亮水母能透過有性和無性生殖繁殖，使族群數量爆發性增長。

box-jellyfish.name: 箱水母
box-jellyfish.description: Box jellyfish are among the most venomous creatures on Earth. Their nearly transparent, cube-shaped bells and up to 60 tentacles make them difficult to spot in tropical waters.
box-jellyfish.funFact: 立方水母擁有二十四隻眼睛，其中包括兩隻能形成影像的眼睛，與多數水母不同。

common-starfish.name: 海星
common-starfish.description: The common starfish is one of the most recognizable sea stars, with five arms and a tough, spiny surface. It feeds on mussels and oysters by everting its stomach through its mouth.
common-starfish.funFact: 海星能將胃翻出體外在體外消化獵物。

blue-poison-dart-frog.name: 藍色箭毒蛙
blue-poison-dart-frog.description: The Blue Poison Dart Frog is a small, brilliantly colored amphibian found in the rainforests of Suriname. Their vivid blue coloration warns predators of their potent skin toxins.
blue-poison-dart-frog.funFact: 藍箭毒蛙的毒性來自其在野外食用的螞蟻和蟎蟲。

golden-poison-dart-frog.name: 金色箭毒蛙
golden-poison-dart-frog.description: The Golden Poison Dart Frog is the most toxic vertebrate on Earth. Found only in Colombia, its bright yellow skin contains batrachotoxin, a potent neurotoxin used by indigenous people to poison blowgun darts.
golden-poison-dart-frog.funFact: 一隻黃金箭毒蛙攜帶的毒素足以殺死十個成年人。

red-eyed-tree-frog.name: 紅眼樹蛙
red-eyed-tree-frog.description: The Red-Eyed Tree Frog is one of the most iconic rainforest amphibians. With vibrant green bodies, blue and yellow striped sides, and stunning red eyes, they are a symbol of tropical biodiversity.
red-eyed-tree-frog.funFact: 紅眼樹蛙閃耀鮮紅的眼睛以驚嚇掠食者，爭取逃脫機會。

green-basilisk.name: 綠雙冠蜥
green-basilisk.description: The green basilisk is a striking lizard found in the tropical rainforests of Central America. Males have impressive crests on their heads, backs, and tails. It is famous for its ability to run bipedally across water surfaces for short distances.
green-basilisk.funFact: 綠蛇怪又稱為耶穌蜥蜴，因為牠能在水面奔跑。

thorny-devil.name: 棘蜥
thorny-devil.description: The thorny devil is a small, spiny lizard native to the arid deserts of central Australia. Its entire body is covered in conical spines that provide defense against predators. Its skin has microscopic channels that collect water and transport it to its mouth.
thorny-devil.funFact: 魔蜥皮膚上有微型溝槽，能將任何身體部位的水分引導至口中。

common-snapping-turtle.name: 鱷龜
common-snapping-turtle.description: The common snapping turtle is a large, freshwater turtle found across eastern North America. It has a powerful beak-like jaw and a long, prehistoric-looking tail. Unlike most turtles, it cannot fully retract into its shell, making it more aggressive on land.
common-snapping-turtle.funFact: 普通 snapping turtle 能將脖子伸展至接近甲殼的長度來攻擊獵物或威脅。

alligator-snapping-turtle.name: 大鱷龜
alligator-snapping-turtle.description: The alligator snapping turtle is the largest freshwater turtle in North America. It has a massive head, a hooked beak, and a shell with three prominent ridges. It is an ambush predator that lies motionless on the river bottom with its mouth open.
alligator-snapping-turtle.funFact: 大鱷龜舌頭上有一個蠕蟲狀的附肢，能引誘魚類直接進入其口中。

okapi.funFact: 長頸鹿現存最近的親屬
okapi.name: 㺢㹢狓
okapi.description: 㺢㹢狓是一種哺乳動物。The okapi is a shy, forest-dwelling relative of the giraffe with distinctive striped legs.

yak.funFact: 能在海拔6000公尺以上生存
yak.name: 氂牛
yak.description: 氂牛是一種哺乳動物。The yak is a long-haired bovid adapted to high altitudes in the Himalayas.

domestic-cattle.name: 家牛
domestic-cattle.description: 家牛是一種哺乳動物。Domestic cattle are large ungulates raised for meat, milk, and leather.

gaur.funFact: 世界上最大的野生牛科動物
gaur.name: 印度野牛
gaur.description: 印度野牛是一種哺乳動物。The gaur is the largest wild cattle species, native to South and Southeast Asia.

saiga-antelope.name: 賽加羚羊
saiga-antelope.description: 賽加羚羊是一種哺乳動物。The saiga antelope is known for its unusual, oversized nose that filters dust and warms cold air.

addax.name: 旋角羚
addax.description: 旋角羚是一種哺乳動物。The addax is a critically endangered antelope adapted to life in the Sahara Desert.

oryx.name: 大羚羊
oryx.description: 大羚羊是一種哺乳動物。The oryx is a large antelope with long, straight horns, adapted to arid environments.

cheetah.funFact: 地球上最快的陸地動物
cheetah.name: 獵豹
cheetah.description: 獵豹是一種哺乳動物。The cheetah is the fastest land animal, built for speed with a lightweight body and long legs.

clouded-leopard.funFact: 相對於體型有最長的犬齒
clouded-leopard.name: 雲豹
