clouded-leopard.description: 雲豹是一種哺乳動物。The clouded leopard is a medium-sized cat with distinctive cloud-shaped markings and exceptionally long canines.

serval.name: 藪貓
serval.description: 藪貓是一種哺乳動物。The serval is a medium-sized cat with long legs and large ears, found in African grasslands.

caracal.name: 獰貓
caracal.description: 獰貓是一種哺乳動物。The caracal is a medium-sized cat known for its distinctive black-tufted ears.

pallas-s-cat.funFact: 所有貓科動物中最厚的毛皮
pallas-s-cat.name: 兔猻
pallas-s-cat.description: 兔猻是一種哺乳動物。Pallas's cat is a small wild cat with a flattened face and dense fur, adapted to cold steppes.

sand-cat.name: 沙貓
sand-cat.description: 沙貓是一種哺乳動物。The sand cat is a small wild cat adapted to life in deserts, with furry paws for walking on hot sand.

fishing-cat.name: 漁貓
fishing-cat.description: 漁貓是一種哺乳動物。The fishing cat is a medium-sized cat that hunts fish and is an excellent swimmer.

american-black-bear.name: 美洲黑熊
american-black-bear.description: 美洲黑熊是一種哺乳動物。The American black bear is the most common bear in North America, known for its climbing ability.

asian-black-bear.funFact: 因胸部印記也被稱為月亮熊
asian-black-bear.name: 亞洲黑熊
asian-black-bear.description: 亞洲黑熊是一種哺乳動物。The Asian black bear is a medium-sized bear with a distinctive white V-shaped chest marking.

spectacled-bear.name: 眼鏡熊
spectacled-bear.description: 眼鏡熊是一種哺乳動物。The spectacled bear is the only bear native to South America, named for its distinctive facial markings.

sun-bear.name: 馬來熊
sun-bear.description: 馬來熊是一種哺乳動物。The sun bear is the smallest bear species, with a distinctive golden chest patch.

sloth-bear.name: 懶熊
sloth-bear.description: 懶熊是一種哺乳動物。The sloth bear has shaggy fur and specialized lips for eating termites and ants.

andean-bear.name: 眼鏡熊
andean-bear.description: 眼鏡熊是一種哺乳動物。The Andean bear is the only bear species in South America, found in the Andes mountains.

arctic-wolf.funFact: 能在零下70度的溫度下生存
arctic-wolf.name: 北極狼
arctic-wolf.description: 北極狼是一種哺乳動物。The Arctic wolf is a subspecies of gray wolf adapted to life in the high Arctic.

african-wild-dog.funFact: 所有捕食者中最高的狩獵成功率
african-wild-dog.name: 非洲野犬
african-wild-dog.description: 非洲野犬是一種哺乳動物。The African wild dog is a highly social canid with distinctive patched coat.

jackal.name: 胡狼
jackal.description: 胡狼是一種哺乳動物。Jackals are medium-sized canids known for their cunning and adaptability.

maned-wolf.funFact: 南美洲最高的野生犬科動物
maned-wolf.name: 鬃狼
maned-wolf.description: 鬃狼是一種哺乳動物。The maned wolf has long legs adapted for seeing over tall grasses.

western-gorilla.funFact: 與人類最親近的親戚（98%的DNA）
western-gorilla.name: 西部大猩猩
western-gorilla.description: 西部大猩猩是一種哺乳動物。The western gorilla is one of two species of gorilla, found in the forests of central Africa.

eastern-gorilla.funFact: 現存最大的靈長類動物
eastern-gorilla.name: 東部大猩猩
eastern-gorilla.description: 東部大猩猩是一種哺乳動物。The eastern gorilla is the largest living primate, found in the forests of eastern Africa.

bonobo.funFact: 與人類的親緣關係比黑猩猩更近
bonobo.name: 倭黑猩猩
bonobo.description: 倭黑猩猩是一種哺乳動物。The bonobo is a great ape known for its peaceful, matriarchal society.

siamang.funFact: 有可以放大叫聲的喉囊
siamang.name: 合趾猿
siamang.description: 合趾猿是一種哺乳動物。The siamang is the largest gibbon, known for its loud vocalizations.

gibbon.name: 長臂猿
gibbon.description: 長臂猿是一種哺乳動物。Gibbons are small apes known for their brachiation, swinging through trees.

mandrill.name: 山魈
mandrill.description: 山魈是一種哺乳動物。The mandrill is the largest and most colorful of all monkeys.

proboscis-monkey.funFact: 有一個大而肉質的鼻子
proboscis-monkey.name: 長鼻猴
proboscis-monkey.description: 長鼻猴是一種哺乳動物。The proboscis monkey is known for its unusually large nose, found in Borneo's mangroves.

spider-monkey.funFact: 有像第五肢一樣的捲尾
spider-monkey.name: 蜘蛛猴
spider-monkey.description: 蜘蛛猴是一種哺乳動物。Spider monkeys have long limbs and a prehensile tail for life in the canopy.

capuchin-monkey.name: 捲尾猴
capuchin-monkey.description: 捲尾猴是一種哺乳動物。Capuchin monkeys are highly intelligent and known for their tool use.

indri.name: 大狐猴
indri.description: 大狐猴是一種哺乳動物。The indri is the largest living lemur, known for its haunting calls.

tarsier.funFact: 相對於體型有所有哺乳動物中最大的眼睛
tarsier.name: 眼鏡猴
tarsier.description: 眼鏡猴是一種哺乳動物。The tarsier is a tiny primate with enormous eyes adapted for night vision.

aye-aye.name: 指猴
aye-aye.description: 指猴是一種哺乳動物。The aye-aye is a nocturnal lemur with a specialized finger for extracting insects.

sperm-whale.funFact: 擁有所有動物中最大的大腦
sperm-whale.name: 抹香鯨
sperm-whale.description: 抹香鯨是一種哺乳動物。The sperm whale is the largest toothed whale, famous for diving to great depths.

dugong.funFact: 唯一嚴格草食性的海洋哺乳動物
dugong.name: 儒艮
dugong.description: 儒艮是一種哺乳動物。The dugong is a large marine mammal related to manatees, found in warm coastal waters.

elephant-seal.name: 象海豹
elephant-seal.description: 象海豹是一種哺乳動物。Elephant seals are the largest seals, named for their trunk-like nose.

leopard-seal.funFact: 南極水域的頂級捕食者
leopard-seal.name: 豹海豹
leopard-seal.description: 豹海豹是一種哺乳動物。The leopard seal is a powerful predator found in Antarctic waters.

harp-seal.name: 豎琴海豹
harp-seal.description: 豎琴海豹是一種哺乳動物。The harp seal is named for the harp-shaped marking on its back.

sea-otter.name: 海獺
sea-otter.description: 海獺是一種哺乳動物。The sea otter is a marine mammal that uses tools to feed on shellfish.

hawaiian-monk-seal.funFact: 世界上最稀有的海豹之一
hawaiian-monk-seal.name: 夏威夷僧海豹
hawaiian-monk-seal.description: 夏威夷僧海豹是一種哺乳動物。The Hawaiian monk seal is an endangered species endemic to the Hawaiian Islands.

steller-sea-lion.name: 北海獅
steller-sea-lion.description: 北海獅是一種哺乳動物。Steller sea lions are the largest of the eared seals, named after Georg Steller.

crested-porcupine.name: 冠豪豬
crested-porcupine.description: 冠豪豬是一種哺乳動物。The crested porcupine is a large rodent with long, sharp quills.

naked-mole-rat.funFact: 能比相似大小的齧齒動物多活幾十年
naked-mole-rat.name: 裸克分子鼠
naked-mole-rat.description: 裸克分子鼠是一種哺乳動物。The naked mole rat is a burrowing rodent with unusual adaptations for underground life.

prairie-dog.name: 草原犬鼠
prairie-dog.description: 草原犬鼠是一種哺乳動物。Prairie dogs are social rodents that live in underground burrow systems.

indian-flying-fox.name: 印度狐蝠
indian-flying-fox.description: 印度狐蝠是一種哺乳動物。The Indian flying fox is one of the largest bats in the world, a fruit-eating megabat.

little-brown-bat.name: 小棕蝠
little-brown-bat.description: 小棕蝠是一種哺乳動物。The little brown bat is a small insectivorous bat found across North America.

mexican-free-tailed-bat.name: 墨西哥無尾蝙蝠
mexican-free-tailed-bat.description: 墨西哥無尾蝙蝠是一種哺乳動物。The Mexican free-tailed bat is known for its incredible speed and massive colonies.

fruit-bat.name: 果蝠
fruit-bat.description: 果蝠是一種哺乳動物。Fruit bats or megabats feed on fruit and nectar, using keen senses of smell and sight.

horseshoe-bat.name: 蹄蝠
horseshoe-bat.description: 蹄蝠是一種哺乳動物。Horseshoe bats are named for their distinctive nose leaf used in echolocation.

vampire-bat.funFact: 唯一完全以血液為食的哺乳動物
vampire-bat.name: 吸血蝙蝠
vampire-bat.description: 吸血蝙蝠是一種哺乳動物。Vampire bats are the only mammals that feed exclusively on blood.

megabat.name: 大型蝙蝠
megabat.description: 大型蝙蝠是一種哺乳動物。Megabats are large fruit-eating bats with excellent vision and sense of smell.

grey-kangaroo.name: 灰袋鼠
grey-kangaroo.description: 灰袋鼠是一種哺乳動物。The grey kangaroo is the second-largest marsupial, common in eastern Australia.

wallaby.name: 小袋鼠
wallaby.description: 小袋鼠是一種哺乳動物。Wallabies are small to medium-sized marsupials related to kangaroos.

tree-kangaroo.funFact: 雖然是袋鼠但生活在樹上
tree-kangaroo.name: 樹袋鼠
tree-kangaroo.description: 樹袋鼠是一種哺乳動物。Tree kangaroos are adapted to life in the canopy, unlike their ground-dwelling relatives.

quokka.name: 短尾矮袋鼠
quokka.description: 短尾矮袋鼠是一種哺乳動物。Quokkas are small marsupials famous for their 'smiling' expression.

tasmanian-devil.funFact: 有強力咬合的肉食性有袋類
tasmanian-devil.name: 袋獾
tasmanian-devil.description: 袋獾是一種哺乳動物。The Tasmanian devil is a carnivorous marsupial with a fearsome reputation.

quoll.funFact: 原產於澳大利亞和新幾內亞
quoll.name: 袋鼬
quoll.description: 袋鼬是一種哺乳動物。Quolls are carnivorous marsupials with distinctive spotted coats.

numbat.name: 袋食蟻獸
numbat.description: 袋食蟻獸是一種哺乳動物。The numbat is a small, termite-eating marsupial with distinctive striped rear.

bandicoot.name: 袋狸
bandicoot.description: 袋狸是一種哺乳動物。Bandicoots are small, omnivorous marsupials found throughout Australia.

sugar-glider.name: 蜜袋鼯
sugar-glider.description: 蜜袋鼯是一種哺乳動物。The sugar glider is a small, nocturnal marsupial with membrane for gliding.

possum.funFact: 在澳大利亞郊區很常見
possum.name: 負鼠
possum.description: 負鼠是一種哺乳動物。Possums are small to medium-sized marsupials found in Australia and surrounding regions.

badger.funFact: 挖掘廣泛的地下隧道系統
badger.name: 獾
badger.description: 獾是一種哺乳動物。Badgers are sturdy, burrowing mammals with distinctive black and white faces.

fisher.funFact: 少數能殺死豪豬的動物之一
fisher.name: 魚貂
fisher.description: 魚貂是一種哺乳動物。The fisher is a medium-sized mustelid known for hunting porcupines.

pine-marten.name: 松貂
pine-marten.description: 松貂是一種哺乳動物。The pine marten is a small, agile mustelid found in European forests.

stoat.name: 白鼬
stoat.description: 白鼬是一種哺乳動物。The stoat or short-tailed weasel is a small predator with seasonal coat changes.

weasel.name: 鼬
weasel.description: 鼬是一種哺乳動物。Weasels are small, slender carnivores with long bodies and short legs.

european-polecat.name: 歐洲鼬
european-polecat.description: 歐洲鼬是一種哺乳動物。The European polecat is a medium-sized mustelid, ancestor of the domestic ferret.

mink.funFact: 優秀的游泳者和潛水者
mink.name: 水貂
mink.description: 水貂是一種哺乳動物。Minks are semi-aquatic mustelids prized for their luxurious fur.

coati.name: 長鼻浣熊
coati.description: 長鼻浣熊是一種哺乳動物。Coatis are social, ring-tailed relatives of raccoons found in the Americas.

kinkajou.name: 蜜熊
kinkajou.description: 蜜熊是一種哺乳動物。The kinkajou is a nocturnal, tree-dwelling mammal with a prehensile tail.

tenrec.name: 马島猬
tenrec.description: 马島猬是一種哺乳動物。Tenrecs are small, insect-eating mammals endemic to Madagascar.

shrew.funFact: 新陳代謝最快的哺乳動物之一
shrew.name: 鼩鼱
shrew.description: 鼩鼱是一種哺乳動物。Shrews are tiny, insect-eating mammals with extremely high metabolic rates.

star-nosed-mole.funFact: 能在230毫秒內辨識並吃掉食物
star-nosed-mole.name: 星鼻鼴
star-nosed-mole.description: 星鼻鼴是一種哺乳動物。The star-nosed mole has a distinctive star-shaped nose used to detect prey underground.

golden-mole.name: 金毛鼹
golden-mole.description: 金毛鼹是一種哺乳動物。Golden moos are small, burrowing insectivores with shimmering golden fur.

solenodon.name: 溝齒鼠
solenodon.description: 溝齒鼠是一種哺乳動物。The solenodon is a rare, venomous mammal found only in the Caribbean.

elephant-shrew.name: 象鼩
elephant-shrew.description: 象鼩是一種哺乳動物。Elephant shrews are small, insect-eating mammals with distinctive long noses.

chinese-pangolin.funFact: 世界上被販賣最多的哺乳動物
chinese-pangolin.name: 穿山甲
chinese-pangolin.description: 穿山甲是一種哺乳動物。The Chinese pangolin is a critically endangered, scaly anteater.

sunda-pangolin.name: 马来穿山甲
sunda-pangolin.description: 马来穿山甲是一種哺乳動物。The Sunda pangolin is a scaly anteater found in Southeast Asia.

indian-pangolin.funFact: 沒有牙齒但用強壯的胃部肌肉
indian-pangolin.name: 印度穿山甲
indian-pangolin.description: 印度穿山甲是一種哺乳動物。The Indian pangolin is a scaly anteater found in the Indian subcontinent.

white-bellied-pangolin.name: 白腹穿山甲
white-bellied-pangolin.description: 白腹穿山甲是一種哺乳動物。The white-bellied pangolin is a tree-dwelling pangolin with a prehensile tail.

giant-pangolin.name: 大穿山甲
giant-pangolin.description: 大穿山甲是一種哺乳動物。The giant pangolin is the largest living pangolin, found in Central Africa.

giant-armadillo.name: 大犰狳
giant-armadillo.description: 大犰狳是一種哺乳動物。The giant armadillo is the largest living armadillo, found in South America.

nine-banded-armadillo.name: 九帶犰狳
nine-banded-armadillo.description: 九帶犰狳是一種哺乳動物。The nine-banded armadillo is the only armadillo found in the United States.

pink-fairy-armadillo.name: 粉紅仙女犰狳
pink-fairy-armadillo.description: 粉紅仙女犰狳是一種哺乳動物。The pink fairy armadillo is the smallest armadillo, found in central Argentina.

southern-three-banded-armadillo.name: 南三帶犰狳
southern-three-banded-armadillo.description: 南三帶犰狳是一種哺乳動物。The southern three-banded armadillo can roll into a perfect ball for protection.

giant-anteater.name: 大食蟻獸
giant-anteater.description: 大食蟻獸是一種哺乳動物。The giant anteater is the largest of the anteaters, with a long, sticky tongue.

two-toed-sloth.funFact: 移動太慢導致毛上長了藻類
two-toed-sloth.name: 二趾樹懶
two-toed-sloth.description: 二趾樹懶是一種哺乳動物。Two-toed sloths are nocturnal, tree-dwelling mammals with two claws on each foot.

southern-tamandua.name: 南方小食蟻獸

great-horned-owl.funFact: 爪子力量可達300磅/平方英寸

snowy-owl.funFact: 與其他貓頭鷹不同，白天活動

northern-saw-whet-owl.funFact: 北美最小的貓頭鷹之一

barred-owl.description: 橫斑林鴞是一種鳥類。The barred owl is a large, stocky owl native to eastern North America. It has dark eyes unlike most other owls and a distinctive hooting call.

long-eared-owl.funFact: 長耳鴞擁有不對稱的耳孔，能在完全黑暗中定位獵物。
long-eared-owl.name: 長耳鴞
long-eared-owl.description: 長耳鴞是一種鳥類。The long-eared owl is a medium-sized nocturnal owl with striking orange eyes and very long ear tufts. It is a secretive bird that roosts in dense vegetation.

great-gray-owl.funFact: 大灰貓頭鷹是北美最高的貓頭鷹，但其體型大部分是羽毛。
great-gray-owl.name: 大灰貓頭鷹
great-gray-owl.description: 大灰貓頭鷹是一種鳥類。The great gray owl is the tallest owl species in North America with a massive facial disc. Despite its imposing size, it is relatively light and feeds primarily on small rodents.

burrowing-owl.funFact: 穴小鴞築巢於草原犬鼠或地松鼠挖掘的地下洞穴中。
burrowing-owl.name: 穴小鴞
burrowing-owl.description: 穴小鴞是一種鳥類。The burrowing owl is a small, long-legged owl that nests in underground burrows. Unlike most owls, it is active during the day and perches on fence posts to watch for prey.

elf-owl.funFact: 姬鴞是世界上最小的貓頭鷹物種，體重不到一顆乒乓球。
elf-owl.name: 鬼鴞
elf-owl.description: 鬼鴞是一種鳥類。The elf owl is the worlds smallest owl, found in the desert Southwest. It nests in holes in saguaro cacti and feeds on insects and small invertebrates.

wood-duck.funFact: 小木鴨能從高達五十英尺的樹巢中跳下而不受傷。
wood-duck.name: 木鴨
wood-duck.description: 木鴨是一種鳥類。The wood duck is one of the most colorful waterfowl in North America. Males display elaborate patterns of green, purple, and white. Unlike most ducks, it nests in tree cavities.

northern-pintail.funFact: 針尾鴨的長尾巴使其成為飛行中最優雅的鴨類之一。
northern-pintail.name: 針尾鴨
northern-pintail.description: 針尾鴨是一種鳥類。The northern pintail is a graceful duck recognized by the males long, pointed tail feathers. It has a chocolate-brown head and white breast stripe.

green-winged-teal.funFact: 綠翅鴨是北美最小的浮水鴨。
green-winged-teal.name: 綠翅鴨
green-winged-teal.description: 綠翅鴨是一種鳥類。The green-winged teal is a small, agile duck with a distinctive chestnut head and green eye patch. It feeds by dabbling at the water surface.

canvasback.funFact: 帆背潛鴨是北美最大和最快的潛水鴨。
canvasback.name: 帆背潛鴨
canvasback.description: 帆背潛鴨是一種鳥類。The canvasback is a large diving duck with a distinctive sloping profile. Males have a white body and reddish-brown head.

snow-goose.funFact: 雪雁遷徙期間群落數量可達數十萬隻。
snow-goose.name: 雪雁
snow-goose.description: 雪雁是一種鳥類。The snow goose is a medium-sized goose with white plumage and black wingtips. It breeds in the Arctic and winters in southern marshes.

greylag-goose.funFact: 灰雁是歐洲大多數家鵝品種的祖先。
greylag-goose.name: 灰雁
greylag-goose.description: 灰雁是一種鳥類。The greylag goose is a large waterfowl with grey-brown plumage and an orange bill. It is the ancestor of most domestic geese.

trumpeter-swan.funFact: 喇叭天鵝是北美最重的原生鳥類。
trumpeter-swan.name: 喇叭天鵝
trumpeter-swan.description: 喇叭天鵝是一種鳥類。The trumpeter swan is the largest waterfowl in North America with a wingspan up to 8 feet. Named for its resonant, trumpet-like call, it has recovered from near extinction.

tundra-swan.funFact: 鵝天鵝在北極繁殖地與越冬地之間單程遷徙可達四千英里。
tundra-swan.name: 小天鵝
tundra-swan.description: 小天鵝是一種鳥類。The tundra swan is a large, white swan that breeds in the Arctic tundra. It has a distinctive yellow spot near the eye and forms large flocks during migration.

american-robin.funFact: 美洲知更鳥一天能吃掉十四英尺長的蚯蚓。
american-robin.name: 旅鶇
american-robin.description: 旅鶇是一種鳥類。The American robin is one of the most familiar songbirds in North America. Recognized by its rusty-red breast and melodic song, it is often seen hopping across lawns.

northern-cardinal.funFact: 雌性北美紅雀也會歌唱，這在北美鳴禽中相當罕見。
northern-cardinal.name: 主教雀
northern-cardinal.description: 主教雀是一種鳥類。The northern cardinal is a vivid red songbird with a distinctive crest and black face. Males are brilliant red while females are warm brown with red accents.

blue-jay.name: 冠藍鴉
blue-jay.description: 冠藍鴉是一種鳥類。The blue jay is a striking songbird with blue, white, and black plumage and a prominent crest. It is intelligent and vocal, known for its loud calls and bold behavior.

american-crow.funFact: 美洲烏鴉能辨識個別的人類面孔並懷恨在心。
american-crow.name: 美洲烏鴉
american-crow.description: 美洲烏鴉是一種鳥類。The American crow is a large, all-black bird known for its intelligence and adaptability. It uses tools, solves complex problems, and lives in large family groups.

common-raven.funFact: 渡鴉會在雪覆蓋的屋頂上滑行取樂，並表演空中特技。
common-raven.name: 渡鴉
common-raven.description: 渡鴉是一種鳥類。The common raven is the largest songbird in North America. Extremely intelligent, it has been observed using tools, solving multi-step puzzles, and manipulating other animals.

house-sparrow.funFact: 家麻雀於一八五一年被引入北美，自此遍布整個大陸。
house-sparrow.name: 家麻雀
house-sparrow.description: 家麻雀是一種鳥類。The house sparrow is one of the most widespread and familiar birds in the world. Originally from Eurasia, it thrives in close association with human habitation.

european-robin.funFact: 歐洲知更鳥是英國聖誕節的象徵，出現在許多節日賀卡上。
european-robin.name: 歐亞鸲
european-robin.description: 歐亞鸲是一種鳥類。The European robin is a small insectivorous bird with a distinctive orange-red breast. Familiar in gardens across Europe, it is known for its territorial behavior.

eastern-bluebird.funFact: 東部藍鳥能看見紫外線光，這有助於牠們找到成熟的漿果。
eastern-bluebird.name: 東部藍知更鳥
eastern-bluebird.description: 東部藍知更鳥是一種鳥類。The eastern bluebird is a small thrush with brilliant blue plumage on the back and a rusty-red throat and breast. A symbol of happiness, it was saved from decline by nest box programs.

western-bluebird.funFact: 西藍鳥是少數在舊啄木鳥洞中築巢的鳴禽之一。
western-bluebird.name: 西部藍知更鳥
western-bluebird.description: 西部藍知更鳥是一種鳥類。The western bluebird is a small thrush with deep blue plumage and a rusty breast. It nests in cavities and feeds primarily on insects caught on the ground.

baltimore-oriole.funFact: 巴爾的擬黃鸝編織精緻的懸掛巢，可能需要長達兩週才能完成。
baltimore-oriole.name: 巴爾的摩金黃鸝
baltimore-oriole.description: 巴爾的摩金黃鸝是一種鳥類。The Baltimore oriole is a striking songbird with vivid orange and black plumage. They weave elaborate pendulous nests from plant fibers.

scarlet-tanager.funFact: 雄性猩紅比藍雀在冬季變為橄欖綠色，看起來像完全不同的鳥類。
scarlet-tanager.name: 猩紅比藍雀
scarlet-tanager.description: 猩紅比藍雀是一種鳥類。The scarlet tanager is a medium-sized songbird with brilliant red plumage and black wings during breeding season. It is a shy forest bird.

yellow-warbler.funFact: 黃林鶯是春季最早回到繁殖地的鳴禽之一。
yellow-warbler.name: 黃林鶯
yellow-warbler.description: 黃林鶯是一種鳥類。The yellow warbler is a small, bright yellow songbird widespread across North America. Its cheerful song is one of the most recognizable spring sounds.

white-throated-sparrow.funFact: 白喉麻雀有兩種色彩型態，幾乎只與另一型態配對。
white-throated-sparrow.name: 白喉雀
white-throated-sparrow.description: 白喉雀是一種鳥類。The white-throated sparrow is a common songbird with a distinctive white throat patch and yellow lores. It has two color morphs that differ in behavior.

dark-eyed-junco.funFact: 暗眼燈草鵐又稱雪鳥，因為牠們在冬季出現在美國南部各州。
dark-eyed-junco.name: 暗眼燈草鵐
dark-eyed-junco.description: 暗眼燈草鵐是一種鳥類。The dark-eyed junco is a small, slate-colored sparrow common across North America. It is one of the most abundant and widespread forest birds.

ruby-throated-hummingbird.funFact: 紅喉蜂鳥每秒振翅五十三次，能倒飛。
ruby-throated-hummingbird.name: 紅喉蜂鳥
ruby-throated-hummingbird.description: 紅喉蜂鳥是一種鳥類。The ruby-throated hummingbird is the only breeding hummingbird in eastern North America. Males have an iridescent ruby-red throat.

annas-hummingbird.funFact: 雄性安氏蜂鳥表演戲劇性的俯衝展示，會發出可聽見的鳴叫聲。
annas-hummingbird.name: 安氏蜂鳥
annas-hummingbird.description: 安氏蜂鳥是一種鳥類。Annas hummingbird is a small, green hummingbird native to western North America. Males have a brilliant rose-pink throat and crown.

black-chinned-hummingbird.funFact: 這種蜂鳥的黑下巴在光線角度恰好時會閃耀出絢麗的紫色。
black-chinned-hummingbird.name: 黑颏蜂鳥
black-chinned-hummingbird.description: 黑颏蜂鳥是一種鳥類。The black-chinned hummingbird is a small, common hummingbird of the western United States with a velvet-black chin that shows iridescent purple.

belted-kingfisher.funFact: 帶魚狗是少數雌鳥比雄鳥色彩更鮮豔的鳥類之一。
belted-kingfisher.name: 帶翠鳥
belted-kingfisher.description: 帶翠鳥是一種鳥類。The belted kingfisher is a stocky, blue-gray bird with a shaggy crest and large dagger-like bill. Females have an additional rusty band across the belly.

great-blue-heron.funFact: 大藍鷺能一動不動站立數小時，等待最佳時機捕食。
great-blue-heron.name: 大藍鷺
great-blue-heron.description: 大藍鷺是一種鳥類。The great blue heron is the largest heron in North America, with a wingspan up to 6.5 feet. It wades in shallow water to hunt fish.

great-egret.funFact: 大白鷺的長羽毛幾乎在十九世紀因用於女帽裝飾而導致其滅絕。
great-egret.name: 大白鷺
great-egret.description: 大白鷺是一種鳥類。The great egret is a large, all-white heron with a yellow bill and black legs. Its near-extinction for the millinery trade helped spark the conservation movement.

snowy-egret.funFact: 小白鷺利用明亮的黃色腳從泥底攪動獵物。
snowy-egret.name: 小白鷺
snowy-egret.description: 小白鷺是一種鳥類。The snowy egret is a small, elegant white heron with black legs and vivid yellow feet. During breeding season, it develops long, flowing plumes.

green-heron.funFact: 綠鷺是少數會使用工具的鳥類之一，牠們會將誘餌丟在水面上吸引魚類。
green-heron.name: 綠鷺
green-heron.description: 綠鷺是一種鳥類。The green heron is a small, stocky heron with dark greenish-gray plumage. It is a clever hunter that sometimes uses bait to lure fish.

american-flamingo.funFact: 美洲火烈鳥是所有火烈鳥物種中色彩最鮮豔的。
american-flamingo.name: 美洲火烈鳥
american-flamingo.description: 美洲火烈鳥是一種鳥類。The American flamingo is a large, bright pink wading bird found in the Caribbean and Galapagos with the brightest plumage of all flamingos.

sandhill-crane.funFact: 沙丘鶴會表演包含跳躍、鞠躬和拋擲樹枝的精緻舞蹈。
sandhill-crane.name: 沙丘鶴
sandhill-crane.description: 沙丘鶴是一種鳥類。The sandhill crane is a tall, gray bird with a red crown and long legs. Known for its trumpeting call and spectacular mating dances.

whooping-crane.funFact: 美洲鶴曾在野外僅剩十五隻，是北美最稀有的鳥類之一。
whooping-crane.name: 美洲鶴
whooping-crane.description: 美洲鶴是一種鳥類。The whooping crane is the tallest bird in North America. Named for its loud whooping call, it was saved from extinction through intensive conservation.

purple-gallinule.funFact: 紫水雞能利用極長的腳趾走在蓮葉上。
purple-gallinule.name: 紫水雞
purple-gallinule.description: 紫水雞是一種鳥類。The purple gallinule is a brightly colored marsh bird with purple-blue plumage and a red and yellow bill. It walks gracefully on floating vegetation.

american-coot.funFact: 美洲白骨頂能緩慢沉入水中隱藏，僅露出頸部以上。
american-coot.name: 美國骨頂雞
american-coot.description: 美國骨頂雞是一種鳥類。The American coot is a dark, chicken-like waterbird with a white bill and frontal shield. Despite looking duck-like, it is related to rails.

wild-turkey.funFact: 野生火雞飛行速度可達每小時八十八公里，奔跑速度達每小時四十公里。
wild-turkey.name: 野生火雞
wild-turkey.description: 野生火雞是一種鳥類。The wild turkey is a large, iridescent bird native to North America. Males display elaborate courtship rituals. It is the ancestor of the domesticated turkey.

ring-necked-pheasant.funFact: 雄性環頸雉擁有如此鮮豔的羽毛，曾被用作龍插圖的模型。
ring-necked-pheasant.name: 環頸雉
ring-necked-pheasant.description: 環頸雉是一種鳥類。The ring-necked pheasant is a colorful game bird originally from Asia, now established across North America and Europe. Males have brilliant copper and green plumage.

bobwhite-quail.funFact: 北方鵪鶉因其獨特的雙音節叫聲類似其名字而得名。
bobwhite-quail.name: 北美鵪鶉
bobwhite-quail.description: 北美鵪鶉是一種鳥類。The northern bobwhite is a small, compact quail with a distinctive white throat and eyebrow stripe in males. Named for its clear bob-white call.

california-quail.funFact: 加州鵪鶉獨特的頭部羽簇向前彎曲，像問號。
california-quail.name: 加州鵪鶉
california-quail.description: 加州鵪鶉是一種鳥類。The California quail is a small, plump ground bird with a distinctive forward-curving black head plume. It is the state bird of California.

rockhopper-penguin.funFact: 跳岩企鵝用雙腳從一塊岩石跳到另一塊，而非搖擺行走。
rockhopper-penguin.name: 跳岩企鵝
rockhopper-penguin.description: 跳岩企鵝是一種鳥類。The rockhopper penguin is a small penguin known for its distinctive yellow and black crest feathers. It navigates steep, rocky terrain by hopping.

little-blue-penguin.funFact: 小藍企鵝是最小的企鵝物種，身高僅約十三英寸。
little-blue-penguin.name: 小藍企鵝
little-blue-penguin.description: 小藍企鵝是一種鳥類。The little blue penguin, also known as the fairy penguin, is the smallest species of penguin. Found in New Zealand and southern Australia.

gentoo-penguin.funFact: 金圖企鵝是水下泳速最快的鳥類，可達每小時三十五公里。
gentoo-penguin.name: 巴布亞企鵝
gentoo-penguin.description: 巴布亞企鵝是一種鳥類。The gentoo penguin is recognizable by the white stripe across its head and its bright orange-red bill. It is the fastest underwater swimming bird.

african-penguin.funFact: 非洲企鵝有時被稱為驢企鵝，因為牠們的叫聲像驢子。
african-penguin.name: 非洲企鵝
african-penguin.description: 非洲企鵝是一種鳥類。The African penguin, also known as the jackass penguin for its donkey-like bray, is the only penguin species that breeds in Africa. It is endangered.

brown-kiwi.funFact: 奇異鳥蛋相對體型比例極大，可達雌鳥體重的百分之二十。
brown-kiwi.name: 奇異鳥
brown-kiwi.description: 奇異鳥是一種鳥類。The brown kiwi is a flightless bird native to New Zealand. It has hair-like feathers, no tail, and a long probing bill with nostrils at the tip.

lyrebird.funFact: 琴鳥幾乎能模仿任何聲音，包括鏈鋸、快門聲和汽車警報器。
lyrebird.name: 琴鳥
lyrebird.description: 琴鳥是一種鳥類。The superb lyrebird is famous for its extraordinary ability to mimic sounds. Males have an elaborate tail that forms a lyre shape during courtship.

cassowary.funFact: 南方食火雞被認為是世界上最危險的鳥類，因其強力的踢擊。
cassowary.name: 鴯鶓
cassowary.description: 鴯鶓是一種鳥類。The southern cassowary is a large, flightless bird with a distinctive blue neck, red wattles, and a bony casque on its head.

scarlet-macaw.funFact: 金剛鸚鵡在人工飼養下可存活超過七十五年，並終生配對。
scarlet-macaw.name: 金剛鸚鵡
scarlet-macaw.description: 金剛鸚鵡是一種鳥類。The scarlet macaw is a large, colorful parrot with brilliant red, yellow, and blue plumage. Found in Central and South American rainforests.

blue-and-yellow-macaw.funFact: 藍黃金剛鸚鵡飛行速度可達每小時五十六公里，並用強大的喙敲碎堅硬的堅果。
blue-and-yellow-macaw.name: 藍黃鸚鵡
blue-and-yellow-macaw.description: 藍黃鸚鵡是一種鳥類。The blue-and-yellow macaw is a large parrot with vivid blue upperparts and golden-yellow underparts. It is highly social and can mimic human speech.

hyacinth-macaw.funFact: 紫藍金剛鸚鵡是世界上最大的飛行鸚鵡，翼展超過四英尺。
hyacinth-macaw.name: 紫藍鸚鵡
hyacinth-macaw.description: 紫藍鸚鵡是一種鳥類。The hyacinth macaw is the largest of all flying parrot species, with stunning cobalt-blue plumage and bright yellow eye rings.

african-grey-parrot.funFact: 非洲灰鸚鹉被認為是智商最高的鳥類，其認知能力與幼童相當。
african-grey-parrot.name: 非洲灰鸚鵡
african-grey-parrot.description: 非洲灰鸚鵡是一種鳥類。The African grey parrot is renowned for its exceptional intelligence and ability to mimic human speech. It has grey plumage with a striking red tail.

budgerigar.name: 虎皮鸚鵡
budgerigar.description: 虎皮鸚鵡是一種鳥類。The budgerigar is a small, long-tailed parakeet native to Australia. In the wild, it is green and yellow with black markings.

cockatiel.funFact: 雞尾鸚鵡是少數能準確吹口哨旋律的鸚鵡物種之一。
cockatiel.name: 玄鳳鸚鵡
cockatiel.description: 玄鳳鸚鵡是一種鳥類。The cockatiel is a small parrot native to Australia, recognizable by its prominent crest and orange cheek patches.

keel-billed-toucan.funFact: 巨嘴鳥色彩鮮豔的喙出奇地輕，主要由角蛋白構成，內部呈蜂巢結構。
keel-billed-toucan.name: 巨嘴鳥
keel-billed-toucan.description: 巨嘴鳥是一種鳥類。The keel-billed toucan is a colorful bird with a massive, rainbow-colored bill. Found in Central and South American rainforests.

toco-toucan.funFact: 巨嘴鳥的喙含有血管網絡，有助於調節體溫。
toco-toucan.name: 托哥巨嘴鳥
toco-toucan.description: 托哥巨嘴鳥是一種鳥類。The toco toucan is the largest toucan species, with a massive orange-yellow bill tipped in black. Found in South American forests.

great-hornbill.funFact: 雙角犀鳥對在築巢期間會將雌鳥封在樹洞中，僅留一條小縫餵食。
great-hornbill.name: 雙角犀鳥
great-hornbill.description: 雙角犀鳥是一種鳥類。The great hornbill is one of the largest hornbill species, distinguished by its massive yellow and black casque atop its bill.

rhinoceros-hornbill.funFact: 犀鳥向上彎曲的盔突可長達七英寸。
rhinoceros-hornbill.name: 犀鳥
rhinoceros-hornbill.description: 犀鳥是一種鳥類。The rhinoceros hornbill is a large hornbill with a dramatic upward-curving casque on its bill. Found in Southeast Asian rainforests.

laughing-kookaburra.funFact: 笑翠鳥的叫聲與人類的笑聲迴盪極為相似。
laughing-kookaburra.name: 笑翠鳥
laughing-kookaburra.description: 笑翠鳥是一種鳥類。The laughing kookaburra is a large kingfisher native to Australia, famous for its distinctive call that sounds like loud, echoing human laughter.

pied-kingfisher.funFact: 斑魚狗是唯一能在水面上方懸停後才俯衝的翠鳥物種。
pied-kingfisher.name: 斑魚狗
pied-kingfisher.description: 斑魚狗是一種鳥類。The pied kingfisher is a black and white kingfisher found across Africa and Asia. It hovers over water before diving to catch fish.

atlantic-puffin.funFact: 海鸚依靠特化的舌頭和喙結構，能同時叼住十條以上的魚。
atlantic-puffin.name: 大西洋海雀
atlantic-puffin.description: 大西洋海雀是一種鳥類。The Atlantic puffin is a small seabird with a colorful triangular bill and distinctive black and white plumage. Known as the clown of the sea.

tufted-puffin.funFact: 角海鸚能潛入超過兩百英尺的深度捕魚。
tufted-puffin.name: 角海雀
tufted-puffin.description: 角海雀是一種鳥類。The tufted puffin is a small seabird with black plumage, white face patches, and distinctive golden head tufts during breeding season.

wandering-albatross.funFact: 漂泊信天翁擁有所有鳥類中最大的翼展，超過十一英尺。
wandering-albatross.name: 漂泊信天翁
wandering-albatross.description: 漂泊信天翁是一種鳥類。The wandering albatross has the largest wingspan of any bird, up to 11.5 feet. It spends most of its life soaring over the Southern Ocean.

black-browed-albatross.funFact: 黑眉信天翁能在海上飛行時入睡。
black-browed-albatross.name: 黑眉信天翁
black-browed-albatross.description: 黑眉信天翁是一種鳥類。The black-browed albatross is a large seabird with dark upper wings and a white body. Named for the dark stripe through its eye.

laysan-albatross.funFact: 世界上最知名的野生鳥類是一隻名為 Wisdom 的黑背信天翁，超過七十歲。
laysan-albatross.name: 黑背信天翁
laysan-albatross.description: 黑背信天翁是一種鳥類。The Laysan albatross is a large seabird of the North Pacific. It breeds primarily on remote Pacific islands.

brown-pelican.funFact: 褐鵜鶘能從超過六十英尺的高度俯衝入水捕魚，其氣囊緩衝了衝擊力。
brown-pelican.name: 褐鵜鶘
brown-pelican.description: 褐鵜鶘是一種鳥類。The brown pelican is a large waterbird with a massive bill and throat pouch. It is unique among pelicans for plunge-diving from the air.

american-white-pelican.funFact: 美洲白鵜鶘合作捕魚，將魚群趕入淺水區。
american-white-pelican.name: 美洲白鵜鶘
american-white-pelican.description: 美洲白鵜鶘是一種鳥類。The American white pelican is one of the largest North American birds, with a wingspan up to 9 feet. It scoops fish while swimming.

frigatebird.funFact: 軍艦鳥能在海上連續飛行數週，並在飛行中入睡。
frigatebird.name: 軍艦鳥
frigatebird.description: 軍艦鳥是一種鳥類。The magnificent frigatebird is a large seabird with long, angular wings and a deeply forked tail. Males inflate a bright red throat pouch.

northern-gannet.funFact: 北方塘鵝從一百三十英尺的高度俯衝入水，以每小時九十七公里的速度撞擊水面。
northern-gannet.name: 北方塘鵝
northern-gannet.description: 北方塘鵝是一種鳥類。The northern gannet is the largest seabird in the North Atlantic. It nests in massive colonies on sea cliffs.

blue-footed-booby.funFact: 雄性藍腳鰹鳥表演精緻的舞蹈，交替抬起明亮的藍色腳以吸引配偶。
blue-footed-booby.name: 藍腳鰹鳥
blue-footed-booby.description: 藍腳鰹鳥是一種鳥類。The blue-footed booby is a marine bird famous for its vivid blue feet. Found along the Pacific coast of the Americas.

red-footed-booby.funFact: 紅腳鰹鳥是最豐富的鰹鳥物種，也是唯一 regularly 在樹上築巢的。
red-footed-booby.name: 紅腳鰹鳥
red-footed-booby.description: 紅腳鰹鳥是一種鳥類。The red-footed booby is the smallest booby species, with distinctive red feet. It comes in several color morphs.

great-cormorant.funFact: 鸕鶿的尾脂腺分泌比其他水鳥少，這有助於潛水但需要晾乾翅膀。
great-cormorant.name: 普通鸕鶿
great-cormorant.description: 普通鸕鶿是一種鳥類。The great cormorant is a large, dark waterbird found across much of the world. It spreads its wings to dry after fishing.

common-loon.funFact: 普通潛鳥擁有實心骨骼，使其浮力較低，比多數鳥類更善潛水。
common-loon.name: 普通潛鳥
common-loon.description: 普通潛鳥是一種鳥類。The common loon is a large waterbird known for its haunting wail across northern lakes. Its solid bones help it dive deep.

arctic-tern.funFact: 北極燕鷗每年從北極遷徙至南極再返回，是所有動物中遷徙距離最長的，可達四萬四千英里。
arctic-tern.name: 北極燕鷗
arctic-tern.description: 北極燕鷗是一種鳥類。The Arctic tern migrates farther than any other animal. It experiences more daylight than any other creature.

caspian-tern.funFact: 裏海燕鷗是世界上最大的燕鷗物種。
caspian-tern.name: 裏海燕鷗
caspian-tern.description: 裏海燕鷗是一種鳥類。The Caspian tern is the worlds largest tern, with a massive red bill and black cap. Found on every continent except Antarctica.

black-skimmer.funFact: 剪嘴鷗的下喙比上喙長，能貼水面滑行捕魚。
black-skimmer.name: 剪嘴鷗
black-skimmer.description: 剪嘴鷗是一種鳥類。The black skimmer is a unique seabird with a distinctive uneven bill. It flies low over water, dragging its bill to catch fish.

herring-gull.funFact: 銀鷗能飲用海水，因為眼睛上方有特殊腺體過濾多餘鹽分。
herring-gull.name: 銀鷗
herring-gull.description: 銀鷗是一種鳥類。The herring gull is one of the most common gulls in the Northern Hemisphere, thriving in coastal and urban environments.

laughing-gull.funFact: 笑鷗因其叫聲類似高音的人類笑聲而得名。
laughing-gull.name: 笑鷗
laughing-gull.description: 笑鷗是一種鳥類。The laughing gull is a medium-sized gull with a distinctive black head in breeding season and a laughing call.

killdeer.funFact: 雙領鴴會表演斷翅動作將掠食者從地面巢穴引開。
killdeer.name: 雙領鴴
killdeer.description: 雙領鴴是一種鳥類。The killdeer is a large plover with distinctive black breast bands. It is famous for its broken-wing display.

american-woodcock.funFact: 美洲丘鷸眼睛位於頭部兩側，能三百六十度視覺。
american-woodcock.name: 丘鹬
american-woodcock.description: 丘鹬是一種鳥類。The American woodcock is a plump shorebird with a long bill. It feeds on earthworms and performs an aerial sky-dance at dusk.

red-knot.funFact: 紅腹濱鷸從北極到南美尖端不間斷遷徙可達九千英里。
red-knot.name: 紅腹濱鷸
red-knot.description: 紅腹濱鷸是一種鳥類。The red knot is famous for one of the longest migrations in the animal kingdom. It turns rusty-red during breeding season.

american-avocet.funFact: 美洲反嘴鷸將上翹的喙在水中左右掃動來捕捉微小無脊椎動物。
american-avocet.name: 美洲反嘴鷸
american-avocet.description: 美洲反嘴鷸是一種鳥類。The American avocet is an elegant wader with a thin, upturned bill and long legs. During breeding season, its head and neck turn rusty-orange.

black-necked-stilt.funFact: 黑頸長腳鷸是腿部相對體長第二長的鳥類，僅次於火烈鳥。
black-necked-stilt.name: 黑頸長腳鷸
black-necked-stilt.description: 黑頸長腳鷸是一種鳥類。The black-necked stilt is a striking wader with black upperparts, white underparts, and extraordinarily long pink legs.

willow-ptarmigan.funFact: 柳雷鳥隨季節變色，夏季為棕色，冬季為純白色。
willow-ptarmigan.name: 柳雷鳥
willow-ptarmigan.description: 柳雷鳥是一種鳥類。The willow ptarmigan is a game bird of the Arctic tundra that changes plumage with the seasons.

spruce-grouse.funFact: 雲杉松雞非常不怕人，有時被稱為蠢雞，因為牠們很少因危險而飛走。
spruce-grouse.name: 披肩榛雞
spruce-grouse.description: 披肩榛雞是一種鳥類。The spruce grouse is a forest-dwelling game bird of the boreal region, known for its tameness.

ruffed-grouse.funFact: 披肩榛雞透過快速拍動翅膀產生鼓聲以吸引雌性。
ruffed-grouse.name: 披肩榛雞
ruffed-grouse.description: 披肩榛雞是一種鳥類。The ruffed grouse is a popular game bird of eastern North American forests with a distinctive drumming display.

chukar.funFact: 石雞遇危險時偏好奔跑上坡而非飛行。
chukar.name: 石雞
chukar.description: 石雞是一種鳥類。The chukar is a rotund game bird native to Eurasia and introduced to North America with distinctive black and white barring.

common-crane.funFact: 灰鶴在求偶期間會表演包含跳躍、鞠躬和拍翅的精緻舞蹈。
common-crane.name: 灰鶴
common-crane.description: 灰鶴是一種鳥類。The common crane is a large, elegant wading bird with gray plumage and a red crown patch. Famous for its courtship dances.

demoiselle-crane.funFact: 蓑羽鶴在喜馬拉雅山遷徙期間飛行高度超過二萬六千英尺。
demoiselle-crane.name: 蓑羽鶴
demoiselle-crane.description: 蓑羽鶴是一種鳥類。The demoiselle crane is the smallest crane species, elegant and graceful with a black neck and white ear tufts.

bearded-vulture.funFact: 胡兀鷲食用骨骼，從高處drop以將其摔碎成可吞嚥的碎片。
bearded-vulture.name: 胡兀鷲
bearded-vulture.description: 胡兀鷲是一種鳥類。The bearded vulture is the only bird species that feeds almost exclusively on bones.

andean-condor.funFact: 安地斯神鷹是所有猛禽中翼展最大的，可超過十英尺。
andean-condor.name: 安第斯神鷹
andean-condor.description: 安第斯神鷹是一種鳥類。The Andean condor is one of the worlds largest flying birds. It soars on thermal currents over the Andes mountains.

king-vulture.funFact: 瑪雅人相信王禿鷲能在人類與神之間傳遞訊息。
king-vulture.name: 王鴟
king-vulture.description: 王鴟是一種鳥類。The king vulture is a large, colorful vulture with a vividly colored head and a white body.

turkey-vulture.funFact: 紅頭美洲鳩擁有所有鳥類中最敏銳的嗅覺，能從數英里外偵測腐肉。
turkey-vulture.name: 紅頭美洲鷲
turkey-vulture.description: 紅頭美洲鷲是一種鳥類。The turkey vulture is a large soaring bird with a red, featherless head resembling a wild turkey.

american-kestrel.funFact: 美洲隼能看見紫外線光，這有助於牠們追蹤囓齒類動物的尿液痕跡。
american-kestrel.name: 美洲隼
american-kestrel.description: 美洲隼是一種鳥類。The American kestrel is the smallest and most common falcon in North America. Males have slate-blue wings.

merlin.funFact: 灰背隼曾因捕食鴿子的習性而被稱為鴿隼。
merlin.name: 灰背隼
merlin.description: 灰背隼是一種鳥類。The merlin is a small, powerful falcon found across the Northern Hemisphere. It pursues small birds in direct flight.

prairie-falcon.funFact: 草原隼在水平飛行中可達每小時七十二公里以上，俯衝時更快。
prairie-falcon.name: 草原隼
prairie-falcon.description: 草原隼是一種鳥類。The prairie falcon is a large, sandy-brown falcon of the western North American open country.

gyrfalcon.funFact: 矛隼是世界上最大的隼，曾被保留為國王之鳥。
gyrfalcon.name: 矛隼
gyrfalcon.description: 矛隼是一種鳥類。The gyrfalcon is the largest of all falcon species, found in Arctic regions. It was historically prized in falconry for royalty.

osprey.funFact: 鸕鶿擁有可反轉的外趾，能以前二後二的方式抓住魚類。
osprey.name: 鸕鶿
osprey.description: 鸕鶿是一種鳥類。The osprey is a large raptor found on every continent except Antarctica. It feeds almost exclusively on fish.

northern-harrier.funFact: 北方澤鵟擁有與貓頭鷹相似的面盤，有助於透過聲音定位獵物。
northern-harrier.name: 北方澤鵟
northern-harrier.description: 北方澤鵟是一種鳥類。The northern harrier is a slim raptor that hunts by flying low over open ground, using both sight and sound.

coopers-hawk.funFact: 庫氏鵟能在茂密的森林中高速追捕獵物。
coopers-hawk.name: 庫氏鷹
coopers-hawk.description: 庫氏鷹是一種鳥類。The Coopers hawk is a medium-sized accipiter that specializes in capturing doves and songbirds in flight.

sharp-shinned-hawk.funFact: 庫氏鵟體型嬌小敏捷，能在茂密森林中高速追捕獵物。
sharp-shinned-hawk.name: 庫氏鷹
sharp-shinned-hawk.description: 庫氏鷹是一種鳥類。The sharp-shinned hawk is the smallest accipiter in North America. A rapid, agile flier that hunts small songbirds.

swainsons-hawk.funFact: 斯氏鵟以數十萬隻的大群從北美遷徙至南美。
swainsons-hawk.name: 草原鵟
swainsons-hawk.description: 草原鵟是一種鳥類。The Swainsons hawk is a medium-sized raptor that migrates in enormous flocks to the pampas of Argentina for the winter.

rough-legged-hawk.funFact: 毛腳鵟的腿部羽毛一直延伸到腳趾，適應北極寒冷環境。
rough-legged-hawk.name: 毛腳鵟
rough-legged-hawk.description: 毛腳鵟是一種鳥類。The rough-legged hawk breeds in the Arctic tundra and winters in open prairies of North America.

ferruginous-hawk.funFact: 棕尾鵟是北美最大的鵟，翼展超過五英尺。
ferruginous-hawk.name: 棕尾鵟
ferruginous-hawk.description: 棕尾鵟是一種鳥類。The ferruginous hawk is the largest buteo hawk in North America with rust-colored upperparts.

white-tailed-kite.funFact: 白尾鵟能在空中長時間懸停，掃描地面尋找獵物。
white-tailed-kite.name: 白尾鳶
white-tailed-kite.description: 白尾鳶是一種鳥類。The white-tailed kite is a graceful raptor with white plumage, black shoulders, and a forked tail.

mississippi-kite.funFact: 密西西比鳶食用大量的蟬和其他在空中捕獲的昆蟲。
mississippi-kite.name: 密西西比鳶
mississippi-kite.description: 密西西比鳶是一種鳥類。The Mississippi kite is a small, elegant raptor with pearl-gray plumage that feeds primarily on insects caught in flight.

red-winged-blackbird.funFact: 紅翅黑鸝是北美數量最多的鳥類之一，超過兩億隻。
red-winged-blackbird.name: 紅翅黑鸝
red-winged-blackbird.description: 紅翅黑鸝是一種鳥類。The red-winged blackbird is one of the most abundant and widespread birds in North America with bright red and yellow shoulder patches.

brown-headed-cowbird.funFact: 棕頭牛鳥是巢寄生者，將卵產在其他鳥類的巢中。
brown-headed-cowbird.name: 褐頭牛鸝
brown-headed-cowbird.description: 褐頭牛鸝是一種鳥類。The brown-headed cowbird is a brood parasite that lays its eggs in the nests of other bird species.

common-grackle.funFact: 普通擬八哥擁有虹彩羽毛，在陽光下閃爍紫色、綠色和青銅色。
common-grackle.name: 普通擬八哥
common-grackle.description: 普通擬八哥是一種鳥類。The common grackle is a large, lanky blackbird with iridescent plumage and bright yellow eyes.

great-tailed-grackle.funFact: 大尾擬八哥翼展近十八英寸，其長尾巴佔總長的一半。
great-tailed-grackle.name: 大尾擬八哥
great-tailed-grackle.description: 大尾擬八哥是一種鳥類。The great-tailed grackle is a large, noisy blackbird with a very long, keel-shaped tail.

yellow-headed-blackbird.funFact: 雄性黃頭黑鳥在沼澤中劃分小型築巢領地，有時一夫多妻。
yellow-headed-blackbird.name: 黃頭黑鸝
yellow-headed-blackbird.description: 黃頭黑鸝是一種鳥類。The yellow-headed blackbird is a striking songbird with a brilliant yellow-orange head contrasting with a black body.

eastern-meadowlark.funFact: 東部草地鵐與西部草地鵐外觀幾乎相同，但叫聲完全不同。
eastern-meadowlark.name: 東方草地鵐
eastern-meadowlark.description: 東方草地鵐是一種鳥類。The eastern meadowlark is a bright yellow songbird with a distinctive V-shaped black breast band.

western-meadowlark.funFact: 西部草地鵐是六個不同美國州的州鳥，比任何其他鳥類都多。
western-meadowlark.name: 西方草地鵐
western-meadowlark.description: 西方草地鵐是一種鳥類。The western meadowlark is a bright yellow songbird with a black V-shaped breast band, the state bird of six states.

orchard-oriole.funFact: orchard oriole是北美擬黃鸝科中最小的物種，比家朱雀還小。
orchard-oriole.name: 果園擬黃鸝
orchard-oriole.description: 果園擬黃鸝是一種鳥類。The orchard oriole is a small, chestnut and black songbird. Males have a chestnut body with a black head.

bullocks-oriole.funFact: 布氏擬黃鸝編織精緻的懸掛囊狀巢，懸垂於樹枝間。
bullocks-oriole.name: 布氏擬黃鸝
bullocks-oriole.description: 布氏擬黃鸝是一種鳥類。The Bullocks oriole is a bright orange and black songbird of western North America that weaves hanging basket nests.

barn-swallow.funFact: 家燕在繁殖地和越冬地之間遷徙可達六千英里。
barn-swallow.name: 家燕
barn-swallow.description: 家燕是一種鳥類。The barn swallow is the most widespread swallow species in the world with a distinctive deeply forked tail.

tree-swallow.funFact: 樹燕是少數能消化漿果的北美鳴禽之一，使牠們能在春季更早遷徙。
tree-swallow.name: 樹燕
tree-swallow.description: 樹燕是一種鳥類。The tree swallow is a small, iridescent blue-green swallow with white underparts.

cliff-swallow.funFact: 崖燕在群體中建造葫蘆狀的泥巢，數量可達數百隻。
cliff-swallow.name: 崖燕
cliff-swallow.description: 崖燕是一種鳥類。The cliff swallow is a small swallow with a pale rump and squared-off tail that builds enclosed mud nests in colonies.

purple-martin.funFact: 紫崖燕在美國東部幾乎完全依賴人工巢箱築巢。
purple-martin.name: 紫 martin
purple-martin.description: 紫 martin是一種鳥類。The purple martin is the largest North American swallow with iridescent purple-blue plumage in males.

bank-swallow.funFact: 崖燕是北美最小的燕子物種，在沙岸上挖掘的洞穴中築巢。
bank-swallow.name: 灰沙燕
bank-swallow.description: 灰沙燕是一種鳥類。The bank swallow is the smallest swallow in North America, nesting in burrows excavated in sandy banks near water.

violet-green-swallow.funFact: 紫綠燕臉上有白斑，延伸至頭後部。
violet-green-swallow.name: 紫綠樹燕
violet-green-swallow.description: 紫綠樹燕是一種鳥類。The violet-green swallow is a small, colorful swallow with iridescent green and violet upperparts.

chimney-swift.funFact: 煙囪雨燕幾乎一生都在空中度過，甚至在飛行中睡覺。
chimney-swift.name: 烟囱雨燕
chimney-swift.description: 烟囱雨燕是一種鳥類。The chimney swift is a cigar-shaped, dark gray bird that spends most of its life on the wing.

common-nighthawk.funFact: 普通夜鷹嘴周圍有細小羽毛形成寬漏斗，用於在空中捕捉昆蟲。
common-nighthawk.name: 普通夜鷹
common-nighthawk.description: 普通夜鷹是一種鳥類。The common nighthawk is a nocturnal bird that feeds on flying insects caught during acrobatic aerial displays.

eastern-whip-poor-will.funFact: 東部夜鷹每小時能鳴叫四百次，整夜重複其類似名字的叫聲。
eastern-whip-poor-will.name: 東北美夜鷹
eastern-whip-poor-will.description: 東北美夜鷹是一種鳥類。The eastern whip-poor-will is a nocturnal bird named for its distinctive three-part call.

greater-roadrunner.funFact: 大走禽奔跑速度可達每小時三十二公里，且能不喝水生存。
greater-roadrunner.name: 走鵑
greater-roadrunner.description: 走鵑是一種鳥類。The greater roadrunner is a large, ground-dwelling cuckoo of the American deserts known for its X-shaped tail.

yellow-billed-cuckoo.funFact: 黃嘴美洲咬鹃有時被稱為雨鳥，因為牠們在暴風雨前鳴叫更頻繁。
yellow-billed-cuckoo.name: 黃嘴美洲杜鵑
yellow-billed-cuckoo.description: 黃嘴美洲杜鵑是一種鳥類。The yellow-billed cuckoo is a slim, long-tailed bird with a curved yellow bill that feeds on caterpillars.

hoopoe.funFact: 戴勝鳥擁有壯觀的扇狀羽冠，在興奮或受驚時會豎起。
hoopoe.name: 戴勝
hoopoe.description: 戴勝是一種鳥類。The Eurasian hoopoe is a distinctive bird with cinnamon plumage, black and white wing bars, and a spectacular erectile crest.

tawny-frogmouth.funFact: 蟆口鴟常被誤認為貓頭鷹，但實際上與夜鷹的親緣關係更近。
tawny-frogmouth.name: 蟆口鴟
tawny-frogmouth.description: 蟆口鴟是一種鳥類。The tawny frogmouth is a nocturnal bird of Australia with cryptic plumage that perfectly camouflages it against tree bark.

common-potoo.funFact: 普通林鵙在白天直立棲息在樹枝上，看起來完全像斷裂的樹樁。
common-potoo.name: 普通林鴟
common-potoo.description: 普通林鴟是一種鳥類。The common potoo is a nocturnal bird of Central and South American forests with an enormous mouth and cryptic plumage.

american-goldfinch.funFact: 美洲金翅雀是築巢最晚的鳥類之一，常在七月下旬才繁殖。
american-goldfinch.name: 美洲金翅雀
american-goldfinch.description: 美洲金翅雀是一種鳥類。The American goldfinch is a small, bright yellow songbird with black wings and cap, one of the latest-nesting birds in North America.

pine-grosbeak.funFact: 松雀是北方最不怕人的鳥類之一，常允許近距離接近。
pine-grosbeak.name: 松雀
pine-grosbeak.description: 松雀是一種鳥類。The pine grosbeak is a large, plump finch with rosy-pink plumage in males. Found in boreal forests across North America.

evening-grosbeak.funFact: 黃昏擬蠟嘴雀是暴發性遷徙鳥，有些年份會大量出現在偏離正常範圍的南方。
evening-grosbeak.name: 黃昏錐嘴雀
evening-grosbeak.description: 黃昏錐嘴雀是一種鳥類。The evening grosbeak is a large, stocky finch with a massive conical bill and bright yellow body in males.

cassins-finch.funFact: 卡氏朱雀是北美最近才被描述的鳥類物種，直到一八六一年才被確認。
cassins-finch.name: 卡氏朱雀
cassins-finch.description: 卡氏朱雀是一種鳥類。The Cassins finch is a medium-sized finch with rosy-red crown and pinkish wash on the breast, found in mountain forests.

red-crossbill.funFact: 紅交嘴鳥擁有獨特的交叉喙，專門用於從針葉樹球果中取種子。
red-crossbill.name: 紅交嘴雀
red-crossbill.description: 紅交嘴雀是一種鳥類。The red crossbill is a finch with a uniquely crossed bill adapted for extracting seeds from conifer cones.

pine-siskin.funFact: 松雀能攜帶沙門氏菌而不發病，可能傳染給後院鳥類。
pine-siskin.name: 松金翅雀
pine-siskin.description: 松金翅雀是一種鳥類。The pine siskin is a small, streaky brown finch with yellow edging on its wings and tail, an irruptive species.

common-redpoll.funFact: 普通白腰朱頂雀能透過食用種子和蓬鬆羽毛在華氏零下六十度的低溫中生存。
common-redpoll.name: 白腰朱頂雀
common-redpoll.description: 白腰朱頂雀是一種鳥類。The common redpoll is a tiny, streaky finch with a distinctive red cap and pink breast, breeding in Arctic tundra.

hoary-redpoll.funFact: 白腰朱頂雀是最耐寒的鳴禽之一，棲息地比幾乎任何其他雀形目鳥類都更北。
hoary-redpoll.name: 白腰朱頂雀
hoary-redpoll.description: 白腰朱頂雀是一種鳥類。The hoary redpoll is a tiny Arctic finch, paler and frostier-looking than the common redpoll.

house-finch.funFact: 雄性家朱雀的紅色來自於其飲食中的漿果和水果色素。
house-finch.name: 家朱雀
house-finch.description: 家朱雀是一種鳥類。The house finch is a small songbird common in urban and suburban areas with red or orange plumage in males.

purple-finch.funFact: 羅傑·托里·彼得森將雄性紫朱雀描述為「浸過覆盆子汁」。
purple-finch.name: 紫朱雀
purple-finch.description: 紫朱雀是一種鳥類。The purple finch is a medium-sized finch with rosy-red plumage in males and streaked brown in females.

eastern-wood-pewee.funFact: 東部綠霸鶲的叫聲極具特色，該物種以牠的歌聲命名。
eastern-wood-pewee.name: 東林鶲
eastern-wood-pewee.description: 東林鶲是一種鳥類。The eastern wood-pewee is a small flycatcher with olive-gray plumage and a distinctive, plaintive whistle.

great-crested-flycatcher.funFact: 大冠霸鶲總會將蛇皮編入巢材中。
great-crested-flycatcher.name: 大冠蝇霸鹟
great-crested-flycatcher.description: 大冠蝇霸鹟是一種鳥類。The great crested flycatcher is a large, yellow-bellied flycatcher with a distinctive crest. It always includes snakeskin in its nest.

eastern-kingbird.funFact: 東方王霸鶲因其攻擊性的領地行為而得名，會攻擊比自身大得多的鳥類。
eastern-kingbird.name: 東方王霸鹟
eastern-kingbird.description: 東方王霸鹟是一種鳥類。The eastern kingbird is a bold flycatcher with dark gray upperparts and a distinctive white tip on its tail.

eastern-phoebe.funFact: 東部菲比霸鶲是北美第一隻被繫放的鳥類，由奧杜邦於一八四零年完成。
eastern-phoebe.name: 東方菲比霸鹟
eastern-phoebe.description: 東方菲比霸鹟是一種鳥類。The eastern phoebe is a small, brownish-gray flycatcher that bobs its tail frequently and often nests on human structures.

willow-flycatcher.funFact: 柳霸鶲與多種其他Empidonax霸鶲 virtually相同，最好透過其獨特的FITZ-bew歌聲辨識。
willow-flycatcher.name: 柳蝇霸鹟
willow-flycatcher.description: 柳蝇霸鹟是一種鳥類。The willow flycatcher is a small, inconspicuous flycatcher best known for its distinctive fitz-bew song.

scissor-tailed-flycatcher.funFact: 剪尾霸鶲的長尾羽可長達身體的兩倍。
scissor-tailed-flycatcher.name: 剪尾王霸鹟
scissor-tailed-flycatcher.description: 剪尾王霸鹟是一種鳥類。The scissor-tailed flycatcher is a distinctive flycatcher with extremely long, forked tail feathers. It is the state bird of Oklahoma.

vermilion-flycatcher.funFact: 朱紅霸鶲是西半球色彩最鮮豔的霸鶲之一。
vermilion-flycatcher.name: 朱紅霸鹟
vermilion-flycatcher.description: 朱紅霸鹟是一種鳥類。The vermilion flycatcher is a small, vividly colored flycatcher with males displaying brilliant red plumage and a black mask.

common-merganser.funFact: 普通秋沙鴨擁有鋸齒狀的喙，幫助牠們在潛水時抓緊滑溜的魚類。
common-merganser.name: 普通秋沙鴨
common-merganser.description: 普通秋沙鴨是一種鳥類。The common merganser is a large diving duck with a reddish-brown crested head in females and a dark green head in males. It feeds primarily on fish.

hooded-merganser.funFact: 鏡冠秋沙鴨擁有相對體型最大的羽冠，能隨意升起或放下。
hooded-merganser.name: 冠秋沙鴨
hooded-merganser.description: 冠秋沙鴨是一種鳥類。The hooded merganser is a small, striking diving duck. Males have a bold black and white fan-shaped crest with a rusty flank patch.

bufflehead.funFact: 巨頭鵲鴨是北美最小的潛水鴨，常在啄木鳥的舊洞穴中築巢。
bufflehead.name: 巨头鹊鸭
bufflehead.description: 巨头鹊鸭是一種鳥類。The bufflehead is a small, compact diving duck. Males have a striking iridescent green and purple head with large white patches.

common-goldeneye.funFact: Common goldeneye hens巢巢内产卵后，雌鸟会用自己腹部脱落的绒羽覆盖卵。
common-goldeneye.name: 普通秋沙鴨
common-goldeneye.description: 普通秋沙鴨是一種鳥類。The common goldeneye is a medium-sized diving duck with a distinctive round head. Males have a dark green-black head with a white circular patch near the bill.

ring-necked-duck.funFact: 儘管名稱如此，環頸鴨的頸環在野外很少可見。
ring-necked-duck.name: 环颈潜鸭
ring-necked-duck.description: 环颈潜鸭是一種鳥類。The ring-necked duck is a medium-sized diving duck with a distinctive peaked head shape. Males have a black back, gray flanks, and a white breast with a subtle neck ring.

gadwall.funFact: 赤膀鴨常被稱為素鴨，但雄鳥近看有精緻的波紋圖案。
gadwall.name: 赤膀鴨
gadwall.description: 赤膀鴨是一種鳥類。The gadwall is a dabbling duck with subtle but elegant plumage. Males are mostly gray with black rear ends, while females are mottled brown.

blue-winged-teal.funFact: 藍翅鴴是北美最早春季遷徙和最晚秋季遷徙的鴨類之一。
blue-winged-teal.name: 蓝翅鸭
blue-winged-teal.description: 蓝翅鸭是一種鳥類。The blue-winged teal is a small dabbling duck. Males have a slate-blue head with a white crescent in front of the eye. It is one of the earliest migrating ducks.

crested-caracara.funFact: 鳳頭卡拉鷹屬於隼科，但行為更像禿鷲，常食腐肉。
crested-caracara.name: 凤头卡拉鹰
crested-caracara.description: 凤头卡拉鹰是一種鳥類。The crested caracara is a distinctive raptor with a black cap, white neck, and orange face. Despite being in the falcon family, it scavenges and forages on the ground.

palm-nut-vulture.funFact: 棕櫚禿鷲是唯一以植物材料（特別是棕櫚果實）為主要食物的禿鷲物種。
palm-nut-vulture.name: 棕榈秃鹫
palm-nut-vulture.description: 棕榈秃鹫是一種鳥類。The palm-nut vulture is a unique raptor of West African palm forests that feeds mainly on the fruit of the oil palm.

black-vulture.funFact: 黑美洲鳶擁有優良的視力，也利用嗅覺定位腐肉。
black-vulture.name: 黑美洲鹫
black-vulture.description: 黑美洲鹫是一種鳥類。The black vulture is a common New World vulture with black plumage and a bare, dark head. It soars in groups looking for carcasses.

roseate-spoonbill.funFact: 玫瑰琵鷺在淺水中左右掃動其鏟狀喙來捕捉小魚和甲殼類動物。
roseate-spoonbill.name: 玫瑰琵鷺
roseate-spoonbill.description: 玫瑰琵鷺是一種鳥類。The roseate spoonbill is a large, pink wading bird with a distinctive spatulate bill. It feeds by sweeping its bill through shallow water.

wood-stork.funFact: 林鸛是唯一在北美繁殖的鸛物種，利用觸覺捕食。
wood-stork.name: 林鹮
wood-stork.description: 林鹮是一種鳥類。The wood stork is a large, white wading bird with a dark, featherless head and a long, curved bill. It is the only stork species breeding in the United States.

white-ibis.funFact: 美洲白䴉利用長而彎曲的喙探測泥土，能僅靠觸覺偵測獵物。
white-ibis.name: 美洲白鹮
white-ibis.description: 美洲白鹮是一種鳥類。The white ibis is a medium-sized wading bird with white plumage, black wing tips, and a distinctive long, curved pink bill.

limpkin.funFact: 秧雞是專業的蘋果螺食者，其喙專門演化以從螺殼中取出螺肉。
limpkin.name: 秧鶴
limpkin.description: 秧鶴是一種鳥類。The limpkin is a large, brown wading bird with white spotting. It is specialized in feeding on apple snails and has a distinctive wailing call.

rusty-blackbird.funFact: 過去五十年間，锈色黑鳥數量下降超過百分之九十，是北美衰退速度最快的鳥類之一。
rusty-blackbird.name: 锈色黑鹂
rusty-blackbird.description: 锈色黑鹂是一種鳥類。The rusty blackbird is a medium-sized blackbird that breeds in boreal wetlands and winters in the southeastern United States. Males are glossy black with rust-colored edges on feathers in fall.

blue-tang.funFact: 藍刺尾鯛在夜間能透過改變顏色使自己幾乎隱形。
blue-tang.name: 蓝吊
blue-tang.description: 蓝吊是一種魚類。The blue tang is a striking royal blue fish with a bright yellow tail and black markings. Found throughout the Indo-Pacific, it feeds primarily on algae and plays an important role in keeping coral reefs healthy.

mandarinfish.funFact: 七彩麒麟是少數能產生藍色色素的脊椎動物之一。
mandarinfish.name: 青蛙魚
mandarinfish.description: 青蛙魚是一種魚類。The mandarinfish is a small, incredibly colorful reef fish with vivid blue, orange, and green patterns. It produces a toxic mucus coating that deters predators and gives it a distinctive smell.

sixbar-wrasse.funFact: 六帶刺尾鯛能在一生中從雌性變為雄性。
sixbar-wrasse.name: 六帶豬魚
sixbar-wrasse.description: 六帶豬魚是一種魚類。The sixbar wrasse is a slender reef fish with distinctive dark vertical bars across its body. Found throughout the Indo-Pacific, it feeds on small crustaceans and fish.

yellowtail-coris.funFact: 幼年黃尾擬隆頭魚與成魚外觀完全不同，帶有橙白色斑點。
yellowtail-coris.name: 黃尾猪魚
yellowtail-coris.description: 黃尾猪魚是一種魚類。The yellowtail coris is a colorful wrasse found in coral reefs across the Indo-Pacific. Adults have a green body with yellow tail and red spots, while juveniles are orange.

bicolor-angelfish.funFact: 二色神仙魚能發出響亮的爆裂聲用於交流。
bicolor-angelfish.name: 雙色神仙魚
bicolor-angelfish.description: 雙色神仙魚是一種魚類。The bicolor angelfish features a striking split coloration of dark blue-black on the front half and bright yellow on the rear half. Found in Caribbean reefs, it feeds on algae.

flame-angelfish.funFact: 火焰神仙魚在小型水族箱中可能變得具攻擊性。
flame-angelfish.name: 火焰神仙魚
flame-angelfish.description: 火焰神仙魚是一種魚類。The flame angelfish is a brilliant orange-red fish with black vertical bars native to the Pacific. It is one of the most popular marine aquarium fish.

queen-angelfish.funFact: 女王神仙魚因額頭上的深藍色環紋類似皇冠而得名。
queen-angelfish.name: 女王神仙魚
queen-angelfish.description: 女王神仙魚是一種魚類。The queen angelfish is a large, stunningly colorful reef fish with blue, yellow, and green hues. Found throughout the tropical western Atlantic, it feeds primarily on sponges.

french-angelfish.funFact: 法國神仙魚常以單配偶對的形式出現，終生相伴。
french-angelfish.name: 法國神仙魚
french-angelfish.description: 法國神仙魚是一種魚類。The French angelfish is a striking black fish with bright yellow-edged scales found in Caribbean reefs. Young individuals are bright yellow but darken as adults.

regal-tang.funFact: 皇家刺尾鯛尾部附近有一根可收縮的刺，能造成疼痛的傷口。
regal-tang.name: 帝王刺尾魚
regal-tang.description: 帝王刺尾魚是一種魚類。The regal tang, also known as the palette surgeonfish, is a bright blue fish with a yellow tail and black markings. Found across the Indo-Pacific.

sohal-surgeonfish.funFact: 刺尾魚極具領地意識，會攻擊進入其空間的潛水員。
sohal-surgeonfish.name: 索氏刺尾魚
sohal-surgeonfish.description: 索氏刺尾魚是一種魚類。The sohal surgeonfish is a large, gray-blue reef fish with horizontal stripes and sharp scalpel-like spines on its tail. Native to the Red Sea and Persian Gulf.

moorish-idol.funFact: 神仙魚在人工飼養中 notoriously 難以存活，很少在水族箱中長期存活。
moorish-idol.name: 镰鱼
moorish-idol.description: 镰鱼是一種魚類。The Moorish idol is one of the most recognizable reef fish with its dramatic black, white, and yellow coloration and a long flowing dorsal fin filament.

royal-gramma.funFact: 皇家格蘭瑪魚常倒掛在岩石懸崖下方。
royal-gramma.name: 皇家格蘭瑪
royal-gramma.description: 皇家格蘭瑪是一種魚類。The royal gramma, or fairy basslet, has a stunning two-tone coloration with bright purple on the front half and yellow on the rear half. Found in Caribbean caves.

longnose-butterflyfish.funFact: 長吻蝴蝶魚利用其細長的吻部深入珊瑚縫隙覓食。
longnose-butterflyfish.name: 長吻蝴蝶魚
longnose-butterflyfish.description: 長吻蝴蝶魚是一種魚類。The longnose butterflyfish is a slender reef fish with a distinctive elongated snout and yellow body with a dark eye band.

copperband-butterflyfish.funFact: 銅帶蝴蝶魚尾部附近有假眼斑，用以迷惑掠食者。
copperband-butterflyfish.name: 銅帶蝴蝶魚
copperband-butterflyfish.description: 銅帶蝴蝶魚是一種魚類。The copperband butterflyfish has a striking pattern of vertical orange bands with black edges on a silver-white body.

foureye-butterflyfish.funFact: 四眼蝴蝶魚有大型眼斑，使掠食者誤認為尾巴是頭部。
foureye-butterflyfish.name: 四眼蝴蝶魚
foureye-butterflyfish.description: 四眼蝴蝶魚是一種魚類。The foureye butterflyfish gets its name from the prominent black eye spot on each side near its tail, confusing predators.

bluegill.funFact: 雄性藍鱲在淺水中建造圓形巢穴並猛烈守護魚卵。
bluegill.name: 蓝鳃太阳鱼
bluegill.description: 蓝鳃太阳鱼是一種魚類。The bluegill is a freshwater sunfish native to eastern North America. It has an olive-green body with a distinctive dark spot on the ear flap.

largemouth-bass.funFact: 大口黑鱸能張開嘴巴吞下接近自身体型一半的獵物。
largemouth-bass.name: 大口黑鲈
largemouth-bass.description: 大口黑鲈是一種魚類。The largemouth bass is the largest of the black basses and the most popular freshwater game fish in North America.

smallmouth-bass.funFact: 小口黑鱸以搏鬥能力著稱，被稱為棕鱸或青銅鱸。
smallmouth-bass.name: 小口黑鲈
smallmouth-bass.description: 小口黑鲈是一種魚類。The smallmouth bass is a freshwater fish prized by anglers for its aggressive fighting style.

rainbow-trout.funFact: 虹鱒能根據環境和情緒改變色彩強度。
rainbow-trout.name: 虹鳟
rainbow-trout.description: 虹鳟是一種魚類。The rainbow trout is a coldwater fish with an olive-green body and a distinctive pinkish-red stripe along its side.

brook-trout.funFact: 溪鱒是東部北美大部分地區唯一的原生鱒魚。
brook-trout.name: 溪红点鲑
brook-trout.description: 溪红点鲑是一種魚類。The brook trout, also called speckled trout, has a dark green body with light spots and red spots with blue halos.

atlantic-salmon.funFact: 大西洋鮭魚在溯河產卵遷徙中能跳躍過瀑布和水壩。
atlantic-salmon.name: 大西洋鲑
atlantic-salmon.description: 大西洋鲑是一種魚類。The Atlantic salmon is an anadromous fish born in freshwater, migrates to the ocean, and returns to freshwater to spawn.

chinook-salmon.funFact: 奇努克鮭是所有太平洋鮭魚中體型最大的。
chinook-salmon.name: 大鳞大麻哈鱼
chinook-salmon.description: 大鳞大麻哈鱼是一種魚類。The Chinook salmon, also called king salmon, is the largest Pacific salmon with a greenish back and dark spots.

coho-salmon.funFact: 紅鮭在產卵季節會變成鮮紅色，並長出鉤狀頜。
coho-salmon.name: 银大麻哈鱼
coho-salmon.description: 银大麻哈鱼是一種魚類。The coho salmon, also known as silver salmon, has a silver body with black spots and is found throughout the North Pacific.

pacific-bluefin-tuna.funFact: 太平洋藍鰭鮪能在不到六十天內橫渡整個太平洋。
pacific-bluefin-tuna.name: 太平洋蓝鳍金枪鱼
pacific-bluefin-tuna.description: 太平洋蓝鳍金枪鱼是一種魚類。The Pacific bluefin tuna is a large, fast, pelagic fish found throughout the Pacific Ocean, highly prized in sushi markets.

yellowfin-tuna.funFact: 黃鳍鮪在短距離衝刺中游速可達每小時六十四公里。
yellowfin-tuna.name: 黄鳍金枪鱼
yellowfin-tuna.description: 黄鳍金枪鱼是一種魚類。The yellowfin tuna is a large, streamlined ocean fish with bright yellow dorsal and anal fins found in tropical oceans worldwide.

atlantic-cod.funFact: 大西洋鱈魚能利用電覺在渾濁水中偵測獵物。
atlantic-cod.name: 大西洋鳕
atlantic-cod.description: 大西洋鳕是一種魚類。The Atlantic cod is a large, cold-water fish with a distinctive chin barbel and three dorsal fins, once one of the most important food fish in the world.

atlantic-grouper.funFact: 石斑魚能透過突然張開巨大的嘴將獵物整個吸入口中。
atlantic-grouper.name: 大西洋石斑魚
atlantic-grouper.description: 大西洋石斑魚是一種魚類。The Atlantic grouper is a large, robust reef fish with a wide mouth and thick lips found in warm Atlantic waters.

goliath-grouper.funFact: 巨型石斑魚體型龐大，可重如小型汽車。
goliath-grouper.name: 巨型石斑魚
goliath-grouper.description: 巨型石斑魚是一種魚類。The goliath grouper is the largest bony fish in the Western Atlantic, reaching weights of up to 800 pounds.

red-snapper.funFact: 紅笛鯛可存活超過五十年，是最長壽的笛鯛物種之一。
red-snapper.name: 紅鲷
red-snapper.description: 紅鲷是一種魚類。The red snapper is a bright red reef fish found in the Gulf of Mexico and western Atlantic.

barracuda.funFact: 能以超過55公里/小時游泳
barracuda.name: 梭鱼
barracuda.description: 梭鱼是一種魚類。The barracuda is a large, predatory fish with a long, streamlined body and razor-sharp teeth found in tropical oceans.

mahi-mahi.funFact: 鬼頭刀又稱為點帶鰹或海豚魚，但與海豚無關。
mahi-mahi.name: 鬼头刀
mahi-mahi.description: 鬼头刀是一種魚類。The mahi-mahi is a brightly colored pelagic fish with a golden-green body and blue fins found in tropical oceans.

wahoo.funFact: 刺鲅是海洋中最快的魚類之一，速度可達每小時八十公里。
wahoo.name: 刺鲅
wahoo.description: 刺鲅是一種魚類。The wahoo is a large, fast pelagic fish related to mackerels with a sleek, torpedo-shaped body and vertical blue bars.

sailfish.funFact: 旗魚被認為是海洋中最快的魚類，速度可達每小時一百一十公里。
sailfish.name: 旗鱼
sailfish.description: 旗鱼是一種魚類。The sailfish is a large billfish with a spectacular high dorsal fin resembling a sail, found in tropical oceans worldwide.

blue-marlin.funFact: 藍槍魚可重達一千磅以上，是世界上最大的硬骨魚之一。
blue-marlin.name: 蓝枪鱼
blue-marlin.description: 蓝枪鱼是一種魚類。The blue marlin is one of the largest ocean fish with a distinctive blue upper body and silver-white belly found in tropical Atlantic waters.

nassau-grouper.funFact: 拿騷石斑能在數秒內改變體色與周遭環境融合。
nassau-grouper.name: 拿骚石斑魚
nassau-grouper.description: 拿骚石斑魚是一種魚類。The Nassau grouper is a large reef fish capable of rapid color changes, now critically endangered from overfishing.

striped-bass.funFact: 條紋鱸為溯河性魚類，能遷徙數百英里產卵。
striped-bass.name: 条纹鲈
striped-bass.description: 条纹鲈是一種魚類。The striped bass is a silver fish with distinctive horizontal dark stripes found along the Atlantic coast.

red-drum.funFact: 紅鼓魚又稱頻道鱸，是北卡羅萊納州的官方州魚。
red-drum.name: 红鼓鱼
red-drum.description: 红鼓鱼是一種魚類。The red drum, also called redfish, is a copper-bronze fish with a distinctive black spot near the tail.

black-drum.funFact: 黑鼓魚能利用魚鰾上的肌肉產生響亮的鼓聲。
black-drum.name: 黑鼓鱼
black-drum.description: 黑鼓鱼是一種魚類。The black drum is a large, dark fish with barbels on its chin that can grow to over 100 pounds.

channel-catfish.funFact: 斑點叉尾鮰全身佈滿味蕾，能從遠處感知食物。
channel-catfish.name: 斑点叉尾鮰
channel-catfish.description: 斑点叉尾鮰是一種魚類。The channel catfish is the most fished catfish species in North America with a forked tail and whisker-like barbels.

blue-catfish.funFact: 藍鲶魚可長到超過一百磅，是北美最大的淡水魚。
blue-catfish.name: 蓝鲶鱼
blue-catfish.description: 蓝鲶鱼是一種魚類。The blue catfish is the largest species of North American catfish reaching weights of over 100 pounds.

walking-catfish.funFact: Walking catfish能離開水存活數小時，並用胸鰭在陸地上行走。
walking-catfish.name: 步行鲶鱼
walking-catfish.description: 步行鲶鱼是一種魚類。The walking catfish is a freshwater catfish native to Southeast Asia that can breathe air and move across land.

wels-catfish.funFact: 歐鯰據報導在罕見情況下可長超過十六英尺。
wels-catfish.name: 欧鲶
wels-catfish.description: 欧鲶是一種魚類。The wels catfish is the largest freshwater fish in Europe reaching lengths of over 16 feet with a wide, flat head.

eurasian-pike.funFact: 歐洲梭魚能在不到十分之一秒內從靜止加速到時速三十二公里。
eurasian-pike.name: 白斑狗鱼
eurasian-pike.description: 白斑狗鱼是一種魚類。The Eurasian pike is a large, ambush predator found throughout Europe, Asia, and northern North America.

muskellunge.funFact: 北方狗魚又被稱為 muskie，是梭子魚科中體型最大的成員。
muskellunge.name: 北美狗鱼
muskellunge.description: 北美狗鱼是一種魚類。The muskellunge, or muskie, is the largest freshwater fish in the pike family found in clear lakes and rivers of North America.

walleye.funFact: 大眼鱸擁有稱為明毯的反光層，使其眼睛在夜間發光。
walleye.name: 暗色狗鱼
walleye.description: 暗色狗鱼是一種魚類。The walleye is a freshwater fish named for its distinctive, glassy eyes that reflect light found in cool, clear lakes.

common-carp.funFact: 鯉魚被認為是世界上最具影響力的入侵性魚類之一。
common-carp.name: 鲤鱼
common-carp.description: 鲤鱼是一種魚類。The common carp is a large, golden-brown freshwater fish found throughout the world, originally from Eurasia.

grass-carp.funFact: 草魚每天能吃掉與自身体重百分之四十的植被。
grass-carp.name: 草鱼
grass-carp.description: 草鱼是一種魚類。The grass carp is a large freshwater fish native to eastern Asia that feeds almost exclusively on aquatic plants.

koi-carp.funFact: 最昂貴的錦鯉是一條名為 S Legend 的日本魚，以一百八十萬美元售出。
koi-carp.name: 锦鲤
koi-carp.description: 锦鲤是一種魚類。Koi are ornamental varieties of common carp bred for their vibrant colors and patterns from Japan.

goldfish.name: 金鱼
goldfish.description: 金鱼是一種魚類。The goldfish is one of the most popular aquarium fish in the world, domesticated from East Asia over 1,000 years ago.

tench.funFact: 丁鱥分泌的黏液能治癒其他魚類的傷口。
tench.name: 丁鲷
tench.description: 丁鲷是一種魚類。The tench is a freshwater fish with a thick, slimy body and olive-green to bronze coloration found throughout Europe and Asia.

three-spined-stickleback.funFact: 雄性刺魚利用水生植物建造精緻的巢穴，並扇動魚卵以提供氧氣。
three-spined-stickleback.name: 三刺鱼
three-spined-stickleback.description: 三刺鱼是一種魚類。The three-spined stickleback is a small, spiny fish found throughout the Northern Hemisphere, males build intricate nests.

florida-gar.funFact: 佛州雀鱔擁有細長的吻部，佈滿針狀牙齒，且能呼吸空氣。
florida-gar.name: 佛罗里达雀鳝
florida-gar.description: 佛罗里达雀鳝是一種魚類。The Florida gar is a long, slender predatory fish with an elongated snout and armored scales found in Florida and Georgia.

alligator-gar.funFact: 雀鱔卵對人類有毒，但美洲原住民經處理後食用。
alligator-gar.name: 雀鳝
alligator-gar.description: 雀鳝是一種魚類。The alligator gar is the largest freshwater fish in North America, reaching over 8 feet long with a long, alligator-like snout.

bowfin.funFact: 弓鰭魚是古老魚類目中唯一倖存的成員。
bowfin.name: 弓鳍鱼
bowfin.description: 弓鳍鱼是一種魚類。The bowfin is a primitive freshwater fish with an elongated body and a distinctive long dorsal fin found in eastern North America.

chinese-sturgeon.funFact: 中華鱘已存在超過一億四千萬年，被稱為活化石。
chinese-sturgeon.name: 中华鲟
chinese-sturgeon.description: 中华鲟是一種魚類。The Chinese sturgeon is a critically endangered species found only in the Yangtze River that can grow to over 16 feet.

atlantic-sturgeon.funFact: 大西洋鱘可存活超過一百年，曾因其魚子醬而被獵捕。
atlantic-sturgeon.name: 大西洋鲟
atlantic-sturgeon.description: 大西洋鲟是一種魚類。The Atlantic sturgeon is a large, primitive fish with a prehistoric appearance featuring bony plates instead of scales.

arctic-char.funFact: 北極紅點鮭是世界上分布最北的淡水魚。
arctic-char.name: 北极红点鲑
arctic-char.description: 北极红点鲑是一種魚類。The Arctic char is a cold-water fish related to salmon and trout found in Arctic and subarctic waters.

lake-trout.funFact: 湖鱒可存活超過四十年，長到超過六十磅。
lake-trout.name: 湖红点鲑
lake-trout.description: 湖红点鲑是一種魚類。The lake trout is a large, cold-water salmonid found in deep lakes of northern North America with a forked tail.

cutthroat-trout.funFact: 虹鱒因其頜下的獨特紅色條紋而得名。
cutthroat-trout.name: 割喉鳟
cutthroat-trout.description: 割喉鳟是一種魚類。The cutthroat trout is a cold-water fish native to western North America, named for red-orange slash marks under its lower jaw.

golden-trout.funFact: 金 trout是加州的官方州魚，僅分布於少數偏遠溪流。
golden-trout.name: 金鳟
golden-trout.description: 金鳟是一種魚類。The golden trout is a subspecies of rainbow trout found in high-altitude mountain streams of California with golden-yellow body.

oceanic-whitetip-shark.funFact: 白尖鯊在二戰期間造成的傷亡人數超過任何其他鯊魚物種。
oceanic-whitetip-shark.name: 大洋白鳍鲨
oceanic-whitetip-shark.description: 大洋白鳍鲨是一種魚類。The oceanic whitetip shark is a large, slow-moving pelagic shark with distinctive white-tipped fins, critically endangered.

blacktip-shark.funFact: 黑鰭鯊以其戲劇性的跳出水面翻轉行為著稱。
blacktip-shark.name: 黑鳍鲨
blacktip-shark.description: 黑鳍鲨是一種魚類。The blacktip shark is a medium-sized shark with distinctive black tips on all its fins found in warm coastal waters.

scalloped-hammerhead.funFact: 路氏雙髻鯊在年度遷徙期間形成數百隻的大型群體。
scalloped-hammerhead.name: 路氏双髻鲨
scalloped-hammerhead.description: 路氏双髻鲨是一種魚類。The scalloped hammerhead is one of the most common hammerhead species with a distinctive scalloped leading edge on its head.

thresher-shark.funFact: 長尾鯊利用其極長的尾鞭擊暈魚群。
thresher-shark.name: 长尾鲨
thresher-shark.description: 长尾鲨是一種魚類。The thresher shark is a distinctive shark with an extremely long upper tail that can be as long as its body found in open ocean.

basking-shark.funFact: 姥鯊是世界上僅次於鯨鯊的第二大魚類。
basking-shark.name: 姥鲨
basking-shark.description: 姥鲨是一種魚類。The basking shark is the second largest fish in the world, filter-feeding on plankton with an enormous mouth over 3 feet wide.

nurse-shark.funFact: 鉸口鯊能在海底休息時持續將水流送過鰓部。
nurse-shark.name: 铰口鲨
nurse-shark.description: 铰口鲨是一種魚類。The nurse shark is a sluggish, bottom-dwelling shark with barbels near its nostrils that help detect prey hidden in sand.

zebra-shark.funFact: 豹紋鯊從幼年的條紋圖案變為成年的斑點圖案。
zebra-shark.name: 豹纹鲨
zebra-shark.description: 豹纹鲨是一種魚類。The zebra shark is a distinctive shark with dark spots on a tan body found on tropical coral reefs of the Indo-Pacific.

epaulette-shark.funFact: 肩章鯊能在低潮時用鰭在礁石平台上行走。
epaulette-shark.name: 肩章鲨
epaulette-shark.description: 肩章鲨是一種魚類。The epaulette shark is a small reef shark that can walk on its fins across the reef flat found in the Indo-Pacific.

angel-shark.funFact: 天使鯊能完全埋入沙中伏擊經過的獵物。
angel-shark.name: 扁鲨
angel-shark.description: 扁鲨是一種魚類。The angel shark is a flattened shark that lies buried in sand on the ocean floor, critically endangered due to habitat loss.

southern-stingray.funFact: 南方黃貂魚能以其毒棘造成劇烈疼痛。
southern-stingray.name: 南方黄貂鱼
southern-stingray.description: 南方黄貂鱼是一種魚類。The southern stingray is a large, diamond-shaped ray found in shallow tropical waters of the western Atlantic.

cownose-ray.funFact: 牛鼻鰩沿大西洋海岸以數千隻的大群遷徙。
cownose-ray.name: 牛鼻鲼
cownose-ray.description: 牛鼻鲼是一種魚類。The cownose ray is a distinctive ray with a unique head shape resembling a cow's nose, forming large schools during migration.

eagle-ray.funFact: 斑點鷹魟能從水面躍起數英尺。
eagle-ray.name: 鹰鲼
eagle-ray.description: 鹰鲼是一種魚類。The spotted eagle ray is a large ray with distinctive white spots on a dark body found in tropical and subtropical oceans.

viperfish.funFact: viperfish擁有極長的針狀牙齒，長到無法收入口中。
viperfish.name: 蝰鱼
viperfish.description: 蝰鱼是一種魚類。The viperfish is a deep-sea predator with extremely long, needle-like teeth and a bioluminescent photophore along its body.

gulper-eel.funFact: 吞噬鰻擁有巨大的嘴巴，能張開吞下比自身更大的獵物。
gulper-eel.name: 吞噬鳗
gulper-eel.description: 吞噬鳗是一種魚類。The gulper eel is a deep-sea fish with an enormous, loosely hinged mouth and a long, whip-like tail found in deep ocean waters.

lungfish.funFact: 肺魚能呼吸空氣，並透過鑽入泥土在水外存活數月。
lungfish.name: 肺鱼
lungfish.description: 肺鱼是一種魚類。The lungfish is a freshwater fish with both gills and primitive lungs, one of the closest living relatives to tetrapods found in Africa, South America, and Australia.

coelacanth.funFact: 腔棘魚曾被認為已滅絕六千六百萬年，直到一九三八年被重新發現。
coelacanth.name: 腔棘鱼
coelacanth.description: 腔棘鱼是一種魚類。The coelacanth is a living fossil, a lobe-finned fish once thought extinct that was rediscovered off the coast of South Africa in 1938.

red-bellied-piranha.funFact: 納氏食人鯧能在數分鐘內用其剃刀般鋒利的牙齒將屍體啃至白骨。
red-bellied-piranha.name: 红腹水虎鱼
red-bellied-piranha.description: 红腹水虎鱼是一種魚類。The red-bellied piranha is a freshwater fish native to South America known for its sharp teeth and powerful jaws found in rivers and lakes.

arapaima.funFact: 巨骨舌魚是世界上最大的淡水魚之一，能呼吸空氣。
arapaima.name: 巨骨舌鱼
arapaima.description: 巨骨舌鱼是一種魚類。The arapaima is one of the largest freshwater fish in the world, reaching lengths of over 10 feet, found in the Amazon basin.

arowana.funFact: 龍魚能從水面躍起六英尺捕捉懸垂樹枝上的獵物。
arowana.name: 龙鱼
arowana.description: 龙鱼是一種魚類。The arowana is a freshwater fish with large, metallic scales and an upward-pointing mouth found in tropical rivers of South America, Asia, and Australia.

knifefish.funFact: 黑魔鬼刀魚利用微弱電場在黑暗渾濁的水中導航和尋找獵物。
knifefish.name: 刀鱼
knifefish.description: 刀鱼是一種魚類。The black ghost knifefish is a freshwater fish with an elongated, laterally compressed body and a distinctive anal fin used for propulsion.

betta.funFact: 雄性鬥魚在水面築造泡巢以保護卵。
betta.name: 斗鱼
betta.description: 斗鱼是一種魚類。The betta, or Siamese fighting fish, is a small freshwater fish with flowing fins and vibrant colors native to Southeast Asia.

discus.funFact: 七彩神仙魚親魚會分泌黏液供幼魚在最初幾週食用。
discus.name: 七彩神仙鱼
discus.description: 七彩神仙鱼是一種魚類。The discus is a freshwater fish with a distinctive disc-shaped body found in the Amazon basin, popular in aquariums for its vibrant colors.

oscarr.funFact: 奧斯卡魚是高度聰明的魚類，能辨認主人。
oscarr.name: 小丑鱼
oscarr.description: 小丑鱼是一種魚類。The oscar is a large cichlid native to South America with a dark body and orange-red markings, popular in aquariums for its personality.

angelfish-freshwater.funFact: 淡水神仙魚實際上是慈鯛科，與海洋神仙魚無關。
angelfish-freshwater.name: 神仙鱼
angelfish-freshwater.description: 神仙鱼是一種魚類。The freshwater angelfish is a popular aquarium fish with a distinctive triangular body shape and long, flowing fins native to the Amazon basin.

convict-cichlid.funFact: 慈鯛是盡職的父母，會猛烈防衛幼魚。
convict-cichlid.name: 条纹慈鲷
convict-cichlid.description: 条纹慈鲷是一種魚類。The convict cichlid is a small freshwater fish with distinctive black vertical stripes on a light body found in Central America.

peacock-cichlid.funFact: 雄性孔雀慈鯛在繁殖期間展示鮮豔的藍色、紅色和金色。
peacock-cichlid.name: 孔雀慈鲷
peacock-cichlid.description: 孔雀慈鲷是一種魚類。The peacock cichlid is a colorful freshwater fish found in Lake Malawi with males displaying vibrant blues, reds, and golds.

lionfish.funFact: 獅子魚有毒的刺能引起劇烈疼痛，其毒液耐熱。
lionfish.name: 狮子鱼
lionfish.description: 狮子鱼是一種魚類。The lionfish is a venomous marine fish with distinctive red, white, and brown stripes and fan-like pectoral fins found in tropical reefs.

stonefish.funFact: 石魚是世界上最毒的魚類，其毒刺對人類可致命。
stonefish.name: 石头鱼
stonefish.description: 石头鱼是一種魚類。The stonefish is the most venomous fish in the world, masters of camouflage resembling rocks on the ocean floor found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

leafy-seadragon.funFact: 葉海龍沒有胃或牙齒，必須幾乎持續不斷地進食。
leafy-seadragon.name: 叶海龙
leafy-seadragon.description: 叶海龙是一種魚類。The leafy seadragon is a marine fish related to seahorses with leaf-like appendages providing perfect camouflage in kelp forests.

weedy-seadragon.funFact: 草海龍由雄性將卵攜帶在尾部直到孵化。
weedy-seadragon.name: 草海龙
weedy-seadragon.description: 草海龙是一種魚類。The weedy seadragon is a marine fish related to seahorses with small leaf-like appendages found in kelp forests of southern Australia.

boxfish.funFact: 箱魨在受壓時會釋放毒素，可殺死水族箱中的其他魚類。
boxfish.name: 箱鲀
boxfish.description: 箱鲀是一種魚類。The yellow boxfish is a small, cube-shaped reef fish with bright yellow coloration and black spots found in the Indo-Pacific.

cowfish.funFact: 長角牛魚頭上有兩根角狀棘刺突出。
cowfish.name: 牛角鲀
cowfish.description: 牛角鲀是一種魚類。The longhorn cowfish is a distinctive reef fish with horn-like spines on its head and a boxy, armored body found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

trunkfish.funFact: 箱魨受威脅時能從皮膚噴射有毒物質。
trunkfish.name: 箱鲀
trunkfish.description: 箱鲀是一種魚類。The spotted trunkfish is a small, box-shaped reef fish with white spots on a dark body found in Caribbean coral reefs.

filefish.funFact: 顆粒鳞能改變顏色和斑紋以融入周遭環境。
filefish.name: 鳞鲀
filefish.description: 鳞鲀是一種魚類。The scrawled filefish is a marine fish with a distinctive elongated body and blue spots found in tropical Atlantic waters.

triggerfish.funFact: 板機鰭背鰭上有一根刺能鎖定在直立位置。
triggerfish.name: 鳞鲀
triggerfish.description: 鳞鲀是一種魚類。The queen triggerfish is a large, colorful reef fish with distinctive blue lines on its face and a trigger spine on its dorsal fin.

leatherjacket.funFact: 翻車魚皮膚粗糙如砂紙，早期移民曾將其用作砂紙。
leatherjacket.name: 皮革鱼
leatherjacket.description: 皮革鱼是一種魚類。The slender leatherjacket is a small marine fish with a compressed body and rough skin found in coastal waters worldwide.

parrotfish.funFact: 鸚嘴魚將消化後的珊瑚以細白沙粒形式排出，創造了熱帶沙灘。
parrotfish.name: 鹦嘴鱼
parrotfish.description: 鹦嘴鱼是一種魚類。The stoplight parrotfish is a colorful reef fish with a beak-like mouth used to scrape algae from coral found in Caribbean reefs.

wrasse.funFact: 清潔蝦虎會設立清潔站，讓較大的魚排隊等待移除寄生蟲。
wrasse.name: 猪鱼
wrasse.description: 猪鱼是一種魚類。The cleaner wrasse is a small reef fish with a distinctive blue stripe that sets up cleaning stations to remove parasites from larger fish.

tuskfish.funFact: 豬魚會利用石頭當作砧板來敲碎貝殼取食。
tuskfish.name: 獠牙鱼
tuskfish.description: 獠牙鱼是一種魚類。The ornate tuskfish is a colorful reef fish with distinctive blue and orange markings found in the Indo-Pacific.

grouper-marbled.funFact: 巨石斑形成數千隻個體的大型產卵聚集。
grouper-marbled.name: 石斑鱼
grouper-marbled.description: 石斑鱼是一種魚類。The marbled grouper is a large reef fish with a marbled pattern found in tropical Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

wrasse-humphead.funFact: 蘇眉魚可存活超過三十年，是隆頭魚科中體型最大的現存魚類。
wrasse-humphead.name: 苏眉鱼
wrasse-humphead.description: 苏眉鱼是一種魚類。The humphead wrasse is the largest living wrasse species with a distinctive hump on its forehead found in Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

coral-grouper.funFact: 珊瑚石斑與海鰻合作狩獵，透過搖頭信號通知海鰻將獵物驅趕出來。
coral-grouper.name: 珊瑚石斑鱼
coral-grouper.description: 珊瑚石斑鱼是一種魚類。The coral grouper is a large reef fish with a reddish body and blue spots found in tropical Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

cardinalfish.funFact: 雄性 bombyli 鮋魚會將卵含在口中直到孵化。
cardinalfish.name: 天竺鲷
cardinalfish.description: 天竺鲷是一種魚類。The Banggai cardinalfish is a small, striking reef fish with black and white stripes and long fins found only in the Banggai Islands of Indonesia.

damselfish.funFact: 雄性galma會建造並照料精緻的藻類巢穴以吸引配偶。
damselfish.name: 雀鲷
damselfish.description: 雀鲷是一種魚類。The garibaldi is a bright orange damselfish found in kelp forests of the eastern Pacific, the official marine fish of California.

sergeant-major.funFact: 雄性sergeant major在守護魚卵時會變成深紫色。
sergeant-major.name: 军曹鱼
sergeant-major.description: 军曹鱼是一種魚類。The sergeant major is a small reef fish with five black vertical bars on a light body found in tropical Atlantic waters.

goby.funFact: 霓虹蝦虎魚設立清潔站，為大型魚類清除寄生蟲。
goby.name: 虾虎鱼
goby.description: 虾虎鱼是一種魚類。The neon goby is a tiny reef fish with a bright blue stripe that sets up cleaning stations to remove parasites from larger fish.

blenny.funFact: 隆頭魚常加入清潔魚群中以避免被捕食。
blenny.name: 鳚鱼
blenny.description: 鳚鱼是一種魚類。The Midas blenny is a small, golden-yellow reef fish that mimics cleaner wrasses for protection found in Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

scorpionfish.funFact: 毒鮋是偽裝大師，外觀像礁石上的藻類。
scorpionfish.name: 鲉鱼
scorpionfish.description: 鲉鱼是一種魚類。The tasseled scorpionfish is a venomous reef fish with elaborate skin flaps providing excellent camouflage found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

flathead.funFact: 扁頭魚是伏擊掠食者，會埋入沙中突襲獵物。
flathead.name: 鲬鱼
flathead.description: 鲬鱼是一種魚類。The bartail flathead is a bottom-dwelling marine fish with a flattened head and body found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

grunt.funFact: batfish因其磨牙時發出的聲音而得名。
grunt.name: 石鲈
grunt.description: 石鲈是一種魚類。The blue-striped grunt is a small reef fish with distinctive blue horizontal stripes found in Caribbean coral reefs.

tang.funFact: surgeonfish具極強領地意識，可能對其他魚類具攻擊性。
tang.name: 刺尾鱼
tang.description: 刺尾鱼是一種魚類。The clown tang is a bright blue surgeonfish with white and black markings found in coral reefs of the Indo-Pacific.

squirrelfish.funFact: 松球魚擁有大眼睛，適應夜間捕食。
squirrelfish.name: 松球鱼
squirrelfish.description: 松球鱼是一種魚類。The squirrelfish is a small, red reef fish with large eyes found in tropical coral reefs worldwide, active at night.

sweep.funFact: swept魚因其獨特的 swept 游泳方式而得名。
sweep.name: 鲳鲹
sweep.description: 鲳鲹是一種魚類。The sweep is a small, silvery fish with a distinctive deep body found in temperate rocky reefs of the Indo-Pacific.

leatherjacket-freshwater.funFact: 紐西蘭magazines是僅分布於紐西蘭的淡水翻車魚。
leatherjacket-freshwater.name: 皮革鱼
leatherjacket-freshwater.description: 皮革鱼是一種魚類。The New Zealand magpie is a small freshwater fish with a compressed body and rough skin found in rivers and lakes of New Zealand.

john-dory.funFact: 論黃鯛魚兩側各有一個獨特的深色斑點，看起來像指紋。
john-dory.name: 月鱼
john-dory.description: 月鱼是一種魚類。The John Dory is a marine fish with a distinctive oval body and dark lateral spot found in temperate coastal waters of the Indo-Pacific.

boarfish.funFact: 馬鮫魚利用其細長的吻部從珊瑚縫隙中取出小型無脊椎動物。
boarfish.name: 猪鱼
boarfish.description: 猪鱼是一種魚類。The longsnout boarfish is a distinctive reef fish with a long, tubular snout and black and white stripes found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

bigeye.funFact: 大眼魚擁有極大的眼睛，適應夜間捕食。
bigeye.name: 大眼鲷
