wool-carder-bee.description: 梳毛蜂是一種昆蟲。Wool carder bees are solitary bees that collect plant hairs to line their nest cells. Males aggressively defend patches of fuzzy plants where females forage for nesting material.

cicada-killer-wasp.funFact: 殺蟬蜂是北美最大的黃蜂，體長可超過兩英寸。
cicada-killer-wasp.name: 蝉杀手蜂
cicada-killer-wasp.description: 蝉杀手蜂是一種昆蟲。The cicada killer is a massive solitary wasp that hunts cicadas to provision its underground nest. Despite its intimidating size, it rarely stings humans unless provoked.

red-velvet-ant.funFact: 絲绒蟻實際上是無翅的蜂，擁有昆蟲界最疼痛的蟄刺之一。
red-velvet-ant.name: 红 velvet 蚁
red-velvet-ant.description: 红 velvet 蚁是一種昆蟲。The red velvet ant is a wingless female wasp with a dense covering of bright red hairs. Despite its ant-like appearance, it is a parasitoid wasp whose sting is extremely painful.

cuckoo-bumblebee.funFact: 杜鵑熊蜂滲透其他熊蜂巢穴，將卵產下由宿主養育。
cuckoo-bumblebee.name: 杜鹃熊蜂
cuckoo-bumblebee.description: 杜鹃熊蜂是一種昆蟲。Cuckoo bumblebees are social parasites that take over the nests of other bumblebee species. The female cuckoo bumblebee displaces the host queen and lays her own eggs for the workers to tend.

mosquito.funFact: 只有雌蚊叮咬，需要血液蛋白來產卵。
mosquito.name: 蚊子
mosquito.description: 蚊子是一種昆蟲。The Asian tiger mosquito is an invasive species that can transmit dengue, chikungunya, and Zika viruses. It is identified by its distinctive black and white striped body and legs.

house-fly.funFact: 家蠅用腳品嚐味道，能從數英里外偵測食物。
house-fly.name: 家蝇
house-fly.description: 家蝇是一種昆蟲。The common house fly is one of the most widespread insects, closely associated with humans. It has sponging mouthparts for liquid feeding and can transmit numerous diseases.

fruit-fly.funFact: 果蠅是基因研究中最重要的模式生物之一。
fruit-fly.name: 果蝇
fruit-fly.description: 果蝇是一種昆蟲。The common fruit fly is tiny but remarkably important in scientific research. They reproduce rapidly and share many genes with humans, making them invaluable for studying genetics and disease.

crane-fly.funFact: 大蚊常被誤稱為巨型蚊子，但不叮咬或吸血。
crane-fly.name: 大蚊
crane-fly.description: 大蚊是一種昆蟲。Crane flies are delicate, long-legged insects that resemble oversized mosquitoes. Adults are harmless and many do not feed at all, while their larvae, known as leatherjackets, live in soil.

horsefly.funFact: 馬虻是飛行速度最快的昆蟲之一，可達每小時一百四十五公里。
horsefly.name: 马蝇
horsefly.description: 马蝇是一種昆蟲。Horse flies are large, powerful fliers with razor-sharp mouthparts that slash skin to feed on blood. Only females bite, and their painful bites can transmit diseases to livestock and humans.

bot-fly.funFact: 馬蠅幼蟲在人類皮膚下發育，形成稱為蠅蛆病的疼痛膿瘍。
bot-fly.name: 狂蝇
bot-fly.description: 狂蝇是一種昆蟲。The human bot fly is a parasitic insect whose larvae develop beneath the skin of mammals, including humans. Adults do not bite; instead, they hijack mosquitoes to deliver their eggs to hosts.

hover-fly.funFact: 食蚜蠅模擬蜜蜂和黃蜂以求保護，但完全無害。
hover-fly.name: 食蚜蝇
hover-fly.description: 食蚜蝇是一種昆蟲。Hover flies are beneficial pollinators that mimic the appearance of stinging insects for protection. Their larvae are important predators of aphids, making them valuable in pest control.

black-fly.funFact: 黑蠅群密度極大，會堵塞牲畜呼吸道導致窒息。
black-fly.name: 蚋
black-fly.description: 蚋是一種昆蟲。Black flies are tiny but relentless biting insects that breed in flowing water. In some regions they transmit river blindness and are considered one of the most important disease vectors.

damselfly.funFact: 豆娘休息時將翅膀沿身體摺疊，與蜻蜓不同。
damselfly.name: 豆娘
damselfly.description: 豆娘是一種昆蟲。Damselflies are slender, delicate relatives of dragonflies that hold their wings together above their body when resting. They are important aquatic ecosystem indicators and voracious mosquito predators.

blue-dasher-dragonfly.funFact: 藍蜻蜓能倒飛並像直升機一樣懸停。
blue-dasher-dragonfly.name: 蓝晏蜓
blue-dasher-dragonfly.description: 蓝晏蜓是一種昆蟲。The blue dasher is a small, common dragonfly with a blue-green body and distinctive wing pattern. It is an agile aerial predator that catches mosquitoes and other small insects on the wing.

emperor-dragonfly.funFact: 帝王蜻蜓每天能吃掉與自身体重相等的昆蟲。
emperor-dragonfly.name: 帝王蜻蜓
emperor-dragonfly.description: 帝王蜻蜓是一種昆蟲。The emperor dragonfly is one of the largest and most powerful dragonflies in Europe. It patrols territories over water and feeds voraciously on mosquitoes, flies, and other flying insects.

four-spotted-chaser.funFact: 四斑蜻蜓是春季最早羽化的蜻蜓之一。
four-spotted-chaser.name: 四斑蜻蜓
four-spotted-chaser.description: 四斑蜻蜓是一種昆蟲。The four-spotted chaser is a robust dragonfly with distinctive dark spots on its wings. It is an aggressive territorial species that perches on vegetation to ambush passing prey.

robber-fly.funFact: 食蟲虻能捕捉並吃掉蜻蜓和蚱蜢等大型昆蟲。
robber-fly.name: 食虫虻
robber-fly.description: 食虫虻是一種昆蟲。Robber flies are aerial predators that intercept prey in flight. They inject victims with saliva that paralyzes and digests their insides, then suck out the liquefied contents.

marmalade-hoverfly.funFact: 食蚜蠅每年在歐洲遷徙數千英里。
marmalade-hoverfly.name: 橙带食蚜蝇
marmalade-hoverfly.description: 橙带食蚜蝇是一種昆蟲。The marmalade hoverfly is a bee-mimic hoverfly that is an important pollinator. Its larvae are voracious aphid predators, making it doubly valuable in gardens and agriculture.

common-mosquito.funFact: 蚊子造成的死亡人數超過歷史上任何其他動物。
common-mosquito.name: 普通蚊子
common-mosquito.description: 普通蚊子是一種昆蟲。Mosquitoes are small, buzzing flies that transmit deadly diseases including malaria, dengue, and Zika. Only females bite to obtain blood for egg production, while males feed on nectar.

biting-midge.funFact: 蠓蟲體型極小，能穿過標準紗窗。
biting-midge.name: 蠓
biting-midge.description: 蠓是一種昆蟲。Biting midges are tiny flies that deliver disproportionately painful bites. They are among the smallest biting flies and can be major pests in coastal and tropical regions.

deer-fly.funFact: 鹿虻被深色和二氧化碳吸引，類似蚊子。
deer-fly.name: 鹿蝇
deer-fly.description: 鹿蝇是一種昆蟲。Deer flies are fast-flying, aggressive biters with patterned wings. They transmit tularemia and can cause severe allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

cattle-bot-fly.funFact: 牛蠅幼蟲附著在牛的舌頭和喉嚨上，造成嚴重不適。
cattle-bot-fly.name: 牛狂蝇
cattle-bot-fly.description: 牛狂蝇是一種昆蟲。The cattle bot fly is a parasitic fly whose larvae develop in the throats of cattle. Adults are bee-like in appearance and do not feed, living only long enough to reproduce.

orchid-mantis.funFact: 蘭花螳螂外觀極像花朵，傳粉昆蟲會直接降落在牠身上。
orchid-mantis.name: 兰花螳螂
orchid-mantis.description: 兰花螳螂是一種昆蟲。The orchid mantis is a stunning pink and white mantis that mimics orchid flowers to ambush pollinators. It is considered one of the most beautiful insects in the world.

ghost-mantis.funFact: 幽靈螳螂外形酷似乾枯的落葉，幾乎隱身不見。
ghost-mantis.name: 幽灵螳螂
ghost-mantis.description: 幽灵螳螂是一種昆蟲。The ghost mantis is a master of camouflage with a body shaped and colored to resemble a dried leaf. It sways gently to mimic a leaf in the wind, hiding from both predators and prey.

leaf-mantis.funFact: 枯葉螳螂不規則的身體邊緣完美複製了破損、腐爛的落葉。
leaf-mantis.name: 叶螳螂
leaf-mantis.description: 叶螳螂是一種昆蟲。The dead leaf mantis is a large, spectacular mantis with a flattened body resembling a dead leaf. It is an ambush predator that waits motionless for prey to come within striking distance.

walking-stick.funFact: 竹節蟲能在蛻皮時再生失去的四肢，部分物種產生有毒的防禦化學物質。
walking-stick.name: 竹节虫
walking-stick.description: 竹节虫是一種昆蟲。Walking sticks are elongated, camouflaged insects that resemble twigs or branches. They are nocturnal herbivores that rely on their extraordinary disguise to avoid detection by predators.

giant-walking-stick.funFact: 巨型竹節蟲保持著世界最長昆蟲的紀錄。
giant-walking-stick.name: 巨型竹节虫
giant-walking-stick.description: 巨型竹节虫是一種昆蟲。The giant walking stick, also known as Chan's megastick, is the longest insect species, with females reaching over 14 inches including legs. It is native to Borneo's tropical rainforests.

american-cockroach.funFact: 蟑螂能在不進食的情況下存活數週，並能閉氣四十分鐘。
american-cockroach.name: 美洲蜚蠊
american-cockroach.description: 美洲蜚蠊是一種昆蟲。The American cockroach is the largest common cockroach found in human habitations. Despite its name, it originated in Africa and is now found worldwide in warm, moist environments.

german-cockroach.funFact: 德國蟑螂一隻雌蟲單年可產生多達三萬隻後代。
german-cockroach.name: 德国蜚蠊
german-cockroach.description: 德国蜚蠊是一種昆蟲。The German cockroach is the most troublesome indoor cockroach species worldwide. It reproduces rapidly, is resistant to many insecticides, and contaminates food and surfaces with pathogens.

madagascar-hissing-cockroach.funFact: 馬達加斯加嘶蟑透過強迫空氣通過特化的呼吸孔發出響亮的嘶嘶聲。
madagascar-hissing-cockroach.name: 马达加斯加发声蜚蠊
madagascar-hissing-cockroach.description: 马达加斯加发声蜚蠊是一種昆蟲。The Madagascar hissing cockroach is one of the largest cockroach species, reaching 3 inches long. It is famous for the loud hissing sound it produces when disturbed, used for defense and communication.

oriental-cockroach.funFact: 東方蟑螂有時被稱為水蟲，因為牠們偏好潮濕陰暗的環境。
oriental-cockroach.name: 东方蜚蠊
oriental-cockroach.description: 东方蜚蠊是一種昆蟲。The oriental cockroach is a large, dark species that prefers cool, damp environments. It is a scavenger that feeds on decaying organic matter and is associated with poor sanitation.

eastern-subterranean-termite.funFact: 地下白蟻群落可包含數百萬隻個體共同工作。
eastern-subterranean-termite.name: 东部地下白蚁
eastern-subterranean-termite.description: 东部地下白蚁是一種昆蟲。Eastern subterranean termites are the most destructive termite species in North America. They live in underground colonies and build mud tubes to reach wood structures above ground.

formosan-termite.funFact: 台灣乳白蟻在地上方建造蟻巢，能在約五個月內消耗一根二乘四英寸的木材。
formosan-termite.name: 台湾乳白蚁
formosan-termite.description: 台湾乳白蚁是一種昆蟲。The Formosan termite is one of the most destructive termite species, capable of consuming enormous amounts of wood. Unlike most termites, it can build above-ground nests, making it especially destructive.

dampwood-termite.funFact: 濕木白蟻是北美最大的白蟻，不需要接觸土壤。
dampwood-termite.name: 湿木白蚁
dampwood-termite.description: 湿木白蚁是一種昆蟲。Dampwood termites infest moist, decaying wood and are indicators of excessive moisture problems. They are larger than subterranean termites and do not build mud tubes.

drywood-termite.funFact: 乾木白蟻會踢出稱為frass的微小糞便顆粒，累積在受蛀木材下方。
drywood-termite.name: 干木白蚁
drywood-termite.description: 干木白蚁是一種昆蟲。Drywood termites live entirely within the wood they consume and do not require soil contact. They are difficult to detect and treat because colonies can be scattered throughout a structure.

cicada.funFact: 週期蟬在地下生活十三或十七年後，以數十億隻同步羽化。
cicada.name: 蝉
cicada.description: 蝉是一種昆蟲。Periodical cicadas are famous for their synchronized mass emergences every 13 or 17 years. They are the longest-lived insects and their emergences create deafening choruses heard for miles.

dog-day-cicada.funFact: 伏天蟬因其在夏季最炎熱時節出現而得名。
dog-day-cicada.name: 伏天蝉
dog-day-cicada.description: 伏天蝉是一種昆蟲。Dog-day cicadas are annual cicadas that emerge each summer, unlike their periodical cousins. Their loud buzzing songs fill late summer afternoons in eastern North America.

masked-devil-cicada.funFact: 部分澳洲蟬物種的鳴叫聲是昆蟲界最響亮的，超過一百二十分貝。
masked-devil-cicada.name: 面具魔蝉
masked-devil-cicada.description: 面具魔蝉是一種昆蟲。The masked devil cicada is an Australian species known for its distinctive facial markings. Like other cicadas, it spends years underground before emerging for a brief, noisy adult life.

leafhopper.funFact: 褐飛蝨單次跳躍可達體長的七十倍。
leafhopper.name: 叶蝉
leafhopper.description: 叶蝉是一種昆蟲。The brown planthopper is a major pest of rice crops in Asia. It feeds on plant sap and transmits the devastating rice ragged stunt virus and rice grassy stunt virus.

spittlebug.funFact: 沫蟬若蟲產生稱為cuckoo spit的泡沫狀唾液以保護自己。
spittlebug.name: 沫蝉
spittlebug.description: 沫蝉是一種昆蟲。Spittlebugs get their name from the frothy foam masses their nymphs produce on plant stems. These nymphs, called froghoppers, are sap-sucking insects that can transmit plant diseases.

aphid.funFact: 蚜蟲可透過孤雌生殖方式在不交配的情況下每隻雌蟲產生多達八十隻後代。
aphid.name: 蚜虫
aphid.description: 蚜虫是一種昆蟲。The green peach aphid is one of the most destructive agricultural pests worldwide. It reproduces rapidly through asexual reproduction and transmits over 100 plant viruses.

bed-bug.funFact: 臭蟲能在不進食的情況下存活超過一年，且對多種殺蟲劑具有抗性。
bed-bug.name: 臭虫
bed-bug.description: 臭虫是一種昆蟲。Bed bugs are parasitic insects that feed on human blood at night. They hide in mattress seams, furniture, and wall cracks, and their populations have surged worldwide due to pesticide resistance.

kissing-bug.funFact: 接吻蟲因其在人類睡覺時常叮咬臉部而得名。
kissing-bug.name: 接吻虫
kissing-bug.description: 接吻虫是一種昆蟲。Triatomine bugs, also known as kissing bugs, are vectors of Chagas disease. They feed on blood at night and transmit the parasite Trypanosoma cruzi through their feces.

stink-bug.funFact: 椿象受干擾時從胸部腺體釋放惡臭的化學物質。
stink-bug.name: 臭虫
stink-bug.description: 臭虫是一種昆蟲。The brown marmorated stink bug is an invasive species from Asia that has become a major agricultural pest in North America. It damages fruit crops and invades homes in winter seeking shelter.

box-elder-bug.funFact: 梧桐緣蝽在秋季大量聚集在溫暖的朝南牆壁上。
box-elder-bug.name: 槭树蝽
box-elder-bug.description: 槭树蝽是一種昆蟲。Box elder bugs are black insects with red markings that feed on box elder tree seeds. They become nuisances in fall when they cluster on buildings seeking warmth for winter.

water-strider.funFact: 水黽能在水面上行走，因為其腿上有微觀毛髮能捕捉空氣。
water-strider.name: 水黾
water-strider.description: 水黾是一種昆蟲。Water striders are insects that glide across the surface of calm water using surface tension. Their hydrophobic leg hairs create air cushions that keep them afloat while they hunt prey.

giant-water-bug.funFact: 田鱉又稱咬趾蟲，能造成極度疼痛的咬傷。
giant-water-bug.name: 田鳖
giant-water-bug.description: 田鳖是一種昆蟲。Giant water bugs are large, flat-bodied aquatic predators that prey on fish, frogs, and snakes. Males carry eggs on their backs and are sometimes called electric-light bugs for their attraction to lights.

american-grasshopper.funFact: 鳥蝗蟲飛行能力強，遷徙時能飛行相當距離。
american-grasshopper.name: 美国蝗虫
american-grasshopper.description: 美国蝗虫是一種昆蟲。The American bird grasshopper is a large, strong-flying grasshopper that feeds on a wide variety of plants. It gets its name from its bird-like flight and large size.

desert-locust.funFact: 沙漠蝗蟲群落可覆蓋四百六十平方英里，包含四百至八百億隻昆蟲。
desert-locust.name: 沙漠蝗虫
desert-locust.description: 沙漠蝗虫是一種昆蟲。The desert locust is the most destructive of all locust species. Under certain conditions it transforms from a solitary grasshopper into a gregarious swarming phase capable of devastating crops.

mormon-cricket.funFact: 儘管名稱中有蟋蟀，摩門蟋蟀實際上是盾背螽斯，而非真正的蟋蟀。
mormon-cricket.name: 摩门蟋蟀
mormon-cricket.description: 摩门蟋蟀是一種昆蟲。The Mormon cricket is not a cricket but a large shield-backed katydid that forms migrating bands of billions. They were named after Mormon settlers whose crops they devastated in the 1840s.

field-cricket.funFact: 雄性蟋蟀透過摩擦翅膀發出鳴叫，透過計算鳴叫次數可估算溫度。
field-cricket.name: 田野蟋蟀
field-cricket.description: 田野蟋蟀是一種昆蟲。Field crickets are known for their distinctive chirping songs produced by males to attract mates. They are omnivorous scavengers that feed on plants, fungi, and other insects.

katydid.funFact: 螽斯的鳴叫聲屬於超音波，人類需要特殊設備才能偵測。
katydid.name: 螽斯
katydid.description: 螽斯是一種昆蟲。True katydids are named after their call, said to sound like Katy-did, Katy-didn't. They are leaf-mimicking insects that produce loud, clicking songs at ultrasonic frequencies.

mole-cricket.funFact: 蟋蟀能游泳和飛行，使其成為高度可移動的草坪害蟲。
mole-cricket.name: 蝼蛄
mole-cricket.description: 蝼蛄是一種昆蟲。Mole crickets are burrowing insects with powerful, shovel-like forelegs adapted for digging through soil. They damage lawns and crops by feeding on roots and disrupting soil structure.

snowy-tree-cricket.funFact: 雪樹蟋蟀被稱為溫度計蟋蟀，因為其鳴叫頻率與溫度相關。
snowy-tree-cricket.name: 雪树蟋蟀
snowy-tree-cricket.description: 雪树蟋蟀是一種昆蟲。The snowy tree cricket produces a pure, musical trill and is famous for its temperature-dependent chirping rate. Dolbear's Law uses its chirps to estimate ambient temperature.

human-head-louse.funFact: 頭虱至少已伴隨人類一萬年。
human-head-louse.name: 头虱
human-head-louse.description: 头虱是一種昆蟲。Human head lice are parasitic insects that live on the scalp and feed on blood. They are wingless and highly adapted to life on humans, spreading through direct head-to-head contact.

body-louse.funFact: 體虱已被用於透過DNA分析追蹤人類遷徙模式。
body-louse.name: 体虱
body-louse.description: 体虱是一種昆蟲。Human body lice live in clothing and emerge to feed on blood. Unlike head lice, they can transmit serious diseases including typhus, trench fever, and relapsing fever.

human-flea.funFact: 跳蚤能跳躍體長的一百五十倍，相當於人類跳過摩天大樓。
human-flea.name: 人蚤
human-flea.description: 人蚤是一種昆蟲。The human flea, Pulex irritans, is the original flea species associated with humans. It is a blood-feeding parasite that can transmit diseases and has been a companion of humans for millennia.

cat-flea.funFact: 貓蚤是全球家寵上最常見的跳蚤物種。
cat-flea.name: 猫蚤
cat-flea.description: 猫蚤是一種昆蟲。The cat flea is the most common flea species affecting domestic cats and dogs. Despite its name, it infests many mammal species and can cause allergic dermatitis and transmit tapeworms.

oriental-rat-flea.funFact: 東方鼠蚤是黑死病期間鼠疫的主要傳播媒介。
oriental-rat-flea.name: 亚洲鼠蚤
oriental-rat-flea.description: 亚洲鼠蚤是一種昆蟲。The oriental rat flea is historically the most important disease vector among fleas, having transmitted bubonic plague during the Black Death. It feeds primarily on rats and other rodents.

brown-recluse-spider.funFact: 棕色遁蛛毒液能造成需要數月才能癒合的壞死性潰瘍。
brown-recluse-spider.name: 棕色遁蛛
brown-recluse-spider.description: 棕色遁蛛是一種昆蟲。The brown recluse spider has a violin-shaped marking on its cephalothorax and venom that can cause tissue death. It is reclusive and bites only when pressed against skin.

wolf-spider.funFact: 狼蛛母親將卵囊和蜘蛛幼蟲背在背上。
wolf-spider.name: 狼蛛
wolf-spider.description: 狼蛛是一種昆蟲。Wolf spiders are agile, ground-hunting spiders that do not build webs. They have excellent vision and chase down their prey, and females are notable for carrying their young on their backs.

jumping-spider.funFact: 跳蛛擁有所有蜘蛛中最好的視力，能跳躍體長的五十倍。
jumping-spider.name: 跳蛛
jumping-spider.description: 跳蛛是一種昆蟲。Bold jumping spiders are charismatic, fuzzy spiders with large forward-facing eyes. They are active hunters that stalk prey and leap to capture it, displaying complex courtship dances.

orb-weaver-spider.funFact: 圓網蛛幾乎每晚都會重建網，並食用舊網以回收蛋白質。
orb-weaver-spider.name: 圆蛛
orb-weaver-spider.description: 圆蛛是一種昆蟲。Garden orb weavers are among the most common web-building spiders. They create distinctive circular webs and are beneficial predators of flying insects in gardens and natural areas.

peacock-spider.funFact: 雄性孔雀蜘蛛會表演精緻的舞蹈展示，展開彩色的腹部瓣以吸引雌性。
peacock-spider.name: 孔雀蜘蛛
peacock-spider.description: 孔雀蜘蛛是一種昆蟲。Peacock spiders are tiny jumping spiders famous for the males' spectacular iridescent abdominal flaps used in elaborate courtship dances. Females will eat males who fail to impress.

brazilian-wandering-spider.funFact: 巴西漫遊蜘蛛擁有所有蜘蛛中最強的毒液，被列入金氏世界紀錄。
brazilian-wandering-spider.name: 巴西流浪蜘蛛
brazilian-wandering-spider.description: 巴西流浪蜘蛛是一種昆蟲。The Brazilian wandering spider is considered the world's most venomous spider. Unlike web-building spiders, it actively wanders the forest floor at night and can deliver a medically significant bite.

emperor-scorpion.funFact: 帝王蠍在紫外線光下會發出明亮的藍綠色光。
emperor-scorpion.name: 帝王蝎
emperor-scorpion.description: 帝王蝎是一種昆蟲。The emperor scorpion is one of the largest scorpion species and one of the most popular in the pet trade. Despite its intimidating size, its venom is relatively mild and it is generally docile.

bark-scorpion.funFact: 亞利桑那樹皮蠍是北美毒性最強的蠍子，能攀爬牆壁和天花板。
bark-scorpion.name: 树皮蝎
bark-scorpion.description: 树皮蝎是一種昆蟲。The Arizona bark scorpion is the most dangerous scorpion in North America. It is unique among scorpions in its ability to climb walls and ceilings, often entering homes through plumbing.

deathstalker-scorpion.funFact: 殺手蠍的毒液中含有正在研究用於癌症治療的化合物。
deathstalker-scorpion.name: 杀人蝎
deathstalker-scorpion.description: 杀人蝎是一種昆蟲。The deathstalker is one of the most venomous scorpions in the world. Its potent neurotoxic venom can be fatal to humans, but its venom compounds show promise in medical research.

spotted-lanternfly.funFact: 斑衣蠟蟬能在幾乎任何平坦表面上產卵達五十顆。
spotted-lanternfly.name: 斑衣蜡蝉
spotted-lanternfly.description: 斑衣蜡蝉是一種昆蟲。The spotted lanternfly is an invasive planthopper from Asia that feeds on over 70 plant species, threatening agriculture. Adults have distinctive spotted wings and bright red hind wings.

wheel-bug.funFact: 輪蝽因其胸部獨特的齒輪狀脊突而得名。
wheel-bug.name: 轮蝽
wheel-bug.description: 轮蝽是一種昆蟲。The wheel bug is a large, beneficial predatory insect with a distinctive semicircular crest on its thorax. It uses its proboscis to inject digestive enzymes into prey and is a natural pest controller.

sawfly.funFact: 鋸蠅幼蟲看起來像毛毛蟲，但有超過五對腹足。
sawfly.name: 叶蜂
sawfly.description: 叶蜂是一種昆蟲。Sawflies are wasp-like insects whose larvae feed on plant foliage, resembling caterpillars. The rose slug sawfly can skeletonize rose leaves, causing significant damage to gardens.

antlion.funFact: 蟻獅幼蟲在沙中挖掘錐形陷阱以捕捉螞蟻和其他小型昆蟲。
antlion.name: 蚁蛉
antlion.description: 蚁蛉是一種昆蟲。Antlions are insects whose larvae are famous for digging conical pitfall traps in sand. They wait at the bottom of the pit for prey to fall in, then inject digestive enzymes.

lacewing.funFact: 草蛉幼蟲被稱為蚜獅，每週每隻可捕食兩百隻蚜蟲。
lacewing.name: 草蛉
lacewing.description: 草蛉是一種昆蟲。Green lacewings are delicate, golden-green insects with lace-like wings. Their larvae are voracious predators of aphids and other soft-bodied pests, making them valuable biological control agents.

dobsonfly.funFact: 魚蛉幼蟲又稱地老虎，是水質良好的指標生物。
dobsonfly.name: 鱼蛉
dobsonfly.description: 鱼蛉是一種昆蟲。The eastern dobsonfly is a large, impressive insect with enormous wings and males have extremely long mandibles. The aquatic larvae are important food for trout and indicators of stream health.

mayfly.funFact: 成年蜉蝣的口器已退化，無法進食，僅存活至完成交配。
mayfly.name: 蜉蝣
mayfly.description: 蜉蝣是一種昆蟲。Mayflies are aquatic insects with extremely short adult lifespans dedicated solely to reproduction. Their larvae are important indicators of water quality and food for fish.

earwig.funFact: 蠼螋母親會守護卵並清理以防止真菌滋生。
earwig.name: 蠼螋
earwig.description: 蠼螋是一種昆蟲。The common European earwig is a nocturnal insect with distinctive pincer-like cerci on its abdomen. Despite myths, earwigs do not burrow into human ears, and mothers provide notable parental care.

silverfish.funFact: 衣魚是最原始的無翅昆蟲之一，四億年來幾乎沒有變化。
silverfish.name: 衣鱼
silverfish.description: 衣鱼是一種昆蟲。Silverfish are small, wingless, silver-colored insects that damage paper, textiles, and food. They are nocturnal and thrive in warm, humid environments like bathrooms and basements.

firebrat.funFact: 衣魚偏好華氏九十度以上的高溫，能在極熱條件下生存。
firebrat.name: 衣鱼
firebrat.description: 衣鱼是一種昆蟲。Firebrats are close relatives of silverfish that prefer much warmer environments. They are found near heat sources like furnaces and water heaters and feed on starchy materials.

jumping-bristletail.funFact: 跳蟲是昆蟲界最古老的物種之一，其化石記錄可追溯到四億年前。
jumping-bristletail.name: 跳蛃
jumping-bristletail.description: 跳蛃是一種昆蟲。Jumping bristletails are small, wingless insects that can jump by curling their abdomen. They are found in moist environments and feed on algae, lichens, and decaying plant matter.

snakefly.funFact: 蛇蛉幼蟲能高速向後爬行以逃脫威脅。
snakefly.name: 蛇蛉
snakefly.description: 蛇蛉是一種昆蟲。Snakeflies are predatory insects with an elongated prothorax that gives them a snake-like appearance. Both adults and larvae are beneficial predators of pest insects on trees.

cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.funFact: 部分杜鵑熊蜂物種已被重新歸類為與宿主完全不同的物種。
cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.name: 杜鹃熊蜂寄生蜂
cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.description: 杜鹃熊蜂寄生蜂是一種昆蟲。This cuckoo bumblebee species is a social parasite that takes over nests of other bumblebee species. The female enters a host nest, kills or displaces the queen, and uses the existing workers.

musk-bee.funFact: 麝蜂受干擾時會散發獨特的檸檬香氣。
musk-bee.name: 麝香蜂
musk-bee.description: 麝香蜂是一種昆蟲。The musk bee is a solitary ground-nesting bee known for its distinctive musky scent. It emerges in late summer and is an important pollinator of goldenrod and other fall wildflowers.

alkali-bee.funFact: 鹼蜂偏好鹹性、鹼性的土壤築巢，能形成大規模的聚集。
alkali-bee.name: 碱蜂
alkali-bee.description: 碱蜂是一種昆蟲。The alkali bee is a solitary ground-nesting bee that prefers alkaline soils near salt flats. It is an excellent pollinator of alfalfa and has been managed commercially for this purpose.

carpenter-ant.funFact: 木匠蟻不食用木材，而是開鑿木材建造巢穴廊道。
carpenter-ant.name: 木蚁
carpenter-ant.description: 木蚁是一種昆蟲。Black carpenter ants are large ants that excavate nests in moist, decaying wood. Unlike termites, they do not consume wood but can cause structural damage by hollowing out timbers.

pharaoh-ant.funFact: 法老蟻能在極小空間築巢，以在醫院傳播疾病而聞名。
pharaoh-ant.name: 法老蚁
pharaoh-ant.description: 法老蚁是一種昆蟲。Pharaoh ants are tiny, pale-colored invasive ants that are particularly problematic in hospitals and food facilities. They form huge colonies with multiple queens and bud frequently.

odorous-house-ant.funFact: 臭屋蟻被壓碎時聞起來像碎椰子。
odorous-house-ant.name: 臭屋蚁
odorous-house-ant.description: 臭屋蚁是一種昆蟲。Odorous house ants are common household ants that emit a distinctive coconut-like odor when crushed. They form large colonies and frequently nest inside walls and under floors.

blue-ringed-octopus.funFact: 藍環章魚的毒液含有河豚毒素，毒性足以殺死二十六個人。
blue-ringed-octopus.name: 蓝环章鱼
blue-ringed-octopus.description: 蓝环章鱼是一種海洋生物。The blue-ringed octopus is a small but deadly cephalopod native to coral reefs. Despite its diminutive size, its bright blue rings serve as a warning of its highly potent venom.

mimic-octopus.funFact: 能模仿超過十五種不同的物種，包括獅子魚和海蛇。
mimic-octopus.name: 拟态章鱼
mimic-octopus.description: 拟态章鱼是一種海洋生物。The mimic octopus is a master of disguise, capable of altering its shape, color, and behavior to resemble other marine animals. It was only discovered in 1998 off the coast of Indonesia.

colossal-squid.funFact: 巨王烏賊擁有所有動物中最大的眼睛，直徑可達十英寸。
colossal-squid.name: 大王酸浆鱿
colossal-squid.description: 大王酸浆鱿是一種海洋生物。The colossal squid is one of the largest invertebrates on Earth, inhabiting the frigid deep waters of the Antarctic. Its massive eyes are adapted to detect light in the perpetual darkness of the deep sea.

humboldt-squid.funFact: 又稱巨型魷魚或紅惡魔，因其攻擊性而得名。
humboldt-squid.name: 洪堡鱿鱼
humboldt-squid.description: 洪堡鱿鱼是一種海洋生物。The Humboldt squid is a large, aggressive cephalopod named after the Humboldt Current. It hunts in packs and is known for its rapid growth rate and voracious appetite.

giant-squid.funFact: 大王烏賊曾被認為是神話生物，直到二零零四年首次被拍攝到活體。
giant-squid.name: 大王乌贼
giant-squid.description: 大王乌贼是一種海洋生物。The giant squid is one of the most mysterious creatures of the deep ocean. With eyes the size of dinner plates and tentacles reaching over 40 feet, it is a legendary predator of the abyss.

firefly-squid.funFact: 透過稱為發光器的生物發光器官自行發光。
firefly-squid.name: 萤火虫鱿鱼
firefly-squid.description: 萤火虫鱿鱼是一種海洋生物。The firefly squid is a small cephalopod famous for its bioluminescence. Each spring millions gather in Toyama Bay, Japan, creating a spectacular natural light show.

caribbean-reef-octopus.funFact: 其三分之二的神經元位於腕足而非大腦。
caribbean-reef-octopus.name: 加勒比礁章鱼
caribbean-reef-octopus.description: 加勒比礁章鱼是一種海洋生物。The Caribbean reef octopus is a nocturnal predator that hunts crustaceans and small fish among coral formations. Its chromatophores allow rapid color changes for communication and camouflage.

flamboyant-cuttlefish.funFact: 是少數已知有毒的頭足類之一。
flamboyant-cuttlefish.name: 火焰花枝
flamboyant-cuttlefish.description: 火焰花枝是一種海洋生物。The flamboyant cuttlefish is a small, vibrantly colored cephalopod that walks along the seafloor on its tentacles. It displays pulsating patterns of yellow, maroon, and white as a warning to predators.

common-cuttlefish.funFact: 能利用快速變化的體色圖案催眠獵物。
common-cuttlefish.name: 墨鱼
common-cuttlefish.description: 墨鱼是一種海洋生物。The common cuttlefish is a highly intelligent cephalopod with W-shaped pupils and an internal cuttlebone used for buoyancy. It is renowned for its extraordinary ability to change color and texture.

chambered-nautilus.funFact: 鸚鵡螺在超過五億年間幾乎沒有發生任何變化。
chambered-nautilus.name: 鹦鹉螺
chambered-nautilus.description: 鹦鹉螺是一種海洋生物。The chambered nautilus is a cephalopod often called a living fossil, having existed since before the dinosaurs. Its beautiful spiral shell is divided into chambers used for buoyancy control.

argonaut.funFact: 雌性章魚會分泌紙質薄殼保護卵，是唯一此行為的章魚。
argonaut.name: 船蛸
argonaut.description: 船蛸是一種海洋生物。The argonaut, or paper nautilus, is a pelagic octopus where only females produce a delicate calcareous shell. Males are much smaller and lack shells entirely.

vampire-squid.funFact: 吸血鬼烏賊既非真正的烏賊也非真正的章魚，屬於自己的目。
vampire-squid.name: 吸血乌贼
vampire-squid.description: 吸血乌贼是一種海洋生物。The vampire squid inhabits the deep ocean's oxygen minimum zones. Despite its name, it feeds on marine snow rather than prey, and can turn itself inside out as a defense mechanism.

strawberry-squid.funFact: 其身體覆蓋著發光器，發出草莓紅色的光芒以偽裝對抗掠食者。
strawberry-squid.name: 草莓鱿鱼
strawberry-squid.description: 草莓鱿鱼是一種海洋生物。The strawberry squid is a deep-sea cephalopod covered in light-producing photophores. Its red coloring is invisible in the deep ocean, providing effective camouflage against predators.

cockatoo-squid.funFact: 墨魚吸入海水膨脹身體，使自己看起來更大更具威嚇性。
cockatoo-squid.name: 鹦鹉鱿鱼
cockatoo-squid.description: 鹦鹉鱿鱼是一種海洋生物。The cockatoo squid is a small, translucent deep-sea cephalopod that inflates its body like a balloon when threatened. Its distinctive appearance resembles a cockatoo with its arms raised.

pajama-squid.funFact: 擁有獨特的黑白條紋圖案，類似條紋睡衣。
pajama-squid.name: 睡衣鱿鱼
pajama-squid.description: 睡衣鱿鱼是一種海洋生物。The pajama squid is a small, nocturnal cephalopod with distinctive black and white stripes. It buries itself in sand during the day and emerges at night to hunt small crustaceans.

bobtail-squid.funFact: 在特化的發光器官中棲息著生物發光細菌，用於反照明偽裝。
bobtail-squid.name: 短尾鱿鱼
bobtail-squid.description: 短尾鱿鱼是一種海洋生物。Bobtail squids are small, round cephalopods that partner with bioluminescent bacteria. The bacteria produce light that matches the moonlight from above, eliminating the squid's shadow.

pygmy-squid.funFact: 利用鼻子上的黏液腺將自己附著在海草葉片上。
pygmy-squid.name: 侏儒鱿鱼
pygmy-squid.description: 侏儒鱿鱼是一種海洋生物。The pygmy squid is one of the smallest cephalopods, reaching barely an inch long. It uses a special adhesive gland to attach itself to seagrass blades, waiting to ambush passing prey.

american-lobster.funFact: 美洲螯蝦可存活超過一百年，且終生持續生長。
american-lobster.name: 美洲龙虾
american-lobster.description: 美洲龙虾是一種海洋生物。The American lobster is a large marine crustacean prized as a delicacy. It uses its powerful claws for defense and crushing prey, and can regenerate lost limbs during molting.

european-lobster.funFact: 歐洲螯蝦可重達二十八磅，是歐洲水域最大的甲殼類之一。
european-lobster.name: 欧洲龙虾
european-lobster.description: 欧洲龙虾是一種海洋生物。The European lobster is a large, deep-blue crustacean found along rocky coastlines. It is a solitary nocturnal hunter that preys on fish, crabs, and mollusks.

spiny-lobster.funFact: 刺龍蝦沒有大螯，而是靠發出響亮的刺耳聲來驅趕掠食者。
spiny-lobster.name: 刺龙虾
spiny-lobster.description: 刺龙虾是一種海洋生物。Spiny lobsters are colorful crustaceans found in tropical marine environments. Unlike true lobsters, they lack large front claws and instead rely on their spiny antennae and a unique alarm call.

slipper-lobster.funFact: 具有獨特的板狀觸角，外觀類似拖鞋鞋底。
slipper-lobster.name: 蝉虾
slipper-lobster.description: 蝉虾是一種海洋生物。Slipper lobsters are robust crustaceans recognized by their flattened, slipper-shaped antennae. They are bottom-dwellers that hunt mollusks and other invertebrates at night.

mantis-shrimp.funFact: 螳螂蝦能以.22口徑子彈的力量出拳，打破水族箱玻璃。
mantis-shrimp.name: 螳螂虾
mantis-shrimp.description: 螳螂虾是一種海洋生物。The mantis shrimp is a strikingly colored crustacean with the fastest punch in the animal kingdom. It possesses the most complex eyes known, with 16 types of color receptors compared to humans' three.

peacock-mantis-shrimp.funFact: 螳螂蝦擁有十六種色覺受體，能感知紫外線和偏振光。
peacock-mantis-shrimp.name: 孔雀螳螂虾
peacock-mantis-shrimp.description: 孔雀螳螂虾是一種海洋生物。The peacock mantis shrimp is one of the most colorful and formidable predators in the reef. Its club-like appendages strike with incredible speed and force, capable of shattering glass aquariums.

spearer-mantis-shrimp.funFact: 擁有帶倒鉤的矛狀appendage，用於刺穿魚類等軟體動物。
spearer-mantis-shrimp.name: 矛螳螂虾
spearer-mantis-shrimp.description: 矛螳螂虾是一種海洋生物。Spearer mantis shrimp are ambush predators that wait at the entrance of their mud burrows. They strike passing prey with barbed, spear-like appendages that can impale fish in milliseconds.

blue-crab.funFact: 因其在求偶展示中使用的亮藍色螯而得名。
blue-crab.name: 蓝蟹
blue-crab.description: 蓝蟹是一種海洋生物。The blue crab is a commercially important species found along the Atlantic coast of North America. It is an aggressive swimmer and opportunistic feeder that plays a key role in estuarine ecosystems.

king-crab.funFact: 帝王蟹帶刺的外殼展開可超過五英尺。
king-crab.name: 帝王蟹
king-crab.description: 帝王蟹是一種海洋生物。The red king crab is one of the largest crabs in the world, prized commercially in Alaska and Russia. Its massive, spiny legs can span over five feet and it can walk up to 100 miles during its annual migration.

japanese-spider-crab.funFact: 日本蜘蛛蟹的腳展是所有節肢動物中最大的，可達十二英尺。
japanese-spider-crab.name: 日本蜘蛛蟹
japanese-spider-crab.description: 日本蜘蛛蟹是一種海洋生物。The Japanese spider crab holds the record for the largest leg span of any living arthropod. Despite its enormous size, it is a gentle giant that scavenges on the ocean floor.

hermit-crab.funFact: 必須在一生中不斷尋找並更換更大的螺殼。
hermit-crab.name: 寄居蟹
hermit-crab.description: 寄居蟹是一種海洋生物。Hermit crabs are decapod crustaceans that use abandoned snail shells to protect their soft abdomens. They are social animals often found in groups, and play dead when threatened.

coconut-crab.funFact: 擁有所有動物中最強的握力，足以敲開椰子。
coconut-crab.name: 椰子蟹
coconut-crab.description: 椰子蟹是一種海洋生物。The coconut crab is the largest terrestrial arthropod, capable of cracking coconuts with its powerful claws. Despite its name, it lives primarily on land but must return to the sea to reproduce.

snow-crab.funFact: 雪蟹能容忍低至攝氏零點五度的近結冰水溫。
snow-crab.name: 雪蟹
snow-crab.description: 雪蟹是一種海洋生物。The snow crab is a cold-water species that lives on sandy and muddy bottoms. It is an important commercial species in both the Atlantic and Pacific, known for its sweet, tender meat.

fiddler-crab.funFact: 招潮蟹雄性擁有一隻巨大的螯，揮舞以吸引配偶。
fiddler-crab.name: 招潮蟹
fiddler-crab.description: 招潮蟹是一種海洋生物。Fiddler crabs are small semiterrestrial crabs recognized by the male's single oversized claw used in elaborate mating dances. They are important ecosystem engineers in mangrove and marsh habitats.

mud-crab.funFact: 可重達五磅，螯的力道足以剪斷人類手指。
mud-crab.name: 青蟹
mud-crab.description: 青蟹是一種海洋生物。The mud crab is a robust species found in mangrove ecosystems across the Indo-Pacific. It is one of the most commercially important crabs in aquaculture, prized for its sweet, firm meat.

atlantic-ghost-crab.funFact: 幽靈蟹奔跑速度可達每小時十六公里，並擁有柄眼提供三百六十度視覺。
atlantic-ghost-crab.name: 大西洋幽灵蟹
atlantic-ghost-crab.description: 大西洋幽灵蟹是一種海洋生物。Ghost crabs are pale, fast-moving crustaceans that burrow in sandy beaches. They are mostly nocturnal and use their large stalked eyes and acute hearing to detect predators and prey.

tropical-hermit-crab.funFact: 部分個體以超過一百隻的群體生活，以鏈狀方式共享螺殼。
tropical-hermit-crab.name: 热带寄居蟹
tropical-hermit-crab.description: 热带寄居蟹是一種海洋生物。Tropical hermit crabs are colorful land-dwelling crustaceans that inhabit beaches and coastal forests. They are highly social and often form shell exchange chains to ensure all members have appropriate shelter.

coconut-hermit-crab.funFact: 常見於椰子殼中，體型可長到足以用椰子殼作庇護所。
coconut-hermit-crab.name: 椰子寄居蟹
coconut-hermit-crab.description: 椰子寄居蟹是一種海洋生物。The coconut hermit crab is a large land-dwelling species that inhabits tropical island beaches. It is known for its habit of using coconut shells as mobile homes and feeding on fallen coconuts.

zebra-fiddler-crab.funFact: 雄性招潮蟹以其物種特有的獨特節奏揮舞其巨大的螯。
zebra-fiddler-crab.name: 斑马招潮蟹
zebra-fiddler-crab.description: 斑马招潮蟹是一種海洋生物。The zebra fiddler crab is named for the distinctive stripes on its carapace. Males perform elaborate claw-waving displays to attract females and defend territory on tropical mudflats.

great-spider-crab.funFact: 常在甲殼上裝飾海綿和藻類以偽裝。
great-spider-crab.name: 蜘蛛蟹
great-spider-crab.description: 蜘蛛蟹是一種海洋生物。The great spider crab is a camouflaged crustacean that attaches organisms to its shell for disguise. It migrates in large numbers to shallow waters for mating each autumn.

swimming-crab.funFact: 後足呈槳狀，能快速在水中游泳。
swimming-crab.name: 梭子蟹
swimming-crab.description: 梭子蟹是一種海洋生物。Swimming crabs are agile crustaceans with modified rear legs that function as paddles. They are aggressive predators that can pursue prey through the water column with remarkable speed.

common-shore-shrimp.funFact: 能緊緊抓住岩石以承受強大的海浪衝擊。
common-shore-shrimp.name: 普通岸虾
common-shore-shrimp.description: 普通岸虾是一種海洋生物。Common shore shrimp are small crustaceans inhabiting the turbulent intertidal zone. They use specialized appendages to cling to rocks and forage among algae and barnacles for food.

antarctic-krill.funFact: 南極磷蝦形成數十億隻的群落，從太空都能看見。
antarctic-krill.name: 南极磷虾
antarctic-krill.description: 南极磷虾是一種海洋生物。Antarctic krill are small crustaceans that form the foundation of the Antarctic marine food web. Swarms can contain billions of individuals and are a critical food source for whales, seals, and penguins.

pacific-krill.funFact: 太平洋磷蝦是北太平洋露脊鲸的主要食物來源。
pacific-krill.name: 太平洋磷虾
pacific-krill.description: 太平洋磷虾是一種海洋生物。Pacific krill are tiny shrimp-like crustaceans that swarm in massive numbers in the North Pacific. They are essential to the marine food web, feeding on phytoplankton and being consumed by larger marine life.

atlantic-krill.funFact: 磷蝦形成可延伸數英里、包含數兆隻個體的密集群落。
atlantic-krill.name: 大西洋磷虾
atlantic-krill.description: 大西洋磷虾是一種海洋生物。Atlantic krill are small pelagic crustaceans found throughout the North Atlantic. They are a keystone species, supporting populations of cod, herring, whales, and numerous seabirds.

giant-amphipod.funFact: 巨型端足類可長到典型端足類的二十倍大。
giant-amphipod.name: 巨型端足类
giant-amphipod.description: 巨型端足类是一種海洋生物。Giant amphipods are deep-sea crustaceans found in ocean trenches up to 10,000 meters deep. Their enormous size compared to shallow-water relatives is an example of deep-sea gigantism.

giant-isopod.funFact: 巨等足類能透過降低代謝率長達五年不進食。
giant-isopod.name: 巨型等足类
giant-isopod.description: 巨型等足类是一種海洋生物。Giant isopods are deep-sea crustaceans that can grow up to 14 inches long. They are scavengers that feed on whale falls and other organic material that sinks to the ocean floor.

lions-mane-jellyfish.funFact: 獅鬃水母的觸手可超過一百二十英尺，與藍鯨的長度相當。
lions-mane-jellyfish.name: 狮鬃水母
lions-mane-jellyfish.description: 狮鬃水母是一種海洋生物。The lion's mane jellyfish is the largest known jellyfish species. Its mass of long, trailing tentacles resembles a lion's mane and can extend far beyond its bell diameter.

portuguese-man-of-war.funFact: 僧帽水母實際上是四種稱為個體的特化生物群體，而非單一動物。
portuguese-man-of-war.name: 僧帽水母
portuguese-man-of-war.description: 僧帽水母是一種海洋生物。The Portuguese man-of-war is a siphonophore, not a true jellyfish. Its iconic blue float sails on the surface while trailing long, venomous tentacles that can deliver an extremely painful sting.

pacific-sea-nettle.funFact: 其金棕色鐘體和長長的觸手使它成為最美麗的水母之一。
pacific-sea-nettle.name: 太平洋海刺水母
pacific-sea-nettle.description: 太平洋海刺水母是一種海洋生物。The Pacific sea nettle is a large, visually striking jellyfish with a rusty-orange bell and long, coiling tentacles. It feeds on zooplankton, fish eggs, and other jellyfish.

upside-down-jellyfish.funFact: 倒立水母倒立棲息在海底，將共生藻暴露在陽光下。
upside-down-jellyfish.name: 倒水母
upside-down-jellyfish.description: 倒水母是一種海洋生物。The upside-down jellyfish, or Cassiopea, lies bell-down on the substrate to maximize photosynthesis by its symbiotic algae. It pulses gently to circulate water and capture food particles.

immortal-jellyfish.funFact: 燈塔水母能從成體形態退回幼年的水螅體階段， effectively逆轉衰老。
immortal-jellyfish.name: 灯塔水母
immortal-jellyfish.description: 灯塔水母是一種海洋生物。The immortal jellyfish, Turritopsis dohrnii, is biologically immortal. When stressed or aging, it reverts to its polyp form and begins its life cycle anew, making it the only known creature capable of true rejuvenation.

sea-wasp.funFact: 箱水母被認為是最毒的海洋動物，能在數分鐘內殺死人類。
sea-wasp.name: 箱水母
sea-wasp.description: 箱水母是一種海洋生物。The sea wasp, or Chironex fleckeri, is the largest and most dangerous box jellyfish. Its nearly invisible body and incredibly potent venom make it one of the deadliest creatures in the ocean.

compass-jellyfish.funFact: 其鐘狀體上有獨特的棕色V形紋路，類似羅盤花。
compass-jellyfish.name: 指南针水母
compass-jellyfish.description: 指南针水母是一種海洋生物。The compass jellyfish is easily identified by the brown radiating lines on its translucent bell that resemble compass markings. It feeds on small fish and other jellyfish.

fried-egg-jellyfish.funFact: 其鐘狀體極像煎蛋，黃色中心被白色環繞。
fried-egg-jellyfish.name: 煎蛋水母
fried-egg-jellyfish.description: 煎蛋水母是一種海洋生物。The fried egg jellyfish, or Cotylorhiza tuberculata, is a visually striking species with a bell that looks remarkably like a fried egg. Despite its large size, its sting is relatively mild.

blood-belly-comb-jelly.funFact: 受到干擾時會發出鮮紅色的生物發光。
blood-belly-comb-jelly.name: 血腹栉水母
blood-belly-comb-jelly.description: 血腹栉水母是一種海洋生物。The blood belly comb jelly is a deep-water ctenophore found in the Mediterranean. When threatened, it produces vivid red bioluminescence, creating a spectacular display in the dark waters.

atolla-jellyfish.funFact: 受到攻擊時會發出生物發光的車輪狀光芒，稱為「警報器」。
atolla-jellyfish.name: 阿托拉水母
atolla-jellyfish.description: 阿托拉水母是一種海洋生物。The Atolla jellyfish inhabits the deep ocean and is famous for its burglar alarm display. When attacked, it produces a rotating wheel of blue bioluminescence to attract larger predators that may attack its attacker.

spotted-jelly.funFact: 其半透明鐘體上有獨特的棕色斑點，因而得名。
spotted-jelly.name: 斑点水母
spotted-jelly.description: 斑点水母是一種海洋生物。The spotted jelly is a rhizostome jellyfish with a translucent bell covered in brown spots. It feeds on plankton and small organisms using oral arms lined with tiny mouth openings.

mauve-stinger.funFact: 紫水母能形成大規模爆發，干擾漁業和水產養殖作業。
mauve-stinger.name: 紫水母
mauve-stinger.description: 紫水母是一種海洋生物。The mauve stinger is a deep-water jellyfish with a distinctive reddish-purple bell covered in nematocyst clusters. It forms massive blooms in open ocean waters.

staghorn-coral.funFact: 鹿角珊瑚每年可生長八英寸，是生長速度最快的珊瑚之一。
staghorn-coral.name: 鹿角珊瑚
staghorn-coral.description: 鹿角珊瑚是一種海洋生物。Staghorn coral is a critically endangered branching coral species. Once dominant in Caribbean reefs, its populations have declined by over 80% due to disease, bleaching, and predation.

brain-coral.funFact: 腦珊瑚可存活近一千年，是地球上最長壽的生物之一。
brain-coral.name: 脑珊瑚
brain-coral.description: 脑珊瑚是一種海洋生物。Brain coral is named for its spherical shape and the winding grooves on its surface that resemble a human brain. It is a slow-growing but extremely long-lived reef-building species.

elkhorn-coral.funFact: 因其寬闊的鹿角狀分支酷似麋鹿角而得名。
elkhorn-coral.name: 角枝珊瑚
elkhorn-coral.description: 角枝珊瑚是一種海洋生物。Elkhorn coral is a critically endangered species that once formed vast reefs throughout the Caribbean. Its large, branching colonies provide essential habitat for hundreds of reef species.

pillar-coral.funFact: 最稀有的珊瑚之一，自一九九八年以來在佛羅里達已知沒有新生珊瑚。
pillar-coral.name: 柱珊瑚
pillar-coral.description: 柱珊瑚是一種海洋生物。Pillar coral is one of the rarest reef-building corals, distinguished by its tall, cylindrical columns that rise from the reef. It is listed as critically endangered with populations plummeting.

fire-coral.funFact: 不是真正的珊瑚，而是水螅蟲群落，能造成疼痛的刺傷。
fire-coral.name: 火珊瑚
fire-coral.description: 火珊瑚是一種海洋生物。Fire coral is a colony-forming hydrozoan that looks like true coral but delivers a painful sting on contact. Its smooth, branching colonies are typically brown, yellow, or reddish in color.

blue-coral.funFact: 唯一造礁的藍色珊瑚，因骨骼中含有鐵鹽。
blue-coral.name: 蓝珊瑚
blue-coral.description: 蓝珊瑚是一種海洋生物。Blue coral is a unique reef-building species with a distinctive blue skeleton. It is one of the few corals that can survive in turbid, low-light environments where other corals cannot.

mushroom-coral.funFact: 與多數珊瑚不同，蕈珊瑚是自由生活的，能短距離移動。
mushroom-coral.name: 蘑菇珊瑚
mushroom-coral.description: 蘑菇珊瑚是一種海洋生物。Mushroom corals are solitary, free-living scleractinian corals shaped like mushrooms. Unlike colonial species, each is a single polyp that can detach and roll across the substrate.

black-coral.funFact: 部分黑珊瑚群落經測定已存活超過四千年，是地球上最古老的生物。
black-coral.name: 黑珊瑚
black-coral.description: 黑珊瑚是一種海洋生物。Black corals are deep-water colonial organisms with a black or dark brown skeleton. They are among the longest-lived organisms on Earth, with some colonies surviving for millennia.

sea-pen.funFact: 海筆是固定在沉積物中的珊瑚蟲群落，部分物種受到干擾時會產生生物發光波。
sea-pen.name: 海鳃
sea-pen.description: 海鳃是一種海洋生物。Sea pens are colonial cnidarians that resemble old-fashioned quill pens. They anchor in soft sediment and can produce bioluminescent waves of light that travel along their colonies.

sea-whip.funFact: 部分物種產生的化合物被用於癌症研究。
sea-whip.name: 海鞭
sea-whip.description: 海鞭是一種海洋生物。Sea whips are octocoral colonies that grow in long, whip-like branches. They are filter feeders that extend polyps into the current to capture plankton and organic particles.

sunflower-sea-star.funFact: 向日葵海星最多可有二十四隻腕，是世界上最大的海星之一。
sunflower-sea-star.name: 海星
sunflower-sea-star.description: 海星是一種海洋生物。The sunflower sea star is one of the largest and fastest sea stars, but populations have crashed by over 90% due to sea star wasting disease. It is now listed as critically endangered.

crown-of-thorns-starfish.funFact: 長棘海星每年能消耗多達十平方英尺的珊瑚。
crown-of-thorns-starfish.name: 长棘海星
crown-of-thorns-starfish.description: 长棘海星是一種海洋生物。The crown-of-thorns starfish is a large, multi-armed sea star covered in venomous spines. It is a significant coral predator whose population outbreaks can devastate reef ecosystems.

blue-sea-star.funFact: 其鮮豔的藍色來自於可能保護其免受紫外線輻射的色素。
blue-sea-star.name: 蓝海星
blue-sea-star.description: 蓝海星是一種海洋生物。The blue sea star is a strikingly colored echinoderm that lives on sandy substrates. It feeds on small invertebrates buried in the sand and can regenerate lost arms.

leather-star.funFact: 海星表面光滑如皮革，與多數海星的粗糙表面不同。
leather-star.name: 革海星
leather-star.description: 革海星是一種海洋生物。The leather star is a smooth-skinned sea star found on rocky reefs. It has a distinctive reddish-brown color and a unique garlic-like odor when handled.

common-brittle-star.funFact: 海蛇尾能斷裂腕足逃脫掠食者，之後再生。
common-brittle-star.name: 阳燧足
common-brittle-star.description: 阳燧足是一種海洋生物。Brittle stars are echinoderms with a distinct central disc and five long, slender arms. They are more agile than sea stars, moving by writhing their arms across the seabed.

giant-basket-star.funFact: 擁有數千個分支的腕尖，能捕獲浮游生物和小型生物。
giant-basket-star.name: 篮蛇尾
giant-basket-star.description: 篮蛇尾是一種海洋生物。The giant basket star is a spectacular echinoderm with a complex network of branching arms. At night, it unfurls its arms into the current to capture plankton and small crustaceans.

feather-star.funFact: 能透過有節奏地擺動其羽狀腕在水中游泳。
feather-star.name: 海羊齿
feather-star.description: 海羊齿是一種海洋生物。Feather stars are mobile crinoids that cling to coral or swim through the water column. Their feathery arms filter plankton from passing currents, and they can detach to relocate when conditions change.

crinoid-feather-star.funFact: 能脫離基底並在條件不利時游泳重新定位。
crinoid-feather-star.name: 海羊齿
crinoid-feather-star.description: 海羊齿是一種海洋生物。Crinoid feather stars are ancient echinoderms related to sea lilies. They perch on coral heads and wave their feathery arms to capture passing plankton from ocean currents.

disk-brittle-star.funFact: 海蛇尾能再生完整的腕足，甚至中央盤體若被分離也能再生。
disk-brittle-star.name: 盘蛇尾
disk-brittle-star.description: 盘蛇尾是一種海洋生物。The disk-brittle star is a small, agile echinoderm found in rock crevices and under stones. It is an opportunistic feeder that can regenerate lost body parts rapidly.

purple-sea-urchin.funFact: 能利用稱為亞里斯多德燈的特化頜器在堅硬岩石上鑽孔。
purple-sea-urchin.name: 紫海胆
purple-sea-urchin.description: 紫海胆是一種海洋生物。The purple sea urchin is a spiny echinoderm that inhabits rocky shores. It uses its five-toothed jaw, Aristotle's lantern, to scrape algae and even excavate burrows in solid rock.

long-spined-sea-urchin.funFact: 刺海膽的棘刺可超過一英尺長，且帶有輕微毒性。
long-spined-sea-urchin.name: 长棘海胆
long-spined-sea-urchin.description: 长棘海胆是一種海洋生物。Long-spined sea urchins are tropical echinoderms with extremely long, sharp spines that provide excellent defense. They play a critical role in controlling algal growth on coral reefs.

pencil-urchin.funFact: 擁有粗鈍的棘刺，外觀像鉛筆，不同於典型的尖刺海膽棘刺。
pencil-urchin.name: 铅笔海胆
pencil-urchin.description: 铅笔海胆是一種海洋生物。Pencil urchins are named for their thick, cylindrical spines that look like colored pencils. They inhabit tropical reefs where they graze on algae using their complex jaw apparatus.

green-sea-urchin.funFact: 綠海膽可存活超過三十年，是最長壽的海膽之一。
green-sea-urchin.name: 绿海胆
green-sea-urchin.description: 绿海胆是一種海洋生物。The green sea urchin is a cold-water species found on rocky substrates. It is an important herbivore in kelp forest ecosystems, controlling algal growth and providing food for sea otters.

flower-urchin.funFact: 覆蓋著稱為球狀體的花狀結構，能注入令人疼痛的毒液。
flower-urchin.name: 花海胆
flower-urchin.description: 花海胆是一種海洋生物。The flower urchin is one of the most dangerous sea urchins, covered in venomous flower-shaped pedicellariae. Despite its beautiful appearance, contact causes intense pain and potential tissue damage.

sand-dollar.funFact: 其骨骼上的花瓣狀紋路實際上是五組管足，用於呼吸。
sand-dollar.name: 沙钱
sand-dollar.description: 沙钱是一種海洋生物。Sand dollars are flat, burrowing sea urchins found on sandy ocean floors. Their flattened bodies and fine spines allow them to bury themselves just beneath the sediment surface.

carpenter-sea-urchin.funFact: 拥有特別強壯的牙齒，能鑽穿堅硬的珊瑚岩。
carpenter-sea-urchin.name: 木匠海胆
carpenter-sea-urchin.description: 木匠海胆是一種海洋生物。The carpenter sea urchin is named for its ability to excavate burrows in solid coral rock. Its powerful Aristotle's lantern allows it to bore into reef substrates for shelter.

fire-urchin.funFact: 擁有毒棘，造成劇烈灼痛，類似火蟻的蟄刺。
fire-urchin.name: 火海胆
fire-urchin.description: 火海胆是一種海洋生物。The fire urchin is a striking red echinoderm with venomous spines that deliver an intensely painful sting. Despite its danger, it provides a symbiotic home for certain shrimp and crabs.

slate-pencil-urchin.funFact: 拥有粗鈍的棘刺，歷史上曾被用作書寫工具。
slate-pencil-urchin.name: 石笔海胆
slate-pencil-urchin.description: 石笔海胆是一種海洋生物。Slate pencil urchins are named for their thick, blunt spines that resemble slate pencils. These colorful echinoderms inhabit tropical reefs where they graze on algae.

tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.funFact: 能從身體 eject 黏稠的有毒管足以纏繞掠食者。
tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.name: 虎尾海参
tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.description: 虎尾海参是一種海洋生物。The tiger tail sea cucumber is a large, conspicuous species with distinctive dark stripes. It is an important bioturbator, processing sediment and recycling nutrients in tropical marine ecosystems.

lolly-sea-cucumber.funFact: 擁有獨特的管狀身體，外觀類似棒棒糖。
lolly-sea-cucumber.name: 棒海参
lolly-sea-cucumber.description: 棒海参是一種海洋生物。The lolly sea cucumber is a small, cylindrical species that processes sand and sediment on tropical reefs. It plays a vital role in reef health by recycling organic matter.

pacific-sea-cucumber.funFact: 海參在亞洲料理中被視為珍饈，商業採捕量極大。
pacific-sea-cucumber.name: 太平洋海参
pacific-sea-cucumber.description: 太平洋海参是一種海洋生物。The Pacific sea cucumber is an ecologically important detritivore that processes vast quantities of sediment. It is commercially harvested and considered a culinary delicacy in many Asian cultures.

black-sea-cucumber.funFact: 受壓時能脫離並再生其內臟器官，這個過程稱為排臟。
black-sea-cucumber.name: 黑海参
black-sea-cucumber.description: 黑海参是一種海洋生物。The black sea cucumber is a large, commercially valuable species found on tropical reefs. It ejects its internal organs as a defense mechanism and later regenerates them completely.

teatfish-sea-cucumber.funFact: 最具商業價值的海參物種之一，作為海參乾出售。
teatfish-sea-cucumber.name: 乳参
teatfish-sea-cucumber.description: 乳参是一種海洋生物。The teatfish is a large, highly valued sea cucumber that has been overexploited for the Asian beche-de-mer trade. Its distinctive nipple-like projections give it its common name.

red-sea-cucumber.funFact: 利用腹面的管足在海底緩慢爬行。
red-sea-cucumber.name: 红海参
red-sea-cucumber.description: 红海参是一種海洋生物。The red sea cucumber is a common species in Pacific kelp forests. It grazes on detritus and algae on rocky substrates, playing an important role in nutrient cycling.

christmas-tree-worm.funFact: 能在不到一秒內將其彩色的螺旋羽莖縮回管中。
christmas-tree-worm.name: 圣诞树蠕虫
christmas-tree-worm.description: 圣诞树蠕虫是一種海洋生物。Christmas tree worms are tubeworms that burrow into living coral colonies. Their colorful, spiral-shaped radioles filter plankton from the water and can retract instantly when disturbed.

giant-tubeworm.funFact: 巨型管蟲無口、胃或腸道，完全依賴共生細菌獲取營養。
giant-tubeworm.name: 巨型管虫
giant-tubeworm.description: 巨型管虫是一種海洋生物。Giant tube worms are extraordinary deep-sea organisms that thrive at hydrothermal vents. They rely on chemosynthetic bacteria housed in a special organ called the trophosome for all nutrition.

feather-duster-worm.funFact: 其羽冠狀的觸手用於進食和呼吸。
feather-duster-worm.name: 羽毛掸蠕虫
feather-duster-worm.description: 羽毛掸蠕虫是一種海洋生物。Feather duster worms are sedentary polychaetes that construct tubes on reef surfaces. Their spectacular crown of feathery tentacles filters plankton and can retract rapidly when threatened.

bearded-fireworm.funFact: 拥有中空的毒毛，接觸會引起劇烈灼痛。
bearded-fireworm.name: 火虫
bearded-fireworm.description: 火虫是一種海洋生物。The bearded fireworm is a predatory polychaete with venomous bristles called chaetae. Contact with these white, hair-like structures causes severe pain, inflammation, and numbness.

blue-glaucus.funFact: 利用儲存的氣泡在水的表面張力上倒立漂浮。
blue-glaucus.name: 大西洋海神海蛞蝓
blue-glaucus.description: 大西洋海神海蛞蝓是一種海洋生物。The blue glaucus, or blue dragon, is a tiny, vibrant blue sea slug that floats upside-down on the ocean surface. It stores stinging cells from its prey for its own defense.

spanish-dancer.funFact: 因其壯觀的波浪式游泳方式類似佛朗明哥舞者而得名。
spanish-dancer.name: 西班牙舞娘
spanish-dancer.description: 西班牙舞娘是一種海洋生物。The Spanish dancer is one of the largest and most colorful nudibranchs. When swimming, it unfurls its brilliant red and white mantle in a mesmerizing undulating display.

leaf-sheep.funFact: 是少數能進行光合作用的動物之一，從藻類中偷取葉綠體。
leaf-sheep.name: 叶羊
leaf-sheep.description: 叶羊是一種海洋生物。The leaf sheep, or Costasiella kuroshimae, is a tiny sea slug that can photosynthesize like a plant. It steals chloroplasts from the algae it eats and stores them in its body to produce energy.

sea-butterfly.funFact: 透過拍動其翼狀的殼延伸物游泳，外觀像飛行中的蝴蝶。
sea-butterfly.name: 翼足类
sea-butterfly.description: 翼足类是一種海洋生物。Sea butterflies are tiny marine snails that swim through the open ocean by flapping their wing-like shell extensions. They are an important food source for fish, whales, and seabirds.

sea-angel.funFact: 海天使是無殼的海蛞蝓，以優雅的翼狀動作游泳。
sea-angel.name: 海天使
sea-angel.description: 海天使是一種海洋生物。Sea angels are gelatinous, transparent marine gastropods that lack shells. They swim through cold ocean waters by flapping wing-like appendages and prey on sea butterflies.

sea-hare.funFact: 受威脅時能釋放紫色墨汁雲霧迷惑掠食者。
sea-hare.name: 海兔
sea-hare.description: 海兔是一種海洋生物。The California sea hare is a large marine gastropod named for its ear-like rhinophores. It feeds on kelp and seaweed and can release a cloud of purple ink as a defense mechanism.

giant-clam.funFact: 可重達五百磅以上，存活超過一百年。
giant-clam.name: 巨蛤
giant-clam.description: 巨蛤是一種海洋生物。The giant clam is the largest living bivalve mollusk, reaching over four feet in length. Its colorful mantle harbors symbiotic algae that provide much of its nutrition through photosynthesis.

geoduck.funFact: 象拔蚌可存活超過一百六十年，是地球上最長壽的動物之一。
geoduck.name: 象拔蚌
geoduck.description: 象拔蚌是一種海洋生物。The geoduck is the largest burrowing clam in the world, with a siphon that can extend three feet. Native to the Pacific Northwest, it is a prized delicacy in Asian cuisine.

atlantic-surf-clam.funFact: 受干擾時能利用肌肉足從沙中彈出。
atlantic-surf-clam.name: 大西洋浪蛤
atlantic-surf-clam.description: 大西洋浪蛤是一種海洋生物。The Atlantic surf clam is a large bivalve found on sandy substrates. It uses its powerful foot to burrow and can explosively eject itself from the sand when threatened by predators.

bay-scallop.funFact: 能透過快速開合貝殼進行短距離游泳。
bay-scallop.name: 扇贝
bay-scallop.description: 扇贝是一種海洋生物。Bay scallops are small, fan-shaped bivalves that live in shallow coastal waters. Unlike most clams, they can swim by rapidly clapping their valves, ejecting water for propulsion.

blue-mussel.funFact: 利用強韌的足絲附著在岩石上，形成數千隻的密集床。
blue-mussel.name: 贻贝
blue-mussel.description: 贻贝是一種海洋生物。Blue mussels are filter-feeding bivalves that attach to rocks with strong byssal threads. They form dense beds that provide habitat for numerous other species and are commercially cultivated.

thorny-oyster.funFact: 殼上佈滿長而尖銳的棘刺，用以驅趕掠食者。
thorny-oyster.name: 棘牡蛎
thorny-oyster.description: 棘牡蛎是一種海洋生物。The thorny oyster is a large, spiny bivalve that cements itself to reef substrates. Its long, sharp spines protect it from predators and can cause painful wounds if touched.

lion-paw-scallop.funFact: 因其帶有脊狀紋路的彩色外殼類似獅爪而得名。
lion-paw-scallop.name: 狮爪扇贝
lion-paw-scallop.description: 狮爪扇贝是一種海洋生物。The lion paw scallop is a large, colorful bivalve with a distinctive ridged shell. It can swim by clapping its valves and is found in kelp forests along the Pacific coast.

nautilus-pompilius.funFact: 螺殼呈對數螺旋，是自然界最完美的數學形式之一。
nautilus-pompilius.name: 鹦鹉螺
nautilus-pompilius.description: 鹦鹉螺是一種海洋生物。Nautilus pompilius is a cephalopod with a beautiful, spiraled shell that has inspired artists and mathematicians for centuries. It is a living fossil, virtually unchanged for 500 million years.

paper-nautilus.funFact: 雌性船蛸會分泌紙質薄殼保護卵。
paper-nautilus.name: 船蛸
paper-nautilus.description: 船蛸是一種海洋生物。The paper nautilus is an argonaut octopus in which only females produce a fragile, calcareous shell. Males are much smaller and shell-less, using a specialized arm to transfer sperm.

atlantic-horseshoe-crab.funFact: 四億五千萬年來幾乎沒有變化，早於恐龍出現。
atlantic-horseshoe-crab.name: 美洲鲎
atlantic-horseshoe-crab.description: 美洲鲎是一種海洋生物。The Atlantic horseshoe crab is a marine arthropod often called a living fossil. Despite its name, it is more closely related to spiders and scorpions than to true crabs.

japanese-horseshoe-crab.funFact: 其藍色血液中含有鱟細胞溶解素，用於檢測醫療設備的細菌污染。
japanese-horseshoe-crab.name: 日本鲎
japanese-horseshoe-crab.description: 日本鲎是一種海洋生物。The Japanese horseshoe crab is an endangered species whose unique blue blood is vital to modern medicine. The substance in its blood detects bacterial endotoxins in pharmaceuticals and medical devices.

indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.funFact: 是唯一分布於亞洲沿海水域的鱟物種。
indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.name: 东方鲎
indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.description: 东方鲎是一種海洋生物。The Indo-Pacific horseshoe crab is an endangered marine arthropod found in Southeast Asian coastal waters. Like its Atlantic relative, it has blue blood containing valuable immune cells.

sea-squirt-tunicate.funFact: 與脊椎動物的親緣關係比多數無脊椎動物更近，屬於脊索動物。
sea-squirt-tunicate.name: 海鞘
sea-squirt-tunicate.description: 海鞘是一種海洋生物。Sea squirts are tunicates, marine invertebrates that are surprisingly closely related to vertebrates. As larvae they have a notochord, which they lose as adults when they attach to surfaces and become filter feeders.

marine-flatworm.funFact: 能從小至其體長二百分之一的碎片再生整個生物體。
marine-flatworm.name: 海扁虫
marine-flatworm.description: 海扁虫是一種海洋生物。Marine flatworms are colorful, soft-bodied invertebrates that glide across reef surfaces. Despite their simple appearance, they are active predators that can deliver venomous bites.

sea-pen-glow.funFact: 受到物理干擾時會產生沿群落傳播的生物發光波。
sea-pen-glow.name: 海鳃
sea-pen-glow.description: 海鳃是一種海洋生物。The deep-sea pennatula is a species of sea pen that inhabits deep muddy bottoms. When disturbed, it produces stunning bioluminescent waves that ripple along its colony.

dodo.funFact: 渡渡鳥是來自模里西斯的不會飛的鳥類，因狩獵和入侵物種在十七世紀末滅絕。
dodo.name: 渡渡鸟
dodo.description: 渡渡鸟是一種鳥類。The dodo was a large, flightless bird native to the island of Mauritius in the Indian Ocean. It was related to pigeons and doves but evolved to be completely flightless with no natural predators.

woolly-mammoth.funFact: 長毛象曾與早期人類共存，其遺骸仍在西伯利亞永久凍土中被發現。
woolly-mammoth.name: 猛犸象
woolly-mammoth.description: 猛犸象是一種哺乳動物。The woolly mammoth was a species of elephant covered in thick fur that lived during the Pleistocene epoch. They roamed the cold tundra regions of North America, Europe, and Asia.

passenger-pigeon.funFact: 旅鴿曾經數量達數十億隻，其飛過時的鳥群能遮蔽天空數小時。
passenger-pigeon.name: 旅鸽
passenger-pigeon.description: 旅鸽是一種鳥類。The passenger pigeon was once the most abundant bird in North America, with flocks containing billions of individuals. Systematic hunting and habitat destruction led to its extinction in 1914.

tasmanian-tiger.funFact: 雖然被稱為虎，但牠其實是有袋類動物，與袋鼠的親緣關係比大型貓科更近。
tasmanian-tiger.name: 袋狼
tasmanian-tiger.description: 袋狼是一種哺乳動物。The Tasmanian tiger, or thylacine, was a carnivorous marsupial native to Tasmania, Australia, and New Guinea. The last known individual died in captivity in 1936.

quagga.funFact: 斑驢半身是斑馬、半身是馬，條紋僅在身體前半部。最後一隻於一八八三年死亡。
quagga.name: 斑驴
quagga.description: 斑驴是一種哺乳動物。The quagga was a subspecies of plains zebra that lived in South Africa. It was distinguished by its limited striping pattern, with stripes only on the head and front body.

pig.name: Pig
pig.description: The domestic pig is a stout-bodied farm animal raised worldwide for meat and known for its intelligence and social nature.
pig.funFact: Pigs are highly intelligent and can learn tricks like dogs

sheep.name: Sheep
sheep.description: Sheep are woolly ruminants raised for wool, meat and milk, known for flocking behavior.
sheep.funFact: Sheep can recognize up to 50 faces for years

goat.name: Goat
goat.description: Goats are hardy farm animals known for climbing and curiosity, raised for milk, meat and fiber.
goat.funFact: Goats have rectangular pupils for wide vision

horse.name: Horse
horse.description: The horse is a large domesticated hoofed mammal used for riding, work and sport.
horse.funFact: Horses can sleep both standing and lying down

donkey.name: Donkey
donkey.description: Donkeys are sturdy equids used as working animals, known for endurance and strong memory.
donkey.funFact: Donkeys have incredible memory and remember places for 25 years

chicken.name: Chicken
chicken.description: Chickens are domesticated fowl raised for eggs and meat, the most numerous bird on Earth.

duck.name: Duck
duck.description: Ducks are waterfowl raised on farms and found wild on ponds and rivers.
duck.funFact: Duck feathers are waterproof due to oil coating

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.description: Turkeys are large North American game birds domesticated for meat.
turkey.funFact: Turkeys can change head color with mood

alpaca.name: Alpaca
alpaca.description: Alpacas are South American camelids raised for soft fleece, similar to llamas but smaller.
alpaca.funFact: Alpaca fleece is 3x warmer than sheep wool

llama.name: Llama
llama.description: Llamas are domesticated camelids from the Andes used as pack animals and for wool.
llama.funFact: Llamas hum to communicate with each other

unicorn.name: Unicorn
unicorn.description: The unicorn is a legendary horse-like creature with a single spiraled horn, symbol of purity and magic.
unicorn.funFact: Unicorn horns were said to purify poisoned water

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.description: Dragons are legendary giant reptiles with wings and fire breath, guardians of treasure in folklore.
dragon.funFact: Dragons were said to hoard gold and breathe fire

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.description: The phoenix is a mythical fire bird that cyclically regenerates by rising from its ashes.
phoenix.funFact: The phoenix rises from its own ashes every 500 years

griffin.name: Griffin
griffin.description: The griffin has the body of a lion and head and wings of an eagle, a majestic guardian beast.
griffin.funFact: Griffins were said to guard gold mines

pegasus.name: Pegasus
pegasus.description: Pegasus is a winged horse of Greek mythology, born from Medusa and symbol of inspiration.
pegasus.funFact: Pegasus was born from Medusa's blood

mermaid.name: Mermaid
mermaid.description: Mermaids are half-human, half-fish beings who lure sailors with enchanting songs.
mermaid.funFact: Mermaid tears were believed to be pearls

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.description: The Kraken is a colossal sea monster resembling a giant squid, feared by sailors.
kraken.funFact: The Kraken was said to drag entire ships underwater

fairy.name: Fairy
fairy.description: Fairies are tiny winged folk who live in forests and use magic to protect nature.
fairy.funFact: Fairies were said to be 6 inches tall

t-rex.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
t-rex.description: Tyrannosaurus rex was a massive predatory dinosaur of the Late Cretaceous with tiny arms and powerful jaws.
t-rex.funFact: T-Rex had the strongest bite of any terrestrial animal

triceratops.name: Triceratops
triceratops.description: Triceratops was a horned dinosaur with three facial horns and a large frill for defense.
triceratops.funFact: Triceratops had three horns and a bony frill

stegosaurus.name: Stegosaurus
stegosaurus.description: Stegosaurus had distinctive kite-shaped plates along its back and spiked tail.
stegosaurus.funFact: Stegosaurus had a brain the size of a dog's

velociraptor.name: Velociraptor
velociraptor.description: Velociraptor was a feathered predatory dinosaur that hunted in packs.
velociraptor.funFact: Velociraptor was actually turkey-sized, not 2m tall

brachiosaurus.name: Brachiosaurus
brachiosaurus.description: Brachiosaurus was a giant long-necked sauropod that could reach high treetops.
brachiosaurus.funFact: Brachiosaurus was as tall as a 4-story building

pterodactyl.name: Pterodactyl
pterodactyl.description: Pterodactylus was a flying reptile with a wingspan up to 1m that soared over coasts.
pterodactyl.funFact: Pterodactyls were not dinosaurs but flying reptiles

ankylosaurus.name: Ankylosaurus
ankylosaurus.description: Ankylosaurus was an armored dinosaur covered in bony plates with a massive tail club.
ankylosaurus.funFact: Ankylosaurus had a club tail that could break T-Rex bones

brontosaurus.name: Brontosaurus
brontosaurus.description: Brontosaurus was a massive sauropod long thought to be Apatosaurus but now recognized again.

saber-toothed-tiger.name: Saber-Toothed Tiger
saber-toothed-tiger.description: Smilodon, the saber-toothed cat, had enormous curved canines for slashing prey.

hydra.name: Hydra
hydra.description: The Hydra is a multi-headed serpent of Greek myth slain by Heracles.
hydra.funFact: Cutting one head makes two more grow

cerberus.name: Cerberus
cerberus.description: Cerberus is the three-headed dog that guards the entrance to the Greek underworld.
cerberus.funFact: Cerberus guarded the gates of the Underworld

minotaur.name: Minotaur
minotaur.description: The Minotaur is half-man, half-bull imprisoned in the Cretan labyrinth.
minotaur.funFact: The Minotaur lived in a labyrinth on Crete

basilisk.name: Basilisk
basilisk.description: The basilisk is a legendary serpent king whose glance is lethal.
basilisk.funFact: Basilisk gaze could turn victims to stone

leviathan.name: Leviathan
leviathan.description: Leviathan is a colossal sea serpent of Hebrew mythology embodying chaos of the ocean.
leviathan.funFact: Leviathan could create whirlpools that sank ships

thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
thunderbird.description: The Thunderbird is a giant legendary bird of Native American lore that creates thunder.
thunderbird.funFact: Thunderbird wings were said to create thunder

kitsune.name: Kitsune
kitsune.description: Kitsune are nine-tailed fox spirits in Japanese folklore, shape-shifters of great magic.
kitsune.funFact: Kitsune gains a tail every 100 years, up to nine

nessie.name: Loch Ness Monster
nessie.description: Nessie is the legendary long-necked creature said to inhabit Scotland's Loch Ness.
nessie.funFact: First sighting of Nessie was in 565 AD

lop-rabbit.name: Lop Rabbit
lop-rabbit.description: Lop rabbits are domestic bunnies with long floppy ears, beloved as gentle pets.
lop-rabbit.funFact: Lop rabbits' ears flop due to a genetic mutation

persian-cat.name: Persian Cat
persian-cat.description: Persian cats are fluffy long-haired cats with flat faces, known for calm temperament.
persian-cat.funFact: Persian cats are one of the oldest cat breeds

corgi.name: Corgi
corgi.description: Corgis are short-legged Welsh herding dogs famous for cute looks and loyalty.
corgi.funFact: Corgis were herding dogs despite short legs

baby-otter.name: Baby Otter
baby-otter.description: Baby otters are incredibly cute pups that hold hands while sleeping to not drift apart.
baby-otter.funFact: Baby otters cannot swim at birth and must be taught

pika-cute.name: Pika
pika-cute.description: Pikas are tiny mountain hamster-like mammals that make hay piles for winter.
pika-cute.funFact: Pikas say 'meh' and collect tiny haystacks

fennec-cute.name: Fennec Fox
fennec-cute.description: Fennec foxes are desert foxes with enormous ears, often called the cutest fox.
fennec-cute.funFact: Fennec fox kits have oversized ears like their parents

quokka-cute.name: Quokka
quokka-cute.description: Quokkas are small marsupials from Australia famous for selfies and smiles.
quokka-cute.funFact: Quokkas always look like they are smiling

axolotl-cute.name: Axolotl
axolotl-cute.description: Axolotls are cute neotenic salamanders that keep external gills and smile.
axolotl-cute.funFact: Axolotls can regenerate their hearts and brains

hedgehog-cute.name: Hedgehog
hedgehog-cute.description: Hedgehogs are small spiny mammals that curl up when scared, adored for cuteness.
hedgehog-cute.funFact: Hedgehogs have 5000 spines and curl into a ball

sugar-glider-cute.name: Sugar Glider
sugar-glider-cute.description: Sugar gliders are tiny marsupials with a membrane that lets them glide, big-eyed and cute.
sugar-glider-cute.funFact: Sugar gliders can glide 50 meters between trees

centaur.name: Centaur
centaur.description: The centaur is half-human, half-horse, known for wisdom and archery in Greek mythology.
centaur.funFact: Centaurs were expert archers and healers

satyr.name: Satyr
satyr.description: Satyrs are half-goat, half-human forest spirits who love music and revelry.
satyr.funFact: Satyrs played flutes that enchanted travelers

wyvern.name: Wyvern
wyvern.description: The wyvern is a winged dragon with two legs and a barbed tail, often guarding castles.
wyvern.funFact: Wyverns have two legs unlike four-legged dragons

djinn.name: Djinn
djinn.description: Djinn are magical smoke-formed beings from Arabian lore who inhabit deserts and grant wishes.
djinn.funFact: Djinn were said to grant three wishes

golem.name: Golem
golem.description: The golem is a clay giant brought to life by Hebrew magic to protect its creator.
golem.funFact: Golems are animated by a word on their forehead

banshee.name: Banshee
banshee.description: The banshee is a wailing female spirit from Irish folklore whose cry warns of death.
banshee.funFact: Hearing a banshee wail foretold death

leprechaun.name: Leprechaun
leprechaun.description: Leprechauns are tiny shoemaking fairies from Irish myth who hide pots of gold.
leprechaun.funFact: Leprechauns hide gold at the end of rainbows

nymph.name: Nymph
nymph.description: Nymphs are nature spirits inhabiting rivers, trees and mountains in Greek lore.
nymph.funFact: Nymphs could live inside trees or rivers

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.description: The werewolf is a human cursed to become a wolf under the full moon.

yeti.name: Yeti
yeti.description: The Yeti, or Abominable Snowman, is a giant ape-like cryptid of the Himalayas.
yeti.funFact: Yeti footprints can be 45 cm long

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.description: Goblins are small, clever, green-skinned tricksters living in caves and mines.
goblin.funFact: Goblins were master miners and craftsmen

troll.name: Troll
troll.description: Trolls are giant, slow-witted brutes who live under bridges and mountains.
troll.funFact: Trolls turn to stone in sunlight

roc.name: Roc
roc.description: The Roc is a gigantic bird of Arabian myth so large it can carry elephants.
roc.funFact: Roc eggs were said to be 15 meters around

sphinx.name: Sphinx
sphinx.description: The Sphinx has a lion's body, human head and eagle wings, guardian of riddles.
sphinx.funFact: The Sphinx asked riddles to travelers

chimera.name: Chimera
chimera.description: The Chimera is a fire-breathing hybrid of lion, goat and serpent from Greek myth.
chimera.funFact: Chimera had a lion head, goat body and snake tail

siren.name: Siren
siren.description: Sirens are enchanting half-bird, half-women whose songs doom sailors.
siren.funFact: Sirens lured sailors to shipwreck with songs

harpy.name: Harpy
harpy.description: The Harpy is half-woman, half-bird, a swift wind spirit that steals offerings.
harpy.funFact: Harpies were winds spirits that snatched souls

garuda.name: Garuda
garuda.description: Garuda is a giant eagle-like deity, mount of Vishnu and enemy of serpents.
garuda.funFact: Garuda is the king of birds in Hindu myth

qilin.name: Qilin
qilin.description: The Qilin is a gentle Chinese unicorn-deer with dragon scales that brings good fortune.
qilin.funFact: Qilin appears only during peaceful reigns

fenrir.name: Fenrir
fenrir.description: Fenrir is the monstrous wolf of Norse myth destined to devour Odin at Ragnarok.
fenrir.funFact: Fenrir was chained by the gods with magic ribbon

jormungandr.name: Jörmungandr
jormungandr.description: Jörmungandr is the World Serpent of Norse myth, so huge it bites its own tail around Earth.

cyclops.name: Cyclops
cyclops.description: The Cyclops is a one-eyed giant blacksmith of Greek myth who forged divine weapons.

medusa.name: Medusa
medusa.description: Medusa is a Gorgon with snakes for hair whose gaze petrifies victims.
medusa.funFact: Medusa's gaze turned people to stone

anubis.name: Anubis
anubis.description: Anubis is the jackal-headed Egyptian god who guides souls to the afterlife.
anubis.funFact: Anubis weighed hearts against a feather

allosaurus.name: Allosaurus
allosaurus.description: Allosaurus was the top predator of Jurassic North America before T. rex.
allosaurus.funFact: Allosaurus had 32 teeth shaped like steak knives

spinosaurus.name: Spinosaurus
spinosaurus.description: Spinosaurus was a semi-aquatic fish-eating dinosaur larger than T. rex with a distinctive sail.
spinosaurus.funFact: Spinosaurus had a sail 1.8m tall on its back

diplodocus.name: Diplodocus
diplodocus.description: Diplodocus was an extremely long-necked sauropod with a whip-like tail.
diplodocus.funFact: Diplodocus had a tail with 80 vertebrae

parasaurolophus.name: Parasaurolophus
parasaurolophus.description: Parasaurolophus was a crested hadrosaur that could make loud calls through its hollow crest.
parasaurolophus.funFact: Its crest acted like a trumpet

iguanodon.name: Iguanodon
iguanodon.description: Iguanodon was one of the first dinosaurs discovered, with distinctive thumb spikes.
iguanodon.funFact: Iguanodon had thumb spikes for defense

archaeopteryx.name: Archaeopteryx
archaeopteryx.description: Archaeopteryx was a feathered dinosaur-bird that could glide between trees 150 million years ago.
archaeopteryx.funFact: Archaeopteryx is the earliest known bird

mosasaurus.name: Mosasaurus
mosasaurus.description: Mosasaurus was a giant marine reptile that ruled Late Cretaceous seas.
mosasaurus.funFact: Mosasaurus had double-hinged jaws like a snake

plesiosaurus.name: Plesiosaurus
plesiosaurus.description: Plesiosaurus was a long-necked marine reptile that swam with four powerful flippers.
plesiosaurus.funFact: Plesiosaurus had four flippers and a long neck

dimetrodon.name: Dimetrodon
dimetrodon.description: Dimetrodon was a sail-backed synapsid predator that lived 40 million years before T. rex.

woolly-rhino.name: Woolly Rhino
woolly-rhino.description: The woolly rhinoceros was a shaggy-coated rhino that roamed Ice Age Eurasia alongside mammoths.

irish-elk.name: Irish Elk
irish-elk.description: Irish Elk was the largest deer ever, with enormous antlers that spanned over 3 meters.

dire-wolf.name: Dire Wolf
dire-wolf.description: Dire Wolf was a large Ice Age wolf that hunted in packs across North America.
dire-wolf.funFact: Dire wolves were 30% heavier than gray wolves

painted-frog.name: الضفدع المطلي
painted-frog.description: frog المصورة هو برمائي متوسط الحجم يوجد في منطقة البحر الأبيض المتوسط.
painted-frog.funFact: يتخمد لمدة تصل إلى 9 أشهر سنوياً

african-elephant.funFact: أكبر حيوان بري على وجه الأرض
african-elephant.name: الفيل الأفريقي
african-elephant.description: الفيل الأفريقي هو أكبر حيوان بري على وجه الأرض، يتميز بحجمه الهائل وخراطيمه وأنيابه الظاهرة.

lion.funFact: القطط الوحيدة التي تعيش في مجموعات اجتماعية
lion.name: أسد
lion.description: الأسد هو القط الاجتماعي الوحيد الذي يعيش في مجموعات تسمى_groups.

tiger.name: نمر
tiger.description: النمر هو أكبر القطط الكبيرة الحية، بفرو برتقالي مخطط بالأسود وقدرة صيد قوية.

giraffe.name: زرافة
giraffe.description: الزرافة هي أطول حيوان بري على قيد الحياة، تستخدم رقبتها الطويلة للوصول إلى الأغصان العالية.

penguin.funFact: الإمبراطور يمكنه الغوص لأكثر من 500 متر

asian-elephant.name: الفيل الآسيوي
asian-elephant.description: الفيل الآسيوي أصغر من نظيره الأفريقي، بأذنين أصغر ورأس أكثر تدويراً.

white-rhinoceros.name: وعل أبيض
white-rhinoceros.description: الوعل الأبيض هو أكبر خمسة أنواع من وحيد القرن، يتميز بفمه الواسع وطبيعته الهادئة.

black-rhinoceros.funFact: عندما يُهدَّد يكون عنيفاً جداً ويهاجم
black-rhinoceros.name: وعل أسود
black-rhinoceros.description: الوعل الأسود من فصيلة العواشب بشفة علوية مقوسة، مشهور بطبعه الهجومي.

hippopotamus.funFact: يستطيع حبس أنفاسه تحت الماء لمدة 5 دقائق
hippopotamus.name: فرس النهر
hippopotamus.description: فرس النهر ثديي نصف مائي ضخم يقضي معظم نهاره في الماء للحفاظ على برودته.

cape-buffalo.funFact: واحد من خمسة حيوانات صيد كبيرة في أفريقيا
cape-buffalo.name: جاموس أفضف
cape-buffalo.description: الجاموس الأفضف من فصيلة البقر الكبيرة مشهور بطبيعته غير المتوقعة وقوارنيه المنحنية الضخمة.

american-bison.funFact: كان عدده 30-60 مليون في أمريكا الشمالية
american-bison.name: بيسون أمريكي
american-bison.description: البيسون الأمريكي هو أكبر حيوان بري في أمريكا الشمالية، كان يتجول في أسراب ضخمة في السهول الكبرى.

water-buffalo.name: جاموس مائي
water-buffalo.description: الجاموس المائي من فصيلة البقر الكبيرة يُستخدم على نطاق واسع في الزراعة في آسيا.

leopard.funFact: يمكنه حمل فريسة بضعف وزنه إلى أعلى شجرة
leopard.name: نمر
leopard.description: النمر حيوان بري متوسط الحجم من فصيلة السنوريات.

snow-leopard.funFact: لا يمكنه الزئير مثل القطط الكبيرة الأخرى
snow-leopard.name: نمر ثلجي
snow-leopard.description: النمر الثلجي حيوان بري يعيش في المناطق الجبلية في آسيا الوسطى.

jaguar.funFact: لديه أقوى لدغة بين جميع القطط الكبيرة
jaguar.name: نمر أمريكا
jaguar.description: النمر الأمريكي هو أكبر القطط في الأمريكتين.

cougar.funFact: يُعرف أيضاً بأسد الجبل أو البوما
cougar.name: أسد الجبال
cougar.description: أسد الجبال هو أكبر القطط البرية في غرب نصف الكرة الغربي.

brown-bear.name: دب بني
brown-bear.description: الدب البني حيوان بري كبير من فصيلة الدببة.

grizzly-bear.funFact: يمكنه شم الطعام من مسافة 32 كم
grizzly-bear.name: دب رمادي
grizzly-bear.description: الدب الرمادي حيوان بري من فصيلة الدببة.

polar-bear.name: دب قطبي
polar-bear.description: الدب القطبي حيوان بري يعيش في القطب الشمالي.

giant-panda.name: باندا عملاقة
giant-panda.description: الباندا العملاقة حيوان بري في الصين.

gray-wolf.name: ذئب رمادي
gray-wolf.description: الذئب الرمادي حيوان بري من فصيلة الكلبيات.

red-fox.name: ثعلب أحمر
red-fox.description: الثعلب الأحمر حيوان بري من فصيلة الكلبيات.

fennec-fox.name: ثعلب فنّك
fennec-fox.description: الثعلب الفنّك حيوان بري صغير في الصحراء.

arctic-fox.name: ثعلب قطبي
arctic-fox.description: الثعلب القطبي حيوان بري في القطب الشمالي.

coyote.name: كويوت
coyote.description: الكويوت حيوان بري في أمريكا الشمالية.
