blue-whale.name: حوت أزرق
blue-whale.description: الحوت الأزرق هو أكبر حيوان على وجه الأرض.

humpback-whale.name: حوت سن宝宝
humpback-whale.description: الحوت السن宝宝 حيوان بري بحري.

bottlenose-dolphin.name: دلفين أنف زجاجي
bottlenose-dolphin.description: الدلفين أنف الزجاجي حيوان بري بحري.

walrus.funFact: يمكنه إبطاء معدل نبض القلب للبقاء في الماء البارد
walrus.name: فول

capybara.name: كابي
capybara.description: الكابي حيوان بري في أمريكا الجنوبية.

beaver.funFact: يبني سدوداً تخلق أنظمة بيئية كاملة
beaver.name: قنادس
beaver.description: القنادس حيوان بري في أمريكا الشمالية.

squirrel.funFact: يخفي الطعام في أكثر من 1000 مكان
squirrel.name: سنجاب

guinea-pig.name: خنزير غينيا
guinea-pig.description: خنزير الغينيا حيوان بري في أمريكا الجنوبية.

hamster.funFact: يمكنه حمل الطعام في وجنتيه بوزن جسده
hamster.name: هملتر

rat.funFact: يمكنه السباحة والتسلق على أسطح عمودية
rat.name: جرذ

red-kangaroo.funFact: يمكنه القفز حتى 9 أمتار في قفزة واحدة
red-kangaroo.name: كنغر أحمر
red-kangaroo.description: الكنغر الأحمر حيوان بري في أستراليا.

otter.name: القندس المائي
otter.description: Otters are playful, semi-aquatic mammals known for their dense fur and tool use.
otter.funFact: لديه أكثر فراء كثافة من أي ثديي

honey-badger.name: الغرير
honey-badger.description: The honey badger is known for its fearlessness and thick skin that resists bee stings.

raccoon.name: الراكون
raccoon.description: Raccoons are clever, adaptable mammals known for their masked faces and dexterous front paws.

red-panda.name: باندا أحمر
red-panda.description: The red panda is a small arboreal mammal with reddish-brown fur and a ringed tail.

clownfish.funFact: جميعها تولد ذكوراً والأكثر هيمنة يصبح أنثى
clownfish.name: Clownfish
clownfish.description: Clownfish حيوان. Clownfish are vibrant orange fish with white bands that live symbiotically among sea anemone tentacles. They gain protection from predators while providing the anemone with food scraps and increased water circulation.

seahorse.name: الحصان البحري
seahorse.description: The seahorse is a small marine fish with a horse-like head, prehensile tail, and upright swimming posture found in shallow coastal waters worldwide.

tiger-shark.name: سمك القرش النمر
tiger-shark.description: The tiger shark is a large predator with distinctive dark vertical stripes found in tropical and subtropical oceans worldwide.
tiger-shark.funFact: Tiger sharks are known as the garbage cans of the sea because they eat almost anything.

bull-shark.name: سمك القرش الثور
bull-shark.description: The bull shark is a large, stocky shark found in warm, shallow coastal waters and occasionally in freshwater rivers.

hammerhead-shark.name: سمك القرش المطرقة
hammerhead-shark.description: The hammerhead shark is a distinctive shark with a wide, flattened head that gives it a hammer-like appearance found in warm waters.

whale-shark.name: سمك القرش الحوت
whale-shark.description: The whale shark is the largest fish in the world, reaching over 40 feet, a gentle filter feeder found in tropical oceans.

great-white-shark.name: سمك القرش الأبيض العظيم
great-white-shark.description: The great white shark is the world's largest known predatory fish, an apex predator found in coastal and offshore waters worldwide.

manta-ray.name: الشفoni
manta-ray.description: The manta ray is one of the largest rays in the world with a wingspan that can exceed 20 feet, a gentle filter feeder.

anglerfish.name: سمك الصنارة
anglerfish.description: The Atlantic anglerfish is a deep-sea fish with a distinctive bioluminescent lure that attracts prey found on the deep ocean floor.

pufferfish.name: Pufferfish
pufferfish.description: Pufferfish حيوان. The pufferfish is a marine fish capable of inflating its body to several times its normal size as a defense mechanism, found in tropical and subtropical waters.

piranha.funFact: لدغته يمكن أن تمارس ضغطاً يصل إلى 300 ضعف وزنه
piranha.name: Piranha
piranha.description: Piranha حيوان. The piranha is a freshwater fish native to South American rivers known for its sharp teeth and powerful jaws found in tropical and subtropical waters.

electric-eel.name: Electric Eel
electric-eel.description: Electric Eel حيوان. The electric eel is a freshwater fish capable of generating powerful electric shocks used for hunting and self-defense found in South American rivers.

komodo-dragon.name: تنين كومودو
komodo-dragon.description: The Komodo dragon is the largest living lizard in the world, found on a few Indonesian islands. It is an apex predator capable of taking down deer, pigs, and even water buffalo. Young Komodo dragons spend their first years in trees to avoid predation by adults.

king-cobra.name: الكوبرا الملك
king-cobra.description: The king cobra is the world's longest venomous snake, capable of reaching lengths over 13 feet. Found in the tropical forests of South and Southeast Asia, it primarily feeds on other snakes. Its venom is potent enough to kill an elephant.

green-sea-turtle.name: سلحفاة بحر خضراء
green-sea-turtle.description: Green sea turtles are among the largest sea turtles in the world and the only herbivorous marine turtle species. They migrate long distances between feeding grounds and nesting beaches, returning to the same beach where they were born.

green-iguana.name: الإغوانا الخضراء
green-iguana.description: The green iguana is a large, arboreal herbivorous lizard native to Central and South America. It is excellent at swimming and can hold its breath for up to 30 minutes. Juveniles are bright green while adults may turn orange or dull grey.
green-iguana.funFact: سباح ماهر، يمكنه حبس أنفاسه 30 دقيقة

boa-constrictor.name: البوةrestricted
boa-constrictor.description: The boa constrictor is a large, non-venomous constrictor found throughout Central and South America. It is a highly adaptable species found in rainforests, savannas, and even near human habitations. It kills prey by constriction and is a popular species in captivity.

black-mamba.name: المامبا السوداء
black-mamba.description: The black mamba is the fastest snake in the world and one of the most venomous. Found in eastern and southern Africa, it can reach speeds of 12 mph and strike with incredible accuracy. Its venom is neurotoxic and can be fatal without antivenom.

ball-python.name: ال_piton
ball-python.description: The ball python is a non-venomous constrictor native to the grasslands of western and central Africa. It is the most popular pet snake in the world due to its docile temperament and manageable size. It has hundreds of color morphs bred in captivity.
ball-python.funFact: أكثر ثعبان أليف شعبية في العالم

red-eared-slider.name: سلحفاة الأذن الحمراء
red-eared-slider.description: The red-eared slider is a semi-aquatic turtle native to the Mississippi Valley region of the United States. It is the most popular pet turtle in the world and has become a significant invasive species on every continent except Antarctica. It has a distinctive red stripe behind each eye.

emperor-penguin.name: بطريق الإمبراطور
emperor-penguin.description: The emperor penguin is the tallest and heaviest of all living penguins. It breeds during the Antarctic winter, with males incubating the egg for about 65 days.
emperor-penguin.funFact: يحتضن البيضة على قدميه لمدة 65 يوماً

king-penguin.name: بطريق الملك
king-penguin.description: The king penguin is the second-largest penguin species, found on sub-Antarctic islands with striking orange and silver markings.
king-penguin.funFact: King penguin parents can go up to two weeks without eating while incubating their egg.

bald-eagle.name: النسر الأصلع
bald-eagle.description: The bald eagle is a bird of prey found in North America and a national symbol of the United States. It is a large raptor with a distinctive white head and tail contrasting with a dark brown body.
bald-eagle.funFact: أعشاشها يمكن أن تزن حتى 2 طن

golden-eagle.name: النسر الذهبي
golden-eagle.description: The golden eagle is one of the largest and most powerful raptors in North America and Eurasia. Named for the golden-brown plumage on its head and neck, it hunts primarily rabbits and hares.

peregrine-falcon.name: Peregrine Falcon
peregrine-falcon.description: Peregrine Falcon حيوان. The peregrine falcon is a widespread bird of prey known for its incredible speed during its hunting dive. It feeds primarily on medium-sized birds caught in flight.

barn-owl.name: بومة
barn-owl.description: The barn owl is a nocturnal raptor found on every continent except Antarctica. Known for its heart-shaped face and ghostly white plumage, it is an exceptionally efficient hunter of rodents.

mallard.name: البط البري
mallard.description: The mallard is the most common and widespread duck in the Northern Hemisphere. Males have a distinctive iridescent green head, while females are mottled brown.
mallard.funFact: All domestic ducks are descendants of the wild mallard except for the muscovy duck.

canada-goose.name: أوز كندي
canada-goose.description: The Canada goose is a large waterfowl native to North America, recognized by its black head and neck with white chinstrap. Highly adaptable, it is known for its V-formation flight.
canada-goose.funFact: Canada geese mate for life and can live together for over 20 years.

mute-swan.name: البجعة الصامتة
mute-swan.description: The mute swan is one of the largest flying birds, with pure white plumage and an orange bill with a black knob. It is known for its graceful S-shaped neck posture.
mute-swan.funFact: Mute swans can be aggressive defenders of their nests, charging at intruders.

flamingo.funFact: يولد أبيض ولونه يأتي من الطعام
flamingo.name: Greater Flamingo
flamingo.description: Greater Flamingo حيوان. The greater flamingo is the largest and most widespread flamingo species. Its pink plumage, long legs, and curved bill are unmistakable.

ostrich.name: Common Ostrich
ostrich.description: Common Ostrich حيوان. The common ostrich is the largest living bird, native to Africa. Unable to fly, it has powerful legs and can run at sustained speeds of 30 mph.

emu.name: الemu
emu.description: The emu is the second-largest living bird, native to Australia. It is flightless with vestigial wings. The male emu performs all parental duties.
emu.funFact: Male emus incubate the eggs and raise the chicks alone for up to 18 months.

monarch-butterfly.name: Monarch Butterfly
monarch-butterfly.description: Monarch Butterfly حيوان. The monarch butterfly is one of the most recognizable butterflies in North America, known for its striking orange and black wing pattern. It is famous for its incredible long-distance migration across thousands of miles.

ladybug.funFact: معلبة واحدة يمكنها أكل 5000 منقذ في حياتها
ladybug.name: Seven-Spotted Ladybug
ladybug.description: Seven-Spotted Ladybug حيوان. Ladybugs are small, round beetles valued by gardeners for their appetite for aphids and other plant pests. Their bright red coloration with black spots warns predators of their bitter taste.

sloth.name: السلق
sloth.description: Sloths are slow-moving tree-dwelling mammals known for their lazy lifestyle.

axolotl.name: Axolotl
axolotl.description: Axolotl حيوان. The Axolotl is a neotenic salamander that retains its larval features throughout life, including external gills. Found only in Lake Xochimilco in Mexico, it is critically endangered in the wild but widely bred in captivity.

incredible-frog.name: ضفدع لا يصدق
incredible-frog.description: The Incredible Frog is a small tree frog found in the rainforests of Central America. They have specialized finger and toe pads that allow them to control their descent when jumping between trees.
incredible-frog.funFact: The Incredible Frog can extend its fingers and toes to slow its descent when jumping from high branches.

meerkat.name: الخيريك
meerkat.description: Meerkats are social mongooses that live in the Kalahari Desert.

mongoose.name: المانغوس
mongoose.description: Mongooses are small carnivores known for their ability to fight snakes.

praying-mantis.name: ال jdada
praying-mantis.description: The Chinese praying mantis is a large, elongated predatory insect with triangular head and powerful raptorial front legs. It is a sit-and-wait ambush predator of other insects.
praying-mantis.funFact: Praying mantises can rotate their heads 180 degrees to scan for prey.

dragonfly.name: اليعسوب
dragonfly.description: Dragonflies are ancient aerial predators with enormous compound eyes and two pairs of independently controlled wings. They are among the most efficient hunters in the insect world.
dragonfly.funFact: Dragonflies can fly in all six directions and hover like a helicopter.

firefly.name: الخنفساء اللامعة
firefly.description: Fireflies are beetles famous for their bioluminescent abdomens used to attract mates. Both adults and larvae produce light through a chemical reaction involving luciferin and luciferase.
firefly.funFact: Firefly larvae glow too, and some produce light to deter predators.

black-widow-spider.name: الارملة السوداء
black-widow-spider.description: The southern black widow is one of North America's most venomous spiders. Females are recognized by the red hourglass marking on their abdomen and sometimes eat the male after mating.
black-widow-spider.funFact: The black widow's venom is 15 times stronger than a rattlesnake's, but less is injected.

tarantula.name: الترنتولا
tarantula.description: The Mexican red-kneed tarantula is a large, docile spider popular in the pet trade. It has urticating hairs on its abdomen that it can flick at threats, causing skin irritation.
tarantula.funFact: Tarantulas urinate from their fangs, using digestive fluid rather than water.

giant-pacific-octopus.name: الأخطبوط العملاق
giant-pacific-octopus.description: The giant Pacific octopus is the largest known octopus species, renowned for its intelligence and ability to solve puzzles. It has three hearts, blue blood, and eight dexterous arms lined with suckers.
giant-pacific-octopus.funFact: Can change color and texture in milliseconds to blend with surroundings.

common-octopus.name: الأخطبوط الشائع
common-octopus.description: The common octopus is a highly intelligent marine invertebrate with excellent eyesight and problem-solving abilities. It uses ink clouds and camouflage as primary defense mechanisms.
common-octopus.funFact: Can squeeze through any opening larger than its beak.

moon-jellyfish.name: قنديل البحر القمري
moon-jellyfish.description: Moon jellyfish are one of the most common and widely distributed jellyfish species. Their translucent bells pulse gently through coastal waters, feeding on plankton and small organisms.
moon-jellyfish.funFact: Can reproduce both sexually and asexually, allowing population explosions.

box-jellyfish.name: قنديل البحر الصندوقي
box-jellyfish.description: Box jellyfish are among the most venomous creatures on Earth. Their nearly transparent, cube-shaped bells and up to 60 tentacles make them difficult to spot in tropical waters.
box-jellyfish.funFact: Has 24 eyes including two that can form images, unlike most jellyfish.

common-starfish.name: نجم البحر الشائع
common-starfish.description: The common starfish is one of the most recognizable sea stars, with five arms and a tough, spiny surface. It feeds on mussels and oysters by everting its stomach through its mouth.
common-starfish.funFact: Can turn its stomach inside out to digest prey externally.

blue-poison-dart-frog.name: ضفدع السهم السام الأزرق
blue-poison-dart-frog.description: The Blue Poison Dart Frog is a small, brilliantly colored amphibian found in the rainforests of Suriname. Their vivid blue coloration warns predators of their potent skin toxins.
blue-poison-dart-frog.funFact: Blue Poison Dart Frogs derive their toxicity from the ants and mites they eat in the wild.

golden-poison-dart-frog.name: ضفدع السهم السام الذهبي
golden-poison-dart-frog.description: The Golden Poison Dart Frog is the most toxic vertebrate on Earth. Found only in Colombia, its bright yellow skin contains batrachotoxin, a potent neurotoxin used by indigenous people to poison blowgun darts.
golden-poison-dart-frog.funFact: A single Golden Poison Dart Frog carries enough toxin to kill 10 grown men.

red-eyed-tree-frog.name: ضفدع الشجر ذي العيون الحمراء
red-eyed-tree-frog.description: The Red-Eyed Tree Frog is one of the most iconic rainforest amphibians. With vibrant green bodies, blue and yellow striped sides, and stunning red eyes, they are a symbol of tropical biodiversity.
red-eyed-tree-frog.funFact: Red-Eyed Tree Frogs flash their bright red eyes to startle predators, giving them a chance to escape.

green-basilisk.name: الباسيليسك الأخضر
green-basilisk.description: The green basilisk is a striking lizard found in the tropical rainforests of Central America. Males have impressive crests on their heads, backs, and tails. It is famous for its ability to run bipedally across water surfaces for short distances.
green-basilisk.funFact: The green basilisk is also called the Jesus Christ lizard because it can run across the surface of water.

thorny-devil.name: الشيطان الشائك
thorny-devil.description: The thorny devil is a small, spiny lizard native to the arid deserts of central Australia. Its entire body is covered in conical spines that provide defense against predators. Its skin has microscopic channels that collect water and transport it to its mouth.
thorny-devil.funFact: Thorny devils have micro-channels in their skin that funnel water from any body part directly to their mouths.

common-snapping-turtle.name: السلحفاة العاضة
common-snapping-turtle.description: The common snapping turtle is a large, freshwater turtle found across eastern North America. It has a powerful beak-like jaw and a long, prehistoric-looking tail. Unlike most turtles, it cannot fully retract into its shell, making it more aggressive on land.
common-snapping-turtle.funFact: Common snapping turtles can extend their necks nearly the length of their shell to strike at prey or threats.

alligator-snapping-turtle.name: السلحفاة العاضة-American
alligator-snapping-turtle.description: The alligator snapping turtle is the largest freshwater turtle in North America. It has a massive head, a hooked beak, and a shell with three prominent ridges. It is an ambush predator that lies motionless on the river bottom with its mouth open.
alligator-snapping-turtle.funFact: Alligator snapping turtles have a worm-like appendage on their tongue that lures fish directly into their mouths.

red-tailed-hawk.funFact: غالباً ما تتم ت dubbing ب birds أخرى في الأفلام
red-tailed-hawk.name: Red-tailed Hawk
red-tailed-hawk.description: Red-tailed Hawk حيوان. The red-tailed hawk is the most common hawk in North America. It is recognizable by its brick-red tail and broad, rounded wings. It hunts rodents and rabbits from a perch or while soaring.

great-horned-owl.name: Great Horned Owl
great-horned-owl.description: Great Horned Owl حيوان. The great horned owl is a powerful nocturnal predator with distinctive ear tufts and deep hooting calls. It is highly adaptable and preys on a wide range of animals.

snowy-owl.funFact: على عكس大多数 البوم، يصطاد في النهار
snowy-owl.name: Snowy Owl
snowy-owl.description: Snowy Owl حيوان. The snowy owl is a large, white owl of the Arctic tundra. Unlike most owl species, it hunts during the day, feeding primarily on lemmings. Males become whiter as they age.

northern-saw-whet-owl.funFact: واحد من أصغر البوم في أمريكا الشمالية
northern-saw-whet-owl.name: Northern Saw-whet Owl
northern-saw-whet-owl.description: Northern Saw-whet Owl حيوان. The northern saw-whet owl is a tiny, nocturnal owl named for its sawing call. Despite its small size, it is a fierce predator of mice and small birds.

barred-owl.funFact: Barred owls are known for their distinctive call that sounds like Who cooks for you.
barred-owl.name: Barred Owl
barred-owl.description: Barred Owl حيوان. The barred owl is a large, stocky owl native to eastern North America. It has dark eyes unlike most other owls and a distinctive hooting call.

long-eared-owl.funFact: Long-eared owls have asymmetric ear openings that allow them to pinpoint prey in complete darkness.
long-eared-owl.name: Long-eared Owl
long-eared-owl.description: Long-eared Owl حيوان. The long-eared owl is a medium-sized nocturnal owl with striking orange eyes and very long ear tufts. It is a secretive bird that roosts in dense vegetation.

great-gray-owl.funFact: The great gray owl is the tallest owl in North America, though much of its size is feathers.
great-gray-owl.name: Great Gray Owl
great-gray-owl.description: Great Gray Owl حيوان. The great gray owl is the tallest owl species in North America with a massive facial disc. Despite its imposing size, it is relatively light and feeds primarily on small rodents.

burrowing-owl.funFact: Burrowing owls nest underground in burrows dug by prairie dogs or ground squirrels.
burrowing-owl.name: Burrowing Owl
burrowing-owl.description: Burrowing Owl حيوان. The burrowing owl is a small, long-legged owl that nests in underground burrows. Unlike most owls, it is active during the day and perches on fence posts to watch for prey.

elf-owl.funFact: The elf owl is the smallest owl species in the world, weighing less than a ping pong ball.
elf-owl.name: Elf Owl
elf-owl.description: Elf Owl حيوان. The elf owl is the worlds smallest owl, found in the desert Southwest. It nests in holes in saguaro cacti and feeds on insects and small invertebrates.

wood-duck.funFact: Wood ducklings can jump from tree nests up to 50 feet high without injury.
wood-duck.name: Wood Duck
wood-duck.description: Wood Duck حيوان. The wood duck is one of the most colorful waterfowl in North America. Males display elaborate patterns of green, purple, and white. Unlike most ducks, it nests in tree cavities.

northern-pintail.funFact: The northern pintails long tail makes it one of the most elegant ducks in flight.
northern-pintail.name: Northern Pintail
northern-pintail.description: Northern Pintail حيوان. The northern pintail is a graceful duck recognized by the males long, pointed tail feathers. It has a chocolate-brown head and white breast stripe.

green-winged-teal.funFact: The green-winged teal is the smallest dabbling duck in North America.
green-winged-teal.name: Green-winged Teal
green-winged-teal.description: Green-winged Teal حيوان. The green-winged teal is a small, agile duck with a distinctive chestnut head and green eye patch. It feeds by dabbling at the water surface.

canvasback.funFact: The canvasback is the largest and fastest diving duck in North America.
canvasback.name: Canvasback
canvasback.description: Canvasback حيوان. The canvasback is a large diving duck with a distinctive sloping profile. Males have a white body and reddish-brown head.

snow-goose.funFact: Snow goose flocks can number in the hundreds of thousands during migration.
snow-goose.name: Snow Goose
snow-goose.description: Snow Goose حيوان. The snow goose is a medium-sized goose with white plumage and black wingtips. It breeds in the Arctic and winters in southern marshes.

greylag-goose.funFact: The greylag goose is the ancestor of most domestic goose breeds in Europe.
greylag-goose.name: Greylag Goose
greylag-goose.description: Greylag Goose حيوان. The greylag goose is a large waterfowl with grey-brown plumage and an orange bill. It is the ancestor of most domestic geese.

trumpeter-swan.funFact: The trumpeter swan is the heaviest bird native to North America.
trumpeter-swan.name: Trumpeter Swan
trumpeter-swan.description: Trumpeter Swan حيوان. The trumpeter swan is the largest waterfowl in North America with a wingspan up to 8 feet. Named for its resonant, trumpet-like call, it has recovered from near extinction.

tundra-swan.funFact: Tundra swans migrate up to 4,000 miles each way between Arctic breeding grounds and wintering areas.
tundra-swan.name: Tundra Swan
tundra-swan.description: Tundra Swan حيوان. The tundra swan is a large, white swan that breeds in the Arctic tundra. It has a distinctive yellow spot near the eye and forms large flocks during migration.

american-robin.funFact: American robins can eat 14 feet of earthworms in a single day.
american-robin.name: American Robin
american-robin.description: American Robin حيوان. The American robin is one of the most familiar songbirds in North America. Recognized by its rusty-red breast and melodic song, it is often seen hopping across lawns.

northern-cardinal.funFact: Northern cardinal females also sing, which is rare among North American songbirds.
northern-cardinal.name: Northern Cardinal
northern-cardinal.description: Northern Cardinal حيوان. The northern cardinal is a vivid red songbird with a distinctive crest and black face. Males are brilliant red while females are warm brown with red accents.

blue-jay.name: Blue Jay
blue-jay.description: Blue Jay حيوان. The blue jay is a striking songbird with blue, white, and black plumage and a prominent crest. It is intelligent and vocal, known for its loud calls and bold behavior.

american-crow.funFact: American crows can recognize individual human faces and hold grudges.
american-crow.name: American Crow
american-crow.description: American Crow حيوان. The American crow is a large, all-black bird known for its intelligence and adaptability. It uses tools, solves complex problems, and lives in large family groups.

common-raven.funFact: Ravens can slide down snow-covered roofs for fun and perform aerial acrobatics.
common-raven.name: Common Raven
common-raven.description: Common Raven حيوان. The common raven is the largest songbird in North America. Extremely intelligent, it has been observed using tools, solving multi-step puzzles, and manipulating other animals.

house-sparrow.funFact: House sparrows were introduced to North America in 1851 and have since spread across the continent.
house-sparrow.name: House Sparrow
house-sparrow.description: House Sparrow حيوان. The house sparrow is one of the most widespread and familiar birds in the world. Originally from Eurasia, it thrives in close association with human habitation.

european-robin.funFact: The European robin is a symbol of Christmas in Britain and appears on many holiday cards.
european-robin.name: European Robin
european-robin.description: European Robin حيوان. The European robin is a small insectivorous bird with a distinctive orange-red breast. Familiar in gardens across Europe, it is known for its territorial behavior.

eastern-bluebird.funFact: Eastern bluebirds can see ultraviolet light, which helps them find ripe berries.
eastern-bluebird.name: Eastern Bluebird
eastern-bluebird.description: Eastern Bluebird حيوان. The eastern bluebird is a small thrush with brilliant blue plumage on the back and a rusty-red throat and breast. A symbol of happiness, it was saved from decline by nest box programs.

western-bluebird.funFact: Western bluebirds are one of the few songbirds that nest in old woodpecker holes.
western-bluebird.name: Western Bluebird
western-bluebird.description: Western Bluebird حيوان. The western bluebird is a small thrush with deep blue plumage and a rusty breast. It nests in cavities and feeds primarily on insects caught on the ground.

baltimore-oriole.funFact: Baltimore orioles weave intricate hanging nests that can take up to two weeks to build.
baltimore-oriole.name: Baltimore Oriole
baltimore-oriole.description: Baltimore Oriole حيوان. The Baltimore oriole is a striking songbird with vivid orange and black plumage. They weave elaborate pendulous nests from plant fibers.

scarlet-tanager.funFact: The male scarlet tanager turns olive-green in winter, looking like a completely different bird.
scarlet-tanager.name: Scarlet Tanager
scarlet-tanager.description: Scarlet Tanager حيوان. The scarlet tanager is a medium-sized songbird with brilliant red plumage and black wings during breeding season. It is a shy forest bird.

yellow-warbler.funFact: Yellow warblers are one of the first songbirds to arrive on their breeding grounds in spring.
yellow-warbler.name: Yellow Warbler
yellow-warbler.description: Yellow Warbler حيوان. The yellow warbler is a small, bright yellow songbird widespread across North America. Its cheerful song is one of the most recognizable spring sounds.

white-throated-sparrow.funFact: White-throated sparrows come in two color morphs that pair almost exclusively with each other.
white-throated-sparrow.name: White-throated Sparrow
white-throated-sparrow.description: White-throated Sparrow حيوان. The white-throated sparrow is a common songbird with a distinctive white throat patch and yellow lores. It has two color morphs that differ in behavior.

dark-eyed-junco.funFact: Dark-eyed juncos are called snowbirds because they appear in southern states during winter.
dark-eyed-junco.name: Dark-eyed Junco
dark-eyed-junco.description: Dark-eyed Junco حيوان. The dark-eyed junco is a small, slate-colored sparrow common across North America. It is one of the most abundant and widespread forest birds.

ruby-throated-hummingbird.funFact: Ruby-throated hummingbirds beat their wings 53 times per second and can fly backwards.
ruby-throated-hummingbird.name: Ruby-throated Hummingbird
ruby-throated-hummingbird.description: Ruby-throated Hummingbird حيوان. The ruby-throated hummingbird is the only breeding hummingbird in eastern North America. Males have an iridescent ruby-red throat.

annas-hummingbird.funFact: Male Annas hummingbirds perform dramatic diving displays that create an audible chirp.
annas-hummingbird.name: Annas Hummingbird
annas-hummingbird.description: Annas Hummingbird حيوان. Annas hummingbird is a small, green hummingbird native to western North America. Males have a brilliant rose-pink throat and crown.

black-chinned-hummingbird.funFact: The black chin of this hummingbird flashes brilliant purple when the light hits it at the right angle.
black-chinned-hummingbird.name: Black-chinned Hummingbird
black-chinned-hummingbird.description: Black-chinned Hummingbird حيوان. The black-chinned hummingbird is a small, common hummingbird of the western United States with a velvet-black chin that shows iridescent purple.

belted-kingfisher.funFact: The belted kingfisher is one of the few bird species where females are more colorful than males.
belted-kingfisher.name: Belted Kingfisher
belted-kingfisher.description: Belted Kingfisher حيوان. The belted kingfisher is a stocky, blue-gray bird with a shaggy crest and large dagger-like bill. Females have an additional rusty band across the belly.

great-blue-heron.funFact: Great blue herons can stand motionless for hours waiting for the perfect moment to strike prey.
great-blue-heron.name: Great Blue Heron
great-blue-heron.description: Great Blue Heron حيوان. The great blue heron is the largest heron in North America, with a wingspan up to 6.5 feet. It wades in shallow water to hunt fish.

great-egret.funFact: The great egrets long plumes nearly drove it to extinction in the 19th century for use in womens hats.
great-egret.name: Great Egret
great-egret.description: Great Egret حيوان. The great egret is a large, all-white heron with a yellow bill and black legs. Its near-extinction for the millinery trade helped spark the conservation movement.

snowy-egret.funFact: Snowy egrets use their bright yellow feet to stir up prey from muddy bottoms.
snowy-egret.name: Snowy Egret
snowy-egret.description: Snowy Egret حيوان. The snowy egret is a small, elegant white heron with black legs and vivid yellow feet. During breeding season, it develops long, flowing plumes.

green-heron.funFact: Green herons are one of the few bird species that use tools, dropping bait on the water to attract fish.
green-heron.name: Green Heron
green-heron.description: Green Heron حيوان. The green heron is a small, stocky heron with dark greenish-gray plumage. It is a clever hunter that sometimes uses bait to lure fish.

american-flamingo.funFact: American flamingos are the most brightly colored of all flamingo species.
american-flamingo.name: American Flamingo
american-flamingo.description: American Flamingo حيوان. The American flamingo is a large, bright pink wading bird found in the Caribbean and Galapagos with the brightest plumage of all flamingos.

sandhill-crane.funFact: Sandhill cranes perform elaborate dances that include jumping, bowing, and tossing sticks.
sandhill-crane.name: Sandhill Crane
sandhill-crane.description: Sandhill Crane حيوان. The sandhill crane is a tall, gray bird with a red crown and long legs. Known for its trumpeting call and spectacular mating dances.

whooping-crane.funFact: Whooping cranes were once down to only 15 birds in the wild, making them one of the rarest birds in North America.
whooping-crane.name: Whooping Crane
whooping-crane.description: Whooping Crane حيوان. The whooping crane is the tallest bird in North America. Named for its loud whooping call, it was saved from extinction through intensive conservation.

purple-gallinule.funFact: Purple gallinules can walk across lily pads thanks to their extremely long toes.
purple-gallinule.name: Purple Gallinule
purple-gallinule.description: Purple Gallinule حيوان. The purple gallinule is a brightly colored marsh bird with purple-blue plumage and a red and yellow bill. It walks gracefully on floating vegetation.

american-coot.funFact: American coots can sink slowly into water to hide, submerging up to their necks.
american-coot.name: American Coot
american-coot.description: American Coot حيوان. The American coot is a dark, chicken-like waterbird with a white bill and frontal shield. Despite looking duck-like, it is related to rails.

wild-turkey.funFact: Wild turkeys can fly at speeds up to 55 mph and run at 25 mph.
wild-turkey.name: Wild Turkey
wild-turkey.description: Wild Turkey حيوان. The wild turkey is a large, iridescent bird native to North America. Males display elaborate courtship rituals. It is the ancestor of the domesticated turkey.

ring-necked-pheasant.funFact: Male ring-necked pheasants have such vivid plumage that they were once used as models for dragon illustrations.
ring-necked-pheasant.name: Ring-necked Pheasant
ring-necked-pheasant.description: Ring-necked Pheasant حيوان. The ring-necked pheasant is a colorful game bird originally from Asia, now established across North America and Europe. Males have brilliant copper and green plumage.

bobwhite-quail.funFact: The northern bobwhite is named for its distinctive two-note call that sounds like its name.
bobwhite-quail.name: Northern Bobwhite
bobwhite-quail.description: Northern Bobwhite حيوان. The northern bobwhite is a small, compact quail with a distinctive white throat and eyebrow stripe in males. Named for its clear bob-white call.

california-quail.funFact: The California quails distinctive head plume curves forward like a question mark.
california-quail.name: California Quail
california-quail.description: California Quail حيوان. The California quail is a small, plump ground bird with a distinctive forward-curving black head plume. It is the state bird of California.

rockhopper-penguin.funFact: Rockhopper penguins bounce from rock to rock using both feet rather than waddling.
rockhopper-penguin.name: Rockhopper Penguin
rockhopper-penguin.description: Rockhopper Penguin حيوان. The rockhopper penguin is a small penguin known for its distinctive yellow and black crest feathers. It navigates steep, rocky terrain by hopping.

little-blue-penguin.funFact: Little blue penguins are the smallest penguin species, standing only about 13 inches tall.
little-blue-penguin.name: Little Blue Penguin
little-blue-penguin.description: Little Blue Penguin حيوان. The little blue penguin, also known as the fairy penguin, is the smallest species of penguin. Found in New Zealand and southern Australia.

gentoo-penguin.funFact: Gentoo penguins are the fastest underwater swimming birds, reaching speeds of 22 mph.
gentoo-penguin.name: Gentoo Penguin
gentoo-penguin.description: Gentoo Penguin حيوان. The gentoo penguin is recognizable by the white stripe across its head and its bright orange-red bill. It is the fastest underwater swimming bird.

african-penguin.funFact: African penguins are sometimes called jackass penguins because they bray like donkeys.
african-penguin.name: African Penguin
african-penguin.description: African Penguin حيوان. The African penguin, also known as the jackass penguin for its donkey-like bray, is the only penguin species that breeds in Africa. It is endangered.

brown-kiwi.funFact: Kiwi eggs are enormous relative to body size, up to 20% of the females body weight.
brown-kiwi.name: Brown Kiwi
brown-kiwi.description: Brown Kiwi حيوان. The brown kiwi is a flightless bird native to New Zealand. It has hair-like feathers, no tail, and a long probing bill with nostrils at the tip.

lyrebird.funFact: The lyrebird can mimic virtually any sound, including chainsaws, camera shutters, and car alarms.
lyrebird.name: Superb Lyrebird
lyrebird.description: Superb Lyrebird حيوان. The superb lyrebird is famous for its extraordinary ability to mimic sounds. Males have an elaborate tail that forms a lyre shape during courtship.

cassowary.funFact: The southern cassowary is considered the worlds most dangerous bird due to its powerful kicks.
cassowary.name: Southern Cassowary
cassowary.description: Southern Cassowary حيوان. The southern cassowary is a large, flightless bird with a distinctive blue neck, red wattles, and a bony casque on its head.

scarlet-macaw.funFact: Scarlet macaws can live over 75 years in captivity and mate for life.
scarlet-macaw.name: Scarlet Macaw
scarlet-macaw.description: Scarlet Macaw حيوان. The scarlet macaw is a large, colorful parrot with brilliant red, yellow, and blue plumage. Found in Central and South American rainforests.

blue-and-yellow-macaw.funFact: Blue-and-yellow macaws can fly at speeds up to 35 mph and use their powerful beaks to crack hard nuts.
blue-and-yellow-macaw.name: Blue-and-yellow Macaw
blue-and-yellow-macaw.description: Blue-and-yellow Macaw حيوان. The blue-and-yellow macaw is a large parrot with vivid blue upperparts and golden-yellow underparts. It is highly social and can mimic human speech.

hyacinth-macaw.funFact: The hyacinth macaw is the largest flying parrot in the world, with a wingspan over 4 feet.
hyacinth-macaw.name: Hyacinth Macaw
hyacinth-macaw.description: Hyacinth Macaw حيوان. The hyacinth macaw is the largest of all flying parrot species, with stunning cobalt-blue plumage and bright yellow eye rings.

african-grey-parrot.funFact: African grey parrots are considered the most intelligent bird species, with cognitive abilities rivaling those of young children.
african-grey-parrot.name: African Grey Parrot
african-grey-parrot.description: African Grey Parrot حيوان. The African grey parrot is renowned for its exceptional intelligence and ability to mimic human speech. It has grey plumage with a striking red tail.

budgerigar.name: Budgerigar
budgerigar.description: Budgerigar حيوان. The budgerigar is a small, long-tailed parakeet native to Australia. In the wild, it is green and yellow with black markings.

cockatiel.funFact: Cockatiels are one of the few parrot species that can whistle tunes accurately.
cockatiel.name: Cockatiel
cockatiel.description: Cockatiel حيوان. The cockatiel is a small parrot native to Australia, recognizable by its prominent crest and orange cheek patches.

keel-billed-toucan.funFact: The toucans colorful bill is surprisingly lightweight, made mostly of keratin with a honeycomb structure.
keel-billed-toucan.name: Keel-billed Toucan
keel-billed-toucan.description: Keel-billed Toucan حيوان. The keel-billed toucan is a colorful bird with a massive, rainbow-colored bill. Found in Central and South American rainforests.

toco-toucan.funFact: The toco toucans bill contains a network of blood vessels that help regulate body temperature.
toco-toucan.name: Toco Toucan
toco-toucan.description: Toco Toucan حيوان. The toco toucan is the largest toucan species, with a massive orange-yellow bill tipped in black. Found in South American forests.

great-hornbill.funFact: Great hornbill pairs seal the female inside a tree cavity during nesting, leaving only a small slit for feeding.
great-hornbill.name: Great Hornbill
great-hornbill.description: Great Hornbill حيوان. The great hornbill is one of the largest hornbill species, distinguished by its massive yellow and black casque atop its bill.

rhinoceros-hornbill.funFact: The rhinoceros hornbills upward-curved casque can grow up to 7 inches long.
rhinoceros-hornbill.name: Rhinoceros Hornbill
rhinoceros-hornbill.description: Rhinoceros Hornbill حيوان. The rhinoceros hornbill is a large hornbill with a dramatic upward-curving casque on its bill. Found in Southeast Asian rainforests.

laughing-kookaburra.funFact: The laughing kookaburras call sounds exactly like echoing human laughter.
laughing-kookaburra.name: Laughing Kookaburra
laughing-kookaburra.description: Laughing Kookaburra حيوان. The laughing kookaburra is a large kingfisher native to Australia, famous for its distinctive call that sounds like loud, echoing human laughter.

pied-kingfisher.funFact: The pied kingfisher is the only kingfisher species that can hover over water before diving.
pied-kingfisher.name: Pied Kingfisher
pied-kingfisher.description: Pied Kingfisher حيوان. The pied kingfisher is a black and white kingfisher found across Africa and Asia. It hovers over water before diving to catch fish.

atlantic-puffin.funFact: Puffins can carry 10 or more fish in their beaks at once thanks to specialized tongue and bill structures.
atlantic-puffin.name: Atlantic Puffin
atlantic-puffin.description: Atlantic Puffin حيوان. The Atlantic puffin is a small seabird with a colorful triangular bill and distinctive black and white plumage. Known as the clown of the sea.

tufted-puffin.funFact: Tufted puffins can dive to depths of over 200 feet to catch fish.
tufted-puffin.name: Tufted Puffin
tufted-puffin.description: Tufted Puffin حيوان. The tufted puffin is a small seabird with black plumage, white face patches, and distinctive golden head tufts during breeding season.

wandering-albatross.funFact: The wandering albatross has the largest wingspan of any living bird, reaching over 11 feet.
wandering-albatross.name: Wandering Albatross
wandering-albatross.description: Wandering Albatross حيوان. The wandering albatross has the largest wingspan of any bird, up to 11.5 feet. It spends most of its life soaring over the Southern Ocean.

black-browed-albatross.funFact: Black-browed albatrosses can sleep while flying over the ocean.
black-browed-albatross.name: Black-browed Albatross
black-browed-albatross.description: Black-browed Albatross حيوان. The black-browed albatross is a large seabird with dark upper wings and a white body. Named for the dark stripe through its eye.

laysan-albatross.funFact: The oldest known wild bird in the world is a Laysan albatross named Wisdom, over 70 years old.
laysan-albatross.name: Laysan Albatross
laysan-albatross.description: Laysan Albatross حيوان. The Laysan albatross is a large seabird of the North Pacific. It breeds primarily on remote Pacific islands.

brown-pelican.funFact: Brown pelicans can dive from heights of over 60 feet to catch fish, with air sacs cushioning the impact.
brown-pelican.name: Brown Pelican
brown-pelican.description: Brown Pelican حيوان. The brown pelican is a large waterbird with a massive bill and throat pouch. It is unique among pelicans for plunge-diving from the air.

american-white-pelican.funFact: American white pelicans fish cooperatively, herding schools of fish into shallow water.
american-white-pelican.name: American White Pelican
american-white-pelican.description: American White Pelican حيوان. The American white pelican is one of the largest North American birds, with a wingspan up to 9 feet. It scoops fish while swimming.

frigatebird.funFact: Frigatebirds can stay airborne for weeks and sleep while flying over the ocean.
frigatebird.name: Magnificent Frigatebird
frigatebird.description: Magnificent Frigatebird حيوان. The magnificent frigatebird is a large seabird with long, angular wings and a deeply forked tail. Males inflate a bright red throat pouch.

northern-gannet.funFact: Northern gannets plunge-dive from heights of 130 feet, hitting the water at 60 mph.
northern-gannet.name: Northern Gannet
northern-gannet.description: Northern Gannet حيوان. The northern gannet is the largest seabird in the North Atlantic. It nests in massive colonies on sea cliffs.

blue-footed-booby.funFact: Male blue-footed boobies perform an elaborate dance, lifting their bright blue feet alternately to attract mates.
blue-footed-booby.name: Blue-footed Booby
blue-footed-booby.description: Blue-footed Booby حيوان. The blue-footed booby is a marine bird famous for its vivid blue feet. Found along the Pacific coast of the Americas.

red-footed-booby.funFact: Red-footed boobies are the most abundant booby species and the only ones that regularly nest in trees.
red-footed-booby.name: Red-footed Booby
red-footed-booby.description: Red-footed Booby حيوان. The red-footed booby is the smallest booby species, with distinctive red feet. It comes in several color morphs.

great-cormorant.funFact: Cormorants have less preen oil than other waterbirds, which helps them dive but requires wing-drying.
great-cormorant.name: Great Cormorant
great-cormorant.description: Great Cormorant حيوان. The great cormorant is a large, dark waterbird found across much of the world. It spreads its wings to dry after fishing.

common-loon.funFact: Common loons have solid bones that make them less buoyant and better at diving than most birds.
common-loon.name: Common Loon
common-loon.description: Common Loon حيوان. The common loon is a large waterbird known for its haunting wail across northern lakes. Its solid bones help it dive deep.

arctic-tern.funFact: Arctic terns migrate from Arctic to Antarctic and back each year, the longest migration of any animal, up to 44,000 miles.
arctic-tern.name: Arctic Tern
arctic-tern.description: Arctic Tern حيوان. The Arctic tern migrates farther than any other animal. It experiences more daylight than any other creature.

caspian-tern.funFact: The Caspian tern is the largest tern species in the world.
caspian-tern.name: Caspian Tern
caspian-tern.description: Caspian Tern حيوان. The Caspian tern is the worlds largest tern, with a massive red bill and black cap. Found on every continent except Antarctica.

black-skimmer.funFact: The black skimmers lower bill is longer than its upper, allowing it to skim fish from the water surface.
black-skimmer.name: Black Skimmer
black-skimmer.description: Black Skimmer حيوان. The black skimmer is a unique seabird with a distinctive uneven bill. It flies low over water, dragging its bill to catch fish.

herring-gull.funFact: Herring gulls can drink saltwater thanks to special glands above their eyes that filter out excess salt.
herring-gull.name: Herring Gull
herring-gull.description: Herring Gull حيوان. The herring gull is one of the most common gulls in the Northern Hemisphere, thriving in coastal and urban environments.

laughing-gull.funFact: Laughing gulls are named for their call that sounds like high-pitched human laughter.
laughing-gull.name: Laughing Gull
laughing-gull.description: Laughing Gull حيوان. The laughing gull is a medium-sized gull with a distinctive black head in breeding season and a laughing call.

killdeer.funFact: Killdeer perform a broken-wing act to lure predators away from their ground nests.
killdeer.name: Killdeer
killdeer.description: Killdeer حيوان. The killdeer is a large plover with distinctive black breast bands. It is famous for its broken-wing display.

american-woodcock.funFact: American woodcocks have eyes on the sides of their heads and can see 360 degrees.
american-woodcock.name: American Woodcock
american-woodcock.description: American Woodcock حيوان. The American woodcock is a plump shorebird with a long bill. It feeds on earthworms and performs an aerial sky-dance at dusk.

red-knot.funFact: Red knots migrate up to 9,000 miles nonstop from the Arctic to the tip of South America.
red-knot.name: Red Knot
red-knot.description: Red Knot حيوان. The red knot is famous for one of the longest migrations in the animal kingdom. It turns rusty-red during breeding season.

american-avocet.funFact: American avocets sweep their upturned bills side to side through water to catch tiny invertebrates.
american-avocet.name: American Avocet
american-avocet.description: American Avocet حيوان. The American avocet is an elegant wader with a thin, upturned bill and long legs. During breeding season, its head and neck turn rusty-orange.

black-necked-stilt.funFact: The black-necked stilt has the second-longest legs relative to body size of any bird, after the flamingo.
black-necked-stilt.name: Black-necked Stilt
black-necked-stilt.description: Black-necked Stilt حيوان. The black-necked stilt is a striking wader with black upperparts, white underparts, and extraordinarily long pink legs.

willow-ptarmigan.funFact: Willow ptarmigan change color with the seasons, brown in summer and pure white in winter.
willow-ptarmigan.name: Willow Ptarmigan
willow-ptarmigan.description: Willow Ptarmigan حيوان. The willow ptarmigan is a game bird of the Arctic tundra that changes plumage with the seasons.

spruce-grouse.funFact: Spruce grouse are so tame they are sometimes called fool hens because they rarely fly from danger.
spruce-grouse.name: Spruce Grouse
spruce-grouse.description: Spruce Grouse حيوان. The spruce grouse is a forest-dwelling game bird of the boreal region, known for its tameness.

ruffed-grouse.funFact: Male ruffed grouse create a drumming sound by beating their wings rapidly to attract females.
ruffed-grouse.name: Ruffed Grouse
ruffed-grouse.description: Ruffed Grouse حيوان. The ruffed grouse is a popular game bird of eastern North American forests with a distinctive drumming display.

chukar.funFact: Chukars prefer running uphill to flying when escaping danger.
chukar.name: Chukar
chukar.description: Chukar حيوان. The chukar is a rotund game bird native to Eurasia and introduced to North America with distinctive black and white barring.

common-crane.funFact: Common cranes perform elaborate dances with jumping, bowing, and wing-flapping during courtship.
common-crane.name: Common Crane
common-crane.description: Common Crane حيوان. The common crane is a large, elegant wading bird with gray plumage and a red crown patch. Famous for its courtship dances.

demoiselle-crane.funFact: Demoiselle cranes fly at altitudes over 26,000 feet during their Himalayan migration.
demoiselle-crane.name: Demoiselle Crane
demoiselle-crane.description: Demoiselle Crane حيوان. The demoiselle crane is the smallest crane species, elegant and graceful with a black neck and white ear tufts.

bearded-vulture.funFact: Bearded vultures eat bones, dropping them from great heights to crack them into swallowable pieces.
bearded-vulture.name: Bearded Vulture
bearded-vulture.description: Bearded Vulture حيوان. The bearded vulture is the only bird species that feeds almost exclusively on bones.

andean-condor.funFact: The Andean condor has the largest wingspan of any raptor, reaching over 10 feet.
andean-condor.name: Andean Condor
andean-condor.description: Andean Condor حيوان. The Andean condor is one of the worlds largest flying birds. It soars on thermal currents over the Andes mountains.

king-vulture.funFact: King vultures were believed by the Maya to carry messages between humans and gods.
king-vulture.name: King Vulture
king-vulture.description: King Vulture حيوان. The king vulture is a large, colorful vulture with a vividly colored head and a white body.

turkey-vulture.funFact: Turkey vultures have the best sense of smell of any bird, able to detect carrion from miles away.
turkey-vulture.name: Turkey Vulture
turkey-vulture.description: Turkey Vulture حيوان. The turkey vulture is a large soaring bird with a red, featherless head resembling a wild turkey.

american-kestrel.funFact: American kestrels can see ultraviolet light, which helps them track the urine trails of rodents.
american-kestrel.name: American Kestrel
american-kestrel.description: American Kestrel حيوان. The American kestrel is the smallest and most common falcon in North America. Males have slate-blue wings.

merlin.funFact: Merlins were once known as pigeon hawks due to their habit of hunting pigeons.
merlin.name: Merlin
merlin.description: Merlin حيوان. The merlin is a small, powerful falcon found across the Northern Hemisphere. It pursues small birds in direct flight.

prairie-falcon.funFact: Prairie falcons can reach speeds over 45 mph in level flight and much faster in a stoop.
prairie-falcon.name: Prairie Falcon
prairie-falcon.description: Prairie Falcon حيوان. The prairie falcon is a large, sandy-brown falcon of the western North American open country.

gyrfalcon.funFact: The gyrfalcon is the largest falcon in the world and was once reserved as a bird of kings.
gyrfalcon.name: Gyrfalcon
gyrfalcon.description: Gyrfalcon حيوان. The gyrfalcon is the largest of all falcon species, found in Arctic regions. It was historically prized in falconry for royalty.

osprey.funFact: Ospreys have reversible outer toes that allow them to grasp fish with two toes in front and two behind.
osprey.name: Osprey
osprey.description: Osprey حيوان. The osprey is a large raptor found on every continent except Antarctica. It feeds almost exclusively on fish.

northern-harrier.funFact: Northern harriers have facial discs similar to owls that help them locate prey by sound.
northern-harrier.name: Northern Harrier
northern-harrier.description: Northern Harrier حيوان. The northern harrier is a slim raptor that hunts by flying low over open ground, using both sight and sound.

coopers-hawk.funFact: Coopers hawks are agile enough to chase prey through dense forest at high speed.
coopers-hawk.name: Coopers Hawk
coopers-hawk.description: Coopers Hawk حيوان. The Coopers hawk is a medium-sized accipiter that specializes in capturing doves and songbirds in flight.

sharp-shinned-hawk.funFact: The sharp-shinned hawk is the smallest hawk in North America, barely larger than a jay.
sharp-shinned-hawk.name: Sharp-shinned Hawk
sharp-shinned-hawk.description: Sharp-shinned Hawk حيوان. The sharp-shinned hawk is the smallest accipiter in North America. A rapid, agile flier that hunts small songbirds.

swainsons-hawk.funFact: Swainsons hawks migrate in massive flocks of hundreds of thousands from North America to South America.
swainsons-hawk.name: Swainsons Hawk
swainsons-hawk.description: Swainsons Hawk حيوان. The Swainsons hawk is a medium-sized raptor that migrates in enormous flocks to the pampas of Argentina for the winter.

rough-legged-hawk.funFact: Rough-legged hawks have feathered legs all the way to their toes, adapted for Arctic cold.
rough-legged-hawk.name: Rough-legged Hawk
rough-legged-hawk.description: Rough-legged Hawk حيوان. The rough-legged hawk breeds in the Arctic tundra and winters in open prairies of North America.

ferruginous-hawk.funFact: The ferruginous hawk is the largest North American hawk, with a wingspan over 5 feet.
ferruginous-hawk.name: Ferruginous Hawk
ferruginous-hawk.description: Ferruginous Hawk حيوان. The ferruginous hawk is the largest buteo hawk in North America with rust-colored upperparts.

white-tailed-kite.funFact: White-tailed kites can hover in place for extended periods while scanning the ground for prey.
white-tailed-kite.name: White-tailed Kite
white-tailed-kite.description: White-tailed Kite حيوان. The white-tailed kite is a graceful raptor with white plumage, black shoulders, and a forked tail.

mississippi-kite.funFact: Mississippi kites eat enormous quantities of cicadas and other insects caught in mid-air.
mississippi-kite.name: Mississippi Kite
mississippi-kite.description: Mississippi Kite حيوان. The Mississippi kite is a small, elegant raptor with pearl-gray plumage that feeds primarily on insects caught in flight.

red-winged-blackbird.funFact: Red-winged blackbirds are one of the most abundant birds in North America, with over 200 million individuals.
red-winged-blackbird.name: Red-winged Blackbird
red-winged-blackbird.description: Red-winged Blackbird حيوان. The red-winged blackbird is one of the most abundant and widespread birds in North America with bright red and yellow shoulder patches.

brown-headed-cowbird.funFact: Brown-headed cowbirds are brood parasites that lay their eggs in other birds nests.
brown-headed-cowbird.name: Brown-headed Cowbird
brown-headed-cowbird.description: Brown-headed Cowbird حيوان. The brown-headed cowbird is a brood parasite that lays its eggs in the nests of other bird species.

common-grackle.funFact: Common grackles have iridescent feathers that shimmer purple, green, and bronze in the sunlight.
common-grackle.name: Common Grackle
common-grackle.description: Common Grackle حيوان. The common grackle is a large, lanky blackbird with iridescent plumage and bright yellow eyes.

great-tailed-grackle.funFact: Male great-tailed grackles have a wingspan of nearly 18 inches and their long tails make up half their total length.
great-tailed-grackle.name: Great-tailed Grackle
great-tailed-grackle.description: Great-tailed Grackle حيوان. The great-tailed grackle is a large, noisy blackbird with a very long, keel-shaped tail.

yellow-headed-blackbird.funFact: Male yellow-headed blackbirds defend small nesting territories within marshes, sometimes with multiple females.
yellow-headed-blackbird.name: Yellow-headed Blackbird
yellow-headed-blackbird.description: Yellow-headed Blackbird حيوان. The yellow-headed blackbird is a striking songbird with a brilliant yellow-orange head contrasting with a black body.

eastern-meadowlark.funFact: The eastern meadowlark looks almost identical to the western meadowlark but has a completely different song.
eastern-meadowlark.name: Eastern Meadowlark
eastern-meadowlark.description: Eastern Meadowlark حيوان. The eastern meadowlark is a bright yellow songbird with a distinctive V-shaped black breast band.

western-meadowlark.funFact: The western meadowlark is the state bird of six different U.S. states, more than any other bird.
western-meadowlark.name: Western Meadowlark
western-meadowlark.description: Western Meadowlark حيوان. The western meadowlark is a bright yellow songbird with a black V-shaped breast band, the state bird of six states.

orchard-oriole.funFact: The orchard oriole is the smallest icterid in North America, smaller than even the house finch.
orchard-oriole.name: Orchard Oriole
orchard-oriole.description: Orchard Oriole حيوان. The orchard oriole is a small, chestnut and black songbird. Males have a chestnut body with a black head.

bullocks-oriole.funFact: Bullocks orioles weave elaborate hanging pouch nests that dangle from tree branches.
bullocks-oriole.name: Bullocks Oriole
bullocks-oriole.description: Bullocks Oriole حيوان. The Bullocks oriole is a bright orange and black songbird of western North America that weaves hanging basket nests.

barn-swallow.funFact: Barn swallows migrate up to 6,000 miles between their breeding and wintering grounds.
barn-swallow.name: Barn Swallow
barn-swallow.description: Barn Swallow حيوان. The barn swallow is the most widespread swallow species in the world with a distinctive deeply forked tail.

tree-swallow.funFact: Tree swallows are one of the few North American songbirds that can digest berries, allowing them to migrate earlier in spring.
tree-swallow.name: Tree Swallow
tree-swallow.description: Tree Swallow حيوان. The tree swallow is a small, iridescent blue-green swallow with white underparts.

cliff-swallow.funFact: Cliff swallows build gourd-shaped mud nests in colonies that can number in the hundreds.
cliff-swallow.name: Cliff Swallow
cliff-swallow.description: Cliff Swallow حيوان. The cliff swallow is a small swallow with a pale rump and squared-off tail that builds enclosed mud nests in colonies.

purple-martin.funFact: Purple martins are almost completely dependent on human-provided nest boxes in the eastern United States.
purple-martin.name: Purple Martin
purple-martin.description: Purple Martin حيوان. The purple martin is the largest North American swallow with iridescent purple-blue plumage in males.

bank-swallow.funFact: Bank swallows are the smallest swallow species in North America and nest in burrows dug into sandy banks.
bank-swallow.name: Bank Swallow
bank-swallow.description: Bank Swallow حيوان. The bank swallow is the smallest swallow in North America, nesting in burrows excavated in sandy banks near water.

violet-green-swallow.funFact: Violet-green swallows have white patches on their face that wrap around to the back of their head.
violet-green-swallow.name: Violet-green Swallow
violet-green-swallow.description: Violet-green Swallow حيوان. The violet-green swallow is a small, colorful swallow with iridescent green and violet upperparts.

chimney-swift.funFact: Chimney swifts can spend almost their entire lives in the air, even sleeping while flying.
chimney-swift.name: Chimney Swift
chimney-swift.description: Chimney Swift حيوان. The chimney swift is a cigar-shaped, dark gray bird that spends most of its life on the wing.

common-nighthawk.funFact: Common nighthawks have tiny feathers around their mouth that form a wide funnel for catching insects in flight.
common-nighthawk.name: Common Nighthawk
common-nighthawk.description: Common Nighthawk حيوان. The common nighthawk is a nocturnal bird that feeds on flying insects caught during acrobatic aerial displays.

eastern-whip-poor-will.funFact: Eastern whip-poor-wills can sing up to 400 times per hour, repeating their name-like call all night.
eastern-whip-poor-will.name: Eastern Whip-poor-will
eastern-whip-poor-will.description: Eastern Whip-poor-will حيوان. The eastern whip-poor-will is a nocturnal bird named for its distinctive three-part call.

greater-roadrunner.funFact: Greater roadrunners can run at speeds up to 20 mph and can live without drinking water.
greater-roadrunner.name: Greater Roadrunner
greater-roadrunner.description: Greater Roadrunner حيوان. The greater roadrunner is a large, ground-dwelling cuckoo of the American deserts known for its X-shaped tail.

yellow-billed-cuckoo.funFact: Yellow-billed cuckoos are sometimes called rain crows because they call more frequently before storms.
yellow-billed-cuckoo.name: Yellow-billed Cuckoo
yellow-billed-cuckoo.description: Yellow-billed Cuckoo حيوان. The yellow-billed cuckoo is a slim, long-tailed bird with a curved yellow bill that feeds on caterpillars.

hoopoe.funFact: The hoopoe has a spectacular fan-like crest that it raises when excited or alarmed.
hoopoe.name: Eurasian Hoopoe
hoopoe.description: Eurasian Hoopoe حيوان. The Eurasian hoopoe is a distinctive bird with cinnamon plumage, black and white wing bars, and a spectacular erectile crest.

tawny-frogmouth.funFact: Tawny frogmouths are often mistaken for owls but are actually more closely related to nightjars.
tawny-frogmouth.name: Tawny Frogmouth
tawny-frogmouth.description: Tawny Frogmouth حيوان. The tawny frogmouth is a nocturnal bird of Australia with cryptic plumage that perfectly camouflages it against tree bark.

common-potoo.funFact: Common potoos perch upright on branches during the day, looking exactly like a broken tree stump.
common-potoo.name: Common Potoo
common-potoo.description: Common Potoo حيوان. The common potoo is a nocturnal bird of Central and South American forests with an enormous mouth and cryptic plumage.

american-goldfinch.funFact: American goldfinches are one of the latest nesting birds, often not breeding until late July.
american-goldfinch.name: American Goldfinch
american-goldfinch.description: American Goldfinch حيوان. The American goldfinch is a small, bright yellow songbird with black wings and cap, one of the latest-nesting birds in North America.

pine-grosbeak.funFact: Pine grosbeaks are one of the tamest boreal birds, often allowing close approach.
pine-grosbeak.name: Pine Grosbeak
pine-grosbeak.description: Pine Grosbeak حيوان. The pine grosbeak is a large, plump finch with rosy-pink plumage in males. Found in boreal forests across North America.

evening-grosbeak.funFact: Evening grosbeaks are irruptive migrants, showing up in large numbers far south of their normal range in some years.
evening-grosbeak.name: Evening Grosbeak
evening-grosbeak.description: Evening Grosbeak حيوان. The evening grosbeak is a large, stocky finch with a massive conical bill and bright yellow body in males.

cassins-finch.funFact: Cassins finches are the most recently described North American bird species, not recognized until 1861.
cassins-finch.name: Cassins Finch
cassins-finch.description: Cassins Finch حيوان. The Cassins finch is a medium-sized finch with rosy-red crown and pinkish wash on the breast, found in mountain forests.

red-crossbill.funFact: Red crossbills have uniquely crossed mandibles specifically adapted for extracting seeds from conifer cones.
red-crossbill.name: Red Crossbill
red-crossbill.description: Red Crossbill حيوان. The red crossbill is a finch with a uniquely crossed bill adapted for extracting seeds from conifer cones.

pine-siskin.funFact: Pine siskins can carry salmonella bacteria without getting sick, which can be transmitted to backyard birds at feeders.
pine-siskin.name: Pine Siskin
pine-siskin.description: Pine Siskin حيوان. The pine siskin is a small, streaky brown finch with yellow edging on its wings and tail, an irruptive species.

common-redpoll.funFact: Common redpolls can survive temperatures of -60 degrees Fahrenheit by eating seeds and fluffing their feathers.
common-redpoll.name: Common Redpoll
common-redpoll.description: Common Redpoll حيوان. The common redpoll is a tiny, streaky finch with a distinctive red cap and pink breast, breeding in Arctic tundra.

hoary-redpoll.funFact: The hoary redpoll is one of the hardiest songbirds, living further north than almost any other passerine.
hoary-redpoll.name: Hoary Redpoll
hoary-redpoll.description: Hoary Redpoll حيوان. The hoary redpoll is a tiny Arctic finch, paler and frostier-looking than the common redpoll.

house-finch.funFact: Male house finches get their red color from pigments in their diet of berries and fruits.
house-finch.name: House Finch
house-finch.description: House Finch حيوان. The house finch is a small songbird common in urban and suburban areas with red or orange plumage in males.

purple-finch.funFact: Roger Tory Peterson described male purple finches as dipped in raspberry juice.
purple-finch.name: Purple Finch
purple-finch.description: Purple Finch حيوان. The purple finch is a medium-sized finch with rosy-red plumage in males and streaked brown in females.

eastern-wood-pewee.funFact: The eastern wood-pewees call is so distinctive that the species was named after its song.
eastern-wood-pewee.name: Eastern Wood-Pewee
eastern-wood-pewee.description: Eastern Wood-Pewee حيوان. The eastern wood-pewee is a small flycatcher with olive-gray plumage and a distinctive, plaintive whistle.

great-crested-flycatcher.funFact: Great crested flycatchers always incorporate snakeskin into their nest material.
great-crested-flycatcher.name: Great Crested Flycatcher
great-crested-flycatcher.description: Great Crested Flycatcher حيوان. The great crested flycatcher is a large, yellow-bellied flycatcher with a distinctive crest. It always includes snakeskin in its nest.

eastern-kingbird.funFact: Eastern kingbirds are named for their aggressive territorial behavior, attacking birds much larger than themselves.
eastern-kingbird.name: Eastern Kingbird
eastern-kingbird.description: Eastern Kingbird حيوان. The eastern kingbird is a bold flycatcher with dark gray upperparts and a distinctive white tip on its tail.

eastern-phoebe.funFact: The eastern phoebe was the first bird ever banded in North America, by Audubon in 1840.
eastern-phoebe.name: Eastern Phoebe
eastern-phoebe.description: Eastern Phoebe حيوان. The eastern phoebe is a small, brownish-gray flycatcher that bobs its tail frequently and often nests on human structures.

willow-flycatcher.funFact: Willow flycatchers are virtually identical to several other Empidonax flycatchers and are best identified by their distinctive FITZ-bew song.
willow-flycatcher.name: Willow Flycatcher
willow-flycatcher.description: Willow Flycatcher حيوان. The willow flycatcher is a small, inconspicuous flycatcher best known for its distinctive fitz-bew song.

scissor-tailed-flycatcher.funFact: The scissor-tailed flycatchers long tail feathers can be twice as long as its body.
scissor-tailed-flycatcher.name: Scissor-tailed Flycatcher
scissor-tailed-flycatcher.description: Scissor-tailed Flycatcher حيوان. The scissor-tailed flycatcher is a distinctive flycatcher with extremely long, forked tail feathers. It is the state bird of Oklahoma.

vermilion-flycatcher.funFact: The vermilion flycatcher is one of the most brilliantly colored flycatchers in the Western Hemisphere.
vermilion-flycatcher.name: Vermilion Flycatcher
vermilion-flycatcher.description: Vermilion Flycatcher حيوان. The vermilion flycatcher is a small, vividly colored flycatcher with males displaying brilliant red plumage and a black mask.

common-merganser.funFact: Common mergansers have serrated bills that help them grip slippery fish while diving underwater.
common-merganser.name: Common Merganser
common-merganser.description: Common Merganser حيوان. The common merganser is a large diving duck with a reddish-brown crested head in females and a dark green head in males. It feeds primarily on fish.

hooded-merganser.funFact: Hooded mergansers have the largest crest relative to body size of any duck, which they raise and lower at will.
hooded-merganser.name: Hooded Merganser
hooded-merganser.description: Hooded Merganser حيوان. The hooded merganser is a small, striking diving duck. Males have a bold black and white fan-shaped crest with a rusty flank patch.

bufflehead.funFact: Buffleheads are the smallest diving ducks in North America and often nest in old woodpecker holes.
bufflehead.name: Bufflehead
bufflehead.description: Bufflehead حيوان. The bufflehead is a small, compact diving duck. Males have a striking iridescent green and purple head with large white patches.

common-goldeneye.funFact: Common goldeneye hens巢巢内产卵后，雌鸟会用自己腹部脱落的绒羽覆盖卵。
common-goldeneye.name: Common Goldeneye
common-goldeneye.description: Common Goldeneye حيوان. The common goldeneye is a medium-sized diving duck with a distinctive round head. Males have a dark green-black head with a white circular patch near the bill.

ring-necked-duck.funFact: Despite its name, the ring-necked duck neck ring is rarely visible in the field.
ring-necked-duck.name: Ring-necked Duck
ring-necked-duck.description: Ring-necked Duck حيوان. The ring-necked duck is a medium-sized diving duck with a distinctive peaked head shape. Males have a black back, gray flanks, and a white breast with a subtle neck ring.

gadwall.funFact: The gadwall is often called the plain duck, but males have an elegant pattern of fine vermiculation visible up close.
gadwall.name: Gadwall
gadwall.description: Gadwall حيوان. The gadwall is a dabbling duck with subtle but elegant plumage. Males are mostly gray with black rear ends, while females are mottled brown.

blue-winged-teal.funFact: Blue-winged teal are among the earliest spring migrants and latest fall migrants in North America.
blue-winged-teal.name: Blue-winged Teal
blue-winged-teal.description: Blue-winged Teal حيوان. The blue-winged teal is a small dabbling duck. Males have a slate-blue head with a white crescent in front of the eye. It is one of the earliest migrating ducks.

crested-caracara.funFact: Crested caracaras are members of the falcon family but behave more like vultures, often scavenging on carrion.
crested-caracara.name: Crested Caracara
crested-caracara.description: Crested Caracara حيوان. The crested caracara is a distinctive raptor with a black cap, white neck, and orange face. Despite being in the falcon family, it scavenges and forages on the ground.

palm-nut-vulture.funFact: The palm-nut vulture is the only vulture species that feeds primarily on plant material, specifically palm fruits.
palm-nut-vulture.name: Palm-nut Vulture
palm-nut-vulture.description: Palm-nut Vulture حيوان. The palm-nut vulture is a unique raptor of West African palm forests that feeds mainly on the fruit of the oil palm.

black-vulture.funFact: Black vultures have excellent eyesight and also use their sense of smell to locate carrion.
black-vulture.name: Black Vulture
black-vulture.description: Black Vulture حيوان. The black vulture is a common New World vulture with black plumage and a bare, dark head. It soars in groups looking for carcasses.

roseate-spoonbill.funFact: Roseate spoonbills sweep their spatulate bills side to side through shallow water to catch small fish and crustaceans.
roseate-spoonbill.name: Roseate Spoonbill
roseate-spoonbill.description: Roseate Spoonbill حيوان. The roseate spoonbill is a large, pink wading bird with a distinctive spatulate bill. It feeds by sweeping its bill through shallow water.

wood-stork.funFact: Wood storks are the only stork species that breeds in North America and use tactile feeding to catch prey.
wood-stork.name: Wood Stork
wood-stork.description: Wood Stork حيوان. The wood stork is a large, white wading bird with a dark, featherless head and a long, curved bill. It is the only stork species breeding in the United States.

white-ibis.funFact: White ibises probe mud with their long, curved bills and can detect prey by touch alone.
white-ibis.name: White Ibis
white-ibis.description: White Ibis حيوان. The white ibis is a medium-sized wading bird with white plumage, black wing tips, and a distinctive long, curved pink bill.

limpkin.funFact: Limpkins are specialized apple snail eaters, with bills specifically adapted to extract snails from their shells.
limpkin.name: Limpkin
limpkin.description: Limpkin حيوان. The limpkin is a large, brown wading bird with white spotting. It is specialized in feeding on apple snails and has a distinctive wailing call.

rusty-blackbird.funFact: The rusty blackbird has declined by over 90% in the past 50 years, making it one of North Americas fastest declining birds.
rusty-blackbird.name: Rusty Blackbird
rusty-blackbird.description: Rusty Blackbird حيوان. The rusty blackbird is a medium-sized blackbird that breeds in boreal wetlands and winters in the southeastern United States. Males are glossy black with rust-colored edges on feathers in fall.

blue-tang.funFact: Blue tangs can make themselves nearly invisible at night by changing color.
blue-tang.name: Blue Tang
blue-tang.description: Blue Tang حيوان. The blue tang is a striking royal blue fish with a bright yellow tail and black markings. Found throughout the Indo-Pacific, it feeds primarily on algae and plays an important role in keeping coral reefs healthy.

mandarinfish.funFact: Mandarinfish are one of only two vertebrates known to produce blue pigment.
mandarinfish.name: Mandarinfish
mandarinfish.description: Mandarinfish حيوان. The mandarinfish is a small, incredibly colorful reef fish with vivid blue, orange, and green patterns. It produces a toxic mucus coating that deters predators and gives it a distinctive smell.

sixbar-wrasse.funFact: Sixbar wrasses can change sex from female to male during their lifetime.
sixbar-wrasse.name: Sixbar Wrasse
sixbar-wrasse.description: Sixbar Wrasse حيوان. The sixbar wrasse is a slender reef fish with distinctive dark vertical bars across its body. Found throughout the Indo-Pacific, it feeds on small crustaceans and fish.

yellowtail-coris.funFact: Juvenile yellowtail coris look completely different from adults with orange and white spotting.
yellowtail-coris.name: Yellowtail Coris
yellowtail-coris.description: Yellowtail Coris حيوان. The yellowtail coris is a colorful wrasse found in coral reefs across the Indo-Pacific. Adults have a green body with yellow tail and red spots, while juveniles are orange.

bicolor-angelfish.funFact: Bicolor angelfish can make loud popping sounds for communication.
bicolor-angelfish.name: Bicolor Angelfish
bicolor-angelfish.description: Bicolor Angelfish حيوان. The bicolor angelfish features a striking split coloration of dark blue-black on the front half and bright yellow on the rear half. Found in Caribbean reefs, it feeds on algae.

flame-angelfish.funFact: Flame angelfish can become aggressive when kept in small aquariums.
flame-angelfish.name: Flame Angelfish
flame-angelfish.description: Flame Angelfish حيوان. The flame angelfish is a brilliant orange-red fish with black vertical bars native to the Pacific. It is one of the most popular marine aquarium fish.

queen-angelfish.funFact: Queen angelfish get their name from a dark blue ring on their forehead resembling a crown.
queen-angelfish.name: Queen Angelfish
queen-angelfish.description: Queen Angelfish حيوان. The queen angelfish is a large, stunningly colorful reef fish with blue, yellow, and green hues. Found throughout the tropical western Atlantic, it feeds primarily on sponges.

french-angelfish.funFact: French angelfish are often seen in monogamous pairs and travel together for life.
french-angelfish.name: French Angelfish
french-angelfish.description: French Angelfish حيوان. The French angelfish is a striking black fish with bright yellow-edged scales found in Caribbean reefs. Young individuals are bright yellow but darken as adults.

regal-tang.funFact: Regal tangs have a retractable spine near their tail that can inflict painful wounds.
regal-tang.name: Regal Tang
regal-tang.description: Regal Tang حيوان. The regal tang, also known as the palette surgeonfish, is a bright blue fish with a yellow tail and black markings. Found across the Indo-Pacific.

sohal-surgeonfish.funFact: Sohal surgeonfish are extremely territorial and will attack divers who enter their space.
sohal-surgeonfish.name: Sohal Surgeonfish
sohal-surgeonfish.description: Sohal Surgeonfish حيوان. The sohal surgeonfish is a large, gray-blue reef fish with horizontal stripes and sharp scalpel-like spines on its tail. Native to the Red Sea and Persian Gulf.

moorish-idol.funFact: Moorish idols are notoriously difficult to keep in captivity and rarely survive long in aquariums.
moorish-idol.name: Moorish Idol
moorish-idol.description: Moorish Idol حيوان. The Moorish idol is one of the most recognizable reef fish with its dramatic black, white, and yellow coloration and a long flowing dorsal fin filament.

royal-gramma.funFact: Royal grammas often hang upside down under rock ledges.
royal-gramma.name: Royal Gramma
royal-gramma.description: Royal Gramma حيوان. The royal gramma, or fairy basslet, has a stunning two-tone coloration with bright purple on the front half and yellow on the rear half. Found in Caribbean caves.

longnose-butterflyfish.funFact: The longnose butterflyfish uses its elongated snout to reach into coral crevices for food.
longnose-butterflyfish.name: Longnose Butterflyfish
longnose-butterflyfish.description: Longnose Butterflyfish حيوان. The longnose butterflyfish is a slender reef fish with a distinctive elongated snout and yellow body with a dark eye band.

copperband-butterflyfish.funFact: Copperband butterflyfish have a false eye spot near their tail to confuse predators.
copperband-butterflyfish.name: Copperband Butterflyfish
copperband-butterflyfish.description: Copperband Butterflyfish حيوان. The copperband butterflyfish has a striking pattern of vertical orange bands with black edges on a silver-white body.

foureye-butterflyfish.funFact: Foureye butterflyfish have large eye spots that make predators think their tail is their head.
