foureye-butterflyfish.name: Foureye Butterflyfish
foureye-butterflyfish.description: Foureye Butterflyfish حيوان. The foureye butterflyfish gets its name from the prominent black eye spot on each side near its tail, confusing predators.

bluegill.funFact: Male bluegills build circular nests in shallow water and guard the eggs fiercely.
bluegill.name: Bluegill
bluegill.description: Bluegill حيوان. The bluegill is a freshwater sunfish native to eastern North America. It has an olive-green body with a distinctive dark spot on the ear flap.

largemouth-bass.funFact: Largemouth bass can open their mouths wide enough to gulp down prey nearly half their size.
largemouth-bass.name: Largemouth Bass
largemouth-bass.description: Largemouth Bass حيوان. The largemouth bass is the largest of the black basses and the most popular freshwater game fish in North America.

smallmouth-bass.funFact: Smallmouth bass are known for their fighting ability and are called brownies or bronzebacks.
smallmouth-bass.name: Smallmouth Bass
smallmouth-bass.description: Smallmouth Bass حيوان. The smallmouth bass is a freshwater fish prized by anglers for its aggressive fighting style.

rainbow-trout.funFact: Rainbow trout can change color intensity based on their environment and mood.
rainbow-trout.name: Rainbow Trout
rainbow-trout.description: Rainbow Trout حيوان. The rainbow trout is a coldwater fish with an olive-green body and a distinctive pinkish-red stripe along its side.

brook-trout.funFact: Brook trout are the only trout native to much of eastern North America.
brook-trout.name: Brook Trout
brook-trout.description: Brook Trout حيوان. The brook trout, also called speckled trout, has a dark green body with light spots and red spots with blue halos.

atlantic-salmon.funFact: Atlantic salmon can jump waterfalls and dams during their upstream spawning migration.
atlantic-salmon.name: Atlantic Salmon
atlantic-salmon.description: Atlantic Salmon حيوان. The Atlantic salmon is an anadromous fish born in freshwater, migrates to the ocean, and returns to freshwater to spawn.

chinook-salmon.funFact: Chinook salmon are the largest of all Pacific salmon species.
chinook-salmon.name: Chinook Salmon
chinook-salmon.description: Chinook Salmon حيوان. The Chinook salmon, also called king salmon, is the largest Pacific salmon with a greenish back and dark spots.

coho-salmon.funFact: Coho salmon turn bright red with hooked jaws during spawning season.
coho-salmon.name: Coho Salmon
coho-salmon.description: Coho Salmon حيوان. The coho salmon, also known as silver salmon, has a silver body with black spots and is found throughout the North Pacific.

pacific-bluefin-tuna.funFact: Pacific bluefin tuna can cross the entire Pacific Ocean in less than 60 days.
pacific-bluefin-tuna.name: Pacific Bluefin Tuna
pacific-bluefin-tuna.description: Pacific Bluefin Tuna حيوان. The Pacific bluefin tuna is a large, fast, pelagic fish found throughout the Pacific Ocean, highly prized in sushi markets.

yellowfin-tuna.funFact: Yellowfin tuna can swim at speeds up to 40 miles per hour in short bursts.
yellowfin-tuna.name: Yellowfin Tuna
yellowfin-tuna.description: Yellowfin Tuna حيوان. The yellowfin tuna is a large, streamlined ocean fish with bright yellow dorsal and anal fins found in tropical oceans worldwide.

atlantic-cod.funFact: Atlantic cod can detect their prey using electroreception even in murky water.
atlantic-cod.name: Atlantic Cod
atlantic-cod.description: Atlantic Cod حيوان. The Atlantic cod is a large, cold-water fish with a distinctive chin barbel and three dorsal fins, once one of the most important food fish in the world.

atlantic-grouper.funFact: Groupers can inhale prey whole by suddenly opening their massive mouths.
atlantic-grouper.name: Atlantic Grouper
atlantic-grouper.description: Atlantic Grouper حيوان. The Atlantic grouper is a large, robust reef fish with a wide mouth and thick lips found in warm Atlantic waters.

goliath-grouper.funFact: Goliath groupers are so large they can weigh as much as a small car.
goliath-grouper.name: Goliath Grouper
goliath-grouper.description: Goliath Grouper حيوان. The goliath grouper is the largest bony fish in the Western Atlantic, reaching weights of up to 800 pounds.

red-snapper.funFact: Red snappers can live over 50 years, making them one of the longest-lived snapper species.
red-snapper.name: Red Snapper
red-snapper.description: Red Snapper حيوان. The red snapper is a bright red reef fish found in the Gulf of Mexico and western Atlantic.

barracuda.funFact: يمكنه السباحة بسرعة أكثر من 55 كم/ساعة
barracuda.name: Barracuda
barracuda.description: Barracuda حيوان. The barracuda is a large, predatory fish with a long, streamlined body and razor-sharp teeth found in tropical oceans.

mahi-mahi.funFact: Mahi-mahi are also called dorado or dolphinfish, not to be confused with dolphins.
mahi-mahi.name: Mahi-Mahi
mahi-mahi.description: Mahi-Mahi حيوان. The mahi-mahi is a brightly colored pelagic fish with a golden-green body and blue fins found in tropical oceans.

wahoo.funFact: Wahoo are among the fastest fish in the ocean, capable of reaching speeds up to 50 mph.
wahoo.name: Wahoo
wahoo.description: Wahoo حيوان. The wahoo is a large, fast pelagic fish related to mackerels with a sleek, torpedo-shaped body and vertical blue bars.

sailfish.funFact: Sailfish are considered the fastest fish in the ocean, reaching speeds up to 68 mph.
sailfish.name: Sailfish
sailfish.description: Sailfish حيوان. The sailfish is a large billfish with a spectacular high dorsal fin resembling a sail, found in tropical oceans worldwide.

blue-marlin.funFact: Blue marlin can weigh over 1,000 pounds and are among the largest bony fish in the world.
blue-marlin.name: Blue Marlin
blue-marlin.description: Blue Marlin حيوان. The blue marlin is one of the largest ocean fish with a distinctive blue upper body and silver-white belly found in tropical Atlantic waters.

nassau-grouper.funFact: Nassau grouper can change color in seconds to match their surroundings.
nassau-grouper.name: Nassau Grouper
nassau-grouper.description: Nassau Grouper حيوان. The Nassau grouper is a large reef fish capable of rapid color changes, now critically endangered from overfishing.

striped-bass.funFact: Striped bass are anadromous and can travel hundreds of miles to spawn.
striped-bass.name: Striped Bass
striped-bass.description: Striped Bass حيوان. The striped bass is a silver fish with distinctive horizontal dark stripes found along the Atlantic coast.

red-drum.funFact: Red drum are also called channel bass and are the official state fish of North Carolina.
red-drum.name: Red Drum
red-drum.description: Red Drum حيوان. The red drum, also called redfish, is a copper-bronze fish with a distinctive black spot near the tail.

black-drum.funFact: Black drum can produce loud drumming sounds using muscles on their swim bladder.
black-drum.name: Black Drum
black-drum.description: Black Drum حيوان. The black drum is a large, dark fish with barbels on its chin that can grow to over 100 pounds.

channel-catfish.funFact: Channel catfish have taste buds covering their entire body and can taste food from far away.
channel-catfish.name: Channel Catfish
channel-catfish.description: Channel Catfish حيوان. The channel catfish is the most fished catfish species in North America with a forked tail and whisker-like barbels.

blue-catfish.funFact: Blue catfish can grow over 100 pounds and are the largest freshwater fish in North America.
blue-catfish.name: Blue Catfish
blue-catfish.description: Blue Catfish حيوان. The blue catfish is the largest species of North American catfish reaching weights of over 100 pounds.

walking-catfish.funFact: Walking catfish can survive out of water for hours and use their pectoral fins to walk on land.
walking-catfish.name: Walking Catfish
walking-catfish.description: Walking Catfish حيوان. The walking catfish is a freshwater catfish native to Southeast Asia that can breathe air and move across land.

wels-catfish.funFact: Wels catfish have been reported to grow over 16 feet long in rare cases.
wels-catfish.name: Wels Catfish
wels-catfish.description: Wels Catfish حيوان. The wels catfish is the largest freshwater fish in Europe reaching lengths of over 16 feet with a wide, flat head.

eurasian-pike.funFact: Eurasian pike can accelerate from a standstill to 20 mph in less than a tenth of a second.
eurasian-pike.name: Eurasian Pike
eurasian-pike.description: Eurasian Pike حيوان. The Eurasian pike is a large, ambush predator found throughout Europe, Asia, and northern North America.

muskellunge.funFact: Muskellunge are also called muskies and are the largest member of the pike family.
muskellunge.name: Muskellunge
muskellunge.description: Muskellunge حيوان. The muskellunge, or muskie, is the largest freshwater fish in the pike family found in clear lakes and rivers of North America.

walleye.funFact: Walleye have a light-reflecting layer called the tapetum lucidum that makes their eyes glow at night.
walleye.name: Walleye
walleye.description: Walleye حيوان. The walleye is a freshwater fish named for its distinctive, glassy eyes that reflect light found in cool, clear lakes.

common-carp.funFact: Common carp are considered one of the most influential invasive fish species in the world.
common-carp.name: Common Carp
common-carp.description: Common Carp حيوان. The common carp is a large, golden-brown freshwater fish found throughout the world, originally from Eurasia.

grass-carp.funFact: Grass carp can eat up to 40% of their body weight in vegetation each day.
grass-carp.name: Grass Carp
grass-carp.description: Grass Carp حيوان. The grass carp is a large freshwater fish native to eastern Asia that feeds almost exclusively on aquatic plants.

koi-carp.funFact: The most expensive koi ever sold was a Japanese fish named S Legend that sold for $1.8 million.
koi-carp.name: Koi
koi-carp.description: Koi حيوان. Koi are ornamental varieties of common carp bred for their vibrant colors and patterns from Japan.

goldfish.name: Goldfish
goldfish.description: Goldfish حيوان. The goldfish is one of the most popular aquarium fish in the world, domesticated from East Asia over 1,000 years ago.

tench.funFact: Tench secrete a mucus that can heal wounds in other fish.
tench.name: Tench
tench.description: Tench حيوان. The tench is a freshwater fish with a thick, slimy body and olive-green to bronze coloration found throughout Europe and Asia.

three-spined-stickleback.funFact: Male sticklebacks build elaborate nests from water plants and fan the eggs to provide oxygen.
three-spined-stickleback.name: Three-spined Stickleback
three-spined-stickleback.description: Three-spined Stickleback حيوان. The three-spined stickleback is a small, spiny fish found throughout the Northern Hemisphere, males build intricate nests.

florida-gar.funFact: Florida gar have an elongated snout filled with needle-like teeth and can breathe air.
florida-gar.name: Florida Gar
florida-gar.description: Florida Gar حيوان. The Florida gar is a long, slender predatory fish with an elongated snout and armored scales found in Florida and Georgia.

alligator-gar.funFact: Alligator gar eggs are toxic to humans but consumed by Native Americans after processing.
alligator-gar.name: Alligator Gar
alligator-gar.description: Alligator Gar حيوان. The alligator gar is the largest freshwater fish in North America, reaching over 8 feet long with a long, alligator-like snout.

bowfin.funFact: Bowfin are the only surviving member of an ancient order of fish.
bowfin.name: Bowfin
bowfin.description: Bowfin حيوان. The bowfin is a primitive freshwater fish with an elongated body and a distinctive long dorsal fin found in eastern North America.

chinese-sturgeon.funFact: Chinese sturgeon have existed for over 140 million years and are called living fossils.
chinese-sturgeon.name: Chinese Sturgeon
chinese-sturgeon.description: Chinese Sturgeon حيوان. The Chinese sturgeon is a critically endangered species found only in the Yangtze River that can grow to over 16 feet.

atlantic-sturgeon.funFact: Atlantic sturgeon can live over 100 years and were once hunted for their caviar.
atlantic-sturgeon.name: Atlantic Sturgeon
atlantic-sturgeon.description: Atlantic Sturgeon حيوان. The Atlantic sturgeon is a large, primitive fish with a prehistoric appearance featuring bony plates instead of scales.

arctic-char.funFact: Arctic char are the most northerly freshwater fish in the world.
arctic-char.name: Arctic Char
arctic-char.description: Arctic Char حيوان. The Arctic char is a cold-water fish related to salmon and trout found in Arctic and subarctic waters.

lake-trout.funFact: Lake trout can live over 40 years and grow to over 60 pounds.
lake-trout.name: Lake Trout
lake-trout.description: Lake Trout حيوان. The lake trout is a large, cold-water salmonid found in deep lakes of northern North America with a forked tail.

cutthroat-trout.funFact: Cutthroat trout are named for the distinctive red slash under their jaw.
cutthroat-trout.name: Cutthroat Trout
cutthroat-trout.description: Cutthroat Trout حيوان. The cutthroat trout is a cold-water fish native to western North America, named for red-orange slash marks under its lower jaw.

golden-trout.funFact: Golden trout are the official state fish of California and are found only in a few remote streams.
golden-trout.name: Golden Trout
golden-trout.description: Golden Trout حيوان. The golden trout is a subspecies of rainbow trout found in high-altitude mountain streams of California with golden-yellow body.

oceanic-whitetip-shark.funFact: Oceanic whitetip sharks were responsible for more human casualties than any other species during World War II.
oceanic-whitetip-shark.name: Oceanic Whitetip Shark
oceanic-whitetip-shark.description: Oceanic Whitetip Shark حيوان. The oceanic whitetip shark is a large, slow-moving pelagic shark with distinctive white-tipped fins, critically endangered.

blacktip-shark.funFact: Blacktip sharks are known for their dramatic breaching behavior, spinning out of the water.
blacktip-shark.name: Blacktip Shark
blacktip-shark.description: Blacktip Shark حيوان. The blacktip shark is a medium-sized shark with distinctive black tips on all its fins found in warm coastal waters.

scalloped-hammerhead.funFact: Scalloped hammerheads form massive schools of hundreds during their annual migration.
scalloped-hammerhead.name: Scalloped Hammerhead
scalloped-hammerhead.description: Scalloped Hammerhead حيوان. The scalloped hammerhead is one of the most common hammerhead species with a distinctive scalloped leading edge on its head.

thresher-shark.funFact: Thresher sharks use their extremely long tail whip to stun schools of fish.
thresher-shark.name: Thresher Shark
thresher-shark.description: Thresher Shark حيوان. The thresher shark is a distinctive shark with an extremely long upper tail that can be as long as its body found in open ocean.

basking-shark.funFact: Basking sharks are the second largest fish in the world, after whale sharks.
basking-shark.name: Basking Shark
basking-shark.description: Basking Shark حيوان. The basking shark is the second largest fish in the world, filter-feeding on plankton with an enormous mouth over 3 feet wide.

nurse-shark.funFact: Nurse sharks can pump water over their gills while resting on the ocean floor.
nurse-shark.name: Nurse Shark
nurse-shark.description: Nurse Shark حيوان. The nurse shark is a sluggish, bottom-dwelling shark with barbels near its nostrils that help detect prey hidden in sand.

zebra-shark.funFact: Zebra sharks change from striped as juveniles to spotted as adults.
zebra-shark.name: Zebra Shark
zebra-shark.description: Zebra Shark حيوان. The zebra shark is a distinctive shark with dark spots on a tan body found on tropical coral reefs of the Indo-Pacific.

epaulette-shark.funFact: Epaulette sharks can walk on their fins across the reef flat at low tide.
epaulette-shark.name: Epaulette Shark
epaulette-shark.description: Epaulette Shark حيوان. The epaulette shark is a small reef shark that can walk on its fins across the reef flat found in the Indo-Pacific.

angel-shark.funFact: Angel sharks can bury themselves completely in sand to ambush passing prey.
angel-shark.name: Angel Shark
angel-shark.description: Angel Shark حيوان. The angel shark is a flattened shark that lies buried in sand on the ocean floor, critically endangered due to habitat loss.

southern-stingray.funFact: Southern stingrays can deliver a venomous barb sting that can cause severe pain.
southern-stingray.name: Southern Stingray
southern-stingray.description: Southern Stingray حيوان. The southern stingray is a large, diamond-shaped ray found in shallow tropical waters of the western Atlantic.

cownose-ray.funFact: Cownose rays migrate in massive schools of thousands along the Atlantic coast.
cownose-ray.name: Cownose Ray
cownose-ray.description: Cownose Ray حيوان. The cownose ray is a distinctive ray with a unique head shape resembling a cow's nose, forming large schools during migration.

eagle-ray.funFact: Spotted eagle rays can leap several feet out of the water.
eagle-ray.name: Spotted Eagle Ray
eagle-ray.description: Spotted Eagle Ray حيوان. The spotted eagle ray is a large ray with distinctive white spots on a dark body found in tropical and subtropical oceans.

viperfish.funFact: Viperfish have extremely long, needle-like teeth that are so long they don't fit inside their mouths.
viperfish.name: Viperfish
viperfish.description: Viperfish حيوان. The viperfish is a deep-sea predator with extremely long, needle-like teeth and a bioluminescent photophore along its body.

gulper-eel.funFact: Gulper eels have enormous mouths that can open wide enough to swallow prey larger than themselves.
gulper-eel.name: Gulper Eel
gulper-eel.description: Gulper Eel حيوان. The gulper eel is a deep-sea fish with an enormous, loosely hinged mouth and a long, whip-like tail found in deep ocean waters.

lungfish.funFact: Lungfish can breathe air and survive out of water for months by burrowing into mud.
lungfish.name: Lungfish
lungfish.description: Lungfish حيوان. The lungfish is a freshwater fish with both gills and primitive lungs, one of the closest living relatives to tetrapods found in Africa, South America, and Australia.

coelacanth.funFact: Coelacanths were thought to be extinct for 66 million years until rediscovered in 1938.
coelacanth.name: Coelacanth
coelacanth.description: Coelacanth حيوان. The coelacanth is a living fossil, a lobe-finned fish once thought extinct that was rediscovered off the coast of South Africa in 1938.

red-bellied-piranha.funFact: Red-bellied piranhas can strip a carcass to bone in minutes with their razor-sharp teeth.
red-bellied-piranha.name: Red-bellied Piranha
red-bellied-piranha.description: Red-bellied Piranha حيوان. The red-bellied piranha is a freshwater fish native to South America known for its sharp teeth and powerful jaws found in rivers and lakes.

arapaima.funFact: Arapaima are among the largest freshwater fish in the world and can breathe air.
arapaima.name: Arapaima
arapaima.description: Arapaima حيوان. The arapaima is one of the largest freshwater fish in the world, reaching lengths of over 10 feet, found in the Amazon basin.

arowana.funFact: Arowana can jump up to 6 feet out of the water to catch prey on overhanging branches.
arowana.name: Arowana
arowana.description: Arowana حيوان. The arowana is a freshwater fish with large, metallic scales and an upward-pointing mouth found in tropical rivers of South America, Asia, and Australia.

knifefish.funFact: Black ghost knifefish use weak electric fields to navigate and find prey in dark, murky water.
knifefish.name: Black Ghost Knifefish
knifefish.description: Black Ghost Knifefish حيوان. The black ghost knifefish is a freshwater fish with an elongated, laterally compressed body and a distinctive anal fin used for propulsion.

betta.funFact: Male bettas build bubble nests at the water surface for their eggs.
betta.name: Betta
betta.description: Betta حيوان. The betta, or Siamese fighting fish, is a small freshwater fish with flowing fins and vibrant colors native to Southeast Asia.

discus.funFact: Discus parents produce a mucus secretion that their young feed on for the first few weeks.
discus.name: Discus
discus.description: Discus حيوان. The discus is a freshwater fish with a distinctive disc-shaped body found in the Amazon basin, popular in aquariums for its vibrant colors.

oscarr.funFact: Oscars are highly intelligent fish that can recognize their owners.
oscarr.name: Oscar
oscarr.description: Oscar حيوان. The oscar is a large cichlid native to South America with a dark body and orange-red markings, popular in aquariums for its personality.

angelfish-freshwater.funFact: Freshwater angelfish are actually cichlids, not related to marine angelfish.
angelfish-freshwater.name: Freshwater Angelfish
angelfish-freshwater.description: Freshwater Angelfish حيوان. The freshwater angelfish is a popular aquarium fish with a distinctive triangular body shape and long, flowing fins native to the Amazon basin.

convict-cichlid.funFact: Convict cichlids are devoted parents that aggressively defend their young.
convict-cichlid.name: Convict Cichlid
convict-cichlid.description: Convict Cichlid حيوان. The convict cichlid is a small freshwater fish with distinctive black vertical stripes on a light body found in Central America.

peacock-cichlid.funFact: Male peacock cichlids display brilliant blue, red, and gold colors during breeding.
peacock-cichlid.name: Peacock Cichlid
peacock-cichlid.description: Peacock Cichlid حيوان. The peacock cichlid is a colorful freshwater fish found in Lake Malawi with males displaying vibrant blues, reds, and golds.

lionfish.funFact: Lionfish venomous spines can cause extreme pain and their venom is heat-stable.
lionfish.name: Lionfish
lionfish.description: Lionfish حيوان. The lionfish is a venomous marine fish with distinctive red, white, and brown stripes and fan-like pectoral fins found in tropical reefs.

stonefish.funFact: Stonefish are the most venomous fish in the world, their sting can be fatal to humans.
stonefish.name: Stonefish
stonefish.description: Stonefish حيوان. The stonefish is the most venomous fish in the world, masters of camouflage resembling rocks on the ocean floor found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

leafy-seadragon.funFact: Leafy seadragons have no stomach or teeth and must eat almost constantly.
leafy-seadragon.name: Leafy Seadragon
leafy-seadragon.description: Leafy Seadragon حيوان. The leafy seadragon is a marine fish related to seahorses with leaf-like appendages providing perfect camouflage in kelp forests.

weedy-seadragon.funFact: Weedy seadragons carry their eggs on the male's tail until they hatch.
weedy-seadragon.name: Weedy Seadragon
weedy-seadragon.description: Weedy Seadragon حيوان. The weedy seadragon is a marine fish related to seahorses with small leaf-like appendages found in kelp forests of southern Australia.

boxfish.funFact: Boxfish can release a toxin when stressed that can kill other fish in an aquarium.
boxfish.name: Yellow Boxfish
boxfish.description: Yellow Boxfish حيوان. The yellow boxfish is a small, cube-shaped reef fish with bright yellow coloration and black spots found in the Indo-Pacific.

cowfish.funFact: Longhorn cowfish have two horn-like spines protruding from their head.
cowfish.name: Longhorn Cowfish
cowfish.description: Longhorn Cowfish حيوان. The longhorn cowfish is a distinctive reef fish with horn-like spines on its head and a boxy, armored body found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

trunkfish.funFact: Trunkfish can squirt a toxic substance from their skin when threatened.
trunkfish.name: Spotted Trunkfish
trunkfish.description: Spotted Trunkfish حيوان. The spotted trunkfish is a small, box-shaped reef fish with white spots on a dark body found in Caribbean coral reefs.

filefish.funFact: Filefish can change color and pattern to match their surroundings.
filefish.name: Scrawled Filefish
filefish.description: Scrawled Filefish حيوان. The scrawled filefish is a marine fish with a distinctive elongated body and blue spots found in tropical Atlantic waters.

triggerfish.funFact: Triggerfish have a spine on their dorsal fin that can be locked in an upright position.
triggerfish.name: Queen Triggerfish
triggerfish.description: Queen Triggerfish حيوان. The queen triggerfish is a large, colorful reef fish with distinctive blue lines on its face and a trigger spine on its dorsal fin.

leatherjacket.funFact: Leatherjackets have rough, sandpaper-like skin used by early settlers as sandpaper.
leatherjacket.name: Slender Leatherjacket
leatherjacket.description: Slender Leatherjacket حيوان. The slender leatherjacket is a small marine fish with a compressed body and rough skin found in coastal waters worldwide.

parrotfish.funFact: Parrotfish excrete digested coral as fine white sand, creating tropical beaches.
parrotfish.name: Stoplight Parrotfish
parrotfish.description: Stoplight Parrotfish حيوان. The stoplight parrotfish is a colorful reef fish with a beak-like mouth used to scrape algae from coral found in Caribbean reefs.

wrasse.funFact: Cleaner wrasses set up cleaning stations where larger fish line up to have parasites removed.
wrasse.name: Cleaner Wrasse
wrasse.description: Cleaner Wrasse حيوان. The cleaner wrasse is a small reef fish with a distinctive blue stripe that sets up cleaning stations to remove parasites from larger fish.

tuskfish.funFact: Tuskfish use rocks as anvils to crack open shellfish for food.
tuskfish.name: Ornate Tuskfish
tuskfish.description: Ornate Tuskfish حيوان. The ornate tuskfish is a colorful reef fish with distinctive blue and orange markings found in the Indo-Pacific.

grouper-marbled.funFact: Marbled groupers form massive spawning aggregations of thousands of individuals.
grouper-marbled.name: Marbled Grouper
grouper-marbled.description: Marbled Grouper حيوان. The marbled grouper is a large reef fish with a marbled pattern found in tropical Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

wrasse-humphead.funFact: Humphead wrasses can live over 30 years and are the largest living labrid fish.
wrasse-humphead.name: Humphead Wrasse
wrasse-humphead.description: Humphead Wrasse حيوان. The humphead wrasse is the largest living wrasse species with a distinctive hump on its forehead found in Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

coral-grouper.funFact: Coral groupers hunt cooperatively with moray eels, using head shakes to signal the eel to flush out prey.
coral-grouper.name: Coral Grouper
coral-grouper.description: Coral Grouper حيوان. The coral grouper is a large reef fish with a reddish body and blue spots found in tropical Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

cardinalfish.funFact: Male Banggai cardinalfish mouthbrood the eggs until they hatch.
cardinalfish.name: Banggai Cardinalfish
cardinalfish.description: Banggai Cardinalfish حيوان. The Banggai cardinalfish is a small, striking reef fish with black and white stripes and long fins found only in the Banggai Islands of Indonesia.

damselfish.funFact: Male garibaldi build and tend elaborate nests of algae to attract mates.
damselfish.name: Garibaldi Damselfish
damselfish.description: Garibaldi Damselfish حيوان. The garibaldi is a bright orange damselfish found in kelp forests of the eastern Pacific, the official marine fish of California.

sergeant-major.funFact: Male sergeant majors turn dark purple when guarding their eggs.
sergeant-major.name: Sergeant Major
sergeant-major.description: Sergeant Major حيوان. The sergeant major is a small reef fish with five black vertical bars on a light body found in tropical Atlantic waters.

goby.funFact: Neon gobies set up cleaning stations and remove parasites from larger fish.
goby.name: Neon Goby
goby.description: Neon Goby حيوان. The neon goby is a tiny reef fish with a bright blue stripe that sets up cleaning stations to remove parasites from larger fish.

blenny.funFact: Midas blennies often join schools of cleaner wrasses to avoid predation.
blenny.name: Midas Blenny
blenny.description: Midas Blenny حيوان. The Midas blenny is a small, golden-yellow reef fish that mimics cleaner wrasses for protection found in Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

scorpionfish.funFact: Scorpionfish are masters of camouflage, resembling algae-covered rocks on the reef.
scorpionfish.name: Tasseled Scorpionfish
scorpionfish.description: Tasseled Scorpionfish حيوان. The tasseled scorpionfish is a venomous reef fish with elaborate skin flaps providing excellent camouflage found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

flathead.funFact: Flathead are ambush predators that bury themselves in sand to surprise prey.
flathead.name: Bartail Flathead
flathead.description: Bartail Flathead حيوان. The bartail flathead is a bottom-dwelling marine fish with a flattened head and body found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

grunt.funFact: Grunts get their name from the sound they make by grinding their teeth.
grunt.name: Blue-striped Grunt
grunt.description: Blue-striped Grunt حيوان. The blue-striped grunt is a small reef fish with distinctive blue horizontal stripes found in Caribbean coral reefs.

tang.funFact: Clown tangs are extremely territorial and can be aggressive toward other fish.
tang.name: Clown Tang
tang.description: Clown Tang حيوان. The clown tang is a bright blue surgeonfish with white and black markings found in coral reefs of the Indo-Pacific.

squirrelfish.funFact: Squirrelfish have large eyes adapted for nocturnal hunting.
squirrelfish.name: Squirrelfish
squirrelfish.description: Squirrelfish حيوان. The squirrelfish is a small, red reef fish with large eyes found in tropical coral reefs worldwide, active at night.

sweep.funFact: Sweep are named for their distinctive sweeping swimming motion.
sweep.name: Sweep
sweep.description: Sweep حيوان. The sweep is a small, silvery fish with a distinctive deep body found in temperate rocky reefs of the Indo-Pacific.

leatherjacket-freshwater.funFact: New Zealand magpie are freshwater leatherjackets found only in New Zealand.
leatherjacket-freshwater.name: New Zealand Magpie
leatherjacket-freshwater.description: New Zealand Magpie حيوان. The New Zealand magpie is a small freshwater fish with a compressed body and rough skin found in rivers and lakes of New Zealand.

john-dory.funFact: John Dory have a distinctive dark spot on each side that looks like a thumbprint.
john-dory.name: John Dory
john-dory.description: John Dory حيوان. The John Dory is a marine fish with a distinctive oval body and dark lateral spot found in temperate coastal waters of the Indo-Pacific.

boarfish.funFact: Boarfish use their elongated snout to extract small invertebrates from coral crevices.
boarfish.name: Longsnout Boarfish
boarfish.description: Longsnout Boarfish حيوان. The longsnout boarfish is a distinctive reef fish with a long, tubular snout and black and white stripes found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

bigeye.funFact: Bigeyes have extremely large eyes adapted for nocturnal feeding.
bigeye.name: Bigeye
bigeye.description: Bigeye حيوان. The bigeye is a small reef fish with disproportionately large eyes found in tropical coral reefs worldwide, active at night.

soldierfish.funFact: Soldierfish are nocturnal and hide in reef crevices during the day.
soldierfish.name: Blackbar Soldierfish
soldierfish.description: Blackbar Soldierfish حيوان. The blackbar soldierfish is a small, red reef fish with a distinctive black bar behind its gill cover found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

green-anole.name: Green Anole
green-anole.description: Green Anole حيوان. The green anole is a small arboreal lizard native to the southeastern United States. Often called the American chameleon, it can shift its skin color between green and brown. Males display a pinkish-red dewlap under their throat during courtship or territorial displays.

saltwater-crocodile.name: Saltwater Crocodile
saltwater-crocodile.description: Saltwater Crocodile حيوان. The saltwater crocodile is the largest living reptile and has the strongest bite force ever measured. Found in coastal regions from eastern India to Australia, it is an opportunistic apex predator. Adults can survive in both saltwater and freshwater environments.

reticulated-python.name: Reticulated Python
reticulated-python.description: Reticulated Python حيوان. The reticulated python is a non-venomous constrictor and the longest snake in the world. Native to Southeast Asia, it is found in rainforests, rivers, and even near human settlements. It kills prey by constriction and can swallow animals much larger than its head.

panther-chameleon.funFact: Chameleons change color primarily for communication and temperature regulation, not camouflage.
panther-chameleon.name: Panther Chameleon
panther-chameleon.description: Panther Chameleon حيوان. The panther chameleon is a vibrant species native to Madagascar's tropical rainforests. Males display vivid colors ranging from blue, green, and yellow to red. They use their long, sticky tongues to catch insects with remarkable accuracy.

american-alligator.funFact: كان على وشك الانقراض، الآن في طريقه للتعافي
american-alligator.name: American Alligator
american-alligator.description: American Alligator حيوان. The American alligator is a large crocodilian native to the southeastern United States. Once endangered, it has made a remarkable recovery through conservation efforts. It inhabits freshwater environments and is an opportunistic predator of fish, birds, and mammals.

leopard-gecko.name: Leopard Gecko
leopard-gecko.description: Leopard Gecko حيوان. The leopard gecko is a small, nocturnal lizard native to the rocky deserts and grasslands of South Asia. Unlike many geckos, it has movable eyelids and can blink. It is one of the most popular pet reptiles due to its docile temperament.

eastern-diamondback-rattlesnake.funFact: The eastern diamondback rattlesnake's rattle can vibrate up to 50 times per second as a warning signal.
eastern-diamondback-rattlesnake.name: Eastern Diamondback Rattlesnake
eastern-diamondback-rattlesnake.description: Eastern Diamondback Rattlesnake حيوان. The eastern diamondback rattlesnake is the largest venomous snake in North America. Found in the coastal scrublands and pine flatwoods of the southeastern United States, it uses its diamond-shaped dorsal pattern as camouflage. Its rattle serves as an auditory warning to potential threats.

gila-monster.funFact: The Gila monster's venom contains a compound used in a drug to treat type 2 diabetes.
gila-monster.name: Gila Monster
gila-monster.description: Gila Monster حيوان. The Gila monster is one of only a few venomous lizards in the world, native to the deserts of the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico. It has a stout body with bead-like scales in black and pink, orange, or yellow patterns. It spends most of its life underground.

leatherback-sea-turtle.funFact: Leatherback sea turtles are the largest turtles in the world and have existed for over 100 million years.
leatherback-sea-turtle.name: Leatherback Sea Turtle
leatherback-sea-turtle.description: Leatherback Sea Turtle حيوان. The leatherback sea turtle is the largest living turtle and the fourth heaviest reptile. Unlike other sea turtles, it has a flexible, leathery carapace instead of a hard shell. It dives to depths exceeding 3,000 feet and feeds almost exclusively on jellyfish.

boomslang.funFact: Boomslang venom prevents blood clotting, causing victims to bleed from every orifice.
boomslang.name: Boomslang
boomslang.description: Boomslang حيوان. The boomslang is a highly venomous rear-fanged snake native to sub-Saharan Africa. Males are typically bright green while females are brown. It is arboreal, spending most of its time in trees, and feeds on birds, chameleons, and small mammals.

indian-cobra.name: Indian Cobra
indian-cobra.description: Indian Cobra حيوان. The Indian cobra is one of the 'big four' venomous snakes responsible for the most snakebite deaths in India. It is iconic for its hood, which it displays when threatened. It is found across the Indian subcontinent in a variety of habitats.

rhinoceros-iguana.funFact: Rhinoceros iguanas get their name from the horn-like scales on their snouts, which resemble rhinoceros horns.
rhinoceros-iguana.name: Rhinoceros Iguana
rhinoceros-iguana.description: Rhinoceros Iguana حيوان. The rhinoceros iguana is a large, heavy-bodied lizard endemic to the Caribbean island of Hispaniola. It is named for the bony, horn-like outgrowths on its snout. It inhabits dry, rocky areas and feeds on leaves, flowers, and fruit.

emerald-tree-boa.funFact: Emerald tree boas have heat-sensing pits along their lips to detect warm-blooded prey in the dark.
emerald-tree-boa.name: Emerald Tree Boa
emerald-tree-boa.description: Emerald Tree Boa حيوان. The emerald tree boa is a bright green, non-venomous constrictor native to the rainforests of South America. It spends almost its entire life coiled on branches, waiting to ambush birds and small mammals. Its white markings along the spine help break up its silhouette.

gharial.name: Gharial
gharial.description: Gharial حيوان. The gharial is a critically endangered crocodilian with a distinctive long, thin snout adapted for catching fish. Once found across the Indian subcontinent, it is now restricted to a few rivers in India and Nepal. It is one of the largest crocodilian species.

mexican-beaded-lizard.funFact: The Mexican beaded lizard is one of only a few venomous lizards and can deliver a painful, though rarely fatal, bite.
mexican-beaded-lizard.name: Mexican Beaded Lizard
mexican-beaded-lizard.description: Mexican Beaded Lizard حيوان. The Mexican beaded lizard is a large, venomous lizard found in the dry forests and thorn scrub of Mexico and Guatemala. It has black skin with yellow or pinkish banding and bead-like scales. It is nocturnal and spends most of its time in burrows.

desert-tortoise.funFact: Desert tortoises can store over a liter of water in their bladders and reabsorb it during droughts.
desert-tortoise.name: Desert Tortoise
desert-tortoise.description: Desert Tortoise حيوان. The desert tortoise is a species of tortoise native to the Mojave and Sonoran Deserts. It spends up to 95% of its life underground in burrows that can be over 30 feet long. It is well adapted to extreme heat and arid conditions.

tokay-gecko.funFact: Tokay geckos can produce one of the loudest calls of any gecko, heard up to a mile away.
tokay-gecko.name: Tokay Gecko
tokay-gecko.description: Tokay Gecko حيوان. The tokay gecko is a large gecko native to Southeast Asia, known for its loud, distinctive call. Males are territorial and aggressive, often found on walls and ceilings of buildings. It is widely used in traditional medicine in some Asian cultures.

king-snake.funFact: King snakes are called 'kings' because they regularly eat other snakes, including venomous rattlesnakes.
king-snake.name: Eastern King Snake
king-snake.description: Eastern King Snake حيوان. The eastern king snake is a powerful, non-venomous constrictor found across the eastern United States. It has a distinctive chain-link pattern of white or yellow bands on a dark background. It is immune to the venom of many pit vipers.

blue-tongued-skink.funFact: Blue-tongued skinks flash their bright blue tongues to startle predators into backing away.
blue-tongued-skink.name: Blue-Tongued Skink
blue-tongued-skink.description: Blue-Tongued Skink حيوان. The blue-tongued skink is a group of lizards native to Australia, Tasmania, and New Guinea. They are known for their distinctive blue tongues, which they display as a defense mechanism. They are omnivorous, eating insects, snails, and vegetation.

american-crocodile.funFact: American crocodiles are more tolerant of saltwater than alligators, which is why they are found in coastal habitats.
american-crocodile.name: American Crocodile
american-crocodile.description: American Crocodile حيوان. The American crocodile is found in the coastal regions of the Americas, from southern Florida to northern South America. It is less aggressive than the saltwater crocodile and prefers brackish and saltwater habitats. It is lighter in color than most crocodiles.

asian-water-monitor.funFact: Asian water monitors are excellent swimmers and can hold their breath for up to 30 minutes.
asian-water-monitor.name: Asian Water Monitor
asian-water-monitor.description: Asian Water Monitor حيوان. The Asian water monitor is a large lizard native to Southeast Asia, commonly found near water. It is an opportunistic carnivore feeding on fish, frogs, birds, and carrion. It is one of the most common monitor lizards in the world.

eastern-hognose-snake.funFact: Hognose snakes are famous for playing dead when threatened, rolling onto their backs with their mouths open.
eastern-hognose-snake.name: Eastern Hognose Snake
eastern-hognose-snake.description: Eastern Hognose Snake حيوان. The eastern hognose snake is a non-venomous colubrid found across eastern North America. It has an upturned snout used for burrowing. When threatened, it may flatten its neck like a cobra or play dead with theatrical drama.

sailfin-lizard.funFact: Sailfin lizards can run across the surface of water for short distances using their flattened, fringed toes.
sailfin-lizard.name: Sailfin Lizard
sailfin-lizard.description: Sailfin Lizard حيوان. The sailfin lizard is a semi-aquatic agamid lizard found in the Philippines and Indonesia. Males have large dorsal crests that resemble sails. They are often found near water and can run bipedally across water surfaces when startled.

texas-rat-snake.funFact: Texas rat snakes are excellent climbers and have been found in trees more than 40 feet high.
texas-rat-snake.name: Texas Rat Snake
texas-rat-snake.description: Texas Rat Snake حيوان. The Texas rat snake is a large, non-venomous colubrid native to Texas and the south-central United States. It is a powerful constrictor that feeds primarily on rodents. It is highly adaptable and found in a wide range of habitats.

gopher-tortoise.funFact: Gopher tortoise burrows can be over 40 feet long and provide shelter for more than 350 other species.
gopher-tortoise.name: Gopher Tortoise
gopher-tortoise.description: Gopher Tortoise حيوان. The gopher tortoise is a keystone species of the southeastern United States, known for digging extensive burrows. These burrows provide critical shelter for over 350 other species, including the eastern indigo snake. It is a slow-moving herbivore.

bush-viper.funFact: Bush vipers have keeled, leaf-like scales that give them a spiky, dragon-like appearance unique among snakes.
bush-viper.name: Bush Viper
bush-viper.description: Bush Viper حيوان. The bush viper is a venomous, arboreal viper found in the tropical rainforests of equatorial Africa. It has distinctive leaf-shaped, keeled scales in various colors. It is nocturnal and uses its prehensile tail to hang from branches while hunting.

pancake-tortoise.funFact: Pancake tortoises have flat, flexible shells that allow them to wedge themselves into rock crevices to escape predators.
pancake-tortoise.name: Pancake Tortoise
pancake-tortoise.description: Pancake Tortoise حيوان. The pancake tortoise is a critically endangered species with a uniquely flat, flexible shell. Found in the rocky outcrops of East Africa, it wedges itself into crevices when threatened. It is one of the fastest tortoise species relative to its size.

cottonmouth.funFact: Cottonmouths get their name from the white, cotton-like lining of their mouth, which they display as a warning.
cottonmouth.name: Cottonmouth
cottonmouth.description: Cottonmouth حيوان. The cottonmouth, or water moccasin, is a venomous pit viper found in the wetlands of the southeastern United States. It is the only venomous water snake in North America. It is often found swimming with its head above water.

cuban-crocodile.funFact: Cuban crocodiles are the most terrestrial of the New World crocodiles and can gallop like a horse.
cuban-crocodile.name: Cuban Crocodile
cuban-crocodile.description: Cuban Crocodile حيوان. The Cuban crocodile is a critically endangered species found only in the Zapata Swamp and Isle of Youth in Cuba. It is highly aggressive and more terrestrial than other crocodiles. It can gallop on land and is known for its distinctive horned ridges.

bearded-dragon.name: Central Bearded Dragon
bearded-dragon.description: Central Bearded Dragon حيوان. The central bearded dragon is a popular pet lizard native to the arid regions of central Australia. It displays a darkened beard when threatened or during social interactions. It basks on rocks and branches, absorbing heat to regulate its body temperature.

yellow-bellied-slider.funFact: Yellow-bellied sliders can bask on logs for hours, using the sun to regulate their body temperature and digest food.
yellow-bellied-slider.name: Yellow-Bellied Slider
yellow-bellied-slider.description: Yellow-Bellied Slider حيوان. The yellow-bellied slider is a semi-aquatic turtle native to the southeastern United States. It has a dark shell with yellow stripes and a distinctive yellow patch on its plastron. It is one of the most common turtle species in pet trade.

western-diamondback-rattlesnake.funFact: Western diamondback rattlesnakes add a new segment to their rattle each time they shed their skin.
western-diamondback-rattlesnake.name: Western Diamondback Rattlesnake
western-diamondback-rattlesnake.description: Western Diamondback Rattlesnake حيوان. The western diamondback rattlesnake is one of the most dangerous snakes in North America. Found across the southwestern United States and Mexico, it is responsible for the majority of snakebite fatalities in the region. Its rattle serves as a warning when threatened.

caiman-lizard.funFact: Caiman lizards have powerful jaws and thick, armored scales that resemble those of caiman crocodilians.
caiman-lizard.name: Caiman Lizard
caiman-lizard.description: Caiman Lizard حيوان. The caiman lizard is a semi-aquatic lizard found in the swamps and rivers of South America. It has a flattened tail for swimming and powerful jaws for crushing snail shells. Its skin resembles that of a caiman, hence its name.

nile-crocodile.name: Nile Crocodile
nile-crocodile.description: Nile Crocodile حيوان. The Nile crocodile is one of the largest crocodilian species and is considered the most dangerous to humans. Found throughout sub-Saharan Africa, it is an apex predator of rivers and lakes. It can go months without eating and has the most powerful bite of any living animal.

carpet-python.funFact: Carpet pythons are nocturnal hunters that use heat-sensing pits to detect warm-blooded prey in total darkness.
carpet-python.name: Carpet Python
carpet-python.description: Carpet Python حيوان. The carpet python is a large, non-venomous snake found across Australia and New Guinea. It has a variable pattern of dark bands on a lighter background. It is arboreal and commonly found in trees and on the roofs of houses.

brown-basilisk.funFact: Brown basilisks can run across water using their long toes and fringed scales, earning them the nickname 'Jesus Christ lizard'.
brown-basilisk.name: Brown Basilisk
brown-basilisk.description: Brown Basilisk حيوان. The brown basilisk is a large lizard found in the tropical rainforests of Central America. It has a distinctive crest on its head and can run bipedally across water. It is semi-arboreal and often found near streams and rivers.

dumerils-boa.funFact: Dumeril's boa can reduce its metabolic rate to survive extended periods without food, going months between meals.
dumerils-boa.name: Dumeril's Boa
dumerils-boa.description: Dumeril's Boa حيوان. Dumeril's boa is a heavy-bodied, non-venomous snake endemic to Madagascar. It has a tan and brown pattern that provides excellent camouflage on the forest floor. It is a ground-dwelling ambush predator feeding on mammals and birds.

sulcata-tortoise.name: African Spurred Tortoise
sulcata-tortoise.description: African Spurred Tortoise حيوان. The African spurred tortoise is the third-largest tortoise species in the world, native to the Sahel region of Africa. It is named for the large, pointed spurs on its legs. It digs deep burrows to escape desert temperatures.

common-caiman.funFact: Common caimans have a bony ridge between their eyes that acts like a built-in pair of sunglasses in bright sunlight.
common-caiman.name: Common Caiman
common-caiman.description: Common Caiman حيوان. The common caiman is a medium-sized crocodilian found throughout Central and South America. It is one of the most widespread crocodilian species. It feeds primarily on fish and invertebrates and is often found in large groups basking on riverbanks.

western-hognose-snake.funFact: Western hognose snakes flatten their heads and hiss loudly when threatened, but their bluff rarely escalates to biting.
western-hognose-snake.name: Western Hognose Snake
western-hognose-snake.description: Western Hognose Snake حيوان. The western hognose snake is a small, non-venomous snake with an upturned snout used for burrowing. Found in the sandy prairies of central North America, it is known for its dramatic threat display. It feeds primarily on toads and small rodents.

forest-cobra.funFact: The forest cobra is the largest true cobra species and an excellent swimmer, often found near water.
forest-cobra.name: Forest Cobra
forest-cobra.description: Forest Cobra حيوان. The forest cobra is the largest cobra species, found in the tropical forests and savannas of central and western Africa. It is highly venomous and can spit venom accurately. It is a strong swimmer and often found near bodies of water.

veiled-chameleon.funFact: Male veiled chameleons have a tall casque on their heads that may help channel dew drops into their mouths.
veiled-chameleon.name: Veiled Chameleon
veiled-chameleon.description: Veiled Chameleon حيوان. The veiled chameleon is one of the most popular pet chameleon species, native to Yemen and Saudi Arabia. Males have a distinctive tall casque on their heads. It is an arboreal species that feeds on insects by projecting its long, sticky tongue.

rough-scaled-sand-boa.funFact: Sand boas spend most of their lives buried underground, with only their eyes and snout visible above the sand.
rough-scaled-sand-boa.name: Rough-Scaled Sand Boa
rough-scaled-sand-boa.description: Rough-Scaled Sand Boa حيوان. The rough-scaled sand boa is a small, non-venomous constrictor found in the arid deserts of South Asia. It has a stout body adapted for burrowing and spends most of its time beneath the sand. It feeds primarily on rodents and small lizards.

philippine-crocodile.funFact: The Philippine crocodile is the most endangered crocodilian in the world, with fewer than 100 left in the wild.
philippine-crocodile.name: Philippine Crocodile
philippine-crocodile.description: Philippine Crocodile حيوان. The Philippine crocodile is a critically endangered species endemic to the Philippines. It is the most endangered crocodilian in the world, with a wild population estimated at fewer than 100 individuals. It inhabits freshwater rivers, lakes, and marshes.

rainbow-boa.funFact: Rainbow boas have iridescent scales that refract light, creating a stunning rainbow shimmer in the sun.
rainbow-boa.name: Rainbow Boa
rainbow-boa.description: Rainbow Boa حيوان. The rainbow boa is a non-venomous constrictor found in the rainforests of South America. Its name comes from the iridescent sheen of its scales, which refract light to create a rainbow effect. It is a terrestrial species found on the forest floor.

giant-plated-lizard.funFact: Giant plated lizards wedge themselves into rock crevices and inflate their bodies, making them nearly impossible to extract.
giant-plated-lizard.name: Giant Plated Lizard
giant-plated-lizard.description: Giant Plated Lizard حيوان. The giant plated lizard is a large, robust lizard found in the rocky outcrops of southern and eastern Africa. It has heavy, plate-like scales and a powerful tail. It is semi-arboreal and feeds on insects, small vertebrates, and fruit.

black-spiny-tailed-iguana.funFact: The black spiny-tailed iguana is the fastest lizard in the world, capable of running at 21 mph.
black-spiny-tailed-iguana.name: Black Spiny-Tailed Iguana
black-spiny-tailed-iguana.description: Black Spiny-Tailed Iguana حيوان. The black spiny-tailed iguana is the fastest lizard in the world, reaching speeds of 21 mph. Native to Central America, it is found on rocky cliffs, walls, and in urban areas. It is an omnivorous species that feeds on plants and small animals.

burmese-python.funFact: Burmese pythons are one of the largest snake species and have become a destructive invasive species in the Florida Everglades.
burmese-python.name: Burmese Python
burmese-python.description: Burmese Python حيوان. The Burmese python is one of the five largest snakes in the world, native to Southeast Asia. It is a popular pet species but has become a significant invasive species in the Florida Everglades. It is a powerful constrictor that feeds on mammals and birds.

ornate-box-turtle.funFact: Ornate box turtles can completely seal their hinged plastron shut, trapping themselves inside their shell for protection.
ornate-box-turtle.name: Ornate Box Turtle
ornate-box-turtle.description: Ornate Box Turtle حيوان. The ornate box turtle is a small, terrestrial turtle native to the prairies of central North America. It has a domed shell with intricate yellow and orange patterns. It can fully close its hinged plastron to protect itself from predators.

common-house-gecko.funFact: Common house geckos are one of the most widespread lizard species on Earth, found on every continent except Antarctica.
common-house-gecko.name: Common House Gecko
common-house-gecko.description: Common House Gecko حيوان. The common house gecko is a small, nocturnal lizard found throughout the tropical and subtropical regions of the world. It is commonly seen on walls and ceilings of buildings, hunting insects. Its toe pads allow it to climb smooth vertical surfaces.

sidewinder-rattlesnake.funFact: Sidewinders move using a unique S-shaped locomotion that minimizes contact with hot desert sand.
sidewinder-rattlesnake.name: Sidewinder Rattlesnake
sidewinder-rattlesnake.description: Sidewinder Rattlesnake حيوان. The sidewinder rattlesnake is a venomous pit viper adapted to desert life in the southwestern United States. It uses a distinctive sidewinding locomotion that leaves J-shaped tracks in the sand. It buries itself in sand to ambush prey and escape heat.

chinese-water-dragon.funFact: Chinese water dragons can drop from heights of 40 feet and land safely on branches below.
chinese-water-dragon.name: Chinese Water Dragon
chinese-water-dragon.description: Chinese Water Dragon حيوان. The Chinese water dragon is an arboreal agamid lizard found near streams in the forests of southeastern China. Males display vibrant green with white and orange markings. It is an excellent swimmer and can hold its breath for up to an hour.

west-african-dwarf-crocodile.funFact: West African dwarf crocodiles are the most terrestrial of all crocodilians and dig deep burrows to rest in during the day.
west-african-dwarf-crocodile.name: West African Dwarf Crocodile
west-african-dwarf-crocodile.description: West African Dwarf Crocodile حيوان. The West African dwarf crocodile is the smallest living crocodile species, found in the swamps and rivers of western and central Africa. It is nocturnal and highly terrestrial, digging burrows for shelter. It feeds primarily on fish, crustaceans, and insects.

cape-cobra.funFact: Cape cobras are highly venomous and are responsible for the most snakebite deaths in southern Africa.
cape-cobra.name: Cape Cobra
cape-cobra.description: Cape Cobra حيوان. The Cape cobra is one of the most dangerous cobras in Africa, found in the shrublands and fynbos of southern Africa. It is highly venomous with potent neurotoxin. It is a diurnal species and an excellent climber.

crested-iguana.funFact: Crested iguanas can change color from green to black based on temperature and social context.
crested-iguana.name: Crested Iguana
crested-iguana.description: Crested Iguana حيوان. The crested iguana is a critically endangered species endemic to the dry forests of western Madagascar. It has a distinctive high dorsal crest and is one of the rarest iguanas in the world. It is primarily herbivorous, feeding on leaves and fruit.

argentine-tegu.funFact: Argentine tegus can regulate their body temperature during the reproductive season without relying solely on external heat.
argentine-tegu.name: Argentine Black and White Tegu
argentine-tegu.description: Argentine Black and White Tegu حيوان. The Argentine black and white tegu is a large, omnivorous lizard native to South America. It has distinctive black and white banding and a robust body. It feeds on a wide variety of foods including insects, small animals, fruit, and eggs.

king-brown-snake.funFact: The king brown snake is technically a black snake, not a brown snake, and is in the genus Pseudechis.
king-brown-snake.name: King Brown Snake
king-brown-snake.description: King Brown Snake حيوان. The king brown snake, also known as the mulga snake, is one of Australia's most widespread and dangerous snakes. Despite its name, it belongs to the black snake genus Pseudechis. It is responsible for more snakebite deaths in Australia than any other species.

false-gharial.funFact: The false gharial has a narrow snout similar to the true gharial but is not closely related to it.
false-gharial.name: False Gharial
false-gharial.description: False Gharial حيوان. The false gharial is a critically endangered crocodilian found in the rivers and swamps of Southeast Asia. It has a distinctive long, narrow snout and is one of the largest crocodilian species. It is a specialist fish-eater with a unique jaw structure.

indian-star-tortoise.funFact: Indian star tortoises have star-shaped patterns on their shells that help with camouflage and thermoregulation.
indian-star-tortoise.name: Indian Star Tortoise
indian-star-tortoise.description: Indian Star Tortoise حيوان. The Indian star tortoise is a small to medium-sized tortoise native to India and Sri Lanka. It has distinctive star-shaped patterns on its carapace that radiate from the center of each scute. It is a popular species in the illegal pet trade.

green-anaconda.funFact: The green anaconda is the heaviest snake in the world, with some individuals weighing over 220 pounds.
green-anaconda.name: Green Anaconda
green-anaconda.description: Green Anaconda حيوان. The green anaconda is the heaviest and one of the longest snakes in the world, found in the swamps and rivers of South America. It is a non-venomous constrictor that feeds on deer, capybaras, and even jaguars. It spends most of its time in water.

tuatara.funFact: Tuatara are the last surviving members of an order of reptiles that lived alongside dinosaurs over 200 million years ago.
tuatara.name: Tuatara
tuatara.description: Tuatara حيوان. The tuatara is a reptile endemic to New Zealand and the only surviving member of the order Rhynchocephalia. Often called a living fossil, it has remained virtually unchanged for 200 million years. It has a third eye on top of its head that detects light changes.

eastern-water-dragon.funFact: Eastern water dragons can swim underwater for up to 90 minutes, closing a special membrane to keep water out of their eyes.
eastern-water-dragon.name: Eastern Water Dragon
eastern-water-dragon.description: Eastern Water Dragon حيوان. The eastern water dragon is a large agamid lizard found along rivers and creeks in eastern Australia. Males have a distinctive red chest and a spiny crest along their back. It is semi-aquatic and an excellent swimmer.

spider-tortoise.funFact: Spider tortoises are named for the radiating yellow lines on their shells that resemble a spider's web.
spider-tortoise.name: Spider Tortoise
spider-tortoise.description: Spider Tortoise حيوان. The spider tortoise is a critically endangered species endemic to the dry spiny forests of southern Madagascar. It has distinctive yellow radiating patterns on its dark shell that resemble a spider's web. It is one of the smallest tortoise species in the world.

russian-tortoise.funFact: Russian tortoises can survive extreme temperatures by brumating underground for up to 6 months during harsh winters.
russian-tortoise.name: Russian Tortoise
russian-tortoise.description: Russian Tortoise حيوان. The Russian tortoise is a small species native to the arid steppes of Central Asia. It is one of the most cold-tolerant tortoise species, surviving harsh winters by brumating underground. It is popular in the pet trade due to its small size and hardy nature.

cat-eyed-snake.funFact: Cat-eyed snakes have vertical pupils like cats, giving them excellent night vision for hunting in the dark rainforest.
cat-eyed-snake.name: Cat-Eyed Snake
cat-eyed-snake.description: Cat-Eyed Snake حيوان. The cat-eyed snake is a small, rear-fanged snake found in the tropical rainforests of Central and South America. It has distinctive vertical pupils and is primarily nocturnal. It feeds on frogs, lizards, and small mammals.

arabian-chameleon.funFact: Arabian chameleons are one of the few chameleon species adapted to live in hot, arid desert conditions.
arabian-chameleon.name: Arabian Chameleon
arabian-chameleon.description: Arabian Chameleon حيوان. The Arabian chameleon is a species of chameleon native to the Arabian Peninsula. It is adapted to arid conditions, unlike most chameleon species. It has a casque on its head and can change color for communication and thermoregulation.

spotted-turtle.funFact: Spotted turtles have yellow spots on their dark shells that become more numerous with age, like counting tree rings.
spotted-turtle.name: Spotted Turtle
spotted-turtle.description: Spotted Turtle حيوان. The spotted turtle is one of the smallest turtles in North America, found in shallow, slow-moving waters. It has a smooth, dark shell with distinctive yellow or orange spots. It is a long-lived species that can survive for over a century.

banded-krait.funFact: Banded kraits are twice as venomous as cobras and often cannibalize other snakes, including other kraits.
banded-krait.name: Banded Krait
banded-krait.description: Banded Krait حيوان. The banded krait is a highly venomous elapid found in South and Southeast Asia. It has distinctive black and yellow bands and is primarily nocturnal. It feeds on other snakes, including venomous species, and is responsible for many snakebite deaths in Asia.

golden-skink.funFact: Golden skinks have a metallic, iridescent sheen that makes them look like they are coated in gold.
golden-skink.name: Golden Skink
golden-skink.description: Golden Skink حيوان. The golden skink is a small, fast-moving lizard found in tropical forests and gardens across South and Southeast Asia. It has a metallic, iridescent body that gives it a golden appearance. It is diurnal and feeds on insects and small invertebrates.

broad-snouted-caiman.funFact: Broad-snouted caimans build mounds of vegetation to incubate their eggs, using decomposition heat to warm them.
broad-snouted-caiman.name: Broad-Snouted Caiman
broad-snouted-caiman.description: Broad-Snouted Caiman حيوان. The broad-snouted caiman is a medium-sized crocodilian found in the freshwater habitats of South America. It has a broad, flat snout adapted for catching fish and invertebrates. It builds vegetation mounds to incubate its eggs.

copperhead.funFact: Copperheads account for the majority of venomous snakebites in the United States, though their venom is rarely fatal.
copperhead.name: Copperhead
copperhead.description: Copperhead حيوان. The copperhead is a venomous pit viper found across the eastern United States. It has a distinctive copper-colored head and hourglass-shaped crossbands. It is responsible for the most snakebite cases in North America, though fatalities are rare.

radiated-tortoise.funFact: Radiated tortoises can live for over 100 years, with some individuals reportedly reaching 188 years of age.
radiated-tortoise.name: Radiated Tortoise
radiated-tortoise.description: Radiated Tortoise حيوان. The radiated tortoise is a critically endangered species endemic to Madagascar. It has a high-domed shell with striking yellow star-shaped patterns radiating from the center of each scute. It is threatened by habitat loss and poaching for food and the pet trade.

blue-racer.funFact: Blue racers are one of the fastest snakes in North America, capable of speeds up to 10 mph.
blue-racer.name: Blue Racer
blue-racer.description: Blue Racer حيوان. The blue racer is a fast-moving, non-venomous colubrid found across the central United States and southern Ontario. It has a distinctive blue-grey dorsal color and a white or cream underside. It is diurnal and feeds on rodents, frogs, and other snakes.

side-blotched-lizard.funFact: Male side-blotched lizards use a rock-paper-scissors strategy with three throat colors to compete for mates.
side-blotched-lizard.name: Side-Blotched Lizard
side-blotched-lizard.description: Side-Blotched Lizard حيوان. The side-blotched lizard is a small lizard found in the deserts and grasslands of western North America. It is famous in evolutionary biology for its rock-paper-scissors mating strategy. Males have three throat colors that correspond to different mating tactics.

nile-monitor.funFact: Nile monitors are excellent swimmers and can hold their breath for up to an hour while submerged underwater.
nile-monitor.name: Nile Monitor
nile-monitor.description: Nile Monitor حيوان. The Nile monitor is a large, powerful lizard found throughout sub-Saharan Africa near water. It is semi-aquatic and feeds on fish, frogs, birds, eggs, and carrion. It has a forked tongue used for detecting prey in the water.

canebrake-rattlesnake.funFact: Canebrake rattlesnakes have a silent rattle compared to other rattlesnake species, often delivering strikes without warning.
canebrake-rattlesnake.name: Canebrake Rattlesnake
canebrake-rattlesnake.description: Canebrake Rattlesnake حيوان. The canebrake rattlesnake, a subspecies of the timber rattlesnake, is found in the forests and swamps of the southeastern United States. It has a distinctive pinkish-brown color with dark crossbands. It is a dangerous venomous pit viper.

yellow-footed-tortoise.funFact: Yellow-footed tortoises play a crucial role in seed dispersal in the Amazon, helping to regenerate the rainforest.
yellow-footed-tortoise.name: Yellow-Footed Tortoise
yellow-footed-tortoise.description: Yellow-Footed Tortoise حيوان. The yellow-footed tortoise is a medium-sized tortoise native to the Amazon Basin of South America. It has distinctive yellow or orange scales on its legs and head. It feeds primarily on fallen fruit and plays an important ecological role in seed dispersal.

puff-adder.funFact: Puff adders are responsible for more snakebite deaths in Africa than any other snake due to their excellent camouflage.
puff-adder.name: Puff Adder
puff-adder.description: Puff Adder حيوان. The puff adder is a venomous viper found throughout sub-Saharan Africa. It relies on its excellent camouflage and will not flee when approached, leading to many defensive strikes. It is an ambush predator that strikes with incredible speed.

eastern-green-mamba.funFact: Eastern green mambas are arboreal and rarely descend to the ground, spending their lives in the forest canopy.
eastern-green-mamba.name: Eastern Green Mamba
eastern-green-mamba.description: Eastern Green Mamba حيوان. The eastern green mamba is a fast, highly venomous elapid found in the coastal forests of eastern and southern Africa. It is bright green, blending perfectly with the forest canopy. Unlike the black mamba, it is arboreal and rarely comes to the ground.

cape-dwarf-chameleon.funFact: Cape dwarf chameleons have independently moving eyes that can rotate 180 degrees, giving them a 360-degree field of vision.
cape-dwarf-chameleon.name: Cape Dwarf Chameleon
cape-dwarf-chameleon.description: Cape Dwarf Chameleon حيوان. The Cape dwarf chameleon is a small chameleon endemic to the Western Cape of South Africa. It has independently rotating eyes, a prehensile tail, and a long, sticky tongue for catching insects. It can change color for communication and thermoregulation.

chinese-alligator.funFact: Chinese alligators are the most endangered crocodilian species, with fewer than 150 individuals remaining in the wild.
chinese-alligator.name: Chinese Alligator
chinese-alligator.description: Chinese Alligator حيوان. The Chinese alligator is a critically endangered species, one of only two alligator species in the world. Found in eastern China, it is smaller than the American alligator and has bony plates on its eyelids. Wild populations are critically low.

snouted-cobra.funFact: Snouted cobras can spit venom accurately up to 2 meters, aiming for the eyes of perceived threats.
snouted-cobra.name: Snouted Cobra
snouted-cobra.description: Snouted Cobra حيوان. The snouted cobra is a large, highly venomous snake found across southern Africa. It has a distinctive upturned snout and can spit venom accurately. It is found in a wide variety of habitats and feeds on rodents, birds, and other snakes.

common-wall-lizard.funFact: Common wall lizards have been introduced to North America from Europe and are now thriving in cities like Toronto and Vancouver.
common-wall-lizard.name: Common Wall Lizard
common-wall-lizard.description: Common Wall Lizard حيوان. The common wall lizard is a small, agile lizard found across Europe and introduced to North America. It is commonly seen basking on stone walls and buildings. It feeds on insects, spiders, and small invertebrates.

brown-tree-snake.funFact: The brown tree snake has driven at least 10 bird species to extinction on Guam after accidentally introduced there.
brown-tree-snake.name: Brown Tree Snake
brown-tree-snake.description: Brown Tree Snake حيوان. The brown tree snake is an arboreal, rear-fanged snake native to Australia and New Guinea. It has become one of the world's most destructive invasive species on Guam, where it has eliminated most of the island's native bird species. It is nocturnal and feeds on birds, lizards, and mammals.

angulate-tortoise.funFact: Angulate tortoises are the most southerly distributed tortoise species in Africa, found even in the cool, wet Western Cape.
angulate-tortoise.name: Angulate Tortoise
angulate-tortoise.description: Angulate Tortoise حيوان. The angulate tortoise is a small tortoise found in the fynbos and karoo shrublands of southern Africa. It has a distinctive upturned front margin to its shell. It is well adapted to the Mediterranean climate of the Western Cape region.

savannah-monitor.funFact: Savannah monitors can slow their metabolism so much that they can survive on as few as three large meals per year.
savannah-monitor.name: Savannah Monitor
savannah-monitor.description: Savannah Monitor حيوان. The savannah monitor is a medium-sized monitor lizard found across sub-Saharan Africa. It is a ground-dwelling species that digs burrows for shelter. It feeds on insects, small mammals, and reptiles, and is popular in the exotic pet trade.

white-lipped-pit-viper.funFact: White-lipped pit vipers have heat-sensing pits between their eyes and nostrils that detect warm-blooded prey in complete darkness.
white-lipped-pit-viper.name: White-Lipped Pit Viper
white-lipped-pit-viper.description: White-Lipped Pit Viper حيوان. The white-lipped pit viper is a venomous snake found in the tropical rainforests of Southeast Asia. It has a distinctive white or yellow line along its upper lip and is primarily arboreal. It is a nocturnal ambush predator that feeds on rodents and birds.

alabama-red-bellied-cooter.funFact: Alabama red-bellied cooters can bask for hours, using the sun to synthesize vitamin D3 for shell health.
alabama-red-bellied-cooter.name: Alabama Red-Bellied Cooter
alabama-red-bellied-cooter.description: Alabama Red-Bellied Cooter حيوان. The Alabama red-bellied cooter is an endangered freshwater turtle endemic to Alabama and Georgia. It has a dark shell with a distinctive red or orange plastron. It is found in rivers, lakes, and ponds with abundant aquatic vegetation.

amazon-tree-boa.funFact: Amazon tree boas are incredibly variable in color and pattern, with no two individuals looking exactly alike.
amazon-tree-boa.name: Amazon Tree Boa
amazon-tree-boa.description: Amazon Tree Boa حيوان. The Amazon tree boa is a small, arboreal constrictor found throughout the Amazon rainforest. It is nocturnal and feeds on birds and small mammals. It has an extremely variable color pattern, ranging from yellow to red to brown.

california-kingsnake.funFact: California kingsnakes are immune to rattlesnake venom and regularly prey upon rattlesnakes in the wild.
california-kingsnake.name: California Kingsnake
california-kingsnake.description: California Kingsnake حيوان. The California kingsnake is a popular, non-venomous constrictor found across the western United States. It has a banded pattern of brown and white or yellow. It is an opportunistic feeder that readily eats rattlesnakes, making it beneficial to humans.

clouded-monitor.funFact: Clouded monitors are arboreal and have sharp claws that allow them to climb vertical tree trunks with ease.
clouded-monitor.name: Clouded Monitor
clouded-monitor.description: Clouded Monitor حيوان. The clouded monitor is a medium-sized monitor lizard found in the tropical rainforests of Southeast Asia. It is arboreal and has a long, slender body adapted for climbing. It feeds on insects, small mammals, and birds.

brazilian-rainbow-boa.funFact: Brazilian rainbow boas have iridescent scales that create a holographic rainbow effect when exposed to light.
brazilian-rainbow-boa.name: Brazilian Rainbow Boa
brazilian-rainbow-boa.description: Brazilian Rainbow Boa حيوان. The Brazilian rainbow boa is a medium-sized, non-venomous constrictor found in the rainforests of South America. Its name comes from the stunning iridescent sheen of its scales. It is primarily terrestrial and feeds on rodents, birds, and bats.

northern-cuirassated-lizard.funFact: Northern cuirassated lizards have bony armor plates called osteoderms that provide protection from predators.
northern-cuirassated-lizard.name: Northern Cuirassated Lizard
northern-cuirassated-lizard.description: Northern Cuirassated Lizard حيوان. The northern cuirassated lizard is a small lizard found in the rocky hillsides of Mexico. It has distinctive bony armor plates called osteoderms covering its body. It is diurnal and feeds on insects and small invertebrates.

desert-iguana.funFact: Desert iguanas can tolerate body temperatures up to 120°F, making them one of the most heat-tolerant lizards.
desert-iguana.name: Desert Iguana
desert-iguana.description: Desert Iguana حيوان. The desert iguana is a medium-sized lizard found in the deserts of the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico. It is one of the most heat-tolerant lizards, active at temperatures that force other reptiles to seek shade. It feeds primarily on leaves and flowers.

false-water-cobra.funFact: False water cobras flatten their necks like true cobras when threatened, despite being only mildly venomous.
false-water-cobra.name: False Water Cobra
false-water-cobra.description: False Water Cobra حيوان. The false water cobra is a large, semi-aquatic colubrid found in the wetlands of South America. It displays a cobra-like hood when threatened, despite being only mildly venomous. It is an excellent swimmer and feeds on fish, frogs, and small mammals.

garter-snake.name: Common Garter Snake
garter-snake.description: Common Garter Snake حيوان. The common garter snake is one of the most widespread snakes in North America, found in gardens, meadows, and woodlands. It has distinctive longitudinal stripes. Despite being mildly venomous, it is harmless to humans and beneficial as pest control.

shingleback-skink.funFact: Shingleback skinks mate for life and reunite with the same partner every breeding season.
shingleback-skink.name: Shingleback Skink
shingleback-skink.description: Shingleback Skink حيوان. The shingleback skink is a large, slow-moving lizard found in the woodlands and grasslands of southern Australia. It has rough, pinecone-like scales and a short, fat tail that resembles its head, confusing predators. It is one of the few reptile species that mate for life.

mozambique-spitting-cobra.funFact: Mozambique spitting cobras can spit venom accurately up to 3 meters, targeting the eyes of threats.
mozambique-spitting-cobra.name: Mozambique Spitting Cobra
mozambique-spitting-cobra.description: Mozambique Spitting Cobra حيوان. The Mozambique spitting cobra is a highly venomous elapid found across eastern and southern Africa. It is one of the most dangerous snakes in the region, responsible for many snakebite cases. It can spit venom accurately into the eyes of perceived threats.

american-bullfrog.funFact: American Bullfrogs can eat almost anything they can fit in their mouths, including other frogs, birds, and even snakes.
american-bullfrog.name: American Bullfrog
american-bullfrog.description: American Bullfrog حيوان. The American Bullfrog is the largest frog in North America. They are powerful swimmers and aggressive predators, known for their deep jug-o-rum calls that can be heard up to a mile away.

glass-frog.funFact: Glass Frogs have transparent abdominal skin that allows you to see their beating heart and internal organs.
glass-frog.name: Glass Frog
glass-frog.description: Glass Frog حيوان. Glass Frogs are remarkable amphibians with translucent ventral skin. Found in Central and South America, they spend most of their lives in trees and descend only to breed near fast-flowing streams.

pacman-frog.funFact: Pacman Frogs are named after the video game character due to their enormous mouths and round bodies.
pacman-frog.name: Pacman Frog
pacman-frog.description: Pacman Frog حيوان. The Pacman Frog, also known as the Argentine Horned Frog, is a popular pet species known for its large mouth and sedentary lifestyle. They are ambush predators that sit and wait for prey to pass by.

budgetts-frog.funFact: Budgett's Frogs inflate their bodies and scream when threatened to appear larger and more intimidating.
budgetts-frog.name: Budgett's Frog
budgetts-frog.description: Budgett's Frog حيوان. Budgett's Frog is a flattened, broad-bodied frog found in South America. They are known for their aggressive defensive behavior, including inflating, screaming, and biting when disturbed.

whites-tree-frog.funFact: White's Tree Frogs have fatty deposits above their eyes that look like eyebrows, giving them a perpetual smile.
whites-tree-frog.name: White's Tree Frog
whites-tree-frog.description: White's Tree Frog حيوان. White's Tree Frog, also known as the Dumpy Tree Frog, is one of the most docile and popular amphibian pets. Native to Australia and New Guinea, they are known for their placid temperament and ability to thrive in captivity.

african-dwarf-frog.funFact: African Dwarf Frogs are fully aquatic and spend their entire lives underwater, unlike most frogs.
african-dwarf-frog.name: African Dwarf Frog
african-dwarf-frog.description: African Dwarf Frog حيوان. African Dwarf Frogs are tiny, fully aquatic amphibians that never leave the water. They are social creatures that do best in groups and are popular aquarium pets due to their small size and active nature.

amazon-milk-frog.funFact: Amazon Milk Frogs secrete a milky white toxin when threatened and can change color from light to dark blue.
amazon-milk-frog.name: Amazon Milk Frog
