amazon-milk-frog.description: Amazon Milk Frog حيوان. The Amazon Milk Frog is a large tree frog found in the Amazon rainforest. They have a distinctive black and white or blue and white banded pattern and are named for the milky toxic substance they secrete.

gray-tree-frog.funFact: Gray Tree Frogs can change color from gray to green depending on their environment and activity level.
gray-tree-frog.name: Gray Tree Frog
gray-tree-frog.description: Gray Tree Frog حيوان. The Gray Tree Frog is a small, arboreal frog native to eastern North America. They have bumpy skin that resembles tree bark and bright yellow-orange patches on the inside of their hind legs.

spring-peeper.funFact: The Spring Peeper's high-pitched peeping call can be heard from over a mile away during breeding season.
spring-peeper.name: Spring Peeper
spring-peeper.description: Spring Peeper حيوان. Spring Peepers are tiny tree frogs whose chorus marks the arrival of spring in eastern North America. Their characteristic X-shaped marking on their back helps identify them among other small frogs.

wood-frog.funFact: Wood Frogs can survive being frozen solid, with up to 65% of their body water turning to ice.
wood-frog.name: Wood Frog
wood-frog.description: Wood Frog حيوان. Wood Frogs are remarkable for their ability to freeze during winter and thaw out alive in spring. Found across North America, they have a distinctive dark mask marking behind each eye.

american-toad.funFact: A single American Toad can eat up to 1,000 insects per day, making them excellent garden pest controllers.
american-toad.name: American Toad
american-toad.description: American Toad حيوان. The American Toad is one of the most common and widespread toads in North America. They have warty skin, parotoid glands that produce a mild toxin, and can live for over a decade in the wild.

cane-toad.funFact: Cane Toads were introduced to Australia in 1935 to control beetles but became one of the worst invasive species in the world.
cane-toad.name: Cane Toad
cane-toad.description: Cane Toad حيوان. The Cane Toad is a large, toxic toad native to Central and South America. It has become one of the most successful invasive amphibians, spreading across Australia, the Caribbean, and Pacific islands.

fire-bellied-toad.funFact: Fire-Bellied Toads display their bright orange-red bellies when threatened in a behavior called the unken reflex.
fire-bellied-toad.name: Fire-Bellied Toad
fire-bellied-toad.description: Fire-Bellied Toad حيوان. Fire-Bellied Toads are small, semi-aquatic toads with bumpy olive-green backs and vivid orange or red bellies. They are popular pets and are known for their aposematic coloration that warns predators of their toxins.

desert-rain-frog.funFact: Desert Rain Frogs let out a high-pitched squeak when threatened, sounding like a dog toy.
desert-rain-frog.name: Desert Rain Frog
desert-rain-frog.description: Desert Rain Frog حيوان. The Desert Rain Frog is a tiny, round frog that burrows into sand along the coast of South Africa and Namibia. They spend most of their lives underground and emerge only to feed and breed during foggy conditions.

goliath-frog.funFact: The Goliath Frog is the largest living frog in the world, weighing up to 7 pounds and spanning over a foot long.
goliath-frog.name: Goliath Frog
goliath-frog.description: Goliath Frog حيوان. The Goliath Frog, or Conraua goliath, is the world's largest frog. Found only in Cameroon and Equatorial Guinea, these massive amphibians inhabit fast-flowing rivers and are threatened by habitat loss and hunting.

mountain-chicken-frog.funFact: Despite their name, Mountain Chicken Frogs are not chickens but are called so because their leg meat tastes like chicken.
mountain-chicken-frog.name: Mountain Chicken Frog
mountain-chicken-frog.description: Mountain Chicken Frog حيوان. The Mountain Chicken Frog is one of the largest frogs in the Caribbean, found only on Dominica and Montserrat. They are critically endangered due to the chytrid fungus and habitat destruction.

spadefoot-toad.funFact: Spadefoot Toads can burrow underground and remain dormant for up to nine months, emerging only when it rains.
spadefoot-toad.name: Spadefoot Toad
spadefoot-toad.description: Spadefoot Toad حيوان. Spadefoot Toads are adapted to arid environments with specialized keratinized spades on their hind feet for burrowing. They spend most of their lives underground and breed explosively in temporary rain pools.

natterjack-toad.funFact: Natterjack Toads are one of the loudest European amphibians, with calls that can be heard over a mile away.
natterjack-toad.name: Natterjack Toad
natterjack-toad.description: Natterjack Toad حيوان. The Natterjack Toad is a medium-sized toad found across Europe. Unlike most toads, they run rather than hop and are known for their loud, rasping calls during breeding season.

midwife-toad.funFact: Male Midwife Toads carry the eggs wrapped around their hind legs until they are ready to hatch.
midwife-toad.name: Midwife Toad
midwife-toad.description: Midwife Toad حيوان. Midwife Toads are small, nocturnal toads named for the male's paternal behavior of carrying eggs on his hind legs. Found across Europe, they have a distinctive high-pitched beep-like call.

european-tree-frog.funFact: European Tree Frogs have adhesive toe pads that allow them to climb smooth surfaces, including glass.
european-tree-frog.name: European Tree Frog
european-tree-frog.description: European Tree Frog حيوان. The European Tree Frog is a small, bright green frog with a distinctive dark stripe along each side. They are excellent climbers and are often found in gardens, orchards, and damp woodlands.

leopard-frog.funFact: Leopard Frogs can jump up to 20 times their body length in a single leap.
leopard-frog.name: Leopard Frog
leopard-frog.description: Leopard Frog حيوان. The Leopard Frog gets its name from the distinctive dark spots covering its green or brown body. Found across North America, they are strong jumpers and swimmers that inhabit a variety of wetland habitats.

strawberry-poison-dart-frog.funFact: The Strawberry Poison Dart Frog has over 30 color morphs, ranging from red with blue legs to green with yellow spots.
strawberry-poison-dart-frog.name: Strawberry Poison Dart Frog
strawberry-poison-dart-frog.description: Strawberry Poison Dart Frog حيوان. The Strawberry Poison Dart Frog, also known as the Blue Jeans Frog, is a small but vividly colored amphibian found in Central America. Males carry tadpoles on their backs to suitable pools of water.

dyeing-poison-dart-frog.funFact: The Dyeing Poison Dart Frog was named because indigenous people used its toxins to dye fabric.
dyeing-poison-dart-frog.name: Dyeing Poison Dart Frog
dyeing-poison-dart-frog.description: Dyeing Poison Dart Frog حيوان. The Dyeing Poison Dart Frog is a variable species with striking color patterns. Found in South America, they were named for the use of their skin secretions by indigenous peoples to dye feathers and textiles.

harlequin-toad.funFact: Many Harlequin Toad species were thought to be extinct until small populations were rediscovered in recent years.
harlequin-toad.name: Harlequin Toad
harlequin-toad.description: Harlequin Toad حيوان. Harlequin Toads are a diverse group of brightly colored toads found in Central and South America. Many species are critically endangered or believed extinct due to the chytrid fungus and habitat loss.

pickerel-frog.funFact: Pickerel Frogs produce a toxin that can irritate human skin and is lethal to other frogs.
pickerel-frog.name: Pickerel Frog
pickerel-frog.description: Pickerel Frog حيوان. The Pickerel Frog is a brownish frog with two parallel rows of dark rectangular spots down its back. Found in eastern North America, they are one of the few frogs whose skin secretions are toxic to other amphibians.

cherry-tree-frog.funFact: Cherry Tree Frogs can change color from bright green to brown depending on their surroundings.
cherry-tree-frog.name: Cherry Tree Frog
cherry-tree-frog.description: Cherry Tree Frog حيوان. The Cherry Tree Frog is a small European tree frog known for its distinctive call that sounds like a cherry pit being clicked. They are excellent climbers with adhesive toe pads.

asian-common-toad.funFact: Asian Common Toads are extremely adaptable and thrive in human-modified environments across Southeast Asia.
asian-common-toad.name: Asian Common Toad
asian-common-toad.description: Asian Common Toad حيوان. The Asian Common Toad is a widespread toad found across South and Southeast Asia. They are highly adaptable to urban environments and are often found in gardens, drains, and agricultural areas.

clown-tree-frog.funFact: Clown Tree Frogs are named for their playful, acrobatic movements through the trees.
clown-tree-frog.name: Clown Tree Frog
clown-tree-frog.description: Clown Tree Frog حيوان. The Clown Tree Frog is a colorful, medium-sized tree frog found in the Amazon rainforest. They have striking patterns of brown, green, and cream that provide excellent camouflage against tree bark.

gliding-tree-frog.funFact: Gliding Tree Frogs can spread their enlarged toe pads and webbed feet to glide between trees.
gliding-tree-frog.name: Gliding Tree Frog
gliding-tree-frog.description: Gliding Tree Frog حيوان. The Gliding Tree Frog has evolved enlarged adhesive toe pads and partially webbed feet that allow it to glide through the rainforest canopy. Found in Central America, they are active at night.

black-legged-poison-frog.funFact: Black-Legged Poison Frogs exhibit biparental care, with both parents tending to their eggs and tadpoles.
black-legged-poison-frog.name: Black-Legged Poison Frog
black-legged-poison-frog.description: Black-Legged Poison Frog حيوان. The Black-Legged Poison Frog is a small, toxic frog found in the rainforests of Colombia. They are known for their complex parental care behaviors and striking black and yellow coloration.

red-backed-poison-frog.funFact: Red-Backed Poison Frogs use their bright coloration to warn predators of their skin toxins in a strategy called aposematism.
red-backed-poison-frog.name: Red-Backed Poison Frog
red-backed-poison-frog.description: Red-Backed Poison Frog حيوان. The Red-Backed Poison Frog is a small, brightly colored amphibian found in the Amazon rainforest. Their vivid red or orange back serves as a warning to potential predators.

splashback-poison-frog.funFact: Splashback Poison Frogs get their name from their colorful backs that look like paint splashes.
splashback-poison-frog.name: Splashback Poison Frog
splashback-poison-frog.description: Splashback Poison Frog حيوان. The Splashback Poison Frog is a small amphibian with vivid coloration that varies from green to blue to yellow. Found in South America, they carry tadpoles on their backs to water-filled bromeliads.

cane-turtle-frog.funFact: Cane Turtle Frogs have a flattened body shape that allows them to hide under rocks and logs.
cane-turtle-frog.name: Cane Turtle Frog
cane-turtle-frog.description: Cane Turtle Frog حيوان. The Cane Turtle Frog is a small, flattened frog found in South America. They are often found in agricultural areas, particularly sugarcane fields, and have a distinctive flattened appearance.

malaysian-horned-frog.funFact: Malaysian Horned Frogs have horn-like projections above their eyes that help break up their outline among leaf litter.
malaysian-horned-frog.name: Malaysian Horned Frog
malaysian-horned-frog.description: Malaysian Horned Frog حيوان. The Malaysian Horned Frog is a medium-sized frog with distinctive horn-like projections above each eye. Found in Southeast Asian rainforests, they are well-camouflaged among dead leaves on the forest floor.

hampire-poison-dart-frog.funFact: Hampire Poison Dart Frogs are named after the Harry Potter character due to their striking black and orange pattern.
hampire-poison-dart-frog.name: Hampire Poison Dart Frog
hampire-poison-dart-frog.description: Hampire Poison Dart Frog حيوان. The Hamphire Poison Dart Frog is a small, strikingly colored amphibian found in South America. Their bold pattern serves as a warning to predators of their toxic skin secretions.

brazilian-horned-frog.funFact: Brazilian Horned Frogs are ambush predators that can remain motionless for hours waiting for prey.
brazilian-horned-frog.name: Brazilian Horned Frog
brazilian-horned-frog.description: Brazilian Horned Frog حيوان. The Brazilian Horned Frog is a medium-sized frog with horn-like projections above its eyes. Found in the Amazon rainforest, they are well-camouflaged and lie in wait to ambush passing prey.

hairy-frog.funFact: Male Hairy Frogs grow hair-like skin projections during breeding season to help absorb oxygen from water.
hairy-frog.name: Hairy Frog
hairy-frog.description: Hairy Frog حيوان. The Hairy Frog, also known as the Trichobatrachus, is a unique amphibian found in Central Africa. Males develop hair-like dermal papillae on their flanks and thighs during the breeding season.

tomato-frog.funFact: Tomato Frogs secrete a thick, white substance that can glue a predator's mouth shut.
tomato-frog.name: Tomato Frog
tomato-frog.description: Tomato Frog حيوان. The Tomato Frog is a bright red-orange frog found in Madagascar. When threatened, they inflate their bodies and secrete a sticky white substance that can temporarily immobilize predators.

marsupial-frog.funFact: Female Marsupial Frogs carry their eggs in a pouch on their back, similar to marsupial mammals.
marsupial-frog.name: Marsupial Frog
marsupial-frog.description: Marsupial Frog حيوان. The Marsupial Frog is a remarkable amphibian found in the Andes mountains. Females have a dorsal pouch where they carry their eggs until they develop into froglets, bypassing the tadpole stage.

foam-nest-frog.funFact: Foam Nest Frogs create a frothy nest by beating their hind legs to whip up a foam that protects their eggs.
foam-nest-frog.name: Foam Nest Frog
foam-nest-frog.description: Foam Nest Frog حيوان. Foam Nest Frogs are found across Africa and South America. They are named for their unique breeding behavior where both sexes whip up a foam nest to protect their eggs from drying out.

surinam-toad.funFact: Female Surinam Toads have eggs embedded in the skin of their backs, where they develop into froglets.
surinam-toad.name: Surinam Toad
surinam-toad.description: Surinam Toad حيوان. The Surinam Toad is a flat, bottom-dwelling amphibian found in South America. Females have a remarkable reproductive strategy where eggs are embedded in the skin of their backs until they emerge as fully formed froglets.

tiger-salamander.funFact: Tiger Salamanders are one of the longest-lived amphibians, with some individuals living over 20 years in captivity.
tiger-salamander.name: Tiger Salamander
tiger-salamander.description: Tiger Salamander حيوان. The Tiger Salamander is the largest terrestrial salamander in North America. They have distinctive yellow or olive markings on a dark background and spend most of their lives underground in burrows.

eastern-newt.funFact: The juvenile Eastern Newt, called a red eft, is brightly colored to warn predators of its toxins.
eastern-newt.name: Eastern Newt
eastern-newt.description: Eastern Newt حيوان. The Eastern Newt has a complex life cycle with three distinct stages: aquatic larva, terrestrial red eft, and aquatic adult. Found in eastern North America, they produce tetrodotoxin in their skin.

hellbender.name: Hellbender
hellbender.description: Hellbender حيوان. The Hellbender is the largest salamander in North America, reaching up to two feet long. Found in clean, fast-flowing streams of the eastern United States, they are declining due to pollution and habitat loss.

olm.funFact: Olms can survive without food for up to 10 years and are among the longest-lived amphibians.
olm.name: Olm
olm.description: Olm حيوان. The Olm is a blind, cave-dwelling salamander found in the caves of southern Europe. It has no eyes, is depigmented, and can live for over 100 years, making it one of the longest-lived vertebrates.

fire-salamander.funFact: Fire Salamanders were once believed to be born from fire and could extinguish flames with their cold bodies.
fire-salamander.name: Fire Salamander
fire-salamander.description: Fire Salamander حيوان. The Fire Salamander is one of Europe's most recognizable amphibians with its striking black body and bright yellow or orange markings. Found in central and southern Europe, they secrete samandarin, a neurotoxin.

spotted-salamander.funFact: Spotted Salamanders have a symbiotic relationship with algae that lives inside their cells.
spotted-salamander.name: Spotted Salamander
spotted-salamander.description: Spotted Salamander حيوان. The Spotted Salamander is a large, robust salamander found in eastern North America. They have distinctive yellow spots on a dark background and are one of the few vertebrates known to have algae living inside their cells.

red-backed-salamander.funFact: Red-Backed Salamanders breathe entirely through their skin and have no lungs or gills as adults.
red-backed-salamander.name: Red-Backed Salamander
red-backed-salamander.description: Red-Backed Salamander حيوان. The Red-Backed Salamander is the most common and abundant salamander in eastern North America. They are entirely lungless, breathing through their moist skin, and come in both red-backed and lead-backed color phases.

mudpuppy.name: Mudpuppy
mudpuppy.description: Mudpuppy حيوان. The Mudpuppy is a fully aquatic salamander found in eastern North America. They retain their bushy red external gills throughout life and are nocturnal hunters that use sensory barbels to find prey.

rough-skinned-newt.funFact: Rough-Skinned Newts produce enough tetrodotoxin to kill several adult humans.
rough-skinned-newt.name: Rough-Skinned Newt
rough-skinned-newt.description: Rough-Skinned Newt حيوان. The Rough-Skinned Newt is a highly toxic amphibian found along the Pacific coast of North America. They produce tetrodotoxin, the same toxin found in pufferfish, and advertise their toxicity with bright orange undersides.

alpine-salamander.funFact: Alpine Salamanders are entirely viviparous, giving birth to fully developed young rather than laying eggs.
alpine-salamander.name: Alpine Salamander
alpine-salamander.description: Alpine Salamander حيوان. The Alpine Salamander is found in the mountains of central and southern Europe. Unlike most amphibians, they give birth to live young that have completed their development inside the mother's body.

great-crested-newt.funFact: Male Great Crested Newts develop a jagged crest along their back during breeding season.
great-crested-newt.name: Great Crested Newt
great-crested-newt.description: Great Crested Newt حيوان. The Great Crested Newt is the largest newt species in Europe. Males develop a distinctive crest during breeding season and have a white flash on their tail. They are legally protected in many countries.

marbled-salamander.funFact: Female Marbled Salamanders stay with their eggs and guard them until they hatch.
marbled-salamander.name: Marbled Salamander
marbled-salamander.description: Marbled Salamander حيوان. The Marbled Salamander is a small, stocky salamander with distinctive white or gray crossbands on a dark background. Found in eastern North America, they are one of the few salamanders that guard their eggs.

long-toed-salamander.funFact: Long-Toed Salamanders can have up to 13 toes on their hind feet, more than most salamanders.
long-toed-salamander.name: Long-Toed Salamander
long-toed-salamander.description: Long-Toed Salamander حيوان. The Long-Toed Salamander is a small salamander found across western North America. They have a characteristic stripe running down their back and long toes that give them their name.

slimy-salamander.funFact: Slimy Salamanders secrete a sticky, glue-like substance from their skin that is difficult to remove.
slimy-salamander.name: Slimy Salamander
slimy-salamander.description: Slimy Salamander حيوان. The Slimy Salamander is a medium-sized lungless salamander found in the eastern United States. They secrete a sticky white substance from their skin that helps deter predators.

red-salamander.funFact: Red Salamanders are one of the largest lungless salamanders in North America.
red-salamander.name: Red Salamander
red-salamander.description: Red Salamander حيوان. The Red Salamander is a brightly colored amphibian found in the Appalachian region of the eastern United States. Adults have a distinctive red to orange coloration with scattered black spots.

lesser-siren.funFact: Lesser Sirens can breathe through their gills and also through their skin, and can survive drying by burrowing into mud.
lesser-siren.name: Lesser Siren
lesser-siren.description: Lesser Siren حيوان. The Lesser Siren is a fully aquatic salamander with external gills found in the southeastern United States. They lack hind legs and can survive drought by burrowing into mud and entering a dormant state.

greater-siren.funFact: Greater Sirens are the largest species in the Sirenidae family and can exceed three feet in length.
greater-siren.name: Greater Siren
greater-siren.description: Greater Siren حيوان. The Greater Siren is a large, fully aquatic salamander with external gills found in the coastal plains of the southeastern United States. They lack hind limbs and can grow up to three feet long.

three-toed-amphiuma.funFact: Three-Toed Amphiumas have vestigial legs that are so small they are almost impossible to see.
three-toed-amphiuma.name: Three-Toed Amphiuma
three-toed-amphiuma.description: Three-Toed Amphiuma حيوان. The Three-Toed Amphiuma is a fully aquatic salamander found in the southeastern United States. It has an eel-like body with three tiny, non-functional toes on each vestigial limb.

waterdog.funFact: Waterdogs retain their external gills throughout their lives, a condition known as neoteny.
waterdog.name: Waterdog
waterdog.description: Waterdog حيوان. The Waterdog is a fully aquatic salamander found in eastern North America. Like the mudpuppy, it retains its external gills throughout life and is an important indicator of stream health.

spring-salamander.funFact: Spring Salamanders are one of the few salamander species that can live their entire lives in water.
spring-salamander.name: Spring Salamander
spring-salamander.description: Spring Salamander حيوان. The Spring Salamander is a large, robust salamander found in cold mountain streams of eastern North America. They have a distinctive salmon or orange coloration with dark reticulations.

cave-salamander.funFact: Cave Salamanders can climb vertical rock faces using their specialized toe pads.
cave-salamander.name: Cave Salamander
cave-salamander.description: Cave Salamander حيوان. The Cave Salamander is a brightly colored salamander with orange to red body and black spots. Found in caves and rocky areas of the eastern United States, they are excellent climbers.

arboreal-salamander.funFact: Arboreal Salamanders can climb trees and have prehensile tails for gripping branches.
arboreal-salamander.name: Arboreal Salamander
arboreal-salamander.description: Arboreal Salamander حيوان. The Arboreal Salamander is a lungless salamander found in the coastal mountains of California. They are excellent climbers, spending much of their time in oak trees and rock crevices.

ensatina.funFact: Ensatina salamanders form a ring species around California's Central Valley, with different subspecies at each end.
ensatina.name: Ensatina
ensatina.description: Ensatina حيوان. The Ensatina is a colorful salamander found along the Pacific coast of North America. They are famous in evolutionary biology as an example of a ring species, with different color morphs forming a circle around California's Central Valley.

slender-salamander.funFact: Slender Salamanders can coil into a tight spiral to conserve moisture.
slender-salamander.name: Slender Salamander
slender-salamander.description: Slender Salamander حيوان. The Slender Salamander is a small, lungless salamander found in California. They have long, thin bodies and can coil into a spiral when disturbed or to prevent water loss.

ringed-salamander.funFact: Ringed Salamanders migrate to breed during autumn rains, one of the few fall-breeding amphibians.
ringed-salamander.name: Ringed Salamander
ringed-salamander.description: Ringed Salamander حيوان. The Ringed Salamander is a large, dark salamander with yellow or white rings or spots. Found in the Ozark Plateau region of the United States, they are one of the few salamanders that breed in the fall.

flatwoods-salamander.funFact: Flatwoods Salamanders have a distinctive dark crossband pattern that helps them camouflage on the forest floor.
flatwoods-salamander.name: Flatwoods Salamander
flatwoods-salamander.description: Flatwoods Salamander حيوان. The Flatwoods Salamander is a small, threatened salamander found in the longleaf pine forests of the southeastern United States. They breed in temporary fishless ponds and are declining due to habitat loss.

dusky-salamander.funFact: Dusky Salamanders can autotomize their tails when threatened, which continue to wiggle and distract predators.
dusky-salamander.name: Dusky Salamander
dusky-salamander.description: Dusky Salamander حيوان. The Dusky Salamander is a medium-sized lungless salamander found in eastern North America. They are variable in color and pattern and are often found near streams and springs.

four-toed-salamander.funFact: Four-Toed Salamanders have only four toes on their hind feet, unlike most salamanders which have five.
four-toed-salamander.name: Four-Toed Salamander
four-toed-salamander.description: Four-Toed Salamander حيوان. The Four-Toed Salamander is a small salamander found in bogs and wetlands of eastern North America. They are the only salamander in their range with four toes on their hind feet.

gulf-coast-salamander.funFact: Gulf Coast Salamanders are one of the few salamander species that can tolerate slightly brackish water.
gulf-coast-salamander.name: Gulf Coast Salamander
gulf-coast-salamander.description: Gulf Coast Salamander حيوان. The Gulf Coast Salamander is a small salamander found in the coastal lowlands of the southeastern United States. They are often found in bottomland hardwood forests and can tolerate mildly saline conditions.

tropical-caecilian.funFact: Caecilians are often mistaken for snakes or worms, but they are actually limbless amphibians.
tropical-caecilian.name: Tropical Caecilian
tropical-caecilian.description: Tropical Caecilian حيوان. Tropical Caecilians are limbless, serpentine amphibians found in tropical regions of the world. They live underground or in leaf litter, feeding on small invertebrates, and are the least known order of amphibians.

boulengers-caecilian.funFact: Boulenger's Caecilians have minute vestigial eyes that can detect light but not form images.
boulengers-caecilian.name: Boulenger's Caecilian
boulengers-caecilian.description: Boulenger's Caecilian حيوان. Boulenger's Caecilian is one of the largest caecilian species, found in South America. These burrowing amphibians have ring-like grooves along their body and tiny, non-functional eyes buried beneath the skin.

ringed-caecilian.funFact: Ringed Caecilians have a unique sensory organ called a tentacle that helps them detect prey underground.
ringed-caecilian.name: Ringed Caecilian
ringed-caecilian.description: Ringed Caecilian حيوان. The Ringed Caecilian is a limbless amphibian found in South America and the Caribbean. They have a distinctive ring-like pattern on their body and use a chemosensory tentacle to find prey in the soil.

luna-moth.funFact: Luna moths do not have mouths and cannot eat as adults, living only on stored energy.
luna-moth.name: Luna Moth
luna-moth.description: Luna Moth حيوان. The luna moth is a large, pale green moth with long tail-like hindwings. It is nocturnal and attracted to light, and adults do not feed, dedicating their brief adult lives entirely to reproduction.

atlas-moth.funFact: The atlas moth is one of the largest insects in the world by wing area.
atlas-moth.name: Atlas Moth
atlas-moth.description: Atlas Moth حيوان. The atlas moth is the largest moth species, with a wingspan that can exceed 12 inches. Its wings have snake-head-shaped tips that deter predators, and like other giant moths, adults do not feed.

swallowtail-butterfly.funFact: Female swallowtails can mimic the toxic pipevine swallowtail to avoid predators.
swallowtail-butterfly.name: Eastern Tiger Swallowtail
swallowtail-butterfly.description: Eastern Tiger Swallowtail حيوان. The eastern tiger swallowtail is a large, bright yellow butterfly with distinctive black tiger stripes. It is one of the most common and recognizable butterflies in eastern North America.

hawk-moth.funFact: Hawk moths are among the fastest flying insects, capable of hovering like hummingbirds.
hawk-moth.name: Hawk Moth
hawk-moth.description: Hawk Moth حيوان. Hawk moths, also known as sphinx moths, are powerful fliers with streamlined bodies. Many species have extremely long proboscises for feeding on deep-throated flowers while hovering.

painted-lady-butterfly.funFact: Painted ladies migrate across the Sahara Desert and the Mediterranean Sea.
painted-lady-butterfly.name: Painted Lady Butterfly
painted-lady-butterfly.description: Painted Lady Butterfly حيوان. The painted lady is one of the most widespread butterflies on Earth, found on every continent except Antarctica. It is a strong migrant and a common visitor to gardens.

blue-morpho-butterfly.funFact: The morpho's blue color is not pigment but structural coloration from microscopic scales.
blue-morpho-butterfly.name: Blue Morpho Butterfly
blue-morpho-butterfly.description: Blue Morpho Butterfly حيوان. The blue morpho is a brilliantly iridescent blue butterfly found in tropical rainforests. Its metallic blue wings are visible from great distances and are produced by light diffraction rather than pigment.

glasswing-butterfly.funFact: The glasswing butterfly has nearly transparent wings due to nanopillar structures.
glasswing-butterfly.name: Glasswing Butterfly
glasswing-butterfly.description: Glasswing Butterfly حيوان. The glasswing butterfly has remarkably transparent wings with only a thin dark border. The transparency is caused by tiny nanopillar structures on the wings that prevent light reflection.

cecropia-moth.funFact: The cecropia moth is the largest native moth in North America.
cecropia-moth.name: Cecropia Moth
cecropia-moth.description: Cecropia Moth حيوان. The cecropia moth is North America's largest moth with wingspans reaching 7 inches. It has striking red, orange, and white markings and, like other giant moths, adults do not feed.

io-moth.funFact: Each wing of the io moth has a large, striking eyespot that deters predators.
io-moth.name: Io Moth
io-moth.description: Io Moth حيوان. The io moth is a beautiful silk moth with large eyespots on each wing. Males are yellow while females are reddish-brown, and both sexes flash their eyespots when threatened.

polyphemus-moth.funFact: The polyphemus moth is named after the one-eyed Greek giant Polyphemus.
polyphemus-moth.name: Polyphemus Moth
polyphemus-moth.description: Polyphemus Moth حيوان. The polyphemus moth is a large, tan-colored silk moth with distinctive eyespots on its hindwings. It is named after the Cyclops of Greek mythology due to the large eyespots.

viceroy-butterfly.funFact: Viceroys mimic the toxic monarch butterfly for protection from predators.
viceroy-butterfly.name: Viceroy Butterfly
viceroy-butterfly.description: Viceroy Butterfly حيوان. The viceroy butterfly closely resembles the monarch and was long thought to be a mimic. It is now known to be somewhat distasteful to predators, making it a Müllerian mimic.

red-admiral-butterfly.funFact: Red admirals are territorial and will chase other butterflies from their favorite basking spots.
red-admiral-butterfly.name: Red Admiral Butterfly
red-admiral-butterfly.description: Red Admiral Butterfly حيوان. The red admiral is a striking black butterfly with bold red-orange bands and white spots. It is a strong flier found worldwide and often visits rotting fruit and tree sap.

great-spangled-fritillary.funFact: Fritillary caterpillars feed exclusively on violets, which is how the group got its name.
great-spangled-fritillary.name: Great Spangled Fritillary
great-spangled-fritillary.description: Great Spangled Fritillary حيوان. The great spangled fritillary is a large, orange butterfly with distinctive silver-spotted underwings. Its larvae feed on various violet species while adults nectar on milkweed and coneflowers.

clouded-yellow-butterfly.funFact: Clouded yellows are strong migrants that can travel hundreds of miles.
clouded-yellow-butterfly.name: Clouded Yellow
clouded-yellow-butterfly.description: Clouded Yellow حيوان. The clouded yellow is a bright golden butterfly common across Europe and parts of Asia. It is a strong migratory species that sometimes appears in large numbers in areas outside its normal range.

comma-butterfly.funFact: The comma butterfly is named for the small white comma-shaped mark on its underwings.
comma-butterfly.name: Comma Butterfly
comma-butterfly.description: Comma Butterfly حيوان. The comma butterfly has uniquely ragged wing edges that help camouflage it as a dead leaf. It has a distinctive white comma-shaped mark on its dark brown underwings.

mourning-cloak-butterfly.funFact: The mourning cloak is one of the longest-lived butterflies and overwinters as an adult.
mourning-cloak-butterfly.name: Mourning Cloak Butterfly
mourning-cloak-butterfly.description: Mourning Cloak Butterfly حيوان. The mourning cloak is one of the longest-lived butterflies, surviving up to 11 months. It overwinters as an adult and is often the first butterfly seen in spring, with dark wings bordered in yellow.

zebra-longwing-butterfly.funFact: Zebra longwings are the state butterfly of Florida and can live on pollen alone.
zebra-longwing-butterfly.name: Zebra Longwing Butterfly
zebra-longwing-butterfly.description: Zebra Longwing Butterfly حيوان. The zebra longwing is a distinctive butterfly with black wings marked by pale yellow stripes. It is unique among butterflies in that adults can digest pollen, extending their lifespan significantly.

snowflake-butterfly.funFact: The snowflake butterfly has mostly white wings with delicate black tips.
snowflake-butterfly.name: Snowflake Butterfly
snowflake-butterfly.description: Snowflake Butterfly حيوان. The snowflake butterfly is a delicate white butterfly found in tropical forests. Its mostly white wings with small dark tips give it a graceful appearance as it glides through forest understory.

resurrection-butterfly.funFact: The resurrection butterfly is considered a symbol of rebirth in Japanese culture.
resurrection-butterfly.name: Resurrection Butterfly
resurrection-butterfly.description: Resurrection Butterfly حيوان. The resurrection butterfly, known as Kuroneko Yamane in Japan, is a medium-sized butterfly with distinctive markings. It has deep cultural significance in Japan as a symbol of love and resurrection.

cabbage-white-butterfly.funFact: The small white is one of the most common butterflies in the world and a notorious garden pest.
cabbage-white-butterfly.name: Small White Butterfly
cabbage-white-butterfly.description: Small White Butterfly حيوان. The small white butterfly is a widespread species often found in gardens and agricultural areas. Its caterpillars are major pests of cabbage and other brassica crops.

atlas-beetle.funFact: Atlas beetles can carry objects 850 times their own body weight.
atlas-beetle.name: Atlas Beetle
atlas-beetle.description: Atlas Beetle حيوان. The atlas beetle is a large rhinoceros beetle native to Southeast Asian rainforests. Males have three prominent horns used in combat for mates, and they are among the strongest insects relative to size.

goliath-beetle.funFact: Goliath beetles are among the heaviest insects in the world.
goliath-beetle.name: Goliath Beetle
goliath-beetle.description: Goliath Beetle حيوان. The goliath beetle is one of the largest and heaviest insects on Earth, found in African tropical forests. They feed on fruit and tree sap, and their larvae are among the heaviest grubs known.

rhinoceros-beetle.funFact: Rhinoceros beetles can lift objects 850 times their own body weight.
rhinoceros-beetle.name: Western Hercules Beetle
rhinoceros-beetle.description: Western Hercules Beetle حيوان. The western hercules beetle is a large rhinoceros beetle found in the hardwood forests of North America. Males have a distinctive horn used for wrestling other males during mating season.

stag-beetle.funFact: Male stag beetles use their enormous mandibles to wrestle rivals for mates.
stag-beetle.name: Stag Beetle
stag-beetle.description: Stag Beetle حيوان. Stag beetles are named for the large, antler-like mandibles of the males. They spend most of their lives as larvae feeding on decaying wood underground before emerging as impressive adults.

dung-beetle.funFact: Dung beetles navigate using the Milky Way, the first insects found to use stars.
dung-beetle.name: Scarab Dung Beetle
dung-beetle.description: Scarab Dung Beetle حيوان. Dung beetles roll animal droppings into balls for food or breeding. They are essential decomposers that help recycle nutrients back into the soil and reduce parasite populations in pastures.

tiger-beetle.funFact: Tiger beetles run so fast they go temporarily blind because their eyes cannot process images quickly enough.
tiger-beetle.name: Six-Spotted Tiger Beetle
tiger-beetle.description: Six-Spotted Tiger Beetle حيوان. Tiger beetles are fast-running predatory beetles with large eyes and powerful jaws. They are voracious hunters of smaller insects and are often found on open, sunlit ground.

longhorn-beetle.funFact: The Asian longhorned beetle can kill healthy hardwood trees by tunneling through their bark.
longhorn-beetle.name: Asian Longhorned Beetle
longhorn-beetle.description: Asian Longhorned Beetle حيوان. The Asian longhorned beetle is an invasive species that attacks a wide variety of hardwood trees. It has distinctive black and white markings and very long antennae that exceed its body length.

click-beetle.funFact: Click beetles can launch themselves into the air with a clicking mechanism without using their legs.
click-beetle.name: Click Beetle
click-beetle.description: Click Beetle حيوان. Click beetles have a unique clicking mechanism on their thorax that allows them to snap and launch into the air when overturned. Their larvae, called wireworms, are important soil dwellers.

bombardier-beetle.funFact: Bombardier beetles spray a boiling chemical spray at 212 degrees Fahrenheit from their abdomen.
bombardier-beetle.name: Bombardier Beetle
bombardier-beetle.description: Bombardier Beetle حيوان. The bombardier beetle defends itself by ejecting a hot, noxious chemical spray from its abdomen with an audible pop. The spray reaches temperatures near boiling and repels predators effectively.

june-bug.funFact: June bugs are clumsy fliers and often bounce off windows and walls.
june-bug.name: June Bug
june-bug.description: June Bug حيوان. June bugs are chunky, brown beetles that emerge in late spring. They are attracted to lights at night and their larvae, known as white grubs, feed on grass roots and can damage lawns.

whirligig-beetle.funFact: Whirligig beetles have four eyes: two for seeing above water and two for seeing below.
whirligig-beetle.name: Whirligig Beetle
whirligig-beetle.description: Whirligig Beetle حيوان. Whirligig beetles are aquatic beetles that spin rapidly on the surface of calm water. They have split eyes adapted for both aerial and aquatic vision and are social insects that form groups.

diving-beetle.funFact: Diving beetles carry an air bubble under their wing covers to breathe underwater.
diving-beetle.name: Predaceous Diving Beetle
diving-beetle.description: Predaceous Diving Beetle حيوان. Predaceous diving beetles are streamlined aquatic predators that hunt tadpoles, small fish, and other insects underwater. They trap air beneath their elytra for extended submerged hunting.

oil-beetle.funFact: Oil beetles secrete oily droplets from their joints that repel predators and can blister human skin.
oil-beetle.name: Oil Beetle
oil-beetle.description: Oil Beetle حيوان. Oil beetles are flightless blister beetles that produce cantharidin, a toxic oily substance, from their joints. Their larvae parasitize solitary bees and develop inside their nests.

bess-beetle.funFact: Bess beetles communicate by rubbing their abdomen to make squeaking sounds.
bess-beetle.name: Bess Beetle
bess-beetle.description: Bess Beetle حيوان. Bess beetles are large, shiny black beetles that live in decaying wood. They exhibit parental care, with adults feeding and caring for their larvae, which is unusual for beetles.

bark-beetle.funFact: Mountain pine beetle outbreaks can kill millions of acres of forest in a single year.
bark-beetle.name: Mountain Pine Beetle
bark-beetle.description: Mountain Pine Beetle حيوان. Mountain pine beetles are tiny bark beetles that bore into pine trees and introduce blue-stain fungi. Massive outbreaks have devastated millions of acres of forest in western North America.

sacred-scarab-beetle.funFact: Ancient Egyptians revered the scarab as a symbol of the sun god Khepri.
sacred-scarab-beetle.name: Sacred Scarab Beetle
sacred-scarab-beetle.description: Sacred Scarab Beetle حيوان. The sacred scarab beetle rolls dung into balls and was revered in ancient Egyptian culture as a symbol of rebirth and the sun's daily journey across the sky.

carrion-beetle.funFact: Carrion beetles can locate a dead animal from over a mile away using chemical sensors.
carrion-beetle.name: American Carrion Beetle
carrion-beetle.description: American Carrion Beetle حيوان. The American carrion beetle is a large, flat beetle that feeds on dead animals and snails. It plays an important ecological role in recycling nutrients back into the ecosystem.

patrol-bess-beetle.funFact: Patrol bess beetles produce sounds by rubbing ridges on their abdomen when disturbed.
patrol-bess-beetle.name: Patrol Bess Beetle
patrol-bess-beetle.description: Patrol Bess Beetle حيوان. The patrol bess beetle is a large, glossy black beetle found in tropical rainforests. Like other passalid beetles, both parents work together to feed and care for their larvae.

eyed-click-beetle.funFact: The eyed click beetle has two large eyespots on its thorax that startle predators.
eyed-click-beetle.name: Eyed Click Beetle
eyed-click-beetle.description: Eyed Click Beetle حيوان. The eyed click beetle is a large click beetle with distinctive eyespots on its pronotum. When threatened, it clicks and flips into the air to right itself or escape danger.

rose-chafer.funFact: Rose chafers can fly with their elytra closed, using only their hind wings.
rose-chafer.name: Rose Chafer
rose-chafer.description: Rose Chafer حيوان. The rose chafer is a metallic green beetle that feeds on flowers, especially roses and fruit blossoms. Despite being considered a pest, its larvae help decompose organic matter in soil.

japanese-beetle.funFact: Japanese beetles release aggregation pheromones that attract more beetles to feed.
japanese-beetle.name: Japanese Beetle
japanese-beetle.description: Japanese Beetle حيوان. The Japanese beetle is a highly invasive pest that skeletonizes leaves and damages turf with its white grub larvae. It is native to Japan and has become a devastating pest in North America.

colorado-potato-beetle.funFact: The Colorado potato beetle is one of the most insecticide-resistant pests in the world.
colorado-potato-beetle.name: Colorado Potato Beetle
colorado-potato-beetle.description: Colorado Potato Beetle حيوان. The Colorado potato beetle is a major agricultural pest that feeds on potatoes, tomatoes, and eggplants. It has developed resistance to over 50 different insecticides.

lily-beetle.funFact: Lily beetles are bright red, making them easy to spot on green leaves.
lily-beetle.name: Scarlet Lily Beetle
lily-beetle.description: Scarlet Lily Beetle حيوان. The scarlet lily beetle is a bright red pest of lily plants. Both adults and larvae feed on leaves, stems, and flowers, and the larvae cover themselves in their own excrement for protection.

elm-beetle.funFact: Elm leaf beetles can enter homes through small cracks and hibernate indoors during winter.
elm-beetle.name: Elm Leaf Beetle
elm-beetle.description: Elm Leaf Beetle حيوان. The elm leaf beetle skeletonizes elm tree leaves and is a significant urban pest. Adults often overwinter inside buildings, emerging in spring to feed on newly emerged elm leaves.

fire-ant.funFact: Fire ant colonies can form living rafts that float on water for weeks during floods.
fire-ant.name: Red Imported Fire Ant
fire-ant.description: Red Imported Fire Ant حيوان. Red imported fire ants are invasive ants native to South America that deliver painful stings causing burning welts. They build large mound nests and can survive flooding by forming floating colonies.

leafcutter-ant.funFact: Leafcutter ants are the largest consumers of vegetation in the Neotropics.
leafcutter-ant.name: Leafcutter Ant
leafcutter-ant.description: Leafcutter Ant حيوان. Leafcutter ants cut and carry pieces of leaves back to their nests to feed a special fungus that they cultivate. They are sophisticated farmers with complex division of labor among castes.

bullet-ant.funFact: The bullet ant's sting is rated as the most painful insect sting in the world.
bullet-ant.name: Bullet Ant
bullet-ant.description: Bullet Ant حيوان. The bullet ant gets its name from the intense pain of its sting, which has been compared to being shot. Indigenous tribes use bullet ant stings in coming-of-age rituals.

army-ant.funFact: Army ant colonies of millions move in massive raiding columns that devour everything in their path.
army-ant.name: Army Ant
army-ant.description: Army Ant حيوان. Army ants are nomadic predators that form massive raiding swarms. They do not build permanent nests but instead form living bivouacs made of their own bodies while the colony rests.

trap-jaw-ant.funFact: Trap-jaw ants can snap their mandibles at speeds exceeding 140 mph.
trap-jaw-ant.name: Trap-Jaw Ant
trap-jaw-ant.description: Trap-Jaw Ant حيوان. Trap-jaw ants have spring-loaded mandibles that snap shut at incredible speeds to capture prey and can also use the force to launch themselves into the air to escape predators.

weaver-ant.funFact: Weaver ants use their own larvae as living glue guns to stitch leaves together.
weaver-ant.name: Weaver Ant
weaver-ant.description: Weaver Ant حيوان. Weaver ants build elaborate nests by weaving living leaves together using silk produced by their larvae. They are aggressive defenders of their territory and tend honeydew-producing insects.

honeybee.funFact: A single honeybee colony can visit over 225,000 flowers to produce one pound of honey.
honeybee.name: Western Honeybee
honeybee.description: Western Honeybee حيوان. The western honeybee is the world's most important pollinator of agricultural crops. They live in highly organized colonies with complex social structures and produce honey and beeswax.

bumblebee.funFact: Bumblebees can fly in colder temperatures than most bees due to their ability to thermoregulate.
bumblebee.name: Common Bumblebee
bumblebee.description: Common Bumblebee حيوان. Bumblebees are robust, fuzzy bees important for pollinating wildflowers and crops. They are capable of buzz pollination, vibrating their flight muscles to release pollen from flowers.

carpenter-bee.funFact: Carpenter bees drill perfectly round holes in wood to create nesting galleries.
carpenter-bee.name: Eastern Carpenter Bee
carpenter-bee.description: Eastern Carpenter Bee حيوان. Carpenter bees are large, solitary bees that bore into untreated wood to create nesting tunnels. Despite their intimidating size, they are gentle and rarely sting, preferring to hover near structures.

paper-wasp.funFact: Paper wasps build their nests from chewed wood fibers mixed with saliva.
paper-wasp.name: European Paper Wasp
paper-wasp.description: European Paper Wasp حيوان. Paper wasps are slender wasps with long legs that build open-comb umbrella-shaped nests from wood pulp. They are beneficial predators of caterpillars but will sting if their nest is threatened.

yellow-jacket.funFact: Yellow jacket colonies can grow to contain 4,000 or more workers by late summer.
yellow-jacket.name: Common Yellow Jacket
yellow-jacket.description: Common Yellow Jacket حيوان. Yellow jackets are aggressive wasps known for their bright yellow and black markings. They build enclosed paper nests and are notorious for scavenging at picnics and outdoor events.

bald-faced-hornet.funFact: Bald-faced hornets can spray venom from their stingers up to several feet.
bald-faced-hornet.name: Bald-Faced Hornet
bald-faced-hornet.description: Bald-Faced Hornet حيوان. Despite its name, the bald-faced hornet is actually a yellowjacket, not a true hornet. It builds large, enclosed paper nests high in trees and is known for its aggressive defense of its colony.

european-hornet.funFact: European hornets are attracted to light and will often fly into homes at night.
european-hornet.name: European Hornet
european-hornet.description: European Hornet حيوان. The European hornet is the largest social wasp in Europe and an invasive species in North America. Queens can reach 1.4 inches in length, and colonies can contain up to 1,000 workers.

tarantula-hawk-wasp.funFact: The tarantula hawk has one of the most painful insect stings in the world.
tarantula-hawk-wasp.name: Tarantula Hawk Wasp
tarantula-hawk-wasp.description: Tarantula Hawk Wasp حيوان. The tarantula hawk is a large, metallic blue-black wasp that hunts tarantulas to serve as live food for its larvae. Its sting is excruciatingly painful but rarely dangerous to humans.

cuckoo-wasp.funFact: Cuckoo wasps can curl into a ball when threatened, using their armored exoskeleton for protection.
cuckoo-wasp.name: Cuckoo Wasp
cuckoo-wasp.description: Cuckoo Wasp حيوان. Cuckoo wasps are brilliant metallic blue or green parasitoids that lay their eggs in the nests of other bees and wasps. Their larvae consume the host's eggs or larvae and stored food.

ichneumon-wasp.funFact: The giant ichneumon's ovipositor can be longer than its body and drills through wood to reach beetle larvae.
ichneumon-wasp.name: Giant Ichneumon Wasp
ichneumon-wasp.description: Giant Ichneumon Wasp حيوان. Giant ichneumon wasps are parasitoids that use their extremely long ovipositors to drill into wood and lay eggs inside wood-boring beetle larvae. Despite their fearsome appearance, they cannot sting humans.

asian-giant-hornet.funFact: The Asian giant hornet can decapitate an entire honeybee colony in hours.
asian-giant-hornet.name: Asian Giant Hornet
asian-giant-hornet.description: Asian Giant Hornet حيوان. The Asian giant hornet, nicknamed the murder hornet, is the world's largest hornet. Its powerful sting delivers potent venom and it is a devastating predator of honeybee colonies.

sweat-bee.funFact: Some sweat bees have metallic green or blue bodies that shimmer in the sunlight.
sweat-bee.name: Sweat Bee
sweat-bee.description: Sweat Bee حيوان. Sweat bees are small, often metallic-colored bees attracted to human perspiration for its salt content. They are important pollinators and nest in the ground or in hollow stems.

mason-bee.funFact: Mason bees are 100 times more efficient at pollinating than honeybees.
mason-bee.name: Blue Orchard Mason Bee
mason-bee.description: Blue Orchard Mason Bee حيوان. The blue orchard mason bee is a solitary bee that nests in hollow tubes and crevices. It is a far more efficient pollinator than honeybees, visiting far more flowers per hour.

mining-bee.funFact: Mining bees create small volcano-shaped mounds of soil at their nest entrances.
mining-bee.name: Tawny Mining Bee
mining-bee.description: Tawny Mining Bee حيوان. Mining bees are solitary ground-nesting bees that excavate tunnels in soil. They emerge in spring and are important early-season pollinators of fruit trees and wildflowers.

golden-digger-wasp.funFact: Golden digger wasps paralyze grasshoppers and crickets to feed their larvae alive.
golden-digger-wasp.name: Golden Digger Wasp
golden-digger-wasp.description: Golden Digger Wasp حيوان. The golden digger wasp is a large, metallic golden wasp that hunts grasshoppers and crickets. It buries paralyzed prey in underground nests for its developing larvae.

mud-dauber-wasp.funFact: Mud daubers stock their nests with paralyzed spiders for their developing larvae.
mud-dauber-wasp.name: Mud Dauber Wasp
mud-dauber-wasp.description: Mud Dauber Wasp حيوان. Mud dauber wasps are solitary wasps that construct tubular mud nests on sheltered surfaces. They hunt and paralyze spiders to stock each cell for their developing young.

horned-mason-bee.funFact: Male horned mason bees have small horns on their faces used in mating displays.
horned-mason-bee.name: Horned Mason Bee
horned-mason-bee.description: Horned Mason Bee حيوان. The horned mason bee is a solitary bee that nests in hollow stems and bee hotels. Males have distinctive facial horns and both sexes are important early-season pollinators.

wool-carder-bee.funFact: Wool carder bees scrape plant hairs to line their nests, hence their name.
wool-carder-bee.name: Wool Carder Bee
wool-carder-bee.description: Wool Carder Bee حيوان. Wool carder bees are solitary bees that collect plant hairs to line their nest cells. Males aggressively defend patches of fuzzy plants where females forage for nesting material.

cicada-killer-wasp.funFact: The cicada killer is the largest wasp in North America and can be over 2 inches long.
cicada-killer-wasp.name: Cicada Killer Wasp
cicada-killer-wasp.description: Cicada Killer Wasp حيوان. The cicada killer is a massive solitary wasp that hunts cicadas to provision its underground nest. Despite its intimidating size, it rarely stings humans unless provoked.

red-velvet-ant.funFact: The velvet ant is actually a wingless wasp with one of the most painful stings in the insect world.
red-velvet-ant.name: Red Velvet Ant
red-velvet-ant.description: Red Velvet Ant حيوان. The red velvet ant is a wingless female wasp with a dense covering of bright red hairs. Despite its ant-like appearance, it is a parasitoid wasp whose sting is extremely painful.

cuckoo-bumblebee.funFact: Cuckoo bumblebees infiltrate other bumblebee nests and lay their eggs for the host to raise.
cuckoo-bumblebee.name: Cuckoo Bumblebee
cuckoo-bumblebee.description: Cuckoo Bumblebee حيوان. Cuckoo bumblebees are social parasites that take over the nests of other bumblebee species. The female cuckoo bumblebee displaces the host queen and lays her own eggs for the workers to tend.

mosquito.funFact: Only female mosquitoes bite, needing blood protein to produce eggs.
mosquito.name: Asian Tiger Mosquito
mosquito.description: Asian Tiger Mosquito حيوان. The Asian tiger mosquito is an invasive species that can transmit dengue, chikungunya, and Zika viruses. It is identified by its distinctive black and white striped body and legs.

house-fly.funFact: House flies taste with their feet and can detect food from miles away.
house-fly.name: Common House Fly
house-fly.description: Common House Fly حيوان. The common house fly is one of the most widespread insects, closely associated with humans. It has sponging mouthparts for liquid feeding and can transmit numerous diseases.

fruit-fly.funFact: Fruit flies are one of the most important model organisms in genetics research.
fruit-fly.name: Common Fruit Fly
fruit-fly.description: Common Fruit Fly حيوان. The common fruit fly is tiny but remarkably important in scientific research. They reproduce rapidly and share many genes with humans, making them invaluable for studying genetics and disease.

crane-fly.funFact: Crane flies are often mistakenly called giant mosquitoes but do not bite or suck blood.
crane-fly.name: Crane Fly
crane-fly.description: Crane Fly حيوان. Crane flies are delicate, long-legged insects that resemble oversized mosquitoes. Adults are harmless and many do not feed at all, while their larvae, known as leatherjackets, live in soil.

horsefly.funFact: Horse flies are among the fastest flying insects, reaching speeds up to 90 mph.
horsefly.name: Horse Fly
horsefly.description: Horse Fly حيوان. Horse flies are large, powerful fliers with razor-sharp mouthparts that slash skin to feed on blood. Only females bite, and their painful bites can transmit diseases to livestock and humans.

bot-fly.funFact: Bot fly larvae develop under human skin, creating painful boils called myiasis.
bot-fly.name: Human Bot Fly
bot-fly.description: Human Bot Fly حيوان. The human bot fly is a parasitic insect whose larvae develop beneath the skin of mammals, including humans. Adults do not bite; instead, they hijack mosquitoes to deliver their eggs to hosts.

hover-fly.funFact: Hover flies mimic bees and wasps for protection but are completely harmless.
hover-fly.name: Common Hover Fly
hover-fly.description: Common Hover Fly حيوان. Hover flies are beneficial pollinators that mimic the appearance of stinging insects for protection. Their larvae are important predators of aphids, making them valuable in pest control.

black-fly.funFact: Black fly swarms can be so dense that they suffocate livestock by blocking their airways.
black-fly.name: Black Fly
black-fly.description: Black Fly حيوان. Black flies are tiny but relentless biting insects that breed in flowing water. In some regions they transmit river blindness and are considered one of the most important disease vectors.

damselfly.funFact: Damselflies fold their wings along their bodies when at rest, unlike dragonflies.
damselfly.name: Blue-Tailed Damselfly
damselfly.description: Blue-Tailed Damselfly حيوان. Damselflies are slender, delicate relatives of dragonflies that hold their wings together above their body when resting. They are important aquatic ecosystem indicators and voracious mosquito predators.

blue-dasher-dragonfly.funFact: Blue dashers can fly backwards and hover in place like a helicopter.
blue-dasher-dragonfly.name: Blue Dasher Dragonfly
blue-dasher-dragonfly.description: Blue Dasher Dragonfly حيوان. The blue dasher is a small, common dragonfly with a blue-green body and distinctive wing pattern. It is an agile aerial predator that catches mosquitoes and other small insects on the wing.

emperor-dragonfly.funFact: Emperor dragonflies can eat their own body weight in insects every day.
emperor-dragonfly.name: Emperor Dragonfly
emperor-dragonfly.description: Emperor Dragonfly حيوان. The emperor dragonfly is one of the largest and most powerful dragonflies in Europe. It patrols territories over water and feeds voraciously on mosquitoes, flies, and other flying insects.

four-spotted-chaser.funFact: Four-spotted chasers are among the first dragonflies to emerge in spring.
four-spotted-chaser.name: Four-Spotted Chaser
four-spotted-chaser.description: Four-Spotted Chaser حيوان. The four-spotted chaser is a robust dragonfly with distinctive dark spots on its wings. It is an aggressive territorial species that perches on vegetation to ambush passing prey.

robber-fly.funFact: Robber flies can capture and eat insects as large as dragonflies and grasshoppers.
robber-fly.name: Robber Fly
robber-fly.description: Robber Fly حيوان. Robber flies are aerial predators that intercept prey in flight. They inject victims with saliva that paralyzes and digests their insides, then suck out the liquefied contents.

marmalade-hoverfly.funFact: Marmalade hoverflies migrate thousands of miles across Europe each year.
marmalade-hoverfly.name: Marmalade Hoverfly
marmalade-hoverfly.description: Marmalade Hoverfly حيوان. The marmalade hoverfly is a bee-mimic hoverfly that is an important pollinator. Its larvae are voracious aphid predators, making it doubly valuable in gardens and agriculture.

common-mosquito.funFact: Mosquitoes are responsible for more human deaths than any other animal in history.
common-mosquito.name: Common Mosquito
common-mosquito.description: Common Mosquito حيوان. Mosquitoes are small, buzzing flies that transmit deadly diseases including malaria, dengue, and Zika. Only females bite to obtain blood for egg production, while males feed on nectar.

biting-midge.funFact: Biting midges, or no-see-ums, are so small they can pass through standard window screens.
biting-midge.name: Biting Midge
biting-midge.description: Biting Midge حيوان. Biting midges are tiny flies that deliver disproportionately painful bites. They are among the smallest biting flies and can be major pests in coastal and tropical regions.

deer-fly.funFact: Deer flies are attracted to dark colors and carbon dioxide, similar to mosquitoes.
deer-fly.name: Deer Fly
deer-fly.description: Deer Fly حيوان. Deer flies are fast-flying, aggressive biters with patterned wings. They transmit tularemia and can cause severe allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

cattle-bot-fly.funFact: Cattle bot fly larvae attach to the tongues and throat of cattle, causing significant irritation.
cattle-bot-fly.name: Cattle Bot Fly
cattle-bot-fly.description: Cattle Bot Fly حيوان. The cattle bot fly is a parasitic fly whose larvae develop in the throats of cattle. Adults are bee-like in appearance and do not feed, living only long enough to reproduce.

orchid-mantis.funFact: The orchid mantis looks so much like a flower that pollinators land directly on it.
orchid-mantis.name: Orchid Mantis
orchid-mantis.description: Orchid Mantis حيوان. The orchid mantis is a stunning pink and white mantis that mimics orchid flowers to ambush pollinators. It is considered one of the most beautiful insects in the world.

ghost-mantis.funFact: The ghost mantis looks exactly like a dried, dead leaf, making it nearly invisible.
ghost-mantis.name: Ghost Mantis
ghost-mantis.description: Ghost Mantis حيوان. The ghost mantis is a master of camouflage with a body shaped and colored to resemble a dried leaf. It sways gently to mimic a leaf in the wind, hiding from both predators and prey.

leaf-mantis.funFact: The dead leaf mantis has irregular body edges that perfectly replicate a torn, decaying leaf.
leaf-mantis.name: Dead Leaf Mantis
leaf-mantis.description: Dead Leaf Mantis حيوان. The dead leaf mantis is a large, spectacular mantis with a flattened body resembling a dead leaf. It is an ambush predator that waits motionless for prey to come within striking distance.

walking-stick.funFact: Walking sticks can regenerate lost limbs during molts and some species produce toxic defensive chemicals.
walking-stick.name: Common Walking Stick
walking-stick.description: Common Walking Stick حيوان. Walking sticks are elongated, camouflaged insects that resemble twigs or branches. They are nocturnal herbivores that rely on their extraordinary disguise to avoid detection by predators.

giant-walking-stick.funFact: The giant walking stick holds the record for the longest insect in the world.
giant-walking-stick.name: Giant Walking Stick
giant-walking-stick.description: Giant Walking Stick حيوان. The giant walking stick, also known as Chan's megastick, is the longest insect species, with females reaching over 14 inches including legs. It is native to Borneo's tropical rainforests.

american-cockroach.funFact: Cockroaches can survive for weeks without food and hold their breath for 40 minutes.
american-cockroach.name: American Cockroach
american-cockroach.description: American Cockroach حيوان. The American cockroach is the largest common cockroach found in human habitations. Despite its name, it originated in Africa and is now found worldwide in warm, moist environments.

german-cockroach.funFact: German cockroaches can produce up to 30,000 offspring in a single year from one female.
german-cockroach.name: German Cockroach
german-cockroach.description: German Cockroach حيوان. The German cockroach is the most troublesome indoor cockroach species worldwide. It reproduces rapidly, is resistant to many insecticides, and contaminates food and surfaces with pathogens.

madagascar-hissing-cockroach.funFact: Madagascar hissing cockroaches produce a loud hiss by forcing air through specialized breathing holes.
madagascar-hissing-cockroach.name: Madagascar Hissing Cockroach
madagascar-hissing-cockroach.description: Madagascar Hissing Cockroach حيوان. The Madagascar hissing cockroach is one of the largest cockroach species, reaching 3 inches long. It is famous for the loud hissing sound it produces when disturbed, used for defense and communication.

oriental-cockroach.funFact: Oriental cockroaches are sometimes called water bugs because they prefer damp, dark environments.
oriental-cockroach.name: Oriental Cockroach
oriental-cockroach.description: Oriental Cockroach حيوان. The oriental cockroach is a large, dark species that prefers cool, damp environments. It is a scavenger that feeds on decaying organic matter and is associated with poor sanitation.

eastern-subterranean-termite.funFact: Subterranean termite colonies can contain millions of individuals working together.
eastern-subterranean-termite.name: Eastern Subterranean Termite
eastern-subterranean-termite.description: Eastern Subterranean Termite حيوان. Eastern subterranean termites are the most destructive termite species in North America. They live in underground colonies and build mud tubes to reach wood structures above ground.

formosan-termite.funFact: Formosan termites build carton nests above ground and can consume a foot of 2x4 lumber in about five months.
formosan-termite.name: Formosan Subterranean Termite
formosan-termite.description: Formosan Subterranean Termite حيوان. The Formosan termite is one of the most destructive termite species, capable of consuming enormous amounts of wood. Unlike most termites, it can build above-ground nests, making it especially destructive.

dampwood-termite.funFact: Dampwood termites are the largest North American termites and do not require soil contact.
dampwood-termite.name: Dampwood Termite
dampwood-termite.description: Dampwood Termite حيوان. Dampwood termites infest moist, decaying wood and are indicators of excessive moisture problems. They are larger than subterranean termites and do not build mud tubes.

drywood-termite.funFact: Drywood termites kick out tiny fecal pellets called frass that accumulate below infested wood.
drywood-termite.name: Drywood Termite
drywood-termite.description: Drywood Termite حيوان. Drywood termites live entirely within the wood they consume and do not require soil contact. They are difficult to detect and treat because colonies can be scattered throughout a structure.

cicada.funFact: Periodical cicadas emerge in synchronized broods of billions after 13 or 17 years underground.
cicada.name: Periodical Cicada
cicada.description: Periodical Cicada حيوان. Periodical cicadas are famous for their synchronized mass emergences every 13 or 17 years. They are the longest-lived insects and their emergences create deafening choruses heard for miles.

dog-day-cicada.funFact: Dog-day cicadas get their name because they emerge during the dog days of summer.
dog-day-cicada.name: Dog-Day Cicada
dog-day-cicada.description: Dog-Day Cicada حيوان. Dog-day cicadas are annual cicadas that emerge each summer, unlike their periodical cousins. Their loud buzzing songs fill late summer afternoons in eastern North America.

masked-devil-cicada.funFact: Some Australian cicada species have the loudest insect calls, exceeding 120 decibels.
masked-devil-cicada.name: Masked Devil Cicada
masked-devil-cicada.description: Masked Devil Cicada حيوان. The masked devil cicada is an Australian species known for its distinctive facial markings. Like other cicadas, it spends years underground before emerging for a brief, noisy adult life.

leafhopper.funFact: Brown planthoppers can jump 70 times their body length in a single leap.
leafhopper.name: Brown Planthopper
leafhopper.description: Brown Planthopper حيوان. The brown planthopper is a major pest of rice crops in Asia. It feeds on plant sap and transmits the devastating rice ragged stunt virus and rice grassy stunt virus.

spittlebug.funFact: Spittlebug nymphs produce foamy saliva masses called cuckoo spit to protect themselves.
spittlebug.name: Meadow Spittlebug
spittlebug.description: Meadow Spittlebug حيوان. Spittlebugs get their name from the frothy foam masses their nymphs produce on plant stems. These nymphs, called froghoppers, are sap-sucking insects that can transmit plant diseases.

aphid.funFact: Aphids can produce up to 80 offspring per female without mating through parthenogenesis.
aphid.name: Green Peach Aphid
aphid.description: Green Peach Aphid حيوان. The green peach aphid is one of the most destructive agricultural pests worldwide. It reproduces rapidly through asexual reproduction and transmits over 100 plant viruses.

bed-bug.funFact: Bed bugs can survive for over a year without feeding and are resistant to many pesticides.
bed-bug.name: Common Bed Bug
bed-bug.description: Common Bed Bug حيوان. Bed bugs are parasitic insects that feed on human blood at night. They hide in mattress seams, furniture, and wall cracks, and their populations have surged worldwide due to pesticide resistance.

kissing-bug.funFact: Kissing bugs are called so because they often bite people on the face while they sleep.
kissing-bug.name: Triatomine Bug
kissing-bug.description: Triatomine Bug حيوان. Triatomine bugs, also known as kissing bugs, are vectors of Chagas disease. They feed on blood at night and transmit the parasite Trypanosoma cruzi through their feces.

stink-bug.funFact: Stink bugs release a foul-smelling chemical from glands on their thorax when disturbed.
stink-bug.name: Brown Marmorated Stink Bug
stink-bug.description: Brown Marmorated Stink Bug حيوان. The brown marmorated stink bug is an invasive species from Asia that has become a major agricultural pest in North America. It damages fruit crops and invades homes in winter seeking shelter.

box-elder-bug.funFact: Box elder bugs aggregate in huge numbers on warm south-facing walls in autumn.
box-elder-bug.name: Box Elder Bug
box-elder-bug.description: Box Elder Bug حيوان. Box elder bugs are black insects with red markings that feed on box elder tree seeds. They become nuisances in fall when they cluster on buildings seeking warmth for winter.

water-strider.funFact: Water striders can walk on water due to microscopic hairs on their legs that trap air.
water-strider.name: Common Water Strider
water-strider.description: Common Water Strider حيوان. Water striders are insects that glide across the surface of calm water using surface tension. Their hydrophobic leg hairs create air cushions that keep them afloat while they hunt prey.

giant-water-bug.funFact: Giant water bugs are called toe-biters and can deliver an extremely painful bite.
giant-water-bug.name: Giant Water Bug
giant-water-bug.description: Giant Water Bug حيوان. Giant water bugs are large, flat-bodied aquatic predators that prey on fish, frogs, and snakes. Males carry eggs on their backs and are sometimes called electric-light bugs for their attraction to lights.

american-grasshopper.funFact: Bird grasshoppers are strong fliers and can travel significant distances during migrations.
american-grasshopper.name: American Bird Grasshopper
american-grasshopper.description: American Bird Grasshopper حيوان. The American bird grasshopper is a large, strong-flying grasshopper that feeds on a wide variety of plants. It gets its name from its bird-like flight and large size.

desert-locust.funFact: Desert locust swarms can cover 460 square miles and contain 40 to 80 billion insects.
desert-locust.name: Desert Locust
desert-locust.description: Desert Locust حيوان. The desert locust is the most destructive of all locust species. Under certain conditions it transforms from a solitary grasshopper into a gregarious swarming phase capable of devastating crops.

mormon-cricket.funFact: Despite their name, Mormon crickets are actually shield-backed katydids, not true crickets.
mormon-cricket.name: Mormon Cricket
mormon-cricket.description: Mormon Cricket حيوان. The Mormon cricket is not a cricket but a large shield-backed katydid that forms migrating bands of billions. They were named after Mormon settlers whose crops they devastated in the 1840s.

field-cricket.funFact: Male field crickets chirp by rubbing their wings together, and you can estimate temperature by counting chirps.
field-cricket.name: Field Cricket
field-cricket.description: Field Cricket حيوان. Field crickets are known for their distinctive chirping songs produced by males to attract mates. They are omnivorous scavengers that feed on plants, fungi, and other insects.

katydid.funFact: Katydid songs are ultrasonic, making them difficult for humans to hear without special equipment.
katydid.name: True Katydid
katydid.description: True Katydid حيوان. True katydids are named after their call, said to sound like Katy-did, Katy-didn't. They are leaf-mimicking insects that produce loud, clicking songs at ultrasonic frequencies.

mole-cricket.funFact: Mole crickets can swim and fly, making them highly mobile pests of turfgrass.
mole-cricket.name: European Mole Cricket
mole-cricket.description: European Mole Cricket حيوان. Mole crickets are burrowing insects with powerful, shovel-like forelegs adapted for digging through soil. They damage lawns and crops by feeding on roots and disrupting soil structure.

snowy-tree-cricket.funFact: The snowy tree cricket is known as the thermometer cricket because chirp rate correlates with temperature.
snowy-tree-cricket.name: Snowy Tree Cricket
snowy-tree-cricket.description: Snowy Tree Cricket حيوان. The snowy tree cricket produces a pure, musical trill and is famous for its temperature-dependent chirping rate. Dolbear's Law uses its chirps to estimate ambient temperature.

human-head-louse.funFact: Head lice have been companions of humans for at least 10,000 years.
human-head-louse.name: Human Head Louse
human-head-louse.description: Human Head Louse حيوان. Human head lice are parasitic insects that live on the scalp and feed on blood. They are wingless and highly adapted to life on humans, spreading through direct head-to-head contact.

body-louse.funFact: Body lice have been used to track human migration patterns through DNA analysis.
body-louse.name: Human Body Louse
body-louse.description: Human Body Louse حيوان. Human body lice live in clothing and emerge to feed on blood. Unlike head lice, they can transmit serious diseases including typhus, trench fever, and relapsing fever.

human-flea.funFact: Fleas can jump up to 150 times their body length, equivalent to a human jumping over a skyscraper.
human-flea.name: Human Flea
human-flea.description: Human Flea حيوان. The human flea, Pulex irritans, is the original flea species associated with humans. It is a blood-feeding parasite that can transmit diseases and has been a companion of humans for millennia.

cat-flea.funFact: Cat fleas are the most common flea species on domestic pets worldwide.
cat-flea.name: Cat Flea
cat-flea.description: Cat Flea حيوان. The cat flea is the most common flea species affecting domestic cats and dogs. Despite its name, it infests many mammal species and can cause allergic dermatitis and transmit tapeworms.

oriental-rat-flea.funFact: The oriental rat flea was the primary vector of bubonic plague during the Black Death.
oriental-rat-flea.name: Oriental Rat Flea
oriental-rat-flea.description: Oriental Rat Flea حيوان. The oriental rat flea is historically the most important disease vector among fleas, having transmitted bubonic plague during the Black Death. It feeds primarily on rats and other rodents.

brown-recluse-spider.funFact: Brown recluse venom can cause necrotic lesions that take months to heal.
brown-recluse-spider.name: Brown Recluse Spider
brown-recluse-spider.description: Brown Recluse Spider حيوان. The brown recluse spider has a violin-shaped marking on its cephalothorax and venom that can cause tissue death. It is reclusive and bites only when pressed against skin.

wolf-spider.funFact: Wolf spider mothers carry their egg sacs and spiderlings on their backs.
wolf-spider.name: Common Wolf Spider
wolf-spider.description: Common Wolf Spider حيوان. Wolf spiders are agile, ground-hunting spiders that do not build webs. They have excellent vision and chase down their prey, and females are notable for carrying their young on their backs.

jumping-spider.funFact: Jumping spiders have the best vision of any spider and can jump 50 times their body length.
jumping-spider.name: Bold Jumping Spider
jumping-spider.description: Bold Jumping Spider حيوان. Bold jumping spiders are charismatic, fuzzy spiders with large forward-facing eyes. They are active hunters that stalk prey and leap to capture it, displaying complex courtship dances.

orb-weaver-spider.funFact: Orb weavers rebuild their webs almost every night, consuming the old silk to recycle the proteins.
orb-weaver-spider.name: Garden Orb Weaver Spider
orb-weaver-spider.description: Garden Orb Weaver Spider حيوان. Garden orb weavers are among the most common web-building spiders. They create distinctive circular webs and are beneficial predators of flying insects in gardens and natural areas.

peacock-spider.funFact: Male peacock spiders perform elaborate dance displays with colorful abdominal flaps to court females.
peacock-spider.name: Peacock Spider
peacock-spider.description: Peacock Spider حيوان. Peacock spiders are tiny jumping spiders famous for the males' spectacular iridescent abdominal flaps used in elaborate courtship dances. Females will eat males who fail to impress.

brazilian-wandering-spider.funFact: The Brazilian wandering spider has the most potent venom of any spider and is listed in Guinness World Records.
brazilian-wandering-spider.name: Brazilian Wandering Spider
brazilian-wandering-spider.description: Brazilian Wandering Spider حيوان. The Brazilian wandering spider is considered the world's most venomous spider. Unlike web-building spiders, it actively wanders the forest floor at night and can deliver a medically significant bite.

emperor-scorpion.funFact: Emperor scorpions glow bright blue-green under ultraviolet light.
emperor-scorpion.name: Emperor Scorpion
emperor-scorpion.description: Emperor Scorpion حيوان. The emperor scorpion is one of the largest scorpion species and one of the most popular in the pet trade. Despite its intimidating size, its venom is relatively mild and it is generally docile.

bark-scorpion.funFact: Arizona bark scorpions are the most venomous scorpion in North America and can climb walls and ceilings.
bark-scorpion.name: Arizona Bark Scorpion
bark-scorpion.description: Arizona Bark Scorpion حيوان. The Arizona bark scorpion is the most dangerous scorpion in North America. It is unique among scorpions in its ability to climb walls and ceilings, often entering homes through plumbing.

deathstalker-scorpion.funFact: The deathstalker's venom contains compounds being researched for use in cancer treatment.
deathstalker-scorpion.name: Deathstalker Scorpion
deathstalker-scorpion.description: Deathstalker Scorpion حيوان. The deathstalker is one of the most venomous scorpions in the world. Its potent neurotoxic venom can be fatal to humans, but its venom compounds show promise in medical research.

spotted-lanternfly.funFact: Spotted lanternflies can lay up to 50 eggs on almost any flat surface.
spotted-lanternfly.name: Spotted Lanternfly
