spotted-lanternfly.description: Spotted Lanternfly حيوان. The spotted lanternfly is an invasive planthopper from Asia that feeds on over 70 plant species, threatening agriculture. Adults have distinctive spotted wings and bright red hind wings.

wheel-bug.funFact: The wheel bug gets its name from the distinctive cogwheel-like crest on its thorax.
wheel-bug.name: Wheel Bug
wheel-bug.description: Wheel Bug حيوان. The wheel bug is a large, beneficial predatory insect with a distinctive semicircular crest on its thorax. It uses its proboscis to inject digestive enzymes into prey and is a natural pest controller.

sawfly.funFact: Sawfly larvae look like caterpillars but have more than five pairs of prolegs.
sawfly.name: Rose Slug Sawfly
sawfly.description: Rose Slug Sawfly حيوان. Sawflies are wasp-like insects whose larvae feed on plant foliage, resembling caterpillars. The rose slug sawfly can skeletonize rose leaves, causing significant damage to gardens.

antlion.funFact: Antlion larvae dig conical pit traps in sand to catch ants and other small insects.
antlion.name: Antlion
antlion.description: Antlion حيوان. Antlions are insects whose larvae are famous for digging conical pitfall traps in sand. They wait at the bottom of the pit for prey to fall in, then inject digestive enzymes.

lacewing.funFact: Lacewing larvae are called aphid lions and can each consume 200 aphids per week.
lacewing.name: Green Lacewing
lacewing.description: Green Lacewing حيوان. Green lacewings are delicate, golden-green insects with lace-like wings. Their larvae are voracious predators of aphids and other soft-bodied pests, making them valuable biological control agents.

dobsonfly.funFact: Dobsonfly larvae, called hellgrammites, are indicators of good water quality.
dobsonfly.name: Eastern Dobsonfly
dobsonfly.description: Eastern Dobsonfly حيوان. The eastern dobsonfly is a large, impressive insect with enormous wings and males have extremely long mandibles. The aquatic larvae are important food for trout and indicators of stream health.

mayfly.funFact: Adult mayflies have vestigial mouthparts and cannot eat, living only long enough to mate.
mayfly.name: Mayfly
mayfly.description: Mayfly حيوان. Mayflies are aquatic insects with extremely short adult lifespans dedicated solely to reproduction. Their larvae are important indicators of water quality and food for fish.

earwig.funFact: Earwig mothers guard their eggs and clean them to prevent fungal growth.
earwig.name: Common European Earwig
earwig.description: Common European Earwig حيوان. The common European earwig is a nocturnal insect with distinctive pincer-like cerci on its abdomen. Despite myths, earwigs do not burrow into human ears, and mothers provide notable parental care.

silverfish.funFact: Silverfish are among the most primitive wingless insects, virtually unchanged for 400 million years.
silverfish.name: Common Silverfish
silverfish.description: Common Silverfish حيوان. Silverfish are small, wingless, silver-colored insects that damage paper, textiles, and food. They are nocturnal and thrive in warm, humid environments like bathrooms and basements.

firebrat.funFact: Firebrats prefer temperatures above 90 degrees Fahrenheit and can survive scorching conditions.
firebrat.name: Firebrat
firebrat.description: Firebrat حيوان. Firebrats are close relatives of silverfish that prefer much warmer environments. They are found near heat sources like furnaces and water heaters and feed on starchy materials.

jumping-bristletail.funFact: Jumping bristletails are among the most ancient insects, with a fossil record dating back 400 million years.
jumping-bristletail.name: Jumping Bristletail
jumping-bristletail.description: Jumping Bristletail حيوان. Jumping bristletails are small, wingless insects that can jump by curling their abdomen. They are found in moist environments and feed on algae, lichens, and decaying plant matter.

snakefly.funFact: Snakefly larvae can crawl backwards at high speed to escape threats.
snakefly.name: Snakefly
snakefly.description: Snakefly حيوان. Snakeflies are predatory insects with an elongated prothorax that gives them a snake-like appearance. Both adults and larvae are beneficial predators of pest insects on trees.

cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.funFact: Some cuckoo bumblebee species have been reclassified as entirely separate species from their hosts.
cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.name: Bombus Bob
cuckoo-bumblebee-parasite.description: Bombus Bob حيوان. This cuckoo bumblebee species is a social parasite that takes over nests of other bumblebee species. The female enters a host nest, kills or displaces the queen, and uses the existing workers.

musk-bee.funFact: Musk bees produce a distinctive lemony scent when disturbed.
musk-bee.name: Musk Bee
musk-bee.description: Musk Bee حيوان. The musk bee is a solitary ground-nesting bee known for its distinctive musky scent. It emerges in late summer and is an important pollinator of goldenrod and other fall wildflowers.

alkali-bee.funFact: Alkali bees prefer salty, alkaline soil for nesting and can form massive aggregations.
alkali-bee.name: Alkali Bee
alkali-bee.description: Alkali Bee حيوان. The alkali bee is a solitary ground-nesting bee that prefers alkaline soils near salt flats. It is an excellent pollinator of alfalfa and has been managed commercially for this purpose.

carpenter-ant.funFact: Carpenter ants do not eat wood but excavate it to create nesting galleries.
carpenter-ant.name: Black Carpenter Ant
carpenter-ant.description: Black Carpenter Ant حيوان. Black carpenter ants are large ants that excavate nests in moist, decaying wood. Unlike termites, they do not consume wood but can cause structural damage by hollowing out timbers.

pharaoh-ant.funFact: Pharaoh ants can nest in extremely small spaces and are known to spread disease in hospitals.
pharaoh-ant.name: Pharaoh Ant
pharaoh-ant.description: Pharaoh Ant حيوان. Pharaoh ants are tiny, pale-colored invasive ants that are particularly problematic in hospitals and food facilities. They form huge colonies with multiple queens and bud frequently.

odorous-house-ant.funFact: Odorous house ants smell like crushed coconut when squished.
odorous-house-ant.name: Odorous House Ant
odorous-house-ant.description: Odorous House Ant حيوان. Odorous house ants are common household ants that emit a distinctive coconut-like odor when crushed. They form large colonies and frequently nest inside walls and under floors.

blue-ringed-octopus.funFact: Its venom contains tetrodotoxin, potent enough to kill 26 humans.
blue-ringed-octopus.name: Blue-Ringed Octopus
blue-ringed-octopus.description: Blue-Ringed Octopus حيوان. The blue-ringed octopus is a small but deadly cephalopod native to coral reefs. Despite its diminutive size, its bright blue rings serve as a warning of its highly potent venom.

mimic-octopus.funFact: Can impersonate over 15 different species including lionfish and sea snakes.
mimic-octopus.name: Mimic Octopus
mimic-octopus.description: Mimic Octopus حيوان. The mimic octopus is a master of disguise, capable of altering its shape, color, and behavior to resemble other marine animals. It was only discovered in 1998 off the coast of Indonesia.

colossal-squid.funFact: Has the largest eyes of any animal, up to 10 inches in diameter.
colossal-squid.name: Colossal Squid
colossal-squid.description: Colossal Squid حيوان. The colossal squid is one of the largest invertebrates on Earth, inhabiting the frigid deep waters of the Antarctic. Its massive eyes are adapted to detect light in the perpetual darkness of the deep sea.

humboldt-squid.funFact: Also called the jumbo squid or red devil for its aggressive nature.
humboldt-squid.name: Humboldt Squid
humboldt-squid.description: Humboldt Squid حيوان. The Humboldt squid is a large, aggressive cephalopod named after the Humboldt Current. It hunts in packs and is known for its rapid growth rate and voracious appetite.

giant-squid.funFact: Was considered a mythical creature until first photographed alive in 2004.
giant-squid.name: Giant Squid
giant-squid.description: Giant Squid حيوان. The giant squid is one of the most mysterious creatures of the deep ocean. With eyes the size of dinner plates and tentacles reaching over 40 feet, it is a legendary predator of the abyss.

firefly-squid.funFact: Produces its own light through bioluminescent organs called photophores.
firefly-squid.name: Firefly Squid
firefly-squid.description: Firefly Squid حيوان. The firefly squid is a small cephalopod famous for its bioluminescence. Each spring millions gather in Toyama Bay, Japan, creating a spectacular natural light show.

caribbean-reef-octopus.funFact: Has two-thirds of its neurons in its arms rather than its brain.
caribbean-reef-octopus.name: Caribbean Reef Octopus
caribbean-reef-octopus.description: Caribbean Reef Octopus حيوان. The Caribbean reef octopus is a nocturnal predator that hunts crustaceans and small fish among coral formations. Its chromatophores allow rapid color changes for communication and camouflage.

flamboyant-cuttlefish.funFact: One of only two known poisonous cephalopods.
flamboyant-cuttlefish.name: Flamboyant Cuttlefish
flamboyant-cuttlefish.description: Flamboyant Cuttlefish حيوان. The flamboyant cuttlefish is a small, vibrantly colored cephalopod that walks along the seafloor on its tentacles. It displays pulsating patterns of yellow, maroon, and white as a warning to predators.

common-cuttlefish.funFact: Can hypnotize prey with rapidly changing color patterns.
common-cuttlefish.name: Common Cuttlefish
common-cuttlefish.description: Common Cuttlefish حيوان. The common cuttlefish is a highly intelligent cephalopod with W-shaped pupils and an internal cuttlebone used for buoyancy. It is renowned for its extraordinary ability to change color and texture.

chambered-nautilus.funFact: Has remained virtually unchanged for over 500 million years.
chambered-nautilus.name: Chambered Nautilus
chambered-nautilus.description: Chambered Nautilus حيوان. The chambered nautilus is a cephalopod often called a living fossil, having existed since before the dinosaurs. Its beautiful spiral shell is divided into chambers used for buoyancy control.

argonaut.funFact: Females create a paper-thin shell for egg protection, the only octopus to do so.
argonaut.name: Argonaut
argonaut.description: Argonaut حيوان. The argonaut, or paper nautilus, is a pelagic octopus where only females produce a delicate calcareous shell. Males are much smaller and lack shells entirely.

vampire-squid.funFact: Is neither a true squid nor a true octopus but occupies its own order.
vampire-squid.name: Vampire Squid
vampire-squid.description: Vampire Squid حيوان. The vampire squid inhabits the deep ocean's oxygen minimum zones. Despite its name, it feeds on marine snow rather than prey, and can turn itself inside out as a defense mechanism.

strawberry-squid.funFact: Has photophores covering its body that produce a strawberry-red glow to camouflage against predators.
strawberry-squid.name: Strawberry Squid
strawberry-squid.description: Strawberry Squid حيوان. The strawberry squid is a deep-sea cephalopod covered in light-producing photophores. Its red coloring is invisible in the deep ocean, providing effective camouflage against predators.

cockatoo-squid.funFact: Inflates its body with seawater to appear larger and more intimidating to predators.
cockatoo-squid.name: Cockatoo Squid
cockatoo-squid.description: Cockatoo Squid حيوان. The cockatoo squid is a small, translucent deep-sea cephalopod that inflates its body like a balloon when threatened. Its distinctive appearance resembles a cockatoo with its arms raised.

pajama-squid.funFact: Has a distinctive black-and-white striped pattern resembling striped pajamas.
pajama-squid.name: Pajama Squid
pajama-squid.description: Pajama Squid حيوان. The pajama squid is a small, nocturnal cephalopod with distinctive black and white stripes. It buries itself in sand during the day and emerges at night to hunt small crustaceans.

bobtail-squid.funFact: Harbors bioluminescent bacteria in a specialized light organ for counter-illumination camouflage.
bobtail-squid.name: Bobtail Squid
bobtail-squid.description: Bobtail Squid حيوان. Bobtail squids are small, round cephalopods that partner with bioluminescent bacteria. The bacteria produce light that matches the moonlight from above, eliminating the squid's shadow.

pygmy-squid.funFact: Uses a sticky gland on its nose to attach itself to seagrass blades.
pygmy-squid.name: Pygmy Squid
pygmy-squid.description: Pygmy Squid حيوان. The pygmy squid is one of the smallest cephalopods, reaching barely an inch long. It uses a special adhesive gland to attach itself to seagrass blades, waiting to ambush passing prey.

american-lobster.funFact: Can live over 100 years and keep growing throughout its life.
american-lobster.name: American Lobster
american-lobster.description: American Lobster حيوان. The American lobster is a large marine crustacean prized as a delicacy. It uses its powerful claws for defense and crushing prey, and can regenerate lost limbs during molting.

european-lobster.funFact: Can weigh up to 28 pounds and is one of the largest crustaceans in European waters.
european-lobster.name: European Lobster
european-lobster.description: European Lobster حيوان. The European lobster is a large, deep-blue crustacean found along rocky coastlines. It is a solitary nocturnal hunter that preys on fish, crabs, and mollusks.

spiny-lobster.funFact: Lacks large claws and instead produces loud rasping sounds to deter predators.
spiny-lobster.name: Spiny Lobster
spiny-lobster.description: Spiny Lobster حيوان. Spiny lobsters are colorful crustaceans found in tropical marine environments. Unlike true lobsters, they lack large front claws and instead rely on their spiny antennae and a unique alarm call.

slipper-lobster.funFact: Has distinctive plate-like antennae that resemble slipper soles.
slipper-lobster.name: Slipper Lobster
slipper-lobster.description: Slipper Lobster حيوان. Slipper lobsters are robust crustaceans recognized by their flattened, slipper-shaped antennae. They are bottom-dwellers that hunt mollusks and other invertebrates at night.

mantis-shrimp.funFact: Can punch with the force of a .22 caliber bullet, breaking aquarium glass.
mantis-shrimp.name: Mantis Shrimp
mantis-shrimp.description: Mantis Shrimp حيوان. The mantis shrimp is a strikingly colored crustacean with the fastest punch in the animal kingdom. It possesses the most complex eyes known, with 16 types of color receptors compared to humans' three.

peacock-mantis-shrimp.funFact: Can see 16 types of color receptors and perceives ultraviolet and polarized light.
peacock-mantis-shrimp.name: Peacock Mantis Shrimp
peacock-mantis-shrimp.description: Peacock Mantis Shrimp حيوان. The peacock mantis shrimp is one of the most colorful and formidable predators in the reef. Its club-like appendages strike with incredible speed and force, capable of shattering glass aquariums.

spearer-mantis-shrimp.funFact: Has barbed, spear-like appendages for impaling soft-bodied prey like fish.
spearer-mantis-shrimp.name: Spearer Mantis Shrimp
spearer-mantis-shrimp.description: Spearer Mantis Shrimp حيوان. Spearer mantis shrimp are ambush predators that wait at the entrance of their mud burrows. They strike passing prey with barbed, spear-like appendages that can impale fish in milliseconds.

blue-crab.funFact: Named for its bright blue claws used in mating displays.
blue-crab.name: Blue Crab
blue-crab.description: Blue Crab حيوان. The blue crab is a commercially important species found along the Atlantic coast of North America. It is an aggressive swimmer and opportunistic feeder that plays a key role in estuarine ecosystems.

king-crab.funFact: Its spiny shell can span over 5 feet from leg tip to leg tip.
king-crab.name: Red King Crab
king-crab.description: Red King Crab حيوان. The red king crab is one of the largest crabs in the world, prized commercially in Alaska and Russia. Its massive, spiny legs can span over five feet and it can walk up to 100 miles during its annual migration.

japanese-spider-crab.funFact: Has the largest leg span of any arthropod, up to 12 feet across.
japanese-spider-crab.name: Japanese Spider Crab
japanese-spider-crab.description: Japanese Spider Crab حيوان. The Japanese spider crab holds the record for the largest leg span of any living arthropod. Despite its enormous size, it is a gentle giant that scavenges on the ocean floor.

hermit-crab.funFact: Must find and upgrade to larger shells as it grows throughout its life.
hermit-crab.name: Hermit Crab
hermit-crab.description: Hermit Crab حيوان. Hermit crabs are decapod crustaceans that use abandoned snail shells to protect their soft abdomens. They are social animals often found in groups, and play dead when threatened.

coconut-crab.funFact: Has the strongest grip of any animal, strong enough to crack open coconuts.
coconut-crab.name: Coconut Crab
coconut-crab.description: Coconut Crab حيوان. The coconut crab is the largest terrestrial arthropod, capable of cracking coconuts with its powerful claws. Despite its name, it lives primarily on land but must return to the sea to reproduce.

snow-crab.funFact: Can tolerate near-freezing water temperatures as low as 0.5 degrees Celsius.
snow-crab.name: Snow Crab
snow-crab.description: Snow Crab حيوان. The snow crab is a cold-water species that lives on sandy and muddy bottoms. It is an important commercial species in both the Atlantic and Pacific, known for its sweet, tender meat.

fiddler-crab.funFact: Males have one enormous claw they wave to attract mates.
fiddler-crab.name: Fiddler Crab
fiddler-crab.description: Fiddler Crab حيوان. Fiddler crabs are small semiterrestrial crabs recognized by the male's single oversized claw used in elaborate mating dances. They are important ecosystem engineers in mangrove and marsh habitats.

mud-crab.funFact: Can grow to 5 pounds and has claws strong enough to sever a human finger.
mud-crab.name: Mud Crab
mud-crab.description: Mud Crab حيوان. The mud crab is a robust species found in mangrove ecosystems across the Indo-Pacific. It is one of the most commercially important crabs in aquaculture, prized for its sweet, firm meat.

atlantic-ghost-crab.funFact: Can run up to 10 mph and has stalked eyes that provide 360-degree vision.
atlantic-ghost-crab.name: Atlantic Ghost Crab
atlantic-ghost-crab.description: Atlantic Ghost Crab حيوان. Ghost crabs are pale, fast-moving crustaceans that burrow in sandy beaches. They are mostly nocturnal and use their large stalked eyes and acute hearing to detect predators and prey.

tropical-hermit-crab.funFact: Some individuals live in groups of over 100, sharing shells in a chain.
tropical-hermit-crab.name: Tropical Hermit Crab
tropical-hermit-crab.description: Tropical Hermit Crab حيوان. Tropical hermit crabs are colorful land-dwelling crustaceans that inhabit beaches and coastal forests. They are highly social and often form shell exchange chains to ensure all members have appropriate shelter.

coconut-hermit-crab.funFact: Often found in coconut shells and can grow large enough to use coconut husks as shelters.
coconut-hermit-crab.name: Coconut Hermit Crab
coconut-hermit-crab.description: Coconut Hermit Crab حيوان. The coconut hermit crab is a large land-dwelling species that inhabits tropical island beaches. It is known for its habit of using coconut shells as mobile homes and feeding on fallen coconuts.

zebra-fiddler-crab.funFact: Males wave their oversized claw in a unique rhythm specific to their species.
zebra-fiddler-crab.name: Zebra Fiddler Crab
zebra-fiddler-crab.description: Zebra Fiddler Crab حيوان. The zebra fiddler crab is named for the distinctive stripes on its carapace. Males perform elaborate claw-waving displays to attract females and defend territory on tropical mudflats.

great-spider-crab.funFact: Often decorates its shell with sponges and algae for camouflage.
great-spider-crab.name: Great Spider Crab
great-spider-crab.description: Great Spider Crab حيوان. The great spider crab is a camouflaged crustacean that attaches organisms to its shell for disguise. It migrates in large numbers to shallow waters for mating each autumn.

swimming-crab.funFact: Has paddle-shaped back legs that allow it to swim rapidly through the water.
swimming-crab.name: Portunus Swimming Crab
swimming-crab.description: Portunus Swimming Crab حيوان. Swimming crabs are agile crustaceans with modified rear legs that function as paddles. They are aggressive predators that can pursue prey through the water column with remarkable speed.

common-shore-shrimp.funFact: Can cling tightly to rocks to survive powerful wave action.
common-shore-shrimp.name: Common Shore Shrimp
common-shore-shrimp.description: Common Shore Shrimp حيوان. Common shore shrimp are small crustaceans inhabiting the turbulent intertidal zone. They use specialized appendages to cling to rocks and forage among algae and barnacles for food.

antarctic-krill.funFact: Forms swarms of billions of individuals visible from space.
antarctic-krill.name: Antarctic Krill
antarctic-krill.description: Antarctic Krill حيوان. Antarctic krill are small crustaceans that form the foundation of the Antarctic marine food web. Swarms can contain billions of individuals and are a critical food source for whales, seals, and penguins.

pacific-krill.funFact: Is the primary food source for North Pacific right whales.
pacific-krill.name: Pacific Krill
pacific-krill.description: Pacific Krill حيوان. Pacific krill are tiny shrimp-like crustaceans that swarm in massive numbers in the North Pacific. They are essential to the marine food web, feeding on phytoplankton and being consumed by larger marine life.

atlantic-krill.funFact: Forms dense swarms that can extend for miles and contain trillions of individuals.
atlantic-krill.name: Atlantic Krill
atlantic-krill.description: Atlantic Krill حيوان. Atlantic krill are small pelagic crustaceans found throughout the North Atlantic. They are a keystone species, supporting populations of cod, herring, whales, and numerous seabirds.

giant-amphipod.funFact: Can grow up to 20 times larger than typical amphipods.
giant-amphipod.name: Giant Amphipod
giant-amphipod.description: Giant Amphipod حيوان. Giant amphipods are deep-sea crustaceans found in ocean trenches up to 10,000 meters deep. Their enormous size compared to shallow-water relatives is an example of deep-sea gigantism.

giant-isopod.funFact: Can survive up to 5 years without eating by slowing its metabolism.
giant-isopod.name: Giant Isopod
giant-isopod.description: Giant Isopod حيوان. Giant isopods are deep-sea crustaceans that can grow up to 14 inches long. They are scavengers that feed on whale falls and other organic material that sinks to the ocean floor.

lions-mane-jellyfish.funFact: Tentacles can exceed 120 feet, rivaling the blue whale in length.
lions-mane-jellyfish.name: Lion's Mane Jellyfish
lions-mane-jellyfish.description: Lion's Mane Jellyfish حيوان. The lion's mane jellyfish is the largest known jellyfish species. Its mass of long, trailing tentacles resembles a lion's mane and can extend far beyond its bell diameter.

portuguese-man-of-war.funFact: Is actually a colony of four specialized organisms called zooids, not a single animal.
portuguese-man-of-war.name: Portuguese Man-of-War
portuguese-man-of-war.description: Portuguese Man-of-War حيوان. The Portuguese man-of-war is a siphonophore, not a true jellyfish. Its iconic blue float sails on the surface while trailing long, venomous tentacles that can deliver an extremely painful sting.

pacific-sea-nettle.funFact: Its golden-brown bell and long trailing tentacles make it one of the most beautiful jellyfish.
pacific-sea-nettle.name: Pacific Sea Nettle
pacific-sea-nettle.description: Pacific Sea Nettle حيوان. The Pacific sea nettle is a large, visually striking jellyfish with a rusty-orange bell and long, coiling tentacles. It feeds on zooplankton, fish eggs, and other jellyfish.

upside-down-jellyfish.funFact: Rests upside-down on the seafloor to expose symbiotic algae to sunlight.
upside-down-jellyfish.name: Upside-Down Jellyfish
upside-down-jellyfish.description: Upside-Down Jellyfish حيوان. The upside-down jellyfish, or Cassiopea, lies bell-down on the substrate to maximize photosynthesis by its symbiotic algae. It pulses gently to circulate water and capture food particles.

immortal-jellyfish.funFact: Can revert from its adult form back to its juvenile polyp stage, effectively reversing aging.
immortal-jellyfish.name: Immortal Jellyfish
immortal-jellyfish.description: Immortal Jellyfish حيوان. The immortal jellyfish, Turritopsis dohrnii, is biologically immortal. When stressed or aging, it reverts to its polyp form and begins its life cycle anew, making it the only known creature capable of true rejuvenation.

sea-wasp.funFact: Considered the most venomous marine animal, capable of killing a human in minutes.
sea-wasp.name: Sea Wasp
sea-wasp.description: Sea Wasp حيوان. The sea wasp, or Chironex fleckeri, is the largest and most dangerous box jellyfish. Its nearly invisible body and incredibly potent venom make it one of the deadliest creatures in the ocean.

compass-jellyfish.funFact: Has distinctive brown V-shaped markings on its bell resembling a compass rose.
compass-jellyfish.name: Compass Jellyfish
compass-jellyfish.description: Compass Jellyfish حيوان. The compass jellyfish is easily identified by the brown radiating lines on its translucent bell that resemble compass markings. It feeds on small fish and other jellyfish.

fried-egg-jellyfish.funFact: Its bell closely resembles a fried egg, with a yellow center surrounded by white.
fried-egg-jellyfish.name: Fried Egg Jellyfish
fried-egg-jellyfish.description: Fried Egg Jellyfish حيوان. The fried egg jellyfish, or Cotylorhiza tuberculata, is a visually striking species with a bell that looks remarkably like a fried egg. Despite its large size, its sting is relatively mild.

blood-belly-comb-jelly.funFact: Produces brilliant red bioluminescence when disturbed.
blood-belly-comb-jelly.name: Blood Belly Comb Jelly
blood-belly-comb-jelly.description: Blood Belly Comb Jelly حيوان. The blood belly comb jelly is a deep-water ctenophore found in the Mediterranean. When threatened, it produces vivid red bioluminescence, creating a spectacular display in the dark waters.

atolla-jellyfish.funFact: Produces a pinwheel of bioluminescent light when attacked, known as a burglar alarm.
atolla-jellyfish.name: Atolla Jellyfish
atolla-jellyfish.description: Atolla Jellyfish حيوان. The Atolla jellyfish inhabits the deep ocean and is famous for its burglar alarm display. When attacked, it produces a rotating wheel of blue bioluminescence to attract larger predators that may attack its attacker.

spotted-jelly.funFact: Has distinctive brown spots on its translucent bell that give it its name.
spotted-jelly.name: Spotted Jelly
spotted-jelly.description: Spotted Jelly حيوان. The spotted jelly is a rhizostome jellyfish with a translucent bell covered in brown spots. It feeds on plankton and small organisms using oral arms lined with tiny mouth openings.

mauve-stinger.funFact: Can bloom in massive swarms that disrupt fisheries and aquaculture operations.
mauve-stinger.name: Mauve Stinger
mauve-stinger.description: Mauve Stinger حيوان. The mauve stinger is a deep-water jellyfish with a distinctive reddish-purple bell covered in nematocyst clusters. It forms massive blooms in open ocean waters.

staghorn-coral.funFact: Can grow up to 8 inches per year, making it one of the fastest-growing corals.
staghorn-coral.name: Staghorn Coral
staghorn-coral.description: Staghorn Coral حيوان. Staghorn coral is a critically endangered branching coral species. Once dominant in Caribbean reefs, its populations have declined by over 80% due to disease, bleaching, and predation.

brain-coral.funFact: Can live for nearly a millennium, making it one of the longest-lived organisms on Earth.
brain-coral.name: Brain Coral
brain-coral.description: Brain Coral حيوان. Brain coral is named for its spherical shape and the winding grooves on its surface that resemble a human brain. It is a slow-growing but extremely long-lived reef-building species.

elkhorn-coral.funFact: Named for its broad, antler-like branches that resemble elk horns.
elkhorn-coral.name: Elkhorn Coral
elkhorn-coral.description: Elkhorn Coral حيوان. Elkhorn coral is a critically endangered species that once formed vast reefs throughout the Caribbean. Its large, branching colonies provide essential habitat for hundreds of reef species.

pillar-coral.funFact: One of the rarest corals, with no known young produced since 1998 in Florida.
pillar-coral.name: Pillar Coral
pillar-coral.description: Pillar Coral حيوان. Pillar coral is one of the rarest reef-building corals, distinguished by its tall, cylindrical columns that rise from the reef. It is listed as critically endangered with populations plummeting.

fire-coral.funFact: Not a true coral but a colony of hydrozoans that delivers a painful sting.
fire-coral.name: Fire Coral
fire-coral.description: Fire Coral حيوان. Fire coral is a colony-forming hydrozoan that looks like true coral but delivers a painful sting on contact. Its smooth, branching colonies are typically brown, yellow, or reddish in color.

blue-coral.funFact: The only reef-building coral with a blue skeleton, caused by iron salts in its skeleton.
blue-coral.name: Blue Coral
blue-coral.description: Blue Coral حيوان. Blue coral is a unique reef-building species with a distinctive blue skeleton. It is one of the few corals that can survive in turbid, low-light environments where other corals cannot.

mushroom-coral.funFact: Unlike most corals, mushroom corals are free-living and can move short distances.
mushroom-coral.name: Mushroom Coral
mushroom-coral.description: Mushroom Coral حيوان. Mushroom corals are solitary, free-living scleractinian corals shaped like mushrooms. Unlike colonial species, each is a single polyp that can detach and roll across the substrate.

black-coral.funFact: Some colonies have been dated to over 4,000 years old, making them the oldest living organisms on Earth.
black-coral.name: Black Coral
black-coral.description: Black Coral حيوان. Black corals are deep-water colonial organisms with a black or dark brown skeleton. They are among the longest-lived organisms on Earth, with some colonies surviving for millennia.

sea-pen.funFact: Is a colony of polyps anchored in sediment, with some species producing bioluminescent waves when disturbed.
sea-pen.name: Sea Pen
sea-pen.description: Sea Pen حيوان. Sea pens are colonial cnidarians that resemble old-fashioned quill pens. They anchor in soft sediment and can produce bioluminescent waves of light that travel along their colonies.

sea-whip.funFact: Some species produce a compound used in cancer research.
sea-whip.name: Sea Whip
sea-whip.description: Sea Whip حيوان. Sea whips are octocoral colonies that grow in long, whip-like branches. They are filter feeders that extend polyps into the current to capture plankton and organic particles.

sunflower-sea-star.funFact: Can have up to 24 arms and is one of the largest sea stars in the world.
sunflower-sea-star.name: Sunflower Sea Star
sunflower-sea-star.description: Sunflower Sea Star حيوان. The sunflower sea star is one of the largest and fastest sea stars, but populations have crashed by over 90% due to sea star wasting disease. It is now listed as critically endangered.

crown-of-thorns-starfish.funFact: Can consume up to 10 square feet of coral per year.
crown-of-thorns-starfish.name: Crown-of-Thorns Starfish
crown-of-thorns-starfish.description: Crown-of-Thorns Starfish حيوان. The crown-of-thorns starfish is a large, multi-armed sea star covered in venomous spines. It is a significant coral predator whose population outbreaks can devastate reef ecosystems.

blue-sea-star.funFact: Its brilliant blue color comes from a pigment that may protect against UV radiation.
blue-sea-star.name: Blue Sea Star
blue-sea-star.description: Blue Sea Star حيوان. The blue sea star is a strikingly colored echinoderm that lives on sandy substrates. It feeds on small invertebrates buried in the sand and can regenerate lost arms.

leather-star.funFact: Has a smooth, leathery texture unlike the rough surface of most sea stars.
leather-star.name: Leather Star
leather-star.description: Leather Star حيوان. The leather star is a smooth-skinned sea star found on rocky reefs. It has a distinctive reddish-brown color and a unique garlic-like odor when handled.

common-brittle-star.funFact: Can detach an arm to escape predators, later regenerating it.
common-brittle-star.name: Common Brittle Star
common-brittle-star.description: Common Brittle Star حيوان. Brittle stars are echinoderms with a distinct central disc and five long, slender arms. They are more agile than sea stars, moving by writhing their arms across the seabed.

giant-basket-star.funFact: Has thousands of branching arm tips that can entrap plankton and small organisms.
giant-basket-star.name: Giant Basket Star
giant-basket-star.description: Giant Basket Star حيوان. The giant basket star is a spectacular echinoderm with a complex network of branching arms. At night, it unfurls its arms into the current to capture plankton and small crustaceans.

feather-star.funFact: Can swim by rhythmically waving its feathery arms through the water.
feather-star.name: Feather Star
feather-star.description: Feather Star حيوان. Feather stars are mobile crinoids that cling to coral or swim through the water column. Their feathery arms filter plankton from passing currents, and they can detach to relocate when conditions change.

crinoid-feather-star.funFact: Can detach from its substrate and swim to relocate when conditions are unfavorable.
crinoid-feather-star.name: Crinoid Feather Star
crinoid-feather-star.description: Crinoid Feather Star حيوان. Crinoid feather stars are ancient echinoderms related to sea lilies. They perch on coral heads and wave their feathery arms to capture passing plankton from ocean currents.

disk-brittle-star.funFact: Can regenerate entire arms and even the central disc if detached.
disk-brittle-star.name: Disk-Brittle Star
disk-brittle-star.description: Disk-Brittle Star حيوان. The disk-brittle star is a small, agile echinoderm found in rock crevices and under stones. It is an opportunistic feeder that can regenerate lost body parts rapidly.

purple-sea-urchin.funFact: Can bore into solid rock using its specialized jaw apparatus called Aristotle's lantern.
purple-sea-urchin.name: Purple Sea Urchin
purple-sea-urchin.description: Purple Sea Urchin حيوان. The purple sea urchin is a spiny echinoderm that inhabits rocky shores. It uses its five-toothed jaw, Aristotle's lantern, to scrape algae and even excavate burrows in solid rock.

long-spined-sea-urchin.funFact: Spines can be over a foot long and are mildly venomous.
long-spined-sea-urchin.name: Long-Spined Sea Urchin
long-spined-sea-urchin.description: Long-Spined Sea Urchin حيوان. Long-spined sea urchins are tropical echinoderms with extremely long, sharp spines that provide excellent defense. They play a critical role in controlling algal growth on coral reefs.

pencil-urchin.funFact: Has thick, blunt spines that resemble pencils, unlike typical sharp urchin spines.
pencil-urchin.name: Pencil Urchin
pencil-urchin.description: Pencil Urchin حيوان. Pencil urchins are named for their thick, cylindrical spines that look like colored pencils. They inhabit tropical reefs where they graze on algae using their complex jaw apparatus.

green-sea-urchin.funFact: Can live for over 30 years, making it one of the longest-lived sea urchins.
green-sea-urchin.name: Green Sea Urchin
green-sea-urchin.description: Green Sea Urchin حيوان. The green sea urchin is a cold-water species found on rocky substrates. It is an important herbivore in kelp forest ecosystems, controlling algal growth and providing food for sea otters.

flower-urchin.funFact: Covered in flower-like structures called pedicellariae that deliver a painful venom.
flower-urchin.name: Flower Urchin
flower-urchin.description: Flower Urchin حيوان. The flower urchin is one of the most dangerous sea urchins, covered in venomous flower-shaped pedicellariae. Despite its beautiful appearance, contact causes intense pain and potential tissue damage.

sand-dollar.funFact: The petal-like pattern on its skeleton is actually five sets of tube feet used for breathing.
sand-dollar.name: Sand Dollar
sand-dollar.description: Sand Dollar حيوان. Sand dollars are flat, burrowing sea urchins found on sandy ocean floors. Their flattened bodies and fine spines allow them to bury themselves just beneath the sediment surface.

carpenter-sea-urchin.funFact: Has particularly strong teeth that can bore through solid coral rock.
carpenter-sea-urchin.name: Carpenter Sea Urchin
carpenter-sea-urchin.description: Carpenter Sea Urchin حيوان. The carpenter sea urchin is named for its ability to excavate burrows in solid coral rock. Its powerful Aristotle's lantern allows it to bore into reef substrates for shelter.

fire-urchin.funFact: Has venomous spines that cause intense burning pain, resembling a fire ant sting.
fire-urchin.name: Fire Urchin
fire-urchin.description: Fire Urchin حيوان. The fire urchin is a striking red echinoderm with venomous spines that deliver an intensely painful sting. Despite its danger, it provides a symbiotic home for certain shrimp and crabs.

slate-pencil-urchin.funFact: Has thick, blunt spines that were historically used as writing instruments.
slate-pencil-urchin.name: Slate Pencil Urchin
slate-pencil-urchin.description: Slate Pencil Urchin حيوان. Slate pencil urchins are named for their thick, blunt spines that resemble slate pencils. These colorful echinoderms inhabit tropical reefs where they graze on algae.

tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.funFact: Can eject sticky, toxic tubules from its body to entangle predators.
tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.name: Tiger Tail Sea Cucumber
tiger-tail-sea-cucumber.description: Tiger Tail Sea Cucumber حيوان. The tiger tail sea cucumber is a large, conspicuous species with distinctive dark stripes. It is an important bioturbator, processing sediment and recycling nutrients in tropical marine ecosystems.

lolly-sea-cucumber.funFact: Has a distinctive tube-like body that resembles a lollipop.
lolly-sea-cucumber.name: Lolly Sea Cucumber
lolly-sea-cucumber.description: Lolly Sea Cucumber حيوان. The lolly sea cucumber is a small, cylindrical species that processes sand and sediment on tropical reefs. It plays a vital role in reef health by recycling organic matter.

pacific-sea-cucumber.funFact: Is commercially harvested as a delicacy in Asian cuisine, known as beche-de-mer.
pacific-sea-cucumber.name: Pacific Sea Cucumber
pacific-sea-cucumber.description: Pacific Sea Cucumber حيوان. The Pacific sea cucumber is an ecologically important detritivore that processes vast quantities of sediment. It is commercially harvested and considered a culinary delicacy in many Asian cultures.

black-sea-cucumber.funFact: Can detach and regrow its internal organs when stressed, a process called evisceration.
black-sea-cucumber.name: Black Sea Cucumber
black-sea-cucumber.description: Black Sea Cucumber حيوان. The black sea cucumber is a large, commercially valuable species found on tropical reefs. It ejects its internal organs as a defense mechanism and later regenerates them completely.

teatfish-sea-cucumber.funFact: One of the most commercially valuable sea cucumber species, sold as beche-de-mer.
teatfish-sea-cucumber.name: Teatfish Sea Cucumber
teatfish-sea-cucumber.description: Teatfish Sea Cucumber حيوان. The teatfish is a large, highly valued sea cucumber that has been overexploited for the Asian beche-de-mer trade. Its distinctive nipple-like projections give it its common name.

red-sea-cucumber.funFact: Uses tube feet along its underside to slowly crawl across the seafloor.
red-sea-cucumber.name: Red Sea Cucumber
red-sea-cucumber.description: Red Sea Cucumber حيوان. The red sea cucumber is a common species in Pacific kelp forests. It grazes on detritus and algae on rocky substrates, playing an important role in nutrient cycling.

christmas-tree-worm.funFact: Can retract its colorful spiral plumes into its tube in less than a second.
christmas-tree-worm.name: Christmas Tree Worm
christmas-tree-worm.description: Christmas Tree Worm حيوان. Christmas tree worms are tubeworms that burrow into living coral colonies. Their colorful, spiral-shaped radioles filter plankton from the water and can retract instantly when disturbed.

giant-tubeworm.funFact: Has no mouth, stomach, or gut, relying entirely on symbiotic bacteria for nutrition.
giant-tubeworm.name: Giant Tube Worm
giant-tubeworm.description: Giant Tube Worm حيوان. Giant tube worms are extraordinary deep-sea organisms that thrive at hydrothermal vents. They rely on chemosynthetic bacteria housed in a special organ called the trophosome for all nutrition.

feather-duster-worm.funFact: Its feathery crown of tentacles is used for both feeding and respiration.
feather-duster-worm.name: Feather Duster Worm
feather-duster-worm.description: Feather Duster Worm حيوان. Feather duster worms are sedentary polychaetes that construct tubes on reef surfaces. Their spectacular crown of feathery tentacles filters plankton and can retract rapidly when threatened.

bearded-fireworm.funFact: Has hollow, venom-filled bristles that cause intense burning pain on contact.
bearded-fireworm.name: Bearded Fireworm
bearded-fireworm.description: Bearded Fireworm حيوان. The bearded fireworm is a predatory polychaete with venomous bristles called chaetae. Contact with these white, hair-like structures causes severe pain, inflammation, and numbness.

blue-glaucus.funFact: Floats upside-down on the surface tension of the water, using stored air bubbles.
blue-glaucus.name: Blue Glaucus
blue-glaucus.description: Blue Glaucus حيوان. The blue glaucus, or blue dragon, is a tiny, vibrant blue sea slug that floats upside-down on the ocean surface. It stores stinging cells from its prey for its own defense.

spanish-dancer.funFact: Named for its spectacular undulating swimming motion that resembles a flamenco dancer.
spanish-dancer.name: Spanish Dancer
spanish-dancer.description: Spanish Dancer حيوان. The Spanish dancer is one of the largest and most colorful nudibranchs. When swimming, it unfurls its brilliant red and white mantle in a mesmerizing undulating display.

leaf-sheep.funFact: Is one of the only animals capable of photosynthesis, stealing chloroplasts from algae.
leaf-sheep.name: Leaf Sheep
leaf-sheep.description: Leaf Sheep حيوان. The leaf sheep, or Costasiella kuroshimae, is a tiny sea slug that can photosynthesize like a plant. It steals chloroplasts from the algae it eats and stores them in its body to produce energy.

sea-butterfly.funFact: Swims by flapping its wing-like shell extensions, resembling a butterfly in flight.
sea-butterfly.name: Sea Butterfly
sea-butterfly.description: Sea Butterfly حيوان. Sea butterflies are tiny marine snails that swim through the open ocean by flapping their wing-like shell extensions. They are an important food source for fish, whales, and seabirds.

sea-angel.funFact: Is a shell-less snail that swims with graceful wing-like movements.
sea-angel.name: Sea Angel
sea-angel.description: Sea Angel حيوان. Sea angels are gelatinous, transparent marine gastropods that lack shells. They swim through cold ocean waters by flapping wing-like appendages and prey on sea butterflies.

sea-hare.funFact: Can release a cloud of purple ink when threatened, confusing predators.
sea-hare.name: California Sea Hare
sea-hare.description: California Sea Hare حيوان. The California sea hare is a large marine gastropod named for its ear-like rhinophores. It feeds on kelp and seaweed and can release a cloud of purple ink as a defense mechanism.

giant-clam.funFact: Can weigh over 500 pounds and live for more than 100 years.
giant-clam.name: Giant Clam
giant-clam.description: Giant Clam حيوان. The giant clam is the largest living bivalve mollusk, reaching over four feet in length. Its colorful mantle harbors symbiotic algae that provide much of its nutrition through photosynthesis.

geoduck.funFact: Can live for over 160 years, making it one of the longest-living animals on Earth.
geoduck.name: Geoduck
geoduck.description: Geoduck حيوان. The geoduck is the largest burrowing clam in the world, with a siphon that can extend three feet. Native to the Pacific Northwest, it is a prized delicacy in Asian cuisine.

atlantic-surf-clam.funFact: Can propel itself out of the sand using its muscular foot when disturbed.
atlantic-surf-clam.name: Atlantic Surf Clam
atlantic-surf-clam.description: Atlantic Surf Clam حيوان. The Atlantic surf clam is a large bivalve found on sandy substrates. It uses its powerful foot to burrow and can explosively eject itself from the sand when threatened by predators.

bay-scallop.funFact: Can swim short distances by rapidly clapping its shell valves together.
bay-scallop.name: Bay Scallop
bay-scallop.description: Bay Scallop حيوان. Bay scallops are small, fan-shaped bivalves that live in shallow coastal waters. Unlike most clams, they can swim by rapidly clapping their valves, ejecting water for propulsion.

blue-mussel.funFact: Attaches to rocks using strong byssal threads, forming dense beds of thousands.
blue-mussel.name: Blue Mussel
blue-mussel.description: Blue Mussel حيوان. Blue mussels are filter-feeding bivalves that attach to rocks with strong byssal threads. They form dense beds that provide habitat for numerous other species and are commercially cultivated.

thorny-oyster.funFact: Shell is covered in long, sharp spines that deter predators.
thorny-oyster.name: Thorny Oyster
thorny-oyster.description: Thorny Oyster حيوان. The thorny oyster is a large, spiny bivalve that cements itself to reef substrates. Its long, sharp spines protect it from predators and can cause painful wounds if touched.

lion-paw-scallop.funFact: Named for its ridged, colorful shell that resembles a lion's paw.
lion-paw-scallop.name: Lion Paw Scallop
lion-paw-scallop.description: Lion Paw Scallop حيوان. The lion paw scallop is a large, colorful bivalve with a distinctive ridged shell. It can swim by clapping its valves and is found in kelp forests along the Pacific coast.

nautilus-pompilius.funFact: Shell follows a logarithmic spiral, one of nature's most perfect mathematical forms.
nautilus-pompilius.name: Nautilus Pompilius
nautilus-pompilius.description: Nautilus Pompilius حيوان. Nautilus pompilius is a cephalopod with a beautiful, spiraled shell that has inspired artists and mathematicians for centuries. It is a living fossil, virtually unchanged for 500 million years.

paper-nautilus.funFact: Females create a delicate, paper-thin shell for egg protection.
paper-nautilus.name: Paper Nautilus
paper-nautilus.description: Paper Nautilus حيوان. The paper nautilus is an argonaut octopus in which only females produce a fragile, calcareous shell. Males are much smaller and shell-less, using a specialized arm to transfer sperm.

atlantic-horseshoe-crab.funFact: Has been virtually unchanged for 450 million years, predating the dinosaurs.
atlantic-horseshoe-crab.name: Atlantic Horseshoe Crab
atlantic-horseshoe-crab.description: Atlantic Horseshoe Crab حيوان. The Atlantic horseshoe crab is a marine arthropod often called a living fossil. Despite its name, it is more closely related to spiders and scorpions than to true crabs.

japanese-horseshoe-crab.funFact: Its blue blood contains Limulus Amebocyte Lysate, used to test for bacterial contamination in medical equipment.
japanese-horseshoe-crab.name: Japanese Horseshoe Crab
japanese-horseshoe-crab.description: Japanese Horseshoe Crab حيوان. The Japanese horseshoe crab is an endangered species whose unique blue blood is vital to modern medicine. The substance in its blood detects bacterial endotoxins in pharmaceuticals and medical devices.

indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.funFact: Is the only horseshoe crab species found in Asian coastal waters.
indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.name: Indo-Pacific Horseshoe Crab
indo-pacific-horseshoe-crab.description: Indo-Pacific Horseshoe Crab حيوان. The Indo-Pacific horseshoe crab is an endangered marine arthropod found in Southeast Asian coastal waters. Like its Atlantic relative, it has blue blood containing valuable immune cells.

sea-squirt-tunicate.funFact: Is more closely related to vertebrates than most invertebrates, being a chordate.
sea-squirt-tunicate.name: Sea Squirt
sea-squirt-tunicate.description: Sea Squirt حيوان. Sea squirts are tunicates, marine invertebrates that are surprisingly closely related to vertebrates. As larvae they have a notochord, which they lose as adults when they attach to surfaces and become filter feeders.

marine-flatworm.funFact: Can regenerate an entire organism from a fragment as small as 1/200th of its body.
marine-flatworm.name: Marine Flatworm
marine-flatworm.description: Marine Flatworm حيوان. Marine flatworms are colorful, soft-bodied invertebrates that glide across reef surfaces. Despite their simple appearance, they are active predators that can deliver venomous bites.

sea-pen-glow.funFact: Produces bioluminescent waves that travel along its colony when physically disturbed.
sea-pen-glow.name: Deep-Sea Pennatula
sea-pen-glow.description: Deep-Sea Pennatula حيوان. The deep-sea pennatula is a species of sea pen that inhabits deep muddy bottoms. When disturbed, it produces stunning bioluminescent waves that ripple along its colony.

dodo.funFact: The dodo was a flightless bird from Mauritius that went extinct in the late 17th century due to hunting and invasive species.
dodo.name: Dodo
dodo.description: Dodo حيوان. The dodo was a large, flightless bird native to the island of Mauritius in the Indian Ocean. It was related to pigeons and doves but evolved to be completely flightless with no natural predators.

woolly-mammoth.funFact: Woolly mammoths coexisted with early humans and their remains are still found frozen in Siberian permafrost.
woolly-mammoth.name: Woolly Mammoth
woolly-mammoth.description: Woolly Mammoth حيوان. The woolly mammoth was a species of elephant covered in thick fur that lived during the Pleistocene epoch. They roamed the cold tundra regions of North America, Europe, and Asia.

passenger-pigeon.funFact: Passenger pigeons once numbered in the billions and their flocks would darken the sky for hours as they flew overhead.
passenger-pigeon.name: Passenger Pigeon
passenger-pigeon.description: Passenger Pigeon حيوان. The passenger pigeon was once the most abundant bird in North America, with flocks containing billions of individuals. Systematic hunting and habitat destruction led to its extinction in 1914.

tasmanian-tiger.funFact: Despite being called a tiger, it was actually a marsupial more closely related to kangaroos than to big cats.
tasmanian-tiger.name: Tasmanian Tiger
tasmanian-tiger.description: Tasmanian Tiger حيوان. The Tasmanian tiger, or thylacine, was a carnivorous marsupial native to Tasmania, Australia, and New Guinea. The last known individual died in captivity in 1936.

quagga.funFact: The quagga was half-zebra, half-horse with stripes only on the front half of its body. The last one died in 1883.
quagga.name: Quagga
quagga.description: Quagga حيوان. The quagga was a subspecies of plains zebra that lived in South Africa. It was distinguished by its limited striping pattern, with stripes only on the head and front body.

pig.name: Pig
pig.description: The domestic pig is a stout-bodied farm animal raised worldwide for meat and known for its intelligence and social nature.
pig.funFact: Pigs are highly intelligent and can learn tricks like dogs

sheep.name: Sheep
sheep.description: Sheep are woolly ruminants raised for wool, meat and milk, known for flocking behavior.
sheep.funFact: Sheep can recognize up to 50 faces for years

goat.name: Goat
goat.description: Goats are hardy farm animals known for climbing and curiosity, raised for milk, meat and fiber.
goat.funFact: Goats have rectangular pupils for wide vision

horse.name: Horse
horse.description: The horse is a large domesticated hoofed mammal used for riding, work and sport.
horse.funFact: Horses can sleep both standing and lying down

donkey.name: Donkey
donkey.description: Donkeys are sturdy equids used as working animals, known for endurance and strong memory.
donkey.funFact: Donkeys have incredible memory and remember places for 25 years

chicken.name: Chicken
chicken.description: Chickens are domesticated fowl raised for eggs and meat, the most numerous bird on Earth.

duck.name: Duck
duck.description: Ducks are waterfowl raised on farms and found wild on ponds and rivers.
duck.funFact: Duck feathers are waterproof due to oil coating

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.description: Turkeys are large North American game birds domesticated for meat.
turkey.funFact: Turkeys can change head color with mood

alpaca.name: Alpaca
alpaca.description: Alpacas are South American camelids raised for soft fleece, similar to llamas but smaller.
alpaca.funFact: Alpaca fleece is 3x warmer than sheep wool

llama.name: Llama
llama.description: Llamas are domesticated camelids from the Andes used as pack animals and for wool.
llama.funFact: Llamas hum to communicate with each other

unicorn.name: Unicorn
unicorn.description: The unicorn is a legendary horse-like creature with a single spiraled horn, symbol of purity and magic.
unicorn.funFact: Unicorn horns were said to purify poisoned water

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.description: Dragons are legendary giant reptiles with wings and fire breath, guardians of treasure in folklore.
dragon.funFact: Dragons were said to hoard gold and breathe fire

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.description: The phoenix is a mythical fire bird that cyclically regenerates by rising from its ashes.
phoenix.funFact: The phoenix rises from its own ashes every 500 years

griffin.name: Griffin
griffin.description: The griffin has the body of a lion and head and wings of an eagle, a majestic guardian beast.
griffin.funFact: Griffins were said to guard gold mines

pegasus.name: Pegasus
pegasus.description: Pegasus is a winged horse of Greek mythology, born from Medusa and symbol of inspiration.
pegasus.funFact: Pegasus was born from Medusa's blood

mermaid.name: Mermaid
mermaid.description: Mermaids are half-human, half-fish beings who lure sailors with enchanting songs.
mermaid.funFact: Mermaid tears were believed to be pearls

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.description: The Kraken is a colossal sea monster resembling a giant squid, feared by sailors.
kraken.funFact: The Kraken was said to drag entire ships underwater

fairy.name: Fairy
fairy.description: Fairies are tiny winged folk who live in forests and use magic to protect nature.
fairy.funFact: Fairies were said to be 6 inches tall

t-rex.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
t-rex.description: Tyrannosaurus rex was a massive predatory dinosaur of the Late Cretaceous with tiny arms and powerful jaws.
t-rex.funFact: T-Rex had the strongest bite of any terrestrial animal

triceratops.name: Triceratops
triceratops.description: Triceratops was a horned dinosaur with three facial horns and a large frill for defense.
triceratops.funFact: Triceratops had three horns and a bony frill

stegosaurus.name: Stegosaurus
stegosaurus.description: Stegosaurus had distinctive kite-shaped plates along its back and spiked tail.
stegosaurus.funFact: Stegosaurus had a brain the size of a dog's

velociraptor.name: Velociraptor
velociraptor.description: Velociraptor was a feathered predatory dinosaur that hunted in packs.
velociraptor.funFact: Velociraptor was actually turkey-sized, not 2m tall

brachiosaurus.name: Brachiosaurus
brachiosaurus.description: Brachiosaurus was a giant long-necked sauropod that could reach high treetops.
brachiosaurus.funFact: Brachiosaurus was as tall as a 4-story building

pterodactyl.name: Pterodactyl
pterodactyl.description: Pterodactylus was a flying reptile with a wingspan up to 1m that soared over coasts.
pterodactyl.funFact: Pterodactyls were not dinosaurs but flying reptiles

ankylosaurus.name: Ankylosaurus
ankylosaurus.description: Ankylosaurus was an armored dinosaur covered in bony plates with a massive tail club.
ankylosaurus.funFact: Ankylosaurus had a club tail that could break T-Rex bones

brontosaurus.name: Brontosaurus
brontosaurus.description: Brontosaurus was a massive sauropod long thought to be Apatosaurus but now recognized again.

saber-toothed-tiger.name: Saber-Toothed Tiger
saber-toothed-tiger.description: Smilodon, the saber-toothed cat, had enormous curved canines for slashing prey.

hydra.name: Hydra
hydra.description: The Hydra is a multi-headed serpent of Greek myth slain by Heracles.
hydra.funFact: Cutting one head makes two more grow

cerberus.name: Cerberus
cerberus.description: Cerberus is the three-headed dog that guards the entrance to the Greek underworld.
cerberus.funFact: Cerberus guarded the gates of the Underworld

minotaur.name: Minotaur
minotaur.description: The Minotaur is half-man, half-bull imprisoned in the Cretan labyrinth.
minotaur.funFact: The Minotaur lived in a labyrinth on Crete

basilisk.name: Basilisk
basilisk.description: The basilisk is a legendary serpent king whose glance is lethal.
basilisk.funFact: Basilisk gaze could turn victims to stone

leviathan.name: Leviathan
leviathan.description: Leviathan is a colossal sea serpent of Hebrew mythology embodying chaos of the ocean.
leviathan.funFact: Leviathan could create whirlpools that sank ships

thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
thunderbird.description: The Thunderbird is a giant legendary bird of Native American lore that creates thunder.
thunderbird.funFact: Thunderbird wings were said to create thunder

kitsune.name: Kitsune
kitsune.description: Kitsune are nine-tailed fox spirits in Japanese folklore, shape-shifters of great magic.
kitsune.funFact: Kitsune gains a tail every 100 years, up to nine

nessie.name: Loch Ness Monster
nessie.description: Nessie is the legendary long-necked creature said to inhabit Scotland's Loch Ness.
nessie.funFact: First sighting of Nessie was in 565 AD

lop-rabbit.name: Lop Rabbit
lop-rabbit.description: Lop rabbits are domestic bunnies with long floppy ears, beloved as gentle pets.
lop-rabbit.funFact: Lop rabbits' ears flop due to a genetic mutation

persian-cat.name: Persian Cat
persian-cat.description: Persian cats are fluffy long-haired cats with flat faces, known for calm temperament.
persian-cat.funFact: Persian cats are one of the oldest cat breeds

corgi.name: Corgi
corgi.description: Corgis are short-legged Welsh herding dogs famous for cute looks and loyalty.
corgi.funFact: Corgis were herding dogs despite short legs

baby-otter.name: Baby Otter
baby-otter.description: Baby otters are incredibly cute pups that hold hands while sleeping to not drift apart.
baby-otter.funFact: Baby otters cannot swim at birth and must be taught

pika-cute.name: Pika
pika-cute.description: Pikas are tiny mountain hamster-like mammals that make hay piles for winter.
pika-cute.funFact: Pikas say 'meh' and collect tiny haystacks

fennec-cute.name: Fennec Fox
fennec-cute.description: Fennec foxes are desert foxes with enormous ears, often called the cutest fox.
fennec-cute.funFact: Fennec fox kits have oversized ears like their parents

quokka-cute.name: Quokka
quokka-cute.description: Quokkas are small marsupials from Australia famous for selfies and smiles.
quokka-cute.funFact: Quokkas always look like they are smiling

axolotl-cute.name: Axolotl
axolotl-cute.description: Axolotls are cute neotenic salamanders that keep external gills and smile.
axolotl-cute.funFact: Axolotls can regenerate their hearts and brains

hedgehog-cute.name: Hedgehog
hedgehog-cute.description: Hedgehogs are small spiny mammals that curl up when scared, adored for cuteness.
hedgehog-cute.funFact: Hedgehogs have 5000 spines and curl into a ball

sugar-glider-cute.name: Sugar Glider
sugar-glider-cute.description: Sugar gliders are tiny marsupials with a membrane that lets them glide, big-eyed and cute.
sugar-glider-cute.funFact: Sugar gliders can glide 50 meters between trees

centaur.name: Centaur
centaur.description: The centaur is half-human, half-horse, known for wisdom and archery in Greek mythology.
centaur.funFact: Centaurs were expert archers and healers

satyr.name: Satyr
satyr.description: Satyrs are half-goat, half-human forest spirits who love music and revelry.
satyr.funFact: Satyrs played flutes that enchanted travelers

wyvern.name: Wyvern
wyvern.description: The wyvern is a winged dragon with two legs and a barbed tail, often guarding castles.
wyvern.funFact: Wyverns have two legs unlike four-legged dragons

djinn.name: Djinn
djinn.description: Djinn are magical smoke-formed beings from Arabian lore who inhabit deserts and grant wishes.
djinn.funFact: Djinn were said to grant three wishes

golem.name: Golem
golem.description: The golem is a clay giant brought to life by Hebrew magic to protect its creator.
golem.funFact: Golems are animated by a word on their forehead

banshee.name: Banshee
banshee.description: The banshee is a wailing female spirit from Irish folklore whose cry warns of death.
banshee.funFact: Hearing a banshee wail foretold death

leprechaun.name: Leprechaun
leprechaun.description: Leprechauns are tiny shoemaking fairies from Irish myth who hide pots of gold.
leprechaun.funFact: Leprechauns hide gold at the end of rainbows

nymph.name: Nymph
nymph.description: Nymphs are nature spirits inhabiting rivers, trees and mountains in Greek lore.
nymph.funFact: Nymphs could live inside trees or rivers

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.description: The werewolf is a human cursed to become a wolf under the full moon.

yeti.name: Yeti
yeti.description: The Yeti, or Abominable Snowman, is a giant ape-like cryptid of the Himalayas.
yeti.funFact: Yeti footprints can be 45 cm long

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.description: Goblins are small, clever, green-skinned tricksters living in caves and mines.
goblin.funFact: Goblins were master miners and craftsmen

troll.name: Troll
troll.description: Trolls are giant, slow-witted brutes who live under bridges and mountains.
troll.funFact: Trolls turn to stone in sunlight

roc.name: Roc
roc.description: The Roc is a gigantic bird of Arabian myth so large it can carry elephants.
roc.funFact: Roc eggs were said to be 15 meters around

sphinx.name: Sphinx
sphinx.description: The Sphinx has a lion's body, human head and eagle wings, guardian of riddles.
sphinx.funFact: The Sphinx asked riddles to travelers

chimera.name: Chimera
chimera.description: The Chimera is a fire-breathing hybrid of lion, goat and serpent from Greek myth.
chimera.funFact: Chimera had a lion head, goat body and snake tail

siren.name: Siren
siren.description: Sirens are enchanting half-bird, half-women whose songs doom sailors.
siren.funFact: Sirens lured sailors to shipwreck with songs

harpy.name: Harpy
harpy.description: The Harpy is half-woman, half-bird, a swift wind spirit that steals offerings.
harpy.funFact: Harpies were winds spirits that snatched souls

garuda.name: Garuda
garuda.description: Garuda is a giant eagle-like deity, mount of Vishnu and enemy of serpents.
garuda.funFact: Garuda is the king of birds in Hindu myth

qilin.name: Qilin
qilin.description: The Qilin is a gentle Chinese unicorn-deer with dragon scales that brings good fortune.
qilin.funFact: Qilin appears only during peaceful reigns

fenrir.name: Fenrir
fenrir.description: Fenrir is the monstrous wolf of Norse myth destined to devour Odin at Ragnarok.
fenrir.funFact: Fenrir was chained by the gods with magic ribbon

jormungandr.name: Jörmungandr
jormungandr.description: Jörmungandr is the World Serpent of Norse myth, so huge it bites its own tail around Earth.

cyclops.name: Cyclops
cyclops.description: The Cyclops is a one-eyed giant blacksmith of Greek myth who forged divine weapons.

medusa.name: Medusa
medusa.description: Medusa is a Gorgon with snakes for hair whose gaze petrifies victims.
medusa.funFact: Medusa's gaze turned people to stone

anubis.name: Anubis
anubis.description: Anubis is the jackal-headed Egyptian god who guides souls to the afterlife.
anubis.funFact: Anubis weighed hearts against a feather

allosaurus.name: Allosaurus
allosaurus.description: Allosaurus was the top predator of Jurassic North America before T. rex.
allosaurus.funFact: Allosaurus had 32 teeth shaped like steak knives

spinosaurus.name: Spinosaurus
spinosaurus.description: Spinosaurus was a semi-aquatic fish-eating dinosaur larger than T. rex with a distinctive sail.
spinosaurus.funFact: Spinosaurus had a sail 1.8m tall on its back

diplodocus.name: Diplodocus
diplodocus.description: Diplodocus was an extremely long-necked sauropod with a whip-like tail.
diplodocus.funFact: Diplodocus had a tail with 80 vertebrae

parasaurolophus.name: Parasaurolophus
parasaurolophus.description: Parasaurolophus was a crested hadrosaur that could make loud calls through its hollow crest.
parasaurolophus.funFact: Its crest acted like a trumpet

iguanodon.name: Iguanodon
iguanodon.description: Iguanodon was one of the first dinosaurs discovered, with distinctive thumb spikes.
iguanodon.funFact: Iguanodon had thumb spikes for defense

archaeopteryx.name: Archaeopteryx
archaeopteryx.description: Archaeopteryx was a feathered dinosaur-bird that could glide between trees 150 million years ago.
archaeopteryx.funFact: Archaeopteryx is the earliest known bird

mosasaurus.name: Mosasaurus
mosasaurus.description: Mosasaurus was a giant marine reptile that ruled Late Cretaceous seas.
mosasaurus.funFact: Mosasaurus had double-hinged jaws like a snake

plesiosaurus.name: Plesiosaurus
plesiosaurus.description: Plesiosaurus was a long-necked marine reptile that swam with four powerful flippers.
plesiosaurus.funFact: Plesiosaurus had four flippers and a long neck

dimetrodon.name: Dimetrodon
dimetrodon.description: Dimetrodon was a sail-backed synapsid predator that lived 40 million years before T. rex.

woolly-rhino.name: Woolly Rhino
woolly-rhino.description: The woolly rhinoceros was a shaggy-coated rhino that roamed Ice Age Eurasia alongside mammoths.

irish-elk.name: Irish Elk
irish-elk.description: Irish Elk was the largest deer ever, with enormous antlers that spanned over 3 meters.

dire-wolf.name: Dire Wolf
dire-wolf.description: Dire Wolf was a large Ice Age wolf that hunted in packs across North America.
dire-wolf.funFact: Dire wolves were 30% heavier than gray wolves
